title: Multi-objectivization Relaxes Multi-funnel Structures in Single-objective NK-landscapes
comment: Author's accepted version. Published in Proc. EvoCOP 2023
summary: This paper investigated the impacts of multi-objectivization on solving combinatorial single-objective NK-landscape problems with multiple funnel structures. Multi-objectivization re-formulates a single-objective target problem into a multi-objective problem with a helper problem to suppress the difficulty of the target problem. This paper analyzed the connectivity of two funnels involving global optima in the target and the helper NK-landscape problems via the Pareto local optimal solutions in the multi-objectivized problem. Experimental results showed that multi-objectivization connects the two funnels with global optima of the target and the helper problems as a single bridging domain consisting of the Pareto local optimal solutions. Also, this paper proposed an algorithm named the multi-objectivized local search (MOLS) that searched for the global optimum of the target problem from the global optimum of an artificially generated helper problem via the Pareto local optimal solutions. Experimental results showed that the proposed MOLS achieved a higher success rate of the target single-objective optimization than iterative local search algorithms on target NK-landscape problems with multiple funnels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多目标化（multi-objectivization）对多漏斗结构单目标NK问题的影响，揭示目标问题与辅助问题的全局最优漏斗通过Pareto局部最优解被连通为单一桥接域，并据此提出多目标化局部搜索算法MOLS。
AI.motivation: 单目标NK景观常具多个漏斗结构，传统局部搜索易陷入局部最优；多目标化被用来缓解此困难，但其如何影响漏斗连通性、能否被有效利用尚缺乏分析。
AI.method: 将单目标NK问题重构为带辅助问题的多目标问题，通过多目标化问题中的Pareto局部最优解分析目标与辅助问题全局最优所在两漏斗的连通性；并提出多目标化局部搜索（MOLS），借助Pareto局部最优解从人工生成的辅助问题全局最优出发搜索目标全局最优。
AI.result: 实验表明，多目标化将目标问题与辅助问题的全局最优漏斗连通为由Pareto局部最优解组成的单一桥接域；MOLS在多漏斗NK问题上取得的目标单目标优化成功率高于迭代局部搜索算法。
AI.conclusion: 多目标化可通过Pareto局部最优解桥接不同漏斗，从而有效帮助跨越多漏斗障碍；MOLS为求解多漏斗单目标组合优化问题提供了有效途径。

title: Compressing probabilistic almost-linear recurrent networks without refitting
comment: 6 pages including references. Under review for ESANN 2027
summary: Can a compressed recurrent network reuse its learned noise model? We applied finite-horizon balanced truncation to ten probabilistic almost-linear networks on delayed recall. Reducing 64 states to 32 without refitting met forecast tolerances for seven networks when balancing included rectifier inputs, compared with one using the readout alone. Including rectifier inputs improved agreement with the parent's mean-centred forecast distribution on all ten networks, with a median reduction in discrepancy of 65%. Compared with random directions, rectifier inputs reduced centred divergence on six networks and mean forecast error on all ten. Both full and reduced networks underestimated uncertainty on weak cues.

AI.tldr: 测试压缩后的循环网络能否复用其学习到的噪声模型：对10个概率近似线性网络做有限时域平衡截断，64→32状态不重拟合，含整流输入的平衡在7个网络上维持预测容差（仅用读出层则为1个）。
AI.motivation: 探究网络压缩后是否能保留已学到的噪声/不确定性模型，以及哪些状态方向对保留概率预测（含均值与分布）最关键。
AI.method: 在延迟回忆任务上训练十个概率近似线性网络，施加有限时域平衡截断将状态从64降至32且不重新拟合；对比平衡截断中是否纳入整流器输入、以及随机方向基线，并评估均值中心化预测分布的一致性与不确定性。
AI.result: 含整流输入的降阶在7个网络达预测容差，仅用读出层仅1个；含整流输入在全部10个网络上改善与母网络均值中心化分布的吻合，差异中位数降低65%；相较随机方向，在6个网络降低中心化散度、在全部10个网络降低均值预测误差；完整与降阶网络在弱线索下均低估不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 加入整流器输入的状态方向对保留概率预测与噪声模型至关重要，压缩网络基本可复用已学噪声模型，但弱线索下不确定性低估问题在压缩前后均存在。

title: Decoupling the clocks of learning and computing in spiking neural networks
summary: Biological intelligence thrives on minimal power despite its noisy, imperfect components, with neurons that communicate through voltage spikes. Brain-inspired computing seeks to bring such efficiency to real devices, which requires training methods tailored to them. The standard way to train spiking neural networks, backpropagation through time, computes weight updates through every step of a simulated device, so faithful or long simulations can make training costly and unstable. Here we show that spiking networks can learn reliably and efficiently by decoupling the clock of learning from that of computing. Our method, ChronoProp, calculates weight updates from each neuron's spike counts in fixed time bins using its measured input-output function. Compared with backpropagation through time, ChronoProp reaches similar accuracy in image classification, with about 3 times less training time and 20 times less memory at the finest timestep tested, and up to 10 times fewer spikes. On spoken-word benchmarks, ChronoProp is far more accurate in recurrent networks at fine timesteps, and with simple, hardware-compatible techniques it approaches the best published models. These networks also tolerate simulated hardware defects and limitations better than those trained with backpropagation through time. Therefore, ChronoProp enables stable and efficient training in simulations close to the continuous time of analog hardware.

AI.tldr: ChronoProp 将学习时钟与计算时钟解耦：用固定时间窗内各神经元的脉冲计数及其实测输入-输出函数来计算权重更新，而非逐步展开的BPTT，从而在接近模拟硬件连续时间的情况下实现稳定高效训练。
AI.motivation: 类脑计算依托脉冲通信以实现高能效，但要落地需适配的训练方法。标准方法BPTT需要在模拟设备的每一步上传播梯度，对忠实/长时间仿真而言训练代价高且不稳定，限制了在真实硬件上训练。
AI.method: 提出 ChronoProp：解耦学习时钟与计算时钟。在每个固定时间窗（bin）内统计各神经元的脉冲计数，并利用该神经元实测的输入-输出函数（f-I类曲线）直接获得权重更新，无需展开时间反向传播。另配以简单的硬件兼容技巧用于循环网络。
AI.result: 图像分类上精度与BPTT相当，最细时间步下训练时间约减少3倍、内存约减少20倍、脉冲最多减少10倍；口头单词基准上，细时间步的循环网络准确率显著更高，配合硬件兼容技巧接近已发表最优模型；并对模拟硬件缺陷与限制具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ChronoProp 为接近模拟硬件连续时间的大规模、稳定、高效脉冲网络训练提供了可行路径，兼顾精度、资源效率与鲁棒性。

title: Is Chaotic Dynamics Enhancing Particle Swarm Optimization? An Anytime Performance Assessment
summary: The search dynamics of particle swarm optimization (PSO) can be driven by random or chaotic values. We study if there are performance differences between random and chaos if distributional equivalence of the used sequences is observed. Therefore, we consider an anytime performance assessment which quantifies the fraction of runs reaching a given target value within a specified numerical budget. Furthermore, we connect quantifiers of the chaotic dynamics to performance metrics of the anytime analysis. The results show that once the underlying distributions are controlled, deterministic chaotic sequences yield no general or consistent advantage over random sequences. Performance differences arise most prominently from the underlying distribution, but also from search-space dimensions, benchmark targets, and numerical budgets. We also find potential budget-dependent advantages under specific parametrization of chaotic maps and distribution settings.

AI.tldr: 在控制分布等价的前提下，混沌序列相对随机序列在PSO中并无普遍或稳定优势，性能差异主要由分布本身、维度、目标值和预算决定。
AI.motivation: PSO的搜索动态可由随机值或混沌值驱动，已有研究常报告混沌的优越性，但往往未控制所用序列的分布等价性，导致优势来源不清：究竟来自混沌的确定性动态，还是来自分布差异。
AI.method: 在保证序列分布等价（distributional equivalence）的条件下比较随机与混沌驱动；采用anytime性能评估，量化在给定数值预算内达到目标值的运行比例；并将混沌动态的量化指标与anytime性能指标关联分析。
AI.result: 控制底层分布后，确定性混沌序列未表现出普遍或一致的优势；性能差异主要来源于底层分布，其次来自搜索空间维度、基准目标值和数值预算；在特定混沌映射参数化与分布设置下，存在潜在的、依赖预算的优势。
AI.conclusion: 混沌在PSO中的优势在很大程度上是分布效应而非混沌动力学本身；报告混沌优势的研究需明确控制分布等价，且优势可能是条件性的、依赖预算与参数设置。

title: Learning the Platform, Not the Learner: Sequencing Shortcuts in the Offline Evaluation of Educational Recommender Systems and LLM Rankers
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 17 tables. Code: https://github.com/jdidou/beat-the-syllabus (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24443552); code and per-case results also in the ancillary files
summary: Educational recommenders are usually compared offline, by how well they predict the next activity in logs of tutoring systems, learning applications and MOOCs, where the next activity is largely decided by the platform: teachers assign problem sets, tutors draw problems until mastery, engines select questions. On eight public datasets from five platforms, we compare four structural predictors, which use nothing about the learner beyond the last activity, with ten personalised recommenders and with open-weight LLM rankers from 0.5 to 7 billion parameters, under two protocols. The structural predictors reach between 0.81 and 1.00 of the best accuracy of any method (median 0.95), mostly through population transitions rather than the course order; the best personalised recommender is significantly better on five datasets, by 0.007 to 0.102 NDCG@10, and on Eedi in three of four training runs. Every method is far less accurate on steps along transitions never seen in training and on steps chosen by learners. LLM rankers look competent with random negatives but are never much better than a word-matching baseline, and with negatives that are plausible under the course structure they stay close to random or well behind the transition heuristic, whatever their size. In a simulation with known learner needs, the structural share tracks the share of steps decided by the platform, and offline accuracy ranks an oracle of the learners' needs below imitators of the platform. Weighting test steps by how unlikely the structure makes them restores much of the link with usefulness and, on the real data, reveals a significant personalisation signal on seven of the eight datasets. We propose a syllabus-aware evaluation checklist and release a Python package that reports the lift of any recommender over the structure.

AI.tldr: 在教育推荐系统的离线评测中，仅依赖上一次活动的"结构预测器"已能接近最优推荐方法的表现（中位0.95），说明常规离线指标主要衡量的是平台的结构性安排而非个性化质量；作者提出结构感知（syllabus-aware）的评测清单与Python工具包。
AI.motivation: 教育推荐系统通常在 tutoring system、学习应用和 MOOC 的日志上做离线评测，预测下一次活动；但下一次活动很大程度上由平台决定（教师布置习题、导师抽题直到掌握、引擎选题），因此现有离线精度可能主要反映平台结构而非真正的个性化价值，需要重新审视这一评测范式。
AI.method: 在来自5个平台的8个公开数据集上，对比四类结构预测器（仅用上一次活动信息）、10种个性化推荐器，以及0.5–7B参数的开源LLM排序器，并在两种评测协议下进行。分析包含：按未见转移/学习者自选步骤分层评测、随机负例与课程结构合理负例下的LLM排序测试、已知学习者需求的模拟实验、按结构不可能性对测试步骤加权的重加权分析，并提出syllabus-aware评测清单及报告推荐器相对结构提升的Python包。
AI.result: 结构预测器达到任一方法最佳精度的0.81–1.00（中位0.95），主要依赖群体转移而非课程顺序；最佳个性化推荐器在5个数据集上显著更优（NDCG@10提升0.007–0.102），Eedi上四次训练中三次显著。所有方法在训练中未见的转移边缘及学习者自选步骤上准确率大幅下降。LLM排序器在随机负例下看似不错，但不优于词匹配基线；在结构合理负例下接近随机或落后于转移启发式，与模型规模无关。模拟显示结构占比随平台决定步骤比例变化，离线精度把"学习者需求oracle"排在"平台模仿者"之下；按结构不可能性加权后，7/8数据集上恢复了显著个性化信号。
AI.conclusion: 当前教育推荐离线评测严重被平台结构性安排主导，精度高不代表个性化有用。应改用结构感知的评测方式（对结构不预测的步骤加权，并报告相对结构基线的提升），作者据此提出syllabus-aware评测清单并发布相应Python工具包。

title: Real-time Food Recipe Generation with Mobile Deep Learning and Large Language Model
summary: Finding recipes that match available kitchen ingredients can be cumbersome and inefficient. This paper addresses this challenge by developing a mobile application that generates tailored food recipes based on ingredients identified using a mobile camera. Leveraging deep learning and large language model (LLM), our system offers a seamless and efficient solution for real-time recipe generation. By integrating deep learning for accurate ingredient recognition with LLM for generating detailed and practical recipes, our approach ensures users receive precise cooking instructions based on actual ingredients on hand. Extensive dataset augmentation and model training have resulted in a robust system capable of high performance. Experimental results demonstrate that EfficientNet, used for food recognition, offers a balance of accuracy and computational efficiency, making it ideal for mobile applications. This dual-approach method enhances the cooking experience, reduces food waste, and provides a comprehensive, real-time tool for everyday cooking needs, bridging a significant gap in current food recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一款移动应用，通过相机识别现有食材并结合LLM实时生成定制食谱，EfficientNet在精度与效率间取得平衡，适合移动端部署。
AI.motivation: 寻找与现有厨房食材匹配的食谱过程繁琐低效，现有食物推荐系统存在明显空白，亟需能基于实际食材实时生成食谱的工具。
AI.method: 采用双技术路线：用深度学习（EfficientNet）进行食材图像识别，再用大语言模型（LLM）根据识别结果生成详细实用的食谱；并进行数据集增强与模型训练。
AI.result: 实验表明EfficientNet在食物识别上兼顾准确率与计算效率，适合移动应用；经数据增强与训练的系统性能稳健，可实现高精度识别与实时食谱生成。
AI.conclusion: 该双方法系统提升烹饪体验、减少食物浪费，为日常烹饪提供综合实时的工具，弥补了现有食物推荐系统的缺口。

title: Formalization, Transparency, and Collusion in Open-Source Game Theory
summary: Cooperation among AI agents will undermine alignment protocols when it takes the form of collusion. Under these protocols, agents often have some information about one another, and how much they have may determine whether they collude. Open-source game theory studies the extreme case, in which each program reads its opponent's source code and acts based on what it can prove about it. We develop formal foundations for this theory: we specify a concrete proof system, resolve an open problem concerning DupocBot and CupodBot through a transposition argument, and mechanize the framework in Lean 4; to our knowledge, this is the first mechanization of resource-bounded open-source game theory. We then extend the framework to the more realistic setting of partial transparency, where each program receives only partial information about its opponent. In Prisoner's Dilemma experiments, where mutual cooperation models collusion, greater transparency increases both the cooperation sustainable in equilibrium and the cooperation selected by replicator dynamics. This suggests that controlling how much agents can know about one another matters for alignment protocols.

AI.tldr: 该论文为开源博弈论建立形式化基础，用Lean 4机械化资源受限的开源博弈框架，并将理论扩展到部分透明性设定，通过囚徒困境实验表明透明度越高，均衡可持续的合作与复制子动力学选择的合作都越多。
AI.motivation: AI智能体之间的共谋会破坏对齐协议，而智能体对彼此掌握的信息量可能决定其是否共谋。开源博弈论研究其中极端情形（读取对方源码并基于可证明结论行动），但该理论缺乏严格的形式化基础，且存在未解决问题，也缺乏对更现实的"部分透明"情形的分析。
AI.method: 明确指定一个具体证明系统，以"换位论证"(transposition argument)解决了关于DupocBot与CupodBot的开放问题，并在Lean 4中机械化整个框架（作者称这是资源受限开源博弈论的首次机械化）。随后把框架扩展到部分透明性设定，每个程序只获得对手的部分信息。
AI.result: 解决了DupocBot/CupodBot的开放问题；完成了首个资源受限开源博弈论的Lean 4机械化。在囚徒困境实验中（相互合作即共谋），透明度越高，均衡中可持续的合作水平越高，复制子动力学所选择的合作也越多。
AI.conclusion: 控制智能体之间可获知彼此信息的程度，对对齐协议的设计具有实质意义。

title: Building a Unified Inline Code Editing Model for GitHub Copilot
summary: AI-assisted coding ranges from fully agentic coding to inline code suggestions in the editor. Inline suggestions require predicting a developer's most likely next edit from an editing session. The next edit may lie at the cursor, in nearby lines, or farther away, and one editing intent can span several of these. The preceding system queries separate completion, nearby edit, and long-distance edit models, each with its own output format, in a fixed sequence; it thus cannot express intents spanning distant locations in one response, can require several sequential model calls per suggestion, and prioritizes completion even when a correction would serve better. We present a unified model that predicts all three edit types in one output space: a sequence of anchored diff patches specifying locations, deleted lines, and added lines. This representation permits multiple edits per response, so the client can serve later edits from a cache without further model calls. We train this model in two phases, first unifying next edit and long-distance edit prediction, then adding code completion. We synthesize multi-edit supervision from single-edit data via model pseudolabeling and edit history playback. We use a binary LLM-graded reward, a patch validity taxonomy shared by data filtering, reward, and evaluation, and grader boosting for targeted failure modes. Phase 2 also adapts how the client processes and presents model outputs. In controlled online A/B experiments in GitHub Copilot, Phase 1 significantly reduces time to display by 6.77% and output tokens by 58.93% relative to the three-model baseline. In Phase 2, the 3-in-1 model and client adaptations reduce dismissed suggestions per user by 10.06% relative to the 2-in-1 model paired with the completion model. Throughout this report, we also share our methodology and learnings in evaluation, training, and end-to-end model and system design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一模型，用锚定的 diff 补丁序列一次性预测行内补全、近邻编辑和长距离编辑三类编辑，显著降低了展示延迟、输出 token 与建议采纳率问题，并已在 GitHub Copilot 线上 A/B 中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有系统将补全、近邻编辑、长距离编辑拆成独立模型按固定顺序调用，各有独立输出格式：无法在一次响应中表达跨远距离的编辑意图，单次建议需多次串行调用，且即使修改更合适也优先给补全。
AI.method: 用统一输出空间表示所有编辑：锚定的 diff 补丁序列（位置、删除行、新增行），支持一次响应多编辑，客户端可缓存后续编辑。分两阶段训练：先统一下一个编辑与长距离编辑预测，再加入代码补全；通过模型伪标签与编辑历史回放从单编辑数据合成多编辑监督；采用二元 LLM 打分奖励、数据过滤/奖励/评估共享的补丁有效性分类体系，以及针对特定失败模式的 grader boosting；第二阶段同时调整客户端对输出的处理与呈现。
AI.result: GitHub Copilot 受控线上 A/B：阶段1相对三模型基线将展示时间降低6.77%、输出 token 减少58.93%；阶段2中3-in-1模型配合客户端改造，相对2-in-1+补全模型使每用户被忽略（dismissed）建议减少10.06%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多编辑 diff 补丁范式可替代多模型级联，在性能、成本与用户体验上均更优，且模型设计需与客户端系统协同；文中还分享了评估、训练与端到端系统设计的方法和经验。

title: The Bundesrat corpus: A dataset of political discourse in the German Federal Council
summary: The Bundesrat is Germany's second legislative chamber and a constitutional veto player within its political system. The members of the Bundesrat are delegates of state governments. Tracing the political discourse in the Bundesrat is challenging as it has a limited machine-readable corpus available. To address this issue, we present a speaker-attributed corpus of 1,067 Bundesrat plenary sessions from the chamber's first session on 7 September 1949 to 10 July 2026. In this period, a total of 53,362 speeches by 2,473 individuals were delivered in the chamber, including written statements. Each speech includes a speech ID, the full German text, the speaker's name, the date and location of the session, the federal state that the speaker represents, the speaker's role (if applicable), the type of contribution, and the speaker's gender. The dataset provides interdisciplinary research opportunities across computational political science, legislative studies, and parliamentary discourse analysis, coupled with discourse from the Bundestag.

AI.tldr: 论文发布了一个覆盖1949年9月7日至2026年7月10日、共1067场德国联邦参议院全体会议、53362篇演讲、2473位发言人的说话人标注语料库，填补该院缺乏机器可读文本的空白。
AI.motivation: 联邦参议院是德国第二立法机构与宪法性否决玩家，其成员为各州政府代表，但可用的机器可读语料十分有限，难以追踪院内的政治话语。
AI.method: 构建说话人属性标注的全会语料库：每篇演讲（含书面声明）附带演讲ID、完整德文文本、发言人姓名、会议日期与地点、所代表联邦州、发言人职务、发言类型及性别。
AI.result: 形成覆盖首场会议至2026年7月10日的1067场会议、53362篇演讲、2473位个人的结构化数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为计算政治学、立法研究和议会话语分析提供跨学科研究机会，并可与联邦议院话语进行对比研究。

title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
comment: Author-revised preprint; journal version published in AI Plus; 20 pages, 3 figures, and 3 tables; position paper and narrative survey
summary: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_θ(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_θ$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $θ$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety and governance for persistent, adaptive systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"上下文扩展（context scaling）"概念，指出AI部署失败常源于任务所需状态与系统决策时可见上下文之间的不匹配，主张以"模型-基础设施"对为分析单位，用训练、决策、上下文基础设施三类预算框架统合研究，并给出上下文生命周期与评估方法议程。
AI.motivation: 已部署AI的许多失败并非推理能力弱，而是决策时依赖的状态（用户状态、代码版本、工具轨迹、传感器读数、环境变化）缺失、失真或选择不当。现有预训练扩展与决策时扩展均未直接针对"系统在决策前能提供什么"这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 将模型形式化为 P_θ(d|c)，置于训练预算B_θ、决策预算B_d、上下文基础设施预算B_c三元框架下；区分部署状态与模型可见上下文，定义"有效上下文价值"作为任务与干预相关的归因；识别可用性、保真度、选择、利用四类失败；以五类操作的上下文生命周期组织现有机制；提出受控预算干预与效用-成本曲线作为评估手段。
AI.result: 提出概念框架与分类体系（三类预算、四类失败、五操作生命周期），并给出可操作的评估设计（预算干预、效用-成本曲线），而非具体实验数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究议程聚焦三点：有依据的报告（grounded reporting）、交互数据与全成本基础设施、以及面向持久化自适应系统的安全与治理。

title: Attributing Agentic Failure in Reasoning Vision-Language Models with Interactive 2D Environments
summary: Agentic benchmarks report a success rate that confounds distinct causes of failure: misreading the environment, never working out how components of the environment operates, operating the components in the wrong order, and failing to recover from a mistake, each of which calls for a different fix. We present an early preview of MultiNet v2.0-Gridworld - an interactive maze environment built for attribution rather than ranking. Four different types of mechanisms, namely key-door pairs, switch-gate pairs, distractors and decoys, and ordered combinations of these mechanisms, can be added, modified, or removed independently while the renderer, the action space, and the scoring function stay fixed. A breadth-first search over the joint state of position, facing direction, inventory, and mechanism state gives every instance an exact optimal action count, which sets its difficulty and grades unfinished episodes. We fix the evaluation protocol on 15 held-out mazes over 540 episodes, then evaluate three vision-language models on 50 mazes. They solve 6 of 150 episodes, 45 of the 50 mazes were not solved by any model, and no episode containing a switch-gate mechanism was solved.

AI.tldr: MultiNet v2.0-Gridworld 是一个用于归因分析而非排名的交互式迷宫环境，通过可独立增减的四种机制（钥匙-门、开关-闸门、干扰项与诱饵、有序组合）分离智能体失败的不同原因，并用 BFS 计算每个实例的精确最优步数来设定难度和评分。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准的成功率是多种不同失败原因的混合产物：误读环境、未理解组件运作方式、操作顺序错误、无法从错误中恢复。这些原因各自需要不同的改进方案，但传统榜单分数无法区分它们，因此需要一个支持归因的环境。
AI.method: 构建交互式迷宫环境，支持四种机制（钥匙-门对、开关-闸门对、干扰项与诱饵、有序组合）的独立添加、修改或删除，同时保持渲染器、动作空间和评分函数不变。在位置、朝向、库存和机制状态的联合状态上运行广度优先搜索，得到每个实例的精确最优动作数，用于设定难度并对未完成回合评分。在 540 个回合、15 个留出迷宫上固定评估协议，再在 50 个迷宫上评估三个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 三个视觉语言模型在 50 个迷宫的 150 个回合中仅解出 6 个；50 个迷宫中有 45 个未被任何模型解出；所有包含开关-闸门机制的回合均未被解出。
AI.conclusion: 该环境能有效隔离失败来源，并暴露出当前视觉语言模型在机制理解与组合推理上的显著短板，尤其对开关-闸门类机制完全失效。

title: Confidence-Based Adaptive Retrieval Fails Where It Matters Most: A Paradox in Biomedical Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for biomedical question answering, but plausible incorrect answers remain a safety risk in clinical settings. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground responses in medical literature, while confidence-based adaptive RAG retrieves only when the model appears uncertain. We evaluate this routing strategy on three biomedical QA benchmarks of increasing difficulty and compare models across a broad range of parameter scales. The results reveal a paradox: confidence is well calibrated (AUROC 0.78--0.89) on standard medical exam questions where retrieval adds little value (+2.4\% to -1.4\%), yet becomes \emph{near-random} (AUROC 0.506) on specialist-level questions where retrieval helps most (+11.2\%). Five uncertainty signals---first-token probability, margin, entropy, consistency-based sampling, and verbalized confidence---show the same failure pattern. Five post-hoc calibration correction strategies, including density-ratio reweighting and rank-preserving transformation, do not recover a useful routing signal on hard questions (best AUROC: 0.507). Cross-model comparison shows that larger parameter scale and higher base accuracy do not guarantee reliable confidence-based routing under specialist-domain difficulty shift. These findings challenge the premise of confidence-based adaptive RAG: in high-stakes biomedical settings, defaulting to always-retrieve is safer and more accurate than confidence-based routing when calibration on the target domain is unknown.

AI.tldr: 该论文考察"基于置信度的自适应RAG"在生物医学问答中的可靠性，发现置信度在简单医学考试题上校准良好（AUROC 0.78–0.89）但检索增益很小，而在检索增益最大的专家级难题上置信度近乎随机（AUROC 0.506），五种不确定性信号与五种事后校准校正均无法挽救，故建议高风险场景默认"总是检索"。
AI.motivation: LLM在临床场景中会产生貌似合理的错误答案，存在安全风险；基于置信度的自适应RAG（仅在模型不确定时检索）被视为节省检索成本同时保证可靠性的方案，但其路由信号在域难度迁移下是否可靠尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 在三个难度递增的生物医学QA基准上，跨广泛参数规模的多个模型评测该路由策略；比较五种不确定性信号（首token概率、margin、熵、一致性采样、语言化置信度），并试验五种事后校准校正策略（含密度比重加权、保秩变换）。
AI.result: 出现"悖论"：标准医学考试题上置信度校准良好（AUROC 0.78–0.89）但检索增益仅+2.4%至-1.4%；专家级问题上检索增益达+11.2%，置信度却近乎随机（AUROC 0.506）。全部五种不确定性信号呈现相同失效模式；五种校准校正策略均无法恢复有效路由信号（最佳AUROC 0.507）。更大参数规模与更高基础准确率并不保证域难度迁移下可靠的路由。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了基于置信度的自适应RAG的前提：在生物医学等高风险场景中，当目标域校准状况未知时，默认"总是检索"比置信度路由更安全、更准确。

title: Multi-Modal Causal Disentanglement for Multi-Domain Sequential Audio Recommendation
summary: Modern music platforms expose users to heterogeneous audio content domains such as songs, playlists, and podcasts. Multi-domain sequential recommendation (MDSR) seeks to exploit such cross-domain behavior, yet two obstacles persist in practice. First, joint optimization across heterogeneous domains is prone to negative transfer, with high-traffic domains dominating the shared parameter space and suppressing weaker domains. Second, conventional ID-based collaborative signals fail to bridge domains that are semantically related but exhibit little behavioral overlap. This paper presents CAMAR, a multi-modal causal disentanglement framework for multi-domain audio recommendation. From a causal perspective, user behavior is modeled as the joint outcome of a domain-invariant preference and domain-specific preferences. Guided by this view, CAMAR factorizes user representations into domain-invariant and domain-specific components and enforces domain adversarial invariance together with orthogonality, restricting cross-domain interaction to the invariant subspace and suppressing harmful transfer paths. To strengthen cross-domain semantic coupling, CAMAR derives trainable semantic-ID embeddings from pre-trained text, vision, and audio features through residual quantization, yielding an end-to-end multi-modal adaptation tailored to recommendation. A transfer network imputes user representations for inactive domains, mitigating cross-domain cold start. Experiments on both public and industrial datasets demonstrate consistent gains over strong baselines. In online A/B tests on NetEase Cloud Music, one of China's largest music streaming platforms, CAMAR delivers consistent gains across all three domains in their main traffic scenarios, validating its effectiveness in multi-domain audio recommendation at scale.

AI.tldr: CAMAR：一种面向多域音频推荐的多模态因果解耦框架，将用户表示分解为域不变与域特异成分，结合域对抗不变性与正交约束抑制负迁移，并通过残差量化从文本/视觉/音频特征构建语义ID嵌入加强跨域语义耦合，在公开与工业数据及网易云音乐A/B测试中均取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 多域序列推荐面临两大障碍：一是异构域联合优化易产生负迁移，高流量域主导共享参数空间、压制弱域；二是传统基于ID的协同信号无法桥接语义相关但行为重叠稀少的域。
AI.method: 从因果视角将用户行为建模为域不变偏好与域特异偏好的联合结果；据此将用户表示因子化为域不变和域特异两部分，并施加域对抗不变性与正交性约束，把跨域交互限制在不变子空间；用预训练文本、视觉、音频特征经残差量化得到可训练语义ID嵌入，实现端到端多模态适配；再用迁移网络为不活跃域补全用户表示以缓解跨域冷启动。
AI.result: 在公开数据集与工业数据集上均稳定优于强基线；在网易云音乐（中国最大音乐流媒体平台之一）的在线A/B测试中，三个域的主流量场景均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 因果解耦视角能有效抑制多域推荐中的负迁移，多模态语义ID可弥补ID协同信号的跨域语义鸿沟，方法在大规模真实场景中验证有效。

title: Multisensory Hybrid TV
comment: 57 pages, 20 figures, 9 tables, and one Appendix qith and additional table
summary: Traditional TV media content exclusively involves audiovisual streams. Multi-sensorial media (mulsemedia) introduces sensory effects such as ambient lighting, vibration, scents, wind, or temperature to stimulate other senses and create more enjoyable, realistic, and immersive content consumption experiences. This paper presents an MPEG-V- and HbbTV-based end-to-end solution for providing multi-sensorial hybrid (broadcast/broadband) TV content consumption experiences. A prototype following the proposal has been implemented on an end-to-end HbbTV-compliant platform, including both video streams and sensory effects metadata delivery and synchronous consumption, replicating a mulsemedia hybrid TV service. The prototype has been subjectively evaluated and validated by 106 participants with diverse profiles, yielding highly satisfactory results, including overall enjoyment, realism, immersion, perceived synchronization, and QoE enhancement. Furthermore, the results have also revealed interesting demographic patterns, such as participants with higher academic levels reporting lower satisfaction scores in general, distinct gender-based preferences regarding sensory acceptance, and potential barriers to commercial adoption, where higher realism and immersion do not translate into an equivalent willingness to pay for these enhanced TV services.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了一套基于MPEG-V与HbbTV的端到端多感官（mulsemedia）混合（广播/宽带）电视方案，通过106名用户的实证评估，验证其显著提升的沉浸感、真实感与QoE。
AI.motivation: 传统电视仅提供视听流，体验受限；多感官媒体通过灯光、振动、气味、风、温度等效果刺激其他感官，有望带来更沉浸、更真实的观看体验。同时，混合广播/宽带（HbbTV）环境下尚无成熟的端到端多感官服务方案。
AI.method: 基于MPEG-V（感官效果元数据）与HbbTV标准，设计端到端多感官混合电视架构，并在符合HbbTV的平台上实现原型，支持视频流与感官效果元数据的同步传输与同步呈现；随后对106名不同背景的参与者进行主观评估与验证。
AI.result: 原型获得高度满意的评价，涵盖整体愉悦感、真实感、沉浸感、感知同步性与QoE提升。同时发现人口统计特征模式：学历越高者满意度普遍越低；性别在感官接受度上存在偏好差异；且更高的真实感与沉浸感并未转化为等量的付费意愿，构成商业化推广的潜在障碍。
AI.conclusion: 基于MPEG-V/HbbTV的多感官混合电视方案在技术上可行且用户体验收益显著，但商业化需应对不同用户群体的差异化偏好与付费意愿不足等问题。

title: Beyond the Limits of Welfarism: An Affordable Proportional Approval Voting Rule
summary: Two of the most widely studied voting rules in approval-based multiwinner elections are Proportional Approval Voting (PAV), which maximizes a welfare score over committees of a fixed size, and the Method of Equal Shares (MES), which gives voters equal budgets and selects candidates whose supporters can pay for them. MES guarantees priceability and laminar proportionality, both of which can fail for PAV. Can PAV offer similar guarantees without giving voters budgets? To answer this question, we go beyond the limits of welfarism by allowing PAV to select committees of varying size, while penalizing larger committees. Both our exact rule and its polynomial-time local-search variant produce outcomes that admit a priceable completion and, on laminar instances, a laminar-proportional one. Our analysis carefully separates the roles of two marginal stability conditions. At suitable thresholds, addition stability gives a strong proportionality guarantee in the form of EJR+, while deletion stability limits overrepresentation and ensures affordability. We use these conditions to derive welfare and coverage guarantees for different completions of our rules. The same welfare comparison also improves the best known lower bound on the utilitarian ratio of standard PAV.

AI.tldr: 本文通过允许PAV选择可变大小的委员会并对较大委员会施加惩罚，突破福利主义限制，使其结果具备可支付性和层状比例性等MES式保证。
AI.motivation: PAV和MES是研究最广的两种批准式多赢家投票规则。MES保证可支付性（priceability）与层状比例性，而PAV在这两方面都可能失败。作者希望在不给选民分配预算的前提下，让PAV获得类似保证。
AI.method: 突破福利主义框架，允许PAV选择可变大小的委员会并对规模较大的委员会加惩罚；提出精确规则及其多项式时间局部搜索变体。方法上分离两类边际稳定性条件的作用：在合适阈值下，加性稳定性给出EJR+形式的强比例保证，删性稳定性限制过度代表并确保可负担性。
AI.result: 精确规则和局部搜索变体产生的结果都允许存在可支付的补全（priceable completion），在层状实例上还允许层状比例性的补全。基于上述稳定性条件推导了不同补全方式的福利与覆盖保证；同样的福利比较还改进了标准PAV功利比（utilitarian ratio）的已知下界。
AI.conclusion: 通过在可变规模、带惩罚的委员会选择中引入并分离加性/删性边际稳定性，PAV可在不设预算的情况下获得接近MES的可支付性与比例性保证，并附带福利与覆盖层面的理论改进。

title: GhostAPI-V: Evaluating Audited Diagnostics for Internal API Migration Repair
summary: API migrations require callers to adopt target-version usages while removing incompatible legacy usages. GhostAPI-V represents these obligations as human-audited temporal contracts and supplies candidate-specific repair diagnostics, with correctness assessed by independent behavioral tests. We evaluate 48 internal migrations from eight Python repositories using Claude Code and Codex, with two initial runs per agent and task. Five revision arms branch from the same 192 initial candidates, controlling generation budget, version evidence, and development-test feedback. Hidden-test success is 120/192 (62.5%) for raw version-difference feedback, 130/192 (67.7%) for required-only contracts, and 148/192 (77.1%) for full bidirectional contracts. Full feedback improves over raw version-difference feedback and required-only feedback by 14.6 and 9.4 percentage points, respectively. The package-level effect is positive in all eight repositories and survives the reported repository sensitivity analyses; the forbidden increment is analysis-sensitive. Postfreeze challenges expose symbolic-behavioral disagreement. The results support the complete audited package beyond the same raw evidence and test failures, while leaving human interpretation, obligation wording, and checking entangled.

AI.tldr: GhostAPI-V 将 API 迁移义务表示为经人工审核的时间契约并给出候选特定修复诊断，在 48 个 Python 仓库迁移任务上验证：完整双向契约使隐藏测试通过率从 62.5% 提升至 77.1%。
AI.motivation: API 迁移要求调用方采用目标版本用法并移除不兼容的旧用法，但现有反馈（原始版本差异、仅"必须新增"的契约、测试失败）不足以支撑正确修复，需要研究"完整审计契约包"是否比同等原始证据更强。
AI.method: 构建 GhostAPI-V：把迁移义务编码为人工审计的时间契约，并提供候选特定修复诊断，正确性由独立行为测试判定。实验覆盖 8 个 Python 仓库的 48 个内部迁移，使用 Claude Code 与 Codex，每个智能体每任务跑两次，共 192 个初始候选。五个修订分支从同一批候选出发，控制生成预算、版本证据与开发测试反馈三个因素。
AI.result: 隐藏测试通过率：原始版本差异反馈 120/192（62.5%），仅必需契约 130/192（67.7%），完整双向契约 148/192（77.1%）。完整反馈相对前两者分别提升 14.6 和 9.4 个百分点；包级效在全部 8 个仓库均为正，且通过所报告的仓库敏感性分析；"禁止项"增量对分析方式敏感。冻结后挑战揭示符号层面与行为层面的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在相同原始证据与测试失败之外额外使用完整审计契约包；但人工解释、义务措辞与检查环节仍相互纠缠，尚未解耦，属于该方法的局限。

title: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
comment: 11 pages of main text plus appendix, 6 figures, 17 tables
summary: Long-horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents need persistent memory that surfaces the right past interaction at the right time across thousands of turns. Many systems index by invoking generative LLMs to rewrite history into summaries, facts, or knowledge graphs--a step that is (a) costly (thousands of generative calls per build), (b) non-deterministic (undermining reproducibility and giving inconsistent answers across runs), and (c) provenance-erasing (the reader sees synthesized text, not the original turn). We propose MGMem, a framework with no generative indexing calls that replaces this step with a deterministic discriminative-parser pipeline: recurring mentions across sessions are organized into an incidence graph, question mentions are resolved by a subject-conditioned three-stage resolver, and raw dialogue episodes are returned to the reader. On English multi-session dialogue QA, MGMem outperforms matched-protocol baselines on LoCoMo without generative indexing calls; on the full LongMemEval-S, it remains competitive overall and leads or ties on single-session types among local retrieval comparisons. Code: https://github.com/junhong-h/MGMem

AI.tldr: MGMem：无需生成式索引调用的长时记忆框架，用确定性判别式解析器管道替代LLM改写历史，在LoCoMo多会话对话QA上超越同协议基线。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程LLM智能体记忆系统多用生成式LLM把历史改写为摘要、事实或知识图谱来建索引，存在三大问题：(a) 开销大，每次构建需数千次生成调用；(b) 非确定性，损害可复现性并导致不同运行答案不一致；(c) 抹除溯源，读者只能看到合成文本而非原始对话轮次。
AI.method: 提出MGMem，完全不含生成式索引调用：将跨会话反复出现的提及组织为关联图（incidence graph）；问题中的提及通过"以主体为条件的三阶段解析器"进行消解；最终向阅读器返回原始对话片段（raw dialogue episodes），而非合成文本。
AI.result: 在英文多会话对话QA上，MGMem在无生成式索引调用的情况下于LoCoMo上优于匹配协议的基线；在完整LongMemEval-S上整体保持竞争力，并在单会话类型上于本地检索对比中领先或持平。
AI.conclusion: 通过确定性判别式解析替代生成式索引，可在降低成本、保证可复现性与保留溯源的同时维持有竞争力的检索问答性能，为长时记忆系统提供了一条轻量、可靠的替代路线。

title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
summary: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, mathematically plausible but physically infeasible, or rated highly by a judge while quietly breaking a task requirement. We propose a scoring framework that combines a small set of hard checks every answer must pass with a wider set of softer checks whose scores are blended into one number per candidate. This adaptive scoring framework consists of three components: a drafting model that produces the candidates, a configuring model that selects and weights the checks for each task, and scoring models that rate properties no grounded tool can compute. We apply our proposed method to four tasks: writing code that is both correct and secure (CWEval), generating robot manipulation plans (LIBERO with added safety variants), passing competitive-programming hidden tests (LiveCodeBench), and answering questions from retrieved documents (HotpotQA). An ablation study isolates the contribution of each component and finds that the largest gains come from combining hard checks with candidate comparison: on tasks where the first sampled answer is often broken or unsafe, this pairing lifts joint correctness-and-safety by up to +0.21 (retrieval-augmented QA) and code-generation safety by up to +0.28 (CWEval), with the size of the gain tracking how weak the first sample is, falling to near zero or slightly negative where it is already strong. The per-task layer that selects and weights the softer checks adds no measurable value over simpler alternatives. This builds a unified scoring framework, together with an ablation that identifies the grounded hard checks, not the soft-factor configuration, as the source of the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应评分框架：用硬性校验+软性评分混合对多个候选答案打分，硬校验与候选比较组合是主要收益来源，软因子配置层无显著增益。
AI.motivation: LLM/VLM 生成多个候选答案后，选优通常依赖模型自置信度、学习型评判模型或领域检查，各有缺陷：答案可能流畅但不安全、数学合理但物理不可行、或被评判模型高分却悄然违反任务要求。
AI.method: 框架含三部分：drafting model 生成候选、configuring model 为每任务选择并加权校验项、scoring models 评估无工具可计算的属性。评分由一组必须通过的硬校验与一组软校验加权融合为单一分数。在 CWEval、LIBERO（含安全变体）、LiveCodeBench、HotpotQA 四任务上评估并做消融。
AI.result: 硬校验+候选比较组合带来最大增益：联合正确性与安全性提升达 +0.21（检索增强QA），代码生成安全性提升达 +0.28（CWEval）；增益大小与首个采样答案的薄弱程度正相关，首个样本已强时增益趋近于零甚至略负。逐任务软因子选择加权层相较更简单方案无可见增益。
AI.conclusion: 构建了统一评分框架，消融表明收益来自 grounded 硬校验而非软因子配置。

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Signature Forgery Detection
comment: Accepted and presented at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON) for Publication IEEE Xplore
summary: Offline handwritten signatures remain a primary behavioural biometric in legal and financial documents. Detecting skilled forgeries from a static raster image is hard because pen pressure, timing and stroke order are missing. This work studies a family of quantum machine learning pipelines for offline signature forgery detection on a public Kaggle corpus of images split into two classes. We pair a ZZ feature map quantum kernel with three classical learners: K-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest. We then propose a deeper hybrid that uses EfficientNetB0 as a frozen feature extractor, reduces the resulting 1280 dimensional representation to a qubit register sized subspace through a quantum compatible principal component projection and decides class membership with a nearest neighbour rule. On a single held out test fold the proposed hybrid reaches 92.62 percent accuracy. On stratified five fold cross validation the same pipeline yields a mean accuracy of 91.26 percent with a standard deviation of 1.13 percent. The pipeline keeps a quantum embedding step that is portable to NISQ hardware. We report a controlled ablation across six quantum variants, confusion matrices, a t SNE projection and per class precision, recall and F1 score.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究离线手写签名伪造检测，将量子核方法与经典学习器结合，并比较多种量子机器学习流程，最强混合模型在单折测试达92.62%准确率，五折交叉验证均值91.26%。
AI.motivation: 离线签名仅有静态图像，缺失笔压、时序与笔顺信息，导致熟练伪造难以识别；同时希望探索可迁移到NISQ硬件的量子机器学习方案。
AI.method: 在公开Kaggle签名数据集上：一是将ZZ特征映射量子核与KNN、SVM、随机森林三种经典学习器配对；二是提出更深混合流程——用冻结的EfficientNetB0提取1280维特征，经量子兼容主成分投影降至量子比特寄存器规模，再用最近邻规则分类。并进行六种量子变体的受控消融，报告混淆矩阵、t-SNE及各类别指标。
AI.result: 单折留出测试准确率92.62%；分层五折交叉验证平均准确率91.26%，标准差1.13%；量子嵌入步骤可移植到NISQ硬件。
AI.conclusion: 量子核嵌入与经典深度特征结合的混合流程在离线签名伪造检测上表现稳健，且保留硬件可移植性，为NISQ时代的行为生物识别提供可行路径。

title: A comprehensive survey of deep face verification systems adversarial attacks and defense strategies
summary: Face Verification (FV) systems have exhibited remarkable performance in verification tasks and have consequently garnered extensive adoption across various applications, from identity duplication to authentication in mobile payments. However, the surge in popularity of face verification has raised concerns about potential vulnerabilities in the face of adversarial attacks. These concerns originate from the fact that advanced FV systems, which rely on deep neural networks, have recently demonstrated susceptibility to crafted input samples known as adversarial examples. Although imperceptible to human observers, adversarial examples can deceive deep neural networks during the testing and deployment phases. These vulnerabilities raised significant concerns about the deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical contexts, prompting extensive investigations into adversarial attacks and corresponding defense strategies. This comprehensive survey provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in deep face verification, encompassing a broad spectrum of topics such as algorithmic designs, database utilization, protocols, and application scenarios. Furthermore, we conduct an in-depth examination of state-of-the-art algorithms to generate adversarial examples and the defense mechanisms devised to mitigate such adversarial threats.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了深度人脸验证系统在算法设计、数据集、协议与应用场景上的进展，并深入分析了针对人脸验证的对抗样本生成方法与防御机制，强调对抗脆弱性对安全关键部署的威胁。
AI.motivation: 人脸验证在身份认证、移动支付等场景广泛应用，但其依赖的深度神经网络易受对抗样本攻击，且这些扰动对人眼不可察，引发对安全关键场景部署的严重担忧，因此需要系统性的对抗攻击与防御综述。
AI.method: 综述性研究：概述深度人脸验证的最新进展（算法设计、数据库利用、评测协议、应用场景），并深入考察最先进的对抗样本生成算法及相应防御机制。
AI.result: 提供了人脸验证领域与对抗攻击/防御两个方向的系统性整理与对比，帮助读者理解现有方法的分类与局限。
AI.conclusion: 人脸验证的对抗脆弱性是安全部署的关键障碍，需同时推进高质量对抗样本生成研究与鲁棒防御设计；未来工作应在统一协议与数据集下评估攻防效果。

title: Structure-Aware Multimodal Retrieval Under Data Scarcity, Privacy Constraints and Out-of-Domain Content
summary: Purpose: Figure retrieval from reference atlases in expert domains like forensic pathology, dentistry and geology must work without labels or training pairs, on content that often cannot leave local hardware, and on images outside the training data of image-text encoders. This work proposes a structure-aware pipeline that satisfies all three, retrieving figures through the page structure recovered by layout geometry and a local open-weight 8B VLM. Methods: A geometry-based pairing method is introduced, in which the model receives a schematic of the detected boxes and selects each picture's caption without access to pixels or text. Caption retrieval is evaluated on three private corpora (29 books, 10,421 figures, 218 queries) with blind human grading, against a lexical baseline, generated descriptions and five image-text encoders. Results: Geometric pairing was correct for 96%, 92% and 77% of pictures in the three domains, against 76%, 45% and 53% for the better of two document parsers. A hosted model given the schematic was equally accurate, while coordinates as text lost 22 points. Caption retrieval obtained an nDCG@5 of 0.85, 0.87 and 0.76, against 0.54, 0.51 and 0.27 for the best cross-modal encoder and 0.41, 0.28 and 0.30 for generated descriptions. Pairing errors carried over to retrieval. Conclusion: The proposed pipeline achieves accurate figure retrieval with small local models and no in-domain training, where general and biomedical image-text encoders fall far behind. Its geometry-only pairing is the most accurate of five methods and exposes no content, even to a hosted model. Code and prompts are released.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结构感知的图检索流水线，用版面几何与本地8B视觉语言模型在无语料标签、无训练对、数据不出本地的前提下实现图注配对与图像检索，显著优于跨模态编码器。
AI.motivation: 法医病理、牙科、地质等专业领域的参考图集检索需求：无法依赖标签或训练对、内容常不能离开本地硬件、且查询图像多超出图像-文本编码器的训练分布。现有跨模态编码器难以同时满足这三点。
AI.method: 提出基于几何的配对方法：检测版面框并生成示意图，模型只看框示意（不看像素或文本）为每张图选择图注。流程依靠版面几何恢复的页面结构加本地开源8B权重视觉语言模型完成图注检索；在三个私有语料（29本书、10,421张图、218条查询）上做盲人评分，对比词法基线、生成式描述和五种图像-文本编码器。
AI.result: 几何配对正确率在三领域分别为96%、92%、77%，优于两种文档解析器中较优者的76%、45%、53%；托管模型使用示意图精度相当，而将坐标转为文本会损失22个点。图注检索nDCG@5为0.85/0.87/0.76，最佳跨模态编码器为0.54/0.51/0.27，生成式描述为0.41/0.28/0.30。配对错误会传导至检索。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线用小规模本地模型、无域内训练即实现准确图检索，通用及生物医学图像-文本编码器远落后。几何配对的精度在五种方法中最高，且不泄露任何内容（即使对托管模型）。代码与提示已开源。

title: Can a Short Video Clip Verify a Model Fix?
summary: A developer who reproduces a video model's error on a short clip can replay that clip after an update. How often does a correct clip answer mean the original test now passes? On 960 prespecified CG-Bench questions, we updated from Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct to Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. Accuracy on a 64-frame sample spanning the full video rose from 27.9% to 33.3%. Before scoring the newer model, we froze 388 clips on which the older model reproduced its exact reference error. The updated model passed the reference on 51 of 116 clip passes (44.0%, 95% Wilson interval 35.3-53.0%) and on 16 of 272 clip failures (5.9%). Closing cases on a clip pass would have declared 65 unresolved reference failures fixed. Requiring a clip pass would have missed 16 of the 67 reference fixes (23.9%). In a separate 1,028-video study with different checkpoints and direct option scoring, only 15 clips passed, and the 16-frame reference confirmed one. For the generated-answer update, the short replay identified cases worth checking, while the original input remained necessary to verify individual fixes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究：用短视频片段复现视频模型错误后，短片段通过是否能代表原测试通过。结果显示短片段通过只有44%对应原问题修复，单独依赖短片段会造成大量误判。
AI.motivation: 开发者常用短视频片段复现模型的错误，并在模型更新后重放该片段来验证修复。但短片段结果能否代表原始完整输入上的修复，缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 在960道预先设定的CG-Bench问题上，从Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct更新到Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct；先在旧模型上冻结388个能精确复现参考错误的片段，再测试新模型在这些片段及原输入上的表现，并辅以1,028个视频的独立研究。
AI.result: 全视频64帧采样准确率由27.9%升至33.3%。片段通过的116例中51例原问题修复(44.0%，95% CI 35.3–53.0%)，片段失败的272例中16例原问题实际已修复(5.9%)。按片段通过判定会误报65个未解决失败为已修复；要求片段通过则会漏掉67个修复中的16个(23.9%)。
AI.conclusion: 短视频重放适合筛选值得检查的案例，但验证个体修复仍需原始完整输入，不能以片段通过替代原测试通过。

title: Non-manipulability and Approachability Beyond Two-Player Games
summary:
We study the problem of guaranteeing non-manipulability and low regret for $n-1$ independent learners in an $n$-player repeated general game with one optimizer. Non-manipulability is a property which guarantees that learning agents can prevent a strategic opponent from exploiting their learning dynamics for its own benefit, while no-regret provides guarantees to a learner with respect to a fixed static benchmark. This problem is well understood in games with a single learner and a single optimizer, where the intersection of non-manipulable and no-regret algorithms is exactly the class of all no-swap regret algorithms. But having multiple independent learners introduces a fundamental constraint: without shared randomness, the learners' joint mixed actions must remain product distributions and individual no-swap regret guarantees need not provide a guarantee of non-manipulability. Our core contributions are as follows.
  We introduce a set of $n-1$ algorithms that $n-1$ learners can play which individually guarantee sublinear swap regret and, when played in conjunction with each other, jointly guarantee non-manipulability against an optimizer. These algorithms require the computation of a Nash equilibrium at every timestep, and we show that this computational cost is inherent in general games. We construct a reduction from computing Nash in $(n-1)$-player games to finding $n-1$ jointly non-manipulable no-external regret algorithms. Therefore, polynomial time algorithms which guarantee multi-learner non-manipulability in conjunction with no-external regret do not exist unless PPAD $\subseteq$ FBPP. In order to construct these algorithms, we develop new techniques for Blackwell approachability beyond $2$-player games. We provide a general characterization for sets which are approachable by $n-1$ players without correlated randomness.

AI.tldr: 研究n人重复一般博弈中n-1个独立学习者面对1个优化者时，如何同时保证不可操纵性与低后悔。作者构造了n-1个算法，各自保证次线性swap regret，联合保证对优化者的不可操纵性；并证明每步计算Nash不可避免——除非PPAD⊆FBPP，否则多项式时间算法不存在。技术上发展了超越2人博弈的Blackwell可逼近性理论。
AI.motivation: 单学习者+单优化者情形已被充分理解（不可操纵且无后悔=无swap regret算法）。但多独立学习者时，无共享随机性导致联合混合动作须为乘积分布，个体no-swap regret不再保证不可操纵性，这一基本约束需要新解决。
AI.method: 引入n-1个学习者算法，每步计算Nash均衡；发展超越2人博弈的Blackwell可逼近性新技术，给出无相关随机性下n-1个玩家可逼近集合的一般刻画；并构造从(n-1)人博弈Nash计算到多学习者联合不可操纵无外部后悔算法的归约，建立计算下界。
AI.result: 所提算法各自保证次线性swap regret并联合保证不可操纵性；证明每步Nash计算代价是固有的——若存在多项式时间保证多学习者不可操纵性与无外部后悔的算法，则PPAD⊆FBPP。
AI.conclusion: 多学习者不可操纵性与低后悔的同时保证在一般博弈中本质上是计算困难的，Nash计算不可回避；论文通过推广Blackwell可逼近性理论为这一问题提供了算法与下界两方面的完整刻画。

title: DevEx is for Humans, AX is for Agents: Measuring Context Health in Agentic Software Work
summary: Coding agents succeed or fail in the context humans give them, yet most evaluations measure only output. Drawing on developer experience research, we introduce Agent Experience (AX), an instrument that scores session transcripts on four dimensions of the CAFE(S) framework: Clarity, Actionability, Fidelity, and Efficiency; Security, a gate rather than a friction dimension, is out of scope. A rubric-guided language model rates each dimension from 1 to 5 and explains what the human could have provided. We report on three studies that tested this model. In the Stack Overflow Developer Survey, respondents reporting context problems were less likely to rate AI as very useful in all seven activities examined (12-28%). Across 882 rated agentic sessions from a pilot sample of 1,000, Actionability received the lowest ratings (59.6% of ratings at or below 3, versus 26.6% for Fidelity), and ratings were lower in longer sessions. One researcher's unblinded review of 15 randomly sampled sessions found all scores reasonable and explanations supported. In a controlled scenario, we injected context defects into one data-analysis task and ran it twelve times. Every defect condition used more tokens than the clean baseline (mean +91%), and five evaluator models flagged 50-85% of targeted dimensions and 14-36% of non-targeted dimensions. Fidelity defects were detected most consistently and Actionability defects least. Because interventions were imperfectly isolated, these results are exploratory. AX gives teams structured, actionable evidence about context-related friction that complements output and outcome measures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Agent Experience (AX)，用 CAFE(S) 框架（Clarity, Actionability, Fidelity, Efficiency）对编码智能体会话进行 1-5 分评分并给出改进建议，作为补充输出度量的上下文质量评估工具。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体的成败依赖人类提供的上下文，但现有评估大多只测输出结果，缺乏对人类侧上下文质量的量化衡量。
AI.method: 基于开发者体验研究构建 CAFE(S) 框架（Security 作为门槛条件不计分），用 rubric 引导的语言模型对会话转录逐维度打 1-5 分并说明人类可改进之处；开展三项研究：Stack Overflow 开发者调查（7 项活动）、882 个评分会话的试点、以及注入上下文缺陷的受控数据分析任务（12 次重复，5 个评估模型）。
AI.result: 调查中报告上下文问题的受访者在全部 7 项活动中更少认为 AI 很有用（12-28%）；Actionability 得分最低（59.6% 评分≤3，Fidelity 为 26.6%），长会话得分更低；15 个抽样会话的盲评合理性获认可；缺陷注入条件下 token 消耗平均增加 91%，评估模型检出 50-85% 的目标维度与 14-36% 的非目标维度，Fidelity 缺陷最易检出、Actionability 最难。
AI.conclusion: AX 为团队提供关于上下文相关摩擦的结构化可行动证据，补充输出与结果度量；但受控实验中干预未完全隔离，结果属探索性。

title: Feature-Based Explainability of Transformer Scoring Models: A Fidelity-First Framework for Automated Writing Assessment
summary: Transformer-based automated writing scoring models can achieve strong agreement with human scores while providing limited transparency into the response characteristics associated with their predictions. This study evaluated a feature-based post-hoc explanation approach in which explanatory fidelity was established before feature importance was interpreted. English Language Arts responses from three writing prompts in Grades 6 and 8 were analyzed, with about 12,700 responses per prompt and separate DeBERTa-v3-base research models for Expression and Conventions. Each response was represented by 61 interpretable linguistic and writing-quality features. Four approaches - theory-driven composites, hierarchical feature groupings, exploratory factor analysis, and Random Forest surrogates - were compared in their ability to reproduce DeBERTa predictions. Random Forest surrogates produced the largest observed R2 values across all six prompt-by-trait conditions, with held-out R2 values from .81 to .95. SHAP analyses showed substantial overlap in high-importance features across traits, with 75% to 90% of the top 20 features shared. Trait differentiation occurred mainly through relative feature weighting: Expression showed greater importance for lexical and conceptual indicators, whereas Conventions showed greater importance for sentence-level and syntactic-control indicators. Under researcher-defined mappings, rubric correspondence was 90%-95% for Expression and 12%-18% for Conventions. These percentages are descriptive and conditional on the mappings and available linguistic features. The findings support a fidelity-first framework for examining apparent scoring priorities while distinguishing post-hoc evidence about model behavior from direct explanation of transformer internals.

AI.tldr: 该研究在解释DeBERTa自动写作评分模型前先验证解释保真度，发现随机森林代理模型最能复现预测（held-out R²=.81-.95），两特质高重要特征高度重叠，特质区分主要靠相对权重。
AI.motivation: Transformer自动写作评分虽与人工评分高度一致，但对哪些作答特征驱动预测缺乏透明性；且许多事后解释方法未先验证其是否忠实反映模型行为。
AI.method: 分析6、8年级三个写作提示的英语语言艺术作答（每提示约12,700份），为Expression与Conventions分别训练DeBERTa-v3-base模型；用61个可解释语言与写作质量特征表示作答，比较四类可解释方法（理论驱动合成、层级特征分组、探索性因子分析、随机森林代理）复现预测的能力，并对代理模型做SHAP分析。
AI.result: 随机森林代理在全部六个提示×特质条件下表现最佳，held-out R²为.81-.95；SHAP显示特质间前20特征有75%-90%重叠，区分主要来自权重差异：Expression更重词汇与概念指标，Conventions更重句子与句法控制指标；按研究者映射，评分标准对应度Expression为90%-95%、Conventions仅12%-18%。
AI.conclusion: 支持"保真度优先"的解释框架，在区分模型行为的事后证据与对transformer内部的直接解释的前提下考察表面评分优先级。

title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
comment: First authors listed in randomized order
summary: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to a formal library. Existing evaluations often provide isolated theorem statements in settings where much of this supporting theory is already available in Mathlib. We introduce AutoformBench, a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks drawn from 24 advanced mathematical sources. Lean-experienced mathematicians formalized and audited each target statement, leaving the corresponding Lean proof to the evaluated agent. Each problem is embedded in a broader mathematical development: agents receive the informal proof but must translate it into Lean while constructing the missing definitions, intermediate lemmas, and supporting infrastructure. We compare the performance of frontier models on these problems. We find a largely shared difficulty frontier: success depends less on mathematical domain than on models' ability to construct missing formal infrastructure. Data and code at https://github.com/facebookresearch/autoformbench

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoformBench 基准，包含 341 个来自 24 个高等数学来源的 Lean 4 形式化任务，考察模型在非孤立定理证明场景下构造缺失定义、中间引理与基础设施的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 数学形式化评测多为孤立定理陈述，且多数支撑理论已在 Mathlib 中现成可用，无法反映真实形式化工作——即需要把结果与形式化库衔接、构建定义与中间引理。因此需要一个更贴近真实数学形式化流程的基准。
AI.method: 构建 AutoformBench：由有 Lean 经验的数学家形式化并审核每个目标陈述，把 Lean 证明留给被测智能体；每题嵌入较完整的数学发展中，智能体获得非形式化证明，须将其翻译为 Lean，并自行补全缺失定义、中间引理和支撑基础设施。随后在基准上对比前沿模型表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型表现出基本共享的难度边界；成功率更多取决于模型构建缺失形式化基础设施的能力，而非数学领域本身。
AI.conclusion: 真实数学形式化的瓶颈在于"连接性"工作而非孤立证明；评价形式化能力应纳入基础设施构建维度。数据与代码已开源（github.com/facebookresearch/autoformbench）。

title: Code availability is not enough: schemas for documenting and extending data analysis
summary: A data analysis involves a sequence of decisions, from data cleaning to model specification, each of which can affect the reported result. Reproducing that result is not the same as understanding the sequence of decisions that produced it and the reasons for each: the code mixes those decisions with implementation details, while the manuscript states the major decisions and their rationale but scatters them across its sections and often leaves out the minor ones. A reader may then ask how the result would change under a different decision: the question itself is easy to pose, but implementing it is often non-trivial in practice. In this work, we propose a schema that represents a data analysis as a collection of decisions in natural language, from which large language models (LLMs) can generate and validate analysis scripts directly. This workflow can also expand a single analysis into a full multiverse of alternatives, specified in an alternative file, ready for comparison. We demonstrate the proposed workflow in two applications. In the first, we construct a schema for a published regression analysis of heaped smoking data and show that it reproduces the reported estimates, and that a reviewer-suggested alternative can be specified through the alternative file and turned into code automatically. In the second, where no schema is provided, we show how the workflow serves instead as a reproducibility check, applied to the many-analysts football study. As an intermediate representation between the manuscript and code scripts, our schema gives a self-contained account of an analysis and makes it extensible from a reader's perspective.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以自然语言"决策集合"作为中间表示的分析schema，使LLM可直接生成并验证分析脚本，并可将单一分析扩展为多宇宙备选方案进行比较。
AI.motivation: 数据分析由一系列决策构成，复现结果不等于理解这些决策及其理由：代码把决策与实现细节混杂，稿件只陈述主要决策且分散各处、常遗漏次要决策。读者想问"换一个决策结果会怎样"，但实际实施困难。
AI.method: 设计一种schema，将数据分析表示为自然语言决策的集合；LLM据此直接生成并验证分析脚本；通过alternative file将单一分析扩展为完整的multiverse备选并自动转为代码。
AI.result: 应用一：为已发表的heap吸烟数据回归分析构建schema，成功复现报告估计，且评审建议的替代方案可通过alternative file自动生成代码。应用二：在无schema的many-analysts足球研究中，该流程作为可复现性检查使用。
AI.conclusion: schema作为稿件与代码之间的中间表示，提供自包含的分析说明，并从读者视角使分析可扩展。

title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. A person who looks through up to 3 base images finds a correct one as often as one RL image is correct. On the prompts that ask for a position, RL is far ahead: a person finds a correct image among 8 base images for only 52% of the prompts, against 92% for one RL image. Over all prompts, our primary test, which we fixed in advance, finds best-of-16 with the VLM picker 9.3 points behind one RL image when both automatic judges must pass an image. People see a smaller gap, 5.5 and 6.5 points in two checks. FLUX.1-dev shows a similar gap in the same test. RL also solves 20 prompts that the base model misses in 128 tries, and 1,024 tries recover half of them. The automatic judges are wrong in opposite directions: a detector-based judge like the reward, as used in our primary test, reports a larger gap than people see, and VLM judges report little or none. Comparisons of RL with best-of-N should therefore check the selected images by hand.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"汇率"概念，量化一次RL采样相当于多少次基础模型采样（best-of-N），在SD3.5 Medium及Flow-GRPO checkpoint上测量发现：不含位置要求的提示下best-of-16即可媲美一次RL图像，但含位置要求时RL优势显著，且自动评判会系统性误判差距。
AI.motivation: RL微调成为文生图训练常见收尾步骤，而best-of-N是更简单的替代方案（多采样择优）。但两者孰优孰劣、一次RL样本相当于多少次基础采样，此前缺乏定量答案，需要以人为标签为基准进行公平比较。
AI.method: 在398条GenEval风格新提示（每条均含人工标注），对比Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium基础模型与其公开Flow-GRPO checkpoint。另用两个独立于奖励的自动评判器，与人工判断对照；事先固定主检验。另在FLUX.1-dev上复现。
AI.result: 约五分之四无位置要求的提示上，VLM挑选的best-of-16约等于1张RL图像；人工浏览最多3张基础图即可找到正确图，与1张RL图正确率相当。位置类提示上RL大幅领先：8张基础图中人工找到正确图仅覆盖52%提示，而单张RL图为92%。全体提示的主检验中，best-of-16+VLM比单张RL图低9.3分（两自动评判均需通过），人工两检验差距5.5和6.5分；FLUX.1-dev呈现类似差距。RL还解决了基础模型128次尝试仍失败的20条提示，1024次可挽回其中一半。检测式评判（类似奖励）高估差距，VLM评判几乎看不出差距。
AI.conclusion: RL相对best-of-N的优势高度依赖提示类型，整体差距存在但小于检测式自动评判所示。由于自动评判在相反方向上出错，RL与best-of-N的比较必须对选中图像进行人工核查。

title: OneQuery: Unified Sequence-to-Structure Generation for Multilingual E-commerce Query Understanding
summary: Multilingual e-commerce search requires robust query understanding to convert cross-lingual user queries with varied linguistic patterns into standardized semantic representations that support retrieval and ranking. However, traditional Query Understanding systems suffer from error accumulation, separately optimized subtasks that ignore their mutual correlations, and high maintenance costs. To address these issues, this paper proposes OneQuery, a unified generative framework for multilingual query understanding based on domain-specific large language models in e-commerce. We reformulate four subtasks, namely Language Recognition, Spelling Correction, Translation, and Query Tagging, into a unified Sequenceto-Structure autoregressive generation process constrained by predefined schemas, and design a three-stage progressive training pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning alignment. OneQuery demonstrates consistent gains over baselines across all tasks and remains effective across different backbone sizes, and online experiments in the AliExpress e-commerce search scenario further confirm its practical value for industrial deployment.

AI.tldr: OneQuery是一个基于领域大语言模型的统一生成式多语言查询理解框架，将语言识别、拼写纠错、翻译、查询标注四个子任务重构为受schema约束的Sequence-to-Structure自回归生成过程，并采用三阶段渐进式训练与多任务强化学习对齐，在AliExpress线上实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 多语言电商搜索需要将跨语言、语言模式多样的用户查询转化为标准化语义表示以支撑检索与排序。传统Query Understanding系统存在误差累积、子任务分别优化而忽略相互关联、维护成本高等问题。
AI.method: 提出OneQuery统一生成式框架，基于电商领域大语言模型，将Language Recognition、Spelling Correction、Translation、Query Tagging四个子任务重构为受预定义schema约束的统一Sequence-to-Structure自回归生成过程，并设计三阶段渐进式训练流程与多任务强化学习对齐。
AI.result: 在所有任务上相比基线均取得一致性提升，且在不同骨干模型规模下均保持有效；AliExpress电商搜索场景的线上实验进一步验证了其工业部署的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 统一生成式建模范式可有效缓解误差累积与子任务割裂问题，降低维护成本，具备工业落地价值。

title: Hierarchical Semantic Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities
comment: Accepted for Publication in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) in real-world systems must handle unpredictable modality missingness caused by sensor failures, privacy masking, and unstable transmission. Existing methods either learn reliability-aware representations or reconstruct missing inputs, often using a single flattened encoder output. This overlooks deep encoders' semantic hierarchy and intra- and inter-modal interactions, causing semantic averaging and ill-posed mappings. We propose Hierarchical Semantic Learning (HSL), a framework that exploits semantic hierarchy for robust MSA with missing modalities. Hierarchical Semantic Decoupling exposes low-, mid-, and high-level feature streams from each modality encoder. Cross-Modal Cross-Level Semantic Reconstruction performs ladder-style recovery, using high-level semantics from observed modalities as global anchors to progressively reconstruct mid-level structures and low-level details of missing modalities. To stabilize cross-level reconstruction, Hierarchical Cascade Error Supervisor applies prototypical contrastive regularization to observed and reconstructed features, enforcing level-specific semantic consistency and limiting error propagation. Finally, Hierarchical Interactive Fusion captures dense interactions across modalities and semantic levels to produce robust predictions under diverse missingness patterns. Experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, IEMOCAP, and CH-SIMS show that HSL outperforms baselines in most missing-modality settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次语义学习框架HSL，利用编码器的语义层次结构实现缺失模态下的鲁棒多模态情感分析。
AI.motivation: 真实系统中常出现传感器故障、隐私屏蔽、传输不稳导致的模态缺失。现有方法只用单一扁平化编码器输出学习可靠性表示或重建输入，忽视了深层编码器的语义层次以及模态内/间交互，导致语义平均和不适定映射问题。
AI.method: 包含四个模块：(1)层次语义解耦，从各模态编码器提取低/中/高三级特征流；(2)跨模态跨层语义重建，以观测模态的高层语义为全局锚点，逐步重建缺失模态的中层结构和低层细节（阶梯式）；(3)层次级联误差监督，用原型对比正则约束观测与重建特征，保证层级语义一致性、抑制误差传播；(4)层次交互融合，捕获跨模态、跨语义层的稠密交互。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI、IEMOCAP、CH-SIMS四个数据集上，多数缺失模态设置下优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用编码器的语义层次结构并结合跨层重建与对比正则，可有效提升缺失模态下MSA的鲁棒性与性能。

title: Physics-Informed Learning for Multiplayer Differential Games
comment: Accepted to IEEE Control Systems Letters (L-CSS) with presentation at CDC 2026
summary: Computing per-player feedback strategies in $N$-player adversarial differential games is challenging as the associated coupled Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman system is high-dimensional and generally lacks classical solutions. We address this by approximating viscosity solutions using physics-informed neural networks within a policy iteration scheme with a vanishing-viscosity annealing schedule. Theoretically, we establish an explicit $\varepsilon$-Nash guarantee by bounding per-player regret via computable residuals and prove our method reaches this stopping criterion in finite time. For two-player zero-sum games, we further establish a computable bound on the approximation error of the value function. Numerical experiments on pursuit-evasion scenarios illustrate the tightness of these computed bounds and the framework's scalability to high-dimensional environments.

AI.tldr: 提出用PINN近似黏性解，结合策略迭代与消失黏性退火，求解N人多玩家对抗微分博弈的反馈策略，并给出可计算的ε-Nash保证。
AI.motivation: N人对抗微分博弈的耦合HJB方程组维度高且一般无经典解，逐玩家求解反馈策略十分困难。
AI.method: 在策略迭代框架中用物理信息神经网络（PINN）近似黏性解，配合黏性系数逐渐趋于零的退火调度；理论上借助可计算的残差界估计每位玩家的遗憾值。
AI.result: 理论上给出显式ε-Nash保证，并证明方法在有限时间内达到该停止准则；对二人零和博弈进一步给出值函数近似误差的可计算界。追逃场景数值实验显示界较紧且可扩展至高维环境。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为高维N人对抗微分博弈提供可行求解途径，兼具可验证的均衡保证与可扩展性，特别适用于追逃类问题。

title: SimFusion: Multi-Fidelity Simulation-based Testing of Automated Driving Systems
comment: In proceedings of the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE '27)
summary: Simulation is the primary means of validating automated driving systems (ADS). Testing typically relies on a single simulator, forcing a trade-off between the speed of low-fidelity (LoFi) simulation and the realism of computationally expensive high-fidelity (HiFi) simulation. We present SimFusion, a multi-fidelity search-based testing framework that decides, for every candidate scenario, which simulator should execute it. Rather than approximating the ADS or its fitness, SimFusion learns whether LoFi and HiFi simulators are likely to agree on a scenario's outcome: scenarios predicted to agree run in the fast LoFi simulator, while all others are conservatively run in HiFi. We evaluate SimFusion on two ADS stacks, three driving scenarios, and four simulators, against LoFi-only, HiFi-only, and surrogate-assisted testing. Across six runs per configuration, SimFusion finds on average 2.1x more HiFi-validated failures than HiFi-only testing and 1.6x more than surrogate-assisted testing, up to 3x and 1.7x faster per failure, while executing 31% fewer HiFi simulations than HiFi-only testing. SimFusion also achieves the highest failure coverage in all three scenarios. An ablation with random simulator selection shows that the gains stem from the learned agreement model rather than from combining two simulators alone. These results suggest that predicting cross-simulator agreement is an effective alternative to surrogate modeling, as simulation fidelity can serve as an optimization dimension in ADS testing.

AI.tldr: SimFusion是一个多保真度搜索测试框架，通过学习低/高保真仿真器结果一致性预测，为每个场景选择仿真器，在更少HiFi开销下找到更多失败场景。
AI.motivation: ADS验证主要依赖仿真，但通常只用单一仿真器，需在低保真(LoFi)速度与高保真(HiFi)真实性之间权衡。
AI.method: 面向每个候选场景决定由哪个仿真器执行；学习LoFi与HiFi是否对场景结果一致，预测一致的走快速LoFi，其余保守走HiFi，而非近似ADS或适应度。
AI.result: 在2个ADS栈、3个场景、4个仿真器上，平均比HiFi-only多2.1倍、比代理辅助多1.6倍经HiFi验证的失败，每失败速度快至3倍/1.7倍，HiFi执行少31%；三个场景失败覆盖率最高；随机选仿真器的消融表明增益源于学习的一致性模型。
AI.conclusion: 预测跨仿真器一致性是替代代理建模的有效方法，仿真保真度可作为ADS测试的优化维度。

title: Psychophysics of Duration Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Studies of time perception in language models focus mainly on text-based settings. Yet multimodal models are increasingly used for tasks that require perceiving the passage of time, making the limits of their temporal perception important to understand. We measure the limits of duration perception from audio against a human baseline to address this gap. Drawing from psychophysics, we operationalise duration perception as a melody recognition task, testing when a melody becomes unrecognisable as it is slowed down. Of 21 tested models, most cannot recognise well-known melodies without labelled in-context examples. With in-context examples, seven recognise melodies reliably, most peaking within the median human recognition band. Generalisation is limited: (i) recognition peaks shift with in-context example speed, (ii) melody titles induce prediction bias, and (iii) providing examples with scientific pitch notation does not prevent accuracy declining at long note durations for most models. In humans, the recognition window is a property of the perceiver; in current models, it is largely a property of the prompt.

AI.tldr: 研究测量多模态音频模型对时长（速度）感知的极限，以旋律识别为任务，与人类基线比较，发现多数模型需上下文示例才能识别旋律，且识别窗口主要依赖提示而非模型自身。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型的时间感知研究多限于文本，而多模态模型日益用于需要感知时间流逝的任务，其时间感知极限尚不清楚，尤其缺少与人类基线的音频时长感知对比。
AI.method: 借鉴心理物理学，将时长感知操作化为旋律识别任务：把知名旋律逐步放慢，测试其在何种速度下变得无法识别；在21个模型上进行，分别测试无标注示例与有上下文示例条件，并考察示例速度、标题偏差、科学音高记谱等泛化因素。
AI.result: 21个模型中多数在无标注上下文示例时无法识别知名旋律；提供示例后7个模型能可靠识别，多数峰值落在人类识别中位区间内。泛化有限：(i) 识别峰值随上下文示例速度偏移；(ii) 旋律标题引起预测偏差；(iii) 提供科学音高记谱对多数模型不能阻止长音符时长下准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 人类的识别窗口是感知者自身的属性，而当前模型的识别窗口在很大程度上是提示（prompt）的属性，其时长感知尚未内化为独立的感知能力。

title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
summary: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost. We investigate whether general-purpose decision models can guide tuning, using Jev as a deployed representative that returns structured choices and numeric scores across diverse tasks. To assess where it helps, we compare its use as an optimizer, performance predictor, and region guider against conventional methods and a large language model (LLM) on eight AI tuning tasks. Conventional optimizers attain rank 1 in six of eight comparisons. Similarly, established predictors outperform Jev in seven. Through region guidance, however, it finds configurations with lower perplexity than those selected by the native tuner, offering a quality gain when additional decision time and API fees are acceptable. These findings yield actionable recommendations on selecting the decision role, retaining conventional predictors, and balancing tuning quality against cost.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了新型通用决策模型（以部署系统Jev为代表）在AI配置调优中作为优化器、性能预测器和区域引导器三种角色的效果。结果显示：传统优化器在8项任务中6项排名第一，传统预测器在7项中胜出；但作为区域引导时Jev能找到比原生调优器困惑度更低的配置，即以额外时间和API成本换取质量提升。
AI.motivation: AI配置调优中采样与搜索策略的选择同时决定调优质量与成本。作者希望探究通用决策模型能否引导调优，并厘清它在何种决策角色下真正有用。
AI.method: 在8个AI调优任务上，将Jev分别用作优化器、性能预测器和区域引导器，与常规优化器、传统预测器以及一个大语言模型进行对比。
AI.result: 传统优化器在8项比较中6项排名第一；传统预测器在7项中优于Jev。但通过区域引导，Jev找到的配置困惑度低于原生调优器所选配置，在可接受额外决策时间与API费用时带来质量收益。
AI.conclusion: 建议按任务选择合适的决策角色、保留传统预测器，并在调优质量与成本之间权衡取舍。

title: Temporal Exposure to Byzantine Vulnerability Under Intermittent Participation in Federated Learning
summary: In this paper, we study the effect of participation variability on per-round Byzantine vulnerability. We formalise Dynamic Participation Exposure (DPE), a phenomenon in which the global Byzantine fraction remains below an aggregation rule's tolerance threshold, while a participating client set violates, or approaches violation of, the assumptions required for robust aggregation. Under stochastic participation, we derive the probability of per round exposure and analyse how active-set size affects the variability of the observed Byzantine fraction. We further examine the accumulation of exposure over multiple rounds and consider adversaries that selectively participate during favourable rounds. Our analysis shows that intermittent participation does not automatically imply aggregation failure. Rather, it transforms Byzantine robustness from a static population-level property into a stochastic and temporal property. To mitigate this risk, we outline actionable design recommendations based on minimum active-set constraints, temporal monitoring, participation history, and adaptive aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文将拜占庭鲁棒性从静态群体属性重新理解为随机且随时间变化的属性，提出"动态参与暴露"(DPE)概念，刻画全局拜占庭比例低于聚合阈值、但单轮参与集合违反鲁棒聚合假设的风险。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习等场景中客户端参与具有间歇性和随机性，现有鲁棒聚合分析通常以全局拜占庭比例作为静态阈值判断，忽视了每轮实际参与集合可能偏离该假设，从而低估单轮失效风险。
AI.method: 形式化定义动态参与暴露DPE；在随机参与模型下推导单轮暴露概率，分析活跃集规模对观测拜占庭比例方差的影响；考察多轮暴露的累积效应；并建模在有利轮次选择性参与的对抗者。
AI.result: 间歇性参与并不必然导致聚合失败，但会使拜占庭鲁棒性从群体层面的静态性质转变为随机、时序性质；活跃集越小，观测拜占庭比例的波动越大，且暴露可跨轮累积。
AI.conclusion: 提出基于最小活跃集约束、时序监测、参与历史与自适应聚合的设计建议，以缓解动态参与暴露风险。

title: MonoQPM: Splitting Features into Concepts for Inherent Interpretability and Predictive Performance
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (10/2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=8bQNRlFQhZ
summary: Alongside superposition, polysemanticity is one of the primary obstacles to achieving interpretable deep neural networks. While these phenomena are typically intrinsically linked, the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) naturally decouples them. By representing classes with a sparse binary assignment of very few features, QPM prevents superposition by design on its final features but still exhibits polysemanticity. However, measuring polysemanticity is an open problem. This work proposes a utility-focused approach to measuring polysemanticity by quantifying the decrease in interference-induced activation errors, which yields the practical utility of tighter prediction sets using Conformal Prediction (CP). We explicitly disentangle the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts to create the Monosemantic QPM (MonoQPM). Because its features are disentangled, MonoQPM acts as a significantly more efficient Conformal Predictor. Additionally, we introduce CUBCars, a dataset providing ground truth information about shared concepts. Using this and other datasets, we demonstrate that polysemanticity emerges in QPM across all tested architectures, but is effectively alleviated by MonoQPM. For instance, MonoQPM guarantees 88% coverage using Adaptive Prediction Sets on ImageNet with just 66% of the frozen QPM's set size.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以实用效用（Conformal Prediction 预测集大小）衡量多义性，并将 QPM 的多义特征显式解耦为单义概念得到 MonoQPM，从而获得更高效的保形预测器；同时发布含共享概念真值的 CUBCars 数据集。MonoQPM 在 ImageNet 上以冻结 QPM 66% 的预测集大小达到 88% 覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 叠加与多义性是深度网络可解释性的主要障碍，二者通常纠缠。QPM 天然将二者解耦：最终特征以稀疏二值分配避免叠加，却仍表现多义性。然而多义性缺乏公认度量，且缺乏带共享概念真值的数据集。
AI.method: 提出以效用为导向的多义性度量——量化干扰导致的激活误差下降，并以保形预测（CP）预测集紧凑度作为其实用体现；据此将 QPM 的多义特征显式解耦为单义概念，构建 MonoQPM；并引入提供共享概念真值的 CUBCars 数据集。
AI.result: 在 CUBCars 及多个数据集上，QPM 在所有测试架构中均出现多义性，而 MonoQPM 有效缓解；例如在 ImageNet 上用 Adaptive Prediction Sets，MonoQPM 仅以冻结 QPM 66% 的预测集大小即保证 88% 覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 多义性可用预测集效率等实用效用进行量化；解耦为单义概念能显著提升保形预测效率，说明单义性对可解释性与实际可靠性均有价值。

title: Privacy-Aware Adaptive Client Selection for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Federated retrieval-augmented generation retrieves evidence from distributed corpora. However, broadcasting queries to all clients increases the retrieval burden and query exposure. We present Privacy-Aware Adaptive Client Selection for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (PACS-FedRAG), an online selector that takes into account perturbed semantic profiles along with evidence feedback, latency, payload cost, and exploration. In a ten-client setting where three clients are chosen, the archived end-to-end benchmark reports an evidence overlap of 0.372 and an answer accuracy of 0.287. The retrieval-only evaluation, on the other hand, reuses a full-broadcast baseline with a different fusion tie-breaking policy. Rank fusion across disjoint client corpora imposes an overlap ceiling of 0.375, limiting its interpretation as a relevance measure. Answer accuracy is below the fixed-label diagnostic of 0.645, and raw generator responses are unavailable for parser verification. Corrected baselines and a new answer-level evaluation are needed to assess whether quality is preserved. Selecting three clients reduces the number of query recipients by 70%. Profile perturbation does not provide confidentiality of queries or passages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACS-FedRAG，一种在联邦检索增强生成中按扰动语义画像、证据反馈、时延、负载与探索进行在线客户端选择的方案；十客户端选三的设置下证据重叠0.372、答案准确率0.287，同时作者指出该结果受融合上限与基线问题限制，尚不能证明质量被保持。
AI.motivation: 联邦RAG需向所有客户端广播查询，带来检索负担与查询暴露问题，因此希望只选择部分客户端检索；同时现有评估可能误导对质量的判断。
AI.method: 提出PACS-FedRAG在线选择器，综合扰动后的语义画像、证据反馈、时延、传输负载代价与探索机制来选择客户端；在10客户端中选3；并对比检索专用评估（复用全广播基线、不同融合平局策略）与端到端基准。
AI.result: 端到端基准：证据重叠0.372、答案准确率0.287；选3客户端使查询接收方减少70%。但跨不相交语料的排序融合形成0.375的重叠上限，使重叠难以解释为相关性；答案准确率低于固定标签诊断值0.645，且缺少原始生成文本供解析器核验。
AI.conclusion: 选择机制可降低查询扩散，但质量是否保持尚无定论，需要修正基线并引入答案级评估；此外画像扰动不提供查询或段落的机密性保障。

title: Where Does the Asymmetry Enter? Staging a Fairness Audit Across a Fused Multimodal Moderation Pipeline
comment: Accepted at the 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation (PACLIC 40)
summary: Almost every short-video upload now passes through a classifier that fuses video, speech, and on-screen text into one decision about whether it may be seen. It moderates every language community on the platform at once, and fairness across them is judged, if at all, from one accuracy score. That score is compatible with error falling almost entirely on one language group. An audit that goes looking reads the model's decisions, the last stage of a long pipeline and the one whose test has the fewest items. We ask where in a fused pipeline a subgroup asymmetry can be detected at all: in what the classifier may read, in what its branches encode, or in what it decides. We answer this with a post-hoc audit of a published TikTok classifier, holding all three stages to one significance standard using only its logged decisions, labels, and pre-fusion features, with source language as the subgroup axis. The asymmetry is significant at the stage deciding what the model may read, and again in what the text branch encodes. At the earlier stage, a language-blind cap admits less of a Vietnamese clip than an English one, for reasons of segmentation, not verbosity. The asymmetry is undetectable at the decision, where the smallest subgroup leaves twelve items to test. An audit reading only decisions looks where its evidence is thinnest; the same test staged upstream recovers a disparity the decision-level view returns as noise.

AI.tldr: 对已发表TikTok多模态审核分类器做后置审计，以源语言为子组轴，将"可读入什么、分支编码了什么、最终决策"三阶段置于同一显著性标准下检验。发现不对称在输入准入阶段和文本分支编码中显著，而在最终决策层不可检出。
AI.motivation: 短视频审核分类器融合视频、语音、屏幕文字做单一可见性决策，却用单一准确率衡量跨语言公平性，该指标可以掩盖误差几乎全落在一个语言群体上的情况。而事后审计通常只看最终决策——流水线最末端、测试样本最少的一环，因此证据最薄弱。
AI.method: 对一个公开的TikTok分类器做后置审计，仅使用其日志化的决策、标签与融合前特征，以源语言为子组轴，对三阶段（模型可读入的输入、各分支编码、最终决策）采用统一的显著性标准进行评估。
AI.result: 不对称在"决定模型可读入什么"的阶段显著，在文本分支编码中同样显著：语言无关的截断上限使越南语片段被准入的比例低于英语片段，原因是分词而非冗长度。在最终决策层无法检出不对称，因为最小子组仅剩12条测试样本。
AI.conclusion: 只读决策的审计正好去看证据最薄弱之处；将同一检验上移至上游阶段，可恢复出决策层视角视为噪声的差异性。多模态审核的公平性审计应在流水线各阶段分别进行，而非仅凭末端准确率判定。

title: The Weak Negotiation Function
summary:
Subgame-perfect equilibria (SPEs) constitute a refinement of Nash equilibria, where the players are not allowed to resort to non-credible threats to discourage deviations. In graph games equipped with a broad class of objectives, SPEs are captured by a tool called the negotiation function.
  After giving a quick overview of what has already been achieved using this tool, we define a variant of it: the weak negotiation function. We show that weak SPEs, a standard relaxation of SPEs, can be captured by the weak negotiation function exactly like SPEs are captured by the negotiation function. This characterisation yields a new computational result: deciding whether a given game contains a weak SPE where each player's payoff lies in a given interval is an NP-complete problem if the game has mean-payoff objectives. We also provide a new proof that the same problem in Büchi games is in P. The proofs reuse many arguments from their SPE counterpart, demonstrating the robustness of the tool.
  We also use the weak negotiation function to present a new proof, significantly shorter than the known one, of the existence of weak SPEs in mean-payoff games. We argue that those new techniques should be reusable in other settings, in particular to prove an open conjecture about the existence of randomised $ε$-SPEs in mean-payoff games.
