AI.tldr: 本文引入"弱谈判函数"（weak negotiation function），刻画图博弈中的弱子博弈完美均衡（weak SPE），并据此给出mean-payoff博弈中带区间约束弱SPE存在性判定为NP完全的结论、Büchi博弈中同类问题属于P的新证明，以及弱SPE存在性的更简证明。
AI.motivation: SPE是Nash均衡的精炼，可排除不可信威胁。已有工作用"谈判函数"刻画图博弈中的SPE，但该工具是否能同样刻画SPE的标准放松——弱SPE——尚不明确；同时希望借此获得新的可计算性结果并简化已有证明。
AI.method: 定义谈判函数的变体——弱谈判函数，证明弱SPE可被其精确刻画，与SPE被谈判函数刻画的方式一致；并复用SPE对应证明中的大量论证来完成复杂性分析与存在性证明。
AI.result: 判定给定博弈是否存在每个参与者收益落在指定区间内的弱SPE：在mean-payoff目标下为NP完全；对Büchi博弈给出该问题属于P的新证明。此外用弱谈判函数给出mean-payoff博弈中弱SPE存在性的显著更短证明。
AI.conclusion: 弱谈判函数是刻画弱SPE的稳健工具，其证明可复用于其他设定，尤其有望用于证明mean-payoff博弈中随机化ε-SPE存在性这一开放猜想。

title: SmartLens: Turning AI Agent Changes into Learning, Review, and Risk Signals in the IDE
summary: Developers increasingly act as managers of AI agents: they hand tasks to AI coding agents and then have to understand, verify, ship, and learn from what the agents produce. IDEs and recent tools can show which committed lines were written by AI, but they do not attribute the pending changes of external agents, and they do not use attribution to help the developer review, learn, or judge risk. We present SmartLens, an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that attributes changes to an AI agent, the developer, or both. It combines this attribution with the Git history to support three goals: (i) Learn compares the skills (APIs, language features, annotations) that agents used with the skills the developer has used in their own commits; (ii) Understand ranks pending changes by review priority; and (iii) Risk shows hotspots: files that change often, are mostly written by AI, and that the developer barely knows. In a preliminary evaluation, SmartLens attributed 8 of 12 scripted IDE scenarios correctly; all failures were in (expected) blind spots. On 8 Open Source Software repositories with agent co-authored commits, agents introduced up to 253 skills that do not appear in the main developer's own commits. The Risk ranking was as good as or better than plain churn at predicting later bug fixes, but part of this gain is due to recency.

AI.tldr: SmartLens是一个IntelliJ IDEA插件，将待提交改动归属为AI代理、开发者或二者合作，并结合Git历史支持学习、理解与风险识别三个目标。
AI.motivation: 开发者越来越多地扮演AI编码代理的管理者角色，需理解、验证和审查代理产出。现有IDE工具只能显示已提交的AI代码行，无法归属外部代理的待提交改动，也未将归属信息用于审查、学习或风险判断。
AI.method: SmartLens在IDE内将改动归属给AI代理、开发者或协作，并与Git历史结合实现三功能：(i) Learn对比代理使用与开发者自身提交中的技能（API、语言特性、注解）；(ii) Understand按审查优先级排序待提交改动；(iii) Risk展示热点文件（频繁变更、多由AI撰写、开发者不熟悉）。
AI.result: 初步评估中，12个脚本化IDE场景正确归属8个，失败均落在预期盲区。在8个含代理共同署名提交的开源仓库中，代理引入了多达253个未见于主开发者自身提交的技能。Risk排序在预测后续bug修复上不劣于纯churn，但部分优势源于新近性。
AI.conclusion: SmartLens填补了IDE中待提交AI改动的归属与利用空白，将归属信息转化为学习、审查与风险洞察；但归属准确性仍受盲区限制，风险预测优势也需排除新近性混淆。

title: Verified experience improves materials prediction with large language models
summary: Materials discovery is an iterative loop: experiments and calculations verify predictions, and each outcome can inform the next. Yet most predictors are specialized single-task models fixed after training. Large language models have recently emerged as predictors across heterogeneous tasks but generally underperform specialized models, and retrieval-augmented variants discard their own outcomes. Benchmarks also score queries in isolation, leaving improvement from outcomes untested. Here we construct MatMemBench, a sequential benchmark of 22 materials tasks that reveals outcomes only after prediction and tests online adaptation, memory retention and cross-task transfer. We present MatRecall, a framework that lets large language models store verified predictions, with evidence, outcome and error, as episodes and recall them without retraining. MatRecall improved median performance by 62% over a memory-free model, exceeded specialized models on 11 tasks, remained useful after feedback stopped and transferred between related tasks. Verified experience could become a reusable resource for self-improving discovery loops.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MatMemBench顺序基准（22项材料任务，预测后才揭示结果，测试在线适应、记忆保持与跨任务迁移）和MatRecall框架，让大模型把带证据、结果与错误的已验证预测存为"情节"并在不重训的情况下召回，中位性能提升62%，在11项任务上超过专用模型。
AI.motivation: 材料发现是迭代闭环，但现有预测器多为训练后固定的单任务专用模型；大模型虽通用却不如专用模型，检索增强变体又丢弃自身结果；现有基准孤立打分，未检验从结果中改进的能力。
AI.method: 构建MatMemBench：22个材料任务的顺序基准，仅在预测后揭示结果，评估在线适应、记忆保持和跨任务迁移。提出MatRecall：将已验证的预测连同证据、结果和错误存为情节记忆，推理时召回，无需重训练。
AI.result: MatRecall较无记忆模型中位性能提升62%；在11项任务上超过专用模型；反馈停止后仍保持有效性；可在相关任务间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 已验证经验可作为自改进材料发现闭环的可复用资源。

title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
summary: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 提出三维度临床化危害分类法（危害类型/涉及对象/发生时点）与"危害刻画—干预决策"分离的安全策略框架，训练35B-A3B推理型守卫模型MindGuard2，以约1/10延迟达到与GLM-5.3相当的平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM用于心理健康支持存在安全风险；现有守卫模型只识别有害内容类别，忽略判断恰当响应所需的语境信息，且安全策略被固化在模型权重中，难以更新与审计。
AI.method: ①构建经临床专家验证的三维危害分类法，将危害刻画与干预决策解耦，使安全策略以显式、可审计的指令形式外置于模型权重；②验证LLM评审小组以规模化标注；③按该分类法重标注公开基准；④训练MindGuard2：先对短推理链做SFT，再用带推理长度惩罚的强化学习，压缩推理开销。
AI.result: 重标注显示公开基准中极少包含"指向用户自身"的危害，而此类危害占真实对话近一半；MindGuard2在两个公开基准与真实对话上平衡准确率接近体量大得多的GLM-5.3，中位延迟约低10倍，推进准确率-延迟帕累托前沿；高召回下假阳性率低。
AI.conclusion: 临床化、可外置审计的分类框架与轻量推理型守卫模型可在保持安全检测精度的同时显著降低延迟与误干预风险；作者开源该守卫模型、合成对话及公开基准的合成标注。

title: Geophysics-informed invertible operator network for Bayesian geophysical inversion
summary: Geophysical inverse problems are inherently ill-posed because of sparse observations and measurement noise. Classical sampling-based Bayesian inference methods, such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), are computationally prohibitive because they require many forward simulations. Data-driven machine-learning methods often struggle to produce physically consistent solutions when training data are limited. To address these issues, we propose a geophysics-informed invertible operator network (GI-ION) that integrates an invertible neural network (INN) within a deep operator-learning framework for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion. The INN serves as the branch network and transforms the model parameters into branch coefficients that represent the forward solution and a latent variable that captures uncertainty in the inverse problem. By learning the forward operator and enforcing statistical independence between the branch coefficients and the latent variable, GI-ION enables efficient sampling from a learned conditional approximation, even with sparse boundary observations. We validated GI-ION on three representative cases: 1D surface-wave dispersion and travel-time tomography for a 2D synthetic random-field model and a seismic-slice model. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust performance across diverse problem settings and efficient conditional sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出地球物理信息可逆算子网络GI-ION，将可逆神经网络嵌入深度算子学习框架，实现高效的贝叶斯地球物理反演与不确定性采样。
AI.motivation: 地球物理反演因观测稀疏和测量噪声而病态：基于采样的MCMC需大量正演模拟，计算代价过高；而数据驱动的机器学习方法在训练数据有限时难以保证物理一致性。
AI.method: 构建GI-ION模型：INN作为分支网络，将模型参数映射为表示正演解的分支系数以及刻画反演不确定性的潜变量；通过同时学习正演算子并强制分支系数与潜变量统计独立，得到可学习的条件近似分布，从而在稀疏边界观测下高效采样。
AI.result: 在一维面波频散、二维随机场模型的走时层析及地震切片模型三个代表性算例上验证，实验显示方法在不同问题设置下性能稳健，并能实现高效的条件采样。
AI.conclusion: GI-ION将可逆网络与算子学习结合，兼顾物理一致性与不确定性量化，为稀疏观测下的贝叶斯地球物理反演提供高效可行方案。

title: CriticalScenes: Scalable Photorealistic Critical-Scenario Generation for Closed-Loop Driving Adaptation
summary: Safety-critical interactions are rare in recorded driving data, leaving end-to-end driving planners with limited exposure to evasive behaviour during training. This lack of critical supervision can lead to unsafe behaviour and, in rare instances, collisions. To address this gap, we introduce CriticalScenes, a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with corresponding collision-avoidance supervision. Across 53 reconstructed source scenes, 979 of 1,060 attempted interactions yield feasible threat trajectories (92.4\%), while the inserted threat actors remain detectable in more than 95\% of non-occluded observations within 5--35\,m. Experiments with two structurally different end-to-end planners show that the generated supervision improves critical-scenario planning, while closed-loop transfer varies across planner architectures. SparseDrive achieves a 46.5\% relative reduction in collision rate on an independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark, whereas UniAD shows only a modest closed-loop improvement despite substantial open-loop gains. The results further highlight the importance of closed-loop evaluation, as improvements in open-loop trajectory prediction do not necessarily translate into equivalent safety gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 CriticalScenes，一个基于重建的框架，将普通行车记录场景转换为照片级真实的、带避撞监督的安全关键交互数据，用于训练端到端驾驶规划器。
AI.motivation: 真实驾驶数据中安全关键交互稀少，端到端规划器在训练中缺乏避险行为的监督，易导致不安全行为甚至碰撞。
AI.method: 基于重建的方法：从53个原始记录场景重建并用生成方式注入威胁目标（threat actor），合成安全关键交互及对应的避撞监督信号，保持照片级真实感。用两种结构不同的端到端规划器（SparseDrive、UniAD）进行开环与闭环实验验证。
AI.result: 1060次尝试交互中979次生成可行威胁轨迹（92.4%）；非遮挡观测中5–35m内威胁目标可检测率超95%。SparseDrive在独立照片级闭环基准上碰撞率相对降低46.5%；UniAD开环提升显著但闭环提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 生成的安全关键监督能改善关键场景规划，但闭环迁移效果因规划器架构而异；开环轨迹预测的提升不一定转化为等效安全收益，凸显闭环评估的重要性。

title: MulCLIP: A Multi-level Alignment Framework for Enhancing Fine-grained Long-context CLIP
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP excel at image-text alignment but struggle with long, detailed descriptions due to training on short captions. Recent methods address this limitation using region proposals to align visual regions with sentences, but at substantial deployment cost. We present MulCLIP, an end-to-end multi-level alignment framework that directly exploits natural long-text structure without region proposals. Instead of simply stacking objectives, MulCLIP aligns different textual granularities through compatible training signals: global contrastive alignment for long captions and short summaries, Word-Patch Reconstruction over locally calibrated features for within-sample word-patch semantics, and Subcaption-Aggregated Patch alignment for context-rich subcaption grounding. Experiments on benchmarks spanning varying caption lengths show consistent gains, and ablations confirm that the proposed objectives are complementary and jointly improve the overall framework. Code will be released at https://github.com/truongchau2602/MulCLIP.

AI.tldr: MulCLIP 是一个端到端多层级对齐框架，无需 region proposals，直接利用长文本结构对齐视觉与文本的多粒度语义。
AI.motivation: CLIP 类视觉-语言模型擅长图文对齐，但由于训练只用短标题，难以处理长而详细的描述。近期方法用 region proposals 将视觉区域与句子对齐，但带来高昂的部署成本。
AI.method: 提出三种兼容的训练信号而非简单叠加：1) 长标题与短摘要的全局对比对齐；2) 基于局部校准特征的 Word-Patch 重建，捕捉样本内词-块语义；3) 子标题聚合块对齐（Subcaption-Aggregated Patch），用于上下文丰富的子标题接地。
AI.result: 在涵盖不同标题长度的基准上取得一致性提升；消融实验表明各目标互补，共同改进整体框架。
AI.conclusion: MulCLIP 避免 region proposals 的高开销，通过多粒度对齐有效提升长描述场景下的视觉-语言对齐能力，代码将开源。

title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
summary: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.

AI.tldr: 在相同任务、相同输入与相同评测器条件下，让编程智能体编写程序渲染答案视频，其表现显著优于视频生成模型，说明"程序合成"是当前更可靠的视觉推理路径。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型常被当作"原生视觉推理器"，理由是其推理直接在像素帧中展开而非借助语言或代码；但这一"原生路径更可靠"的假设从未在与符号化替代方案同条件对照下被检验过。
AI.method: 在 VBVR-Pro-Bench（500 实例、5 类认知任务、带符号真值）上，以相同首帧和提示词、相同输出规范与未修改的规则式评测器，对比两种媒介：像素去噪的视频生成，与由编程智能体写程序渲染答案视频。智能体无真值/元数据/生成模型访问权限，每例仅一次机会。测试 3 个闭源模型智能体（Codex+gpt-6-astra、Claude Code+Fable 5.1、Gemini CLI+Gemini 3.1 Pro）及 23 个可运行开源权重模型。
AI.result: 三个闭源智能体得分 0.923、0.894、0.893，均比最强视频模型高 0.22 以上；开源模型中最好的 GLM-5 达 0.572，超过除 RL 训练模型外的所有视频模型。
AI.conclusion: 对解可由首帧与提示词计算的任务，程序合成目前明显比视频生成更可靠地实现视觉推理。论文还区分"描绘式程序"（通过导航图像恢复可迁移方案）与"命题式程序"（操作硬编码数值），揭示智能体程序中视觉推理的展开方式及其对推理本质的启示。

title: Computing Feasible EF1 Allocations under Generalized Assignment Constraints
summary: We study the fair allocation of indivisible goods under generalized assignment constraints, where each agent's bundle must fit within her budget, the sizes of goods may differ across agents, and unallocated goods go to a charity. A natural fairness notion here is feasible envy-freeness up to one good (FEF1), which requires an agent's envy towards any feasible subset of another bundle to disappear after some good is removed from this subset. While FEF1 allocations always exist, they could previously be computed efficiently only when sizes are common to all agents. We show that FEF1 allocations can be computed in strongly polynomial time, and more generally whenever each agent's value can be almost exactly maximized over her feasible bundles, a requirement that cannot be relaxed substantially. Our analysis relies on an essentially tight quadratic bound on how often each agent's bundle is repaired. Moreover, the allocation can be made approximately envy-free up to any good while retaining nearly half the Nash welfare of any given allocation. In contrast, requiring a single good to eliminate an agent's envy towards all feasible subsets of another bundle at once, which makes no difference without constraints, renders the problem NP-hard and may halve the attainable Nash welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究广义分配约束下不可分物品的公平分配，提出Feasible EF1 (FEF1)概念，证明其可在强多项式时间内计算，并给出修复次数的紧二次界与近似无嫉妒及Nash福利结果。
AI.motivation: 在带预算约束（每个agent的bundle需符合自身预算，物品大小因agent而异，未分配物品归慈善）的不可分物品分配中，FEF1分配虽总存在，但此前仅在所有agent共享同一物品大小时才能高效计算，需要一般化情形下的高效算法。
AI.method: 通过分析每个agent的bundle被"修复"的次数，建立本质紧的二次上界；并利用"每个agent的效用可在其可行bundle上几乎精确最大化"这一条件泛化算法。
AI.result: FEF1分配可在强多项式时间内计算；更一般地，只要每个agent的效用能在其可行bundle上几乎精确最大化——且该要求不能大幅放宽——即可计算。所得分配可近似满足EFX(任何物品)，同时保留任意给定分配近一半的Nash福利。相对地，"用单一物品同时消除对另一bundle所有可行子集的无嫉妒"（无约束时无差别）会导致NP难，且可能使可达Nash福利减半。
AI.conclusion: FEF1在广义分配约束下可高效求解且具有良好福利保证，但更强的"一次性消除全部嫉妒"variant在约束下变难并损害福利，刻画了约束环境下公平与效率的边界。

title: Evaluating More with Less: Black-Box Test Selection for AI Agents
summary: Agentic software systems are increasingly used in development, where changes to the model, prompt, scaffold, tools, or execution environment require repeated testing. Test case selection (TCS) can reduce testing costs while providing estimates of agent performance or exposing failures early. Although TCS has been studied for deep neural networks and LLM code models, prior work does not directly address agentic systems and often requires model information unavailable for proprietary agents. We present the first empirical study of black-box TCS for agentic software systems. We treat each benchmark task as a test case and adapt black-box regression-testing techniques using selection criteria based on task descriptions, metadata, code fragments, and embeddings. We also propose strategies that estimate task difficulty using heuristic features or independent LLM-as-judge assessments. Our strategies select tasks without executing the target agent or using past results. We evaluate fourteen selection strategies, including random sampling, plus a historical-data baseline, across ten AI agent benchmarks with 12 to 101 agents per benchmark. We assess Success Rate estimation and early failure detection. No single strategy dominates both objectives. Adapted black-box regression-testing strategies are most effective for Success Rate estimation, with Category Partition obtaining the lowest median error on five benchmarks at the 20% task budget. LLM-as-judge selection is more effective for early failure detection. For GPT 5.2 Codex on SWE-bench Verified, Category Partition selects 100 instead of 500 tasks, reducing execution cost from \$225 to \$47, with a Success Rate estimation error of 0.8 percentage points. At the same budget, LLM-as-judge selection detects nearly twice as many failures as random sampling: 53.0% of selected tasks reveal failures, compared with 27.4% for random sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对面向智能体软件系统的黑盒测试用例选择（TCS）进行实证研究，将基准任务视为测试用例，适配黑盒回归测试技术并比较14种选择策略在成功率估计与早期故障检测上的效果。
AI.motivation: 智能体软件系统在开发中被广泛使用，模型、提示、脚手架、工具或运行环境的变更都需反复测试，成本高昂；已有TCS研究针对深度神经网络和LLM代码模型，未直接覆盖智能体系统，且常依赖专有智能体无法提供的模型内部信息。
AI.method: 把每个基准任务当作一个测试用例，适配基于任务描述、元数据、代码片段和嵌入等选择准则的黑盒回归测试技术；并提��利用启发式特征或独立LLM-as-judge评估来估计任务难度的策略。所有策略在选中任务时不执行目标智能体、也不使用历史结果。在10个AI智能体基准（每个12至101个智能体）上评估14种选择策略（含随机采样）及一个历史数据基线。
AI.result: 没有单一策略在两项指标上全面占优。适配的黑盒回归测试策略在成功率估计上最有效，其中Category Partition在20%任务预算下于5个基准取得最低中位误差。LLM-as-judge选择在早期故障检测上更有效。在SWE-bench Verified上的GPT 5.2 Codex实验中，Category Partition选取100个而非500个任务，将执行成本从\$225降至\$47，成功率估计误差仅0.8个百分点；同预算下LLM-as-judge选择的故障检测量接近随机采样的两倍（53.0%对27.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒TCS可显著降低智能体系统的测试成本并提供可靠的成功率估计与早期故障暴露；不同目标需选用不同策略——成功率估计宜用Category Partition等回归测试方法，早期故障检测宜用LLM-as-judge选择。

title: Extraneous Cognitive Load in Large Language Models
summary: Cognitive Load Theory (CLT) shows that human problem-solving is affected by both intrinsic load, arising from task difficulty, and extraneous load, arising from how task information is presented. Large language models (LLMs) show analogous effects: presentation alone can affect model performance, but these effects have not yet been systematically isolated from task difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce CogLoadBench, a controlled benchmark that varies five CLT-inspired presentation factors across three reasoning task families. Across models, we find that higher extraneous load conditions often reduce accuracy by either adding competition or complicating the reasoning path. To support diagnosis and mitigation of load-related effects, we propose the Extraneous Load Score (ELS), a prompt-time metric computed from activations that estimates a model's extraneous load, and show that it generalizes across reasoning task types and load levels. We further show that shifting model representations toward lower-load directions at inference time can improve average model performance without changing prompt content.

AI.tldr: 该论文将认知负荷理论引入LLM评估，提出CogLoadBench基准以分离"呈现方式"与"任务难度"的影响，并提出基于激活的Extraneous Load Score (ELS)用于诊断，且通过在推理时将表示推向低负荷方向可提升性能。
AI.motivation: CLT指出人类解题受内在负荷（任务难度）与外在负荷（信息呈现方式）共同影响。LLM也表现出类似"仅呈现方式即影响性能"的现象，但这些效应尚未与任务难度系统性地分离，缺乏受控实验证据。
AI.method: 1) 构建CogLoadBench：在三类推理任务族上，系统地变化五种源自CLT的呈现因素，实现受控对照；2) 提出Extraneous Load Score (ELS)：一种在提示时从模型激活计算的外在负荷度量；3) 推理阶段对模型表示进行低负荷方向偏移，无需改动提示内容。
AI.result: 跨模型实验显示，高外在负荷条件通常降低准确率，机制为增加干扰竞争或使推理路径复杂化；ELS在不同推理任务类型与负荷水平间具有泛化能力；将表示向低负荷方向偏移可在不改动提示的情况下提升平均性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM存在可测量、可泛化的"外在负荷"效应，且可通过激活层面的诊断指标与表示干预加以缓解，为提示设计与模型可解释性提供了新视角。

title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
summary: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating its premises as the problem. However, a planted proof is only one possible proof. A problem can also have shorter proofs, or several unrelated ones, and its stated depth then overstates what solving it requires. We measure what a problem actually requires, relative to a stated set of inference rules. For each problem, we compute the steps every proof must make, the shortest proof, the number of minimal proofs and the indispensable premises, and export certificates that an independent checker verifies. Audits of eight datasets find depth that is forced (ProofWriter, Blocksworld), problems labelled depth 5 that require about two specific rule applications (FLDx2), and answers that need no particular step (ZebraLogic). We then construct problems whose every proof has a requested structure, using a catalog of shortcuts proved once per rule set. Every constructed problem is checked in full and comes with its own certificate. In training, the best data mixes depths and problem types. At equal size, such mixtures of certified problem types, including model-checking problems that forward generation does not produce, transfer better than FLDx2-style derivation data for Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B.

AI.tldr: 论文指出程序化生成的逻辑题中"植入证明深度"并不等于题目真实难度，提出以推理规则为基准计算每个问题最小证明、必然步骤与不可缺前提，并导出可独立验证的证书；审计8个数据集后构造"每条证明都符合要求结构"的题目，训练中混合多种经认证的题型优于FLDx2式推导数据。
AI.motivation: 现有逻辑题通过"植入"一条指定深度的证明来设定难度，但植入的证明只是众多可能证明之一：题目可能存在更短证明或若干互不相关的证明，导致标称深度高估了实际解题所需。因此需要一个衡量题目"真实所需"的方法。
AI.method: 在给定推理规则集下，对每个问题计算：所有证明都必须经过的步骤、最短证明、极小证明的数量以及不可缺前提，并导出可被独立检查器验证的证明证书。随后基于每个规则集一次性证明的"捷径目录"，构造每条证明都具有指定结构的问题，全部完整校验并附证书；并在Qwen3 0.6B–8B上比较不同数据混合的训练效果。
AI.result: 对8个数据集的审计发现：ProofWriter、Blocksworld的深度是被迫的；FLDx2中标注深度5的题目实际只需约两次特定规则应用；ZebraLogic的答案不需要任何特定步骤。训练实验表明，等规模下混合多种已认证题型（含前向生成无法产生的模型检验类问题）比FLDx2式推导数据迁移效果更好。
AI.conclusion: 应以可验证的"真实推理需求"而非植入证明深度来定义与生成逻辑题难度；证书化的问题构造可精确控制证明结构，且混合多种认证题型是更优的训练数据策略。

title: Deep Learning-Based Mesoscopic Emission Modeling
comment: Submitted to Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
summary: Traffic-related emissions are a major contributor to urban air pollution. However, existing emission models face a fundamental trade-off: macroscopic models are computationally efficient but rely on average speeds, leading to systematic errors, while microscopic models achieve high accuracy but are computationally prohibitive for large scale simulations. To bridge this gap, this study introduces Direct Emission Prediction (DEP), a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)-based deep learning model. DEP was trained on over one million synthetic trips generated by coupling real-world GNSS speed profiles with the microscopic emission model MOBSim. By processing sequential link-level inputs, including vehicle characteristics, road attributes, and ambient temperature, DEP predicts CO$_2$ and NOx emissions. We integrated DEP into a MATSim-based workflow and applied it to the Ile-de-France region. DEP matches the accuracy of SPG-M, a hybrid mesoscopic-microscopic reference model, within 0.35% for CO$_2$ and 1.87% for NOx across both hot and cold-start scenarios, while reducing computational runtime to just 2.2%. Furthermore, validation against empirical remote sensing data confirms that DEP accurately reproduces real-world NOx emission levels across Euro 2-6 diesel vehicles, whereas traditional macroscopic tools like COPERT and HBEFA systematically underestimate them. Finally, DEP effectively captures the spatial distribution of cold-start emissions, identifying key hotspots in dense urban areas. This work demonstrates that deep learning-based mesoscopic frameworks can achieve microscopic accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, enabling scalable, high-resolution urban emission modeling without relying on pre-computed emission factor databases.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于GRU深度学习的"直接排放预测"(DEP)模型，在百万级合成出行数据上训练，以微观模型精度、约2%的计算开销实现可扩展的城市交通排放建模。
AI.motivation: 现有交通排放模型存在根本性权衡：宏观模型计算高效但依赖平均速度导致系统性误差，微观模型精度高但对大规模仿真计算成本过高，亟需兼顾精度与效率的中间方案。
AI.method: 提出DEP（Direct Emission Prediction）模型：将真实GNSS速度轨迹与微观排放模型MOBSim耦合生成超百万合成出行数据，训练GRU处理路段级序列输入（车辆特性、道路属性、环境温度），预测CO2与NOx排放，并集成到MATSim工作流。
AI.result: 在法兰西岛区域应用：DEP与混合中微观参考模型SPG-M精度相当（CO2误差<0.35%，NOx<1.87%，含冷热启动），运行时间仅为其2.2%；与遥感实测数据对比能准确复现Euro 2-6柴油车NOx水平，而COPERT、HBEFA系统性低估；并有效捕捉冷启动排放的空间热点分布。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习驱动的中观框架可仅以极小计算成本达到微观级精度，实现不依赖预计算排放因子数据库的可扩展高分辨率城市排放建模。

title: Same Tokenizer, Better Tokens: Choosing Image Tokens by MAP Inference
summary:
Discrete visual tokens encode images for reconstruction and serve as training targets for autoregressive image generators. Vector-quantized tokenizers typically assign each encoder feature its nearest code independently. The decoder uses these codes jointly, so a sequence of individually nearest codes can reconstruct an image less faithfully than an alternative assignment. A local model of the reconstruction loss yields a closest-vector problem with a decoder-dependent target and metric. Reconstruction-only search improves PSNR across the frozen tokenizers we test. Different code sequences can achieve similar reconstruction quality, leaving room to favour more predictable ones.
  We introduce RecaP (Reconstruction and Predictability), which selects codes for a frozen tokenizer by balancing how faithfully they reconstruct the image with how likely their sequence is under a pretrained autoregressive prior. On ImageNet, LlamaGen GPT-B trained on RecaP tokens achieves lower early-checkpoint FID against training images than GPT-B trained on nearest-neighbour tokens. The difference is smaller against held-out images. On an ImageNet subset, the prior improves generation at comparable reconstruction FID. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/recap

AI.tldr: 提出RecaP，在冻结分词器上联合优化"重建保真度"与"自回归先验下的序列可预测性"来选择离散视觉token，从而提升自回归图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有向量量化分词器对每个编码器特征独立取最近邻码字，但解码器是联合使用整串码字的，因此"逐点最近邻"序列未必是最优重建；同时不同码序列可达到相近重建质量，存在挑选更"可预测"序列的空间。
AI.method: 1) 将重建损失局部建模，得到一个依赖解码器的最近向量问题（解码器相关目标与度量），用重建-only 搜索选码；2) 提出 RecaP，在冻结分词器上按"重建保真度 + 预训练自回归先验下序列似然"的平衡来选码；3) 用 LlamaGen GPT-B 在 RecaP token 上训练验证。
AI.result: 在测试的冻结分词器上，重建-only 搜索普遍提升 PSNR。ImageNet 上，用 RecaP token 训练的 GPT-B 相比最近邻 token 训练，在早期 checkpoint 对训练图像的 FID 更低；对留出图像差距较小。在 ImageNet 子集上，先验在相当重建 FID 下改善生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 分词器不应只做逐特征最近邻量化，引入解码器感知的重建搜索与先验可预测性正则能改善自回归生成；但收益部分来自对训练图像的拟合，泛化增益有限。

title: RecField: Embedding Recommendations into Spatial Movie Organization as Affordances for Serendipitous Encounters
summary: Research on serendipity-oriented recommender systems has focused on algorithms that recommend unexpected yet useful items. However, serendipity is increasingly viewed as a user experience shaped by both algorithmic outputs and system features. This study positions recommendations not as the primary goal users pursue but as an environmental affordance that creates opportunities for discovery during other activities. We propose RecField, a spatial movie organization interface where users freely arrange movies into collection zones. For each collection, RecField provides attribute-based recommendation lists labeled according to their recommendation perspectives. A between-subjects experiment ($N$ = 57) examined the effects of recommendations on discoveries made during a foreground task of creating and organizing personal movie profiles. Although recommendations did not significantly affect environment-level perceived serendipity, ratings of encounter-related aspects tended to be higher, with small effect sizes. At the individual-movie level, favorites in the recommendation condition received significantly higher ratings for stimulating the desire to watch and broadening preferences, but not for novelty or unexpectedness. Notably, only 14\% of evaluated favorites in the recommendation condition were added directly from recommendation lists. Differences in ratings showed similar effect sizes even when the analysis was restricted to favorites added through other routes. These findings suggest that embedded recommendations can contribute to serendipitous experiences both directly through item acceptance and indirectly by prompting users' own exploration and re-evaluation. They also highlight the value of evaluating serendipity at both the environment and item levels and the limitations of relying solely on direct recommendation acceptance rates.

AI.tldr: 提出RecField空间化电影组织界面，将推荐作为环境可供性嵌入用户任务中，实验表明嵌入式推荐可通过直接采纳和间接激发探索两条途径促进偶遇性体验。
AI.motivation: 现有偶遇性推荐研究多聚焦算法本身，但偶遇性日益被视为由算法输出与系统功能共同塑造的用户体验；同时推荐往往被当作用户的主要目标而非背景环境的一部分。作者希望把推荐重新定位为在用户从事其他活动时创造发现机会的环境性可供性。
AI.method: 设计RecField——一个空间化电影组织界面，用户可将电影自由排布到"收藏区域"；每个收藏区提供按其推荐视角命名的属性驱动推荐列表。开展被试间实验（N=57），考察推荐对用户在前台任务（创建与组织个人电影档案）中发现的影​​响，并在环境层面和单部电影层面分别评估偶遇性。
AI.result: 推荐对环境层面的整体偶遇感无显著影响，但"相遇"相关评分略高（效应量小）。在单部电影层面，推荐组的收藏条目在"激发观看欲望"和"拓宽偏好"上显著更高，而在新颖性与意外性上无显著差异。值得注意的是，推荐组中仅14%的收藏条目直接来自推荐列表；即便仅分析通过其他途径添加的条目，评分差异效应量仍相近。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入式推荐可通过直接采纳条目和间接促使用户自主探索与重新评估两种途径促成偶遇体验；研究强调应在环境与条目两个层面评估偶遇性，并指出仅依赖直接推荐采纳率存在局限。

title: Last-Iterate Equilibrium Learning in Symmetric Congestion Games under Semi-Bandit Feedback
summary: We study last-iterate learning of mixed Nash equilibria in atomic symmetric congestion games under resource semi-bandit feedback, where players observe both the costs and the loads of their selected resources. For strictly increasing latency functions, the restriction of the potential function to symmetric marginal profiles is strongly convex. However, players' independent stochastic updates need not preserve this symmetry without explicit synchronization. We show that a quadratic consensus penalty makes the potential globally strongly convex while making the symmetric equilibrium the unique minimizer of the transformed potential. We propose a variant of online projected gradient descent that achieves $O(t^{-2/3})$ squared distance to equilibrium and $O(t^{-1/3})$ maximum deviation gain in expectation, for every $t\geq 1$ and for any initialization. The played profile also converges to equilibrium almost surely.

AI.tldr: 研究原子对称拥塞博弈在资源半带状反馈下混合纳什均衡的last-iterate学习，提出加二次一致惩罚使势函数全局强凸，并给出在线投影梯度下降变体，实现$O(t^{-2/3})$的平方距离收敛与$O(t^{-1/3})$的最大偏差收益，且几乎必然收敛到均衡。
AI.motivation: 严格递增时延函数下，势函数限制在对称边际剖面上是强凸的，但玩家独立随机更新在缺乏显式同步时无法保持这种对称性，导致无法直接利用强凸性做last-iterate收敛分析。
AI.method: 引入二次一致惩罚（quadratic consensus penalty）构造变换后的势函数，使其全局强凸且对称均衡成为唯一极小点；在此基础上提出在线投影梯度下降的一个变体。
AI.result: 对任意$t\geq1$和任意初始化，期望平方距离达$O(t^{-2/3})$，期望最大偏差收益达$O(t^{-1/3})$；实际博弈剖面几乎必然收敛到均衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过一致惩罚恢复全局强凸性，可在非同步的独立更新下实现混合纳什均衡的last-iterate收敛，兼具速率保证与几乎必然收敛性。

title: Multi-Party Authorization of Maintenance Prescriptions on a Permissioned Blockchain
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IFAC AMEST / IMS 2027
summary: In industrial prescriptive maintenance, an equipment supplier's model may recommend an intervention that a plant schedules, a contractor executes, and a quality or safety function approves. A shared ledger records who submitted the prescription, yet cannot check whether the agreed model and decision rule produced it. We require permissioned-blockchain endorsers to verify a succinct proof of that calculation before releasing a work order. On a four-organization Hyperledger Fabric testbed using a public engine benchmark, this stopped all nine contested or mis-operated prescriptions, whereas hash checks accepted four that either raised simulated maintenance cost or reintroduced late failures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在许可链（Hyperledger Fabric）背书环节验证"处方维护决策计算"的简洁证明，再放行工单，从而把"谁提交"的可追溯性升级为"计算是否正确"的可验证性。
AI.motivation: 工业处方性维护涉及供应商模型、工厂排程、承包商执行、质量/安全审批多方，共享账本只记录提交者身份，无法核验结果是否由约定模型与决策规则产生，导致争议或误操作处方无法被识别。
AI.method: 构建一个公共服务引擎基准上的四组织 Fabric 测试床；由链上背书节点在签发工单前验证该决策计算的简洁证明（proof of calculation），与哈希校验基线对比。
AI.result: 证明验证方案拦截了全部 9 条争议/误操作处方；哈希校验则放行了 4 条，这些处方或抬高模拟维护成本、或导致故障复发。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭内容哈希不足以保证处方合规，需在链上对决策计算本身做可验证性校验；该方案在多方工业维护场景中可行且有效。

title: Focus On Facts: Stylistically Invariant and Factually Sensitive Text Embeddings
summary: Text embedding models can conflate surface-form similarity with factual identity. Given an altered near-copy with one corrupted fact and a differently worded fact-preserving rewrite, the base model prefers the altered near-copy. We test whether hard-negative contrastive supervision can reduce this surface-similarity shortcut. We construct FOF-Bench, an 83,263-triplet benchmark spanning five domains. Each anchor is paired with an LLM-generated, fact-preserving stylistic rewrite and a matched fact-altered near-copy. We fine-tune FOF-80M (Focus On Facts), an 80M-parameter embedding model, with a triplet contrastive objective that ranks the rewrite above the factual alteration. On 8,327 held-out test triplets, the base model chooses the factually altered text in 99.58% of cases (0.42% factual preference rate; mean separation -0.1650). After fine-tuning, mean positive--negative separation is +0.0329, 98.5% of individual margins move in the intended direction, and the preference rate reaches 29.37%. On DiSC, an external style-transfer corpus, mean cross-style similarity increases from 0.7905 to 0.9559. The model also penalizes omission and transfers poorly to directional tasks such as NLI and summarization. We characterize FOF-80M as a soft factual fingerprint for studying factual retention under stylistic variation, not as a general-purpose factuality metric.

AI.tldr: 本文构建FOF-Bench基准并微调80M嵌入模型FOF-80M，用硬负样本对比学习缓解"表面相似性捷径"，使模型更偏好保真改写而非事实篡改的近拷贝。
AI.motivation: 文本嵌入模型常将表面形式相似与事实同一性混淆：面对仅一处事实被篡改的近拷贝与措辞不同但事实保真的改写，基座模型更偏好前者，体现出表面相似性捷径。
AI.method: 构建FOF-Bench（83,263个三元组，跨五领域）；每个锚点配一个LLM生成的事实保真风格改写与一个匹配的事实篡改近拷贝；以排序改写高于篡改的三元组对比目标微调80M参数嵌入模型FOF-80M。
AI.result: 在8,327个留出测试三元组上，基座模型99.58%选择篡改文本（偏好率0.42%，平均分离-0.1650）；微调后平均正负分离+0.0329，98.5%样本边际方向正确，偏好率升至29.37%；DiSC外部语料跨风格相似度由0.7905升至0.9559。模型会惩罚遗漏，且对NLI、摘要等方向性任务迁移较差。
AI.conclusion: FOF-80M应被定位为研究风格变化下事实保留的"软事实指纹"，而非通用事实性度量。

title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.

AI.tldr: 本文在雅可比透镜（Jacobian lens）定义的 J-空间（每个词/类对应的能最大提升该词/类生成倾向的隐藏状态向量集合）上验证 Platonic Representation Hypothesis（PRH），发现视觉与语言模型的 J-空间也趋于收敛，且主要相差一个旋转：在部分词上拟合的单一旋转即可迁移到未见词与类别，并能实际干预多模态模型与图像生成器的输出。
AI.motivation: 已有工作只在"表征"层面（激活值）找到 PRH 证据，但模型是否在"如何作用于表征"这一输出影响机制上也收敛，尚未被检验。作者希望把 PRH 从"如何表示世界"扩展到"如何作用于世界"。
AI.method: 在 transformer 选定层的 Jacobian lens 下，为词表（或图像分类器类别）中每个词计算"最能提升该词/类生成倾向"的隐藏状态向量，构成 J-空间；跨视觉与语言模型比较 J-空间，并拟合子集词上的单一旋转来做跨模型映射，再将该旋转后的向量注入其他模型（VLM 的 patch token、图像生成器的文本条件、ImageNet 分类器）做因果干预。
AI.result: J-空间跨视觉与语言模型存在 PRH 证据，且基本"仅差一个旋转"：在未拟合的词与类别上旋转映射依然有效。把纯文本语言模型中的词向量旋转注入视觉语言模型的图像 patch token，会改变其识别的物体，且仅影响注入所在图像区域；注入图像生成器文本条件可改变生成物体的类别；注入无文本训练的 ImageNet 分类器可把该物体类别分数提到近乎最高，反向亦然。
AI.conclusion: 模型不仅在如何表征世界上收敛，也在如何作用于世界上收敛：J-空间可通过单一旋转跨模态对齐，并具备可迁移的因果干预能力。这为 PRH 提供了机制层面的新证据，也提示跨模型、跨模态之间可能存在共享的"动作接口"。

title: Neighbor Crowding Predicts Feature Stability in Sparse Autoencoders
comment: Accepted at the NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations), NeurIPS 2026, Proceedings track. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offer an approach to identify language model representations by breaking apart polysemantic features into more sparse, interpretable ones. Yet, it is challenging to identify which of the learned features are actually stable, rather than artifacts of initialization. One approach is to train multiple SAE seeds, and compare the learned features across seeds by cosine similarity, but this is notably costly. This raises the question of whether stable features can be identified without the computational expense of training multiple seeds. In this work, we examine cross-seed feature stability across differing levels of training tokens, and demonstrate that in TopK SAEs, it is highly predictable using six computationally cheap statistics derived from a single training run. Neighbor crowding, a geometric property of the dictionary, is the strongest single predictor, with features that sit in dense regions of the unit sphere more likely to be stable than isolated ones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏自编码器(SAE)特征跨随机种子训练的稳定性,发现仅用单次训练得到的六个廉价统计量即可高度预测TopK SAE特征的跨种子稳定性,其中"邻居拥挤度"是最强单项预测因子。
AI.motivation: SAE可把语言模型的多义特征分解为更稀疏、可解释的特征,但难以判断哪些学到的特征真正稳定、而非初始化产物。常规做法是训练多个种子并用余弦相似度比较,计算成本很高。因此作者追问:能否在不训练多种子的前提下识别稳定特征。
AI.method: 作者分析不同训练token数量下的跨种子特征稳定性,并针对TopK SAE,用单次训练中提取的六个计算廉价的统计量来预测稳定性。其中"邻居拥挤度"(字典的几何性质,即特征在单位球上的分布密度)作为核心指标被重点检验。
AI.result: 跨种子特征稳定性高度可预测。六个廉价统计量即可较好预测稳定性,其中邻居拥挤度是最强单项预测因子:位于单位球稠密区域的特征比孤立特征更可能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练多种子,仅凭单次训练的廉价统计量即可识别SAE中稳定的特征,大幅降低成本;特征在字典几何中的拥挤程度是稳定性的关键信号。

title: JetDiffusion: Pushing the Speed Limits of Video Generation with NVFP4 Sparse Attention
summary: Attention over long sequences is a major computational bottleneck in video generation, which can be alleviated through sparsity and low-bit quantization. We propose JetDiffusion, a video generation system built on trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA), with custom inference kernels that combine native NVFP4 computation and kernel fusion. At 90% sparsity, VSQA accelerates attention by 8-29x compared with FlashAttention on different hardwares. To further accelerate video generation, we combine VSQA with NVFP4 linear quantization and step distillation. Although each technique can individually preserve generation quality, jointly adapting to all three remains challenging, particularly under aggressive NVFP4 quantization. Through empirical studies, we develop an effective staged training recipe that enables stable adaptation to quantization, sparsity, and few-step denoising. On Wan2.1-14B, the resulting model achieves 273x end-to-end video generation speedup on the RTX 5090 while maintaining comparable video quality.

AI.tldr: JetDiffusion 是一个视频生成系统，基于可训练的 VSQA 稀疏量化注意力，结合 NVFP4 计算、核融合与步数蒸馏，在 RTX 5090 上实现 273x 端到端加速且质量相当。
AI.motivation: 长序列注意力是视频生成的主要计算瓶颈，稀疏化与低比特量化虽有潜力，但三者（稀疏、NVFP4 量化、少步蒸馏）联合适配困难，尤其在激进 NVFP4 量化下难以稳定保持生成质量。
AI.method: 提出可训练的视频稀疏量化注意力 VSQA（含原生 NVFP4 计算与核融合的自定义推理核）；将 VSQA 与 NVFP4 线性量化、步数蒸馏结合；通过实证研究设计分阶段训练配方，实现稳定适配。
AI.result: 90% 稀疏度下 VSQA 相比 FlashAttention 加速 8-29x（不同硬件）；在 Wan2.1-14B 上，RTX 5090 端到端视频生成加速 273x，视频质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力、低比特量化与步数蒸馏的联合优化在合适的分阶段训练下可稳定协同，带来数量级的视频生成效率提升。

title: ConTra: A Training Framework for Effective Contextual Retrieval via Prefix Generation
summary: Data management systems organize large text collections for tasks such as finding relevant studies and extracting contract clauses. Systems make long documents searchable by splitting them into independently indexed chunks. Chunking can separate text from its identifying details. The indexing challenge is to keep each chunk independently searchable while preserving the context needed to find and rank it. Existing methods either encode that context in chunk vectors or attach it as a text prefix. Context encoded only in vectors is unavailable to text rerankers. Prompted prefixes serve both vector search and reranking, but are costly to generate at indexing time and can underperform contextual encoders. We propose ConTra (Context That Travels), a reinforcement learning framework for training lightweight prefix generators. Its reward combines feedback from frozen embedding and reranking models with factual verification and length control. ConTra generates one prefix per chunk during index construction and stores the augmented text and its embedding for reuse across queries. To evaluate contextual retrieval across workloads and under interference, we introduce RealContextBench, a benchmark with five application collections and three controlled conditions that isolate the effect of distracting text. On ConTEB and RealContextBench, ConTra-2B outperforms the prompted 9B baseline using Anthropic's method and the PPLX-4B contextual encoder, with a margin of up to 3.15 points over their best overall scores, while indexing short documents 7.74 times and 2.15 times as fast as those baselines, respectively. Post-trained only on ConTEB, it leads the standalone methods on RealContextBench after reranking and is less sensitive than the prompted 2B baseline to random and topically similar distractors. Code, datasets, and trained models are available at https://github.com/SStan1/ConTra.

AI.tldr: ConTra 是一个强化学习框架，训练轻量级前缀生成器为每个文本块生成可随行传播的上下文前缀，从而在保持独立可检索性的同时保留检索与重排序所需的上下文。作者还提出 RealContextBench 基准，ConTra-2B 在准确率与索引速度上均优于更强的提示式与编码器基线，且对干扰文本更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 长文档切块后，文本会与其识别性细节（如标题、出处等）分离，导致块难以被正确检索和排序。现有做法要么仅把上下文编码进向量（文本重排序器无法使用），要么用提示式方法生成文本前缀（索引时生成代价高，效果也不如上下文编码器）。因此需要一个既能让前缀同时服务向量检索与重排序、又便宜高效且质量可靠的方法。
AI.method: 提出 ConTra（Context That Travels）：用强化学习训练轻量级前缀生成器，奖励由冻结的嵌入模型与重排序模型的反馈、事实性校验以及长度控制共同构成。索引构建时为每个块生成一个前缀，并存储增强后的文本及其嵌入，可跨查询复用。同时构建 RealContextBench：包含 5 个应用集合与 3 种控制条件，用于隔离干扰文本的影响，评估上下文检索在真实工作负载与干扰下的表现。
AI.result: 在 ConTEB 与 RealContextBench 上，ConTra-2B 超过使用 Anthropic 方法的提示式 9B 基线和 PPLX-4B 上下文编码器，整体最佳分数领先最多 3.15 分；短文档索引速度分别为两者的 7.74 倍和 2.15 倍。仅在 ConTEB 上后训练，在 RealContextBench 上重排序后仍领先独立方法，且相比提示式 2B 基线对随机及主题相似的干扰文本更不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过学习式轻量前缀生成，可同时提升上下文检索的质量与索引效率，并以更小模型超过更大基线；所生成的上下文前缀还带来更强的抗干扰鲁棒性。代码、数据集与模型均已开源。

title: Computing Normal-Form Correlated Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games is in PPAD
summary: We study the computational complexity of finding any normal-form correlated equilibria (NFCE for short) in the succinct games of extensive-form with perfect recall, which is considered as a major open problem in algorithmic game theory. Our main results place this problem in PPAD for an arbitrary numbers of players. Our second result establishes PPAD-hardness of computing such an NFCE with support size of at most quadratic in the size of the game, even for two-player games. The posed restriction on the support size in PPAD-hardness construction is motivated by our PPAD algorithm, which constructs an NFCE with support size quadratic in the size of the input extensive-form game.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在完美回忆扩展式博弈（简洁博弈）中寻找正规型相关均衡（NFCE）的计算复杂度，证明该问题属于PPAD，且在支持集规模至多二次方时是PPAD-难的（即使两人博弈）。
AI.motivation: 在扩展式完美回忆博弈中寻找任何正规型相关均衡（NFCE）是算法博弈论中的主要开放问题，其计算复杂度此前未定。
AI.method: 构造PPAD算法：对任意玩家数量都能找到支持集规模与输入扩展式博弈规模成二次方的NFCE；同时通过归约证明在支持集规模不超过二次方的限制下该问题是PPAD-难的（含两人博弈）。
AI.result: 主要结果一：任意玩家数的NFCE计算问题属于PPAD；结果二：将NFCE计算（支持集至多二次方）证明为PPAD-难，且适用于两人博弈。PPAD-难性中的支持集限制由所提PPAD算法自然引出。
AI.conclusion: NFCE计算问题被定位在PPAD内，并在二次支持集限制下具有PPAD-难性，从而基本刻画了该开放问题的复杂度，且算法与下界在支持集规模上相匹配。

title: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
summary: Agent patches are larger than developers', which is widely read as over-editing. But patch size does not say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from. We introduce Delta Residue Attribution (DRA), which replays agent trajectories, traces every block (unit) of the final patch to the step that wrote it, reverts each unit, and reruns the task tests to decide whether the unit is needed. We apply DRA to 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18 frontier models on SWE-bench Verified (6,728) and DeepSWE (932), and grade developer patches using the same method. Agent patches do change more lines than developers'; on SWE-bench Verified the majority of extra edits add tests (61%) and documentation (13%) while on DeepSWE, most extra edits are code (58%). On both benchmarks, agents' code is on average at least as necessary as developers' (mean $NP_{code}$ 0.887 vs. 0.864 on SWE-bench Verified, where 11 of 18 models leave less unneeded code than developers, and 0.797 vs. 0.785 on DeepSWE). On average, 11% of an agent patch's code units on SWE-bench Verified are still unneeded, and 89% of those change behavior. Debug steps write almost none of the unneeded code. Code necessity differs substantially by model; it is unrelated to resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified and negatively correlated with it on DeepSWE (Spearman -0.59, p = 0.01). On SWE-bench Verified, pruning with DRA using only the tests the agent can see (its own tests and the repository's) removes the majority of unneeded code but also some needed code (67% recall, 46% precision), and 89% of pruned patches still resolve the task; asking the agent to audit its own diff is more precise but less effective (36% recall, 66% precision). We recommend that benchmarks report code necessity next to resolve rate and that over-editing be addressed through model training and harness-level pruning.

AI.tldr: 提出Delta Residue Attribution (DRA)，通过回放agent轨迹并逐单元回滚+重跑测试来判定补丁每个代码单元是否必要，发现agent补丁虽更大但代码必要性与开发者相当，多余编辑多为测试和文档。
AI.motivation: agent补丁比开发者更大，通常被解读为"过度编辑"，但补丁大小无法说明额外编辑是否必要、内容为何、来源何处，需要更细粒度的必要性度量。
AI.method: DRA：回放agent轨迹，把最终补丁的每个单元追溯到写入它的步骤，逐个回滚该单元并重跑任务测试，判定其是否必要；对开发者补丁同样打分。用于7,660条已解决的GitHub Copilot CLI轨迹（18个前沿模型，SWE-bench Verified 6,728 + DeepSWE 932）。
AI.result: agent改动行数更多：SWE-bench Verified上额外编辑61%为测试、13%为文档，DeepSWE上58%为代码。代码必要性均不低于开发者（NP_code均值0.887 vs 0.864，18个模型中11个更少多余代码；DeepSWE 0.797 vs 0.785）。SWE-bench上平均11%代码单元仍不必要，其中89%改变行为；debug步骤几乎不产生多余代码。代码必要性与resolve rate在SWE-bench上无关，在DeepSWE上负相关（Spearman -0.59, p=0.01）。用可见测试做DRA剪枝：67%召回、46%精确率，89%剪枝后补丁仍通过；agent自审diff更精确但效果差（36%召回、66%精确率）。
AI.conclusion: 建议基准在报告resolve rate的同时报告代码必要性，并通过模型训练与harness级剪枝来解决过度编辑问题。

title: FrIdéo: French News Outlet Ideology Scoring via Multi-Source Evidence Fusion and Distancing-Aware Lexical Scoring
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Published in the Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP-2026), ACL Anthology ID 2026.icnlsp-1.22: https://aclanthology.org/2026.icnlsp-1.22/ . Code and data: https://github.com/lefrenchnewslab/frideo
summary: Outlet ideology is a standard explanatory variable in media framing, media effects, and political communication research, but continuous, ecosystem-wide coverage lets it enter as graded exposure rather than a coarse bin. For France, existing references are either broad but non-analytic or analytic but sparse and source-specific, and none we are aware of offers ecosystem-wide coverage on a unified continuous scale. We contribute FrIdéo: to our knowledge the first ecosystem-wide continuous ideology scores for the French press, a transparent composite score for 30 French news outlets, fusing nine independent families of evidence with empirical-Bayes-style shrinkage toward a structural prior. For the text-based family we introduce symmetric plain/qualified scoring, which separates the plain use of ideologically loaded vocabulary from its qualified (distanced) use on both sides, a distinction bag-of-words methods miss. The resulting scale runs from L'Humanité on the far left to Valeurs actuelles on the far right; the far-right pole is near-indistinguishable and CNews ties Le Figaro. Because the text family reads current articles, it also captures editorial change that static sources miss, such as the Journal du Dimanche's sharp rightward shift after its 2023 ownership change. The ordering is robust to perturbation and to dropping any single family, and agrees with held-out Media Bias Fact Check labels. We release the scores, confidence intervals, and replication code.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FrIdéo，首个覆盖法国新闻媒体生态的连续意识形态评分体系，为30家法国媒体机构构建透明的复合得分。融合九类独立证据，并采用经验贝叶斯式向结构先验收缩的方法。
AI.motivation: 媒体意识形态是框架研究、媒介效果与政治传播研究中的标准解释变量，但现有法国相关参考要么宽泛却缺乏分析，要么分析严谨但稀疏且局限于单一来源，尚无统一连续尺度覆盖整个媒体生态。连续、全生态的覆盖能让意识形态作为分级暴露变量进入模型，而非粗糙二分。
AI.method: 构建30家法国媒体的复合意识形态得分，融合九个独立证据家族，并以经验贝叶斯式收缩向结构先验靠拢。文本类证据引入对称的"朴素/限定"评分法，区分意识形态负载词汇的朴素使用与被限定（保持距离）的使用，弥补词袋方法的不足。
AI.result: 量表从左翼的《人道报》到右翼的《当前价值观》；极右端区分度低，CNews与《费加罗报》持平。由于文本证据读取当期文章，可捕捉静态来源遗漏的编辑立场变化，如《周日报》2023年易主后急剧右转。排序对扰动及删除任一证据家族均稳健，并与留出的 Media Bias Fact Check 标签一致。
AI.conclusion: FrIdéo 提供了首个全生态、连续、可复现的法国媒体意识形态评分，公开得分、置信区间与复现代码，为媒体研究提供分级暴露变量。

title: Brand Recall and Category Accuracy in Language Models: An Audit of 1,000 B2B SaaS Brands
summary: A language model can name a brand without classifying it correctly. This study measures these outcomes separately for 1,000 B2B SaaS brands across 333 product categories. On Gemma 4 12B, with no external retrieval, category prompts elicit 510 brands (51.0%). A separate five-candidate category probe ranks the reference label first for 787 brands, a distractor first for 194, and yields little separation for 19. Among the 981 separated rankings, the error rate is 19.8%. It falls to 3.5% for the 547 brands with a winner-to-runner-up log-probability margin above 0.6. These are within-cohort measurements, not calibrated confidence estimates. Exploratory regressions associate technical coverage with recall and an owned-properties composite with category accuracy, but the composites use different adjustment sets and do not establish causal effects. Across four Gemma generations, measured recall is 39.8%, 44.3%, 51.1% and 51.0%. A separate representation-based sentiment measure has little linear association with customer ratings (r=0.03, n=921). The findings support reporting recall and category accuracy separately. Failure to elicit a brand does not establish its absence from model parameters or training data.

AI.tldr: 该研究在1,000个B2B SaaS品牌、333个产品类别上分别测量LLM的"品牌召回"与"类别正确性"，发现二者并不一致：Gemma 4 12B可召回51.0%品牌，但在可分离的五选一排序中错误率达19.8%，高置信边际样本降至3.5%。
AI.motivation: "能说出品牌名"不等于"能正确归类"——现有评估常把二者混为一谈，缺乏对召回率与类别准确率的分离测量，也缺乏跨模型代际与不确定性的细致刻画。
AI.method: 在333个类别、1,000个B2B SaaS品牌上做无外部检索的类别提示引发（测召回）；再用独立五候选探针排序参考标签、干扰项，并按获胜-次优对数概率边际分层；跨四代Gemma比较召回；用探索性回归关联技术覆盖度、自有资产复合指标，并另做基于表征的情感测量与客户评分相关性分析（r=0.03, n=921）。
AI.result: Gemma 4 12B召回510个品牌（51.0%）；五选一探针中787个首选参考标签、194个首选干扰项、19个区分度低；981个可分离样本错误率19.8%，边际>0.6的547个品牌仅3.5%。四代Gemma召回为39.8%、44.3%、51.1%、51.0%。情感表征与客户评分几乎无线性关联。
AI.conclusion: 应分别报告召回率与类别准确率；未召回某品牌并不能推定其不存在于模型参数或训练数据中；置信边际为队列内测量而非校准置信度，回归关联亦非因果结论。

title: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
summary: As AI systems become increasingly capable of executing and evaluating experiments, ideation is emerging as a bottleneck in automated scientific and engineering iteration. In many real-world domains, useful ideas are sparse and their validation is costly, making direct online exploration inefficient. We observe that repository evolution provides a scalable source of reusable technical experience: code changes record concrete technical hypotheses, while subsequent revisions, adoption, and reuse provide signals about their utility. Based on this observation, we propose REI, a Repository Evolution-driven Ideation framework that learns reusable ideation policies from repository evolution, injecting domain-specific technical experience into model parameters and reducing reliance on costly trial-and-error. We further identify a hidden failure mode in quality-driven ideation optimization: semantic diversity collapse. Although generated ideas can remain lexically diverse, they increasingly concentrate in a small number of dominant method families, limiting cross-task generalization and long-tail exploration. To address this problem, we introduce Semantic Prior Optimization and Debiasing (SPOD), a diversity-preserving alignment mechanism that makes method identity explicit, corrects category-level reward bias, and limits redundant accumulation within the same method family while retaining strong representatives. Experiments on public benchmarks and a real-world industrial setting demonstrate improvements in ideation quality, method diversity, cross-task generalization, and long-tail exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出REI框架，从代码仓库演化中学习可复用的构思策略，并引入SPOD机制缓解语义多样性坍缩，提升想法质量、方法多样性与跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: AI执行与评估实验的能力增强后，"构思(ideation)"成为自动化科研迭代的瓶颈。在真实领域中有用想法稀疏、验证成本高，直接在线试错效率低下。
AI.method: 观察到仓库演化是可扩展的技术经验来源：代码变更记录具体技术假设，后续修订、采纳与复用提供效用信号。据此提出REI，将领域技术经验注入模型参数，学习可复用构思策略。另识别出质量驱动优化中的隐藏失效模式——语义多样性坍缩（词汇多样但方法族集中），并提出SPOD：显式化方法身份、校正类别级奖励偏差、限制同族冗余累积同时保留强代表。
AI.result: 在公开基准和真实工业场景中，想法质量、方法多样性、跨任务泛化和长尾探索均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用仓库演化作为经验来源可有效缓解构思瓶颈，且需显式保持语义层面的方法多样性以避免优化中的多样性坍缩。

title: CoSMo: A Compact Spectral Space of Body Motion in Video
summary: We introduce CoSMo, a compact spectral space of body motion in video, in which each motion is a single code that can be compared and edited without training, transferred to a new subject, interpolated, composed, scaled in intensity and detail, or sampled anew. Our encoder expresses how a clip's DINOv2 features change over time in a fixed temporal basis, the discrete cosine transform (DCT), and compresses this change into 384 numbers. Because each frequency band is the same cosine pattern in every code, codes are aligned in time, ordered from coarse to fine, and can be blended or added without matching frames. What stays constant over a clip cancels, and keeping fewer frequencies leaves less of the performer and scene. The encoder is trained on real videos and on synthetic motions of several characters, and lightweight adapters let a frozen image-to-video model render any code with any subject. On unseen videos, our code ranks the same motion on other bodies higher than DisMo, a per-frame representation, while its nearest neighbors show the same performer about 40% less often with a seven times more compact code. In generation, without per-motion training, CoSMo transfers motion more faithfully than FlexiAct and a text-prompt baseline, at least as faithfully as DisMo on automatic metrics and clearly better between humanoid bodies, and its blends keep much more of both source motions than DisMo's. Users rank CoSMo first nearly twice as often as DisMo for motion transfer (59% vs. 30%), place it top-two 94% of the time, and prefer it in 76% of the interpolation comparisons.

AI.tldr: CoSMo提出一种紧凑的频谱化身体运动编码：用DCT将视频DINOv2特征的时间变化压缩为384维单码，可无需训练地比较、编辑、迁移、插值、组合与调节运动强度。
AI.motivation: 现有逐帧运动表示（如DisMo）维度高、依赖帧对齐，且易将与身份/场景相关的信息混入，难以直接比较、编辑与迁移运动。
AI.method: 编码器在固定DCT基上表达片段DINOv2特征随时间的变化，并压缩为384个数；各频带使用相同余弦模式，使码在时间上对齐、由粗到细排序、可无帧匹配地混合或相加；常量部分被抵消，保留更少频率则去除更多表演者与场景信息。编码器在真实视频与多角色合成运动上训练，并以轻量适配器让冻结的图像到视频模型用任意主体渲染任意码。
AI.result: 在未见视频上，CoSMo把同一运动在其他身体上的排名高于DisMo，且最近邻出现同一表演者的概率低约40%，码紧凑7倍。生成时无需逐运动训练，运动迁移比FlexiAct与文本提示基线更忠实，自动指标至少与DisMo相当，类人身体间明显更优，混合保留的两种源运动远多于DisMo。用户研究中运动迁移首选率59%对30%，进入前二94%，插值比较偏好76%。
AI.conclusion: 频谱化、时间对齐的紧凑运动码是一种有效且可编辑、可迁移、可组合的运动表示，在检索与生成任务上优于逐帧表示与现有基线。

title: Grounding User Preferences in Shared Multimodal Concepts for Recommendation
comment: Accepted at WSDM 2027 (Main Conference). 10 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
summary: Multimodal recommendation has substantially advanced item understanding by incorporating rich visual and textual content. Yet user preferences are still commonly encoded as implicit signals tied to individual items, leaving recurring semantic factors without persistent identities that can be shared across items. We introduce MKGE, a multimodal knowledge graph framework that represents these factors as canonical, addressable concepts. MKGE induces a domain-adaptive concept vocabulary from item images and titles, grounds each user's interaction history in supported concepts, and jointly models direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals. By turning recurring semantics into shared coordinates, MKGE enables evidence from different items to accumulate around the same preference factors. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that MKGE consistently outperforms collaborative, knowledge-graph, multimodal, and recent LLM/MLLM-based recommenders across all six reported metrics. Controlled studies further demonstrate the importance of canonical concept identities and personalized user-concept correspondence, with especially pronounced gains over removing or rewiring the user graph for low-activity users. These results establish canonical multimodal concepts as effective units for preference modeling and transfer. Code, constructed knowledge graphs, and prompts are available at https://github.com/Garden1a-X/MKGE.

AI.tldr: MKGE 提出一种多模态知识图谱框架，将跨商品反复出现的语义因素表示为规范、可寻址的概念，从而把用户偏好编码为可共享的语义坐标而非孤立的物品隐信号。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐虽融合视觉与文本内容提升了物品理解，但用户偏好仍被编码为与单个物品绑定的隐式信号，重复出现的语义因素缺乏可在物品间共享的持久身份，导致证据无法有效累积。
AI.method: MKGE 从物品图像与标题中归纳出领域自适应的概念词表，将每个用户的交互历史对齐（grounding）到有支撑的概念上，并联合建模直接的用户—物品证据与概念中介的偏好信号，构建规范概念身份与个性化用户—概念对应关系。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上，MKGE 在全部六项指标上一致优于协同过滤、知识图谱、多模态及近期 LLM/MLLM 推荐方法；消融与对照实验表明规范概念身份和个性化用户—概念对应至关重要，尤其对低活跃用户，移除或重连用户图带来的性能下降最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态语义抽象为规范概念，可作为偏好建模与迁移的有效单元；通过共享语义坐标实现跨物品证据累积，代码、知识图谱与提示词已开源。

title: Kant-Q: A Q-Learning Algorithm for Kantian Equilibrium in Symmetric Markov Games
summary: AI agents increasingly interact with one another, and many of these interactions are mixed-motive games, which have posed a persistent challenge for learning algorithms. Most multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms are designed to reach Nash equilibria, yet in many such games these equilibria are Pareto-inefficient. We instead study Kantian equilibria, an economic solution concept in which each agent plays the action it would want all agents to adopt. In symmetric games, this corresponds to an optimal common policy. We propose Kant-Q, a Q-learning algorithm in which each agent learns action profiles where all agents play the same action. Each update is then a sample from a single-agent MDP, so Kant-Q inherits the convergence guarantees of standard Q-learning. We show that every symmetric Markov game has a pure Kantian equilibrium. We also prove that all agents' Q-tables converge to the same limit, whose greedy policy is such an equilibrium, and that greedy play converges whenever the optimal common action is unique at every state. We further show that in a subclass of symmetric monotone games, the Kantian equilibrium is Pareto-efficient among pure strategy profiles and strictly individually rational. Empirically, on the iterated Prisoner's Dilemma and the GovSim fishery with up to 200 agents, Kant-Q learns the Kantian equilibrium, while the baselines underperform. Since copies of the same AI system naturally face one another in symmetric games, these results suggest universalization as a design principle for cooperative AI-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出Kant-Q：一种让每个智能体学习"所有人都采取同一动作"的动作剖面的Q-learning算法，在对称博弈中收敛到Kantian均衡，该均衡在对称单调博弈中Pareto有效。
AI.motivation: AI智能体之间越来越多地进行混合动机博弈交互，而主流MARL算法追求Nash均衡，这类均衡在许多博弈中Pareto低效（如囚徒困境），无法实现合作收益；因此需要一种以"普遍化"为设计原则、可获得Pareto有效结果的求解概念与算法。
AI.method: 采用经济学中的Kantian均衡概念（每个智能体选择它希望所有智能体都采用的动作），在对称博弈中即最优共同策略。据此设计Kant-Q：每个智能体只学习所有智能体同动作的动作剖面，使每次更新成为单智能体MDP的采样，从而继承标准Q-learning的收敛保证。
AI.result: 理论：证明任意对称Markov博弈均存在纯Kantian均衡；证明所有智能体的Q表收敛到同一极限，其贪婪策略即为该均衡；当每个状态的最优共同动作唯一时，贪婪策略可收敛。在对称单调博弈子类中，Kantian均衡在纯策略剖面中Pareto有效且严格个体理性。实验：在迭代囚徒困境及最多200智能体的GovSim渔业环境中，Kant-Q学到Kantian均衡，基线方法表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 由于同一AI系统的多个副本在对称博弈中天然互相对弈，Kant-Q的结果表明"普遍化（universalization）"可作为合作型AI-AI交互的设计原则，在保证收敛性的同时实现Pareto有效、个体理性的合作结果。

title: How Much Effort Does an AI Code Reviewer Need? Evidence from Claude 5.5 Models on Plausible-but-Wrong Patches
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Preregistered at https://osf.io/r8q2m. Data and code: https://github.com/trustmybot/research-artifacts
summary: AI coding agents write code faster than people can review it, so teams add AI reviewers. Reasoning models let such a reviewer trade cost for diligence through an effort setting. We asked how much effort a reviewer needs to catch plausible-but-wrong patches, which pass a benchmark's tests but fail stronger ones. Claude Opus 5.5 (preregistered), Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 (exploratory) each reviewed the same 90 agent-written Django patches from SWE-bench Verified at low, medium and high effort. By strengthened SWE-ABS tests, 55 patches were wrong and 35 correct. In every model, high effort accepted fewer wrong patches than low (false success .45 against .67 for Opus, .49 against .65 for Sonnet, .51 against .78 for Haiku), a supported difference for Opus and Haiku. For Opus, medium was non-inferior to high within 15 percentage points (difference .018, 95% CI [-.065, .108]) and cost 20% less, short of the preregistered 30%. For Sonnet and Haiku, medium cost 39% and 51% less than high but was not shown non-inferior. Opus at medium or high agreed best with the labels; Haiku at high cost about 8% as much per review as Opus at medium, accuracy difference unresolved. Exploratory coding showed that most rejections named the tested defect and that effort added such rejections. No setting is a strong gate: each accepted at least 45% of wrong patches. For 32 of the 55 wrong patches the issue may not require what the failing test checks; without them, neither accuracy hypothesis holds for any model.

AI.tldr: 研究AI代码审查者在不同"努力程度"设置下能否识别"看似正确实则错误"的补丁。90个SWE-bench Verified的Django补丁经强化测试判定55个错误、35个正确。三个Claude模型均显示高努力比低努力拒绝更多错误补丁，但无任何设置能成为强门（均至少接受了45%的错误补丁）。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理写代码的速度超过人工审查速度，团队因此引入AI审查者。推理模型可通过努力程度设置权衡成本与严谨性，但尚不清楚审查者需要多大努力才能发现"通过基准测试但实际错误"的补丁。
AI.method: 让Claude Opus 5.5（预注册）、Sonnet 5.5与Haiku 5.5（探索性）分别在低、中、高努力下审查相同的90个SWE-bench Verified Django补丁，并以强化的SWE-ABS测试作为真实标签（55错、35对），比较假成功率、成本与准确性，并进行探索性编码分析。
AI.result: 各模型中高努力比低努力接受更少错误补丁（Opus .45 vs .67、Sonnet .49 vs .65、Haiku .51 vs .78），Opus与Haiku差异显著。Opus中努力与高努力在15个百分点内非劣（差.018，95% CI [-.065,.108]）且成本低20%（低于预注册的30%目标）；Sonnet与Haiku中努力成本低39%与51%，但未证实非劣。Haiku高努力每次审查成本约为Opus中努力的8%，准确性差异未定。无设置能强门控：均接受至少45%错误补丁。若剔除32个"问题可能不涉及失败测试所检查内容"的错误补丁，则任何模型的准确性假设均不成立。
AI.conclusion: 提高努力可减少错误补丁被接受的比例，但没有设置能可靠充当强门。Opus中努力在成本与准确性间表现较好，Haiku高努力极具成本优势但准确性不明。结果对"错误"标签的定义敏感，需谨慎解读。

title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
summary: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English. We evaluate 25 top-ranked open-weight decision models on 17 tasks in 14 languages, comparing each language with English on parallel items. Every model loses accuracy in every language, from about 2 points in high-resource languages to 8 in Tamil, while confidence falls only half as much: a threshold set for 95\% accuracy in English yields 90% in Tamil. The size of the loss is set by the language and the base model rather than by leaderboard rank. In 81 controlled fine-tuning runs, task skill learned in English transfers to other languages and a few thousand target-language items narrow large losses, but neither more data nor full-parameter tuning closes them. Finally, the same test items are answered more accurately in all 23 benchmark--language pairs we compare when an LLM rather than a person translated them, so LLM-translated test sets understate the gap.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了25个开源决策模型在14种语言、17项任务上的表现，发现所有模型在非英语语言上精度都下降（高资源语言约2分，泰米尔语约8分），但置信度下降幅度只有精度的一半，导致按英语设定的阈值在非英语上失效；损失大小由语言和基座模型决定而非排行榜排名，微调仅能部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 决策模型（返回类型化查询各选项概率的微调语言模型）被路由器和护栏直接用于阈值判断，它们虽基于多语言基座构建，但排名和评估几乎完全基于英语。作者希望揭示这种"英语中心"评估掩盖的多语言可靠性问题，尤其是精度与置信度的错配会使阈值在非英语上失效。
AI.method: 在17项任务、14种语言上评测25个排名靠前的开源决策模型，对平行条目逐语言与英语对比；并进行81次受控微调实验，考察英语任务技能向其他语言的迁移、目标语言数据量以及全参数微调的影响；另外对比人工翻译与LLM翻译的测试集在23个基准—语言对上的表现。
AI.result: 所有模型在每种语言上都掉精度，从高资源语言的约2分到泰米尔语的约8分；而置信度只下降约一半，英语下设定95%精度的阈值在泰米尔语下仅约90%。损失幅度由语言和基座模型决定而非榜单排名。81次微调显示英语学到的任务技能可迁移到其他语言，几千条目标语言样本可缩小较大损失，但更多数据或全参数微调都无法消除差距。在全部23个基准—语言对中，LLM翻译的题目准确率都高于人工翻译，说明LLM翻译测试集会低估差距。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型的英语排行榜排名不能代表其多语言可靠性，阈值在非英语场景下会系统性失效，且这一差距无法仅靠更多数据或全参数微调弥补；同时现有基于LLM翻译的多语言基准低估了真实差距，需要以人工翻译平行测试和双语校准来评估与部署决策模型。

title: Confidence scores for gated automation of large language models
summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated decision-making. However, LLMs may produce incorrect answers with high confidence, limiting their applicability in decisions that affect individuals and organizations. Reliable confidence scores are necessary to gate such decisions, and existing estimates are frequently unavailable or too coarse to support effective gating. This work uses supervised learning to train models to predict the correctness of LLM-generated answers, enabling automated confident responses and routing uncertain ones for human review. A linear confidence score head is fitted to the final-layer hidden state of the frozen LLM backbone, and text-only metamodels are trained as an alternative for closed models. All results come from a single 2B-parameter backbone, on graded answers that are about 98% SQuAD and the remainder TruthfulQA. Against multiple baselines, the confidence score head outperforms all baselines and metamodels, automating the largest fraction of the workload at high accuracy targets. Prompted confidence scores can appear well calibrated yet lack the resolution needed for thresholding. Although transferability to unseen datasets is modest, the confidence score head remains the most robust approach. The proposed confidence scoring framework enhances the safety of automating LLM-based agents and can be adapted to gate other properties, including safety or compliance.

AI.tldr: 通过监督学习训练置信度评分头，预测LLM答案正确性，实现自动响应与不确定样本转人工审查。
AI.motivation: LLM可能以高置信度给出错误答案，现有置信度估计要么不可用，要么过粗，无法有效用于决策门控。
AI.method: 在冻结的2B参数LLM主干最后一层隐藏状态上拟合线性置信度评分头；针对闭源模型，训练仅文本的元模型作为替代方案。数据约98%为SQuAD、其余为TruthfulQA。
AI.result: 置信度评分头优于所有基线和元模型，在高准确率目标下自动化比例最高。提示式置信度虽看似校准良好，但缺乏阈值化所需的分辨率；跨数据集迁移性一般，但评分头仍最稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该置信度评分框架提升LLM智能体自动化的安全性，并可推广用于安全性、合规性等其他属性的门控。

title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
summary: Persistent textual memory can improve LLM agents, but repeated updates can erode task performance. We ask whether memory-store statistics warn before held-out accuracy declines. We registered mean pairwise cosine similarity ($ρ$) and 13 additional geometry, retrieval, and graph statistics on 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across ALFWorld, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and two ARC-AGI settings. These methods store trajectories, rules, workflows, strategies, or linked records, using selective retrieval or whole-store prompting. No such statistic reliably predicted early signs of task accuracy decline, and $ρ$ had zero median lead. With the checkpoint after peak accuracy as a secondary decline point, measures of highly similar pairs and nearest-neighbor crowding changed earlier but did not consistently outperform stored-item count. We trained classifiers on this corpus and applied them unchanged to PropWorld runs of up to 5,000 crafting tasks. They falsely flagged 56.9% of checkpoints from size-limited stores with stable accuracy and detected only 18% of checkpoints after task success fell to zero. Thus, global semantic density did not provide a reliable warning, while local crowding did not transfer consistently across memory designs. In these long-horizon runs, size-limited stores remained stable, while the sole failure arose when unbounded whole-store prompting exceeded model input capacity, which token growth predicted directly.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统检验了"记忆库统计量能否在LLM智能体任务准确率下降前预警"这一问题，结论是全局语义密度（ρ等）无法可靠预警，局部拥挤指标也不能跨记忆设计迁移。
AI.motivation: 持久化文本记忆可提升LLM智能体表现，但反复更新记忆可能侵蚀任务性能。作者希望探索是否可用记忆库的统计特征在留出准确率真正下滑之前发出预警，从而为记忆管理提供早期信号。
AI.method: 在ALFWorld、AppWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop及两个ARC-AGI设置上，覆盖13种记忆方法共805个快照，登记平均成对余弦相似度ρ及13个几何、检索、图统计量，考察其对任务准确率下降的预测能力与领先时间；并将在该语料上训练的预警分类器原样迁移到最长5000任务的PropWorld运行中测试。
AI.result: 没有任何统计量能可靠预测准确率下降的早期迹象，ρ的中位领先时间为零；以峰值后检查点为次要点时，高相似对与最近邻拥挤指标变化更早，但不稳定优于"存储条目数"这一简单量。迁移测试中分类器对稳定准确率的限容量存储误报56.9%，对任务成功率归零后的检查点仅检出18%。
AI.conclusion: 全局语义密度无法提供可靠预警，局部拥挤指标难以跨记忆设计迁移。在长程运行中，限容量存储保持稳定；唯一失败案例是无界全库提示超出模型输入容量，而该问题可由token增长直接预测。

title: Large-scale Model Merging via Recovery-aware Task Weighting
summary: Model merging combines multiple task-specific expert models into a single model. However, merging preserves expert capabilities unevenly across tasks. This imbalance is particularly pronounced in large-scale settings, where some tasks can suffer severe capability losses even when average accuracy remains high. To address this imbalance, we introduce Recovery-aware Task Weighting (RaTW), a model merging framework that assigns larger weights to tasks whose expert capabilities are poorly retained by an initial merged model. We quantify these recovery opportunities as the fraction of a task's labeled validation samples that its expert predicts correctly but the initial merged model gets wrong, and use the resulting task weights to re-merge the experts. To evaluate merging at large scale, we construct CLIPMerge-100, a 100-task benchmark with task-specific experts on CLIP ViT-L/14 and ViT-B/32. Across eleven merging methods with 20, 50, and 100 tasks on two CLIP backbones, RaTW improves both mean accuracy and tail20 (the mean expert-normalized accuracy of the 20% worst-retained tasks) in all 33 ViT-L/14 settings and 32 of 33 ViT-B/32 settings. We further introduce ReForge++, which combines RaTW with iterative model refinement and outperforms all evaluated baselines, including a matched-budget control, in both mean accuracy and tail20 across all settings.

AI.tldr: RaTW 依据初始合并模型在各任务上的"可恢复样本"比例为任务加权并重新合并专家，配合 ReForge++ 迭代精炼，在大规模多任务场景下同时提升平均精度与最差任务表现。
AI.motivation: 模型合并把多个任务专家合成一个模型，但各任务能力保留不均衡，在大规模场景下即使平均精度高，个别任务也会严重退化（长尾问题）。
AI.method: 提出 Recovery-aware Task Weighting (RaTW)：用任务验证集中"专家预测正确但初始合并模型预测错误"的样本比例量化恢复机会，据此给保留差的任务更大权重再重新合并；并构建 100 任务的 CLIPMerge-100 基准（CLIP ViT-L/14 与 ViT-B/32）；进一步提出 ReForge++ 结合迭代模型精炼。
AI.result: 在 11 种合并方法、20/50/100 任务、两种骨干下测试：RaTW 在全部 33 个 ViT-L/14 设置和 33 个中的 32 个 ViT-B/32 设置上均提升平均精度与 tail20；ReForge++ 在所有设置上于两项指标均超过所有基线（含等预算对照组）。
AI.conclusion: 以任务保留不均衡为目标的加权重合并能有效缓解大规模合并中的任务退化，迭代精炼可进一步带来稳定增益。

title: CA-RAG: Constraint-Aligned Retrieval for Structurally Faithful Long-Form Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically optimises evidence selection for semantic relevance, whereas compliance-sensitive long-form generation also requires evidence supporting explicit structural obligations. Semantically relevant retrieval may therefore omit information needed for mandatory downstream clauses. We propose Constraint-Aligned RAG (CA-RAG), a retrieval-conditioning framework that augments section-specific queries with ontology-derived structural constraints and policy-grounded knowledge-graph relations before evidence selection. Retrieval-only evaluation with manually annotated evidence shows consistent improvements across retrieval budgets. At $k=6$, CA-RAG increases Precision@$k$ from $0.5268$ to $0.5692$, pooled Recall@$k$ from $0.5402$ to $0.5950$, and F1@$k$ from $0.5389$ to $0.5672$ over standard RAG. Generation experiments further show improvements in compliance and reliability in several model--domain settings, while generation-only constraints achieve higher clause coverage but lower overall compliance and reliability. These results indicate that structurally aligned retrieval can improve evidence sufficiency in compliance-sensitive long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 提出CA-RAG框架，将本体衍生的结构约束与政策知识图谱关系加入检索查询，提升合规敏感长文本生成的证据充分性。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG按语义相关性选证据，但合规敏感的长文本生成还需要支撑强制结构条款的证据，纯语义检索可能遗漏下游必备信息。
AI.method: 在证据选择前，用本体衍生的结构约束和政策知识图谱关系增强分节查询（Constraint-Aligned RAG）。
AI.result: k=6时，Precision@k由0.5268升至0.5692，pooled Recall@k由0.5402升至0.5950，F1@k由0.5389升至0.5672；生成实验中多模型-领域设置的合规性与可靠性提升；仅约束生成覆盖率更高但整体合规与可靠性更低。
AI.conclusion: 结构对齐的检索能提升合规敏感长文本生成中的证据充分性。

title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
comment: Accepted at DATE 2027 (Design, Automation and Test in Europe); initial author version
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can write and repair RTL, but successful compilation or testbench execution does not establish defect removal, behavioral preservation, security, or implementation feasibility. Existing LLM-based RTL repair methods often report a single repair rate without retaining separate evidence for these properties, limiting reproducible comparison and integration into hardware design flows. We present REFORGE, which, to our knowledge, is the first LLM-assisted RTL repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations, allowing it to generate fixes that satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously, including functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency. REFORGE profiles buggy RTL, identifies structural and security-relevant features, localizes failing behavior, and uses verification-guided diagnosis to generate complete RTL repair variants. Each variant undergoes syntax checking, simulation, formal analysis, off-trigger preservation, security re-scan, and synthesis-based power, performance, and area analysis. We implement REFORGE as a backend-independent repair-and-verification flow and evaluate it in 288 runs across three LLM backends and three benchmark suites. On CirFix, the proposed context and diagnosis increase runs delivering a checked repair from 32/63 to 51/63, while every configuration repairs the Hack@DAC OpenTitan defect. Evidence records also show that a testbench-only criterion reports 3.9 times more repairs than the full set of applicable checks, security-clean outputs may lack functional verification, and different RTL repairs can implement equivalent hardware. These results show that LLM-generated RTL repairs require explicit multi-stage verification evidence rather than a single pass/fail outcome.

AI.tldr: 提出REFORGE框架，这是首个跨迭代维护并累积结构化修复证据的LLM辅助RTL修复框架，通过多阶段验证（语法、仿真、形式分析、off-trigger保持、安全重扫描、综合PPA）产出具功能、行为等价、安全与成本效率的多目标修复，并在288次运行中证明单一修复率指标不足以反映缺陷真正被移除。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM RTL修复方法只报告单一修复率，而编译成功或测试平台通过并不能说明缺陷已被移除、行为被保持、安全性达标或实现可行；缺少分离证据导致难以复现比较，也难以集成到硬件设计流程中。
AI.method: REFORGE先分析含缺陷RTL，识别结构与安全相关特征、定位失效行为，并用验证引导的诊断生成完整修复变体；每个变体依次经过语法检查、仿真、形式分析、off-trigger保持检查、安全重扫描以及基于综合的功耗/性能/面积分析，并跨迭代累积结构化证据。实现为与后端无关的修复-验证流程。
AI.result: 在三个LLM后端、三个基准套件上共288次运行：CirFix上，改进的上下文与诊断使产出可核验修复的运行从32/63提升至51/63；所有配置均修复Hack@DAC OpenTitan缺陷。证据显示仅用测试平台判据报告的修复数是用全部适用检查的3.9倍；安全洁净的输出可能缺失功能验证；不同修复可实现等价硬件。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的RTL修复需要显式的多阶段验证证据，而非单一通过/失败结果；结构化证据累积支持可复现比较并便于集成到硬件设计流程。

title: Who Attributes a Mind to Whom? Mutual Theory of Mind in Simulated User-Assistant Conversation
summary: When users assume that an AI chatbot has mental states, they are more likely to develop over-reliance, emotional dependence, and in extreme cases, psychological harm or self-harm. However, how these mind attributions arise in conversations and how human or AI factors influence this is still unknown. We study how users attribute minds using a minimal framework: a simulated user with different characteristics chats with assistants that differ in social style and memory. We also introduce a message-level measure of who attributes a mind to whom in four directions, checked with trained coders and applied by a fine-tuned encoder that reproduces an LLM judge. Our results show that, on average, nine out of thirteen characteristics raised simulated users' attribution to the assistant. We found that relational needs such as attachment anxiety raised it as theory predicts, some general personality traits raised it as well, and AI-specific characteristics the least. By contrast, the assistant's social style barely changed simulated users' mind attribution. Instead, sycophantic instructions raised the assistant's attribution to itself. Memory raised users' attribution only with some user models. The model playing the user changed overall attribution and the effects of characteristics, style, and memory. Our framework measures how persona descriptions affect mind attribution in simulation. It gives concrete hypotheses for human studies and shows the need for more consistent user simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文用模拟用户与不同社交风格、记忆能力的AI助手对话，提出消息级“心智归因方向”测量方法，发现多数用户特征会提升对助手的心智归因，而社交风格影响甚微。
AI.motivation: 用户若认为聊天机器人具有心智，易产生过度依赖、情感依赖乃至心理伤害，但心智归因如何在对话中产生、受哪些人类或AI因素影响仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构建最小化模拟框架：具不同特征的人设模拟用户与不同社交风格、记忆设置的助手对话；提出四方向的消息级心智归因测度，经训练编码员校验，并用微调编码器复现LLM评判。
AI.result: 13个特征中平均9个提升了模拟用户对助手的归因；依恋焦虑等关系需求和部分人格特质提升明显，AI特有特征影响最小；助手社交风格几乎无影响，谄媚指令反而提升助手对自身的归因；记忆仅在部分用户模型下有效；扮演用户的模型会改变整体归因及各因素效应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可测量人设描述对模拟中心智归因的影响，为人类研究提供具体假设，并说明需要更一致的用户模拟器。

title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
summary: AI models vary enormously in capability and price. Model routing exploits this by sending easier tasks to cheaper models. However, a single agentic task often combines easy and difficult subtasks, making one model choice for the entire task inefficient. We introduce partial routing, which guides a frontier lead model to delegate suitable subtasks to a cheaper worker model. From both models' past runs, we identify recurring subtasks and measure each model's quality and cost on them. These measurements produce delegation guidance, with a parameter, $δ$, controlling how much is delegated. The lead decides when and what to delegate during execution, without training either model. On held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0, partial routing achieves higher mean task performance than the lead alone and task-level routing.
