With $δ= 0.75$, it raises the lead's ViBench score from 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and its Terminal-Bench pass rate from 54% to 61% at similar cost. Giving the lead only the subtask breakdown, without a worker, also reduces cost on both benchmarks and raises the Terminal-Bench pass rate. These results show that analysis of past runs can support more efficient planning and more effective delegation, with little cost and implementation overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出"部分路由"方法，引导前沿主模型将合适的子任务委派给更便宜的从模型，在ViBench和Terminal-Bench上同时提升性能并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 模型能力与价格差异巨大，整体任务路由虽能把简单任务交给便宜模型，但单个智能体任务常混合简单与困难子任务，为整任务选一个模型效率低下。
AI.method: 从主、从两个模型的过往运行中识别重复出现的子任务，测量各模型在这些子任务上的质量与成本，生成委派指引，并用参数δ控制委派程度；主模型在执行过程中自主决定何时委派什么，无需训练任何模型。
AI.result: 在ViBench和Terminal-Bench 4.0的留出任务上，平均任务表现优于单独主模型与任务级路由。δ=0.75时，ViBench分数从70.2升至78.5且成本降19%；Terminal-Bench通过率从54%升至61%且成本相当。仅提供子任务分解而不给从模型，也能降本并在Terminal-Bench上提升通过率。
AI.conclusion: 对过往运行的分析可支持更高效的规划与更有效的委派，额外成本与实现开销很小。

title: KiRA: Kronecker Input-Gated Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
summary: Full fine-tuning of large pretrained models is expensive, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is the standard alternative. Most PEFT methods use low-rank updates, whose rank lies far below that of full fine-tuning and is the same for every input. Input-adaptive variants vary the capacity per input but remain within the low-rank bottleneck, and whether a task benefits from input conditioning is not known before training. This paper introduces Kronecker input-gated rank adaptation (KiRA). Instead of the conventional low-rank product, the update $ΔW$ is the Kronecker product of a frozen random $p\times p$ matrix $A$ and a trainable factor $M(x)$, which overcomes the rank ceiling: because rank is multiplicative under this product, $A$ multiplies the rank of $M(x)$ by $p$ without adding trainable parameters. The factor $M(x)$ is further decomposed as $B_1\,\mathrm{diag}(g(x))\,B_2$, where the input gate $g(x)$, computed once per sample by a network shared across all adapted layers, adjusts the rank of the update to each input in steps of $p$. Where input conditioning is unnecessary, the gate is folded into $B_1$ at deployment. Because the gate changes the rank only in discrete steps, the benefit of input conditioning can be predicted before training from a few hundred labeled inputs. Across six medical imaging and language benchmarks, KiRA attains the highest mean score against five published baselines with 8.7--9.7 times fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation, and the pre-training criterion agrees with the measured benefit of input conditioning on all six tasks.

AI.tldr: KiRA 用"冻结随机矩阵 A 与可训练因子 M(x) 的 Kronecker 积"作为权重更新，突破低秩瓶颈，并以每样本输入门控按 p 的整数倍调整更新秩；同一门控网络跨层共享，且可在训练前用数百条标注样本预测输入条件化是否有益。
AI.motivation: 全量微调大预训练模型代价高，PEFT 成为主流替代，但现有方法（含输入自适应变体）受限于低秩瓶颈：秩远低于全量微调，且各方法对每个输入使用相同秩。此外，"任务是否需要输入条件化"在训练前无法判断。
AI.method: 提出 Kronecker 输入门控秩适配（KiRA）：ΔW = A ⊗ M(x)，其中 A 为冻结的随机 p×p 矩阵，M(x) 为可训练因子；利用秩在 Kronecker 积下的可乘性，A 将 M(x) 的秩放大 p 倍而不增加可训练参数。M(x) 进一步分解为 B1·diag(g(x))·B2，输入门 g(x) 由跨所有适配层共享的网络逐样本计算一次，以 p 为步长调节秩；若无需输入条件化，部署时可将门控折叠进 B1。由于门控只以离散步长改变秩，可用数百条标注输入在训练前预测输入条件化的收益。
AI.result: 在六个医学影像与语言基准上，KiRA 对五种已发表基线取得最高平均分，可训练参数量比 LoRA 少 8.7–9.7 倍；且训练前的判据在全部六项任务上与实测的输入条件化收益一致。
AI.conclusion: KiRA 在保持高参数效率的同时消除了低秩天花板，实现了按输入自适应调整更新秩，并提供了训练前预判输入条件化是否有效的实用手段，结果一致地优于现有 PEFT 基线。

title: What Does RL Post-Training Teach Text-to-Image Models? A Skill-Wise Analysis of Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become a standard way to improve text-to-image flow models: Flow-GRPO lifts the GenEval score of SD3.5-M from 0.63 to 0.95, a gain read as the model having learned compositional generation. We ask how much of that gain the base model's own samples already contained, by measuring pass@k over shared noise seeds, one skill at a time, before and after RL, on prompts never used in training. The answer differs by skill. On four of GenEval's six skills, where 32 base samples already solve almost every prompt, the gain is sharpening: one post-trained sample is worth 4 to 10 base samples, and pass@32 barely moves. On spatial relations it is unlocking: pass@32 rises from 0.69 to 1.00, 128 base samples do not match one post-trained sample, and prompts the base model never solved in 32 samples are solved 93% of the time, as often as those it solved. The benchmark average, 31 base samples per post-trained sample, describes no skill. Relations carry 35% of the gain; of the other 65%, selecting among 8 base samples with the judge behind the reward recovers nine tenths. We propose an account of when each occurs: within a prompt, a group-relative update re-weights only the outcomes its samples contain, and a flow policy cannot widen the noise that produces them; across prompts, shared parameters let successes on some prompts repair a deficit common to many. The same anatomy applies to a text-rendering checkpoint. The account's predictions are tested with a checkpoint trained without KL, within-prompt diversity, and controlled training that holds object classes out, where sharpening comes first and transfers, and unlocking follows, on practised objects before unseen ones.

AI.tldr: 本文剖析Flow-GRPO对文生图模型的提升来源，发现"锐化"(sharpening)与"解锁"(unlocking)两种机制并存，且按技能不同而不同。
AI.motivation: Flow-GRPO把SD3.5-M的GenEval分数从0.63提到0.95，通常被解读为学到了组合生成能力。作者质疑：这一提升中有多少其实已存在于基座模型自身的采样中？
AI.method: 在共享噪声种子上、逐技能测量pass@k，比较RL前后及未见prompt；分析reward judge选样可恢复多少增益；提出理论解释并用无KL、组内多样性、留出物体类别等受控实验验证预测。
AI.result: 六项技能中四项是锐化（1个后训练样本抵4–10个基座样本，pass@32几乎不变）；空间关系是解锁（pass@32从0.69升至1.00，128个基座样本不及1个后训练样本，基座32样本从未解出的prompt有93%被解出）。关系贡献35%增益，其余65%中judge选样可恢复九成。
AI.conclusion: 给"RL学得了新能力"的说法降温：大部分增益是重加权已有结果，仅少数技能真正扩展了采样覆盖；机制可跨checkpoint推广，并受受控实验支持。

title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
summary: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Agentic Waterfall Feed"这一新的个性化信息发现任务——用户主动引导推荐、系统从显式请求与浏览行为中推断并适应不断演变的需求；并给出Agentic Waterfall框架（LLM控制器维护持久用户状态并协调检索、排序与状态更新）、配套数据集与回放式评测协议。在5个公开基准上推荐性能具竞争力，在自建数据集上两类评测均超过最强基线，最高相对提升16.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统多为被动、静态地建模用户偏好，难以支持用户主动引导推荐、以及需求随交互不断演变的情境。作者因此形式化一个新的个性化信息发现问题，要求系统同时利用显式请求和浏览行为推断动态需求。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Waterfall框架：由语言模型控制器维护持久化的用户状态，并统一协调内容检索、排序与状态更新，形成"瀑布式"级联流程。同时构建Agentic Waterfall Dataset（真实内容元数据+模拟交互历史）以及基于回放的评测协议：在共享交互历史下对比不同系统，指标包括相关性分数与对推荐是否满足当前目标与约束的盲评判断。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准的传统推荐任务上，该方法与强基线相比保持竞争力；在Agentic Waterfall Dataset上，两类评测均优于最强基线，相对提升最高达16.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将"用户主动引导+行为推断"的个性化信息发现作为独立任务建模，并配合LLM控制器与回放评测，是可行且有效的方向；不过数据集中的交互历史为模拟生成，真实场景泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
comment: 2 figures, 6 tables. Code, audit ledgers, and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/rrrrr4788/skillsbench-lift-reanalysis
summary: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.

AI.tldr: 本文对SkillsBench进行了源码级审计与重新分析，指出其中"技能有害"及"技能门控有效"的结论主要源于评分器依赖、定义缺口、执行框架注入技能、运行噪声与泄漏等混杂因素，而非技能本身的效果。
AI.motivation: SkillsBench显示人工整理技能平均提升通过率约16.6pp，但部分任务反而下降，后续研究据此对技能进行门控或剔除。作者怀疑这些反面证据存在基准本身的缺陷，需从源头核查。
AI.method: 对SkillsBench进行源码级审计；分析7,554次公开试验，构建1,421个配对的(配置,任务)单元；采用多重检验校正的汇合重分析；打乱条件标签以检验门控策略；并在未参与拟合与决策的留出运行上验证。
AI.result: 发现2例经对照验证的评分器依赖和1处操作定义缺口，这三项任务平均提升74.6pp（全集中均提升18.7pp）；4个任务含占位技能目录；某执行框架在多数运行中额外注入48个内置技能；经多重检验校正后无任务级下降达到统计显著；每单元至多3次运行，58%的单元算术上不可能出现下降；门控策略在日志中提升2-3pp，但打乱标签后仍有4-7pp提升（说明存在泄漏），留出运行上无统计显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 现有负面单元格数量不能证明技能造成伤害；基于无技能得分的门控策略提升不可靠。作者公开了审计台账与分析脚本，呼吁更严谨的基准设计与评估。

title: When the Knowledge Runs Out: A Part-Level Pilot Evaluation of How Language Models Handle Partially Covered Questions
summary: Assistants that answer from supplied reference material often receive material that covers some parts of a user's question and not others. Existing evaluations of insufficient context mostly score one answer per question, and often treat partially sufficient context as simply insufficient. We describe a small, open evaluation that scores each part of a three-part question separately, with a verdict for parts that are answered correctly from the material but carry an added unsupported claim. On 30 cases (five scenarios, six coverage patterns, five samples each) we test claude-haiku-4-5 and llama3.1:8b. Without an explicit instruction to stay within the material, both models fill most gaps from their own knowledge (unsupported-claim rates of 0.71 and 0.90). One added sentence instructing them to answer only from the material brings these rates to 0.00 and 0.06, consistent with prior work. What remains is less visible: answers that strengthen the material, for example turning "many job sites prohibit bots" into a flat "no". We also report on the judge. Three rounds of blind hand labelling show that this added-claim verdict is the hardest to apply, for the judge and the author alike; RAGAS faithfulness is unsuitable for this task because it penalises correct withholding; and a difference between the two models that is clear under one judge disappears when the judge model is replaced. The dataset, code, hand labels and per-run figures are public.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个小型开放评测，对三段式问题的每一部分单独评分，并新增"部分正确但含无依据附加断言"的判定；在30个案例上测试两个模型，发现无显式"仅依据材料"指令时模型大量用自有知识填补缺口，加一句指令后无依据附加率骤降，但"强化材料"类的细微越界依然存在；同时揭示判定器本身是该任务最难环节。
AI.motivation: 现有对"上下文不足"的评测通常每题只给一个答案打分，并把"部分充分"的上下文一律当作"不充分"处理，无法刻画模型在材料只覆盖问题一部分时的行为，尤其是"答对但额外加入无依据论断"这类中间情形。
AI.method: 设计小型开放评测：三段式问题逐部分独立打分，并增加"正确但含无支持附加断言"的判定类别；构造30个案例（5个场景×6种覆盖模式×5个样本），测试claude-haiku-4-5与llama3.1:8b；比较有无"仅依据材料作答"显式指令的效果；进行三轮盲式人工标注以评估判定器；并检验RAGAS faithfulness及替换判定模型的影响。
AI.result: 无指令时两模型无支持附加断言率高达0.71与0.90；加入一句约束指令后降至0.00与0.06，与既有工作一致。仍存在更隐蔽的问题：答案会"强化"材料（如把"许多招聘网站禁止机器人"变成绝对化的"不"）。判定器方面：三轮盲标注显示附加断言判定对判定器和作者都最难；RAGAS faithfulness不适用，因其惩罚正确的"拒答/保留"；某判定器下两模型差异明显，换判定模型后差异消失。
AI.conclusion: 简单指令可基本消除显式的知识越界，但无法消除对材料的过度强化等细微失真；"部分充分"需被作为独立类别评估，且自动判定指标（如RAGAS faithfulness）与单一判定模型结论均不可靠，需人工标注与多判定器交叉验证。数据集、代码、人工标签与逐次运行结果均已公开。

title: Collaborative Language Models for Semantic IoT Data Processing: Validation through Zero-Shot Human Activity Recognition
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) systems generate low-level sensor observations that are not directly suitable for process analysis and must first be transformed into semantically meaningful events. This paper investigates collaborative language models as a zero-shot semantic abstraction layer for converting such observations into higher-level event and activity labels. We propose a five-stage workflow comprising semantic mapping, semantic aggregation, temporal and contextual aggregation, specialized reasoning, and final event abstraction. The resulting labels and contextual information can subsequently be represented as event records for downstream Process Mining (PM) tasks. The approach is evaluated through Human Activity Recognition on the CASAS Aruba smart home dataset using eleven workflow configurations. The experiments show that collaboration alone does not guarantee improved performance: general-purpose auxiliary SLMs can degrade recognition, whereas assigning complementary specialist roles leads to better results and allows a smaller final classifier to retain much of the performance of a larger model. The selected workflow achieves a macro F1 of 0.643 in the 1.5-day comparison and 0.567 (weighted F1 0.680) in a one-week evaluation. Although trained ML approaches remain more accurate on this dataset, the results demonstrate a different design point: modular semantic event abstraction using off-the-shelf models without task-specific parameter fine-tuning. The findings indicate that the structure of LM collaboration and task decomposition is more important than simply increasing the number of participating models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用协作式语言模型作为零样本语义抽象层，把IoT底层传感器观测转换为高层事件与活动标签，并以五阶段工作流衔接下游过程挖掘任务；在CASAS Aruba数据集上验证显示，专家角色分工比单纯增加模型数量更关键。
AI.motivation: IoT系统产生的底层传感器观测不适合直接做过程分析，必须先转化为有语义的事件；同时缺少任务特定微调数据，因此需要一种无需训练即可完成语义抽象的方案。
AI.method: 构建五阶段工作流：语义映射、语义聚合、时序与上下文聚合、专门化推理、最终事件抽象，输出可表示为事件记录供过程挖掘使用。以协作式语言模型（含通用辅助SLM与专用角色SLM）零样本执行，在CASAS Aruba智能家居数据上通过人类活动识别任务测试11种工作流配置。
AI.result: 仅靠协作不必然提升性能：通用辅助SLM可能反而降低识别效果，而赋予互补的专家角色能带来更优结果，并使较小的最终分类器保留大模型的大部分性能。选定工作流在1.5天对比中macro F1为0.643，一周评估中macro F1为0.567（weighted F1 0.680）。
AI.conclusion: 尽管在该数据集上训练型ML方法仍更准确，本文展示了另一种设计点：使用现成模型、无需任务特定参数微调的模块化语义事件抽象。结果表明，LM协作的结构与任务分解方式比单纯增加参与模型数量更重要。

title: Resource-Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Early Rice Blast Forecasting in Sustainable Agriculture
summary: Resource-efficient artificial intelligence has become increasingly important for sustainable agriculture, where timely disease forecasting must be achieved under computational and energy constraints. Early estimation of rice blast can enhance food security by optimizing crop management practices while reducing excessive pesticide use. However, existing frameworks often suffer from high computational overhead and limited capability to model the complex spectral-temporal dependencies present in heterogeneous meteorological and remote sensing data. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a lightweight multimodal fusion framework comprising an attentive positional encoding-based Transformer and a convolutional neural network (CNN)-embedded gated recurrent unit (GRU) for efficient spectral-temporal representation learning. The attention-enhanced positional encoding assigns adaptive importance to sequential meteorological tokens, enabling effective modelling of temporal characteristics. In parallel, the lightweight CNN extracts discriminative spectral features, while the GRU captures temporal dynamics from remote sensing imagery acquired over two time-instances. A multimodal fusion layer integrates these heterogeneous representations to forecast rice blast risk 5-10 days before symptom manifestation across diverse agro-climatic zones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving a validation accuracy of 96.93% and an F1-score of 95.79%. In addition to its predictive performance, the lightweight multimodal architecture substantially reduces computational complexity, inference latency, and carbon emissions, making it an energy-efficient solution for large-scale disease forecasting. The proposed framework provides a practical foundation for resource-efficient artificial intelligence in sustainable agriculture.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级多模态融合框架（注意力位置编码Transformer + CNN-GRU），在症状出现前5-10天预测稻瘟病风险，准确率96.93%，并显著降低算力与碳排放。
AI.motivation: 可持续农业需要资源高效、低能耗的及时病害预报；稻瘟病早期估计有助于保障粮食安全、优化用药。但现有框架计算开销高，且难以建模异构气象与遥感数据中的复杂光谱-时序依赖。
AI.method: 构建轻量多模态融合框架：①基于注意力增强位置编码的Transformer处理序列气象token，自适应分配重要性以建模时序特征；②轻量CNN提取遥感影像判别性光谱特征，GRU捕捉两个时间实例的时序动态；③多模态融合层整合异构表征，预测多个农业气候区稻瘟病风险。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该框架优于SOTA方法，验证准确率96.93%、F1分数95.79%；同时显著降低计算复杂度、推理延迟和碳排放，可在症状显现前5-10天完成风险预警。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量多模态架构兼具高预测性能与低能耗特性，为可持续农业中的资源高效人工智能提供了实用基础。

title: StyleID++: Position-Decoupled and Structure-Coherent Style Retrieval across Diffusion Architectures
summary: Attention injection offers a remarkably simple route to training-free style transfer: content queries retrieve style keys and values inside a pretrained diffusion model. We show that this operation also creates an overlooked failure mode. Position signals that are useful within one image become a spurious shared coordinate system across two spatially unrelated images, causing content tokens to favor style tokens at similar coordinates. This cross-image positional leakage appears in both convolutional U-Nets and diffusion transformers (DiTs), despite their different position mechanisms. Removing the positional shortcut exposes a second problem: unconstrained global retrieval lets related content tokens select incompatible style regions, producing fragmented appearance. We present StyleID++, a training-free framework that addresses the two problems jointly. Position-Decoupled Retrieval reduces coordinate-dependent matching through circular padding in U-Nets and injection-only RoPE removal in DiTs, while preserving native position modeling elsewhere. Affinity-Coherent Refinement then regularizes style assignments with the content self-attention graph, encouraging structurally related tokens to retrieve compatible style evidence. We quantify the leakage with a coordinate--centroid correlation and a permutation test on the style reference. The permutation error can be driven to zero in both backbones, which identifies the position mechanism as the carrier of the leakage, and StyleID++ obtains the best ArtFID of all methods we compare.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示注意力注入式免训练风格迁移存在跨图像位置泄漏问题，并提出StyleID++联合解决位置泄漏与风格检索碎片化两大问题。
AI.motivation: 注意力注入（内容query检索风格key/value）是简单有效的免训练风格迁移方法，但作者发现其被忽视的失效模式：单图内有用的位置信号在两张空间无关图像间变成虚假共享坐标系，使内容token倾向匹配同坐标的风格token；去除位置捷径后又暴露出全局检索导致相关内容token选中不兼容风格区域、外观碎片化的第二问题。
AI.method: 提出StyleID++免训练框架，联合解决两问题：(1) 位置解耦检索（Position-Decoupled Retrieval）：U-Net中用循环填充削弱坐标依赖匹配，DiT中仅在注入处移除RoPE而保留其他位置的原始建模；(2) 亲和一致性精炼（Affinity-Coherent Refinement）：用内容自注意力图正则化风格分配，使结构相关token检索兼容风格证据。并用坐标-质心相关性与风格参考上的置换检验量化泄漏。
AI.result: 两种骨干（U-Net与DiT）上置换误差均可降至零，证伪性实验确认位置机制即泄漏载体；StyleID++在对比方法中取得最优ArtFID。
AI.conclusion: 跨图像位置泄漏是注意力注入风格迁移的普遍失效根源，通过位置解耦检索加上亲和一致性精炼可同时解决泄漏与碎片化，且无需训练即在U-Net和DiT上通用有效。

title: Procedure Inference as Memory: Learning Recruiter Decision Procedures from OKF-Structured Episodes in Multi-Session Hiring Assistants
comment: Includes supplementary appendices with experimental configurations, prompts, evaluation protocols, and learned procedure examples
summary:
Multi-session hiring assistants must infer evolving recruiter preferences and decision patterns across projects and time. We introduce Open Knowledge Format (OKF)-indexed episodic memory to organize interactions and retrieve related events through their lineage. We also introduce Procedure Memory, which learns reusable decision procedures from these episodes through prompted reflection or reinforcement learning. We compare these approaches with no memory, full-history context, and conversation search, and evaluate Jev-class models for index navigation and GPT-5.6 Luna as a lower-cost alternative to GPT-5.4.
  In our evaluation, OKF-indexed retrieval achieves low-priority preference F1 scores of 0.93-0.95 at medium and high preference overlap between hiring projects. It significantly outperforms full-history context and conversation search in both settings, and no memory at high overlap, while using 69% fewer context tokens than full history. Procedure Memory reduces conversational turns by up to 39% relative to no memory. Qualitative and long-horizon evaluations provide evidence of temporal reasoning, with RL-learned procedures achieving 60% on both correct abstention and exact-field identification. Jev-class models improve conversational efficiency but more frequently miss temporally relevant evidence, highlighting the importance of evidence selection.
  On PersonaMem-v2, Procedure Memory with OKF retrieval achieves 50.2% accuracy versus 48.6% for full-history context and 29.0% for no memory, using 90.5% fewer reader input tokens than full history. GPT-5.6 Luna performs comparably to GPT-5.4 at lower cost. These findings highlight the value of structured episodic memory and learned decision procedures for efficient personalization and temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出OKF索引的情节记忆与Procedure Memory，用于多会话招聘助手，显著优于全历史和会话检索，节省大量上下文token。
AI.motivation: 多会话招聘助手需要跨项目、跨时间推断不断演变的招聘者偏好与决策模式；现有方式（无记忆、全历史上下文、会话搜索）难以兼顾效率与时间推理能力。
AI.method: 1) Open Knowledge Format (OKF) 索引的情节记忆，按血缘(linage)组织交互并检索相关事件；2) Procedure Memory，通过提示反思或强化学习从情节中学习可复用决策流程；对比无记忆、全历史、会话搜索；用Jev类模型做索引导航，GPT-5.6 Luna作为GPT-5.4的低成本替代。
AI.result: OKF检索在低优先级偏好上F1达0.93-0.95（中/高偏好重叠），显著优于全历史与会话搜索，并在高重叠下优于无记忆，token用量比全历史少69%；Procedure Memory减少对话轮次最多39%；RL学得流程在正确弃答与精确字段识别上均达60%；Jev类模型提升效率但更易漏掉时间相关证据。PersonaMem-v2上50.2%准确率（全历史48.6%，无记忆29.0%），reader输入token减少90.5%；GPT-5.6 Luna性能接近GPT-5.4且成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 结构化情节记忆与学习型决策流程能有效支撑高效个性化与时间推理；证据选择（而非仅索引导航效率）是性能关键。

title: Open-Source FUTO Keyboard Layouts and Predictive Text for a Few Endangered Languages
summary: We present open-source FUTO Keyboard layouts and predictive text dictionaries for five endangered Uralic languages: Erzya, Moksha, Komi-Zyrian, Livonian, and Skolt Sami. Existing Divvun Android keyboard layouts are converted automatically into the YAML format used by FUTO Keyboard. For predictive text, we construct weighted AOSP dictionaries using translated Finnish lemma frequencies together with morphological frequencies extracted from small target-language corpora using finite-state transducers. This combination provides a practical way to rank inflected word forms when large monolingual corpora are unavailable. The resulting resources offer reusable mobile keyboard support for endangered Uralic languages.

AI.tldr: 为五种濒危乌拉尔语系语言构建开源FUTO键盘布局与预测词典，采用自动格式转换与跨语言词频迁移加形态分析的组合方法。
AI.motivation: 濒危乌拉尔语系语言缺乏移动端输入支持；现有Divvun安卓键盘布局格式不兼容FUTO，且目标语言缺少大规模单语语料，难以对屈折词形进行合理排序。
AI.method: 将Divvun安卓键盘布局自动转换为FUTO所用YAML格式；用有限状态转换器从小规模语料中抽取形态频率，结合翻译后的芬兰语词元频率构造加权AOSP预测词典（覆盖埃尔兹亚语、莫克沙语、科米-兹梁语、利沃尼亚语、斯科尔特萨米语）。
AI.result: 产出五门语言可用的开源键盘布局与加权预测词典，可在无大规模单语语料的条件下给出屈折词形排序，并作为可复用资源发布。
AI.conclusion: 格式自动转换与跨语言词频+形态频率迁移是低资源濒危语言移动输入支持的实用方案；资源开源可复用，可用于后续扩充与传播。

title: Dynamic Reasoning in Next-Gen Detection and Response: An Empirical Study of LLM Triage, Reinforcement Tuning, and Adversarial Evasion
comment: 13 pages (main text), 44 pages total with appendices, 5 figures, 56 experiments. Companion architectural design and threat model: https://jeremycanale.com/google-nextgen-detection/
summary: We present an end-to-end empirical study of dynamic reasoning in next-generation detection and response pipelines, evaluating how static classifiers, graph-based signal fusion, and large language model (LLM) triage agents perform under strict human-analyst attention budgets (Recall at B alerts/day). Across 56 reproducible experiments spanning a multi-layer enterprise-and-cloud simulator and four public datasets (SOREL-20M, BODMAS, LANL, and DARPA Transparent Computing), we test twelve architectural claims governing modern fleet-scale defense. First, we show that fleet growth halves recall at a fixed analyst budget even at negligible compute cost (<$0.0003 per million events), and that rarity-weighted graph risk propagation outperforms GraphSAGE without neural training. Second, evaluating frontier reasoning models (Gemini) and fine-tuned open-weight models (Qwen3-4B) for alert triage reveals that unconstrained LLM auto-closure eliminates 90% of false positives while silently discarding 31-44% of true attack cases. Third, post-training with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) causes severe reward hacking on unseen attack classes, suppressing up to 86% of novel attacks compared to two-epoch supervised fine-tuning. Finally, against an adaptive adversary generating plausible cover stories in benign telemetry fields, LLM triage evasion rises sharply unless gated by a deterministic policy harness prior to model invocation.

AI.tldr: 论文对下一代检测与响应流程中的动态推理做了端到端实证研究，在56个可复现实验中比较静态分类器、图信号融合与LLM分诊代理在严格分析师注意力预算（Recall@B alerts/day）下的表现，并检验12项架构主张。
AI.motivation: 现代舰队规模防御中，检测系统的评估常忽略人类分析师注意力预算这一真实约束；同时LLM代理、图学习、强化学习后训练等新范式缺乏在统一预算口径下的可靠比较与鲁棒性验证。
AI.method: 构建企业+云多层模拟器并结合四个公开数据集（SOREL-20M、BODMAS、LANL、DARPA TC），运行56个可复现实验测试12项主张。对比静态分类器、稀有度加权图风险传播 vs GraphSAGE、Gemini与微调Qwen3-4B分诊、GRPO vs 两轮SFT，并引入自适应对手（在良性遥测字段中生成可信掩护故事）测试LLM分诊规避。
AI.result: 舰队规模增长在计算成本极低（<$0.0003/百万事件）下仍使固定预算召回减半；稀有度加权图风险传播在无神经训练下优于GraphSAGE。无约束LLM自动关闭消除90%误报但静默丢弃31–44%真实攻击；GRPO出现严重奖励黑客，对未见攻击类抑制高达86%；面对自适应对手，LLM分诊规避显著上升，除非在调用模型前加确定性策略门控。
AI.conclusion: 预算约束下的召回衰减是结构性问题，图方法可在免训练下取得竞争力；LLM分诊的错误是"静默"的、高风险的，RL后训练泛化性差。结论建议在模型调用前部署确定性策略harness作为门控，并强调以Recall@B而非AUC类指标评估SOC流程。

title: Sequential Testing on Complex and High Dimensional Data Streams Leveraging Unsupervised Model Errors
summary: We propose two general, distribution-free test statistics for binary Sequential Hypothesis Testing (SHT) and Sequential Change Point Detection (SCPD) respectively, in streaming environments where the data (e.g., network traffic metadata) are too complicated for the exact probabilistic modeling required by conventional likelihood ratio-driven tests. Our framework also addresses the challenge of information asymmetry, where data is available only from the null/pre-change regime and not from the alternative/post-change one such as zero-day attacks or emerging disease related regimes. The proposed statistics monitor the errors of a predictive or reconstructive machine learning model trained solely on null/pre-change data, relying on imperfect generalization (the model's performance will degrade when deployed on data from the alternative/post-change class). Under mild assumptions on the model's errors, we establish rigorous analytical guarantees: strict non-asymptotic error control for SHT, and explicit bounds on the Average Run Length (ARL) and the Expected Detection Delay (EDD) for SCPD. Extensive evaluations in target tracking, chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world network security datasets, demonstrate that our framework consistently satisfies prescribed constraints where existing algorithms succumb to inflated missed detections and/or false alarms. Finally, because our methods operate on scalar errors without requiring online retraining or kernel evaluations, they are highly scalable.

AI.tldr: 提出两种通用、无分布假设的检验统计量，分别用于二值序贯假设检验(SHT)和序贯变点检测(SCPD)，在仅有零假设/变点前数据的信息不对称流式场景下，通过监测仅在正常数据上训练的预测/重构模型的误差来实现检测，并给出严格非渐近误差控制与ARL/EDD界。
AI.motivation: 流式数据（如网络流量元数据）过于复杂，难以做传统似然比检验所需的精确概率建模；且存在信息不对称——只有零假设/变点前的数据可用，缺乏零日攻击或新发疾病等替代/变点后数据的样本。
AI.method: 构建两个通用、无分布假设的检验统计量，利用仅在零假设/变点前数据上训练的预测或重构机器学习模型，监测其误差（依赖模型泛化不完美：在替代/变点后数据上性能会退化）。在模型误差的温和假设下，推导SHT的严格非渐近误差控制，以及SCPD的平均运行长度(ARL)与期望检测延迟(EDD)的显式界。方法仅依赖标量误差，无需在线重训练或核函数计算。
AI.result: 在目标跟踪、混沌动力系统以及真实网络安�全数据集上的广泛评估显示：该框架始终满足预设约束，而现有算法会出现虚高的漏检和/或误报。方法仅基于标量误差，无需在线重训练或核评估，因此高度可扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为无精确建模、信息不对称的流式序贯检测提供了理论上可靠（非渐近误差控制、ARL/EDD界）且高度可扩展的通用方案，实验证明优于现有算法。

title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. Across sparse-view CT, accelerated brain MRI, and photoacoustic tomography, selective anchoring improves lesion contrast preservation and uncertainty reliability, and can reduce reconstruction error within lesions. For tumor detection in accelerated MRI, with a healthy reference estimated from the measurements alone, deterministic anchoring raises mean AUROC across eight samplers from 78.4% to 84.6% and lesion sensitivity at 0.25 false-positive marks per slice from 38.8% to 47.5%, with gains in all four predefined tumor-size groups. At thresholds frozen on healthy validation data, mean sensitivity rises from 20.2% to 44.1% (37.6% with stochastic anchoring). These findings show how expressive generative priors can reconstruct unresolved anatomy without healing away the abnormalities that the measurements support.

AI.tldr: 提出"selective anchoring"(选择性锚定)：将测量可靠的分量从生成先验驱动的修改中保护起来，只让生成模型重建未解析结构，从而在保留病灶的同时完成重建。
AI.motivation: 生成式先验能从残缺医学测量中恢复解剖细节，但可能"抹掉"测量中本已含证据的病灶（即"healing away"异常），这对诊断极为不利。
AI.method: 对可靠测量的图像分量施加锚定，不随先验改变；其采集不确定性要么确定性加入下游检验，要么通过读数随机扰动由集成传递。实现为预训练扩散/流采样器的wrapper，以及快速约束流模型AnchoredFM。线性-高斯测量模型下给出理论分析。
AI.result: 保护系数在期望上无偏、区间覆盖率达标，且与学习先验无关。稀疏视角CT、加速脑MRI、光声断层中改善病灶对比度保持与不确定性可靠性、降低病灶内重建误差。加速MRI肿瘤检测：8个采样器平均AUROC 78.4%→84.6%，敏感性(0.25 FP/层)38.8%→47.5%，四类肿瘤尺寸均提升；健康数据冻结阈值下平均敏感性20.2%→44.1%(随机锚定37.6%)。
AI.conclusion: 表达能力强的生成先验可在重建未解析解剖的同时，不"治愈"掉测量所支持的异常；选择性锚定为病灶保留与不确定性校准提供了通用、可插拔的方案。

title: AI-human hybrid conversations: Can AI Agents Improve Discourse Quality?
comment: Ishita Chakraborty and Xingjian You contributed equally
summary: Conversations are central to how people exchange information, share experiences, and develop collective understanding. Yet, across conversational settings, discussions often suffer from uneven participation, unanswered contributions, and a narrow range of perspectives. As generative AI agents increasingly participate alongside humans, hybrid human-AI conversations present a new opportunity to address these challenges. We investigate whether AI agents can serve as catalysts for human interaction, improving conversational engagement and broadening collective discourse. We develop a framework for introducing generic and persona-conditioned AI agents into evolving discussions and evaluate it through two complementary studies. First, using agent-based simulations grounded in Reddit discussions across four domains, we find that AI-generated conversations are more positive and less toxic than human conversations, but substantially less semantically diverse. Persona conditioning produces more human-like contributions and narrows this diversity gap, while increasing the representation of underrepresented personas can shift which perspectives emerge without necessarily increasing overall diversity. Second, we conduct a pre-registered experiment with 221 participants across nine discussion threads, comparing human-only conversations with those involving generic or persona-conditioned AI agents. We find that AI participation increases responsiveness, reduces unanswered contributions, and broadens the range of ideas expressed by human participants, even though the AI agents themselves do not fully reproduce human conversational diversity. These findings suggest that the value of hybrid human-AI conversations lies not simply in the content AI agents generate, but also in their potential to stimulate more responsive and diverse interactions among humans.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨AI智能体能否作为"催化剂"改善人类对话的参与度与观点多样性，通过Reddit模拟与221人预注册实验发现：AI参与提高了回应性、减少了无人回应的发言、拓宽了人类表达的观点范围，即便AI自身生成内容多样性不如人类。
AI.motivation: 对话是信息交换与集体理解的核心，但常存在参与不均、贡献无人回应、视角狭窄等问题。随着生成式AI日益参与人类讨论，混合人-AI对话为缓解这些问题提供了新机遇，作者希望检验AI能否催化人类互动、提升对话参与度并拓宽集体话语。
AI.method: 提出将通用型与人格条件化（persona-conditioned）AI智能体引入演进中讨论的框架，并采用两项互补研究评估：(1) 基于Reddit四个领域讨论的智能体模拟；(2) 221名参与者、9个讨论线程的预注册实验，对比纯人类对话与含通用/人格条件化AI的对话。
AI.result: 模拟显示AI生成对话比人类对话更积极、毒性更低，但语义多样性显著较低；人格条件化使贡献更接近人类并缩小多样性差距；增加代表性不足人格的呈现可改变涌现观点但不必然提升整体多样性。实验显示AI参与提升了回应性、减少了无人回应的贡献，并拓宽了人类参与者表达的观点范围，尽管AI本身未完全复现人类的对话多样性。
AI.conclusion: 混合人-AI对话的价值不仅在于AI生成的内容本身，更在于其激发人类间更具回应性与多样性互动的潜力。AI智能体可作为人类对话的催化剂。

title: Typical Angina, Reversed: A Long-Standing Documentation Error in the UCI Heart Disease Data
comment: 12 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/tpattabhi/anginaflip . An earlier version is on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24358545
summary:
The UCI Heart Disease data are a widely used machine-learning benchmark. We show that their chest-pain variable is stored in reverse of its documentation. At all four sites, the code documented as "asymptomatic" (4) marks patients with typical angina, and the code documented as "typical angina" (1) marks patients with almost none of the classical angina features (at Cleveland, no chest pain).
  Two complementary checks establish this: (i) the chest-pain table and regression coefficients of the original 1986 Cleveland study are reproduced only under the corrected reading; (ii) in the Budapest, Switzerland and Long Beach files, 93-96% of patients coded 4 have all three classical angina features. A 1990 word-labeled Cleveland file already uses the documented labels, and Statlog (Heart), a Cleveland subset, stores the same codes. OpenML, PMLB and two highly voted Kaggle copies that name the categories use the same documented labels (about 400,000 downloads combined).
  We audited a seeded random sample of 150 records from a pre-specified Scholar query for SHAP studies of these data mentioning asymptomatic chest pain (124 readable). Of 32 papers that state a direction for a named category, 25 (78%; 95% CI 61-89%) state one inconsistent with the corrected category identities; 22 (69%; 51-82%; post hoc) are attributable to the documentation error, and nine of these explain it clinically. None of the 124 readable papers identifies the reversal.
  Conventional models are essentially unaffected, one reason the error went unnoticed. Interpretations that attach the documented names to model effects are reversed, and zero-shot language-model classifiers that read the labels are misled: with the documented labels, three open-weight models lose 0.12-0.33 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) given age, sex and chest-pain type. We give the corrected mapping, evidence and code.

AI.tldr: UCI心脏病数据集把胸痛变量按与文档相反的编码存储，导致大量文献与零样本LLM分类器把类别名称贴反；修正映射后传统模型性能基本不变，但解释和LLM分类受影响。
AI.motivation: UCI Heart Disease是广用的机器学习基准，但其胸痛变量编码可能与文档相反，若属实将污染基于该变量的模型解释与依赖标签文本的方法，因此需要系统核查编码正误并评估其影响范围。
AI.method: (i) 复现1986年Cleveland原始研究的胸痛表与回归系数，仅在修正读法下成立；(ii) 在Budapest、Switzerland、Long Beach文件中验证代码4患者的典型心绞痛特征比例；(iii) 核查1990年词标签文件、Statlog、OpenML、PMLB及Kaggle副本的编码；(iv) 对SHAP相关文献做预设定查询的种子随机抽样150篇（124篇可读）进行审计；(v) 用三个开放权重模型做零样本分类，比较文档标签与修正标签下的AUC。
AI.result: 四个站点均显示代码4实为典型心绞痛、代码1近乎无经典心绞痛特征（Cleveland中代码1无胸痛）；Budapest等三地93–96%的代码4患者具备全部三项典型特征。124篇可读文献中无一指出该反转；32篇明确方向的论文里25篇（78%，95%CI 61–89%）方向与修正后类别不符，22篇（69%）可归因于文档错误，其中9篇还据此作临床解释。传统模型性能基本不受影响；但用文档标签时，三个开放权重模型在给定年龄、性别和胸痛类型下的AUC下降0.12–0.33。
AI.conclusion: UCI心脏病数据的胸痛变量确实与文档相反存储，该错误长期未被察觉且已广泛传播于数据副本与文献解释中；作者给出修正映射、证据与代码，并警示凡将类别名称与模型效应绑定的解释需重新审视，依赖标签文本的零样本LLM分类器尤其受影响。

title: Temporal Weight Surgery: Repairing Video Grounding with LLM Editors
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material
summary: A surgeon first finds what is wrong, then fixes only that part. We use this idea for video grounding, where video-language models often find the right moment in a long video but write its time wrong. In Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), a general-purpose LLM reads the model's weights and activations, finds where the error arises and repairs it there, without gradients. Separate sessions find the same cause, and this diagnosis of where and why the model fails is our main contribution. Three GPT-6 Astra sessions trace a dropped digit in TimeLens-8B to one MLP layer, and the largest edit gains 7.9 mIoU on 1,215 unseen questions and 18.3 on videos of 30 minutes or more. Two Claude Opus 5.5 sessions trace minutes written as seconds in Qwen3-VL-8B to the separator and gain 2.9 and 1.3. Before any edit, its answers often have the right minute and the wrong separator, and fixing only the separator lifts their mIoU from 13.1 to 19.2. Every improving edit beats a random edit of its size, and the edited models run as fast as before.

AI.tldr: 提出Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS)：用通用LLM无梯度地读取模型权重与激活、定位视频定位中的时间错误来源并就地修复，主贡献是对"何处、为何失败"的逆向诊断。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型在长视频中常能找到正确片段，却把时间写错（如丢数字、把分写成秒）；作者希望像外科医生一样只修复出错的那一小部分，而非整体重训练。
AI.method: TWS让通用LLM（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5）检查模型权重与激活，定位错误产生的层/组件，并在无梯度情况下做局部权重编辑；多个独立session互相验证同一病因。
AI.result: TimeLens-8B中丢失的数字被定位到一个MLP层，最大编辑在1215个未见问题上提升7.9 mIoU、30分钟以上视频提升18.3；Qwen3-VL-8B把分写成秒被定位到分隔符，分别提升2.9和1.3；仅修分隔符即使mIoU从13.1升到19.2。所有有效编辑优于同规模随机编辑，编辑后模型速度不变。
AI.conclusion: 无梯度、LLM驱动的精确权重手术可高效纠正视频定位的时间错误，且不增加推理开销；"定位失败原因"本身具有独立价值。

title: Learning from Recurrence: Internalizing Depth-Induced Preferences in Looped Language Models
summary: A looped language model repeatedly applies the same block to its hidden state before predicting each token. The number of passes is its recurrent depth. Increasing this depth gives the model more computation per token with the same parameters. Can the shared block learn from the predictions it makes at greater depth? Following prior work, we retrofit pretrained OLMo-2-1B with a shared recurrent block and continue mid-training over varying recurrent depths. In the four-pass model, additional passes mainly redistribute probability among tokens that already rank highly after one pass. We use the continuations generated at greater depth to train only the shared block through a single pass, without reference answers or correctness filtering. We call this transfer preference write-back. Write-back further improves one-pass and multi-pass accuracy on most tasks. At their target depths, the updated models outperform a non-recurrent control matched for mid-training data and token budget on all six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with a mean relative gain in accuracy of up to 46.2% across tasks. At four-pass inference, one-pass training outperforms full-depth training on the same targets in the model with input injection. This advantage disappears in the matched model without injection. On GSM8K, using the updated block only on passes two through four recovers nearly the entire four-pass gain, showing that an update learned in one pass can improve later applications of the same block.

AI.tldr: 重复应用共享块的循环语言模型在增加循环深度时可获得更多计算；作者提出"偏好回写"(transfer preference write-back)——用更深层生成的续写来训练共享块的单次传递，从而提升一进程与多进程精度。
AI.motivation: 循环深度增加带来每token更多计算，但共享块能否从自身更深层的预测中学习尚不清楚；本文探究深度间能否实现自举式能力迁移。
AI.method: 将预训练OLMo-2-1B改造为带共享循环块的结构并继续中训练（不同循环深度）。观察到四进程模型的额外传递主要只是在高排名token间重新分配概率。据此提出transfer preference write-back：仅用更深层生成的续写、无参考答案与正确性筛选，训练共享块的单次传递；并与相同数据/算力预算的非循环对照模型比较。
AI.result: 回写提升了大多数任务的一进程与多进程精度；在六个数学推理基准上，目标深度下平均相对精度增益最高达46.2%，优于非循环对照。四进程推理时，有输入注入的模型中一进程训练优于全深度训练，而无注入对照中该优势消失。GSM8K上仅在第二至四进程使用更新后的块即可恢复几乎全部四进程收益。
AI.conclusion: 共享块可从深层预测中学习并迁移至浅层/后续应用，实现"一次学、多次用"；输入注入是决定该优势成立的关键因素。

title: Learning to Reason in Real-Time
summary: AI agents that operate in the real world must reason correctly and on-time, yet they currently do not account for how time should alter their reasoning. Modern agents learn to do tasks in environments that are entirely synchronous: where the world waits for the agent to act before changing. A real-time environment, by contrast, changes independent of the agent. Existing approaches try to bridge this gap by imposing a ratio of thinking to acting. However, for an agent to succeed in real-time it must learn to act quickly when delay is costly and to reason longer when the benefit outweighs the missed opportunities. To this end, we introduce real-time reasoning training (RRT) as the class of training techniques for real-time reasoning agents. We develop three standard RRT techniques: (1) using real-time data, (2) decoupling acting and observing, and (3) curriculum learning in time. Together, these simple techniques substantially outperform strong baselines. Across time pressures, we outperform the strongest non-RRT baseline by an average of 33% reward on in-distribution and 55% reward on out-of-distribution tasks in two real-time environments: Frogger and Snake. These results demonstrate that we can teach agents to balance reasoning and responsiveness under real-time constraints, and that RRT opens a broad, new set of capabilities for real-time agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出实时推理训练（RRT）这一类方法，让智能体学会在实时环境中权衡推理时间与行动速度，显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体在完全同步的环境中训练（世界等待智能体行动后才变化），而真实环境独立于智能体持续变化。现有方法只是强制"思考/行动"的固定比例，无法让智能体学会何时该快、何时该多想。
AI.method: 提出RRT三类标准技术：(1) 使用实时数据；(2) 解耦行动与观察；(3) 时间维度的课程学习。
AI.result: 在Frogger和Snake两个实时环境中，跨不同时间压力下，平均比最强非RRT基线在分布内任务高33%奖励、分布外任务高55%奖励。
AI.conclusion: 可教会智能体在实时约束下平衡推理与响应，RRT为实时智能体开辟了广泛的新能力方向。

title: FERRETS: A Scalable Symbolic Transform for Time Series Classification
comment: 42 pages including references and appendices, 19 figures
summary: Dictionary methods for time series build bags of symbolic words from subsequences, but the accurate ones scale poorly. Against other families of methods, their accuracy no longer pays for their cost. We present FERRETS, a label-free dictionary transform built on WEASEL~2. It keys windows of random length and dilation into exact eight-bit words, adds a level word of each window's mean and spread, and on multivariate data adds cross-channel words. We compare it with leading classifiers, deep networks and foundation models included, on the UCR, Multiverse and MONSTER archives. FERRETS is the fastest of the eleven methods timed on UCR under a ten-thread budget. Of the ten others, only MultiRocket-Hydra is significantly more accurate, taking 24.7 times as long. FERRETS is not significantly different from WEASEL~2, the most accurate earlier dictionary method, which takes 125 times as long, and is significantly ahead of the other dictionary methods. On the Multiverse core, it is not significantly different in accuracy from HIVE-COTE~2 and MultiRocket-Hydra, though behind both on UCR. It is also significantly more accurate than five frozen foundation models on UCR's published split. On the MONSTER problems both complete, MiniRocket takes 3.7 times as long to fit as the streaming FERRETS classifier, which is significantly more accurate.

AI.tldr: FERRETS 是一种无需标签的字典变换方法，将随机长度与膨胀的窗口映射为精确的八位词，并加入均值/离散度层级词和多变量跨通道词，在精度接近最强方法的同时速度大幅领先。
AI.motivation: 时间序列的字典方法虽然精度高，但扩展性差，其精度优势已无法弥补高昂的计算成本。
AI.method: 基于 WEASEL 2 构建无标签字典变换：将随机长度与膨胀的窗口键控为精确的八位词，为每个窗口增加表示均值与离散度的层级词，在多变量数据上增加跨通道词。
AI.result: 在 UCR、Multiverse 和 MONSTER 数据集上对比分类器、深度网络和基础模型：FERRETS 是 UCR 十线程预算下 11 种方法中最快的；仅 MultiRocket-Hydra 显著更准但耗时 24.7 倍；与 WEASEL 2 精度无显著差异（后者耗时 125 倍）；UCR 上显著优于五个冻结基础模型；MONSTER 上比 MiniRocket 更准且流式拟合快 3.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: FERRETS 以极低成本达到接近最先进方法的精度，显著优于其他字典方法，在精度-效率权衡上具有强竞争力。

title: LGCount: Layout-Guided Diffusion for Zero-Shot Object Counting
summary: Class-agnostic counting requires the user to specify what to count, usually with a class name or a few annotated boxes. We propose a richer text-based specification: a structured layout that names the target, the region that holds it, the distractors to ignore. A prompt upsampler writes this layout from the image and the requested category alone, and an image-editing diffusion model, adapted into a single-step counter, turns it into a density map. Because counting datasets pair each image with a single valid density map, a counter trained on it learns to ignore the layout. We therefore train on synthetic counterfactuals in which one image admits several valid density maps, so that the layout cannot be ignored. On FSC-147 we improve on the previous zero-shot state of the art and we set the best reported result on LOOKALIKES while being told the least about each image. A single photograph can be counted by category, by region, or by granularity without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化文本规范（目标/所在区域/干扰物）实现类无关计数，用prompt upsampler在单步扩散计数器上生成密度图，并通过合成反事实训练让模型无法忽略布局，在FSC-147和LOOKALIKES取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有类无关计数仅靠类名或少量标注框指定计数对象，规范过于稀疏，难以表达"数什么、数哪里、忽略什么"，导致歧义和干扰误计。
AI.method: 1) 用结构化文本布局（目标名称、包含区域、需忽略的干扰物）作为更丰富的计数规范；2) prompt upsampler仅凭图像和类名自动写出该布局；3) 将图像编辑扩散模型改造为单步计数器，直接输出密度图；4) 针对单图单密度图标注导致模型忽略布局的问题，构造合成反事实数据——同一图像对应多张合法密度图，迫使模型依赖布局。
AI.result: 在FSC-147上超过此前零样本SOTA；在LOOKALIKES上取得已报告最佳结果，且对每张图像提供的信息最少。无需重训练即可按类别、区域或粒度对同一张照片计数。
AI.conclusion: 结构化布局规范结合反事实训练可有效提升类无关计数的可控性与精度，实现单一模型多粒度、区域级计数的灵活泛化。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models on conversational African American English: Feature classification and next-turn generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to misinterpret and misrepresent regional and social varieties of English other than Mainstream American English (MAE), such as African American English (AAE), yet most evaluations of these biases have relied on synthetic, stylized or decontextualized data. This paper instead evaluates LLMs on authentic, conversational AAE to more closely reflect how such models may encounter AAE when deployed as chatbots. Concretely, we perform two complementary evaluation tasks on 100 six-turn segments randomly sampled from the Corpus of Regional African American Language (CORAAL; Kendall and Farrington, 2024), comparing three closed-weight LLM configurations: Gemini 2.5 Flash with and without reasoning, and GPT-4.1 mini. The first task compares the models against gold-standard manual annotations for five AAE morphosyntactic features, while the second assesses their ability to generate contextually appropriate next turns, evaluating outputs for AAE feature frequency, diversity (Self-BLEU), and pragmatic quality. Reasoning-enabled Gemini is the strongest feature detector by a clear margin (macro F1 of 0.91), outperforming both other LLMs as well as a finetuned BERT-based baseline (Masis et al., 2022). In generation, however, all LLMs underproduce AAE relative to the human speakers and produce relatively uniform continuations, with reasoning-enabled Gemini producing the least AAE and the least diverse output. We conclude that a model's ability to detect AAE does not straightforwardly translate into its spontaneous use of AAE in generation, and argue that addressing this gap requires changes upstream, in how pretraining and alignment data represent dialectal variation.

AI.tldr: 本文在真实对话式AAE数据（CORAAL）上评测三个LLM：检测AAE形态句法特征与生成语境合适的下一轮对话。结果显示推理版Gemini检测最强（macro F1 0.91），但所有模型生成时AAE使用不足且多样性低，且推理版Gemini反而最少、最单一。
AI.motivation: 以往对LLM在非主流美式英语（如非裔美国人英语AAE）上的偏见评测多依赖合成、风格化或去语境化数据，无法反映聊天机器人部署时真实遇到AAE的情形。
AI.method: 从CORAAL随机抽取100段六轮对话，进行两项互补评测：一是对照人工标注检测五种AAE形态句法特征；二是生成上下文合适的下一轮utterance，并评估AAE特征频率、多样性（Self-BLEU）与语用质量。比较Gemini 2.5 Flash（含/不含推理）与GPT-4.1 mini。
AI.result: 推理版Gemini检测最强，macro F1达0.91，明显优于另两个LLM及微调的BERT基线（Masis et al., 2022）。生成方面，所有LLM相对人类说话人均AAE产出不足且续写趋同，推理版Gemini的AAE最少、多样性最低。
AI.conclusion: 模型检测AAE的能力并不能简单转化为生成中的自发使用；弥合这一差距需从上游入手，改变预训练与对齐数据对方言变异的表征方式。

title: PeerReveal: Learning to Generalize in AI Peer Review Detection
summary: Can we distinguish fully AI-generated reviews from those using AI only to rewrite human judgement? Furthermore, can we do so reliably when reviews are generated from diverse AI models and workflows across scientific domains? To this end, we introduce PeerReveal, a new detector that grounds its decisions in learned relationships between a review's claims and reference claims drawn from AI-generated reviews of the same paper, complemented by review-level textual signals. We evaluate PeerReveal on PeerShift, a new, challenging test set of 5,430 reviews spanning multiple domains, including machine learning, life sciences, and social sciences, combining variation in disciplinary review conventions with diverse AI review-production mechanisms. With regular training, PeerReveal achieves 70.52% pooled Macro-F1 on this benchmark, improving over the strongest baseline by 11.48 points. We develop an effective and practical adversarial training framework that further improves the detector's generalization using a small local generator optimized to produce challenging reviews, raising pooled Macro-F1 from 70.52% to 82.40%. These results show that robust AI-review detection benefits from richer review-level evidence and adversarial training on more challenging generation processes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PeerReveal 检测器，用于区分"完全由 AI 生成的评审"与"AI 仅用于润色人类判断的评审"，并通过对抗训练提升跨模型、跨学科泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 文本检测难以应对关键区分场景：完全 AI 生成评审 vs. 用 AI 改写人类判断的评审；且在多样 AI 模型、生成流程和不同学科评审惯例下可靠性不足。
AI.method: PeerReveal 基于"评审主张"与"同一论文的 AI 生成评审中的参考主张"之间的学习关系做判断，并辅以评审级文本信号；构建 PeerShift 测试集（5,430 条评审，涵盖机器学习、生命科学、社会科学等）；提出实用的对抗训练框架，用小型本地生成器产生高难度评审以提升泛化。
AI.result: 常规训练下 PeerReveal 在 PeerShift 上取得 70.52% pooled Macro-F1，较最强基线提升 11.48 个百分点；对抗训练后提升至 82.40%。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的 AI 评审检测得益于更丰富的评审级证据，以及针对更具挑战性生成过程的对抗训练。

title: One Token, Many Lessons: Sliding-Window Attention within Gated Delta Networks
summary: Linear attention compresses historical context into a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing the computational and memory costs of long-sequence modeling. From the perspective of test-time regression (TTR), the state matrix can be viewed as an online-learned regression model, where keys and values serve as inputs and targets respectively, and queries are used to read from the model. From this perspective, the effectiveness of state learning depends not only on the update rule but also on how the key-value learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. While existing work has largely focused on how the state is updated and organized, we investigate how the learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. To this end, we propose Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet (SWGDN), which replaces short convolutions in Delta-Rule linear attention with sliding-window attention to perform content-dependent local aggregation of projected queries, keys, and values. Our experiments show that SWGDN makes the key-value pairs used in consecutive updates more similar in both GDN2 and KDA. In SWGDN, carrying information from the same token across updates can help the recurrent state reinforce a previously learned association. The local mixing strategy can be incorporated into any Delta-Rule-based linear attention architecture without changing its state update equations or chunkwise parallel algorithms. We apply this strategy to two Delta-Rule variants, GDN2 and KDA, and experimental results demonstrate that SWGDN outperforms the original Delta-Rule baseline across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文从测试时回归(TTR)视角出发，研究线性注意力中用于状态更新的键值学习对如何构造，提出滑动窗口门控DeltaNet (SWGDN)，用滑动窗口注意力替代短卷积做内容相关的局部聚合，从而改进状态学习效果。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力将历史上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态。从TTR视角看，状态可视为在线学习的回归模型，其学习效果不仅取决于更新规则，还取决于用于状态更新的键值学习对如何构造。现有工作多关注状态如何更新与组织，而忽略了学习对的构造方式。
AI.method: 提出SWGDN，将Delta-Rule线性注意力中的短卷积替换为滑动窗口注意力，对投影后的query、key、value进行内容相关的局部聚合。该策略不改变状态更新方程与分块并行算法，可插入任意基于Delta-Rule的线性注意力架构。
AI.result: 实验表明SWGDN使连续更新所用的键值对在GDN2和KDA中更加相似；同一token的信息跨更新携带有助于循环状态强化先前学到的关联。在GDN2和KDA两种变体上，SWGDN在多个基准上优于原始Delta-Rule基线。
AI.conclusion: 构造状态更新学习对的局部混合策略是提升Delta-Rule线性注意力的有效且通用手段，SWGDN在保持算法结构不变的前提下取得更优性能。

title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
summary: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.

AI.tldr: DDxBasis 提出一种在冻结基础编码器上以“鉴别诊断”形式解释医学图像分类器的三步方法，兼顾忠实性与简洁性。
AI.motivation: 临床鉴别诊断靠少量区分性发现来解释诊断，而现有医学图像解释要么忠实但分散于数百概念，要么简洁但遗漏部分决策依据。
AI.method: 1) 用门控二阶槽注意力在所有编码层读取全部 patch token 构建概念瓶颈；2) 概念基将概念重组为两极性轴，每轴代表诊断组间的鉴别；3) 通过极点典型表现、病例相关发现及边界病例反事实编辑，从各轴读出鉴别诊断。
AI.result: 在五个医学数据集上，DDxBasis 是最准确的冻结编码器模型，接近最佳领域专用结果；概念基可精确拆分每个决策且不损精度；无需阶段或概念标签即可恢复细胞谱系与稀有亚型，与皮肤科医生结构标注一致，并揭示植入及真实捷径。
AI.conclusion: DDxBasis 无需标签即可生成忠实且紧凑的鉴别诊断式解释，兼具准确性与可解释性，并能发现捷径。

title: Using AI to Simulate the Behaviour of European Populations
summary: Language models can stand in for survey respondents, but leading approaches build their simulated people from interviews or individual records. We show that a model can learn how European population groups respond from published statistics, without interviews and without training on individual records. We fine-tune an open-weight language model on more than 12 million published group-level answer distributions from about 40 European countries, setting it up to predict each group's departure from a reference distribution. On opinion surveys from its training families it calls the direction of group differences right 84% of the time, ahead of a demographic statistical model (77%, paired test) and level with Claude Opus 5 and 5.5, which it also ties on accuracy; the frontier models are more accurate on new questions. On 278 held-out questions, almost all from the survey families seen in training, its error is 12% lower than that statistical model. It runs on a single 32 GB GPU or a high-memory laptop, and in a test with an earlier model, an evidence gate calibrated on half of a survey's questions fell back to the reference where the model's adjustments did not help. Coupled to a transport simulation of a planned metro closure, with a conventional elasticity as the reference, it adds a testable age gradient to the response, which we freeze for later scoring.

AI.tldr: 该文利用公开统计数据微调开放权重语言模型，模拟欧洲人群对调查问题的回答，无需访谈或个人记录，性能可与前沿模型相当且可在单卡GPU上运行。
AI.motivation: 现有用语言模型替代调查受访者的方法依赖访谈或个体记录数据，成本高且受隐私限制。作者希望探索能否仅从已发布的群体层面统计数据中学习人群的回答模式。
AI.method: 在约40个欧洲国家、超1200万条群体层回答分布上微调开放权重语言模型，将其设置为预测每个群体相对参考分布的偏离量。引入一个在半数调查问题上校准的"证据门"（evidence gate），当模型调整无帮助时回退到参考分布。并接入规划中地铁关闭的交通仿真，以常规弹性为参考，检验年龄梯度。
AI.result: 在训练所属调查族上判断群体差异方向正确率84%，高于人口统计模型（77%，配对检验），与Claude Opus 5和5.5持平（准确率亦相当），但前沿模型在新问题上更准确；278个留出问题上误差比统计模型低12%。模型可运行于单张32GB GPU或大内存笔记本。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭公开的群体层统计数据即可让语言模型模拟人口群体回答，达到统计学基线与前沿模型之间的水平，且轻量可部署、具备可校准的回退机制，可扩展至交通规划等应用场景。

title: FIG-MAC: A Fine-grained Inspiration Graph Empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation
summary: Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation (ASHG) leveraging large language models (LLMs) aims to harness their strengths in knowledge integration, logical reasoning, and text generation for efficiently producing innovative, verifiable scientific hypotheses. However, existing approaches face three critical limitations: (i) insufficient fine-grained knowledge representation, as unstructured context impairs LLM comprehension and reasoning; (ii) lack of knowledge evolution traceability, constraining the generation of innovative cross-domain conjectures; (iii) absence of human-inspired and role-specialized multi-agent collaboration, failing to leverage the efficient innovation mechanisms arising from cognitive diversity and division of labor among expert roles to complete the full ASHG-evaluation loop. To address these limitations, we propose the Fine-grained Inspiration Graph-empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration framework (FIG-MAC) including: (i) Fine-grained Inspiration Graph module (FIG), to obtain fine-grained structured knowledge representations, where nodes represent academic semantic units and edges encode heuristic relationships among them; (ii) ontology-guided hybrid reasoning module, which follows the FIG ontology to construct structured reasoning paths and uses vector search to enrich them with semantic evidence, to obtain the traceable scientific conjecture paths; (iii) role-specialized Multi-Agent framework, inspired by real scientific teamwork, enabling a closed-loop process of scientific conjecture generation, screening, and validation. Experimental results demonstrate that FIG-MAC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on source diversity, provenance-adjusted novelty, and raw novelty.

AI.tldr: FIG-MAC 提出细粒度启发图 + 本体引导混合推理 + 角色专门化多智能体协作框架，用于自动科学假设生成，在来源多样性、溯源调整新颖性与原始新颖性上显著优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动科学假设生成（ASHG）存在三大局限：知识表示不够细粒度（非结构化上下文损害理解与推理）、缺乏知识演化可追溯性（限制跨域创新猜想）、缺少类人的角色专门化多智能体协作（难以形成完整的生成—评估闭环）。
AI.method: 提出FIG-MAC框架，含三模块：(i) 细粒度启发图（FIG）模块，节点为学术语义单元、边编码启发式关系，得到结构化知识表示；(ii) 本体引导的混合推理模块，依FIG本体构建结构化推理路径，并用向量检索补充语义证据，获得可追溯的科学猜想路径；(iii) 角色专门化的多智能体框架，仿真实科研团队分工，实现猜想生成、筛选与验证的闭环。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，FIG-MAC在来源多样性、溯源调整新颖性（provenance-adjusted novelty）和原始新颖性上均显著优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度结构化知识表示、可追溯推理路径与角色分工多智能体协作的有机结合，可有效提升LLM自动科学假设生成的创新性与可验证性。

title: Fast and Scalable Abstract Interpretation for Deep Neural Networks
summary:
Abstract interpretation can certify properties of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), but precise analyses remain expensive. General implementations repeat work when analyzing the same architecture under different inputs and properties. Interleaving this work with numerical operations limits GPU utilization and restricts how much of the analysis a tensor compiler can process together.
  We present Scepter, a framework for specializing DNN abstract interpreters through structural semantics. The semantics determine the structure of intermediate abstract values while deferring their numerical evaluation. Structural computations from successive operations can therefore be performed together before certification, generating an executable tensor program. With the abstract interpreter and DNN architecture fixed, the program can be reused with different weights and input regions. We prove that it computes the same bounds as the general interpreter in exact arithmetic. The generated program also exposes operations and their dependencies for tensor compilation and memory planning. We implement Scepter for the tensor programs that Neuton generates from ConstraintFlow specifications.
  We evaluate Scepter on eight abstract interpreters and 44 DNNs against six baseline systems on GPUs and CPUs. Scepter handles networks with up to 153x as many neurons as the largest completed by the corresponding baselines. It completes DeepPoly on ResNet50 and VGG-16, whereas none of the evaluated DeepPoly baselines completes either network. On configurations completed by both systems, GPU geometric-mean speedups over Neuton range from 11.9x to 44.4x across eight analyses, with a 2.60x geometric-mean reduction in peak memory. In an input-splitting case study, Scepter proves 68 properties for which the baselines time out.
  Code: https://github.com/uiuc-focal-lab/constraintflow.git

AI.tldr: Scepter 通过"结构化语义"将 DNN 抽象解释器特化为可复用的张量程序，把跨算子的结构计算归并后再做数值求值，从而在大幅提升可分析网络规模的同时获得显著的 GPU 加速与内存节省。
AI.motivation: 抽象解释虽能验证 DNN 性质，但精确分析代价高昂：通用解释器在相同架构、不同输入和性质时重复做同样的工作；且结构与数值运算交错执行，限制了 GPU 利用率和张量编译器可整体处理的规模。
AI.method: 提出 Scepter 框架，用结构化语义专门化抽象解释器：语义只决定中间抽象值的结构，推迟数值求值，从而把连续算子产生的结构计算合并为可执行张量程序；在解释器与架构固定后，该程序可复用不同权重与输入区域。并在精确算术下证明其与通用解释器给出相同边界。程序还暴露操作及其依赖以便张量编译和内存规划，实现基于 Neuton 从 ConstraintFlow 规范生成的张量程序。
AI.result: 在 GPU/CPU 上以 8 个抽象解释器、44 个 DNN 对比 6 个基线系统：可处理网络神经元数量最高达对应基线 153×；能完成 ResNet50 与 VGG-16 上的 DeepPoly，而所有 DeepPoly 基线均无法完成；在共同完成配置上，GPU 几何平均加速 11.9×–44.4×，峰值内存几何平均降低 2.60×；输入分裂案例中证明 68 个基线超时的性质。
AI.conclusion: 将抽象解释的工作"结构—数值"分离并特化为可复用张量程序，是一种可行且高效的 DNN 认证路径，兼顾正确性（精确算术下等价）、规模可扩展性与工程性能（速度、内存、编译友好）。

title: Searching Ultra-Long Videos with Decision Models
comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/CeeZh/DeLoVi
summary: Understanding ultra-long videos requires retrieving sparse, query-relevant evidence from extensive video histories. Existing similarity-based retrieval methods are efficient, but they encode the question and the video content independently and thus often miss evidence whose relevance requires reasoning over both. Generative large language models (LLMs) can perform such reasoning, but they typically generate text over multiple rounds of search, which makes each query slow and costly. In this work, we introduce DeLoVi (Decision Models for Long Video), a framework that leverages pretrained decision models to retrieve evidence from ultra-long videos. Like an LLM, a decision model reads the question together with the candidate evidence, so it can reason over both. Unlike an LLM, it directly outputs a relevance score without generating text, which makes it fast and inexpensive. We first present DeLoVi-S, a simple method that generates captions for short video clips and uses a decision model to rank those captions by their relevance to a question. A generative LLM then answers the question using the top-ranked captions. Despite its simplicity, DeLoVi-S achieves state-of-the-art performance on three ultra-long video understanding benchmarks, EgoLifeQA, EgoMemReason, and MM-Lifelong, and generalizes effectively to long-video understanding benchmarks, VideoMME-L and LVBench. However, DeLoVi-S scores every caption for every question, so its cost grows linearly with video length. To reduce this cost, we propose an automated policy evolution framework that iteratively refines the memory construction and retrieval policies around a fixed pretrained decision model. The resulting method, DeLoVi-E, maintains comparable performance while reducing input tokens by 34x on average compared with DeLoVi-S. It also runs over 3x faster than the best prior method on EgoLifeQA while achieving higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出DeLoVi框架，用预训练决策模型（而非生成式LLM）对长视频片段做相关性打分检索证据，含简易版DeLoVi-S与经策略演化降本34倍的DeLoVi-E。
AI.motivation: 超长视频问答需从海量视频历史中检索稀疏的相关证据。基于相似度的方法独立编码问题与视频，难以捕捉需要联合推理的证据；生成式LLM虽能推理，但需多轮生成文本，慢且贵。
AI.method: 利用预训练决策模型同时读取问题与候选证据并直接输出相关性分数，无需生成文本。DeLoVi-S：为短视频片段生成字幕，用决策模型按相关性排序，再由LLM基于Top字幕作答。DeLoVi-E：引入自动化策略演化框架，围绕固定决策模型迭代优化记忆构建与检索策略。
AI.result: DeLoVi-S在EgoLifeQA、EgoMemReason、MM-Lifelong三个超长视频基准上达SOTA，并有效泛化到VideoMME-L与LVBench。DeLoVi-E在性能相当的同时平均减少34倍输入token，在EgoLifeQA上比最佳先前方法快3倍以上且准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可作为长视频证据检索的高效推理型检索器，兼顾联合推理能力与低成本；配合策略演化可显著降低线性增长的开销，实现速度与精度的双赢。

title: LogToPersona: New Benchmark and Efficient Persona Prediction through Semantic Log Filtering
summary: Detailed knowledge of a user's persona is valuable for personalizing generative AI models and agents, yet such details are difficult to obtain and change over time. We address the task of inferring persona attributes from a single day of mobile activity logs. No suitable publicly available benchmark exists for this task, so we introduce a synthetic benchmark of 1,600 persona-log pairs. We target on-device inference so that raw logs never leave the phone, which makes memory rather than speed the limiting constraint: a day of activity yields roughly 30K tokens, whose key-value cache alone exceeds the INT4 weights of a 4B-parameter model. We therefore propose a log filtering method that retains only behaviorally distinct entries. Filtering reduces the memory footprint by up to 39% across nine models from four families and more than halves prefill time, while maintaining or improving prediction quality. For Qwen3-4B it removes 2.5GB, bringing the model from well beyond a realistic per-process budget to a manageable one. Within our benchmark, these results indicate that preserving diverse behavioral events matters more for persona prediction than retaining every semantically similar log entry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从单日手机活动日志推断用户人格属性的任务，构建1600组"人格-日志"配对合成基准，并针对端侧推理的内存瓶颈提出保留行为差异性条目的日志过滤方法，最多降低39%内存占用、预填时间减半以上且预测质量持平或提升。
AI.motivation: 用户人格细节对个性化生成式AI有价值，但难以获取且随时间变化；同时公开基准缺失，端侧推理下一天日志约3万token，其KV cache即超过4B模型的INT4权重，内存成为主要限制。
AI.method: 构建1600组人格-日志配对的合成基准；面向端侧推理（原始日志不出设备）；提出日志过滤方法，仅保留行为上差异显著的条目，去除语义相似的冗余日志。
AI.result: 在来自4个模型族的9个模型上，内存占用最高降低39%，预填时间缩短一半以上，预测质量保持或提升；对Qwen3-4B减少2.5GB，使其从超出实际单进程预算降至可管理范围。
AI.conclusion: 在基准内，保留多样的行为事件比保留每条语义相似的日志条目更有利于人格预测，说明行为多样性比日志完整性更关键。

title: Aligned Machine: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Embedding Similarity via Human Comparative Judgements
summary: Embedding models increasingly inform how people search, recommend, and retrieve information, yet we lack credible ways to test whether these similarity judgments reflect how humans understand meaning. Existing benchmarks typically rely on static, expert-labeled pairs with coarse Likert-style annotations, limiting scalability and making it difficult to obtain consistent, high-confidence annotations. We introduce Aligned Machine, an interactive, public-facing platform that transforms broad participation into a continuously growing Human-Aligned Similarity Benchmark (HASB) for evaluating semantic alignment in embedding-based systems. Participants complete a cognitively-natural, forced-choice task, comparing two pairs of items (text or images) and selecting which pair is more similar. This comparative design is accessible to non-experts, yields clean preference data, and supports robust aggregation. We report results from an initial deployment with 115 participants contributing 2,875 total labeled pairs and 872 unique pairs. Using HASB, we evaluated 12 widely used embedding models and found only partial alignment between embedding similarity and human judgments. Text-only models consistently achieve higher overall agreement than multimodal models, while multimodal performance varies systematically by task type: alignment is strongest for image-image comparisons, weaker for image-text comparisons, and lowest for text-text comparisons. Aligned Machine is designed to evolve over time as participation grows, supporting longitudinal analysis, domain-specific studies, bias detection, and measurement of concept drift across model versions. By combining accessible public participation with rigorous comparative evaluation, HASB provides a scalable and accountable framework for auditing semantic alignment in embedding models.

AI.tldr: 提出Aligned Machine公共参与平台，通过强制选择比较任务构建持续增长的人类对齐相似度基准HASB，并评估12个嵌入模型。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型评估基准依赖静态、专家标注的粗粒度Likert配对数据，难以扩展且难以获得一致的高置信标注，缺乏可信方式检验相似度判断是否符合人类语义理解。
AI.method: 搭建面向公众的交互式平台Aligned Machine，让参与者完成认知自然的强制选择任务（比较两对文本或图像并选出更相似的一对），从而聚合出干净的偏好数据构建HASB基准；首批部署115名参与者，获得2,875条标注对（872个唯一对），并用其评估12个常用嵌入模型。
AI.result: 嵌入相似度与人类判断仅部分对齐；纯文本模型整体一致性高于多模态模型；多模态模型表现随任务类型系统性变化——图像-图像最强，图像-文本较弱，文本-文本最低。
AI.conclusion: HASB将可及的大众参与与严谨比较评估结合，提供可扩展、可问责的嵌入模型语义对齐审计框架，并支持纵向分析、领域研究、偏见检测与模型版本间概念漂移测量。

title: Two Timescales of Forgetting in Fine-tuning of Language Models: Fast Behavioral Suppression and Slow Representational Drift
summary: Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a broad range of text corpora and then fine-tuning on specific tasks or desired behaviors. Yet we still have limited understanding of how fine-tuning on a restricted data distribution modifies representations acquired during pretraining. In particular, it remains unclear whether surface behavioral suppression happens together with the erasure of latent representations that support it. In this work, we study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by pretraining transformers on a controlled context-free grammar with hierarchical latent structure, the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fine-tuning with a restricted subset of its generative rules. While during pretraining the model's ability to generate with the correct grammar rules coincides with building the internal representations of the corresponding latent, we find that SFT exhibits a very different dynamics: (i) the generation of deleted rules changes on a fast timescale inversely proportional to the magnitude of the token-latent correlation; meanwhile, their corresponding representations stay intact; (ii) the hidden representations of the deleted rules become forgotten on a much longer timescale, associated with a slow drift of the network parameters. Finally, we observe analogous results in a realistic setup with natural language, suggesting that this timescale separation in forgetting is a more general phenomenon of fine-tuning language models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在可控的随机层次模型(RHM)上做预训练+SFT实验，发现监督微调中"行为抑制"与"潜在表征遗忘"存在显著的时间尺度分离：被删除规则的行为改变很快，而其内部表征完好；表征遗忘则在长得多的时间尺度上发生，并与参数缓慢漂移相关。
AI.motivation: 当前对预训练后微调如何改变表征理解有限，尤其不清楚表面行为的抑制是否伴随支撑该行为的潜在表征被擦除。作者希望厘清SFT中"行为消失"与"表征遗忘"之间的关系与时间尺度。
AI.method: 在具有层次潜在结构的受控上下文无关文法——随机层次模型(RHM)上预训练Transformer，再用其生成规则的一个受限子集做监督微调(SFT)，追踪生成行为和内部表征随微调时间的变化；并在自然语言的真实场景中验证类似结论。
AI.result: (i) 被删除规则的生成行为在快速时间尺度上改变，该尺度与token–潜在相关性强弱成反比，而对应表征保持完好；(ii) 这些被删除规则的隐藏表征在长得多的时间尺度上才被遗忘，并与网络参数的缓慢漂移相关。自然语言实验呈现类似结果。
AI.conclusion: SFT中行为抑制与表征擦除是可分离的两个过程，遗忘存在时间尺度分离；这一现象可能是语言模型微调的普遍特性。提示仅凭行为变化判断表征是否被遗忘并不可靠。

title: Benchmarking Segmentation Models for Scalable Mangrove Mapping with Sentinel-1/2 Imagery
comment: Accepted at the Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning (TCCML) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Mangroves are dynamic coastal ecosystems that contribute to carbon storage, coastal protection and biodiversity conservation, but are vulnerable to climate change. Very-high-resolution imagery such as Pléiades enables detailed mangrove mapping but it is costly and have a low revisit rate. Large-scale monitoring requires free and regularly available data such as Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 but their spatial resolution poses challenges for detailed mangrove mapping. In this work, we benchmark deep learning approaches for mangrove mapping from Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery using reference maps derived from very-high-resolution Pléiades imagery. We compare four segmentation configurations based on CROMA and BigEarthNet-pretrained ResNet50 representations with different segmentation decoders. We construct a mangrove mapping dataset covering French Guiana, Suriname, and Amapá. CROMA + UPerNet achieves the best performance, with an F1-score of 0.9218 and an IoU of 0.8549. These results highlight the potential of pretrained multimodal Earth observation representations and open Sentinel data to support mangrove resilience through scalable monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究以Pléiades高分辨率影像生成的参考图为准，在法属圭亚那、苏里南和阿马帕构建红树林制图数据集，基准测试基于Sentinel-1雷达与Sentinel-2光学影像的深度学习分割方法。结果显示CROMA+UPerNet最佳，F1为0.9218、IoU为0.8549，证明预训练多模态遥感表征结合免费开放Sentinel数据可实现可扩展的红树林监测。
AI.motivation: 红树林对碳储存、海岸防护和生物多样性保护至关重要，但易受气候变化影响。Pléiades等超高分辨率影像可精细制图，但成本高、重访率低；Sentinel-1/2免费且定期可用，适合大尺度监测，然而空间分辨率较低，给精细红树林制图带来挑战。
AI.method: 以超高分辨率Pléiades影像导出的参考图作为基准，基于CROMA和BigEarthNet预训练ResNet50表征，搭配不同分割解码器，构建四种分割配置进行对比；并构建覆盖法属圭亚那、苏里南和阿马帕的红树林制图数据集。
AI.result: CROMA+UPerNet表现最佳，F1-score达0.9218，IoU达0.8549。
AI.conclusion: 预训练多模态地球观测表征与开放Sentinel数据相结合，能够支持可扩展的红树林监测，从而助力红树林韧性保护。

title: Failure Broadens, Success Sharpens: Continual Adaptation of Tool-Use Agents Across Diverse Tasks with Dual-Polarity Memory
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
summary: Large language model agents can self-improve over time by utilizing procedural memory derived from prior task trajectories, yet the distinct utilities of memories derived from local successes and failures remain underexplored. This work studies this question in a realistic setting with heterogeneous streams of multi-domain tool-use tasks and various environment constraints common in real-world scenarios. We develop \emph{Dual-Polarity Memory with Periodic Maintenance} (DualPM), a simple, retrieval-free memory workflow characterized by (1) customizable reflection and procedural memory generation from both local successes and failures within each trajectory, and (2) periodic memory consolidation over long task streams under a given memory capacity, preventing memory explosion. Online prequential evaluation with fine-grained metrics reveals that failure memory more strongly broadens coverage, success memory better streamlines execution, while combining both polarities effectively integrates both benefits. Further studies demonstrate that DualPM enables cross-domain memory generalization and continual memory adaptation, while external evaluation on EvoMemBench reveals the portability and effectiveness of DualPM as a general long-term procedural memory method.

AI.tldr: DualPM：一种免检索、双极性（成功+失败）程序性记忆工作流，配合周期性记忆整合，用于LLM智能体在多域工具使用任务流中的长期自我改进。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可利用既往任务轨迹衍生的程序性记忆自我改进，但来自局部“成功”与“失败”的记忆各自的价值尚未被充分研究；真实场景中还存在多域异构任务流与环境约束。
AI.method: 提出DualPM（双极性记忆+周期维护）：(1) 对每条轨迹中的局部成功与失败分别进行可定制的反思并生成程序性记忆；(2) 在给定记忆容量下，对长任务流周期性整合记忆，防止记忆爆炸；整体免检索（retrieval-free）。采用在线prequential评估与细粒度指标，在EvoMemBench等外部评测上验证。
AI.result: 失败记忆更能拓宽任务覆盖范围，成功记忆更能精简执行流程，二者结合可有效整合两种收益；DualPM还展现出跨域记忆迁移与持续记忆适应能力，在EvoMemBench上验证了其可移植性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 成功与失败记忆具有互补价值，双极性+周期维护的简单记忆流程可作为通用的长期程序性记忆方法，支持智能体在多域任务流中持续自我改进。

title: Learning from Natural Images Untangles Number Sense
summary: Numerical cognition is a simple yet fundamental ability that remains challenging for modern vision-language models. Meanwhile, number sense is already present in numerically naïve animals, suggesting that it can emerge without explicit numerical learning. Deep neural networks provide a related observation, with numerosity-selective units appearing after training on unrelated natural-image tasks and even before any training. However, these findings leave unresolved whether visual learning contributes beyond the spontaneous emergence of numerical selectivity. Human development provides a clue, as children become better at making judgments in which numerosity and proportion conflict. Here, we introduce a geometric framework to trace how representations of these two quantities change across learning. Although untrained and pretrained networks exhibited similar unit-level numerosity selectivity and basic comparison performance, natural-image pretraining increased the angle between numerosity and proportion subspaces while reducing their overlap, supporting more robust readout under conflict. Direct manipulation of these geometric properties further demonstrated their functional contributions to decoding accuracy and functional independence. Importantly, conventional supervised pretraining was not essential for quantity separation, which also emerged through self-supervised learning without category labels and synthetic-image training without natural-image exposure. Together, our findings suggest that structured visual learning can refine spontaneously emerging number sense into robust and functionally independent quantity representations without explicit numerical training.

AI.tldr: 该论文用几何框架追踪学习过程中"数量"与"比例"两种表征的变化，发现自然图像预训练虽不改变单元级数量选择性，却通过增大两个子空间夹角、降低重叠来提升冲突条件下的稳健解码。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型仍难以处理"数感"这类基本能力，而幼稚动物与未经训练的神经网络却已自发出现数量选择性单元。这留下一个未解问题：视觉学习究竟在自发涌现的数量选择性之外还贡献了什么？人类儿童在数量与比例冲突判断上随发展变强的现象提供了线索，提示需考察两类量表征在学习中的关系变化。
AI.method: 提出一个几何框架，量化表征空间中数量子空间与比例子空间之间的夹角与重叠度；对比未训练、预训练（自然图像监督、自监督、合成图像）网络在单元级数量选择性、基本比较任务及冲突任务上的表现；并直接操纵这些几何属性以检验其功能因果性。
AI.result: 未训练与预训练网络的单元级数量选择性和基本比较表现相近；但自然图像预训练增大了数量与比例子空间夹角、减少重叠，从而在冲突条件下支持更稳健的读出。直接操纵几何属性可改变解码准确率与功能独立性。监督预训练并非必需：自监督学习（无类别标签）与合成图像训练（无自然图像）亦能产生数量分离。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的视觉学习能在无显式数值训练的情况下，把自发涌现的数感精炼为稳健且功能独立的量表征；关键在于数量与比例子空间的几何分离而非单元级选择性本身。

title: Change Partners at Every Layer: Balanced Random Regrouping for Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines fine-tuned experts into one model that serves many tasks without retraining, but merging many experts this way substantially reduces accuracy. Grouping offers a middle ground: at every layer or weight matrix, the $N$ experts are divided into $K<N$ groups, the experts in a group are merged into one shared module, and a task uses the module merged from its expert's group. Natural choices are to keep the same partners across layers or to group similar experts. Surprisingly, we find that randomly changing partners at every layer outperforms both. We call this Balanced Random Regrouping (BRR): it independently partitions the experts into $K$ equal-sized random groups at each layer (BRR-layer) or weight matrix (BRR-matrix) and merges each group with an existing method. With validation-selected merge scales, both BRR variants outperform reusing one grouping across layers in all 24 CLIP settings, by 1.0-6.8 points, and BRR-matrix also outperforms the similarity-based FlexMerge in every setting. A first-order analysis explains this gain. At each layer, merging a task's expert with its partners shifts the task's output features; when the partners are the same at every layer, these shifts tend to point in similar directions and add up, whereas with new partners at every layer they vary independently and add up less on average. A series of experiments supports this analysis, which further guides a grouping search that can outperform BRR.

AI.tldr: 提出 Balanced Random Regrouping (BRR)：在每一层/每个权重矩阵独立地把 N 个专家随机均分为 K 组再合并，效果优于固定分组与相似性分组，并给出了一阶分析解释。
AI.motivation: 模型合并可将多个微调专家合并为一个多任务模型而无需重训，但合并大量专家会显著降低精度。分组合并是一种折中方案（每层把 N 个专家分为 K<N 组，组内合并共享模块），但如何选择分组伙伴尚无定论：跨层保持相同伙伴，还是按相似性分组，直觉上都更合理，因此需要探究更好的分组策略。
AI.method: BRR：在每一层（BRR-layer）或每个权重矩阵（BRR-matrix）上独立地将专家随机划分为 K 个等大小分组，再用现有合并方法合并每组，合并尺度由验证集选择。作者还通过一阶分析解释其有效性，并据此设计分组搜索方法。
AI.result: 在全部 24 个 CLIP 设置上，两种 BRR 变体均优于跨层复用同一分组，提升 1.0–6.8 分；BRR-matrix 在所有设置上也优于基于相似性的 FlexMerge。分析表明：若各层伙伴相同，合并引起的输出特征偏移方向相似而累加放大；若每层更换伙伴，偏移方向相互独立、平均累加更小。系列实验支持该分析，并进一步指导出可超越 BRR 的分组搜索。
AI.conclusion: 随机、逐层（逐矩阵）变化的分组伙伴反而优于跨层固定伙伴与相似性分组，原因在于误差偏移的独立性降低了累积偏差；该洞见可指导更优的分组搜索。

title: MotifFlow: Training-Free, Self-Contained Style Transfer from Color to Motif in Rectified Flow Transformers
summary: Expressive style transfer must reproduce a painting's palette, brushwork, and characteristic motifs while retaining the content image's structure. Attention injection is effective in U-Net-based diffusion models, but adapting it to FLUX often transfers color without capturing the style's distinctive brushwork. Our analysis across backbones links this gap to how injected features are integrated across neighboring spatial locations.
