We introduce MotifFlow, a training-free, self-contained framework that combines style injection with style-alignment guidance in FLUX. Injection supplies style features during generation but does not explicitly encourage the model's native attention output to align with them. We therefore use the discrepancy between native and injected attention outputs to guide latent-space updates, encouraging the evolving image to develop the style's distinctive brushwork and motifs. Style encoding, guidance, and synthesis all use the same frozen backbone, without auxiliary image encoders or trained adapters. A single strength parameter controls the transition from color transfer to pronounced brushwork and motifs, with additional support for regional stylization and style mixing. Experiments on 1,000 content-style pairs show that MotifFlow better matches the local textures of the style image than baseline methods and produces more consistent stylization than injection alone. The same design extends to FLUX.2.

AI.tldr: MotifFlow 提出一种免训练框架，将风格注入与风格对齐引导结合用于 FLUX 扩散模型，通过原生注意力与注入注意力输出间的差异引导潜空间更新，从而不仅迁移颜色，还能复现笔触与典型母题。
AI.motivation: 注意力注入在 U-Net 扩散模型中效果好，但迁移到 FLUX 时常只迁移颜色而丢失风格的独特笔触。作者分析发现，这一问题源于注入特征在相邻空间位置上的整合方式不同。
AI.method: 在 FLUX 中同时进行风格注入与风格对齐引导：注入在生成中提供风格特征，但缺乏显式对齐；因此用原生注意力输出与注入注意力输出的差异来引导潜空间更新。风格编码、引导与合成共用同一冻结主干，无需辅助图像编码器或训练适配器，并用单一强度参数控制从颜色迁移到笔触母题的过渡，支持区域风格化与风格混合。
AI.result: 在 1000 个内容-风格对上，MotifFlow 比基线更好地匹配风格图的局部纹理，且风格化一致性优于单独注入；该设计可扩展到 FLUX.2。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力差异引导可弥补 FLUX 上风格注入的笔触缺失问题，实现免训练、自包含的高表现力风格迁移，并具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Sparse-to-Sparse Feature Learning for Cross-Layer Analysis and Steering
summary: Understanding how models internally represent information is a central challenge in interpretation and control. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense hidden representations into sparse features, and cross-layer methods capture structure spanning multiple layers. However, existing objectives do not explicitly train the sparse code at one layer to predict the sparse code at the next layer. We propose sparse-to-sparse feature learning (S2S), where sparse features at each intermediate layer are trained to predict those of the immediately following layer, with the final layer anchored by an output-distribution loss and optimization proceeding sequentially from output to input. Experiments across eight language models show stronger adjacent-layer correspondence than matched sparse-feature baselines. We evaluate feature-based interventions at matched output-distribution shift, separating steering-induced effects from sparse-pathway reconstruction effects. Causal ablation provides complementary evidence beyond correspondence metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 sparse-to-sparse feature learning (S2S)，让每一中间层的稀疏特征去预测紧邻下一层的稀疏特征，并用输出分布损失锚定最后一层，从输出到输入顺序优化；在八个语言模型上相邻层对应性强于基线。
AI.motivation: SAE 能把稠密隐表示分解为稀疏特征，跨层方法也能刻画多层结构，但现有目标函数并未显式训练某一层的稀疏码去预测下一层的稀疏码。
AI.method: 在各中间层训练稀疏特征预测下一层稀疏特征；最后一层由输出分布损失锚定；优化顺序从输出层向输入层依次推进。实验覆盖八个语言模型，与匹配的稀疏特征基线比较相邻层对应性；在输出分布偏移匹配的条件下评估基于特征的干预，以区分引导效应与稀疏通路重构效应，并用因果消融作为补充证据。
AI.result: 八个语言模型上相邻层对应性均强于匹配基线；匹配输出分布偏移的特征干预可分离引导效应与重构效应，因果消融提供了对应性指标之外的补充证据。
AI.conclusion: 显式的层间稀疏码预测目标能改善跨层特征结构的一致性，并为层间特征干预的因果评估提供更受控的实验框架。

title: Controllable CAD Generation and Interactive Editing of Fluid Rotors
summary: Computer-aided design (CAD) provides the geometric foundation for rotors in fluid rotating machinery. However, creating models for different rotors requires different modeling processes, making it difficult to control geometry through design intent and reuse existing models. We introduce VaneCraft, an agent-driven framework for rotor generation, inverse recovery, and editing through a unified analytical representation. The agent interprets design requests and invokes geometric modeling operations. The representation defines geometric controls through meridional geometry and independent boundary angle laws. An anisotropic partial differential equation (PDE) maps these controls to the blade surfaces. Geometric parameter correction (GPC) uses a joint geometric encoder and a parameter decoder to refine controls initialized from rotor category and dimensions. Inverse recovery maps existing CAD to the same geometric controls for reconstruction and continued editing. Experiments demonstrate that VaneCraft supports anisotropy control and parameter editing and outperforms representative baselines in rotor CAD generation tasks. Project page is available on \href{https://github.com/shenchen333/vanecraft}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: VaneCraft：智能体驱动、统一解析表示的叶轮机械转子生成/逆向复原/编辑框架。
AI.motivation: 转子CAD建模流程因类型而异，难以用设计意图控制几何、难以复用已有模型。
AI.method: 用子午几何+独立边界角律定义几何控制，各向异性PDE映射为叶片曲面；智能体解析设计请求并调用建模操作；几何参数校正(GPC)用联合几何编码器与参数解码器精化由类别和尺寸初始化的控制量；逆向复原将现有CAD映射到同一控制空间。
AI.result: 实验证明支持各向异性控制与参数编辑，在转子CAD生成任务上优于代表性基线。
AI.conclusion: 统一解析表示有望实现设计意图可控、可复用、可编辑的转子CAD建模。

title: Sparse Adaptation for In-Context Learning on Data Streams
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) generates massive data streams, making edge computing essential for low-latency applications and 5G networks. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable adaptation through in-context examples rather than parameter updates, but evolving streams challenge context relevance and computational efficiency. This work introduces SAIL, a framework for sparse adaptation of TFMs that reuses the model's key--value cache between adaptation events. SAIL reconstructs its support set only when drifts in stream structure indicate potential context inadequacy, while the structural representation itself is updated by changes in predictive performance. SAIL combines prequential error monitoring with online, class-specific micro-clustering to detect changes in cluster mass, class separability, and feature-space coverage. Upon adaptation, a context budget is allocated proportionally to class mass, and the most recently updated micro-clusters provide representative observations for refitting. This limits context redundancy and computational cost while preserving recent structural information.

AI.tldr: SAIL：面向表格基础模型(TFM)的稀疏自适应框架，复用KV缓存，仅在流结构漂移时重建支撑集，实现低开销的流式适应。
AI.motivation: IoT与5G场景产生海量数据流，边缘计算需低延迟；TFM通过上下文示例而非参数更新实现适应，但持续演化的数据流使上下文相关性难以维持且计算开销高。
AI.method: 提出SAIL稀疏自适应框架：在适应事件间复用模型KV缓存；结合预序误差(prequential)监控与在线、类特定微聚类，检测簇质量、类可分性和特征空间覆盖的变化，以此判断上下文是否失效；触发适应时按类质量比例分配上下文预算，用最新更新的微簇提供代表性样本重新拟合。
AI.result: 限制了上下文冗余与计算成本，同时保留近期结构信息；仅在结构漂移指示上下文可能不足时才重建支撑集。
AI.conclusion: SAIL以稀疏、按需的上下文重建方式，在保持TFM免参数更新优势的同时，兼顾流式环境下的上下文相关性与效率。

title: VersionGS: Compact and Motion-Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Versioned Gaussians
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Recent dynamic Gaussian splatting methods encode temporal change, either as smooth functions of time or as constrained updates between frames. We observe that their reconstruction quality degrades significantly under fast motion. In challenging dance sequences, their PSNR drops by 1.1-4.0 dB on high-motion frames compared to low-motion frames. To overcome this limitation, we propose VersionGS, a method that directly encodes per-frame Gaussian states and uses motion estimation only to guide reconstruction. Within each group of frames, unchanged Gaussians keep their current versions in a shared dictionary, while modified Gaussians are appended as new versions. To maximize version reuse, we introduce selective sequential construction, which refines the Gaussians selected by optical flow, photograph differences or rendering errors and leaves the others unchanged. The dictionary is then pruned, fine-tuned with simulated quantization and encoded as images. Adjusting the pruning ratio trades off storage and quality without rebuilding the dictionary. On the fast dance sequences of DanceNet3D, VersionGS improves foreground PSNR by 2.7 dB over the best baseline, and its PSNR decreases by less than 0.3 dB on the highest-motion frames. On N3DV and Technicolor, it requires 6.0x and 5.7x less storage than TAD-GS, the strongest baseline overall, while achieving even higher PSNR. Finally, playback is fast and requires no motion model or neural network, only a 3DGS rasterizer.

AI.tldr: VersionGS 用"逐帧高斯状态版本字典"直接编码动态场景，运动估计仅作为重建引导，在快速运动场景中显著优于现有动态高斯泼溅方法。
AI.motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅方法将时间变化编码为时间的平滑函数或帧间受约束的更新，在快速运动下重建质量明显下降：高运动帧相较低运动帧 PSNR 下降 1.1–4.0 dB。
AI.method: 1) 每个帧组内维护共享字典，未变化的高斯保留当前版本，变化的高斯追加为新版本；2) 选择性顺序构建：仅对由光流、光度差异或渲染误差选出的高斯进行细化，其余保持不变以最大化版本复用；3) 字典剪枝后结合模拟量化进行微调，并编码为图像存储；4) 调整剪枝比例即可在存储与质量间权衡，无需重建字典。
AI.result: DanceNet3D 快速舞蹈序列上前景 PSNR 比最佳基线提升 2.7 dB，最高运动帧 PSNR 下降少于 0.3 dB；N3DV 与 Technicolor 上比最强基线 TAD-GS 分别节省 6.0x 和 5.7x 存储，同时 PSNR 更高。
AI.conclusion: VersionGS 通过版本化字典直接存储逐帧高斯状态，避免了运动模型的拟合误差，在快速运动下更稳健、更省存储，且仅需 3DGS 光栅化器即可快速回放，无需运动模型或神经网络。

title: Verifiable but Not Predictable: What Sentence Embeddings Know About Propositional Decomposition
summary: Quality control for proposition decomposition by large language models (LLMs) raises two asymmetric questions. After decomposition, one can verify: given a sentence and a candidate proposition, does the proposition belong to that sentence? Before decomposition, one would like to predict: how many propositions should the sentence yield? On PropSegmEnt, a corpus of English Wikipedia sentences each segmented by three human annotators, we find that the two questions live in different representational spaces. A natural language inference (NLI) judge verifies membership with 92.8% accuracy and an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.977, and its residual errors turn out to be mostly propositions that are true in document context rather than genuine entailment mistakes. Vector geometry cannot verify: cosine similarity saturates, and a sentence embedding is not a linear combination of its propositions' embeddings. For prediction, every symbolic anchor we test, namely token count, the CPIDR idea-density counter, and a Neo-Davidsonian predicate count, reduces to a length proxy once token count is controlled. A linear ridge probe on sentence embeddings is the only predictor that keeps genuine count signal: its length-partialled correlation with human counts is 0.40-0.49 with bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs) excluding zero, and it orders length-matched sentence pairs correctly 67-71% of the time against a 50% chance level, statistically matching the inter-annotator agreement ceiling. This signal survives INT8 quantization without loss, INT4 at a small cost, and Matryoshka truncation to 256 dimensions, and it works as well in a 2021 encoder as in a 2025 one. Its structured weakness is a systematic under-splitting of long sentences. We distill the protocol lessons, including a retracted pilot study, into a checklist for probing length-confounded quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM命题分解质量控制的"验证"与"预测"两个不对称问题，发现验证适合用NLI法官，预测只能靠句嵌入上的线性探针，并将协议教训提炼为检查清单。
AI.motivation: 命题分解的质量控制需要回答两类不对称问题：分解后如何验证某命题是否属于原句（membership），分解前如何预测句子应产生多少命题（count）。作者想知道这两类问题分别落在什么表征空间、哪种方法才真正有效，而非依赖直觉或受限几何/长度代理。
AI.method: 在PropSegmEnt数据集上（英文维基百科句子，每句由3位标注者切分）做系统对比：(1) 用NLI判断做成员验证，与余弦相似/嵌入线性组合等向量几何方法对比；(2) 对计数预测，测试token数、CPIDR观念密度计数器、Neo-Davidsonian谓词数等符号锚点，在控制token长度后检验其是否退化为长度代理；并提出句嵌入上的线性ridge探针，做长度偏相关分析与长度匹配句对排序实验，考察量化与降维鲁棒性。
AI.result: NLI判断验证成员关系达92.8%准确率、AUC 0.977，残余错误多为"文档语境为真"而非真正蕴含错误；向量几何无法验证（余弦饱和、句嵌入非命题嵌入线性组合）。符号锚点在控制token数后全部退化为长度代理；只有嵌入线性ridge探针保留真实计数信号：长度偏相关0.40–0.49（bootstrap CI不含零），长度匹配句对正确排序率67–71%（对50%随机水平），统计上达到标注者间一致上限；该信号经受INT8无损、INT4小损、Matryoshka截断至256维，且2021与2025编码器效果相当；结构性弱点是系统性低估长句切分数。
AI.conclusion: 验证与预测分属不同表征空间：验证用NLI最有效，预测只有嵌入线性探针保留真实计数信号。作者将协议教训（含一项被撤回的预实验）提炼为探测长度混淆量的检查清单。

title: Online Prediction System for Proactive Autoscaling
summary: We present an online learning system for short-term time series forecasting that enables proactive autoscaling in large-scale distributed systems. Unlike traditional forecasting methods that focus on modeling seasonality and long-term trends, the system targets high-accuracy, low-latency predictions for immediate future intervals for dynamic resource management in internet-scale infrastructures. The system employs a two-stage architecture: a seasonality decomposition stage followed by a residual correction stage using lightweight linear models with engineered features. By retraining models on-the-fly for every prediction cycle, the online prediction system continuously adapts to changing demand patterns without requiring persistent model storage or feature drift monitoring. Deployed across many heterogeneous services, the system processes over 900K predictions per hour; in an offline evaluation on production traffic, its STL-based configuration reduces prediction error (MAPE) by 18.6\% relative to the previous production model. In production, the system has saved an estimated 118K servers daily.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于短期时间序列预测的在线学习系统，支持大规模分布式系统的主动自动扩缩容，采用两阶段架构并每周期即时重训练，在生产中显著降低误差并节省服务器。
AI.motivation: 传统预测方法侧重季节性与长期趋势建模，难以满足互联网级基础设施对紧邻未来区间的高精度、低延迟预测需求，以实现动态资源管理。
AI.method: 两阶段架构：先做季节性分解，再用带工程特征的轻量线性模型做残差校正；每个预测周期在线重训练，无需持久化模型存储或特征漂移监控。
AI.result: 部署于多种异构服务，每小时处理超90万次预测；离线评估中基于STL的配置相较原生产模型MAPE降低18.6%；生产环境每日估计节省11.8万台服务器。
AI.conclusion: 轻量在线重训练的两阶段方法可在生产规模下兼顾精度与延迟，自适应需求变化，带来显著的资源成本收益。

title: DreamTour: Layout Steering for Training-Free World Exploration
summary: Video diffusion and world models generate plausible videos but do not reliably match the requested camera direction and travel distance. We present DreamTour, a training-free framework that generates camera tours from a single image with more accurate control over camera motion. DreamTour first uses a frozen image inpainting prior to extend the photograph beyond its original field of view while preserving the input pixels. Depth-based rendering of this extended scene along the requested camera path produces approximate target views that serve as spatial guidance. We introduce Layout Steering, which aligns early video latents with these views through decaying low-frequency corrections, leaving later denoising to refine appearance and dynamics. For longer tours, we autoregressively generate the video segments, repeating guidance construction from each segment's final frame to maintain camera control across the full trajectory. DreamTour improves directional accuracy and travel calibration on VBench while maintaining competitive video quality. On WorldScore, it strengthens camera control and scene consistency across chained movements. Together, these results demonstrate that training-free spatial guidance enables more accurate and consistent camera control in pretrained video diffusion and world models.

AI.tldr: DreamTour是一个免训练框架，利用单张图像生成相机轨迹可控的视频漫游，通过场景外扩、深度渲染引导和布局引导实现更准确的相机运动控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散与世界模型虽能生成逼真视频，但无法可靠匹配所请求的相机方向与移动距离，缺乏精确的相机运动控制。
AI.method: 先用冻结的图像修复先验将照片扩展到原始视野之外并保留输入像素；再沿指定相机路径对扩展场景做基于深度的渲染，得到近似目标视图作为空间引导；提出Layout Steering，通过衰减的低频修正将早期视频潜变量对齐到这些视图，后续去噪负责细化外观与动态；对长轨迹采用自回归分段生成，并以每段末帧重复构建引导以保持全程控制。
AI.result: 在VBench上提升方向准确性与移动距离标定，同时保持有竞争力的视频质量；在WorldScore上增强了链式运动的相机控制与场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的空间引导可使预训练视频扩散与世界模型获得更准确、更一致的相机控制。

title: Rethinking Knowledge Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation has recently proven highly effective for improving autoregressive models, but its applicability to DLMs remains poorly understood. We present the first systematic study of KD for DLMs and uncover two non-intuitive failures of classical forward-KL (FKL) distillation: (i) student perplexity does not improve monotonically with more teacher-generated data, and (ii) on the same teacher-generated corpus, FKL distillation underperforms simply training the student with the original DLM denoising objective. To address them, we propose a unified, data-free distillation framework for masked DLMs. First, the framework runs an off-policy distillation phase that absorbs general knowledge from a static set of teacher-generated data. Then, the framework employs on-policy distillation which consists of three techniques: a trajectory loss along the student's own reverse process, confidence reweighting that down-weights tokens where the teacher is unsure, and a trust-region anchor that stabilizes the moving target. On MDLM, the resulting student attains a GPT-2 perplexity of $24.75$, surpassing the teacher's $27.04$; on Dream-7B distillation to a 93M student model, the framework reduces Qwen-2.5 perplexity from the FKL-distilled baseline of $25.23$ to $19.83$ while preserving performance on zero-shot general capability benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究扩散语言模型(DLM)的知识蒸馏,揭示经典前向KL蒸馏的两个反直觉失效,并提出统一的免数据蒸馏框架(离线+在线策略三技术),蒸馏学生模型困惑度超越教师。
AI.motivation: KD对自回归模型有效,但对DLM适用性理解不足。作者发现FKL蒸馏的两个非直观失效:(i)学生困惑度不随教师生成数据增多而单调改善;(ii)在同一教师语料上FKL反而不如原始去噪目标训练。
AI.method: 面向掩码DLM的统一免数据蒸馏框架:先进行离策略蒸馏,从静态教师数据吸收通用知识;再进行在线策略蒸馏,含三项技术——沿学生自身反向过程的轨迹损失、对教师不确定token降权的置信度重加权、稳定移动目标的信赖域锚点。
AI.result: MDLM上学生达到GPT-2困惑度24.75,超过教师27.04;Dream-7B蒸馏到93M学生,Qwen-2.5困惑度从FKL基线25.23降至19.83,并保持零样本通用能力基准表现。
AI.conclusion: FKL不适合DLM蒸馏,在线策略+轨迹/置信度/信赖域组合的免数据框架显著优于FKL,且小模型可超越教师困惑度并保留通用能力。

title: SlicePlanner: Logic-Guided Agentic AI for Online QoS-Aware Network Slicing in Open RAN
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS), October 21-23, 2026, Hong Kong SAR, China
summary: Adaptive network slicing in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) demands reconfiguration decisions that respond to live traffic conditions while remaining safe with respect to Service Level Agreement (SLA) constraints, a combination that purely data-driven controllers cannot reliably guarantee without continuous retraining. We present SlicePlanner, a logic-guided closed-loop framework that treats each RAN reconfiguration as a controlled hypothesis: proposed from live and historical KeyPerformance Indicator (KPI) evidence, filtered through explicit SLA constraints and mined RAN control rules, and committed only when post-action measurements confirm improvement. SlicePlanner comprises two cooperating agents: SliceSense, which monitors live KPIs, retrieves context-conditioned evidence, and ranks candidate RAN actions through a surrogate-guided admissibility filter; and SliceGuard, which validates post-action KPI responses, rolls back harmful configurations, and refreshes rules under distribution drift. Validated over the air using OpenAirInterface, FlexRIC, and commercial Sierra Wireless 5G devices, SlicePlanner reduces SLA latency violations by up to 86% over static slicing and 50% over Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based slicing, while maintaining comparable cell throughput and auditable decisions without online retraining.

AI.tldr: SlicePlanner 是一个逻辑引导的 O-RAN 网络切片闭环重配置框架，将每次重配置视为"受控假设"：由实时与历史 KPI 证据提出、经 SLA 约束与挖掘的 RAN 控制规则过滤、仅在事后测量确认改善后提交，在真实 5G 设备上最高降低 86% SLA 时延违规。
AI.motivation: O-RAN 自适应切片需要同时满足两点：根据实时流量做重配置决策，且对 SLA 约束保持安全。纯数据驱动（如 DRL）控制器若无持续再训练，无法可靠保证这种安全性。
AI.method: 提出逻辑引导的闭环框架，含两个协作智能体：SliceSense 监控实时 KPI、检索上下文条件化证据、通过代理模型引导的可接受性过滤器对候选 RAN 动作排序；SliceGuard 验证动作后 KPI 响应、回滚有害配置，并在分布漂移下刷新规则。基于 OpenAirInterface、FlexRIC 与商用 Sierra Wireless 5G 设备进行空口验证。
AI.result: 相比静态切片最多降低 86% 的 SLA 时延违规，相比 DRL 切片降低 50%，同时保持相当的蜂窝吞吐量，并获得可审计的决策，且无需在线再训练。
AI.conclusion: 将安全约束与规则逻辑嵌入控制闭环，可在无需在线再训练的前提下实现安全、可审计且有效的 O-RAN 切片重配置，优于静态与 DRL 方法。

title: A Hierarchy of Risk Certificates for Representation-Based Prediction
summary: Representation-based prediction underlies many machine-learning systems. Yet a fitted predictor's failure to meet an accuracy requirement does not establish that its representation-decoder class cannot meet it. We study optimal population mean squared error (MSE) over Lipschitz decoders acting on a fixed representation. For blocks of $b\geq2$ independent and identically distributed (iid) observations, we minimize total squared error (normalized by $b-1$) under pairwise Lipschitz constraints. We prove that expected block scores form nondecreasing lower bounds on optimal class risk and converge to that risk on compact metric feature spaces, although no fixed block size provides a uniform relative guarantee. Verified dual lower bounds and iid calibration observations independent of model development, with bounded targets and predictions, yield simultaneous lower confidence bounds on optimal class risk and upper confidence bounds on fitted-predictor risk. These bounds can establish that every admissible decoder exceeds a prescribed MSE threshold or that an admissible fitted predictor meets it. Controlled experiments illustrate population-risk certification; fixed PTB-XL and Bike Sharing experiments provide deterministic empirical-risk conclusions. The results support principled assessment and selection of representation-decoder configurations. Efficient certification at scale and extensions to dependent observations remain open problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于分块（b≥2个iid观测）与成对Lipschitz约束的期望块分数，用以刻画固定表示下Lipschitz解码器类的最优总体MSE，并给出可同时认证“类最优风险下界”与“拟合预测器风险上界”的置信界方法。
AI.motivation: 一个已拟合预测器未达到精度要求，并不能说明其表示-解码器类本身无法达到该要求，因此需要一种对“类最优风险”进行原则性评估与认证的方法。
AI.method: 在固定表示与Lipschitz解码器类上研究最优总体MSE；对b≥2的独立同分布观测块，在成对Lipschitz约束下最小化（以b−1归一化的）总平方误差，证明期望块分数是类最优风险的非降下界并在紧致度量特征空间上收敛到该风险；结合经验证的对偶下界与独立于模型开发的iid校准观测（有界目标与预测），构造类最优风险的同步下置信界与拟合预测器风险的上置信界。
AI.result: 理论证明块分数收敛但不存在固定块大小的统一相对保证；实验展示总体风险认证，PTB-XL与Bike Sharing实验给出确定性的经验风险结论。
AI.conclusion: 结果为表示-解码器配置的原则性评估与选择提供支持；大规模高效认证与依赖观测的推广仍是开放问题。

title: ArtTet: Watertight Part Meshes of Articulated Objects from Rigid-Body Rules and Partitioned Marching Tetrahedra
summary: We present ArtTet, a method that reconstructs an articulated object from multi-view observations of two articulation states and outputs one watertight mesh per rigid part together with the joints that move them. Mesh splatting gives explicit triangles, but it treats the object as one scene. It extracts a single global surface and cannot keep the triangles of different parts apart; the mesh it exports is layered, self-intersecting, and full of holes. ArtTet follows a divide-and-conquer strategy instead. We first divide the object into rigid parts with dynamic- and geometric-constrained articulation and ownership inference. A multibody registration of the two states recovers the parts and their screw joints. Rigid-body rules on attachment, contact, and swept motion then correct joint types and part labels without any part annotation. We then divide space into part cells with an articulated tetrahedral partition, and conquer each cell with its own differentiable signed distance field on a shared tetrahedral grid. In these partitioned marching tetrahedra the fields are mutually exclusive by construction, so the extracted part meshes are closed and never overlap. All part meshes are optimized jointly from the images of both states through the recovered joints. On Articulate-100, ArtTet gives the most accurate axis directions, part motions, and part geometry over all objects among methods that use no part masks, and its part meshes have virtually no open boundary edges. We also show reconstructions of real captures from the SplArt dataset.

AI.tldr: ArtTet 通过"分而治之"策略，从两个关节状态的多视角观测重建铰接物体：先用多体配准和刚体规则划分刚性部件并恢复螺旋转轴，再用铰接四面体划分把空间切成互斥的部件单元、各单元用独立可微 SDF 提取闭合不重叠的部件网格，并在 Articulate-100 上取得无部件掩码方法中最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 mesh splatting 方法虽能给出显式三角网格，但把物体当作单一场景、只提取一个全局表面，无法分隔不同部件，导致导出网格分层、自交且多孔洞。作者希望获得每部件封闭、互不重叠且带关节信息的水密网格。
AI.method: 分两阶段：(1) 用动态与几何约束的关节/归属推断，将物体划分为刚性部件；对两状态做多体配准恢复部件及其螺旋关节，再用依附、接触、扫掠运动等刚体规则自动纠正关节类型与部件标签（无需部件标注）。(2) 构建铰接四面体空间划分成部件单元，在共享四面体网格上为每个单元学习独立可微 SDF，使各场互斥，经分区 marching tetrahedra 提取闭合不重叠部件网格；所有部件网格通过恢复的关节、由两状态图像联合优化。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 上，在所有不使用部件掩码的方法中，ArtTet 在转轴方向、部件运动与部件几何精度上对所有物体均最优，且部件网格几乎没有开放边界边；并在 SplArt 真实采集数据上展示了重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过部件级显式分解与互斥的四面体 SDF 表示，ArtTet 解决了整体式重建中部件混杂、网格破损的问题，可在无部件标注条件下生成水密、无重叠的部件网格及准确关节，并适用于真实捕获数据。

title: Refusal Is Not Scored: A Coverage Limit in Content-Based Bias Evaluation
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AfifahK/bias-eval-construct-validity
summary: Bias audits of conversational models often discard refusals (responses such as "I can't assist with that request") before scoring, a filtering step which is rarely examined as a measurement decision even though it determines which responses an audit is capable of evaluating. This work examines what the step removes, applying seven bias-evaluation instruments spanning both deployed paradigms, three dictionary-based and four LLM-as-judge, to two intersectional datasets of 360 generated responses each. In both datasets, the filter removed a demographically skewed subset produced entirely by one of the three responder models, which refused North Korean prompts at 2.15 times the rate of American prompts on declarative content and 1.76 times on operational content. We then remove the filter and pass every refusal to all seven instruments. Bias-Lexicon scores refusals as clean, and including them shrinks the nationality disparity it reports. HurtLex appears to register the disparity, but we trace this entirely to a single lexicon entry matching the token "can" in "I can't". The LLM judges either flag most responses or rate refusals as unbiased. For the two judges that discriminate, including refusals lowers the nationality disparity they report, and no instrument identifies the refusal disparity. The failure is therefore a coverage limit upstream of scoring rather than a calibration gap that a better lexicon or judge prompt would be expected to close, which makes the behavioral channel an instrument is sensitive to a question of construct validity rather than one of method selection.

AI.tldr: 偏见审计在评分前通常丢弃拒答（如"I can't assist"）响应，本文考察这一过滤步骤删除了什么。对两个各含360条响应的数据集、七种评估工具的分析表明：过滤删掉的是一组由单一模型产生、人口统计学上偏斜的拒答（对朝鲜提示的拒答率为美国的2.15/1.76倍），且无任何工具能识别这一拒答差异——这是评分上游的覆盖性限制，属于构念效度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对话模型偏见审计普遍在打分前丢弃拒答，但这一测量决策几乎从未被审视，而它实际决定了审计"能评估哪些响应"。作者希望弄清过滤究竟移除了什么，以及去掉过滤后各评估工具如何处理拒答。
AI.method: 用七种偏见评估工具（3种词典法、4种LLM-as-judge），在两个各含360条生成响应的交叉性数据集上，先复现"过滤—评分"流程，量化被删响应；再移除过滤，把所有拒答送入全部七种工具，比较各工具对拒答的判定及其对国家差异度量的影响。
AI.result: 两个数据集中，过滤均移除了由三个响应模型之一独家产生的、人口统计学偏斜的子集；该模型对朝鲜提示的拒答率是美国的2.15倍（陈述性内容）、1.76倍（操作性内容）。无过滤时：Bias-Lexicon将拒答判为"干净"，纳入后反而缩小其报告的国家差异；HurtLex表面有差异，但完全源于"can't"中的"can"匹配了某词典条目；LLM评委或大面积报警或将拒答判为无偏，仅两个有区分力的评委在纳入拒答后国家差异下降；没有任何工具识别出拒答本身的差异。
AI.conclusion: 该失败是评分上游的覆盖性限制，而非词典或评委提示词可弥补的校准缺陷。工具对特定"行为通道"的敏感性应被视为构念效度问题，而不只是方法选择问题。

title: Interactive Proofs as a Unified Framework for Evaluating and Leveraging Verifiable Proof Generation by LLM Agents
summary: Recent advances in LLM-assisted theorem proving and program verification have attracted widespread attention. Beyond determining whether a proposition is true, LLM agents must produce evidence that can be independently checked by humans or formal verification tools. To evaluate the underlying, protocol-agnostic ability of LLM agents to construct verifiable proofs-rather than their proficiency with any particular proof language or verification tool, we introduce Merlin-Bench. Drawing on interactive proof systems from computational complexity theory, we cast an LLM agent as the prover: under a designated protocol, the agent interacts with a formal verifier to substantiate its claimed answer to a problem instance. We develop an automated framework for constructing test cases and use it to create 100 cases across 15 problem families, each formulated within this prover-verifier framework. Experiments with 10 frontier LLMs across multiple agent harnesses show that reliably producing verifiable proofs in accordance with specified protocols remains a substantial challenge. Our case studies further provide actionable insights into improving agents' ability to generate verifier-accepted proofs: tool use is essential for completing practical proof tasks; different forms of guidance, ranging from engineering instructions to problem-specific knowledge, substantially affect success rates on interactive-proof tasks; and proof-solving experience distilled from abstract tasks can transfer to concrete, real-world verification tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Merlin-Bench，用计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统来评测 LLM 智能体"构造可验证证明"的协议无关能力：智能体作为证明者与形式化验证器交互，共 100 个测试用例、15 类问题，10 个前沿 LLM 表现均不理想。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多关注 LLM 在某特定证明语言或验证工具上的熟练度，难以衡量其"能否构造可被独立检查的证据"这一底层通用能力；此外，判定命题真假之外，智能体还需产出可验证的证明。作者希望建立一个与具体语言/工具解耦的评测基准。
AI.method: 借鉴计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统，将 LLM 智能体设定为证明者（prover），在指定协议下与形式化验证器（verifier）交互，为其对问题实例的答案提供证据；并构建自动化测试用例生成框架，据此生成覆盖 15 个问题族的 100 个案例。
AI.result: 在 10 个前沿 LLM 与多种智能体框架（harness）上实验：可靠地产出符合协议且被验证器接受的证明仍是显著挑战。案例研究显示：工具使用对完成实际证明任务不可或缺；从工程指令到问题特定知识的不同形式引导显著影响交互式证明成功率；从抽象任务中提炼的证明经验可迁移到具体真实世界验证任务。
AI.conclusion: Merlin-Bench 提供了协议无关的可验证证明构造评测基准，揭示当前智能体能力瓶颈，并为提升其可验证推理能力给出可行方向（强化工具使用、优化引导设计、利用抽象任务经验迁移）。

title: FlowersBench: A FluidFlower-Inspired Dataset for Benchmarking Carbon Storage Surrogates Across Geological Structures
comment: 40 pages, 22 figures, 11 tables. Dataset available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24380326
summary: Machine learning surrogates are emerging as a computationally efficient tool for uncertainty quantification in geological carbon storage (GCS). Geological structure constitutes a major source of uncertainty; however, existing benchmark simulation datasets predominantly vary petrophysical and operational parameters within a fixed geological setting. Generalisation to unseen geological structures therefore remains largely unexplored. We introduce FlowersBench, a benchmark dataset of 5,000 two-dimensional, reservoir-scale CO$_2$ storage simulations across 244 structural geometries. The geometries are sampled from an in-house structural generator inspired by the FluidFlower experiments and Case B of the 11th Society of Petroleum Engineers Comparative Solution Project (SPE11B). Each simulation is run with Open Porous Media (OPM) Flow over a 50-year injection period and a 500-year post-injection monitoring period. Test geometries are withheld from training to assess generalisation to unseen structural geometries. Two additional subsets support evaluation under structural shift. The first extends the parameter ranges of the structural generator beyond those used for training, and the second introduces an unseen topology of multiple parallel faults. A baseline U-Net surrogate is trained to predict CO$_2$ gas saturation. In representative test cases, the surrogate recovers the main migration pathways, including lateral spreading beneath low-permeability layers and upward flow along fault damage zones, with errors concentrated near the plume boundary. Under both structural shifts, prediction error exceeds that on the held-out geometries, and the increase in relative error is greater for the unseen fault topology. FlowersBench is publicly available and provides a common basis for evaluating GCS surrogates across geological structures.

AI.tldr: FlowersBench是一个包含5000个二维CO2封存模拟、覆盖244种地质构造几何的基准数据集，用于评测机器学习代理模型对未见地质构造的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 地质构造是CO2地质封存（GCS）不确定性量化的重要来源，但现有基准数据集大多只在固定地质背景下变化岩石物理与运行参数，代理模型向未见地质构造的泛化能力基本未被探索。
AI.method: 基于受FluidFlower实验和SPE11B启发的自研构造生成器采样244种几何，用OPM Flow开展5000个二维油藏尺度模拟（50年注入+500年注入后监测）；测试几何不参与训练，并设两个结构性偏移子集（扩展参数范围；引入多条平行断层的未见拓扑）。基线U-Net代理模型预测CO2气体饱和度。
AI.result: 代理模型在代表性测试案例中能复现主要运移路径（低渗层下侧向扩展、沿断层破碎带向上流动），误差集中在羽流边界；两种结构性偏移下误差均高于留出几何，且未见断层拓扑的相对误差增幅更大。
AI.conclusion: FlowersBench公开可用，为跨地质构造评测GCS代理模型提供统一基准，并揭示了结构偏移下的泛化挑战。

title: Synchronizing Cameras via 3D Object Relationships
summary: In this paper, we synchronize multiple videos of the same dynamic event through object relationships. Driven by dynamic reconstruction and novel view synthesis, many recent synchronization methods rely on pixel-level evidence, such as point correspondences across views or the photometric losses of a reconstructed scene. In dynamic scenes, however, fast motion and occlusions make the moving regions that carry much of the timing information hard to match across views. We thus propose to bring back the traditional wisdom that objects are reliable cues for global reasoning about cameras. Measured in 3D, the relationships between objects, such as the distance between two people, are stable across all views up to scale; they can serve as cues for alignment. To compare these relationships across cameras, we only need the identity of each object in every view, as the cues are relational. We obtain these identities by giving a vision-language model a few frames of every camera and prompting it to identify the objects in the scene. We then segment and track each identified object through every video with an open-vocabulary segmentor. To obtain the 3D locations of objects, we use a pretrained depth estimator. Where depth or segmentation fails, we complement these 3D cues with 2D motion from point tracks. Finally, we synchronize the cameras by finding the temporal offsets at which the cues of different cameras agree best, first for each camera pair and then for all cameras jointly with robust optimization. We evaluate our method on four standard benchmarks, outperforming the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于物体关系（而非像素级证据）的多视频时间同步方法，利用VLM识别物体、开放词汇分割跟踪、深度估计获得3D关系，结合2D点轨迹补充，通过成对及联合鲁棒优化求解相机时间偏移，在四个基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有同步方法依赖像素级证据（跨视图点对应或重建场景的光度损失），但动态场景中快速运动与遮挡使承载时序信息的运动区域难以跨视图匹配，导致同步困难。
AI.method: 回归"物体是相机全局推理可靠线索"的传统思路：3D度量下物体间关系（如两人距离）在各视图间尺度一致，可作为对齐线索；只需各视图中物体身份即可比较，故用VLM对每相机少量帧识别物体，再用开放词汇分割器分割跟踪；用预训练深度估计器获取3D位置，深度或分割失败处用2D点轨迹运动补充；通过寻找使不同相机线索最一致的时间偏移，先逐对后联合鲁棒优化完成同步。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上评估，性能超越当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 物体级关系线索可有效替代像素级证据实现动态多视频的时间同步，且仅需物体身份信息，方法在多个基准上验证有效。

title: Rethinking Sequential Locate-Then-Edit: Optimality and Stability
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages of main text, 6 figures, and 2 tables. The full manuscript contains 41 pages, including references and supplementary material. This work concerns sequential knowledge editing within the locate-then-edit framework
summary: The Locate-Then-Edit framework enables efficient knowledge updates in large language models without requiring full retraining. Recent research has increasingly focused on sequential editing, where knowledge arrives continuously and the model is updated incrementally. However, existing sequential methods commonly suffer from catastrophic forgetting and model collapse after only a few hundred edits. In contrast, batch editing - which jointly optimizes all edits and yields the optimal solution under a specified editing objective - can support tens of thousands of edits with high edit efficacy while preserving the model's general capabilities, resulting in a substantial performance gap between the two editing paradigms. In this paper, we demonstrate that this gap can be closed via a batch-equivalent sequential editing approach. Moreover, we investigate the underlying mechanism of model degradation in existing sequential methods by analyzing the convergence behavior of weight perturbations as edits accumulate. Our analysis reveals that current methods typically exhibit linear or logarithmic growth in perturbation, whereas the proposed batch-equivalent method achieves time-invariant growth, thereby theoretically guaranteeing long-term stability and preserving the integrity of pretrained knowledge throughout massive-scale sequential editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"批等价"顺序编辑方法，弥合顺序编辑与批量编辑的巨大性能差距，并通过权重扰动收敛分析揭示现有方法退化的机制。
AI.motivation: 定位-编辑（Locate-Then-Edit）框架下，顺序编辑（知识持续到来、增量更新）存在灾难性遗忘与模型崩溃，仅数百次编辑即失效；而批量编辑联合优化可支持数万次编辑并保持通用能力，两大范式差距显著。本文旨在弥合该差距并解释退化机理。
AI.method: 提出批等价（batch-equivalent）顺序编辑方法；同时从权重扰动随编辑累积的收敛行为入手，分析现有顺序方法导致模型退化的内在机制。
AI.result: 现有顺序方法的扰动呈线性或对数增长，而所提批等价方法实现时间不变（time-invariant）的扰动增长；理论上保证长期稳定性，并在大规模顺序编辑中保持预训练知识的完整性。
AI.conclusion: 通过批等价设计可弥合顺序编辑与批量编辑的性能鸿沟，扰动增长的时间不变性为长期稳定的知识编辑提供了理论依据。

title: Faster and Better Query (FBQ): Learning Future-Position Probes from the First Generated Token
summary: When a large language model (LLM) evicts prompt keys and values at the end of prefill, it must decide what to keep before it sees the queries from subsequent decoding steps. Generating a draft continuation can approximate those queries at the cost of extra autoregressive steps. Can we use the embedding of the first output token, already available from the final prefill logits, to construct low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries? We start with FTQ-8, which places eight copies of the first token ID at consecutive future positions and reads their attention to the prompt in one causal forward pass. Each copy sees a different prefix, but a generic opening such as the offers a poor literal guess for seven successive tokens. Faster and Better Query (FBQ) preserves the first embedding and learns an additive offset at each of the seven remaining positions. We train these offsets to predict the average prompt attention of a full-cache continuation. On LongBench, FBQ performs comparably to eight-step Lookahead Q-Cache at the same cache budget, using a single forward pass to compute all probe queries.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FBQ（Faster and Better Query）：利用预填充阶段最后一个logits中已可得的首token嵌入，学习七个位置加性偏移以构造低成本"伪查询"，近似未来解码查询，从而在单次前向中完成KV缓存淘汰，性能与8步Lookahead Q-Cache相当。
AI.motivation: LLM在prefill结束时就要淘汰prompt的key/value，此时尚看不到后续解码步的查询，选错保留内容会损害生成质量。生成草稿续写可近似这些查询，但需额外多次自回归步骤，代价高。作者希望找到一种近乎零成本的方式来获得未来查询的近似。
AI.method: 先做基线FTQ-8：把首token ID复制8份放到连续未来位置，在一次因果前向中读取它们对prompt的注意力；但每个副本只看不同前缀，"the"这类通用开头对后续7个token的字面猜测很差。FBQ在此基础上保留首token的真实嵌入，在其余7个位置学习可训练的加性偏移，以全缓存续写的平均prompt注意力为监督目标训练这些偏移。
AI.result: 在LongBench上，相同缓存预算下FBQ与8步Lookahead Q-Cache性能相当，但所有探测查询只需一次前向即可算出。
AI.conclusion: 已存在的首token嵌入加上轻量可学习偏移，足以替代昂贵的多步草稿续写来近似解码期查询，为prefill阶段的KV缓存淘汰提供高效方案。

title: Understanding Failure Patterns in LLM-Based Mathematical Optimization Modeling
summary: Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeling difficult to automate. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for generating optimization models from natural language, but their reliability in end-to-end settings remains limited, often producing non-executable, infeasible, or feasible but incorrect solutions. In this work, we study failure modes in LLM-based optimization modeling by decomposing the process into three components: mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge, and constructing datasets that target each aspect. Using these datasets, we analyze how different components relate to errors and find that they are associated with different types of failure, although these relationships are not always strong or consistent. Furthermore, while combining these components improves execution reliability, feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode, suggesting a remaining gap between executability and correctness. These findings highlight limitations of current dataset designs and suggest the importance of data that better capture constraint completeness and formulation accuracy to enhance reliability.

AI.tldr: 该文将LLM优化建模过程分解为数学推理、求解器使用和领域知识三部分，构建针对性数据集分析失败模式，发现三者与不同失败类型相关但关系不强，且组合后仍以"可行但错误"为主要失败模式。
AI.motivation: 工业优化约束复杂，建模难以自动化。LLM虽被用于从自然语言生成优化模型，但端到端可靠性有限，常产生不可执行、不可行或可行但错误的解。作者希望系统性地理解LLM优化建模的失败模式及其成因。
AI.method: 将建模过程分解为数学推理、求解器使用、领域知识三个组件，分别构建针对性数据集，用这些数据集分析各组件与错误类型的关联，并评估组件组合对执行可靠性的影响。
AI.result: 不同组件关联不同类型的失败，但这些关系并不总是强或一致；组合各组件能提升执行可靠性，但"可行但错误"的解仍是主导失败模式，说明可执行性与正确性之间仍存在差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有数据集设计存在局限，需构建更能捕捉约束完整性与建模准确性的数据，以提升LLM优化建模的可靠性。

title: Measuring and Predicting Image-Token Repair Boundaries in Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Degraded images make vision-language models answer wrongly. Using synthetic paired blur, noise, and low light, we trace which clean image states can still repair those answers from the vision encoder through the language model. In four encoder models, 12 to 23 ranked tokens recover half of the full-patch effect, whereas random orders require four to fifteen times as many; encoder-free Gemma needs 22.2 versus 53.1. Full-block repair expires at a model-specific language-model crossing. The matched reverse-direction intervention is algebraically identical to text-token restoration, so its gap from image restoration measures a redundancy band rather than an independent predictor. A clean-image gray-ablation crossing independently predicts held-out repair with 1.53-layer error, against 3.65 for shared depth. Gemma MMBench has the only large attention-to-repair point gap; Gemma GQA does not. Restormer provides a non-oracle consistency check on two models.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究退化图像导致视觉语言模型答错的问题，通过追迹从视觉编码器到语言模型的修复路径，识别可修复答案的关键图像状态。
AI.motivation: 退化图像（模糊、噪声、低光）会使视觉语言模型给出错误答案。作者希望弄清哪些"干净图像状态"能够修复这些错误答案，以及这种修复能力在模型内部的分布规律。
AI.method: 使用合成的成对退化（模糊、噪声、低光）图像，从视觉编码器到语言模型逐层追迹修复效果。比较排序token与随机顺序的效率，测试完整块修复的失效点，分析反向干预与文本token恢复的代数等价性，并用干净图像灰度消融交叉点预测held-out修复。
AI.result: 在四种编码器模型中，12–23个排序token即可恢复一半的全patch效果，而随机顺序需4–15倍；无编码器的Gemma需22.2对53.1。完整块修复在模型特定的语言模型交叉点失效。反向干预等价于文本token恢复，其与图像修复的差距衡量的是冗余带而非独立预测因子。灰度消融交叉点以1.53层误差预测修复（共享深度为3.65）。Gemma MMBench是唯一存在大注意力-修复点差距的模型，Gemma GQA则没有。Restormer在两个模型上提供非oracle一致性检验。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息修复错误答案高度集中且可预测，存在模型特定的修复失效点，且反向干预测得的是冗余带而非独立信号；研究揭示了视觉语言模型内部修复机制的结构规律。

title: Sports Agent: A Self-Evolving System for Conversational Data Analytics
summary:
Conversational sports analytics requires accurate, evidence-based responses with low latency. Changes in query distributions, data resources, and model behavior can degrade static agent configurations, motivating controlled evolution guided by runtime evidence.
  We present Sports Agent, a self-evolving framework integrating an Agentic SQL Model for structured-data reasoning, a harness for planning and tool orchestration, and a unified Feedback Engine connecting online execution with offline evolution. The engine assesses responses and execution trajectories, verifies factual claims, diagnoses failures, and generates evolution signals. Model evolution combines SQL-to-Question Scaling for coverage expansion with Graph-Guided Scaling for error-targeted synthesis. Generated questions undergo trajectory distillation and quality filtering for iterative supervised fine-tuning, followed by a separate Post-RL stage. Harness evolution translates recurrent failures into bounded prompt and skill updates, validated through independent audits, execution replay, and regression testing. Performance-tolerance checks guard against unacceptable degradation during simplification.
  The resulting Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-based model outperforms Qwen3.8-Max on sports question answering and analysis while achieving approximately three times the inference efficiency. Across 30 harness-evolution rounds, the aggregate performance score improves by 10.8 points. In a live sports analytics product, the evolved system improves factual correctness by 10.5 points and average response length, a proxy for answer richness, by 158.1%, while reducing average latency by 41.3% relative to the baseline.

AI.tldr: Sports Agent 是一个自我进化框架，通过统一反馈引擎连接在线执行与离线进化，联合演化模型与 harness，在体育问答与分析任务上超越 Qwen3.8-Max 且推理效率约 3 倍。
AI.motivation: 对话式体育分析需要准确、有证据支撑且低延迟的响应；而查询分布、数据资源和模型行为的变化会使静态 agent 配置逐渐退化，因此需要由运行时证据引导的可控演化。
AI.method: 框架由三部分组成：Agentic SQL Model（结构化数据推理）、负�责规划与工具编排的 harness、以及连接在线执行与离线进化的统一 Feedback Engine。引擎评估回答与执行轨迹、核验事实声明、诊断失败并生成进化信号。模型进化结合 SQL-to-Question Scaling（扩展覆盖）与 Graph-Guided Scaling（针对性合成错误样本），经轨迹蒸馏与质量过滤做迭代 SFT，并另设 Post-RL 阶段。Harness 进化将重复失败转化为有界的 prompt 与技能更新，通过独立审计、执行重放和回归测试验证，并用性能容忍检查防止简化过程中的退化。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的模型在体育问答与分析上超过 Qwen3.8-Max，推理效率约为其 3 倍；30 轮 harness 进化使综合性能分数提升 10.8 分；在真实体育分析产品中，事实正确率提升 10.5 分，平均响应长度（答案丰富度代理指标）提升 158.1%，平均延迟相对基线降低 41.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以运行时证据驱动的模型+harness 协同自我进化，可在提升准确性与答案丰富度的同时降低延迟，为体育分析类对话系统提供可落地的持续优化路径。

title: EVA: Evidence-seeking Visual Agent for Hallucination-Resistant Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often arise from visual assumptions that go unchecked. Self-reflection, multi-agent debate, and counterfactual verification can reinforce erroneous conclusions when they rely on the same unverified visual assumptions. External visual tools can provide verifiable evidence, but models may select the wrong tools, supply incorrect parameters, or ignore or contradict the evidence they obtain. In this work, we propose EVA, an Evidence-seeking Visual Agent that reframes multimodal reasoning as an explicit process of evidence acquisition and verification. At the core of EVA is a unified evidence-grounded execution pipeline designed to address the above challenges through two tightly coupled mechanisms. First, we introduce Iterative Tool Replanning, which dynamically refines tool selection and parameters based on intermediate observations, improving the reliability of tool usage. Second, we develop Evidence Consistency Verification, an answer validation mechanism that improves alignment between the final prediction and the collected evidence, mitigating evidence--reasoning inconsistencies. In addition, to balance robustness and efficiency, EVA incorporates Selective Evidence Routing, an adaptive fast--slow reasoning strategy that determines when external evidence is necessary. Visually straightforward queries are handled via direct reasoning, while complex or high-risk cases trigger tool-based evidence acquisition. By jointly addressing how to reliably acquire evidence and how to use it consistently, EVA transforms multimodal reasoning from passive answer validation into explicit evidence-backed decision making. Experimental results demonstrate that EVA achieves significantly improved reasoning reliability over direct VLM inference and multi-agent methods, while maintaining efficiency through selective tool invocation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EVA，一个"取证式视觉智能体"，将多模态推理重构为显式的证据获取与验证过程，通过迭代工具重规划、证据一致性验证和选择性证据路由，减少 MLLM 幻觉并兼顾效率。
AI.motivation: MLLM 幻觉常源于未经检验的视觉假设；自我反思、多智能体辩论、反事实验证若共享同一错误假设反而会强化错误。外部视觉工具可提供可验证证据，但模型可能选错工具、给错参数，或忽略/违背已获取的证据。
AI.method: 三大机制：(1) Iterative Tool Replanning——依据中间观测动态修正工具选择与参数，提高工具使用可靠性；(2) Evidence Consistency Verification——答案校验机制，使最终预测与所收集证据对齐，缓解证据-推理解耦；(3) Selective Evidence Routing——自适应快慢推理策略，简单查询直接作答，复杂或高风险情形触发工具取证。
AI.result: 实验表明 EVA 在推理可靠性上显著优于直接 VLM 推理与多智能体方法，并通过选择性调用工具保持效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时解决"如何可靠获取证据"与"如何一致地使用证据"，EVA 将多模态推理从被动答案验证转变为显式的证据支撑决策，为缓解 MLLM 幻觉提供了有效且高效的范式。

title: The Marauder's Map: Bézier Manifolds Reveal Hidden Surfaces for Model Merging and Ensembling
summary: Neural circuits are famously more robust than deep networks. This is often explained through degeneracy, where structurally distinct configurations support the same function. However, real biological systems exhibit a more flexible form of degeneracy in which specialized circuits continually adapt towards new competencies through localized changes while preserving existing function. Deep learning studies degeneracy through mode connectivity, which connects same-task networks by low-loss curves, sheets, or volumes. However, the field lacks a counterpart to flexible degeneracy, which demands more than ordinary mode connectivity. Defining such an analogue requires asking whether many independently initialized models trained on distinct tasks can be connected by a high-dimensional region of multi-task solutions. We introduce $\textit{Nimbus}$, which learns a high-dimensional Bézier manifold connecting $N$ specialists, going beyond the one-dimensional paths and two-dimensional sheets of mode connectivity work. A naive parameterization would scale combinatorially with $N$, but $\textit{Nimbus}$ requires learning corrections of only 3 interaction orders, showing that the connecting manifold has surprisingly low complexity yet supports multi-task competencies. The resulting manifold forms a navigable "Marauder's Map" that connects specialist models through a shared geometry of competent solutions. Trained across vision and language domains, $\textit{Nimbus}$ produces manifolds that are functionally and locally weight-flat: ensembles sampled from them degrade more gracefully than baselines under input and weight perturbations, with the largest gains in NLL loss and calibration error. $\textit{Nimbus}$ supplies a deep learning interpretation of flexible degeneracy, recasting model connectivity from a low-dimensional path between distant solutions into a high-dimensional volume of nearby ones.

AI.tldr: 提出Nimbus，学习连接N个专家模型的高维Bézier流形，仅需3阶交互修正即可实现多任务连通，对应生物神经系统的"灵活退化性"。
AI.motivation: 神经电路比深度网络更鲁棒，常以退化性（degeneracy）解释：结构不同的构型支持同一功能。生物系统还有一种更灵活的形式——专门化电路通过局部改变持续适应新能力且保留旧功能。深度学习的模式连通性（低损失路径/平面/体积）尚缺对应物，需回答：独立初始化、不同任务的多个模型能否由高维多任务解区域连通。
AI.method: Nimbus学习一个连接N个专家的高维Bézier流形，超越一维路径和二维平面。朴素参数化随N组合爆炸，但Nimbus仅学习3个交互阶的修正，说明流形复杂度低却支持多任务能力。形成可导航的"Marauder's Map"共享几何。
AI.result: 在视觉和语言领域训练，Nimbus生成的流形在功能和局部权重上平坦：从流形采样的集成在输入与权重扰动下退化更平缓，NLL损失与校准误差增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Nimbus给出灵活退化性的深度学习解释，将模型连通性从远端解之间的低维路径重构为邻近解的高维体积。

title: BreathSplat: Grounding One Smooth Motion in the Breathing Phase for 4D Cone-Beam CT
summary: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D-CBCT) images the anatomy of a breathing patient, but sees each breathing phase from only a few angles. Breathing, however, is a smooth motion that repeats; it has a phase. Existing methods exploit this either by reconstructing the anatomy as a function of the breathing phase, often through bins, or by estimating smooth dynamic motions in time. Yet none of these grounds one smooth motion in the phase. We thus propose to share projections across breathing phases with splines. Specifically, we represent the 4D volume with dynamic Gaussians whose motion uses B-splines in space and time. We ground the motion state in the respiratory phase, which we read from well-studied conventional surrogates. Projections at the same phase in different breathing cycles then constrain the same anatomy and motion. On simulated lung scans, our method, BreathSplat, outperforms recent dynamic methods in reconstruction and motion accuracy, including those given the ground-truth phase. We further show qualitatively, on two real patient scans, that our method provides clearer reconstructions than the state of the art.

AI.tldr: BreathSplat 用相位驱动的 B 样条动态高斯表示 4D 体积，让不同呼吸周期中同相位的投影共同约束同一解剖与运动，在仿真肺部扫描上重建与运动精度超过现有动态方法（含给定真值相位的方法），并在两例真实患者数据上定性优于 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 4D-CBCT 每个呼吸相位仅有少量角度投影，但呼吸是平滑且周期重复的、具有相位；现有方法或按相位分箱重建解剖、或估计时间上的平滑动态运动，都没有把"一条平滑运动"锚定到呼吸相位上。
AI.method: 用动态高斯表示 4D 体积，其运动在空间与时间上用 B 样条建模；将运动状态锚定在从成熟常规呼吸替代信号中读取的呼吸相位上，从而跨呼吸周期共享同相位投影，使同一相位在不同周期的投影约束同一解剖与运动。
AI.result: 在仿真肺部扫描上，重建精度与运动精度均优于近期动态方法，包括被给定真实相位的方法；在两例真实患者扫描上定性显示重建比 SOTA 更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 将平滑运动显式锚定于呼吸相位、并结合 B 样条动态高斯表示，是提升 4D-CBCT 少角度重建的有效思路，真实数据上亦具潜力。

title: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
summary: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.

AI.tldr: NORMCRAFT 将"规范推断"与"回应生成"解耦：用一个多视角监督训练出的规范生成器产出共享社会规范，再引导冻结的回应模型，在 SafeWorld 等基准上优于 prompting 与 SFT 基线。
AI.motivation: 文化对齐要求模型从场景与语境中推断隐含的社会规范，但已有方法多为直接微调单个模型或外挂文化知识，而"独立于下游回应生成来学习规范推断"这一路线研究不足。
AI.method: 提出模块化框架 NORMCRAFT，把规范推断与回应生成拆开。采用规范为中心的多视角监督（前瞻、遵守、违反三类场景），在不使用下游回应标签的情况下训练一个 LLM 作为规范生成器；生成的规范再指导另一个冻结的 LLM（回应器）作答。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.5-4B 为回应器时，NORMCRAFT 在五项下游指标中的四项优于 prompting 与 SFT 基线；在 SafeWorld 上 Coverage 与 Faithfulness 分别比回应器 SFT 高 18.0 和 14.1 个百分点。规范本身的直接评测也优于基座与 few-shot 生成器。同一生成器在五个模型家族、0.8B–27B 共十四个冻结 LLM 上均提升文化对齐，且对小模型增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 显式的规范推断可以作为一个可复用、模型无关的中间模块，替代指令微调，并具备跨模型规模与家族的迁移性；小模型收益最大，说明该解耦设计对能力受限模型尤为有价值。

title: P-FedSkill: A Personalized Federated Skill Learning Framework under Task Heterogeneity
summary: Skill learning has become an important way to improve agent performance. However, agent trajectories often contain sensitive information and cannot be shared across clients, hindering collaborative skill learning. To tackle this issue, federated skill learning (FSL) has emerged as a solution by distilling trajectories into compact skill representations and uploading them to a central server for sharing. However, existing FSL methods typically share skills based on skill similarity without considering their contributions to heterogeneous tasks across clients, thereby degrading agent performance. To address this challenge, we propose P-FedSkill, a personalized FSL framework that comprises three key components: local skill extraction (LSE), personalized skill selection (PSS), and task-aware skill routing (TASR). Specifically, LSE first extracts skill patches (i.e., task applicability conditions and execution strategies) and task execution outcomes from trajectories. PSS then uses these outcomes to evaluate each skill patch's performance on client tasks and incorporates its task applicability condition to construct a personalized skill set for each client. Finally, TASR adaptively selects a task-relevant subset of skill patches based on their applicability conditions to guide agent execution. We further provide a theoretical guarantee for personalized skill selection in P-FedSkill, and extensive experiments also demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: P-FedSkill：个性化联邦技能学习框架，通过提取技能补丁并用任务结果评估其贡献，为每个客户端构建个性化技能集并做任务感知路由，附理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 智能体轨迹含敏感信息难以跨客户端共享，阻碍协作技能学习；联邦技能学习将轨迹蒸馏为紧凑技能表示上传共享，但现有方法仅按技能相似度共享，忽视技能对客户端异构任务的实际贡献，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出P-FedSkill框架，含三部分：局部技能提取（LSE）从轨迹中提取技能补丁（任务适用条件+执行策略）及任务执行结果；个性化技能选择（PSS）用执行结果评估每个技能补丁在客户端任务上的表现，并结合适用条件构建个性化技能集；任务感知技能路由（TASR）依据适用条件自适应选取任务相关的技能补丁子集指导执行。并给出个性化技能选择的理论保证。
AI.result: 大量实验证明P-FedSkill有效；同时提供个性化技能选择的理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 通过以任务贡献而非单纯技能相似度驱动的个性化技能选择与路由，P-FedSkill缓解了异构任务下的性能退化，是个性化联邦技能学习的可行方案。

title: Discovering Explicit Magnetic Core-Loss Equations via Symbolic Sparse Identification
summary: Compact core loss equations are essential tools in magnetic component design, but existing approaches trade accuracy against interpretability. Empirical models such as the Steinmetz Equation (SE) yield compact expressions of limited accuracy, while machine learning methods achieve high accuracy as black-box predictors. This paper bridges the gap with a Symbolic Sparse Identification (SSI) framework, which casts core loss modeling as a data-driven symbolic regression problem and recovers unknown equations directly from measured data, without presuming a functional form. First, a comprehensively expanded library of symbolic candidate terms far richer than the SE is constructed. Second, the governing terms are isolated from this library by sparse regression. Third, the coefficients of the retained terms are refined with an AdamW optimizer to maximize accuracy and form an analytical equation. Experiments on Fair-Rite 78, 79, and 95 yield test mean absolute percentage errors of 1.89%, 1.01%, and 1.56%, respectively, with only 10, 10, and 7 active terms. Comparisons with empirical, numerical, and symbolic models quantify the resulting balance of accuracy and compactness. SSI thus provides an explicit and physically guided approach for high-frequency magnetic characterization and design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出符号稀疏识别（SSI）框架，将磁芯损耗建模视为数据驱动的符号回归问题，直接从实测数据恢复显式解析方程，在Fair-Rite 78/79/95材料上分别取得1.89%、1.01%、1.56%的测试MAPE，仅用10、10、7个有效项。
AI.motivation: 磁芯损耗建模中，经验模型（如Steinmetz方程）表达式紧凑但精度有限，机器学习方法精度高却是黑箱、缺乏可解释性。本文旨在弥合精度与可解释性之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: SSI框架分三步：1）构建远丰富于Steinmetz方程的符号候选项库；2）通过稀疏回归从库中筛选主导项；3）用AdamW优化器精修保留项的系数，得到解析方程。整个过程不预设函数形式。
AI.result: 在Fair-Rite 78、79、95上的测试MAPE分别为1.89%、1.01%、1.56%，仅含10、10、7个有效项；与经验模型、数值模型及符号模型的对比量化了其在精度与紧凑性间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SSI为高频磁性表征与设计提供了一种显式、物理引导的方法，兼顾高精度与可解释的紧凑方程。

title: ArtKit: Motion-Driven Re-Segmentation and Link Re-Generation for Articulated Objects from RGB-D Video
summary: An RGB-D camera that films an object being moved, often from one viewpoint, sees one side of it and how its parts move. We present ArtKit, which takes such a video as input to create an articulated model with complete parts, a kinematic tree, and typed joints. Our central idea is generating the hidden geometry and verifying it against what the camera sees. A generative part prior proposes complete, part-decomposed geometry based on the first frame. Point tracks, grouped into rigid trajectories, split and merge the generated parts into links. We then fit revolute and prismatic joints, with a visibility-aware energy ensuring that the articulated model explains the depth observed across the video. A rule checks against the video to choose between synchronous group fits and per-frame chain fits, so that one pipeline serves a diverse range of articulated objects, such as household items and robotic hands. Finally, we regenerate each link of the chosen fit as one part and keep it wherever it agrees better with the observations. We evaluate on Articulate-100 and on HArt, a new benchmark of 60 PartNet-Mobility objects and 8 robotic hands and grippers rendered as RGB-D videos with ground-truth parts and joints. ArtKit reduces the axis and part motion errors of the strongest baseline by more than half on the objects, as well as the axis error on the hands. ArtKit also runs on real recordings and generated videos.

AI.tldr: ArtKit 用单视角 RGB-D 视频重建带完整部件、运动学树和关节类型的铰接模型，核心是先由生成式部件先验补全隐藏几何，再用视频观测验证并拟合运动链。
AI.motivation: 现有单视角 RGB-D 拍摄只能看到物体一侧及其部分运动，无法得到完整部件几何与关节结构，需要从可见证据推断隐藏几何与运动学。
AI.method: 1) 生成式部件先验基于首帧生成完整、部件分解的几何；2) 利用点轨迹聚类为刚性轨迹，对生成部件进行拆分与合并得到 links；3) 拟合旋转/移动关节，并以可见性感知能量确保模型能解释整段视频深度；4) 设计规则在“同步组拟合”与“逐帧链拟合”间选择，以适配家用物体与机器人手等多样对象；5) 对选中拟合中的每个 link 重新生成并择优保留。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 及新基准 HArt（60 个 PartNet-Mobility 物体和 8 个机械手/夹爪的真值 RGB-D 视频）上，物体上的关节轴与部件运动误差比最强基线降低一半以上，机械手上的轴误差也显著下降；并可运行于真实录制与生成视频。
AI.conclusion: 结合生成式先验与视频一致性验证，可有效从单视角 RGB-D 视频恢复完整铰接模型，且在多样物体类别与真实场景中均具泛化性。

title: Tells of a Lying Machine: Analyzing LLM-Generated Strategic Dialogue in Chinese Werewolf
comment: 23 pages. Xian Cui and Gan Yang contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: Social-deduction games give models opposing objectives, but they also give roles different information and speaking obligations. We analyze 5,404 public utterances from 150 Chinese Werewolf games played by 12 models, comparing ordinary wolves with ordinary villagers so that special roles are excluded. Private knowledge and goals still differ, and no utterance is verified as true or false. After model and length adjustment, wolf utterances score higher on both certainty and uncertainty (coefficients +0.074 and +0.072). Emotional intensification has the largest rank-biserial effect (r = .145), but it depends on a single degree marker and correlates weakly with human-rated affect. Three annotators' ratings of 392 utterances show higher wolf scores on four behavioral dimensions, and five LLM judges reach 60.8%-70.2% accuracy on a shared evaluation set. In a generation probe that prompts six models with a wolf identity but a villager speaking goal under fixed public context, certainty (+0.164) and emotional intensification (+0.095) increase. These findings describe role-associated language rather than verified lying, and they argue for explicit comparison groups and lexicon sensitivity checks in game-based deception evaluation. Data and code are available at https://github.com/justinchoi929/Tells-of-a-Lying-Machine

AI.tldr: 分析150局中文狼人杀、12个模型的5404条发言，对比普通狼人与普通村民，发现狼人发言在确定性与不确定性表达上均更强，情感强化效应最大但依赖单一程度标记；生成探针复现该倾向。结论强调这属于角色关联语言而非已验证说谎。
AI.motivation: 社交推理游戏给模型设定对立目标，同时赋予不同角色不同信息与发言义务，因此"欺骗性语言"与"角色语言"难以区分。作者希望通过控制普通狼人 vs 普通村民这一清晰对比组，排除特殊角色干扰，检验模型发言中是否存在可归因于角色（而非谎言）的语言特征。
AI.method: 收集150局中文狼人杀、12个模型的5404条公开发言；仅比较普通狼人与普通村民（排除特殊角色）；对模型与发言长度做调整后回归分析确定性与不确定性；计算情感强化的rank-biserial效应；3名标注者对392条发言在4个行为维度打分；5个LLM评判者在共享评测集上判断；并用6个模型做"狼人身份+村民发言目标+固定公共上下文"的生成探针。
AI.result: 调整后狼人发言确定性(+0.074)与不确定性(+0.072)均更高；情感强化rank-biserial效应最大(r=.145)，但依赖单一程度副词标记，与人类感知情感相关性弱；人类标注显示狼人在4个维度得分更高；5个LLM评判者准确率60.8%–70.2%；生成探针中确定性(+0.164)、情感强化(+0.095)上升。
AI.conclusion: 所观察到的差异是角色关联的语言模式，而非经核实的说谎行为；基于游戏评测欺骗时应设置明确的对照组，并对词典/标记做敏感性检验。

title: PowerFix: Physics-Guided Iterative Repair for LLM-Assisted Power Converter Design
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Can Wang and Shi Qiu contributed equally
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for automated engineering design. However, repairing power-converter designs that fail engineering validation remains challenging: the system must identify physical causes, locate responsible design variables, and resolve violations without compromising other constraints. We introduce PowerFix, a physics-guided iterative repair framework that converts validation failures into structured diagnoses and executable patches while preserving topology and design requirements. PowerDiagGraph links failed checks to possible physical causes and constrains repair routes. An LLM prioritizes these routes, while a deterministic compiler translates selected repairs into authorized field-level edits. Candidates are validated on isolated design copies and committed only after all required engineering checks pass; failed validation can guide replanning. On our constructed 96-task flyback repair benchmark, comprising injected single faults, coupled faults, and held-out natural failures from our design generator, PowerFix achieves 78.7% verified repair success rate (VRSR), compared with 30.1% for the strongest of three LLM baselines. Three additional replanning rounds increase VRSR to 88.4%. These offline results provide pilot-stage evidence within a simulation-based design workflow, with hardware prototype validation and transfer to a second converter topology as the next steps toward deployment.

AI.tldr: PowerFix：物理引导的LLM迭代修复框架，将电源变换器验证失败转为结构化诊断与可执行补丁，在96任务反激基准上达78.7%验证修复成功率（基线30.1%），三轮重规划后升至88.4%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体用于自动化工程设计时，修复未通过验证的电源变换器设计仍很困难：需识别物理成因、定位责任设计变量，并在不破坏其他约束的前提下解决违规。
AI.method: 构建PowerDiagGraph，将失败的检查关联到可能物理成因并约束修复路径；LLM对修复路径排序；确定性编译器把选定修复翻译为经授权的字段级编辑；候选在隔离设计副本上验证，全部工程检查通过后才提交，失败可引导重规划；保持拓扑与设计需求不变。
AI.result: 在自建96任务反激变换器修复基准（单故障注入、耦合故障、设计生成器的留出自然故障）上，VRSR为78.7%，最强LLM基线为30.1%；增加三轮重规划后提升至88.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果为基于仿真的设计流程内的试点阶段证据，尚需硬件样机验证及向第二种变换器拓扑的迁移，方可走向部署。

title: Federated Learning with Uncertainty Quantification on Pseudo Label Exchange
summary: In this work, we investigate federated stochastic operator learning for stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs), with an emphasis on heterogeneous client data distributions and uncertainty quantification. Federated learning enables clients to collaboratively train models without exchanging their original solution data, but conventional federated averaging can suffer significant performance degradation when client distributions differ, particularly when their input function supports are disjoint. To address these challenges, we propose the Federated Stochastic Operator Network (FedSON), a two-phase framework that combines auxiliary data construction with stochastic operator learning. In the first phase, locally trained deterministic neural operators and their corresponding input functions are exchanged to generate pseudolabeled auxiliary data, enabling the federated model to learn across heterogeneous input distributions without sharing original solution trajectories. In the second phase, a stochastic operator network is trained on top of the frozen deterministic operator to characterize stochastic fluctuations and quantify uncertainty in the predicted solutions. Numerical experiments involving the heat equation, viscous Burgers' equation, and two-dimensional advection-diffusion equation demonstrate the FedSON substantially improves deterministic prediction accuracy under heterogeneous client distributions while producing uncertainty estimates comparable to those obtained through centralized training.

AI.tldr: 提出FedSON两阶段框架，解决异构客户端数据分布下的联邦随机算子学习与不确定性量化问题。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可让客户端在不共享原始解数据的前提下协作训练SPDE模型，但传统联邦平均在客户端分布差异大（尤其输入函数支撑集不相交）时性能显著下降，且需兼顾不确定性量化。
AI.method: FedSON分两阶段：第一阶段交换本地训练的确定性神经算子及其输入函数，生成伪标签辅助数据，使联邦模型能跨异构输入分布学习而不共享原始解轨迹；第二阶段在冻结的确定性算子上训练随机算子网络，刻画随机波动并量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在热方程、粘性Burgers方程和二维对流扩散方程上的数值实验表明，FedSON在异构客户端分布下显著提升确定性预测精度，且不确定性估计与集中式训练相当。
AI.conclusion: FedSON通过"辅助数据构造+随机算子学习"的两阶段设计，有效缓解异构分布导致的联邦性能退化，并实现接近集中式训练的不确定性量化。

title: A Semantics-First Approach to Multimodal Video Captioning with Frozen Encoders and Stabilized Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Preprint correcting minor typographical errors and clarifying baseline evaluation conditions from the SPIE Defense + Security 2026 proceedings
summary: We propose the Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer), a highly efficient architecture built upon a 2.7B parameter LLM featuring a fixed-length $K=16$ semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training (ASCST) with Entropy Regularization. Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) often rely on global audio representations to compensate for inefficient, frame-based visual encoders. While our Phase 1 prompted evaluations demonstrate that the Multimodal Base Model achieves strong deep semantic alignment (scoring 0.889 on BERTScore F1), optimizing this architecture for legacy metrics reveals a performance gap. We explore this gap as a hypothesis we term temporal alignment friction: a conflict where global audio representations disrupt the chronological sequence of visual frames, leading to penalties under visually-focused evaluation metrics. Consequently, by stripping away the audio, our Video-Only ablation conforms more closely to this rigid syntax, achieving 63.0 CIDEr. While trailing larger models such as Qwen2.5-VL (67.4 CIDEr), this establishes a strong baseline for sub-3B parameter LLM-based models. This indicates that CIDEr, as applied to datasets such as MSR-VTT, may exhibit a bias toward visually grounded syntax, limiting its ability to fully capture multimodal semantic richness.

AI.tldr: 提出 AVQFormer：基于 2.7B LLM 的视听查询 Transformer，用固定长度 K=16 语义对齐模块与带熵正则的自适应自批判序列训练（ASCST）稳定训练；发现"时序对齐摩擦"现象，指出 CIDEr 等指标偏向视觉语法。
AI.motivation: 多模态 LLM 常依赖全局音频表示来弥补低效的逐帧视觉编码器，导致全局音频与视觉帧时序结构冲突；同时希望厘清在旧式指标（如 CIDEr）下成绩不佳的原因。
AI.method: 在 2.7B 参数 LLM 上构建 AVQFormer，采用固定长度 K=16 的语义对齐模块压缩多模态信息，并用带熵正则化的自适应自批判序列训练（ASCST）稳定优化；通过 Phase 1 提示式评估与 Video-Only 消融实验对比。
AI.result: Phase 1 多模态基模型 BERTScore F1 达 0.889，深度语义对齐良好；去掉音频的 Video-Only 消融在 CIDEr 上达 63.0，略逊于 Qwen2.5-VL 的 67.4，但在 3B 以下模型中构成强基线。
AI.conclusion: 提出"时序对齐摩擦"假说解释全局音频表示对视觉帧时序的干扰；认为 MSR-VTT 上的 CIDEr 存在偏向视觉化句法的偏差，无法充分反映多模态语义丰富度。

title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation of Vision-Language Models in Japanese
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in Japanese-language settings, yet multimodal safety evaluation has been largely English-centric. We extend the Multimodal Safety Test Suite (MSTS) of Röttger et al. (2025) to Japanese as the 12th language, contributing 320 machine-translated and post-edited cases with reference answers plus 82 culturally localized Japanese images. We introduce an evaluation framework that (i) extends MSTS's 3-class safety grouping with a 5-point scale that also rewards useful (not just safe) responses, and (ii) separates image recognition from safety judgment to isolate recognition errors. Using this framework, we evaluate five modern Japanese VLMs (Gemini-3-Flash, GPT-5, InternVL3, LLM-JP-4-VL, Qwen3-VL) against human evaluation, and find substantial variance in the safety readiness across the models. Finally, we evaluate two LLM-as-a-Judge models and find that providing a reference answer improves agreement with human safety judgments, though recall for detecting unsafe responses remains limited, underscoring the difficulty of automating multimodal safety evaluation. The dataset created for our study will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 将多模态安全测试套件MSTS扩展到日语（第12种语言），新增320个翻译+后编辑案例和82张文化本地化图片，并提出分离识别与安全判断的评测框架，评测5个日语VLM与2个LLM裁判。
AI.motivation: VLM在日语场景中部署增多，但多模态安全评测仍以英语为中心，缺乏日语及文化适配的安全基准。
AI.method: 把Röttger等(2025)的MSTS扩展为日语：320个机器翻译+人工后编辑案例（含参考答案）+82张文化本地化图片；评测框架将原3类安全分组扩展为5分制（兼顾安全与有用性），并把图像识别与安全判断分离以隔离识别错误；用该框架评测Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5、InternVL3、LLM-JP-4-VL、Qwen3-VL五个模型并与人工评测对比，另评测两个LLM-as-a-Judge。
AI.result: 五个日语VLM的安全准备度差异显著；提供参考答案可提升LLM裁判与人类判断的一致性，但对不安全回答的召回率仍有限。
AI.conclusion: 日语多模态安全评测仍具挑战，自动化安全判断尤其困难；数据集将于论文发表后公开。

title: KeyDeck: Multi-Paper-to-Slide Generation via Cross-Paper Synthesis and Reference-Guided Personalization
summary: Multi-paper-to-slide generation (multi-PTSG) is the task of constructing a unified presentation from multiple research papers by selecting, organizing, and synthesizing information across sources. This task introduces two main challenges: (i) combining multiple sources into a coherent narrative requires identifying cross-paper relationships and synthesizing their content, and (ii) the desired organization and emphasis varies substantially across presenters, making personalization essential for user satisfaction. Motivated by these challenges, we propose KeyDeck, the first multi-PTSG framework that integrates per-paper and cross-paper analysis to identify relationships among sources and synthesize their contributions into a coherent narrative, and reference-guided personalization to infer presenters' narrative, content, textual, and visual preferences and adapt slide generation accordingly. To evaluate generation quality, personalization adherence, and conversational goal satisfaction, we introduce KeyBench, a benchmark of 100 expert-authored multi-paper presentations, together with a comprehensive evaluation framework. Our results demonstrate that KeyDeck outperforms existing approaches in multi-PTSG quality, personalization adherence, and conversational goal satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 提出首个多论文转幻灯片框架KeyDeck，结合跨论文关系分析与参考引导个性化，并发布基准KeyBench。
AI.motivation: 多论文转幻灯片（multi-PTSG）需跨源综合并迎合不同讲者的组织与侧重点偏好，现有方法难以同时解决跨论文关系识别与个性化两大难题。
AI.method: KeyDeck融合三类组件：单篇与跨篇分析以识别来源间关系并综合贡献成连贯叙事；参考引导的个性化，从示例中推断讲者在叙事、内容、文本与视觉上的偏好并据此调整生成；配套构建KeyBench（100份专家撰写的多论文演示）及综合评测框架。
AI.result: 在多论文幻灯片生成质量、个性化遵从度与对话目标满足度上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 按单篇+跨篇分析与参考引导个性化可有效实现多论文到统一演示的生成，KeyBench为相关评测提供标准化基准。

title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
comment: Published at fifth conference on lifelong learning agents
summary: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SACK（Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge），一种可插拔的持续学习方法，通过将模型的类别知识分解为细粒度概念，计算新样本与已学概念间的语义关系，据此对输入样本进行打分和优先级排序，从而改善稳定性-可塑性平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要聚焦于显式地平衡稳定性与可塑性以缓解灾难性遗忘，但训练样本的顺序与性质对学习过程的影响仍缺乏探索。作者认为持续学习算法应具备对输入样本排序的能力，即根据样本与历史数据的关系及其对学习过程的影响进行优先级评估。
AI.method: SACK是一种即插即用技术：将模型的类别知识拆解为细粒度概念；在每个经验中计算已学概念与新概念之间的语义关系；利用该关系知识对新样本进行优先级排序/打分，并据此指导训练。
AI.result: 在多种持续学习方法（正则化、回放、提示-based）以及类增量与任务增量设置下，集成SACK不仅能提升准确率、降低遗忘，还能应对长尾分布，使模型聚焦于语义可解释区域，并获得校准更好、更鲁棒的模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于语义关系的样本排序与优先级策略是持续学习中一个被忽视但有效的维度，SACK作为通用插件可广泛增强现有CL方法的性能与鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Random Starts: Amortized Initialization for Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Models
summary: Gradient-based transferable adversarial attacks achieve state-of-the-art attack success rates against black-box vision-language models (VLMs). However, they require hundreds of costly optimization steps for each image pair. One possible reason is that these attacks typically start from random perturbations that contain no information about the source or target image. In this work, we study whether amortized adversarial generation can provide better initializations for gradient-based attacks. By learning across many image pairs, amortization allows a generator to produce adversarial perturbations for new inputs without optimizing each perturbation from scratch. We introduce SPARK, a lightweight looped perturbation generator conditioned on both the source and target images. SPARK repeatedly applies the same network to refine a perturbation, producing effective adversarial attacks in a few forward passes without requiring gradients through surrogate vision encoders at inference time. We show that these perturbations provide effective warm starts for existing gradient-based attacks, substantially improving attack success rates while reducing the number of optimization steps required. These improvements generalize across different attack methods, VLMs, and unseen image categories. SPARK also produces effective standalone attacks at a fraction of the computational cost of gradient-based optimization. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/Patchwork53/SPARK.

AI.tldr: SPARK：一种轻量循环式对抗扰动生成器，以源图和目标图为条件，通过摊还学习为梯度攻击提供高质量初始化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的可迁移对抗攻击对黑盒视觉语言模型（VLM）成功率很高，但每对图像需数百步昂贵优化；作者认为原因是初始扰动随机、不包含源/目标图像信息。
AI.method: 提出SPARK，一个轻量的循环（looped）扰动生成器，同时以源图像和目标图像为条件；重复应用同一网络迭代精化扰动，推理时无需通过代理视觉编码器反向传播梯度，仅几次前向即可生成扰动，可作为现有梯度攻击的热启动。
AI.result: 作为热启动时，SPARK显著提升攻击成功率并减少所需优化步数，且改进可泛化到不同攻击方法、不同VLM及未见图像类别；单独使用时也能以远低于梯度优化的计算成本实现有效攻击。
AI.conclusion: 摊还式对抗扰动生成能为梯度攻击提供有效初始化，兼具高效性与可迁移性；代码与权重已开源。

title: Pitfalls of Dependency-Ready Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have shown strong performance on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, Trip Planning, and Countdown. MDMs introduce a freedom in the order in which tokens may be unmasked, and to exercise this freedom for good accuracy, early decoding strategies relied on signals of confidence or the downstream impact of decoding a token. However, simple examples seem to illustrate that resolving a token's dependencies before unmasking it should be important. Therefore, we examine whether this principle, which we call dependency-ready decoding, would contribute to better accuracy, from a practical and a theoretical perspective. We examine a recent decoder that implements dependency-readiness through attention, and generally find that when it performs better than confidence-based or future utility baselines, its decoding order collapses to left-to-right decoding. For theoretical analysis, we establish a definition of dependency without resorting to attention, measured by an information-theoretic score of how much revealing a single masked token (or a set) would shift the model's prediction for another. We prove that when the margin is large relative to this score, no such revelation can change the top prediction, so in this regime Maximum-Margin decoding already commits dependency-ready tokens. These findings leave only a narrow scope for future dependency-ready decoders: their potential benefit is limited to positions with margins smaller than the information-theoretic sensitivity, and reliance on attention should be questioned.

AI.tldr: 本文从实践与理论两方面检验"依赖就绪解码"(依赖先于揭示)是否真正提升掩码扩散模型准确率，发现其实践增益多归结为左到右解码，理论上最大边际解码已能提交依赖就绪的token，故该方向空间有限。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型(MDM)可在任意顺序解除token掩码，早期解码策略依赖置信度或下游效用信号，但直觉上应先满足token依赖再解码。作者想验证这一"依赖就绪解码"原则是否真能带来更好准确率。
AI.method: 1) 实践:考察一个通过注意力实现依赖就绪的近期解码器，与基于置信度和未来效用的基线对比;2) 理论:不依赖注意力定义"依赖"，用信息论分数度量揭示某掩码token(或集合)对另一token预测的偏移量，证明边际相对该分数较大时，揭示无法改变最高预测。
AI.result: 依赖就绪解码器优于基线时，其解码顺序往往退化为左到右解码;理论上当边际远大于信息论敏感度时，任何揭示都不能改变top预测，此时最大边际解码已隐式提交依赖就绪token。
AI.conclusion: 依赖就绪解码的潜在收益仅限于边际小于信息论敏感度的位置，范围狭窄;基于注意力的依赖实现方式应受质疑，未来需谨慎评估该方向的价值。

title: Asset4D-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Editable 3D and 4D Reconstruction
comment: The first three authors contributed equally
summary: A cart can follow its reference trajectory while its cargo floats above the deck. Asset4D-Bench tests whether coding agents recover objects, motion and interactions from visual references as editable Blender scenes. Its 114 conditions span image editing, video reconstruction with matched full or partial starter assets, and independently selected from-scratch tasks. We independently reopen projects and measure them against native reference states. The 228 archived scores include original delivery outcomes and versioned measures of scene quality. On 24 from-scratch tasks, each model earns full dynamics credit on 14. Of these, three GPT-6.1-Sol and eight GPT-6-Astra reconstructions earn zero relation points. Under the fixed scoring weights, relations contribute 5.15 points to the 6.50-point Sol-minus-Astra difference in mean recovered fidelity. Differences in execution and recovery policy across archived runs preclude a causal estimate of starter-asset effects.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Asset4D-Bench，用114个任务条件评测编码智能体能否从视觉参考中恢复物体、运动与交互并生成可编辑的Blender场景，通过独立重开项目与原生参考状态比对打分（共228条归档分数）。结果显示模型动态学分普遍较高但关系/交互恢复存在明显差异。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体生成3D内容的能力缺乏可复现、可编辑场景层面的系统性评测，尤其缺少对物体恢复、运动与交互关系准确性的独立验证，以及对起始资产（starter asset）作用机制的考察。
AI.method: 构建Asset4D-Bench：114个条件覆盖图像编辑、视频重建（配全量或部分匹配起始资产）以及独立选取的从零构建任务；对交付项目独立重开，与原生参考状态比对，汇总228条归档分数，并区分原始交付结果与版本化的场景质量度量。
AI.result: 24个从零任务中，各模型均在14项上获得完整动态学分；其中3个GPT-6.1-Sol与8个GPT-6-Astra重建关系得分为零。在固定权重下，关系项贡献5.15分，占Sol与Astra平均恢复保真度差（6.50分）的主要部分。由于归档运行在执行与恢复策略上存在差异，无法对起始资产效应作因果估计。
AI.conclusion: Asset4D-Bench提供了可编辑场景级别的可复现评测框架，揭示模型在关系/交互恢复上的系统性短板；未来需在控制策略差异的条件下，才可评估起始资产的影响。

title: Temporal Selective Exploration for Reinforcement Learning-Guided Continuous-Discrete Flow Matching in 3D Molecular Design
summary: Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains underexplored, especially in continuous-discrete mixed settings. Moreover, flow matching is formulated as an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), whose deterministic trajectories do not naturally support RL optimization. Introducing stochasticity by converting the entire trajectory into a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) is a common practice. Nevertheless, not all timesteps contribute to the final outcomes, and redundant exploration introduces additional noise. Furthermore, in multi-objective settings, some objectives may dominate the optimization while others receive insufficient updates. In this study, we propose an RL-guided continuous-discrete flow matching framework with temporal selective exploration for 3D de novo molecular design.
