Specifically, our method jointly optimizes continuous and discrete flow matching for atomic coordinates and molecular identities, respectively, while restricting exploration to timesteps that primarily contribute to target properties, reducing ineffective exploration. We also introduce a reward-based advantage calibration mechanism to mitigate objective dominance in multi-objective optimization. The framework is applied to design inhibitors for both the well-studied target protein EGFR and the challenging Pin1 protein. We identify some novel candidate inhibitors, supported by in silico validation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种RL引导的连续-离散流匹配框架，配合时间选择性探索，用于3D从头分子设计，并在EGFR与Pin1上发现新候选抑制剂。
AI.motivation: 流匹配在生成任务中潜力强，但其强化学习优化仍研究不足，尤其是在连续-离散混合场景下；流匹配以ODE形式表达，确定性轨迹无法自然支持RL探索；常用做法将整条轨迹转为SDE引入随机性，但并非所有时间步都影响最终结果，冗余探索带来额外噪声；多目标优化中还易出现目标支配、部分目标更新不足的问题。
AI.method: 构建RL引导的连续-离散流匹配框架：分别针对原子坐标（连续）和分子身份（离散）联合优化连续与离散流匹配；将探索限制在对目标性质贡献主要的时间步上，减少无效探索；引入基于奖励的优势校准机制，缓解多目标优化中的目标支配问题。
AI.result: 将该框架用于为成熟靶点EGFR和较具挑战性的Pin1蛋白设计抑制剂，识别出若干新颖候选抑制剂，并获得in silico验证支持。
AI.conclusion: 时间选择性探索与奖励优势校准可有效提升流匹配的RL优化效率与多目标均衡性，在3D从头分子设计中具有实用性。

title: Anatomy-Aware Pseudo-Labels and Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff Supervision for Semi-Supervised Pancreas Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to WACV 2027 Workshops (FABRIC). \c{opyright} 2027 IEEE
summary: Confidence-gated co-training assumes that pseudo-label errors are uncertain and concentrated at organ boundaries. We argue that for pancreas CT, where the target organ is a single connected structure and detached fragments are anatomically implausible, the dominant failures arise at three levels: where the organ is, what its boundary should look like, and how a correct boundary is penalized. Anatomical Rectification relabels implausible fragments of a teacher prediction as confident background, without adding any loss or parameter; an audit confirms that its rejections are overwhelmingly detached hallucinations and that thin, tail-like slices are not eroded. Boundary Grafting transplants labelled surface regions with their annotation into unlabeled volumes, replacing unreliable boundary pseudo-labels with ground truth. The residual error is coherent surface displacement, weakly penalized by permutation-invariant Dice and cross-entropy losses. Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff (HAH) supervision anneals a distance-weighted penalty from an annotation-anchored objective that is convex in the prediction to a Hausdorff surrogate, admitting the prediction-dependent distance term only after the predicted surface becomes reliable. On NIH pancreas CT, under the standard semi-supervised split, the full method reaches 84.60% Dice and 4.97 voxels 95HD, improving all four metrics over compared methods; on MSD Task07, 78.90% Dice and 4.19 voxels 95HD. We further contribute PanTS-SSL, a semi-supervised evaluation protocol derived from the public 9,901-case PanTS corpus, with a curated 1,015-volume main pool, labelled tiers of 50, 100 and 250 volumes, an 80-case tumor track, shift probes for acquisition and anatomy change, and a fixed 901-volume test set. On it, the method exceeds the co-training baseline at 100 labels, scales to 85.29% Dice at 250 labels, and reaches 85.50% Dice at 100 labels with HAH.

AI.tldr: 提出三层次误差修复框架（解剖纠正、边界移植、同伦退火 Hausdorff 监督）用于胰腺 CT 半监督分割，在 NIH 与 MSD 上全面优于对比方法，并贡献 PanTS-SSL 评测协议。
AI.motivation: 置信度门控协同训练假定伪标签错误集中在器官边界。但对胰腺 CT，目标是单一连通结构、离散碎片在解剖上不合理，主要失败发生在“器官在哪”“边界应长什么样”“正确边界如何被惩罚”三个层面。
AI.method: 1) 解剖纠正：将教师预测中不合理的碎片重标为高置信背景，不增加损失或参数；2) 边界移植：把带标注的表面区域连同标注移植到无标注体积中，以真值替代不可靠边界伪标签；3) 同伦退火 Hausdorff（HAH）：从对预测凸的、以标注为锚的目标，退火到 Hausdorff 代理，仅在预测表面可靠后引入依赖预测的距离项。
AI.result: NIH 胰腺 CT 标准半监督划分下达 84.60% Dice、4.97 体素 95HD，四项指标均优于对比方法；MSD Task07 上 78.90% Dice、4.19 体素 95HD。
AI.conclusion: 贡献 PanTS-SSL 半监督评测协议（源自 9,901 例 PanTS，主池 1,015 例，标注档 50/100/250，80 例肿瘤赛道，采集与解剖漂移探针，固定 901 例测试集）。该协议下 100 标注超过协同训练基线，250 标注达 85.29% Dice，100 标注加 HAH 达 85.50% Dice。

title: Teaching a Multilingual Translation Model Regional Varieties: Castilian and Latin American Spanish, Asturian, Aragonese and Aranese with MADLAD-400-3B-MT
comment: 12 pages, 10 tables. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/Ugiat
summary: Massively multilingual translation models usually have one tag per language and no control over regional varieties, and they cover a region's smaller languages poorly or not at all. We report three fine-tunes of MADLAD-400-3B-MT, each adding target tags with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), back-translation of monolingual text and replay of the base model's own translations: <2es_ES> for Spanish as written in Spain, <2es_419> for Latin American Spanish, and one model for three Romance languages of the Iberian Peninsula, Asturian (<2ast>), Aragonese (<2an>) and Aranese (<2oc_aranes>). For the Spanish varieties we annotate the 250.9M documents of MADLAD-400's Spanish split with a domain-supervised Spain vs. Latin America classifier and select variety text with a rule that admitted no Latin American document in a 340-document reference set. The Castilian model chooses Spain's everyday vocabulary in 97% of a targeted test (base model 62%) and vosotros for informal plural address in 70% (10%), while improving chrF++ on human references. A first finding is tag collapse: with a new tag initialised from <2es>, the parent tag drifts to the new variety (84-87% identical outputs). In the Iberian model, contrastive pairs and a separate learning rate for the tag embeddings keep each tag in its own language. Trained only on publicly available data, mostly the TAN-IBE Wikipedia corpora, the Iberian model matches or beats the TAN-IBE Marian systems in four of six Spanish directions on FLORES+, is 1.9 BLEU behind in Spanish->Aranese, and is second only to SalamandraTA-7B in most directions. The exception, Spanish->Aragonese, reflects a difference of written variety between Aragonese Wikipedia and the FLORES+ reference, not model quality. All three fine-tunes lose 0.6-0.7 chrF++ on average in thirteen other FLORES-200 directions. We release the models, data and variety classifier under open licences

AI.tldr: 本文对 MADLAD-400-3B-MT 进行三次 LoRA 微调，为西班牙语地区变体（西班牙/拉美西班牙语）及伊比利亚半岛三种小语种（阿斯图里亚斯语、阿拉贡语、阿兰语）增加可控的目标语言标签，公开模型与数据。
AI.motivation: 现有多语翻译模型通常每种语言仅一个标签、无法控制地区变体，且对地区内小语种覆盖很差甚至缺失。
AI.method: 用 LoRA 加新目标标签并做单语回译与基座模型译文回放；用领域监督的西班牙vs拉美分类器标注 MADLAD-400 西班牙语 250.9M 文档并严格筛选变体文本；对伊比利亚模型使用对比样本与标签嵌入独立学习率防止标签塌缩。
AI.result: 卡斯蒂利亚模型在针对性测试中 97% 选用西班牙日常词汇（基座 62%）、70% 使用 vosotros（基座 10%），并提升 chrF++；发现标签塌缩现象（新旧标签输出 84-87% 相同）；伊比利亚模型在 FLORES+ 六个西语方向中四向持平或超过 TAN-IBE Marian，西→阿兰语落后 1.9 BLEU，多数方向仅次于 SalamandraTA-7B；十三项其他 FLORES-200 方向平均下降 0.6-0.7 chrF++。
AI.conclusion: 以低资源手段可实现地区变体与区域小语种的可控、高质量翻译，标签分离策略有效；代价是少量通用方向的轻微性能损失。

title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and LLM based agents have expanded the capabilities of AI glasses, enabling egocentric visual question answering, memory retrieval, and proactive assistance. These applications involve diverse inputs, including speech, images, and video, and range from simple device control to complex visual reasoning, posing challenges for efficient computation and communication. While video centric capabilities have received considerable attention, simple text based and device executable tasks remain underexplored despite their prevalence in daily interactions. Efficiently supporting diverse workloads within a unified assistant remains an open challenge. We propose JOVE ICE, an intent guided cloud, edge, and device collaborative framework that routes requests among AI glasses, a paired smartphone, and cloud servers according to user intent. JOVE ICE integrates hierarchical intent classification with dynamic subagent orchestration to select efficient execution paths and flexibly incorporate new applications through specialized subagents. Analysis of real world AI glasses requests reveals that simple device control tasks account for over 30% of interactions, which JOVE ICE handles directly on device to avoid unnecessary cloud computation and costs. Evaluations on three public benchmarks demonstrate that JOVE ICE reduces time to first token by approximately 13% and token usage by over 11% compared with conventional device and cloud architectures, while maintaining task quality. These results demonstrate the potential of intent guided collaboration to improve the efficiency and scalability of AI glasses.

AI.tldr: 提出JOVE ICE，一个基于意图引导的“云—边缘—设备”协同框架，将AI眼镜请求按用户意图在眼镜、配对手机和云服务器之间路由，以提升效率并保持任务质量。
AI.motivation: AI眼镜应用涉及语音、图像、视频等多样输入，涵盖从设备控制到复杂视觉推理的任务，带来计算与通信效率挑战；现有研究偏重视频/视觉能力，而高频且简单的文本类与设备可执行任务被忽视，如何在统一助手中高效支持多样工作负载仍是开放问题。
AI.method: JOVE ICE采用分层意图分类与动态子代理编排，按用户意图在AI眼镜、手机和云端选择高效执行路径，并可通过专用子代理灵活接入新应用；简单设备控制类请求直接在设备端处理。
AI.result: 真实AI眼镜请求分析显示简单设备控制任务占交互30%以上；在三个公开基准上，相比传统设备与云架构，首token时间约降低13%，token用量减少逾11%，同时保持任务质量。
AI.conclusion: 意图引导的协同可在保持任务质量的前提下提升AI眼镜系统的效率与可扩展性。

title: Yet Another Concept Drift Benchmark? A Principled Framework for Evaluating Drift Detectors
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet its empirical evaluation remains based on loosely defined protocols, ambiguous alarm semantics, and inconsistent metrics. We propose a principled benchmark grounded in an explicit formulation of drift observability and alarm semantics. Our framework introduces finite detection windows and repeated alarms, enabling a clear separation between detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, and employs a reproducible observer to provide a controlled and interpretable performance signal. Building on this formulation, we define normalized evaluation metrics and a composite score addressing limitations of existing measures. We validate the framework through a large-scale stress-testing evaluation of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于明确"漂移可观测性"与"告警语义"定义的漂移检测基准框架，通过有限检测窗口与重复告警将检测准确性、及时性和稳定性解耦，并给出归一化指标与综合评分。
AI.motivation: 现有概念漂移检测器的实证评估存在协议定义松散、告警语义模糊、指标不一致等问题，导致结果难以复现与比较。
AI.method: 以显式漂移可观测性公式与告警语义为基础构建基准：引入有限检测窗口与重复告警机制，用可复现的"observer"提供受控且可解释的性能信号；在此基础上定义归一化评估指标及综合评分以弥补现有指标的不足。
AI.result: 通过大规模压力测试验证框架：覆盖10种检测器、9种学习器配置与16个数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了准确性、及时性与稳定性的清晰分离，为概念漂移检测提供可复现、可解释且更一致的评估标准。

title: ViCARD: Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Visual reasoning requires models to identify relevant visual evidence and use it to derive correct answers. Outcomebased reinforcement learning (RL) faces two key challenges in this regime: it yields no learning signal when perceptual errors cause all sampled responses to fail, and it broadcasts a uniform advantage across every token within a response. Conversely, while visual self-distillation offers dense guidance from evidence-centered image crops, student learning from token distributions alone often fails to elicit correct final answers. Motivated by an audit of training rollouts that exposes these complementary failure modes, we introduce ViCARD (Visual Credit Assignment with RewardGated Distillation), which integrates per-token visual supervision with verified correctness rewards. For each rollout group, we leverage a teacher with its input image cropped to the relevant visual area, and use this to provide per-token supervision to the student while also valuing correctness. If all sampled rollouts fail, ViCARD samples an additional crop-teacher answer and activates on-policy distillation only if that answer is correct. Together, these mechanisms provide fine-grained visual credit within informative reward groups and a learning signal for otherwise uninformative all-fail groups. Extensive comparisons across model scales demonstrate that ViCARD improves fine-grained visual reasoning performance over RL and distillation baselines, while retaining broad visual reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: ViCARD 将逐 token 视觉蒸馏与可验证正确性奖励结合，解决基于结果 RL 在视觉推理中的“全失败无信号”和“优势均匀广播”两大问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理需要模型定位相关视觉证据并据此作答。基于结果的 RL 存在两处缺陷：(1) 当感知错误导致所有采样回答都失败时，没有任何学习信号；(2) 只在整条回答上广播统一优势，缺乏 token 级细粒度信用分配。而视觉自蒸馏虽能从以证据为中心的裁剪图提供稠密指导，但学生仅从 token 分布学习往往学不出正确最终答案。作者基于对训练 rollout 的审计，揭示了这两类互补的失效模式。
AI.method: 提出 ViCARD（Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation）。对每个 rollout 组，使用输入图像裁剪到相关视觉区域的教师模型，为学生提供逐 token 监督，同时以正确性作为奖励门控。若所有采样 rollout 均失败，则额外采样一个“裁剪图-教师”答案，仅当该答案正确时激活 on-policy 蒸馏。由此在信息量充足的奖励组内实现细粒度视觉信用分配，并为全失败组提供学习信号。
AI.result: 跨模型规模的广泛实验表明，ViCARD 在细粒度视觉推理上优于 RL 与蒸馏基线，同时保留广泛视觉推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 将逐 token 视觉蒸馏与可验证正确性奖励门控相结合，可同时补救稀疏奖励下的全失败无信号和粗粒度优势分配问题，是提升视觉推理的有效训练范式。

title: When Rerankers Work Together: Better and Faster Reranking without Joint Training
summary: Standalone reranker quality does not determine its value in a multistage RAG pipeline. We systematically study heterogeneous rerankers composed without joint training, spanning lexical, single-vector, late-interaction, and joint query-context scoring. Two lightweight semantic coarse scorers, Cache-Pointwise and Cache-Shapley, learn from passage relevance labels and share cacheable representations and linear-time singleton inference. Under matched candidates and budgets, we compare cascades with stage-removal references to measure evidence retention, repair and breakage, reader accuracy, and online pruning cost. On NoLiMa 32K with Gemma, inserting these scorers before CrossEncoder or Provence improves answer accuracy by 4.02-9.43 percentage points while accelerating online pruning by 1.57-1.88x relative to the corresponding reranker alone. Cache-Pointwise composed with ColBERTv2 through reciprocal rank fusion improves accuracy by 4.60 points at 1.36x speedup over direct ColBERTv2. The stage-removal comparisons reveal an asymmetry: a cascade can outperform its final reranker alone while underperforming its coarse selector alone. Two readers, a second multi-hop dataset, and three-stage extensions show that the gains depend on the reader, reranker pairing, and stage configuration. These findings demonstrate a practical route to better and faster reranking without joint training and motivate studying stage order, candidate budgets, and rank fusion as determinants of composition quality.

AI.tldr: 在多阶段RAG中，重排器的独立质量不能决定其组合价值；本文系统研究无需联合训练的异构重排器级联组合，提出两种轻量语义粗排器，并证明在相同候选与预算下可同时提升精度和加速在线剪枝。
AI.motivation: 传统观点以重排器的单独指标衡量其价值，但在多阶段RAG流水线中，组合效果受阶段顺序、候选预算与排序融合影响，缺乏系统研究。作者希望明确异构（无联合训练）重排器级联的实际收益与失效条件。
AI.method: 提出Cache-Pointwise与Cache-Shapley两种轻量语义粗排器，从段落相关性标签学习，共享可缓存表示并具有线性时间的单例推理。在词汇、单向量、晚交互与联合查询-上下文打分四类重排器上构造无联合训练的级联，在匹配候选与预算下与"去阶段"参照对比，测量证据保留、修复与破坏、读者准确率及在线剪枝成本。
AI.result: NoLiMa 32K+Gemma上，将粗排器插入CrossEncoder或Provence之前，准确率提升4.02–9.43个百分点，在线剪枝加速1.57–1.88倍；Cache-Pointwise与ColBERTv2经RRF融合提升4.60个点并加速1.36倍。去阶段对比显示不对称性：级联可优于其最终重排器，却劣于其粗排选择器。两读者、第二个多跳数据集及三阶段扩展表明收益依赖读者、重排器配对与阶段配置。
AI.conclusion: 无需联合训练即可获得更好更快重排的实用路径；阶段顺序、候选预算与排序融合是组合质量的决定因素，值得进一步研究。

title: WhatIf: Counterfactual World Models over Action-Grounded Causal Graphs for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World models predict what happens under an action, but choosing between actions requires comparing their outcomes in the same physical situation. Factual transitions alone determine action-wise marginal futures and average effects, but not individual effects or the probability that switching actions causes harm. We introduce WhatIf, a counterfactual world model for manipulation that couples candidate futures through shared latent physics and transition noise inferred from factual history. Each candidate action induces a sparse object-factor causal graph describing the physical pathways it activates. Rolling out these graphs under the shared situation anchors predictions to observed outcomes and confines action contrasts to the objects each action reaches. Shared type-conditioned functions support varying numbers of objects, while a round-trip loss enforces action-invariant abduction without counterfactual labels. We show that replacing an individual effect with its conditional mean incurs mean-squared error equal to its conditional variance, motivating comparisons between coupled futures. Building on these comparisons, Counterfactual Advantage Planning (CAP) ranks plans by their advantage over an incumbent within shared situations and constrains the probability of harm. Paired advantages reduce estimator variance by a factor of $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the correlation between branch outcomes, and cancel model errors shared by both branches. Each executed transition provides hindsight advantages to update the physics posterior, the next plan, and an amortized policy without a learned critic. We further establish when observational transitions identify interventional dynamics. Paired simulator interventions evaluate counterfactual accuracy, graph recovery, compositional generalization, and decision quality.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实世界模型 WhatIf 与反事实优势规划 CAP，通过共享潜在物理耦合候选未来，实现可比较的动作反事实预测与安全决策。
AI.motivation: 仅凭事实转移只能得到各动作的条件均值（平均效应），无法估计个体效应或"切换动作造成伤害"的概率；比较动作需要在同一物理情境下耦合候选未来。
AI.method: 用共享潜在物理与从事实历史推断的转移噪声耦合候选未来；每个动作诱导稀疏物体因子因果图，表征其激活的物理通路；共享类型条件函数支持变动物体数，往返损失在无反事实标签下实现动作不变的反事实推断（abduction）。据此提出 CAP：以对现任方案的配对优势排序计划并约束伤害概率；结合回溯优势更新物理后验、下一计划与摊销策略（无需学习 critic）。
AI.result: 理论表明：用条件均值替代个体效应，其 MSE 等于条件方差，故须比较耦合未来；配对优势使估计方差降低 1-ρ 倍并抵消共享模型误差。仿真成对干预实验评估反事实精度、图恢复、组合泛化与决策质量，并给出观测转移识别干预动力学的条件。
AI.conclusion: 耦合反事实建模 + 配对优势规划为操控任务提供了低方差、可约束风险且可自我改进的决策框架。

title: Scalpel and Brush: Pruning and Targeted Weight Editing of a Small Language Model by a Single LLM Agent
summary: It has recently been shown that an LLM can itself edit the weights of a language model, yet it remains unclear which part of such a result is due to the agent and which part is reproduced by a random edit of the same shape, by an instruction in the prompt, or by a standard procedure without an LLM. We unify repair and pruning as sparse weight edits to optimize a metric we specify, using BLEU as an example: three tasks -- targeted weight repair ("brush"), structured MLP neuron pruning ("scalpel", zeroing pruned weights), and layer removal with repair - are assigned to a DeepSeek Harness agent powered by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with up to 50 dev evaluations. We study Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct in three independent runs per task, with final evaluation on two hidden splits. On ordinary differential equations, changing at most 0.0084% of weights raised test BLEU by 24-32% on second-order equations and by a factor of 1.8-2.5 on equations with polynomial right-hand sides. An independent substitution check showed that higher BLEU reflects notation alignment rather than improved correctness. Masks that remove 12.5-15% of MLP neurons shrink the model by 9.4-11.2% with mean BLEU loss of at most 0.01 on both hidden splits, whereas standard pruning with equal shares per layer failed the constraint at all tested shares. On seven-class GoEmotions classification, edits raise macro-F1 from 0.100 to 0.396-0.451 on test and from 0.175 to 0.455-0.476 on holdout. A ridge-based classifier written into agent-selected weight rows yields macro-F1 of 0.424 and 0.464. Pruning search with the same evaluation limit removes 15.9% of neurons versus 14-21.4% for agent runs passing the hidden check. Standard procedures without an LLM reproduce much of the performance once given the location and form of intervention found by the agent; a comparison of agentic and non-agentic search remains open.

AI.tldr: 该论文将权重修复与剪枝统一表述为稀疏权重编辑，在DeepSeek Harness代理下用BLEU/macro-F1为目标做三项任务，并系统性地用随机编辑、提示指令与无LLM标准流程做对照消融。
AI.motivation: 近期有工作声称LLM能自行编辑语言模型权重，但尚不清楚其中多少来自代理的智能、多少可由同形状随机编辑、提示指令或无LLM的标准流程复现，因此需要一个可控的统一框架进行归因分析。
AI.method: 把修复与剪枝统一为优化指定度量（以BLEU为例）的稀疏权重编辑，三项任务：定向权重修复"brush"、结构化MLP神经元剪枝"scalpel"（剪除权重置零）、带修复的层移除；由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash驱动的DeepSeek Harness代理执行，最多50次dev评估；模型为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct，每任务三次独立运行，最终在两个隐藏划分上评测，并做替换检验与无LLM标准流程对照。
AI.result: ODE任务上改动≤0.0084%权重使二阶方程测试BLEU提升24–32%，多项式右端方程提升1.8–2.5倍，但替换检验显示提升反映记号对齐而非正确性；剪除12.5–15% MLP神经元使模型缩小9.4–11.2%，两隐藏划分平均BLEU损失≤0.01，而逐层等额标准剪枝在各比例下均违反约束；GoEmotions七分类macro-F1由0.100升至0.396–0.451（test）、0.175升至0.455–0.476（holdout），写入代理所选权重行的ridge分类器达0.424/0.464；同评估预算下剪枝搜索移除15.9%神经元，代理运行14–21.4%。
AI.conclusion: 一旦给定代理找到的干预位置与形式，无LLM的标准流程即可复现大部分性能，说明该结果中"代理智能"的贡献被高估；代理式与非代理式搜索的系统比较仍是开放问题。

title: HumblePRM: Improving VLM Abstention in Ambiguous Situations through Process Reward Modeling
summary: Reliable deployment of Vision Language Models (VLMs) requires that a model's expressed confidence remain grounded in what it can actually see, and that it recognize when the visual evidence is too ambiguous to commit to a confident response. Standard post-training uses outcome reward models (ORMs) that supervise only the final decision, rewarding a confident answer regardless of whether the image supports one, while existing methods either tend to detect uncertainty post-hoc or assume an objective verdict always exists. We instead split multimodal reasoning into two stages: perception, where the model must factually describe the scene, and calibration, where it must judge whether that evidence is sufficient to commit to a conclusion. We introduce HumblePRM, a lightweight process reward model (PRM) that scores each stage independently, rewarding agreement between evidence and expressed confidence rather than outcome correctness alone. Training with HumblePRM increases abstention due to uncertainty on ambiguous inputs considerably while leaving accuracy on clear images roughly unchanged. We also find that the improvement transfers to Gemma 4 E4B, a larger, popular edge model. Our findings show that process reward supervision is a promising route to VLMs with better calibrated abstention, ensuring more reliability rather than unpredictable behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HumblePRM，一种分阶段（感知/校准）打分的轻量过程奖励模型，奖励"证据与置信度一致"而非仅结果正确，从而提升 VLM 在模糊图像上的弃答校准能力。
AI.motivation: 标准后训练用结果奖励模型（ORM）只监督最终答案，会奖励"无论如何都自信作答"，不考虑图像是否真的支持该答案；现有方法要么事后检测不确定性，要么假设总存在客观标准答案。因此需要让模型置信度扎根于可见证据，并能识别证据不足的情况。
AI.method: 将多模态推理拆为两阶段：感知（事实性描述场景）与校准（判断证据是否足以支持结论）。提出轻量级 HumblePRM 分别对两阶段独立打分，奖励证据与所表达置信度之间的一致性，而非单纯的结果正确性。
AI.result: 用 HumblePRM 训练后，模型在模糊输入上因不确定而弃答的比例显著上升，而在清晰图像上的准确率基本不变；该改进可迁移到更大的 Gemma 4 E4B 边缘模型。
AI.conclusion: 过程奖励监督是获得更好校准弃答行为的可行路径，可提升 VLM 可靠性，避免不可预测行为。

title: ChemDeduce: Benchmarking LLMs for Unknown Chemical Identification through Interactive Simulated Experiments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in chemical knowledge and reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether they can solve problems whose answers must be discovered through experimentation. We investigate this question through Unknown Chemical Identification, where a model must actively design experiments, interpret observations, update hypotheses, and ultimately identify a hidden substance. We introduce ChemDeduce, an interactive evaluation framework for assessing LLMs through simulated experiments. ChemDeduce formulates chemical identification as a sequential decision process and provides a stateful simulated laboratory with explicit instrument and operational constraints, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation of iterative experimental reasoning. We benchmark eight frontier LLMs on 200 chemicals, yielding 1600 model--target pairs and 4800 episodes over three independent repetitions, and evaluate identification accuracy, operational compliance, interaction efficiency, and trajectory-level reasoning quality. Despite generating seemingly plausible experimental plans, current models achieve an average identification accuracy ranging from 23.83% to 67.33%, revealing substantial limitations in experiment selection, evidence interpretation, and sequential hypothesis refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出ChemDeduce交互式评测框架，将未知化学物质鉴定建模为序贯决策任务，在带状态的模拟实验室中评估LLM主动设计实验、解释观测、更新假设的能力；8个前沿模型在200种化学品上平均鉴定准确率仅23.83%–67.33%。
AI.motivation: LLM在化学知识与推理上表现良好，但是否能解决"必须通过实验才能发现答案"的问题尚不清楚；现有评测多为静态问答，缺乏对迭代实验推理能力的检验。
AI.method: 构建Unknown Chemical Identification任务：模型需主动设计实验、解读观测、更新假设并最终鉴定隐藏物质。ChemDeduce将其形式化为序贯决策过程，提供带状态的模拟实验室，含显式仪器与操作约束，支持可扩展、可复现的评测；从鉴定准确率、操作合规性、交互效率、轨迹级推理质量四个维度评估。
AI.result: 在200种化学品、8个前沿LLM上共1600个模型-目标对、三次独立重复共4800个episode。模型虽能生成看似合理的实验方案，但平均鉴定准确率仅23.83%–67.33%，在实验选择、证据解释和序贯假设精化上存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM尚不具备可靠的自主实验推理能力，"方案看起来合理"与"真正能推断出答案"之间存在显著差距；ChemDeduce为迭代实验推理提供了可复现的评测基准。

title: Fast Muscle-Driven Whole-Body Motion Tracking with a Differentiable World Model
summary: Tracking motion capture with a whole-body musculoskeletal model means coordinating hundreds of muscles through contact, and current controllers take hours to days of GPU time to train, so every tuning decision is expensive. SuperMimic trains a tracking policy by backpropagating through the rollouts of a learned world model. We extend it to MS-Human-700 (700 muscles) and MyoFullBody (354 muscles), with MuJoCo's activation dynamics inside the world model. To make its training fast, our recipe takes the speedups developed for the Unitree G1, replaces three of their settings that fail on muscles, and adds four changes of our own: observations without muscle geometry, data collection concurrent with the updates, Beta exploration noise that keeps every excitation in $[0,1]$, and 50 Hz control. On one RTX 5090 it trains MS-Human-700 in 6.3 minutes to the held-out return that SuperMimic's published hyperparameters reach in 3.9 hours, 37$\times$ sooner, and in 20 minutes to lower tracking errors than theirs after 10 hours. It trains MyoFullBody 34$\times$ sooner without retuning. Ablations show what is specific to muscles: a higher policy learning rate stalls half of the runs, and clipped Gaussian noise adds a tonic co-contraction that Beta noise avoids. Finally, refining the policy's actions through the world model at test time lowers the position error by a further 26% with no held-out clip failing, and reaches the same return after 5.1 instead of 6.3 minutes of training. Code, the training recipe and videos are on the project page https://muscle-supermimic.beanpow.top.

AI.tldr: 将基于世界模型反向传播的 SuperMimic 扩展到 700/354 块肌肉的全身肌骨模型，用一套改动后的训练配方在单张 RTX 5090 上把训练时间缩短约 34–37 倍，并通过测试时动作精修进一步降低误差。
AI.motivation: 带全身肌骨模型的运动捕捉跟踪需要协调数百块肌肉与接触，现有控制器训练需数小时至数天 GPU 时间，每个调参决策代价高昂，因此需要大幅加速训练的方法。
AI.method: 把 SuperMimic（通过在学得世界模型的 rollout 上反向传播来训练跟踪策略）扩展到 MS-Human-700 与 MyoFullBody，并在世界模型内建模 MuJoCo 的激活动力学。加速配方：沿用为 Unitree G1 开发的加速技巧，替换其中三个在肌肉上失效的设置，并新增四项改动——不含肌肉几何的观测、数据采集与更新并行、使激励始终落在 [0,1] 的 Beta 探索噪声、50 Hz 控制。另加测试时用世界模型精修策略动作。
AI.result: 单张 RTX 5090 上，MS-Human-700 用 6.3 分钟达到 SuperMimic 已发布超参 3.9 小时的留出回报（快 37 倍），20 分钟即获得低于其 10 小时结果的跟踪误差；MyoFullBody 在不再调参下快 34 倍。消融显示：较高策略学习率使一半训练停滞；裁剪高斯噪声会引入 Beta 噪声可避免的持续性共收缩。测试时精修再降 26% 位置误差且无留出片段失败，5.1 分钟即达到原 6.3 分钟的回报。
AI.conclusion: 针对肌肉特有的失效点重设世界模型跟踪的训练配方，可把全身肌骨运动跟踪的训练成本从小时级降到分钟级，并配合测试时精修进一步提升精度；代码、配方与视频已公开。

title: Recovering What Matters, Transferring Only What Is Reliable: Toward Precise Reference-Based Super-Resolution
summary: Reference-based super-resolution (RefSR) aims to recover missing details from high-quality references. However, existing methods face two fundamental challenges. First, perceptual plausibility does not guarantee content fidelity. Existing methods often produce visually convincing details without faithfully recovering reference-specific information, such as text, codes, and identity cues. Second, faithful reference reading does not guarantee reliable information transfer. Increasing reference utilization also exposes the restoration process to misleading content, as global semantic relevance does not necessarily imply local correspondence consistency. To address these challenges, we propose PreciseRef, a reference-aware generative framework for faithful and reliable RefSR. At its core, Asymmetric Twin-Attention (ATA) allows target and reference images to participate in a unified attention space while the reference keeps its own shape. By letting their image tokens interact directly through joint attention, ATA facilitates fine-grained reference information retrieval without explicit image alignment. To ensure reliable information transfer, we introduce Dual-Scale Reference Gating (DRG), which combines Semantic Relevance Gating (SRG) to filter globally irrelevant reference context and Bidirectional Consistency Gating (BCG) to suppress unreliable local correspondences. Furthermore, we establish VeriRef, a benchmark evaluating exact reference-dependent content recovery and robustness to mismatched references. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves 85.6% character accuracy and 76.3% exact code decoding, compared with 17.4% and 0% for existing methods, while effectively suppressing erroneous reference transfer. It also achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality on CUFED5 and WR-SR.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreciseRef 参考感知生成框架，用非对称孪生注意力实现无需对齐的细粒度参考检索，并用双尺度参考门控保证可靠的信息传递，同时建立 VeriRef 基准评测精确参考内容恢复与错配鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 RefSR 方法存在两大问题：感知合理性不等于内容保真，常生成看似逼真但未忠实恢复参考特有信息（文字、编码、身份线索）的细节；忠实读取参考也不保证可靠传递，提高参考利用率会把误导内容引入恢复过程，因为全局语义相关不代表局部对应一致。
AI.method: 核心为 Asymmetric Twin-Attention (ATA)：让目标与参考图像进入统一注意力空间而参考保持自身形状，通过联合注意力令图像 token 直接交互，实现无需显式对齐的细粒度检索。为保证可靠传递，引入 Dual-Scale Reference Gating (DRG)：Semantic Relevance Gating (SRG) 过滤全局无关上下文，Bidirectional Consistency Gating (BCG) 抑制不可靠的局部对应。同时建立 VeriRef 基准。
AI.result: 字符准确率达 85.6%（现有方法 17.4%），精确编码解码率 76.3%（现有方法 0%），并有效抑制错误参考传递；在 CUFED5 与 WR-SR 上取得 SOTA 感知质量。
AI.conclusion: PreciseRef 通过联合注意力检索与双尺度门控，兼顾内容保真与传递可靠性，并借助 VeriRef 基准揭示了既有方法在参考依赖内容恢复上的严重不足。

title: Contextual language representations link narrative processing to language and literacy in children
summary: Spoken narratives extensively connect moment-to-moment language processing with knowledge accumulated through language and literacy experience. This study examined that relationship using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) during Cantonese story listening and contextual representations from large language model (LLM). The imaging cohort comprised 23 school-age children; 16 contributed complete standardized literacy and language assessments and served as held-out participants in a nested cross-subject encoding analysis of the same story. Contextual embeddings predicted distributed narrative responses, with prominent correspondence in temporoparietal and default-network parcels. Regional summaries of the top 25% of voxels ranked by held-out correlation yielded atlas-wide means of r=0.174 and partial R2=0.0165. A joint feature model identified negative surprisal and positive predictive-entropy coefficients across cortical and subcortical parcels, including control, salience, hippocampal and amygdalar regions. Higher word-dictation and overall literacy scores were associated with lower regional encoding performance. Higher Cantonese grammar scores were associated with more negative semantic-update coefficients in parietal control, somatomotor and dorsal-attention parcels. Together, these findings connect language and literacy skills to the regional strength and direction of neural coupling with narrative context. They position naturalistic context processing as a possibly measurable link between oral comprehension and literacy in childhood.

AI.tldr: 研究用fMRI记录23名学龄儿童聆听粤语故事时的大脑活动，并以大语言模型的情境嵌入作为编码模型，发现情境表征能预测分布式叙事脑响应；且读写与语法能力同区域编码强度和方向相关。
AI.motivation: 叙事理解把即时语言加工与语言/读写经验积累的知识联系起来，但儿童中这一关系及其神经基础尚不清楚，作者希望检验自然情境加工能否作为口语理解与读写能力之间可测量的联结。
AI.method: 23名学龄儿童聆听粤语故事并接受fMRI扫描，其中16人完成标准化读写与语言测评并作为嵌套跨被试编码分析的留出被试。用LLM情境嵌入预测脑响应，并构建联合特征模型（负surprisal、正预测熵等），将区域编码表现与读写、语法分数关联。
AI.result: 情境嵌入显著预测分布式叙事响应，主要在颞顶和默认网络脑区；前25%体素留出相关均值r=0.174、偏R²=0.0165；联合模型在皮层及皮层下（控制、凸显、海马、杏仁核）脑区检出负surprisal与正预测熵系数；词听写与总体读写分数越高，区域编码越弱；粤语语法分数越高，顶叶控制、感觉运动与背侧注意脑区的语义更新系数越负。
AI.conclusion: 语言与读写技能与叙事情境神经耦合的区域强度和方向相关，提示自然情境加工可能是儿童口语理解与读写之间可测量的神经桥梁。

title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Harness evolution offers a path to improving coding agents without updating model weights. However, existing methods can overfit their evolution benchmarks, producing gains that fail to carry over to new tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Transferable Harness Evolution (TransHarness), which evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts. These policies couple execution-context triggers with diagnostic guidance, enabling task-dependent checks and corrections beyond the source executions. Cross-task replay and independent semantic selection retain policies that intervene selectively and ground corrections in current-task evidence rather than source-specific solutions. We further curate an independent evolution set for cross-distribution transfer and conduct a cross-benchmark evaluation covering multiple strong models and a range of lightweight and mature harnesses. Experiments show that, with only 300 source trajectories from outside the test distribution, TransHarness further improves strong agents across distinct target benchmarks, demonstrating transferable harness evolution beyond benchmark overfitting. Specifically, TransHarness achieves state-of-the-art scores of 76.4% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 95.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, surpassing the strongest baseline model, GPT-6 Astra, by 2.4 and 5.6 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: TransHarness 提出可迁移的 harness 演化方法，用同任务的成功-失败对比演化出通用干预策略，避免在演化基准上过拟合，在跨基准测试中显著提升强编码智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 演化方法容易过拟合其演化基准，带来的增益无法迁移到新任务；作者希望在不更新模型权重的前提下，实现能跨任务/跨分布泛化的 harness 演化。
AI.method: 从同任务的成功-失败轨迹对比中演化 harness 干预策略；策略将执行上下文触发器与诊断性指导耦合，支持依赖当前任务情境的检查与纠错。采用跨任务重放与独立语义选择，只保留选择性干预、且基于当前任务证据（而非源任务特定解法）的策略。另外构建独立的演化集用于跨分布迁移，并进行覆盖多个强模型及轻量/成熟 harness 的跨基准评测。
AI.result: 仅用 300 条测试分布外的源轨迹，即可在多个不同目标基准上进一步提升强智能体。DeepSWE v1.1 达 76.4%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 达 95.5%，分别超过最强基线 GPT-6 Astra 2.4 和 5.6 个百分点，达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: TransHarness 证明 harness 演化可以突破基准过拟合，实现跨分布的可迁移提升。

title: Differentially Private Policy Optimization in Linear MDPs with Adversarial Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in personalized services often relies on sensitive interaction data. Motivated by the need to protect these data, we study differentially private (DP) policy optimization in episodic linear Markov decision processes (MDPs) with unknown transitions and adaptive adversarial linear rewards under full-information feedback. This setting poses two key challenges: past trajectories are repeatedly reused for policy evaluation, and reward choices may depend on previously released private statistics. The proposed algorithm combines batched proximal policy optimization (PPO) updates with optimistic policy evaluation, using private regression statistics and reward estimates to protect both trajectories and reward functions under joint differential privacy (JDP). With all other parameters fixed, our high-probability regret bound retains the same leading $\widetilde{O}\left(K^{3/4}\right)$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$ as the corresponding non-private bound for batched optimistic PPO. The additional privacy terms scale as $\widetilde{O} \left(K^{5/8}\right)$ and $\widetilde{O} \left(K^{1/2}\right)$. Thus, privacy incurs only lower-order additive costs in $K$, even under adaptive adversarial rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文研究情节式线性MDP（转移未知、全信息反馈、自适应对抗线性奖励）下的差分隐私策略优化，提出将批处理PPO与乐观策略评估结合、并使用私有回归统计量和奖励估计的算法，在联合差分隐私(JDP)下实现隐私保护，且隐私仅带来低阶加性悔遗憾代价。
AI.motivation: 个性化服务中的强化学习依赖敏感交互数据，需要保护这些数据。现有DP策略优化研究未充分处理该设定下的两大挑战：过去轨迹被反复复用于策略评估，以及奖励选择可能依赖先前发布的私有统计量（自适应对抗奖励）。
AI.method: 提出结合批处理近端策略优化(PPO)更新与乐观策略评估的算法；采用私有回归统计量和奖励估计，同时对轨迹与奖励函数提供保护，在联合差分隐私(JDP)框架下给出高概率遗憾界分析。
AI.result: 在其余参数固定时，高概率遗憾界保持与非私有批处理乐观PPO相同的关于情节数K的主导项Õ(K^{3/4})；额外隐私项分别为Õ(K^{5/8})和Õ(K^{1/2})。
AI.conclusion: 即使在自适应对抗奖励下，隐私代价也仅为关于K的低阶加性项，不改变主导遗憾阶数，表明在情节式线性MDP中实现JDP策略优化具有可接受的理论代价。

title: Playfulness as Feedback for Agentic Game Development
summary: Coding agents can generate runnable games from natural-language descriptions. However, a runnable game does not guarantee an excellent gameplay experience for players. In our view, a playful game should provide 1) reliable core functionality, 2) appealing visual design and assets, and 3) rich gameplay that supports exploration and progression. How agents can improve these aspects of playfulness remains underexplored. In our work, we propose Play2Evolve, a recursive game development framework with three stages: Initialization, Refinement, and Evolution. Using playfulness as feedback, agents playtest the game and diagnose issues in its functionality, visual presentation, and gameplay. Their feedback guides bug fixes and asset improvements. It also helps agents propose new gameplay and aesthetic goals for continued game evolution. To enrich game materials, we combine a video generation model with code to create appealing static and dynamic assets and integrate them into interactive gameplay. Finally, Play2Evolve achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods, scoring 60.05 on GameCraft-Bench compared with 50.81 after Game Initialization and 52.46 for Play2Code. Human overall-quality ratings reach 3.67, compared with 2.38 and 2.43, respectively. Our code will be released at https://github.com/showlab/Play2Evolve.

AI.tldr: 提出Play2Evolve递归式游戏开发框架，以"可玩性"为反馈，通过初始化、精修、演化三阶段让编码智能体迭代提升游戏功能、视觉与玩法。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体能从自然语言生成可运行游戏，但"可运行"不等于"好玩"；如何让智能体提升游戏的核心功能可靠性、视觉资产吸引力与玩法丰富度（探索与进阶）尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 递归三阶段框架：初始化、精修（Refinement）、演化（Evolution）。智能体以可玩性作为反馈进行试玩，诊断功能、视觉呈现和玩法问题，反馈驱动缺陷修复与资产改进，并据此提出新玩法与美术目标以持续演化。同时将视频生成模型与代码结合，生成有吸引力的静态与动态资产并集成到交互玩法中。
AI.result: 在GameCraft-Bench上得分60.05，优于游戏初始化后的50.81及Play2Code的52.46；人类总体质量评分达3.67，对比方法分别为2.38与2.43，取得所评估方法中的SOTA表现。
AI.conclusion: 以可玩性反馈为核心的试玩—诊断—修复—演化闭环，配合视频生成资产增强，能显著提升智能体生成游戏的功能、视觉与玩法质量；代码将于GitHub开源。

title: DiCALM: Converting Autoregressive Convolution-Attention Language Models into Discrete Diffusion Language Models
comment: To appear in Proceedings of EACL 2027 (Main conference paper)
summary: Existing methods for adapting autoregressive (AR) language models to diffusion generation focus mainly on full-attention architectures. More efficient hybrid architectures remain underexplored. We introduce DiCALM, a recipe for converting the hybrid convolution-attention models of the LFM2 family (LFM2 and LFM2.5) from AR to masked-diffusion generation. DiCALM progressively extends LFM2's causal gated convolution so that it captures local context in both directions. It combines this extension with a masking warm-up and joint AR--diffusion training. In controlled experiments, DiCALM performs comparably to the corresponding fine-tuned LFM2.5-based AR models and delivers consistent speedups over them at both the 350M and 1.2B scales: over 1.4x on average and up to 1.79x.

AI.tldr: DiCALM 提出一套将 LFM2 系列混合卷积-注意力模型从自回归转换为掩码扩散生成的方案，在 350M 和 1.2B 规模上与微调后的 AR 模型效果相当，并实现平均 1.4 倍、最高 1.79 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有将自回归语言模型适配为扩散生成的方法主要针对全注意力架构，更高效的混合架构（如卷积-注意力混合）尚未充分探索。
AI.method: DiCALM 渐进式扩展 LFM2 的因果门控卷积，使其能双向捕捉局部上下文；并结合掩码预热（masking warm-up）与 AR–扩散联合训练。
AI.result: 在受控实验中，DiCALM 与对应微调的 LFM2.5 自回归模型性能相当，且在 350M 与 1.2B 两个规模上均获得稳定加速：平均超过 1.4 倍，最高 1.79 倍。
AI.conclusion: DiCALM 表明混合卷积-注意力架构可有效转换为扩散生成，兼顾质量与推理效率，为高效扩散语言模型提供了可行路径。

title: Improving Building Energy Efficiency with an Indoor Environmental World Model and Counterfactual Adaptive Learning
summary: Optimizing indoor climate systems plays a critical role in achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals 11 and 13. However, indoor delayed thermodynamic responses and partial observability severely hinder existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods, which are primarily limited by implicit thermal inertia, occupancy dynamic prediction, and cumulative prediction errors during long-horizon rollouts. Thus, we propose a novel occupant-centric indoor climate control framework. It develops indoor environmental world models to predict future physical thermal baselines and dynamic occupancy, explicitly capturing latent thermal inertia. By formulating adaptive regulation as counterfactual advantage learning against future environments via a Branching Dueling Q-Network, and integrating a Held-Action TD-λ target, it effectively mitigates delayed credit assignment. Additionally, a proposed physics-aligned smoothness regularization suppresses high-frequency actuator fluctuations, potentially extending equipment service life. Experiments on SemiBuildingSim and Sinergym demonstrate that our method achieves a superior multi-objective trade-off. Compared to the best-performing methods, it further reduces energy consumption by 11.2%, occupant discomfort by 44.2%, and action fluctuation by 47.3%, achieving better sample efficiency and cross-region effectiveness. This interdisciplinary study offers an energy-efficient, occupant-centric AI solution for control science, building science, and energy sustainability.

AI.tldr: 提出以居住者为中心的室内气候控制框架，结合室内环境世界模型、反事实优势学习与Held-Action TD-λ目标，解决热惯性、占用动态预测与长时预测误差问题，实现能耗、舒适度与动作波动的多目标优化。
AI.motivation: 室内气候系统对SDG 11和13至关重要，但热响应延迟与部分可观测性使现有强化学习方法受限于隐式热惯性、占用动态预测困难和长时rollout的累积误差。
AI.method: 构建室内环境世界模型预测未来物理热基线与动态占用，显式捕捉潜在热惯性；将自适应调节建模为面向未来环境的反事实优势学习，采用Branching Dueling Q-Network，并引入Held-Action TD-λ目标缓解延迟信用分配；加入物理对齐的平滑正则化抑制执行器高频波动。
AI.result: 在SemiBuildingSim与Sinergym上取得更优多目标权衡：相比最佳基线，能耗降低11.2%、居住者不适降低44.2%、动作波动降低47.3%，并具备更好样本效率与跨区域有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该跨学科研究为控制科学、建筑科学与能源可持续性提供了一种节能、以居住者为中心的AI解决方案。

title: The Geometry Is the Memory: Task-Density Routing for Continual LoRA
summary: Freezing older adapters does not ensure that a continual learner will select and use them properly at inference time. When multiple adapters exist, routing among them and identifying the adapter whose representation space matches the query's answer can be difficult. We propose CONTLORA, which replaces stored examples with compact class statistics for adapter selection and classification. Gaussian class models in a frozen representation select LoRA adapters, while accumulated feature moments exactly recover a class-balanced ridge classifier for fixed training features. Trained without retaining images or feature vectors, CONTLORA reaches 88.55% accuracy on 20-task CIFAR-100 and 86.99% on CUB-200. Across three benchmarks in the matched component study, its mean final accuracy differs from an independently trained stored-feature counterpart by at most 0.07 percentage points. Ablations show that improved task coverage need not improve classification and adapter composition also matters. On held-out classes, competitor-centered likelihood scores improve novelty AUROC over raw likelihood without altering routing ranks. These results support statistical memory as an alternative to example-retention approaches in the evaluated settings, while identifying task ambiguity as an ongoing limitation.

AI.tldr: CONTLORA 用紧凑的类统计量（冻结表示下的高斯类模型＋累积特征矩）替代存储样本，来选择 LoRA 适配器并做分类，避免保留图像或特征向量。
AI.motivation: 冻结旧适配器并不能保证持续学习者在推理时正确选择并使用它们；多适配器场景下路由与判断哪个适配器表示空间匹配查询答案很困难，而示例保留法有隐私与存储代价。
AI.method: 在冻结表示中用高斯类模型选择 LoRA 适配器；累积的特征矩可精确恢复类平衡岭分类器（针对固定训练特征）。整个训练过程不保留图像或特征向量。
AI.result: 20任务 CIFAR-100 达 88.55%，CUB-200 达 86.99%；三个基准上与独立训练的存储特征对照方法平均最终精度差不超过 0.07 个百分点。消融显示任务覆盖提升不等于分类提升，适配器组合方式也重要；在留出类上，以竞争者为中心的似然分数在不改变路由排序的前提下提升新颖性 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 在评估设定下，统计记忆可作为示例保留方法的替代方案；任务歧义仍是持续局限。

title: FoamSurf: A Voronoi-Surfel Representation for Differentiable Rendering
summary:
Scenes inside a scattering medium contain solid surfaces, such as the seabed or rocks, and a semi-transparent medium, such as water, fog, or smoke. Recent Gaussian-based methods produce realistic images of scenes in scattering media, but traces of the medium can remain visible in surface-only renders. Neural fields separate surfaces and medium more accurately, but they are slow to train and difficult to edit. Both approaches evaluate the medium only along camera rays, so its effects along reflected and refracted rays are not modeled. These limitations prevent reliable surface recovery, independent editing of surfaces and the medium, and consistent rendering of inserted objects. We present FoamSurf, a hybrid representation that models surfaces with planar Gaussian surfels and the medium with space-filling Voronoi cells. A single differentiable ray tracer composites both along arbitrary rays, while training priors keep them separate without segmentation masks. Across real underwater scenes, synthetic scenes, and dense fog, FoamSurf achieves image quality on par with the state of the art and the most accurate surface-medium separation among the compared methods. The recovered components can be removed, edited, or stylized independently, and the same reconstruction supports inserted mesh objects with attenuation and scattering along both direct and reflected or refracted rays. Together, these capabilities enable scene restoration, editing, and composition within a single reconstructed model.
  Project page: https://grzegorzwilczynski.com/foamsurf/

AI.tldr: FoamSurf：用平面高斯面元表示表面、Voronoi 胞元表示散射介质，通过单一可微光线追踪器沿任意光线合成，实现表面与介质的精确解耦与独立编辑。
AI.motivation: 散射介质（水体、雾、烟）场景中需同时恢复固体表面与半透明介质。现有高斯方法在纯表面渲染中仍残留介质痕迹；神经场分离更准确但训练慢、难编辑；且两者仅在相机光线上评估介质，忽略反射/折射光线上的介质效应，导致表面恢复不可靠、无法独立编辑、插入物体渲染不一致。
AI.method: 提出混合表示：表面用平面高斯 surfel，介质用空间填充的 Voronoi 胞元；由单个可微光线追踪器沿任意光线对两者合成；借助训练先验在无分割掩码的情况下保持二者分离。
AI.result: 在真实水下场景、合成场景与浓雾中，图像质量与 SOTA 相当，且表面-介质分离精度在对比方法中最优；恢复出的分量可独立移除、编辑或风格化，同一重建支持插入网格物体，并沿直接光线与反射/折射光线正确模拟衰减与散射。
AI.conclusion: 在单一重建模型中统一实现场景恢复、编辑与合成，克服了现有高斯/神经场方法在介质光线建模与可编辑性上的局限。

title: PINN-Slicer: Exploiting Rotational Symmetry to Solve the Photon Orbit Equation Around a Black Hole
comment: 11 pages, 14 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026). Code: https://github.com/soot-bit/pinnslicer
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) typically struggle with long-horizon domains, often requiring the network to be retrained as the domain grows. We present PINN-Slicer, a method for second-order autonomous ordinary differential equations, $\ddot{u} = G(u, \dot{u})$, which exploits the invariance of this class of equations under translations of the independent variable. A single PINN, embedded within a solution ansatz that enforces the initial conditions explicitly, is trained on a thin slice of the independent variable using Sobol-sampled initial conditions. The PINN is then deployed recursively, slice-by-slice, across the full domain. We demonstrate PINN-Slicer on the nonlinear equation that describes photon orbits around a black hole, and reach a point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) below $10^{-3}$ in $u = r_s/r$ (the inverse radial coordinate in units of the Schwarzschild radius) relative to a finite-difference reference solution. A key advantage of PINN-Slicer is that a single trained network generalizes to any orbital initial condition within the training range, without retraining. In addition, PINN-Slicer can cope with solution domains that may not be known a priori.

AI.tldr: 提出 PINN-Slicer，利用二阶自主常微分方程在自变量平移下的不变性，用单个 PINN 在薄切片上训练并递归铺满全域，在黑洞光子轨道方程上达到逐点 RMSE 低于 1e-3，且单网络可泛化到训练范围内的任意初值。
AI.motivation: PINN 难以处理长时域/大定义域问题，域增长时通常需要重新训练网络，计算代价高；同时希望一个网络能覆盖多种初始条件并适应未知的解域范围。
AI.method: 针对形如 ddot{u}=G(u,dot{u}) 的二阶自主 ODE，利用方程对自变量平移的不变性；将单个 PINN 嵌入显式满足初始条件的解式（ansatz）中，在自变量的一个薄切片上用 Sobol 采样的初始条件训练，然后逐切片递归部署，滚动推进覆盖整个域。
AI.result: 在描述黑洞周围光子轨道的非线性方程上验证，相对有限差分参考解，u=r_s/r（以史瓦西半径为单位的逆径向坐标）的逐点 RMSE 低于 1e-3；单一训练好的网络无需重训即可泛化到训练范围内的任意轨道初始条件，并能处理事先未知的解域。
AI.conclusion: PINN-Slicer 通过平移不变性把长域问题化为单切片训练加递归推进，避免了重复训练，兼具初值泛化性与未知域适应性，为长时域 ODE 的物理信息求解提供了可扩展方案。

title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
comment: 21 pages (8 main + references + appendix), 9 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Maitri-Labs-Amrita/CHD-Bench
summary: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个交互式先天性心脏病(CHD)诊断基准CHD-Bench及配套开源软件CHD-Harness,让视觉语言模型(VLM)在3D Slicer环境中通过22种工具操作CT/MRI体积数据完成多标签诊断,交互式检查可使Gemini模型宏F1最多提升20分。
AI.motivation: CHD诊断需理解心脏结构空间关系,临床依赖滚动切片与旋转3D重建;自动化分割已进步,但从体积扫描诊断CHD仍是开放难题。现有两类方法依赖手工诊断规则且仅限静态解剖异常,无法捕捉需交互观察的缺陷。
AI.method: 构建CHD-Bench:覆盖3个队列247例CT/MRI、38种CHD类型的多标签任务与评测协议;开发CHD-Harness:开源的3D Slicer环境,通过22个工具驱动VLM操作,管理每例检查并记录诊断与支撑视图;对比现成医疗、开源、闭源VLM与3D CNN及规则方法。
AI.result: Gemini 4 Argon配合CHD-Harness在三个队列均取得最高宏F1(0.63、0.63、0.43);允许交互检查较静态视图宏F1最多提升20分。
AI.conclusion: CHD-Bench与CHD-Harness为开发与评估交互式CHD诊断VLM奠定基础。

title: Evaluation and Restoration of Safety in Reasoning-Tuned LLMs
comment: Main Paper: 10 Pages, 35 pages with references and appendix
summary: Open-source LLMs that are optimized for reasoning, such as VibeThinker, aim to democratize AI by bringing high-capability models to users with limited resources. They are broadly available but lack regulation and external guardrails; therefore, in order to integrate them safely into human society, it is critical that they perform in a safe manner. There are popular and intuitive arguments for why improved reasoning should improve safety, but recent evidence suggests that, in fact, the opposite may be true. This paper aims to characterize and mitigate this issue. First, it develops a metric for evaluating LLMs optimized for reasoning, and shows that increasing reasoning across multiple model families increases the unsafe rate in all cases. Second, it proposes a method for restoring safety by combining evolution strategies with a post-training guardrail (ESPG). Compared to alternative methods for safety post-training such as GRPO, ESPG is simple to implement, requires no GPU memory beyond that of inference, and works with remarkably few training samples (e.g.\ 30), yet makes the model significantly safer. The study thus establishes a path towards safe post-training of open-source AI models.

AI.tldr: 推理优化会降低开源LLM的安全性，作者提出ESPG方法以极少样本恢复安全性。
AI.motivation: 开源推理优化模型（如VibeThinker）广泛可得但缺乏监管与外部护栏，需确保其安全行为。流行观点认为推理能力提升会带来安全提升，但近期证据显示可能相反，本文旨在刻画并缓解该问题。
AI.method: 首先构建评估推理优化LLM的度量指标，跨多个模型族验证推理增强对不安全率的影响；其次提出ESPG，将进化策略与后训练护栏结合进行安全后训练。
AI.result: 在多个模型族中，推理增强均导致不安全率上升；ESPG相比GRPO等安全后训练方法实现简单，除推理外无需额外GPU显存，仅需极少训练样本（约30个）即可显著提升安全性。
AI.conclusion: 推理优化与安全性存在负相关，ESPG为开源AI模型的安全后训练提供了一条可行路径。

title: OrdiHand-GS: Ordinal-Guided Tracking and Hand-Refined Gaussian Avatars for Digital Signers
summary: Digital signers, also known as signing avatars, convey sign language through animated virtual humans, where visual fidelity and linguistic intelligibility hinge primarily on the hands. When one hand crosses over the other, two failure modes dominate. First, monocular expressive-human tracking suffers from ordinal depth ambiguity: either hand can satisfy the same 2D landmarks, and the baseline tracker orders wrists at chance level on 365 annotated overlapping frames from How2Sign. Second, hand appearance remains blurred in neural rendering even after geometry is corrected. We propose OrdiHand-GS to address these errors separately. Relative depth from a video depth estimator and apparent hand size vote, with confidence weighting and abstention, for a front-back relation, which enters expressive-human tracking as a hinge on median hand-surface depth. A source-conditioned residual head then refines the local positions of hand-associated UV Gaussians with the avatar backbone and renderer frozen. We instantiate the framework with GUAVA. Against matched unconstrained refinement, wrist-order accuracy rises from 32.9% to 77.3% at a cost of 0.39 pixels of reprojection error, while a random-sign placebo gives no balanced-accuracy gain. A 2x2 factorial evaluation attributes most of the interaction-rendering improvement to tracking-stage refinement, with a smaller additional benefit from the residual.

AI.tldr: 提出 OrdiHand-GS，分别解决手语数字人渲染中双手交叉时的两个失败模式：单目追踪的序数深度歧义（前后手判定），以及神经渲染中手部外观模糊。
AI.motivation: 数字手语人（signing avatars）的视觉保真与语言可懂度主要取决于双手。当一只手越过另一只手时存在两个主导问题：(1) 单目高表现力人体追踪存在序数深度歧义，两只手都能满足同一组2D关键点，基线追踪器在How2Sign的365帧重叠标注上判断手腕前后顺序仅为随机水平；(2) 即便几何被修正，神经渲染中手部外观仍然模糊。
AI.method: 用视频深度估计器的相对深度与手部表观尺寸投票，带置信度加权与弃权机制，得出前—后关系，作为中位手部表面深度的铰链约束进入人体追踪；随后用源条件残差头在冻结avatar骨干与渲染器的条件下，精修手相关UV高斯点的局部位置。以GUAVA为实例化框架。
AI.result: 相较匹配的无约束精修，手腕顺序准确率从32.9%提升至77.3%，重投影误差仅增加0.39像素；随机符号安慰剂未带来平衡准确率提升。2×2因子实验表明，交互渲染的改善主要来自追踪阶段精修，残差头带来较小额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 序数深度推理与冻结骨干下的手部残差精修可分别、有效地缓解双手交叉时的追踪歧义与渲染模糊问题。

title: Fine-Tuning Without Gradients? Closed-Form, LLM-Written Classifiers on a Frozen Encoder
summary: Can a classifier computed in closed form on a frozen encoder match gradient fine-tuning? We present closed-form weight-space programming (WSP): a large language model (LLM), used as a design assistant, writes programs that read a frozen masked language model through cloze-style prompt templates at several layers, fit closed-form heads (shrinkage discriminant analysis, kernel ridge regression and the encoder's label-word prior) on labelled data, and select among a pool of candidate heads by cross-fitting. No gradient is computed and no encoder weight changes. We instantiate the framework on RoBERTa-large. On 11 development datasets with 512 to 8,192 training labels, WSP is ahead of full fine-tuning (FT) and LoRA at every label budget (by 0.3 to 0.6 points on average; the registered non-inferiority tests pass) and within 0.5 points of prompt-based fine-tuning (PFT); these datasets also shaped the recipe. With fewer labels its lead over FT and LoRA grows: 1.2 to 3.5 points with 64 and 128 labels, and 3.8 to 5.3 points in the few-shot setting of 16 labels per class, where WSP is again within half a point of PFT on the development datasets. On six held-out datasets, WSP stays ahead of LoRA and within half a point of FT on average, although with six datasets no registered test passes, and PFT is ahead, by 1.30 points with 8,192 labels. WSP never collapses and is deterministic, but it needs one encoder pass per template (17 here). We report all eight recipe versions, every decision that saw test results, and 27 ideas that did not help.

AI.tldr: WSP：用LLM作为设计助手写出程序，在冻结的RoBERTa-large上通过多层cloze模板提取特征，闭式拟合多种分类头（收缩判别分析、核岭回归、标签词先验），并用交叉拟合选择；全程无梯度、无编码器更新，在多数设定下可媲美甚至超越全量微调/LoRA。
AI.motivation: 探究能否用冻结编码器上的闭式分类器匹配甚至超过梯度微调，从而避免梯度计算与编码器权重更新。
AI.method: 由LLM作为设计助手生成程序；冻结masked LM通过多层cloze式提示模板读取表示；在标注数据上闭式拟合收缩判别分析、核岭回归及编码器标签词先验等头；用交叉拟合在候选头池中选择。无梯度、无权重更新，代价是每个模板一次编码器前向（此处17次）。
AI.result: 在11个开发集（512–8192标签）上，WSP在每个标签预算下均优于FT与LoRA（平均0.3–0.6分，非劣性检验通过），与PFT差距在0.5分内；标签更少时优势扩大（64/128标签领先1.2–3.5分，每类16样本少样本下领先3.8–5.3分且仍在PFT的0.5分内）。在6个留出集上WSP优于LoRA、与FT平均差距在半分内，但无检验通过，PFT领先（8192标签时1.30分）。
AI.conclusion: 闭式WSP是确定性、永不崩溃的可行替代方案，在低标签预算下优势明显，但多模板需多次编码器前向，且在留出集上未通过注册检验、仍逊于PFT。论文完整报告了8个配方版本、所有接触测试结果的决策及27个无效想法。

title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
comment: 31 pages including appendices, 2 figures. Author-accepted version of an article published in IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering
summary:
Objective: To develop and validate InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular electronic health records (EHRs) and longitudinal trajectories for scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models.
  Methods: An optional large language model (LLM) parser converts clinical requests into structured constraints. Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records, while diffusion models generate longitudinal trajectories. We evaluate parsing, distributional fidelity, imputation, clinical-constraint adherence, mortality prediction, and clinical plausibility using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 patients receiving venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO).
  Results: Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the highest parsing performance with a low spurious slot rate. IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE perform well in single-time-point generation; IGE-CSDI, IGE-FGTI, and IGE-MTSCI lead on different longitudinal fidelity metrics. Across five random seeds and three classifiers, synthetic cohorts retain predictive utility for mortality prediction on real test data. Clinician ratings support trajectory plausibility and alignment with requested scenarios.
  Conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$ supports clinician-specified generation of EHR trajectories with statistical fidelity and downstream predictive utility in the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort. Extension to other clinical settings requires further validation.
  Significance: The framework supports scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.

AI.tldr: InterGenEHR$^+$ 是一个可根据自然语言临床场景请求，生成合成表格 EHR 与纵向轨迹的交互式框架，并在 VV-ECMO 队列中验证了解析、保真度、临床约束遵循与下游预测效用。
AI.motivation: 数据稀疏的重症监护场景下，缺乏可用于场景化评估机器学习模型的真实 EHR 数据，需要能按临床需求定制生成合成数据的方法。
AI.method: 可选的 LLM 解析器将临床请求转为结构化约束；用条件 VAE 与扩散模型生成单时间点记录，用扩散模型生成纵向轨迹。在 874 例 VV-ECMO 患者的多机构队列上评估解析性能、分布保真度、插补、临床约束遵循、死亡预测与临床合理性。
AI.result: Gemma 3 4B 少样本提示解析表现最佳且虚假槽率低；IGE-TabDDPM 与 IGE-PMVAE 在单时间点生成上表现良好，IGE-CSDI、IGE-FGTI、IGE-MTSCI 各在部分纵向保真度指标上领先；在 5 个随机种子与 3 个分类器下合成队列在真实测试集上仍保持死亡预测效用；临床医生评分支持轨迹合理性与场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$ 能在所评估的 VV-ECMO 队列中支持临床医生指定的 EHR 轨迹生成，兼具统计保真度与下游预测效用，但推广至其他临床场景仍需进一步验证。

title: A Perturbation-Driven Framework for Sensitivity Analysis of Dimensionality Reduction
comment: This manuscript is currently under review
summary: Low-dimensional representations produced by dimensionality reduction (DR) are commonly evaluated using distortion measures such as trustworthiness and continuity. In this paper, we study the sensitivity of DR methods to plausible input variations by quantifying changes in structural preservation and visually diagnosing how these changes manifest in the resulting representations. This perspective reflects the fact that real-world datasets are finite, noisy samples of an underlying distribution, and DR should not produce substantially different structures under small data changes. We introduce a model-agnostic, perturbation-driven sensitivity evaluation framework that treats perturbations as controlled probes of plausible data variation. Across multiple perturbation families and strength levels, we repeatedly perturb the input, apply a DR method, and evaluate the resulting low-dimensional representations using a set of distortion measures to derive sensitivity profiles for each DR method. We demonstrate the utility of our framework through case studies on DR method comparison, behavior analysis, and robustness improvement. We find that methods performing well according to conventional distortion measures (e.g., t-SNE) can still exhibit substantial sensitivity, leading to instability in visually salient structures such as trajectories and clusters, while certain methods (e.g., multidimensional scaling) may exhibit improved structural preservation under specific perturbations. These results highlight the importance of sensitivity analysis for comparing DR methods, diagnosing perturbation-sensitive visual patterns, and guiding the development of more robust DR methods toward trustworthy visual analytics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个与模型无关、以扰动为驱动的敏感性评估框架，通过量化降维结果在输入微小变化下结构保持度的变化，揭示传统失真指标难以反映的不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 真实数据集只是潜在分布的有限含噪样本，降维方法不应对小的数据变化产生显著不同的结构。但常用的trustworthiness、continuity等失真指标仅评估单次结果的结构保持，无法反映方法对合理输入扰动的敏感性。
AI.method: 构建模型无关的扰动驱动评估框架：将扰动视为对合理数据变化的受控探针，在多种扰动族和强度水平下反复扰动输入、运行降维方法，并用一组失真度指标评估低维表示，从而为每种降维方法得到敏感性剖面；再通过可视化诊断变化如何在表示中体现。
AI.result: 案例研究覆盖降维方法比较、行为分析与鲁棒性改进。发现传统失真指标表现良好的方法（如t-SNE）仍可能高度敏感，导致轨迹、簇等视觉显著结构不稳定；而某些方法（如MDS）在特定扰动下结构保持反而提升。
AI.conclusion: 敏感性分析对降维方法比较、诊断扰动敏感的视觉模式以及指导更鲁棒降维方法的发展具有重要意义，有助于实现可信的可视分析。

title: SplatWAM: Splatting World Action Models for Real-Time 3D Imagination
summary: World models typically predict future observations in pixel or latent space, limiting their ability to directly represent true 3D scene evolution. We present SplatWAM (Splatting World Action Model), a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives. A tokenizer SplatWAM-T first encodes a variable number of unposed views into a fixed budget of Gaussian tokens. A dynamics model SplatWAM-D then predicts future Gaussian states in a single forward pass per action, using log-Euclidean covariance coordinates and differentiable rendering supervision to facilitate learning in an explicit 3D space. Each predicted state can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints, enforcing a shared 3D representation across views by construction. On OGBench Scene, SplatWAM renders novel views 12x faster than video world models (~80 FPS on an RTX 5090) with up to 2.0 dB higher PSNR. We further introduce SplatWAM-P, a lightweight flow-matching policy head jointly trained with the dynamics model. Across 8 task suites, model-free Gaussian-token policies outperform pixel-based counterparts by up to 24.8 percentage points. SplatWAM-P improves over Latent Particle World Model (LPWM) by 12 percentage points and matches HIQL without a learned value function. On LIBERO, our ~1B model outperforms WorldVLA (~7B) and the robot-pretrained OpenVLA (~7B), while matching OpenVLA-OFT when both are trained without large-scale robot pretraining. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: SplatWAM 是一个直接在紧凑 3D 高斯原语上学习动作条件动力学的生成式世界模型，支持任意视角渲染，并在渲染速度、视觉质量与策略性能上超越视频/像素世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在像素或潜空间预测未来观测，难以直接表示真实三维场景演化，跨视角一致性差且渲染效率低。作者希望在世界模型层面直接以显式 3D 表示建模动力学。
AI.method: 提出 SplatWAM 框架：SplatWAM-T 作为 tokenizer，将任意数量的无位姿视角编码为固定预算的高斯 token；SplatWAM-D 作为动力学模型，在每个动作下单次前向预测未来高斯状态，采用对数欧氏协方差坐标与可微渲染监督在显式 3D 空间学习；预测状态可任意视角光栅化，天然保证跨视角共享 3D 表示。另提出 SplatWAM-P，与动力学模型联合训练的轻量 flow-matching 策略头。
AI.result: 在 OGBench Scene 上，新视角渲染比视频世界模型快 12 倍（RTX 5090 上约 80 FPS），PSNR 最高提升 2.0 dB；在 8 个任务套件上，无模型高斯 token 策略比像素策略高最多 24.8 个百分点；SplatWAM-P 比 LPWM 高 12 个百分点，且无价值函数即匹配 HIQL。在 LIBERO 上，约 1B 的模型超过 WorldVLA（约 7B）与机器人预训练 OpenVLA（约 7B），在均无大规模机器人预训练时与 OpenVLA-OFT 持平。
AI.conclusion: 直接在 3D 高斯原语上建模世界动力学可行且高效，兼具更快渲染、更高视觉质量与更强策略性能，并可支撑轻量策略头实现高效决策，为显式 3D 世界模型提供了有前景的方向。

title: Auto-Features: An LLM-Assisted Corpus for Contextual Recognition of Standard and Optional Car Features
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 18 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables
summary: We present Auto-Features, a corpus for detecting a car's standard and optional features in advertisement text, given the feature catalogue of that exact vehicle. Sellers name the same feature in many ways. We therefore cast the task as feature-conditioned, or contextual, named entity recognition: extract the span that expresses one given catalogue feature. An entity-linking view follows from the same output. The corpus has a human-gold layer (430 adverts) from screened annotators and an LLM-silver layer (925 adverts) auto-annotated by a search-grounded LLM. We also contribute the way it was built. Every LLM output is validated, and each kind of failure has its own remedy. Malformed output is patched. Hallucinated content triggers a fresh attempt by a stronger model. Links to features outside the candidate list are dropped and counted (3 in 10,928 records). The LLM annotates alone only after its agreement with human annotators on link verification is comparable to human-human agreement. On advert-disjoint splits, a LoRA-tuned 4B LLM reaches 63.9% span F1 and 76.1% on the entity-linking view. A fine-tuned encoder reaches 59.0% and 74.1%. The margin is widest on catalogue features never seen in training (54.5% vs. 49.0%).

AI.tldr: 提出Auto-Features语料库，将汽车广告中卖点特征的识别建模为"特征条件命名实体识别"，提供人工金标与LLM银标两层数据及可靠构建流程。
AI.motivation: 卖家在广告中用多种说法描述同一汽车配置特征，需要依据精确车型的特征目录来检测标准与选配功能。现有方法缺乏针对该任务的语料与可靠标注手段。
AI.method: 构建语料：人工金标层（430条广告，经筛选的标注员）与LLM银标层（925条广告，由检索增强的LLM自动标注）。任务形式化为特征条件NER（提取表达给定目录特征的片段），并可扩展为实体链接。标注流程含多重校验：格式错误修补、幻觉内容由更强模型重试、候选列表外的链接被丢弃并计数（10,928条中仅3条），且LLM仅在链接验证上与人类一致性达到人际水平后才独立标注。
AI.result: 在广告不相交划分上，LoRA微调的4B LLM达63.9% span F1，实体链接视角76.1%；微调编码器为59.0%与74.1%。对训练中未见的目录特征差距最大（54.5% vs 49.0%）。
AI.conclusion: Auto-Features为特征条件NER/实体链接提供了高质量语料与可复用的标注构建方法，4B级LLM微调已优于编码器基线，且在未见特征泛化上优势更明显。

title: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
summary: We present ExtractBench Pro, a schema-guided document extraction benchmark that tests six challenging modes of extraction underrepresented in existing datasets. It is created following a framework for synthetic document generation, in which deterministic document generators assemble challenging components into documents that are designed to be difficult at a level calibrated for frontier systems. We synthesize 100 realistic documents spanning a diverse range of styles. On this data, we evaluate ten coding agents and eight extraction API configurations for accuracy, grounding, and their ability to perfectly extract documents. No extraction system extracts more than 61% of documents error-free. The strongest general-purpose coding agents, Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra, outperform specialized extraction APIs on both perfect-document rate and Value F1, but at a higher cost per page. Among specialized extraction APIs, LlamaExtract spans the lower-cost frontier, with Agentic Plus Max Effort approaching the strongest coding agent on both perfect-document rate and Value F1 at lower cost per page. Our analysis of coding agent traces identifies intelligent image processing and programmatic reasoning, but also failures in applying document-specific definitions and recovering relationships from diagrams. We release ExtractBench Pro and these evaluation results as resources for the future development of improved frontier extraction systems.

AI.tldr: 提出ExtractBench Pro——一个模式引导的文档抽取基准，覆盖六种被现有数据集低估的困难抽取模式，合成100份高难度文档，评测10个编码智能体与8种抽取API配置。没有任何系统能无错抽取超过61%的文档。
AI.motivation: 现有文档抽取数据集对若干困难抽取模式覆盖不足，且缺少能对标前沿系统能力上限、按难度校准的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建合成文档生成框架：用确定性生成器将挑战性组件组装成文档，难度按前沿系统水平校准；合成100份风格多样的真实感文档；在准确率、grounding和"完全无错抽取率"三项指标上评测10个编码智能体与8种抽取API配置，并分析编码智能体的执行轨迹。
AI.result: 无任何系统对超过61%的文档实现无错抽取。最强通用编码智能体（Claude Code Opus 5.5、Codex GPT-6 Astra）在完全无错率与Value F1上均超过专用抽取API，但单页成本更高；专用API中LlamaExtract处于低成本前沿，Agentic Plus Max Effort以更低单页成本接近最强编码智能体。轨迹分析显示智能体具备智能图像处理与程序化推理能力，但在应用文档特定定义、从图表恢复关系上存在失败。
AI.conclusion: ExtractBench Pro及评测结果公开，作为推动前沿抽取系统改进的资源；同时揭示通用编码智能体与专用API在精度—成本上的权衡格局。

title: Deletion You Can Check: Auditing LLM Unlearning
comment: Accepted at 4th International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM2026)
summary: A common indication that a fine-tuned model has forgotten a deleted record is a membership-inference score near chance (ROC-AUC $\approx 0.5$). This reading is sound only if the comparison population represents how the record should behave after a valid deletion---a counterfactual that is rarely validated. We test this premise in a controlled $2\times2$ study pairing two membership-inference benchmarks, ArxivMIA and BookMIA, with two language models, Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B. Exact retraining validates the membership reference: it lies within the prespecified chance band on ArxivMIA but reaches $0.122$ on BookMIA, causing the same metric to reject an empirical deletion reference. A post-hoc BookMIA/Qwen diagnostic replaces benchmark label-0 records with same-pool, never-fine-tuned records and moves the reference from $0.257$ to $0.523$, supporting population mismatch in that cell. Each approximate-unlearning checkpoint is judged jointly on membership removal, deletion-targeted shift beyond non-deletion variation, and utility. On the admitted ArxivMIA/Llama axis, no tested configuration of gradient ascent with retain descent (GA+GD), negative-preference optimization with retain training (NPO-RT), or teacher--student unlearning (SCRUB) passes. A score near chance is not evidence of forgetting until a reference establishes what chance means.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑"成员推理分数接近随机水平(ROC-AUC≈0.5)即说明模型已遗忘被删记录"这一常见判断，通过受控2×2实验发现该前提仅在参考群体有效时成立。
AI.motivation: 现有文献常把成员推理接近随机水平当作遗忘成功的标志，但这只有当比较群体真正代表"合法删除后的反事实行为"时才合理，而这一前提很少被验证。作者要检验该前提是否成立。
AI.method: 采用2×2受控研究，配对两个MIA基准(ArxivMIA、BookMIA)与两个模型(Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B)。用精确重训练验证成员参考是否落在预设随机区间内；再做事后BookMIA/Qwen诊断，将基准label-0记录替换为同池、从未微调的记录。每个近似遗忘检查点从成员移除、删除目标偏移(超出非删除变动)和效用三方面联合评估。
AI.result: 精确重训练在ArxivMIA上落在预设随机区间内，但在BookMIA上达到0.122，导致同一指标拒绝了一个经验删除参考。事后诊断把BookMIA/Qwen的参考从0.257移到0.523，支持该单元存在群体不匹配。在被认可的ArxivMIA/Llama轴上，GA+GD、NPO-RT、SCRUB均未通过。
AI.conclusion: 在参考确立"随机"含义之前，接近随机的分数不能作为遗忘的证据；结论取决于参考群体是否正确代表有效删除后的反事实。

title: Streaming Tax: Can Streaming VLMs Replace Their Offline Parents?
summary: Most vision-language models (VLMs) specialize in offline video understanding; in contrast, their post-trained versions, streaming VLMs, can perform live interactions. We investigate whether streaming VLMs can replace their offline parent models on offline tasks. Such replacement could reduce deployment costs and improve efficiency. We propose Streaming Tax to systematically evaluate streaming VLMs on offline tasks. Our exploration spans three core dimensions: understanding, trustworthiness, and generalization across 15 benchmarks. Our findings reveal a critical gap between offline capability preservation and practical replaceability. This gap emerges at two stages: streaming adaptation can alter trustworthy behavior even when offline understanding is largely preserved, while the native streaming protocol can introduce further performance losses. Our analyses show that some of these losses arise from restricted access to historical visual evidence and failures to deliver usable responses. Importantly, regarding safety, streaming models often leave both harmful and legitimate requests unanswered rather than genuinely refusing unsafe ones. We then propose Stream++, a training-free plugin to improve streaming VLMs on offline tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Streaming Tax"系统评估流式VLM能否替代离线父模型完成离线任务，覆盖理解、可信度与泛化15个基准，揭示离线能力保持与实际可替代性之间存在两阶段差距，并提出免训练插件Stream++予以改善。
AI.motivation: 流式VLM可实时交互，若能直接替代离线模型可降低部署成本、提升效率，但其在离线任务上的可靠性尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 构建Streaming Tax评估框架，从理解、可信度、泛化三个维度在15个基准上对比流式模型与其离线父模型；分析性能损失来源，并提出免训练插件Stream++。
AI.result: 差距分两阶段出现：流式适配在离线理解基本保持时已改变可信行为；原生流式协议又带来额外性能损失。损失原因包括历史视觉证据访问受限及无法给出可用回答；安全方面，流式模型对有害与合理请求常均不回答，而非真正拒答不安全请求。
AI.conclusion: 流式VLM尚不能简单替代离线父模型，需关注可信度与协议层损失；Stream++作为免训练插件可缓解离线任务性能下降。

title: Residual Cross-Model Narrative Convergence under Shared Prompts: Auditing Prompt Controls and Narrative Measurement
summary: Stories created by LLMs based on the same prompts can be narratively similar to one another. This similarity may reflect constraints imposed by the prompts as well as the models' writing tendencies. The current research analyzes 51,240 stories created by five models in the StoryScope corpus based on 10,248 common prompts. It uses 213 narrative features in seven dimensions to compare cross-model distances between stories generated from the same prompts with distances between stories generated from different but semantically matched prompts. To assess the relationship between narrative features and prompt content, a semantic relevance mask was evaluated against 420 author-annotated prompt-feature judgments (F1 = .813; near-threshold accuracy = .621). The equally weighted mean Residual Convergence Index (RCI) was .409 without masking and .406 with masking. These findings indicate measurable cross-model narrative convergence relative to a semantically matched-prompt baseline, with little change following semantic relevance masking.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析五款大模型基于10,248个共同提示生成的51,240篇故事，用213个叙事特征在七个维度上比较"同提示跨模型"与"语义匹配的不同提示"之间的叙事距离，发现存在可测量的跨模型叙事趋同（RCI≈0.41），且语义相关性掩码几乎不改变结论。
AI.motivation: 大模型针对相同提示生成的故事往往在叙事上彼此相似，这种相似性可能来自提示本身的约束，也可能来自模型固有的写作倾向。作者希望区分二者，检验跨模型叙事趋同是否真实存在。
AI.method: 使用StoryScope语料中5个模型基于10,248个共同提示生成的51,240篇故事；提取七个维度共213个叙事特征；比较"同一提示"与"语义匹配的不同提示"下的跨模型故事距离；构建语义相关性掩码，并以420条作者标注的提示—特征判断进行评估（F1=0.813，近阈值准确率=0.621），对比掩码前后的等权平均残差收敛指数（RCI）。
AI.result: 无掩码时等权平均RCI为0.409，掩码后为0.406，两者几乎无差异；掩码本身在人工标注上表现良好（F1=0.813）。
AI.conclusion: 相对于语义匹配提示基线，跨模型叙事趋同是可测量的；但剔除与提示内容语义相关的特征后，趋同程度几乎不变，说明该趋同不能主要归因于提示约束，而更多反映模型共享的写作倾向。

title: Keep or Roll Back? Out-of-Loop Judges for Self-Improving VLA and End-to-End Embodied Policies
summary: Self-improvement is now a practical recipe for embodied policies: a policy collects experience, is retrained, and is kept when a judge rates it higher. However, the judge is usually trained or chosen inside the same loop, so its evidence is not independent of the policy. We introduce SealedLoop, an evaluation framework that adds a sealed judge: an evaluator outside the loop that the improver cannot see or optimize against. A new policy is kept only when a sequential test on the sealed judge confirms the gain, with a bounded probability of keeping a worse one. Running the same loop under each judge, we separate two sources of a false gain, which we call judge error (the loop's judge is wrong on its own data) and transfer gap (a real gain there does not carry over to unseen conditions). We evaluate on LIBERO manipulation, NAVSIM driving, and a full-scale real vehicle. In manipulation, a success classifier accepted 65 of 196 failures in one generation. In driving, policies that gain on the loop's own frames lose in an unseen city, so even an exact in-loop judge would keep 8/15 of them. When the sealed test decides, a driving loop built to improve ends with a better policy than under its own critic (0.674 against 0.649 PDMS, from 0.638), and on driving pairs with known sealed gain the test accepted 11 of 12 real gains and none of 59 losses. In a real-world field experiment on a published improvement step, the reinforced version drove further into a curve than the version it started from in all 6 blind pairs, though neither completed it. These results show that evidence from inside the loop, however accurate, is not enough to decide whether a policy has improved. SealedLoop offers a foundation for trustworthy self-improvement of embodied policies, in which progress is judged by evidence the improving system cannot influence.

AI.tldr: 提出 SealedLoop 评估框架，用"闭环外、改进者不可见"的密封评审（sealed judge）加序贯检验来决定是否保留新策略，从而把虚假增益分解为评审误差与迁移差距，并在 LIBERO、NAVSIM 与真实车辆上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 具身策略自改进通常由同一循环内的评审打分，证据不独立于策略，无法可靠判定策略是否真的变好。
AI.method: 引入闭环之外的密封评审，改进者不可见也不能针对其优化；仅在密封评审上通过序贯检验且有界错误概率时才保留新策略；在同一循环下分别替换评审以分离"评审误差"与"迁移差距"。
AI.result: 操纵任务中成功分类器在一代里把 196 个失败中的 65 个误判为成功；驾驶任务中在自身帧上增益的策略在陌生城市失效，即使评审完全精确也会保留 8/15；密封检验下驾驶循环从 0.638 提升到 0.674 PDMS（优于自有 critics 的 0.649），并接受 12 个真实增益中的 11 个、拒绝全部 59 个损失；真实车辆盲测 6/6 对均比起点更深入弯道。
AI.conclusion: 闭环内部的证据即便准确也不足以判断策略是否改进，进度须由改进系统无法影响的外部证据裁定；SealedLoop 为具身策略的可信自改进提供基础。

title: Casper: A Projection-Based Neurosymbolic Layer for Scalable & Guaranteed Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Many real-world problems demand exact constraint satisfaction to be meaningfully solved, yet existing neurosymbolic methods face a stark trade-off: those that guarantee satisfaction fail to scale, while those that scale must resort to approximation. Meanwhile, traditional deep learning approaches offer no satisfaction guarantees at all. In this paper, we propose Casper, a neurosymbolic layer that simultaneously (i) guarantees constraint satisfaction, (ii) scales at inference time, (iii) is fully automated, requiring no problem-specific engineering, and (iv) is fully differentiable, making it composable with any neural predictor both at training and at inference time. Casper casts constraint satisfaction as a closed-form Euclidean projection onto the constraint-feasible region, computable in a single forward pass. Experiments across MNIST arithmetic (up to 1024 digits), Sudoku solving, and Warcraft pathfinding show that Casper is the only method that produces guaranteed-valid outputs at scale: on $30\times30$ Warcraft grids, exact baselines time out and approximate ones produce valid paths less than 7% of the time, while Casper produces them 100% of the time.

AI.tldr: Casper 是一种神经符号层，将约束满足建模为闭式欧几里得投影，单次前向即可计算，兼具约束保证、可扩展、全自动与可微性，在大规模任务上优于精确与近似基线。
AI.motivation: 现实问题常需严格满足约束才能有意义地求解，但现有神经符号方法存在两难：保证满足的方法无法扩展，可扩展的方法只能近似；传统深度学习则完全不提供满足保证。
AI.method: 作者提出神经符号层 Casper，把约束满足转化为向约束可行域的闭式欧几里得投影，可在单次前向传播中完成计算；该层全自动、无需问题特定工程，且完全可微，训练和推理阶段均可与任意神经预测器组合。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 算术（最多 1024 位）、数独求解和魔兽争霸寻路任务上，Casper 是唯一能在大规模下产出保证有效输出的方法：30×30 网格上精确基线超时，近似方法有效路径比例不足 7%，而 Casper 达到 100%。
AI.conclusion: Casper 同时实现了约束满足保证、推理可扩展性、全自动和无缝集成，为神经符号系统的实用化提供了新思路。

title: Memory as the Backbone: A Dual-Store Associative Memory Architecture for Visual Recognition
summary: We investigate whether explicit memory can serve as the organizing principle of a general-purpose visual backbone. Inspired by the interaction between working and long-term memory in human cognition, we introduce DuSAM (Dual-Store Associative Memory), a hierarchical memory-native visual backbone coupling image-local working memory (WM) with a fixed-capacity persistent semantic memory (PM). WM organizes local visual evidence into compact, spatially anchored states that are updated and transported across stages, then read back to refine dense features. PM consolidates semantic evidence from training images and annotated regions into prototypes, whose retrieved content enriches the same working states. With these memory operations in place of self-attention or state-space blocks, DuSAM achieves competitive performance relative to representative, similarly sized backbones on ImageNet-1K classification, ADE20K semantic segmentation, and COCO object detection and instance segmentation. Ablations show contributions from both stores, with PM particularly benefiting class groups with fewer annotated training pixels. At $2048\times2048$, the complete DuSAM-based UPerNet segmentor achieves $2.36\times$ the throughput of the evaluated DeiT-S/16 counterpart while using $59.5\%$ less GPU memory, and $1.24\times$ the throughput of the linear-complexity VMamba-T. Memory analyses reveal spatially selective WM access and semantic associations between retrieved prototypes and training regions. Class-targeted removal and restoration further demonstrate that category-specific experience can be replenished through state updates without changing network parameters. These results establish explicit memory as a viable organizing principle for visual backbones and provide a foundation for jointly designing contextual computation and addressable semantic memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DuSAM（双存储联想记忆），一种以显式记忆为组织原则的层次化视觉骨干网络，将图像局部工作记忆（WM）与固定容量的持久语义记忆（PM）耦合，替代自注意力或状态空间模块，在分类、分割、检测任务上取得与同规模骨干相当的性能，并在高分辨率下显著提升吞吐、降低显存。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉骨干普遍以自注意力或状态空间块作为核心组织原则，缺乏显式、可寻址的记忆机制。作者受人类认知中工作记忆与长期记忆交互的启发，探索显式记忆能否成为通用视觉骨干的组织原则。
AI.method: DuSAM由两个存储构成：图像局部工作记忆（WM）将局部视觉证据组织为紧凑、空间锚定的状态，并在各阶段间更新、传输，再读回以精炼稠密特征；持久语义记忆（PM）以固定容量存储从训练图像及标注区域整合出的语义原型，检索到的内容用于丰富同一工作状态。以这些记忆操作替代自注意力/状态空间块，构建层次化骨干。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K分类、ADE20K语义分割、COCO检测与实例分割上，DuSAM与代表性同规模骨干性能相当。消融显示两个存储均有贡献，PM对标注像素较少的类别提升尤为明显。2048×2048下，完整DuSAM UPerNet分割器吞吐为DeiT-S/16的2.36倍且显存少59.5%，为线性复杂度VMamba-T的1.24倍。记忆分析揭示WM的空间选择性访问及检索原型与训练区域的语义关联；类别定向移除与恢复实验表明无需更改网络参数即可通过状态更新补充类别特定经验。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式记忆是视觉骨干可行的组织原则，为联合设计上下文计算与可寻址语义记忆提供了基础。

title: Evaluating Ukrainian Grammatical Competence in Language Models: Probability Versus Prompting
