comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Presented at CITI-2026: 4th International Conference on Computer Information Technologies in Industry 4.0 (Ternopil, Ukraine, November 4-6, 2026); to appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings. Data and code: https://github.com/DmytroBabarytskyi/ukrainian-minimal-pairs
summary: Organisations deploying large language models in Ukrainian-language information systems need to know whether a model produces normative Ukrainian. This paper establishes a protocol for measuring that reliably and applies it to 19 models. The instrument is a released set of 1,444 Ukrainian minimal pairs covering the vocative case, numeral-noun and adjective agreement, verb government and calques from russian, with subject-verb agreement as a control; a quarter of the set was checked against the answer key in two independent native-speaker ratings, which agreed at Cohen's $κ$ = 0.963. Every pair is scored twice: by comparing the probabilities a model assigns to the two sentences, and by asking the model directly, with the sentences presented in both orders so that answer-position effects are measured instead of being absorbed into the score. Three results follow. Order consistency (the share of pairs answered identically when the sentences are exchanged) falls below 0.05 for ten of the nineteen models, and what separates the usable models is instruction tuning, not scale. The vocative case is systematically inverted: 0.153 accuracy against 0.951 on the control, with models preferring the non-normative nominative form of address. Ukrainian adaptation substantially reduces this deficit, measured against the exact checkpoints two adapted models were trained from.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套可靠测量大语言模型乌克兰语规范性的协议，并应用于19个模型；发现多数模型存在严重的答案顺序不稳定性与呼格系统性错误，而指令微调（非规模）和乌克兰语适配是关键改善因素。
AI.motivation: 在乌克兰语信息系统中部署大语言模型的机构需要知道模型是否产出规范乌克兰语，但此前缺乏可靠、可复现的测量方法。
AI.method: 发布1,444组乌克兰语最小对立对，覆盖呼格、数词-名词与形容词一致、动词支配、俄语仿译（calques），并以主谓一致作对照；其中四分之一由两位母语者独立评分校验（Cohen's κ=0.963）。每对句子两种方式评分：比较模型对两句的概率，以及直接提问；两种呈现顺序均测试，以显式测量答案位置效应。
AI.result: 19个模型中有10个的顺序一致性低于0.05；区分可用模型的是指令微调而非规模。呼格系统性反转（准确率0.153 vs 对照组0.951），模型偏好非规范的呼格主格形式。乌克兰语适配可显著缩小该差距（依据两个适配模型训练前的精确checkpoint对比）。
AI.conclusion: 乌克兰语规范性测量需要同时控制答案位置效应与人类校验；指令微调和语言适配比模型规模更决定可用性，且呼格是系统性薄弱点。

title: Ensuring Deployment-Time Safety of Neural Network Controlled Systems via Localized Certificate Repair
summary: Barrier certificates provide formal safety guarantees for neural network controlled systems by ensuring that system trajectories avoid unsafe regions over time. However, after deployment, previously unseen obstacles or constraint changes may introduce new unsafe regions, invalidating the original certificate and potentially leading to unsafe behavior. We address this setting with adaptive piecewise barrier certificates, which preserve the original certificate and policy in unchanged regions while introducing localized updates around newly emerged unsafe regions. The central question is how to perform such updates efficiently during system execution without retraining from scratch. Our key idea is to cast deployment-time adaptation as a localized certificate repair problem and reduce it to an optimization task that leverages the learned structure of previous barrier certificates, enabling fast updates without global retraining. We further design a staged repair framework that progressively transitions from localized repair to joint policy-certificate updates and, when necessary, localized retraining. Empirical results on four benchmarks with five new obstacles show that our method succeeds in all cases and completes within tens of seconds on average, whereas retraining from scratch fails in most cases. On instances where retraining succeeds, our method is 17.3$\times$ faster on average. It incurs only 16.2% performance degradation relative to the original policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应分段屏障证书（adaptive piecewise barrier certificates），将部署时新障碍/约束变化引发的安全自适应转化为局部化证书修复问题，通过分阶段修复框架在数十秒内完成更新，无需全局重训练。
AI.motivation: 神经网络控制系统部署后可能遇到未见过的障碍或约束变化，产生新的不安全区域，使原有屏障证书失效并可能导致不安全行为。核心问题是：如何在系统运行过程中高效更新证书，而不是从头重训练。
AI.method: 保留未变化区域的原始证书与策略，仅在新出现的不安全区域周围做局部更新（自适应分段屏障证书）；将部署时自适应建模为局部化证书修复问题，并归约为一个利用已有屏障证书学习结构的优化任务；设计分阶段修复框架，逐步从局部修复过渡到策略-证书联合更新，必要时再进行局部重训练。
AI.result: 在四个基准、五个新障碍的实验中全部成功，平均数十秒内完成；从头重训练在多数情况下失败，在重训练成功的实例上本方法平均快17.3倍，且相对原策略仅有16.2%的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 将部署时自适应形式化为局部证书修复并利用已有证书结构，可实现对未知不安全区域快速、可靠的在线安全保障，显著优于全局重训练。

title: DiffER$^2$: Diffusion Ensembles for Retrosynthesis Prediction with SMILES Adapted Particle Guidance
summary: Computational retrosynthesis prediction has the potential to reduce development time for newly discovered drugs by automatically generating potential reactions for a target product. Data-driven approaches commonly treat this as a sequence-to-sequence generation task on SMILES strings. In this work, we construct ensembles of discrete-time and continuous-time diffusion models for molecular generation and incorporate guidance mechanisms for improved output diversity. We propose an adaptation of particle guidance to SMILES sequence generation which significantly improves the number of unique molecules generated by diffusion ensembles while increasing top-k accuracy. These results further expand the efficacy of discrete diffusion for SMILES generation, and our empirical analyses offer new insights into the capabilities of diffusion models for chemical retrosynthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文构建离散时间与连续时间扩散模型的集成，并引入粒子引导(particle guidance)机制，用于SMILES序列的逆合成预测，在提高唯一分子数量的同时提升top-k准确率。
AI.motivation: 计算逆合成预测可缩短新药研发时间，自动为目标产物生成候选反应。现有数据驱动方法多将逆合成视为SMILES字符串的序列到序列生成，输出多样性不足。
AI.method: 将逆合成建模为SMILES序列生成；构建离散时间与连续时间扩散模型的集成；加入引导机制提升多样性；并针对SMILES序列生成改造粒子引导方法。
AI.result: 改造后的粒子引导在扩散集成中显著增加生成的唯一分子数量，同时提升top-k准确率；经验分析揭示了扩散模型在化学逆合成中的能力特点。
AI.conclusion: 结果拓展了离散扩散在SMILES生成上的有效性，并为扩散模型用于化学逆合成提供了新见解。

title: EvOrderBench: When do sampled frames establish event order?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often asked which of two actions in a video happened first, given only a few sampled frames. Such frames can show that both actions occurred without showing which came first, so a reliable model should state an order only when the frames establish it. Forced-choice temporal benchmarks treat every input as answerable and reward lucky guesses, while answerability benchmarks do not separate frames that miss an action from frames that show both actions but not their order. We introduce EvOrderBench, a real-video benchmark of 579 event families. Each family fixes an episode and a question and varies only the frames: of two four-frame inputs, only one establishes the order, and two six-frame inputs extend the other one with either the frames that resolve the order or frames that do not. Every input is labeled for whether its frames establish each action and their order. Across sixteen open-weight configurations and three closed-source references, the best open models order nearly as accurately as the references when the frames establish the order, but withhold correctly on at most 83% of the inputs where they do not, against at least 90% for every reference; forced-choice accuracy cannot reveal this gap. Open models withhold mainly when the frames show neither action; once the frames show one or both, most of them commit to an order. Thinking narrows the gap, even when it is switched on within a single checkpoint, mainly by separating sufficient from insufficient evidence rather than by making models more cautious overall. Accurate ordering thus does not imply knowing when the frames fall short, and benchmarks should reward withholding alongside ordering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EvOrderBench 真实视频基准（579 个事件族），通过在固定事件与问题下只改变采样帧，检验 VLMs 能否在帧不足以确立顺序时正确"弃答"，而非强行给出顺序。
AI.motivation: 现有强制二选一的时序基准把所有输入都当作可回答，奖励瞎猜；而可回答性基准又未区分"帧中缺少某个动作"与"帧中两个动作都出现但无法确定先后"这两种证据不足情形。
AI.method: 构建 579 个事件族的基准：每个族固定一个 episode 和问题，仅改变帧。两段四帧输入中只有一段能确立顺序；两段六帧输入在基础之上分别加入可确立顺序的帧或不可确立的帧。每个输入都标注是否展示了各动作及其先后关系。评测 16 个开源权重配置与 3 个闭源参考模型。
AI.result: 当帧能确立顺序时，最好的开源模型排序准确率接近闭源参考；但在帧不足以确立顺序时，开源模型正确弃答率最高仅 83%，而所有闭源参考均 ≥90%。强制二选一准确率无法暴露此差距。开源模型主要在两个动作都未出现时弃答；一旦出现一个或两个动作，多数模型便强行给出顺序。开启思考（同一 checkpoint 内切换）可缩小差距，主要是更好地区分证据充分与不足，而非整体变得更谨慎。
AI.conclusion: 精确排序能力不等于知道帧证据不足；基准评测应同时奖励正确的弃答与正确排序。

title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
summary: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($τ= 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L.

AI.tldr: 构建日本本地化的临床评测基准 JHealthBench-L（79个咨询、1022条标准），表明机器翻译评测虽保持粗粒度排名稳定，却掩盖了条目级的临床误判。
AI.motivation: HealthBench 等基于评分标准的基准其医师标准内嵌来源地区的医疗机构、药物与诊疗路径假设。仅做机器翻译会保留这些地区假设，使在日本合理的回答被误判或不被计分，需将其本地化到日本而无需从零编写标准。
AI.method: 通过"溯源引用的LLM起草—单一专科医生筛选修订—双医师独立评审—元评审"流程构建 JHealthBench-L（79例患者端咨询、1022条标准）；并在18个LLM上与机器翻译基线对比，做条目级、轴级与配对分析。
AI.result: 专家仅需从零改写4.4%的标准，独立评审对93.6%的二阶段标准无异议。翻译基线保持粗粒度排名（τ=0.817，平均偏移+0.027），但17.7%的修改条目判定翻转（重评噪声为7.3%），日本适配负向标准的误罚降低7.1个百分点。轴级分析显示上下文感知与日本特有临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日语持续预训练与推理后训练显著提升本地接地性能。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠翻译的评测会以稳定的排行榜掩盖条目级临床误测；应进行临床视角的本地化适配。JHealthBench-L及修订日志与代码已开源。

title: Spectral Optimal Transport for Dynamics-Aware Sign Language Generation
summary: Sign language generation (SLG) translates spoken-language text into pose sequences that convey its meaning. Recently, flow-based models with optimal transport (OT) have become a strong SLG baseline by handling the one-to-many nature of text-to-sign. While classifier-free guidance (CFG) could be applied to further strengthen the semantic alignment theoretically, its training involves conditional and unconditional training, which may contradict the pose-space OT, thus reducing the generation quality. Under the condition dropout, one noise sample can be paired with target motions exhibiting incompatible motion dynamics, interfering with the semantic guidance when the text condition is present. To address this issue, we propose Spectral Optimal Transport (SOT), which augments the pose-space cost with a spectral feature distance, reweighting the coupling toward the temporal-frequency structure of the target motions, thereby improving the performance when using CFG. The quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出谱最优传输(SOT)，在姿态空间代价中加入谱特征距离，缓解条件丢弃与姿态空间OT冲突时CFG下的语义引导失配，提升手语生成质量。
AI.motivation: 基于最优传输(OT)的流模型是手语生成的强基线，可处理一对多映射；理论上CFG能增强语义对齐，但其训练需条件与无条件两种模式，与姿态空间OT相冲突。特别是条件丢弃时，同一噪声样本会与运动动态不兼容的目标动作配对，削弱语义引导。
AI.method: 提出谱最优传输(SOT)：在姿态空间代价基础上增加谱特征距离，重新加权传输耦合，引导配对朝向目标动作的时频结构，从而在结合CFG时保持语义引导的一致性。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验均验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SOT通过引入时频结构约束改进OT耦合，改善了CFG在手语生成中的表现，可作为OT基线的一致性增强方案。

title: Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning for Backdoor Removal
comment: An extended version of the short paper published at CIKM 2026 (https://dl.acm.org/doi/abs/10.1145/3799682.3839969)
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a severe threat to modern NLP models by embedding hidden triggers that induce malicious behavior at inference time. Recent unlearning methods such as gradient ascent (GA) attempt to remove backdoors by maximizing the loss on poisoned samples; however, these methods can suffer from a critical limitation: they may shift the trigger's influence to other classes rather than eliminating it. In this work, we propose Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning (TICU), a framework for mitigating textual backdoor behavior by enforcing prediction and representation invariance to trigger insertion. TICU constructs clean and trigger-inserted counterfactual pairs, then fine-tunes the model so that both inputs produce consistent output distributions and aligned hidden representations. To preserve clean-task performance, TICU also retains the supervised classification loss on clean data and constrains parameter drift from the original model. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets, model architectures, and attack settings show that TICU improves triggered accuracy and reduces trigger-induced prediction shifts compared with existing baselines, while maintaining competitive label-flipping performance and limiting clean-task degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning (TICU)，通过对触发词插入保持预测与表示不变性来缓解文本后门，效果优于梯度上升等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有反学习（如梯度上升 GA）试图通过最大化毒样本损失移除后门，但存在关键缺陷：可能只是把触发词的影响转移到其他类别，而非真正消除。
AI.method: 构造干净样本与插入触发词的反事实对，微调模型使两种输入产生一致的输出分布并对齐隐层表示；同时保留干净数据的监督分类损失，并约束参数相对原模型的漂移。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、模型架构和攻击设置下，TICU 相比现有基线提升了触发样本准确率、减少了触发引起的预测偏移，同时保持有竞争力的标签翻转表现并限制干净任务性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 基于触发不变性的对比反学习能更有效地消除文本后门，并兼顾干净任务性能，是一种可行的后门缓解方案。

title: A 3D Simulator for Passive SPAD Imaging
summary: Passive single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras provide short-exposure observations for low-light perception, but collecting task annotations for these sensors remains difficult, and annotated datasets are scarce. We present a 3D simulation pipeline that generates realistic photon detections together with camera-motion and semantic labels, enabling perception models to be trained on synthetic SPAD observations and applied directly to real-world data. The pipeline couples controllable scene geometry and motion with a sensor-informed observation model that accounts for photon shot noise, dark counts, and spatial crosstalk. We evaluate the pipeline through calibrated photon-count comparisons and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across three downstream perception tasks. We show that classifiers trained only on synthetic SPAD data achieve high accuracy on real low-light recordings at illumination levels less than 2 lux, without real-data fine-tuning. Similarly, we apply models trained entirely on simulated camera sweeps to real-world camera-rotation estimation and achieve mean absolute rotation errors of less than 1 degree on real 20-degree and 30-degree sweeps at 0.5 and 5.0 lux, when deployed zero-shot. We additionally train semantic segmentation models on synthetic data with automatically generated dense labels and perform direct inference on real-world low-light recordings; the results further demonstrate the usefulness of synthetic dense supervision for real low-light perception. Our simulator thus provides a practical source of annotated training data for real SPAD perception.

AI.tldr: 提出一个SPAD相机3D仿真管线，可在合成光子探测数据上训练感知模型并零样本迁移到真实低光场景。
AI.motivation: 被动SPAD相机适合低光感知，但真实传感器数据缺乏任务标注、数据集稀缺，需要可行的合成标注数据来源。
AI.method: 构建耦合可控场景几何与运动的3D仿真管线，配以包含光子散粒噪声、暗计数和空间串扰的传感器观测模型，同时生成相机运动与语义标签；用标定光子计数比较和三类下游任务做零样本sim-to-real验证。
AI.result: 仅用合成数据训练的分类器在光照低于2 lux的真实低光记录上达到高准确率且无需微调；相机旋转估计在20°和30°真实扫描、0.5与5.0 lux下达平均绝对旋转误差<1°；语义分割模型用自动生成稠密标签训练后可直接在真实低光数据上推理。
AI.conclusion: 该仿真器可提供带标注的SPAD感知训练数据，是低光感知标注数据短缺问题的实用解决方案。

title: Too Smart for Its Own Good? Cognitive Fidelity and Competence Leakage in LLM Simulations of Young Learners
summary: LLM-based interactive learner simulators are increasingly used in educational applications, including teacher training and tutoring system development. A critical requirement for those simulations is cognitive fidelity: the simulated learner should maintain the assigned knowledge, misconceptions, and reasoning procedures throughout interaction. However, LLMs may express knowledge or problem-solving skills beyond the assigned learner's cognitive status, a phenomenon we refer to as competence leakage. In this exploratory study, we examine 3,339 simulated learner utterances from 130 teacher-learner simulator transcripts across three learning scenarios and identify over-competence as a prominent direction of cognitive-profile misalignment during interaction. We then investigate the recurrence of previously observed competence leakage cases under four matched-trigger evaluation protocols, ranging from isolated questioning to multi-turn interactions, across five model configurations. Overall, we observe higher violation recurrence under multi-turn protocols than under isolated question answering. More capable models generally show lower recurrence, whereas increased reasoning effort does not consistently improve cognitive fidelity and is even associated with slightly higher recurrence under multi-turn protocols in our matched-model comparison. These findings provide exploratory evidence of competence leakage phenomena in interactive learner simulation and suggest that single-turn question-answering type of evaluations alone may be insufficient, motivating the development of more systematic and reliable multi-turn protocols for evaluating cognitive fidelity in learner simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文探索性地研究基于LLM的"学习者模拟器"中的"能力泄漏"现象——模拟学习者表现出超出所设定认知水平的知识或解题能力，并发现多轮交互下该违规的复现率高于单轮问答。
AI.motivation: 教育类应用（教师培训、辅导系统开发）日益使用LLM交互式学习者模拟器，其关键要求是"认知保真度"：模拟学习者须在整个交互过程中维持被赋予的知识、迷思概念与推理过程。但LLM可能表现出超出设定认知状态的胜任力，即"能力泄漏"，这会破坏模拟的有效性。
AI.method: 分析130份教师-学习者模拟器对话记录、共3,339条模拟学习者话语，覆盖三种学习场景，识别出"过度胜任"是认知画像错位的主要方向；随后在四种匹配触发条件的评估协议（从孤立提问到多轮交互）与五种模型配置下，检验已观测到的能力泄漏案例的复现情况。
AI.result: 多轮协议下的违规复现率高于孤立问答；能力更强的模型通常复现率更低；而提高推理投入（reasoning effort）并未稳定提升认知保真度，在多轮协议的匹配模型比较中甚至与略高的复现率相关。
AI.conclusion: 结果为交互式学习者模拟中的能力泄漏现象提供了探索性证据，表明仅靠单轮问答式评估不足，需发展更系统、可靠的多轮评估协议来衡量学习者模拟的认知保真度。

title: RadOncGym: An Agent-Based Framework for Radiotherapy Dose-Mimicking Optimization
summary: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy, providing an important intermediate representation for automated radiotherapy planning. However, an AI-predicted dose must undergo downstream optimization to produce a physically constrained treatment plan, a process that requires balancing competing planning objectives. We present RadOncGym, an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for dose-mimicking optimization. To reduce iterative evaluation cost, RadOncGym incorporates a surrogate verifier that provides rapid feedback while allowing the agent to decide when to request a full planning solve within a fixed solve budget. We evaluate RadOncGym on 60 OpenKBP head-and-neck patients, each paired with 10 predictions from OpenKBP-Opt dose-prediction sets, yielding 600 patient-prediction contexts per experimental configuration. Under RadOncGym's 16-turn setting with a three-solve budget, a GPT-5.6 Sol agent reduces mean clinical-criterion violation by 0.6131 Gy and improves DVH and dose scores by 0.5986 and 0.2204 Gy relative to leaving all 12 weights fixed at 1, outperforming all evaluated non-agent weight-tuning methods under the same solve budget. It remains competitive with the 16-solve variants of these methods while requiring 75.0-77.6% less normalized runtime. RadOncGym demonstrates the potential of LLM agents as optimization planners in downstream radiotherapy plan optimization and provides a public testbed for their systematic evaluation. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym.

AI.tldr: 提出 RadOncGym：一个让 LLM 智能体迭代调节 12 个规划目标权重、结合代理验证器降低求解成本的放疗计划优化框架。
AI.motivation: AI 剂量预测给出患者特异 3D 剂量，但需下游优化才能生成物理可行的计划，优化中需平衡多个相互竞争的目标，人工调权重耗时且成本高。
AI.method: 构建智能体框架，LLM 在固定求解预算内多轮调节 12 个规划目标权重用于剂量模仿优化；引入代理验证器提供快速反馈，并由智能体自主决定何时请求完整计划求解。
AI.result: 在 60 名 OpenKBP 头颈患者×10 组预测（每配置 600 个患者-预测上下文）上，16 轮、3 次求解预算下 GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体相对全权重固定为 1 平均降低临床准则违反 0.6131 Gy，DVH 与剂量得分分别提升 0.5986 和 0.2204 Gy，优于所有同预算非智能体方法，与 16 次求解变体相当但归一化运行时间少 75.0–77.6%。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体可作为下游放疗计划优化的优化规划者，并提供了公开可复现的评测基准。

title: Amortizing Exact Orthogonality: Drift-Triggered Restoration for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
summary: Orthogonal finetuning (OFT) adapts a pretrained weight by an orthogonal transform and preserves its singular values and row angles, but existing methods construct an exact or approximate orthogonal transform at every optimization step. We measure how far a transform $A$ is from orthogonal by its orthogonality defect $\|A^\top A-I\|_2$. For OFTv2, which truncates a Cayley-Neumann series, we show that the truncation order does not determine the defect. At its default order, block defects in checkpoints from the reference implementation span five orders of magnitude. We propose Restarted Tangent Orthogonal Finetuning (RTOFT), which uses the first-order update $W(I+S)$ of a weight $W$ with a skew-symmetric $S$ and restores exact orthogonality by a polar decomposition only when the drift $\|S\|_2$ reaches a tolerance $τ$. The defect of $I+S$ is exactly $\|S\|_2^2$. Therefore, reading the drift after every update and restoring before the next forward pass guarantees a defect of at most $τ^2$ in every forward pass, independently of the loss, data, model, and optimizer. A final restoration makes the returned transform exactly orthogonal. On GLUE, RTOFT reduces the training time of block-diagonal, subspace, and butterfly parameterizations from $1.10$-$1.58\times$ to $0.97$-$1.13\times$ that of LoRA, and its block-diagonal version exceeds LoRA by $1.98\pm0.39$ points on the six-task average over five seeds. At $τ=0.10$, the largest drift read during training stays between $0.10$ and $0.12$ across DeBERTaV3, Qwen, and diffusion models, whereas it ranges from $0.17$ to $1.65$ when restoring once per epoch. In all seven settings of our ablation, the tangent update is worse without restoration than with it, and restoring after every step yields no measurable accuracy gain over restoring at the tolerance and costs $4.5$-$27.5\%$ more per step.

AI.tldr: 提出RTOFT：用一阶斜对称更新W(I+S)代替逐步构造正交变换，仅当漂移‖S‖₂达阈值τ时用极分解恢复精确正交，从而对任意情形保证正交缺陷≤τ²，在GLUE上提速并超过LoRA。
AI.motivation: 现有OFT（含OFTv2截断Cayley-Neumann级数）需在每步优化都构造精确或近似正交变换；实测OFTv2默认阶数下检查点分块缺陷跨五个数量级，说明截断阶数并不能控制正交性，缺乏可靠的正交保证且每步开销高。
AI.method: 以正交缺陷‖AᵀA−I‖₂度量偏离；采用斜对称S的一阶更新W(I+S)，其缺陷恰为‖S‖₂²；每次更新后读取漂移‖S‖₂，仅当达到容差τ时用极分解恢复精确正交，保证下一次前向传播缺陷≤τ²，与损失、数据、模型、优化器无关；训练结束再做一次最终恢复使变换精确正交。支持块对角、子空间、蝴蝶等参数化，并在DeBERTaV3、Qwen、扩散模型上验证。
AI.result: GLUE上训练时间由LoRA的1.10–1.58×降至0.97–1.13×；块对角版六任务均值五种子下超LoRA 1.98±0.39点。τ=0.10时训练中最大漂移稳定在0.10–0.12（跨DeBERTaV3、Qwen、扩散模型），而每epoch恢复一次则为0.17–1.65。消融七种设置中无恢复的切线更新均更差；每步恢复相比按τ恢复无精度增益且单步多耗4.5–27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 正交性可由显式漂移阈值加惰性极分解恢复来严格保证，无需每步构造正交变换；RTOFT在效率与精度上均优于LoRA且具模型无关的正交保证。

title: Separating Environment and Sensor Shift from Acquisition Protocol in Physical Vision Benchmarks
summary: In real-world deployments, vision systems must operate under varying environmental conditions, such as illumination changes. Recent work has explored adaptive sensing strategies that select camera parameters according to the current environment and downstream task to improve task performance. Reliable physical benchmarks are therefore essential for evaluating such strategies. We study ImageNet-ES-Diverse, a physical benchmark that evaluates the adaptive exposure control strategy Lens by recapturing printed ImageNet images under varying illumination conditions. We construct four controlled acquisition pipelines that vary printed-image scale and camera zoom, and conduct a pilot study with directly captured physical objects. We find that the acquisition choices substantially change benchmark difficulty on all downstream baselines. Moreover, the average classification-accuracy advantage of Lens over auto exposure observed on the original benchmark does not persist in either our collected pipelines or real-object pilot study. Oracle exposure selection nevertheless retains substantial gains, indicating remaining potential for sensor control. These findings highlight acquisition protocol as an important factor in physical benchmark evaluation and motivate explicit protocol reporting and evaluation across multiple acquisition setups when assessing adaptive-sensing benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视物理基准 ImageNet-ES-Diverse 对自适应曝光控制策略 Lens 的评测，发现采集协议（打印尺度、相机变焦）会显著改变基准难度，且 Lens 相对自动曝光的分类精度优势在自建流程与真实物体试验中不复现。
AI.motivation: 自适应传感（如根据环境与下游任务选择相机参数）需要可靠的物理基准来验证收益；但现有基准的采集协议是否稳健、是否影响结论，尚缺乏检验。
AI.method: 构建四条受控采集流程，变化打印图像尺度与相机变焦，重新采集印刷版 ImageNet 图像；并开展直接拍摄真实物理物体的预试验；在多种下游基线（含自动曝光、Lens 与 oracle 曝光选择）上比较分类精度。
AI.result: 采集选择在所有下游基线上显著改变基准难度；原基准上 Lens 相对自动曝光的平均精度优势在新采集流程和真实物体预试验中均未保持；而 oracle 曝光选择仍有可观增益。
AI.conclusion: 采集协议是物理基准评测的重要因素；评估自适应传感收益时应显式报告协议，并在多种采集设置下交叉验证，而非依赖单一基准结论。

title: Reliable User Simulation in Complex Multi-Step Workflows
summary: LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used to evaluate conversational assistants. Yet, these simulators can drift from their assigned goals or fail to exhaustively explore all specified options, causing evaluation errors incorrectly attributed to the assistant. Prior work has examined goal alignment in single-task settings, but many practical scenarios require simulators to execute multi-step workflows with sequential tasks, fallback logic, and cross-task dependencies, where simulator fidelity has not been measured. To close this gap, we introduce a benchmark of 500 workflows represented using the Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) abstraction. Our experiments reveal that the simulator's fidelity degrades sharply with workflow complexity, and that goal drift accounts for the majority of failures. Fidelity also depends on the assistant's response style, with the same simulator scoring substantially better or worse across styles. To address this, we propose ReUST (Reasoning + User State Tracking), a simple prompting strategy to maintain state information across dialogue turns. ReUST improves goal success rate by more than 12 points for mid-sized and large models, and reduces simulator sensitivity to the assistant's response style.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于HTN表示的500个工作流基准，测量LLM用户模拟器在多步骤工作流中的保真度，发现保真度随复杂度显著下降、目标漂移是主因，并提出ReUST提示策略以提升目标成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM用户模拟器用于评估对话助手时，可能偏离既定目标或未穷尽所有指定选项，导致评估错误被错误归咎于助手。已有工作只研究单任务场景下的目标对齐，而实际多步骤工作流（含顺序任务、回退逻辑、跨任务依赖）中的模拟器保真度尚未被测量。
AI.method: 构建包含500个工作流的基准，使用分层任务网络（HTN）抽象表示；实验测量模拟器保真度随工作流复杂度的变化，并分析失败来源与助手回复风格的影响；提出ReUST（推理+用户状态跟踪）提示策略，在对话轮次间维护状态信息。
AI.result: 模拟器保真度随工作流复杂度急剧下降，目标漂移构成大部分失败原因；保真度还依赖助手回复风格，同一模拟器在不同风格下得分差异明显。ReUST使中型和大型模型的目标成功率达到提升12个百分点以上，并降低模拟器对助手回复风格的敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 多步骤工作流中LLM用户模拟器保真度不足且高度依赖助手风格，ReUST作为一种简单的状态跟踪提示策略可有效缓解该问题，为更可靠的对话助手评估提供了方向。

title: MetaDecomp: Adaptive Task Decomposition via Meta-Learned Procedural Memory
summary: Reusing past experience in long-horizon tasks requires more than storing successful procedures: Language agents must distinguish which procedures apply and what work remains as execution progresses. We introduce MetaDecomp, an in-context meta-learning framework for adaptive task decomposition that jointly learns a task-relative state space and reusable procedures. Its outer loop builds procedural memory from successful training executions, representing task progress as abstract states and procedures between states as directed acyclic graphs of operations and dependencies. As new progress distinctions are learned, MetaDecomp revisits historical execution evidence to reassess state assignments and reorganize the procedures they support. With memory fixed at test time, the inner loop refines an initial decomposition and revises it from environmental feedback, combining applicable procedure fragments with task-specific steps missing from memory. Evaluated on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld over three seeds, MetaDecomp achieves the highest mean performance among the compared methods in four of five settings, for example, an 86.3% success rate on ALFWorld with Qwen3-4B. Fixing the initial schema or omitting historical reprojection reduces performance in component ablations. MetaDecomp also uses fewer inference tokens than ReAct and AutoRefine in all five settings. Cross-benchmark analysis identifies a low-performance area where partial coverage degrades success relative to hidden memory; high coverage improves success, while low coverage changes little. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: MetaDecomp：一种面向语言智能体的上下文元学习式自适应任务分解框架，通过联合学习任务相对状态空间与可复用过程片段，提升长程任务中的经验复用与执行自适应能力。
AI.motivation: 单纯存储成功流程不足：长程任务中，智能体需在执行过程中判断哪些过程适用、哪些工作尚未完成。因此需要按任务进度组织经验，并动态调整分解。
AI.method: 外层循环从成功执行中构建“程序性记忆”，以抽象状态表示任务进度，状态间过程用操作与依赖构成的有向无环图表示；学习到新的进度区分后回访历史执行证据，重新评估状态分配并重组过程。测试时记忆固定，内层循环细化初始分解并结合环境反馈修订，将可适用过程片段与记忆中缺失的任务特定步骤融合。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与ScienceWorld上（3个随机种子、5个设置），4个设置中取得最高平均性能，例如Qwen3-4B在ALFWorld上成功率86.3%。组件消融显示固定初始模式或去掉历史重投影会降低性能；全部5个设置中推理token数均少于ReAct与AutoRefine。跨基准分析发现一个低性能区域：部分覆盖会相对隐藏记忆降低成功率，高覆盖提升成功率，低覆盖影响不明显。
AI.conclusion: 将任务进度抽象为状态并搭配可回访重组的程序性记忆，能有效支持长程语言智能体的自适应分解；记忆覆盖程度是性能的关键因素。

title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
summary: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. We compare SSA with recurrent models, bounded-memory attention methods, and full-attention Transformers across retrieval, variable tracking, multi-hop reasoning, and language modeling. On our retrieval and reasoning benchmarks, SSA matches or comes within a few points of full attention on most tasks, far outperforms a Transformer with the same readable budget on every long-context retrieval task we evaluate, and matches or outperforms one with about 4 times that budget, while using constant inference memory. The largest remaining gap to full attention at small language model scale is on RULER. SSA makes a fixed number of tokens useful over a longer context, and since it reads memory with standard attention, we propose that it can be stacked with KV cache eviction methods. We also pretrain and post-train 400M-parameter models and measure how SSA's training and inference costs scale with context length and model size. Together, these experiments examine the capabilities and limitations of learned memory retention for long-context sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 State Space Attention (SSA)：用一个可学习的打分器决定保留哪些历史片段，用标准注意力读取有界记忆，从而在常数推理内存下逼近全注意力性能。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力的 KV cache 随上下文线性增长；要限制它，就要解决"序列模型在长上下文推理中应保留什么"这一问题，作者主张这一选择应当被学习而不是固定策略（如只保留最近 token）。
AI.method: SSA 学习维护一组有界的过去表示，并用标准注意力读取；学习到的打分器会针对新到达的上下文与记忆其余部分对每个 chunk 重新打分。固定上下文 Transformer 成为"总保留最近 token"的特例。打分器与读取器联合训练，可从可微软加权逐步过渡到硬保留，也可直接硬保留；并用训练时生成监督样本的"recovery"技术为打分器提供信号。
AI.result: 在检索、变量追踪、多跳推理和语言建模上与循环模型、有界记忆注意力、全注意力对比：多数任务上 SSA 与全注意力持平或仅差几个点；在所有长上下文检索任务上远超同等可读预算的 Transformer，并持平或超过约 4 倍预算的模型，同时推理内存恒定。小规模语言模型上与全注意力的最大差距在 RULER。另预训练/后训练 400M 模型，测量训练与推理开销随上下文长度和模型规模的变化。
AI.conclusion: 可学习记忆保留使固定数量的 token 在更长上下文上仍有用，且因使用标准注意力读取记忆，可与 KV cache 驱逐方法叠加。整体实验刻画了学习式记忆保留在长上下文建模中的能力与局限。

title: ArtLang-4D: Articulation-Aware Dynamic Language Fields from Monocular Videos
summary: Language that describes an articulated object is often about its state: the drawer pulled out the furthest, the door opened halfway, push the drawer all the way in. Existing 3D language fields attach one feature to each point and cannot tell these descriptions apart, and 4D language fields condition on video time, which has no kinematic meaning and cannot be set by a user. We present ArtLang-4D, which reconstructs an articulated object from a single monocular RGB-D video and equips it with a dynamic language field indexed by articulation time t, the normalized state of its joints, instead of video time. The geometry is a canonical triangle field whose triangles follow typed screw joints, discovered from the video without any joint initialization. The language field is supervised by a t-tagged caption bank that describes each part with comparative state phrases in a whitened open-vocabulary text space. A free-form query is answered by maximizing part relevance jointly over parts and states, which returns both the part and the articulation state it describes; a command is then executed by moving only that part along its recovered joint. On the 100 objects of Articulate-100, ArtLang-4D recovers more accurate joints and part geometry than reconstruction and articulation baselines, retrieves the queried state far more reliably than a state-agnostic language field, and executes language commands with lower motion error.

AI.tldr: ArtLang-4D从单目RGB-D视频重建铰接物体，并构建以"关节铰接时间t"而非视频时间为索引的动态语言场，实现状态感知的语言查询与命令执行。
AI.motivation: 描述铰接物体的语言多涉及其状态（如抽屉拉到最外、门半开），但现有3D语言场每点仅一个特征无法区分状态，4D语言场以视频时间为条件，无运动学意义且用户无法设定。
AI.method: 几何用规范三角面片场，面片沿带类型的螺旋关节运动，关节无需初始化、从视频中自动发现；语言场由带t标签、含比较状态短语的caption库监督，在去白化开放词表文本空间中学习；查询时在部件与状态上联合最大化相关性，返回部件及其状态；命令则沿恢复的关节仅移动该部件。
AI.result: 在Articulate-100的100个物体上，关节与部件几何重建精度优于重建及铰接基线；相比状态无关语言场更可靠地检索所查询状态；语言命令执行的运动误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 以铰接状态而非视频时间作为语言场索引，使语言查询与命令具备运动学意义与用户可控性，同时提升重建与执行精度。

title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
summary: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training. We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes. To resolve this, we propose \model{}, employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility. Theoretically, we establish an $O(\sqrt{T})$ upper bound on recurrent state growth while retaining chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on ~1.6B parameter models show that \model{} achieves stable training alongside improved long-context retrieval. Compared to GDN-2, it boosts the 128K average RULER score by 6.80 points in the recurrent setting and average accuracy across nine downstream tasks by 0.62 points in the hybrid setting.

AI.tldr: 论文分析Gated DeltaNet-2长上下文训练失败的原因（擦除算子非正规导致状态指数增长），提出对称擦除与衰减调控残差写入的改进模型，理论保证状态增长O(√T)，实验在1.6B模型上实现稳定训练并提升长上下文检索。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力以线性复杂度和固定大小循环状态高效处理长序列。GDN-2通过通道级独立的擦除与写入控制增强状态更新表达能力，但在长上下文训练中出现训练失败，需要定位并解决该问题。
AI.method: 将训练失败归因于擦除阶段读方向与修改方向的不对称性，产生非正规擦除算子，其方向增益在token间累积，即使无新写入也导致状态指数增长。为此提出采用对称擦除以保证状态传播非扩张，并使用衰减调控的残差写入保留写入灵活性。
AI.result: 理论上给出循环状态增长的O(√T)上界，同时保留分块并行计算。在约1.6B参数模型实验中实现稳定训练并提升长上下文检索：循环设置下128K平均RULER分数较GDN-2提升6.80分，混合设置下九个下游任务平均准确率提升0.62分。
AI.conclusion: 通过对称擦除与衰减调控残差写入，解决了GDN-2长上下文训练不稳定问题，在保持并行效率的同时兼顾训练稳定性与长上下文检索性能。

title: Can Its Own Misses Teach an MLLM to Find Small Brain Metastases?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are becoming general readers of medical images, yet they remain weak at locating small abnormalities. Brain metastases expose this gap: at 384 px a 0.1 mL lesion covers less than a quarter of one visual token, and at one false positive per scan frontier MLLMs find fewer than 30% of lesions of 0.1-1 mL. Fine-tuning on one dataset helps but transfers poorly, and improving it further is slow trial and error steered by a single score. We introduce LANTERN (Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing), a framework in which an MLLM improves recursively from its own misses. LANTERN recasts model development as an error-driven loop: a failure census attributes every missed lesion to one of four causes, an LLM mentor revises one of four levels (evidence acquisition, visual representation, learning policy, decision aggregation) per round, and a rule frozen before the first round decides what is kept, without test data and with every tool call audited. Over 15 unattended rounds, LANTERN raises a fine-tuned 4B MLLM from finding 75% to 94% of lesions at one false positive per scan on BraTS-MET, and 91% of those of 0.1-1 mL, compared with at most 51% and 29% for five frontier MLLMs read under the starting protocol; the gains hold on an external cohort (89%) and on unseen meningiomas (77%). These results show that an MLLM's own misses, attributed to their causes, can drive its reliable recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出LANTERN框架，让多模态大模型通过"错误归因+LLM导师改设计"的递归闭环自我改进，在脑转移灶检测上把4B模型从75%提升到94%，并在外部队列与未见病种上保持增益。
AI.motivation: MLLM作为医学影像通用读片器时对小病灶定位很弱：384px下0.1mL病灶不足1/4个视觉token，1 FP/scan条件下对0.1–1mL病灶检出不足30%。单数据集微调迁移性差，且改进依赖单一分数引导的缓慢试错。
AI.method: 将模型开发重构为错误驱动循环：①失败普查(failure census)把每个漏检病灶归因到四类原因之一；②LLM导师每轮只修改四个层级之一（证据获取、视觉表征、学习策略、决策聚合）；③第一轮前冻结的规则决定哪些改动被保留。全程不用测试数据，每次工具调用可审计，共15轮无人值守。
AI.result: 在BraTS-MET上，微调的4B MLLM在1 FP/scan下检出率从75%升至94%，0.1–1mL病灶达91%；五个前沿MLLM在起始协议下最多51%和29%。增益可迁移：外部队列89%，未见脑膜瘤77%。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM自身漏检按原因归因，可驱动其可靠、递归的自我改进，为小病灶检测提供可审计的自动化研发范式。

title: Pretraining for Forecasting in Relational Databases
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling
summary: Real-world forecasting increasingly relies on asynchronous transaction logs in relational databases rather than uniformly sampled arrays. While relational deep learning (RDL) models can forecast from these complex histories, they are typically trained separately for each specific target and root entity type. We introduce Query-Conditioned Relational pretraining (QCRP), a self-supervised framework that enables a standard RDL backbone to act as a universal forecaster across a database. QCRP generates diverse forecasting objectives using a structured temporal query grammar and interleaves them through a shared conditional predictor. This produces a robust, frozen encoder reusable for downstream tasks via lightweight predictors or a zero-shot interface. Evaluated on large-scale RelBench databases, QCRP learns frozen representations that support competitive forecasting across tasks and entity types. Furthermore, a single unified QCRP model checkpoint is competitive with isolated, entity-specific specialists. We demonstrate promising results for reusing the learned representations from standard RDL backbones for forecasting tasks in relational databases.

AI.tldr: QCRP 是一种自监督关系型深度学习预训练框架，用结构化时序查询语法生成多样预测目标并用共享条件预测器交错训练，从而得到一个可复用的通用预测编码器。
AI.motivation: 现实预测任务更多依赖关系数据库中异步的事务日志，而非均匀采样数组；现有 RDL 模型通常针对每个特定预测目标和根实体类型分别训练，无法跨任务与实体类型通用，成本高且难以复用。
AI.method: 提出 Query-Conditioned Relational Pretraining（QCRP）：借助结构化时序查询语法自动生成多样的预测目标，通过共享的条件预测器将这些目标交错训练，使标准 RDL 主干学得鲁棒的冻结编码器；下游可通过轻量预测头或零样本接口复用。
AI.result: 在 RelBench 大规模数据库上评估，QCRP 学到的冻结表示在多种任务和实体类型上均具备有竞争力的预测性能；单一统一 QCRP 检查点可与各实体类型的独立专家模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 标准 RDL 主干上的表示可通过 QCRP 有效复用为关系数据库中的通用预测器，为跨任务、跨实体类型的统一预训练提供了可行方向。

title: AVERT: Anomalous Value Erasure with Response Testing against Visual Prompt Injection
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to visual prompt injection, in which an adversarially perturbed image forces the model to respond with the attacker's chosen content, such as malicious tool calls, website links, or advertisements, sometimes regardless of the user's question. Existing defenses, such as diffusion-based purification and image-token masking, mitigate these attacks at a substantial cost to the model's utility on benign inputs. To address this challenge, we propose AVERT, which removes adversarial feature directions only when the model's answer depends on them. Our key procedures involve identifying anomalous value subspaces and detecting answer dependence. To identify the anomalous value subspace, we compare the statistics of each input's attention-head outputs with those of clean images and extract the directions along which the input deviates the most. We then project out these directions to remove the injected content. Because the same directions also carry benign visual information, we apply the removal only to answers that depend on them, namely answers whose likelihood collapses once the directions are removed or that are as likely under unrelated questions as under the user's question. Against white-box attacks on four VLMs (Qwen2-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, LLaVA, InternVL2.5) and four injection benchmarks, AVERT lowers average attack success from 86-90% to at most 0.6% while retaining at least 96% of undefended utility averaged over thirteen benchmarks. Its defense-utility F-score ($F_{DU}$), the harmonic mean of attacks stopped and utility retained, is 98.0-99.1 and the highest among all compared defenses on every model.

AI.tldr: AVERT：仅在模型答案依赖异常特征方向时才移除这些方向，从而防御视觉提示注入，攻击成功率从86-90%降至≤0.6%，同时保留≥96%的良性效用。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型易受视觉提示注入攻击（对抗扰动图像迫使模型输出攻击者指定内容），而扩散净化、图像token掩码等现有防御以大幅牺牲良性输入效用为代价。
AI.method: 核心为两步：1）识别异常值子空间——比较各输入注意力头输出与前缀干净图像的统计量，提取偏离最大的方向并投影消除注入内容；2）检测答案依赖性——因同一方向也承载良性视觉信息，仅对依赖这些方向的答案施加移除（移除后似然崩塌、或在无关问题下与用户问题下似然相当）。
AI.result: 在4个VLM（Qwen2-VL、Qwen2.5-VL、LLaVA、InternVL2.5）、4个注入基准的白盒攻击下，平均攻击成功率从86-90%降至至多0.6%，13个基准平均保留至少96%效用；防御-效用F分数F_DU为98.0-99.1，在所有对比防御中每个模型上均最高。
AI.conclusion: 按需定向移除对抗特征方向可在几乎不损失良性性能的前提下高效防御视觉提示注入，优于牺牲效用的现有方法。

title: Disciplined Anthropomorphism: How to Extend Cognitive Language to Artificial Intelligence
summary: Researchers increasingly describe AI in cognitive terms such as "understanding" and "believing", while critics denounce this as wishful anthropomorphism. Both sides align in taking a subsumptive approach, however: they ask whether AI systems fall under concepts minted for human beings, reporting verdicts as discoveries about those systems when they are largely determined by conceptual frames. Yet the problem AI poses is precisely the problem of how to conceptually frame these systems, and the explosive rise of anthropomorphism is best seen as a response to this problem that needs disciplining rather than discouragement. A disciplined anthropomorphism, I argue, should disentangle the inferential connections bundled up in our cognitive concepts and ask which connections to preserve, sever, or forge for AI. The disciplining then comes, on the one hand, from the human conceptual needs that give point to the drawing of these connections and motivate the concepts' extension in the first place; and, on the other hand, from empirical and especially mechanistic evidence that supports and constrains these connections. By reverse-engineering a concept's point in relation to a particular need before re-engineering it to better serve that point in our dealings with AI, anthropomorphizing extensions can be point-based, transposing the work those concepts do for us while revising the inferential workings through which they do it. Transposing human-tailored conceptions of understanding and belief on the pivot of the underlying conceptual needs gives us just the definitional freedom required to accommodate how AI systems differ from us, yielding conceptions that are not just thinned-out versions of existing ones, but potentially richer and better fitted to the peculiarities of AI.

AI.tldr: 论文主张对AI的"拟人化"不应简单否定，而应加以"规训"：拆解认知概念中的推理关联，依据人的概念需求与机制性证据，重建适用于AI的"基于要点"的概念扩展。
AI.motivation: 学界对用"理解""相信"等认知词描述AI的态度分为两派——支持者与批评者（斥之为一厢情愿的拟人论）——但双方都采取"归摄"进路：追问AI是否落入为人铸造的概念之下，并把结论当成关于AI本身的发现，而实则结论主要由概念框架决定。作者认为AI带来的真正问题是"如何概念化地框定这些系统"，拟人化的激增是对此问题的回应，需要规训而非打压。
AI.method: 哲学概念分析。提出"规训的拟人论"：将认知概念中捆绑的推理关联拆解，逐一决定哪些关联应保留、切断或新造；规训来自两方面——一是使这些关联有意义的人类概念需求，二是支持并约束这些关联的经验与尤其是机制性证据。方法是先"逆向工程"概念相对于特定需求的要点，再"再工程"概念以更好服务于该要点，即"基于要点"的拟人化扩展。
AI.result: 以"理解"与"信念"为例，将该类人化概念围绕底层概念需求进行"转置"，可获得界定上的自由度，从而容纳AI系统与人的差异；所得概念并非现有概念的稀释版，而可能更丰富、更契合AI的特性。
AI.conclusion: 拟人化不应被劝阻而应被规训；基于要点的概念转置为AI认知概念的建构提供了可行路径，使概念扩展既保留概念对人的功能性要点，又依据机制证据重订其推理结构。

title: FORK: Co-Evolving Safe Disclosure and Decision Skills Against Attackers Who Read Every Refusal
summary: When a guardrail rejects an LLM agent's action, its message reaches any attacker observing the trajectory: a fixed refusal leaves benign users unable to recover, whereas an explanation can tell the attacker what to try next. We study this as safe disclosure: explaining rejections so that authorized tasks recover without increasing adaptive attack success. Safe disclosure depends on both the decision and the message: what the guardrail blocks and what it reveals to the agent and the attacker. Because hand-written rules alone cannot anticipate how adaptive attackers probe decisions or use messages, we introduce FORK, which co-evolves a guardrail's natural-language decision and disclosure skills with an attacker that reads every public message. Each exploited message and permissive decision gives FORK evidence for a gradient-free revision of its natural-language skill library. We evaluate FORK on four benchmarks. Averaged over three agents on FORK-World, FORK cuts attack success rate (ASR) under adaptive attack from 78.4% to 14.1% and keeps utility above 85%, outperforming baselines on both ASR and utility. Notably, on MT-AgentRisk, whose environments and tasks are unseen in training, FORK lowers ASR from 70.6% to 9.1% with 93.1% benign utility.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"安全披露"问题：护栏拒绝LLM agent动作时，拒绝信息会被攻击者看到，固定拒绝使良性用户无法恢复、过度解释又泄露信息。提出FORK，让护栏的决策与披露技能与读取所有公开信息的自适应攻击者共同进化，从被利用的样本中无梯度地修订自然语言技能库。
AI.motivation: 护栏拒绝对话动作时，消息同时对良性用户和观察轨迹的攻击者可见：固定拒绝使良性用户难以恢复任务，详细解释则告诉攻击者下一步怎么试。因此需要同时考虑"拦截什么"和"披露什么"，而手写规则无法预判自适应攻击者如何探测决策或利用消息。
AI.method: 提出FORK，将护栏的自然语言"决策技能"与"披露技能"和一个读取所有公开消息的攻击者共同进化；每一条被利用的消息和过宽的允许决策都作为证据，用于对自然语言技能库做无梯度（gradient-free）修订。
AI.result: 在FORK-World上对三个agent取平均，自适应攻击下ASR由78.4%降至14.1%，效用保持85%以上，在ASR与效用上均优于基线。在训练中未见的MT-AgentRisk环境与任务上，ASR由70.6%降至9.1%，良性效用93.1%。
AI.conclusion: 护栏设计应将"拒绝决策"与"拒绝披露"联合优化，并通过与自适应攻击者共同进化、无梯度地迭代自然语言技能库，可在保持高良性效用的同时显著降低自适应攻击成功率，并具备跨未见环境的泛化能力。

title: The Danger of Double Precision: Working Precision as a Hidden Constraint in Gaussian Process Maximum Likelihood
summary: Gaussian process (GP) hyperparameters are routinely fitted by maximizing the marginal likelihood in IEEE double precision, although for smooth kernels and noiseless data the covariance matrix is often more ill conditioned than double precision can resolve. For a squared-exponential kernel on a design with a Bayesian-optimization cluster, refits over a range of significand widths, judged against a high-precision reference, show that the double-precision fit is a different model and that fits converge only once the width exceeds the base-2 logarithm of the covariance condition number, about 70 bits. Cholesky failure acts as an implicit conditioning constraint, caused mostly by rounding of the kernel entries; the constrained solution predicted from the working precision alone is within 20% of the best Powell fits at five of the six precisions from 40 to 64 bits, with a local expansion proved for the idealized problem. Across 43 kernels, designs and problem settings, including negative controls that double precision already resolves, the bits needed follow the log condition number at the reference optimum plus a tolerance-dependent offset, and at the loosest tolerance double precision suffices for the Matern 1.5 kernel but not for the squared-exponential kernel on clustered designs. Double-precision hyperparameters overstate the posterior standard deviation near the design cluster and, on a quadratic objective whose likelihood heads to the flat limit, stall closed-loop active learning. Promoting the whole likelihood to 80 significand bits recovers the reference accuracy on every fixed design tested, whereas a fixed jitter trades failures for a posterior bias.

AI.tldr: 高斯过程超参数在双精度下拟合不可靠：平滑核与无噪声数据下需约70位有效数字（超过协方差条件数的二进制对数）才能收敛到参考解，双精度拟合实为不同模型。
AI.motivation: GP超参数通常以IEEE双精度最大化边缘似然拟合，但对平滑核（如平方指数核）和无噪声数据，协方差矩阵条件数常超出双精度可分辨范围，导致拟合结果不可信，需量化所需精度及后果。
AI.method: 在贝叶斯优化聚类设计上，对平方指数核在不同有效位宽下重复拟合，与高精度参考解比对；分析Cholesky失败作为隐式条件约束（主要源于核矩阵元素舍入），并用理想化问题的局部展开加以证明；跨43个核、设计与问题设置（含负对照）考察所需位数与对数条件数的关系。
AI.result: 双精度拟合与参考解为不同模型，位宽超过约70位（协方差条件数以2为底的对数）才收敛；仅凭工作精度预测的约束解在40–64位六种精度中五种上误差在最佳Powell拟合的20%以内；所需位数约等于参考最优处对数条件数加容差相关偏移；最宽松容差下双精度对Matern 1.5足够，但对聚类设计上的平方指数核不足；双精度高估聚类附近后验标准差，并在趋于平坦似然的二次目标上使闭环主动学习停滞。
AI.conclusion: 将整个似然提升至80位有效数字可在所有测试的固定设计上恢复参考精度，而固定jitter只是以失败换后验偏差；实践应重视精度对GP拟合可靠性与贝叶斯优化闭环的影响。

title: Frame geometry, fascicle extrapolation and leaderboard overfitting in muscle ultrasound
comment: 38 pages (20 main text, 18 supplement), 13 figures, 21 tables. Code, trained weights, notebooks and derived data are public on Kaggle (user soheilkooklan) and in the ancillary files
summary: Automated readings of pennation angle, fascicle length and muscle thickness from B-mode ultrasound depend on the geometry of the stored frame and on how fascicles that leave the image are extended, and challenge entries add settings chosen on a small public leaderboard. This study measures all three in one entry of the UMUD Challenge, which scored 309 frames from six screen layouts, 103 on a public and 206 on a private leaderboard. The pipeline applies layout-specific values of scale and pixel aspect, resamples each frame to square pixels, segments aponeuroses and fascicle fragments with U-Nets and measures the three readings geometrically; the submitted entry blended its angle and length with public notebooks. Because the score is additive, 65 single-change contrasts from 13 base entries measured each decision on both splits. The primary selected entry scored 0.27608 on the private split, the 69th reported position of 690 teams. Reading every frame with square pixels cost 0.029 public and 0.037 private. Of 20 late-stage corrections, 9 kept the sign of their effect on the private split. An audit of the UMUD expert benchmark found that 26 of its 35 frames share their tissue with training images of both DL_Track_US and the challenge. On the 9 frames with no detected match in either set or orientation, the recipe scored 0.213, two experts against two others 0.218 and DL_Track_US 0.263 (0.209, 0.196 and 0.259 when both raters of a reference pair are required), with no difference established. Frame geometry and the extension rule moved readings as much as the choice of model, and small corrections tuned on about 100 public frames did not carry over.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析UMUD Challenge单条参赛方案，衡量超声图像几何处理（缩放、像素纵横比、筋膜延伸规则）与模型选择对羽状角、肌束长度和肌肉厚度自动测量的影响，并审计基准数据泄漏。
AI.motivation: B超自动测量依赖存储帧的几何参数和离帧肌束的延伸方式，而参赛者往往在小规模公开榜单上调参，这些选择是否稳健、基准是否被污染尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对一条UMUD Challenge参赛方案做消融：按屏幕布局设定缩放与像素纵横比、重采样为方形像素、用U-Net分割腱膜与肌束片段后几何测量；利用评分为可加性，从13个基础方案构造65组单变量对照，在公开与私有榜单上分别评估；并对专家基准35帧与DL_Track_US及挑战训练集做组织匹配审计。
AI.result: 主方案私有榜0.27608（690队中第69名）；全部帧按方形像素读取损失公开0.029、私有0.037；20项后期修正仅9项在私有榜保持效应符号；专家基准35帧中26帧与两训练集组织重叠，无匹配的9帧上本方案0.213，两专家0.218，DL_Track_US 0.263，差异未确立。
AI.conclusion: 帧几何与肌束延伸规则的影响可与模型选择相当，约100帧公开榜上的微调不可迁移；基准存在显著数据泄漏，相关比较结论需谨慎。

title: From Data Room to Report: End-to-End AI Support for M&A Legal Due Diligence
comment: Accepted at IEEE BigData 2026 as workshop paper: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: Legal due diligence in mergers and acquisitions requires lawyers to organize heterogeneous virtual data room documents, extract transaction-relevant information and consolidate reviewed findings into a due diligence report. We present LEXI (Legal Extraction and Intelligence), a work-in-progress system that demonstrates how large language models can support this process from document ingestion to report preparation. LEXI classifies documents under a configurable due diligence taxonomy, assigns relevant target entities, extracts predefined information with supporting passages and page-level provenance and prepares report content from reviewed findings. Structured outputs connect these stages and allow model-generated results to be passed through the workflow in a controlled form. Lawyers review and correct classifications and extractions and retain responsibility for legal assessments, recommendations, risk ratings and final report wording. Initial evaluations of the classification and extraction components provide preliminary evidence that the approach is feasible. LEXI illustrates how AI can be integrated across the legal due diligence workflow while preserving lawyer control over substantive legal judgment.

AI.tldr: LEXI是一个基于大语言模型的法律尽职调查工作流系统，覆盖文档分类、实体识别、信息抽取与报告准备，强调保留律师对法律判断的控制权。
AI.motivation: 并购法律尽职调查需律师整理异构虚拟数据室文档、抽取交易相关信息并汇总为尽调报告，工作量大且流程分散，需探索LLM如何端到端支撑该流程同时不削弱律师的专业判断责任。
AI.method: 构建LEXI原型系统：按可配置尽调分类体系对文档分类，分配相关目标实体，抽取预定义信息并附带支撑段落与页码级溯源，基于已审核发现生成报告内容；各阶段通过结构化输出衔接，使模型结果以受控形式流转；律师审核修正分类与抽取结果。
AI.result: 对分类与抽取组件的初步评估提供了方法可行的初步证据；系统为进行中的工作（work-in-progress）。
AI.conclusion: LEXI展示了AI可贯穿法律尽职调查工作流，同时将法律评估、建议、风险评级与最终报告措辞等实质性判断保留给律师。

title: EATS: Scaling Tool-Use Experience for Medical Reasoning Agents
summary: Medical reasoning agents combine large language model (LLM) reasoning with clinical workflows and specialized neural tools. However, general-purpose LLMs receive limited training exposure to domain-specific medical tools, and the uncertainty and distributional shifts of neural tool outputs make selecting tools from simple descriptions significantly more challenging than in deterministic settings such as calculators or dictionary lookups. In this paper, we propose EATS, an experience-augmented tool selection strategy that leverages accumulated tool-use trajectories to improve tool selection in medical reasoning agents. EATS constructs a memory of past interactions, including queries, tool choices, arguments, and self-evaluated feedback, and retrieves relevant experiences to guide tool selection for new queries. As memory construction does not require ground-truth supervision, EATS scales naturally with test-time experience. We evaluate EATS on tool-augmented medical reasoning tasks, including closed-ended visual question answering and free-form report generation. Experiments on four public datasets, ChestAgentBench, CheXbench, MIMIC-CXR, and SLAKE-VQA, across three multimodal LLMs, Qwen3-VL 2B, Qwen3-VL 32B, and GPT-5.5, show consistent gains in tool selection behavior and downstream medical reasoning performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Limingyuan001/EATS.

AI.tldr: 提出EATS，一种基于经验增强的工具选择策略，利用累积的工具使用轨迹构建记忆并检索相关经验，以改进医疗推理智能体的工具选择。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM对医学领域工具训练曝光有限；神经工具输出的不确定性与分布漂移，使仅凭简单描述选择工具比在确定性场景（如计算器、查字典）更具挑战。
AI.method: EATS构建过去交互记忆（查询、工具选择、参数、自评估反馈），对新查询检索相关经验以指导工具选择；记忆构建无需真值监督，可随测试时经验自然扩展。
AI.result: 在闭式视觉问答与自由形式报告生成任务上评估；四个公开数据集（ChestAgentBench、CheXbench、MIMIC-CXR、SLAKE-VQA）、三个多模态LLM（Qwen3-VL 2B、Qwen3-VL 32B、GPT-5.5）上，工具选择行为与下游医疗推理性能均有稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用经验轨迹检索可有效缓解神经工具不确定性带来的选择难题，无需监督即可扩展，是提升医疗推理智能体工具使用的通用有效方法。

title: PRIOR: Pre-Call Reasoning in SFT and Its Influence on Tool-Use Retention under RL
summary: Tool use learned during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is not always retained during reinforcement learning (RL). We study how properties of SFT data may affect this retention by constructing Low, Medium, and High SFT datasets with approximately matched token budgets but different tool-call depths. Under the same RL recipe, the three initializations reach similar RL training accuracy yet exhibit markedly different tool-use dynamics: tool initiation increases in Low, declines in Medium, and collapses in High. We observe that these datasets also differ substantially in the amount of reasoning preceding each tool call. In particular, High trajectories contain considerably less pre-call reasoning, motivating the hypothesis that pre-call reasoning may affect how well tool use is calibrated and, consequently, whether the corresponding behaviors are retained during RL. An idealized theoretical analysis provides a selective-retention view of this process: advantages in overall and tool-conditioned accuracy can be preserved under outcome-only optimization, while tool initiation increases only when tool-using trajectories are more successful than the tool-free alternative. Guided by this analysis, we rank the original High trajectories by average pre-call reasoning length and retain the highest-ranked examples while approximately matching cumulative SFT token exposure. This simple filtering strategy improves post-RL accuracy and tool-conditioned final-answer success without consistently increasing tool initiation across multiple benchmarks. These results suggest that pre-call reasoning is a useful dimension of SFT supervision for understanding and improving tool-use retention under downstream RL.

AI.tldr: SFT 学到的工具使用能力在下游 RL 中不一定能保留；作者发现工具调用前的推理量（pre-call reasoning）是关键影响因素，并提出按此过滤 SFT 数据可改善 RL 后的工具使用保持。
AI.motivation: SFT 阶段学到的工具使用行为在 RL 训练中经常退化或崩溃，现有工作不清楚 SFT 数据的哪些性质导致这种不保留，因此需要研究 SFT 数据结构如何影响 RL 阶段的工具使用动态。
AI.method: 构建 Low/Medium/High 三个 token 预算近似匹配但工具调用深度不同的 SFT 数据集，用相同 RL 流程分别初始化并观测工具启动变化；进一步分析每次工具调用前的推理长度差异，并给出一个理想化理论分析（选择性保留视角），据此对 High 数据按平均 pre-call reasoning 长度排序过滤，保留高排名样本并匹配累计 token 暴露后重训。
AI.result: 三种初始化 RL 训练准确率相近，但工具启动呈现不同动态：Low 上升、Medium 下降、High 崩溃；High 轨迹的调用前推理明显更少。仅按 pre-call reasoning 过滤 High 数据后，多个基准上 RL 后准确率与工具条件下的最终答案成功率提升，且不会一致性地增加工具调用频率。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用前的推理是理解并改善下游 RL 中工具使用保留的一个有价值的 SFT 监督维度；简单的数据过滤策略即可在不大幅改变调用频率的前提下提升工具使用效果。

title: EgoCARBS: Egocentric Video Meets Active Acoustics for Kitchen Action Understanding
comment: 36 pages (12 main paper and references, 24 supplementary material). Project page: https://saif-mahmud.github.io/projects/ego-carbs
summary: Egocentric video records what a person looks at, but often misses what their body does: the hands leave the frame, and arm motion goes unseen. An exocentric camera recovers this context, but it must be installed wherever the activity happens. Active acoustic sensing can recover it from the wearables themselves: a device's speaker emits inaudible chirps, and its microphone senses the motion of the hands, arms, and nearby objects from their echoes. Yet no public dataset pairs it with egocentric video. We present EgoCARBS, with two deliverables. The first is a multimodal dataset and benchmark: 15 participants cook unscripted meals in their own kitchens wearing camera glasses and an off-the-shelf smartwatch that both sense with active acoustics, synchronized with egocentric and exocentric video and the watch's audio and IMU, with 4,019 verb-noun action annotations in 11.4 hours. The second is a study of what the wearables add to egocentric video. On verb recognition, they add at least as much as an exocentric camera for participants seen in training, and even more for new participants, for whom the exocentric camera does not help. Active acoustics alone provides most of this gain, and helps most where the camera does not see the hands. Trimmed action recognition, detection, and anticipation remain open. We will release the data, our data collection and annotation tools, and pre-trained models.

AI.tldr: EgoCARBS 是一个新的多模态数据集与基准，将主动声学感知（智能手表/眼镜的扬声器发人耳不闻的 chirp、麦克风接收回波）与第一人称视频同步，用于捕捉相机视野外的手部与手臂动作，并研究了可穿戴声学传感能为第一人称视频补充什么。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频只记录人看什么，常丢失身体动作：手会出画、手臂运动看不到；而外置相机虽能补充上下文，但必须在活动地点安装。主动声学感知可直接从可穿戴设备恢复这些信息，但目前没有与之配对的第一人称视频公开数据集。
AI.method: 构建 EgoCARBS：15 名参与者在自家厨房无脚本做饭，佩戴摄像眼镜和商用智能手表，二者均具备主动声学感知，并与第一人称/外置视频、手表音频与 IMU 同步；共 11.4 小时、4,019 条动宾动作标注。随后开展对比研究，评估可穿戴设备相对第一人称视频的增益（动词识别等任务）。
AI.result: 在动词识别上，可穿戴设备带来的增益至少相当于外置相机对训练中见过的参与者所能提供的增益，对新参与者增益更大（外置相机对新参与者无帮助）；这些增益主要来自主动声学感知本身，且在相机看不到手时帮助最大。Trimmed 动作识别、检测与预测仍为开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 作者将发布数据、数据采集与标注工具以及预训练模型，推动可穿戴主动声学感知与第一人称视频结合的研究。

title: Is Sara Omar the true author of Dødevaskeren (The Dead Washer)? Authorship attribution in Danish literature
summary: The bestseller Dødevaskeren (The Dead Washer) was published in 2017 under the name Sara Omar. A Danish colleague has suggested that the novel may have been written by another author, possibly Mads Peder Nordbo. To investigate this authorship question, four authorship attribution methods were applied, namely Delta, intertextual distance, Nearest Shrunken Centroids (NSC), and naïve Bayes. Using various parameter settings, these approaches consistently identify Nordbo's writing style in the doubtful novel, although the results do not provide conclusive evidence that he authored the novel in its entirety. In a second step, the novel was divided into non-overlapping segments of 5,000 tokens. Once again, Nordbo's style was identified in the majority of the segments. However, a small number of passages do not clearly support this conclusion and instead suggest the possible involvement of another, as yet unidentified, author, possibly Sara Omar herself.

AI.tldr: 论文采用Delta、文本间距离、最近收缩质心(NSC)和朴素贝叶斯四种作者归属方法，对2017年以Sara Omar名义出版的畅销小说《Dødevaskeren》进行署名争议分析，结果一致指向Mads Peder Nordbo的写作风格，但不足以证明其独立完成全书。
AI.motivation: 畅销小说《Dødevaskeren》署名Sara Omar，但有丹麦同行怀疑实际由他人（可能是Mads Peder Nordbo）代笔，需用计算文体学方法检验这一署名疑点。
AI.method: 应用四种作者归属方法：Delta、文本间距离(intertextual distance)、最近收缩质心(NSC)与朴素贝叶斯，并在多种参数设置下比较；随后将小说切分为互不重叠的5,000词元片段，逐段进行风格判定。
AI.result: 各方法与参数设置均一致地在整部小说中识别出Nordbo的写作风格；分段分析中，多数片段同样指向Nordbo，但少数段落不清晰，提示可能另有尚未确认的作者（可能是Sara Omar本人）参与。
AI.conclusion: 证据倾向于Nordbo参与创作，但不足以断定全书出自其一人之手；小说可能存在多人合作或部分代笔，需进一步识别其他作者。

title: EGSE: Evidence-Grounded Skill Evolution for Medical Reasoning Agents
summary: Medical reasoning agents combine foundation models with specialized tools to interpret medical images, yet reusing their historical experience remains challenging. A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures. In this paper, we propose EGSE, an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a multi-faceted skill library through supported and validated updates to improve medical agents. EGSE evaluates intermediate reasoning and tool use and contrasts repeated successful and failed rollouts to extract useful practices and evidence-supported avoidance guidance. These experiences are synthesized into workflows with applicability conditions and checks traceable to source dialogues. Library additions and merges require source-grounded review and execution validation. At inference time, EGSE routes queries to skill nodes organized by imaging modality, question task type, and disease category, then retrieves and selects applicable workflows based on their conditions, the current images, and the question to guide evidence acquisition and interpretation. Experiments across four chest X-ray benchmarks show that EGSE outperforms representative medical agents and skill evolution methods in reasoning accuracy while reducing tool calls. It also delivers consistent accuracy gains across seven foundation models and supports skill transfer across datasets.

AI.tldr: EGSE 是一个证据锚定的技能进化框架，将相似病例的历史对话蒸馏为带适用条件的可复用工作流，并通过有来源支持且经执行验证的更新，逐步精炼多面技能库，以提升医学推理智能体。
AI.motivation: 医学推理智能体结合基础模型与专用工具解读医学图像，但复用历史经验困难：正确最终答案可能掩盖错误推理或工具使用；合成建议可能缺乏来源支持；表面相似的病例可能需要不同的诊断流程。
AI.method: EGSE 评估中间推理与工具使用，对比重复的成功与失败轨迹以提炼有效做法和基于证据的规避指导；将经验综合为带适用条件、可追溯到源对话的检查项的工作流；技能库增补与合并需经来源审查和执行验证。推理时按影像模态、问题任务类型、疾病类别路由到技能节点，再依据条件、当前图像和问题检索并选择适用工作流。
AI.result: 在四个胸部 X 光基准上，EGSE 在推理准确率上优于代表性医学智能体和技能进化方法，同时减少工具调用；在七个基础模型上均带来一致的准确率提升，并支持跨数据集技能迁移。
AI.conclusion: EGSE 通过证据锚定、条件化工作流与验证式技能更新，实现可复用、可追溯且可迁移的医学智能体经验积累，兼顾准确率与工具效率。

title: Self-supervised Clipped-objective Reinforcement Leaning Framework for Risk-aware Portfolio Management
summary: Portfolio management involves balancing diverse financial assets, a critical yet challenging task in quantitative trading. Although deep reinforcement learning has emerged as an active research domain for solving complex sequential decision-making problems over the past decade, deploying reinforcement learning frameworks in non-stationary financial markets raises formidable difficulties. Most existing reinforcement learning-based portfolio management models fail to account for tick-level intraday market dynamics (e.g., order flow imbalances and liquidity fluctuations), which reflect rapid capital movements. Simultaneously, these models suffer from unstable learning processes due to reinforcement learning's inherent high variance. This paper presents a Self-supervised Clipped-objective Portfolio management framework (SCP), which addresses these limitations through a two-phase architecture. Market feature integration phase (application contribution) integrates micro-level market microstructure patterns with macro-level financial indicators to enhance sensitivity to intraday asset trend dynamics. Policy optimization Phase (AI contribution) employs intermediate asset state representations to derive optimal portfolio allocations via a self-supervised clipped-objective policy-learner, ensuring both effectiveness and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations on three major index datasets from China's A-share market demonstrate that SCP's superior performance in balancing risk-return trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Exploratory and ablation studies further validate the contributions of SCP's key components.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督裁剪目标投资组合管理框架SCP，融合微观市场结构特征与宏观指标，用两阶段架构提升投资组合的收益-风险权衡与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的投资组合模型忽略tick级日内市场动态（订单流失衡、流动性波动），且因强化学习固有高方差导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 两阶段架构：①市场特征整合阶段，将微观市场结构模式与宏观金融指标融合，增强对日内资产趋势的敏感度；②策略优化阶段，用中间资产状态表示，通过自监督裁剪目标策略学习器（类似PPO的clipped objective）导出最优资产配置。
AI.result: 在中国A股三大指数数据集上，SCP在风险-收益权衡上优于SOTA基线；探索性与消融实验验证了关键组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: SCP通过微观-宏观特征融合与裁剪目标策略学习，兼具有效性与计算效率，并在A股市场验证了其优越性。

title: ProPolar: Progressive Polar Decomposition for Implicit Neural Representations
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) capture global low-frequency structure during the early stage of training and then refine localized high-frequency details, afterwards. However, standard optimizers are agnostic to the coarse-to-fine learning behavior of INRs. Such optimizers accumulate a gradient matrix in momentum buffer and retain components misaligned with the dominant low-frequency directions in the early stage. We propose a progressively growing rank scheduler and a rank-aware learning-rate scheduler for enhancing a subspace-based momentum optimization, where a momentum matrix is updated within a low-rank subspace. The rank schedule expands the subspace during training, and the scheduler holds the peak learning rate through rank growth so that the added subspace contributes to fine-detail recovery. Experiments on image fitting, single-image super-resolution (SISR), and neural radiance field optimization show that the proposed method improves convergence and peak reconstruction quality over competitive optimizers. The largest gains appear in the high-frequency refinement stage, mirroring the coarse-to-fine progression that the rank schedule targets. A significant study on hyperparameter optimization (HPO) on NeRF further confirms that these gains persist under matched search budgets.

AI.tldr: 针对INR粗到细的学习特性，提出渐进秩调度与秩感知学习率调度，改进低秩子空间动量优化器。
AI.motivation: INR训练先学全局低频后细化局部高频，但标准优化器对此无感知，会累积与低频主方向错位的动量分量。
AI.method: 在低秩子空间内更新动量矩阵；秩调度随训练扩大子空间，秩感知学习率调度在秩增长期保持峰值学习率以使新增子空间贡献于细节恢复。
AI.result: 在图像拟合、单图超分与NeRF优化上收敛更快、峰值重建质量更高，增益主要出现在高频细化阶段；NeRF超参搜索对照实验表明增益在同等预算下依旧存在。
AI.conclusion: 使优化器显式对齐INR的粗到细特性可有效提升重建质量，且效果不依赖于额外调参预算。

title: How resampling method can help us: Improving the Delta model
summary: Delta has been successfully employed as an authorship attribution method in various contexts, although its effectiveness is not always perfect. Since it is based on the most frequent words, its results can be readily interpreted and explained in plain English. In this study, we propose improving its performance by applying a resampling method to the selected stylistic features. The results show that this approach increases the accuracy of the model while preserving the interpretability of its outcomes. However, the main drawback of the proposed technique is the additional computational time required to obtain more accurate results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用重采样方法对Delta法的特征进行改进，在保持可解释性的同时提升作者归属准确率，代价是计算时间增加。
AI.motivation: Delta作为作者归属方法虽有成效但效果并不总是理想，且其基于高频词的特点使其结果易于用通俗英语解释；作者希望在保留这一可解释性优势的前提下提升其性能。
AI.method: 对Delta方法选定的文体特征（基于最频繁词）施加重采样（resampling）技术，以改进特征表示后再进行作者归属判定。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该重采样方法提升了模型准确率，同时保持了结果的可解释性；主要缺点是获得更准确结果需要额外的计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 重采样增强的Delta方法在准确性与可解释性之间取得了较好平衡，是一种有前景的作者归属改进方案，但需权衡计算成本。

title: Flipping the Coins: Training Physical Simulators through Hard Switches
summary: Hybrid simulators embed learnable components such as neural networks in physical solvers and train them on reference trajectories. Many scientific solvers feature hard switches, such as a tripping power line, an igniting grid cell, or depolarizing brain tissue, where the loss exhibits discrete jumps across switch flips, leaving standard automatic differentiation to capture only its smooth part. Existing training paradigms face a fundamentally challenging trade-off, as gradient-based relaxations smooth the switches and introduce bias across jumps, whereas derivative-free methods treat the solver as a black box and discard path gradients of the continuous dynamics. Here we introduce EventFlip, which flips a near-threshold switch from a stored state, replays the original solver, and measures the loss difference between the two runs, in effect a finite difference across the switch. By perturbing every threshold with small Gaussian noise, we cast each switch as a stochastic binary decision and derive an unbiased gradient estimator that combines the continuous path gradient with a jump term constructed from these counterfactual rollouts. EventFlip-Rand optimizes this noise-averaged objective, whereas EventFlip-Hard operates on the deterministic hard-switch simulator used at deployment and provably targets the complete discontinuous loss. Under an identical forward evaluation budget, we benchmark EventFlip against twelve baselines across a power-grid cascade, a detonation wave, and cortical spreading depolarization, achieving the lowest error on every task and reducing the strongest baseline's error by factors of 1.5, 1.4, and 1.4, respectively.

AI.tldr: 针对含硬切换的科学求解器混合模拟器，提出EventFlip无偏梯度估计器，结合路径梯度与反事实跳跃项，在三个任务上误差最低。
AI.motivation: 混合模拟器将神经网络等可学习组件嵌入物理求解器并用参考轨迹训练。许多科学求解器含硬切换（如线路跳闸、网格点火、脑组织去极化），损失在切换翻转处出现离散跳跃，标准自动微分只能捕获其平滑部分。现有训练范式面临两难：梯度松弛会平滑切换并引入跨跳变偏差，而无导数方法把求解器当黑箱、丢弃连续动态的路径梯度。
AI.method: EventFlip从存储状态翻转一个接近阈值的开关，重放原求解器并测量两次运行的损失差，相当于跨开关的有限差分。对每个阈值施加小幅高斯噪声，将每个开关视为随机二值决策，从而推导出无偏梯度估计器，将连续路径梯度与由反事实轨迹构建的跳跃项结合。variant上，EventFlip-Rand优化噪声平均目标；EventFlip-Hard在部署所用的确定性硬切换模拟器上运行，可证明针对完整的不连续损失。
AI.result: 在相同前向评估预算下，与十二个基线方法在电网级联、爆轰波和皮层扩散性去极化三个任务上对比，EventFlip在每个任务上误差最低，分别将最强基线的误差降低1.5、1.4和1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实重放的有限差分构造无偏梯度估计器，可有效解决硬切换导致的不连续损失训练难题，兼顾路径梯度与跳跃项，在多个真实科学任务上优于现有方法与无导数基线。

title: DoseSteer: Steering diffusion-based dose prediction models towards clinical targets via Dual-Response Guidance
summary: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy. Yet these predictions can still miss structure-level clinical dose targets. Once deployed, most existing predictors offer no direct mechanism to correct such deviations, deferring target enforcement to downstream plan optimization. We introduce DoseSteer, an inference-time framework that steers frozen diffusion-based dose prediction models towards specified clinical targets without retraining. To meet clinical targets while preserving overall dose prediction quality, we propose Dual-Response Guidance (DRG), a structure-centric algorithm that probes the model's responses to perturbations in each structure's noisy dose and context and jointly solves for per-structure steering strengths. Across five dataset-model configurations spanning three diffusion architectures and three datasets, DRG outperforms 12 training-free baselines under identical reference-derived target proxies, removing at least 97% of the target error, reducing the official dose error by 7.8% on average, and improving dose fidelity outside the steered structures. DoseSteer reconciles learned anatomical dose priors with explicit structure-level targets at test time, establishing a principled, training-free mechanism to refine AI dose predictions prior to plan optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/csp2002/DoseSteer.

AI.tldr: 提出 DoseSteer 推理时框架，无需重训练即可将冻结的扩散式剂量预测模型引导至指定临床结构级剂量目标，核心为 Dual-Response Guidance（DRG），在 5 个数据集-模型配置上消除至少 97% 目标误差，官方剂量误差平均降低 7.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 剂量预测模型虽能由解剖结构生成 3D 剂量分布，但仍会偏离结构级临床剂量目标；部署后缺乏直接纠偏机制，只能把目标约束推给下游计划优化。
AI.method: 推理时引导框架 DoseSteer：对冻结的扩散模型不重训。DRG（Dual-Response Guidance）以结构为中心，探测模型对各结构噪声剂量与上下文扰动的响应，联合求解每个结构的引导强度，在满足临床目标的同时保持整体剂量预测质量。
AI.result: 跨 3 种扩散架构、3 个数据集共 5 个配置，在相同参考目标代理下优于 12 个免训练基线：消除至少 97% 目标误差，官方剂量误差平均降低 7.8%，并改善未引导结构外的剂量保真度。
AI.conclusion: DoseSteer 在测试阶段调和了学到的解剖剂量先验与显式结构级目标，为计划优化前精修 AI 剂量预测提供了有原理依据的免训练机制。

title: Familiar Words, Unfamiliar Minds: Conventionalization without Calibration in the Vocabulary of Mind
summary: Speakers describe new technologies by stretching old words, letting experience of the new referents sort out which inferences carry over. I argue that stretching the vocabulary of mind to language models pulls apart two processes that theories of metaphor and linguistic change tend to conflate: conventionalization, whereby a stretched word ceases to be marked as such, and calibration, whereby the inferences it invites are fitted to what its new referents bear out. As a gene variant can reach fixation without being an adaptation, a word can become conventional without being calibrated. A corpus study of "hallucinate" in 8,568 abstracts and 31,866 forum comments shows conventionalization running most of its course within three years. Calibration need not keep pace: these models are organized so unlike human minds that it is hard to tell when mental words apply and what they imply. Even warranted attributions can mislead: mechanistic analysis shows that a transformer trained to navigate Manhattan has and uses a faithful street map, yet loses track of its position on long, diverted journeys. Nor is the gap likely to close by itself. The usual routes to calibration (direct experience, designers' knowledge, experiment) presuppose a referent that is accessible, stable, and independent of the discourse about it. But language models are opaque, fast-changing, and looped into the discourse: they are trained on past uses of mental vocabulary and on the experimental literature about them, and join the discourse themselves. Calibration must therefore be organized, through a reciprocal, not merely deferential, division of linguistic labour. This yields a norm of targeted qualification (flag the specific inferences an attribution invites without support), a reply to the worry that meaning change eludes deliberate control, and three testable predictions about when qualifications calibrate expectations.

AI.tldr: 论文区分语言隐喻的"惯例化"与"校准"两个过程，通过"hallucinate"语料研究及机制分析表明：心智词汇用于语言模型时可迅速惯例化但难以校准，因此需要组织化的双向语言分工与"针对性限定"规范。
AI.motivation: 人们用旧词指称新技术时，往往把隐喻理论与语言变迁理论混为一谈的"惯例化"和"校准"视为同一过程。当心智词汇被用于语言模型时，这一混淆暴露出来：词可以变得通用而无需真正核对新指称对象，而语言模型不透明、快速变化且卷入话语循环，使常规校准途径失效。
AI.method: (1)概念区分：将惯例化（词不再被标记为隐喻）与校准（该词所引导的推论是否拟合新指称对象）分开；(2)对8,568篇摘要与31,866条论坛评论中"hallucinate"一词的语料研究；(3)对在曼哈顿导航任务上训练的transformer进行机制分析，考察其心智归因的可靠性；(4)论证校准所需指称条件的缺失并提出规范方案。
AI.result: 语料研究显示"hallucinate"的惯例化在三年内基本完成，但校准未必同步。机制分析表明：即便某transformer拥有并使用了忠实的街道地图，在长距离、绕行的路线上仍会丢失自身位置——即有根据的心智归因也可能误导。通常的校准途径（直接经验、设计者知识、实验）都预设指称对象可及、稳定且独立于相关话语，而语言模型三者皆不具备。
AI.conclusion: 惯例化不等于校准，如基因变异可固定而非适应。语言模型的心智词汇校准必须被有组织地进行，依靠互惠而非单纯顺从的语言分工，由此得出"针对性限定"规范（点明归因所引发但缺乏支持的特定推论），回应了"意义变化无法被自觉控制"的担忧，并提出三个关于限定何时能校准预期的可检验预测。

title: Should Service Requirements Be Scalarized or Constrained When Minimizing Costs? A Case Study on HVAC Control
summary: Automated decision systems, from learned policies to model-based optimizers, often minimize costs such as energy or resource use while meeting a service requirement, for example the quality of service (QoS) specified in a service level agreement (SLA), a comfort band, or a safety margin. The requirement can be scalarized with the costs into a single objective, with a fixed or an adaptively tuned (Lagrangian) weight, or it can be imposed as a constraint. We study this choice in the Smart Buildings Challenge, in which a single policy controls the heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) of previously unseen buildings and is evaluated by a weighted sum of comfort, energy cost and carbon emissions. With all other components fixed, we compare the two treatments in model-based optimization, represented by model predictive control (MPC) with the requirement as a hard or a soft (l1-penalized) constraint, and in learned policies, represented by proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a fixed or a Lagrangian penalty in the reward or a projection layer on the action. In MPC, the soft constraint reproduces the hard one once its weight exceeds the requirement's shadow price, which the challenge's comfort weight exceeds approximately fourfold; below this weight, comfort is sacrificed, and under a metric that values comfort below its shadow price the soft constraint outperforms the hard one by up to 28%. A weight tuned on the training buildings is 3.9% worse than the hard constraint on 48 unseen buildings, because the shadow price varies across buildings. In PPO, the projected policy satisfies the requirement from the outset and leads early in training; with longer training, the Lagrangian policy overtakes it while the projected policy deteriorates, and the fixed penalty does not learn to satisfy the requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文在 Smart Buildings Challenge 场景下系统比较了"标量化（固定/拉格朗日权重）"与"约束化（硬/软约束、投影层）"两种处理服务需求的方式，覆盖 MPC 与 PPO 两类方法。
AI.motivation: 自动决策系统常在最小化成本（能耗、资源）的同时满足某项服务需求（QoS、舒适带、安全裕度）。该需求可被标量化为加权目标，或被作为约束施加；这一建模选择对性能的影响缺乏系统、可比的实证分析。
AI.method: 以 HVAC 控制任务为试验床（舒适度、能耗、碳排放加权评价），其余组件固定，仅对比需求处理方式：MPC 中为硬约束 vs. l1 惩罚软约束；PPO 中为固定惩罚 vs. 拉格朗日惩罚 vs. 动作投影层。
AI.result: MPC 中软约束权重超过需求影子价格（挑战赛权重约为其 4 倍）时可复现硬约束；权重偏低则牺牲舒适度，在低估舒适度的度量下软约束最多优于硬约束 28%；训练集调出的权重在 48 个未见建筑上比硬约束差 3.9%，因影子价格随建筑变化。PPO 中投影策略训练初期即满足需求并领先，但更长时间训练后被拉格朗日策略反超且自身退化，固定惩罚则学不会满足需求。
AI.conclusion: 标量化与约束化的选择后果显著且依赖于权重设置、影子价格的跨实例变化与训练时长；单一超参（权重）难以泛化，约束/拉格朗日类方法在中长期训练中更具优势。

title: Understanding Mode Collapse in Diffusion Models under Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: The use of classifier-free guidance in diffusion and flow models has proven critical to their empirical success, as it allows for the controllable generation of lower-temperature and higher-fidelity samples. Despite its widespread use, classifier-free guidance remains both empirically and theoretically poorly understood, owing to the difficulty of solving the associated transport equations for arbitrary normalizing flows.
