On Huginn-0125, FlyingStart matches the accuracy of the strongest training-free baseline with 14--19% fewer decoding layers, raises batched throughput by 16--18% in two serving engines, and adds a further 10--14% on top of self-speculative decoding. A contraction analysis predicts the number of loops saved on all four models we study, including one where the prediction was recorded before any evaluation, and token by token on Huginn, and it identifies when a warm start pays off: the saving grows with the number of loops a model needs to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文指出循环深度语言模型的迭代起点是被忽视的第二个杠杆，提出 FlyingStart：利用前一 token 的停止状态经学习坐标变换后作为下一 token 的线性热启动，闭式拟合于冻结模型、开销不足一次循环的 5%，在不改迭代与停止规则的前提下减少循环次数并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有循环深度语言模型的推理方法只决定"何时停止"迭代，但每个 token 仍从随机噪声出发，必须付出完整的收敛代价，造成大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 关键观察：token 的不动点可由前一个 token 停止时的隐状态经学习坐标变换预测。据此提出 FlyingStart——一种在冻结模型上闭式拟合的线性热启动方法，代价低于一次循环开销的 5%；迭代过程与停止准则保持不变，退出判据从任意起点都能证明相同的到不动点距离。并用收缩分析预测可节省的循环数。
AI.result: Huginn-0125 上以少 14–19% 的解码层数达到最强免训练基线精度；两个服务引擎中批处理吞吐提升 16–18%；在自投机解码之上再提升 10–14%。收缩分析在研究的全部四个模型（含一个评测前即记录的预测）和 Huginn 的逐 token 上均准确预测节省的循环数，并指出节省随模型收敛所需循环数增加而增大。
AI.conclusion: 迭代起点与停止规则是相互独立的两个杠杆，更好的热启动可在精度不变下减少循环，且其收益可被收缩理论定量预测。

title: EXPOSURE: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ESANN 2027. Code: https://github.com/kianaf/exposure-rl
summary: Shapley values in reinforcement learning are used to explain which observation features drive an agent's behavior and expected return, but not its certainty. Explaining certainty requires understanding how observation features influence different sources of return uncertainty, and Shapley values need the agent's prediction for every subset of visible features. We propose EXPOSURE, which uses one mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations. It explains the variance of the return, split into an observational part due to missing features and an inherent part due to the environment's own randomness, and the entropy of its belief over the masked features. In tic-tac-toe and Minesweeper, where exact Shapley values are computable, EXPOSURE gives more accurate explanations of expected return and its uncertainty, while uniquely explaining belief uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出 EXPOSURE：用单一 mask-aware belief network 同时做动作选择与 Shapley 解释，可解释回报方差（观测缺失部分与环境固有随机部分）及对掩码特征的信念熵。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 中的 Shapley 值只解释哪些观测特征驱动行为与期望回报，却不解释"确定性"；而解释不确定性需理解特征如何影响不同来源的回报不确定性。
AI.method: 用带掩码感知（mask-aware）的信念网络统一处理所有可见特征子集的预测，从而计算 Shapley 值；将回报方差分解为缺失特征导致的观测部分与环境固有随机部分，并解释关于被掩码特征的信念熵。
AI.result: 在可精确计算 Shapley 值的井字棋与扫雷任务中，EXPOSURE 对期望回报及其不确定性的解释更准确，并独有地解释了信念不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 单一 mask-aware 信念网络即可兼顾决策与多源不确定性解释，实现对回报不确定性与信念不确定性的有效归因。

title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
summary: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.

AI.tldr: Floodgates 提出一种面向循环语言模型的自推测解码方法：将一段掩码 token 作为后缀并行草拟，再用深层循环验证，多数场景下成为最快的无损解码方法，最高加速 7.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 循环模型可通过调整循环次数来调节计算量，此前已被用于自推测解码（浅循环做草稿、深循环做验证），类似 Medusa/自推测思路。但现有方法中草稿仍用完整参数做逐 token 推测，未充分利用浅循环对多个未来 token 的预测潜力，推理加速有限。作者希望进一步挖掘这一潜力来大幅加速循环模型推理。
AI.method: 提出 Floodgates：在输入后附加一块 mask token 作为后缀，通过低秩适配（LoRA）学习并行草拟该块 token；浅层循环作为草稿器并行预测多个未来 token（而非仅下一个 token），深层循环作为验证器；草稿器以验证阶段计算出的深层前缀缓存为条件，从而利用全深度计算信息。
AI.result: 在 7 个模型、5 个基准、多种 batch size 以及贪心与采样解码设置下，Floodgates 在大多数情况下是最快的无损解码方法，最高达 7.5 倍加速。分析表明，该加速得益于循环模型的全深度训练，以及浅层草稿器借助深层前缀缓存利用全深度计算的能力。
AI.conclusion: 浅循环不仅能预测下一个 token，还能预测多个未来 token；结合 mask 后缀并行草拟与深层前缀缓存条件化，可在不损失输出的前提下显著加速循环语言模型推理。全深度训练是该方法奏效的关键。

title: WorldUAV: Scaling UAV Data Synthesis via World Models
summary: UAV detection and tracking remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing game-engine-based synthetic UAV data suffer from a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, while the high cost of manually collected real-world UAV data limits dataset scale. Therefore, we introduce WorldUAV, a high-quality UAV dataset constructed through an efficient framework powered by world models. Specifically, WorldUAV directly integrates UAVs into readily available real-world videos, naturally preserving realistic backgrounds, illumination, and scene dynamics. Leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of world models, it generates UAV videos with plausible motion, pose variations, and cross-frame consistency, effectively narrowing the gap between synthetic and real data. We further develop an agentic pipeline orchestrated by a multimodal large language model that acquires sources, plans UAV trajectories, invokes synthesis, and verifies generated videos, enabling fully automated dataset construction. WorldUAV comprises 6,878 UAV videos and 205,778 UAV images. Experiments show that WorldUAV significantly improves the performance of UAV detectors. Moreover, it substantially reduces dataset construction costs, requiring only 15 seconds and USD 0.0005 API cost per high-quality UAV image. Our work offers both a high-quality dataset and a scalable data generation paradigm for UAV detection and tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldUAV：用世界模型把无人机直接合成进现成真实视频，配合 MLLM 多智能体自动化流水线构建无人机数据集（6,878 段视频 / 205,778 张图像），显著提升检测性能且成本极低（每张图 15 秒、0.0005 美元）。
AI.motivation: UAV 检测与跟踪受限于高质量训练数据稀缺：游戏引擎合成数据存在明显 sim-to-real 差距，而人工采集真实无人机数据成本高、规模受限。作者希望兼顾真实性、规模与成本。
AI.method: 将 UAV 直接插入现成的真实世界视频中，保留真实背景、光照与场景动态；利用世界模型的时空先验生成具有合理运动、姿态变化与跨帧一致性的无人机视频，从而缩小合成-真实差距。同时构建由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）编排的 agentic 流水线，负责素材获取、轨迹规划、调用合成与生成视频校验，实现全自动数据集构建。
AI.result: WorldUAV 包含 6,878 段 UAV 视频和 205,778 张 UAV 图像；实验表明其显著提升 UAV 检测器性能，并大幅降低构建成本，每张高质量 UAV 图像仅需 15 秒和 0.0005 美元 API 费用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作同时提供了高质量数据集与可扩展的数据生成范式，为 UAV 检测与跟踪的数据瓶颈提供了低成本、可自动化的解决路径。

title: Know the Design, Pick the Attack: Sentence-Keyed Watermarks for LLMs
summary: A watermark lets the provider of a language model recognise the text its model wrote, which matters more as generated text becomes hard to tell from human writing: provenance underpins academic integrity, the fight against misinformation and new regulation. Providers have started to watermark the text of their models, and to explain how their watermarks work. Explaining a watermark, however, also tells an attacker how to break it, and there are two ways to do so: reword the text to erase the mark, or learn the mark and copy it onto text the model never wrote. Each attack has been studied on its own. We study an attacker that reads the published design to choose between them: it erases the watermarks that are hard to learn and forges the ones that survive rewording. Against it, every existing watermark we compare fails. We propose KeyedLex, which reads its secret key from the grammar of the previous sentence, which rewording changes little, and whose detector does not need to recover the key exactly. It outperforms every watermark we compare on both models we test, losing about half of its signal where the best alternative loses two thirds, at no extra cost in text quality over the best-known watermarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KeyedLex 水印方法，从上一句的语法结构中派生密钥，使水印对改写更鲁棒、更难被学习伪造，在两个模型上均优于现有水印。
AI.motivation: 语言模型提供商已开始公开其水印方案原理，但公开设计也让攻击者可据此选择攻击方式：难以学习的水印就通过改写抹除，能扛住改写的水印则学习后伪造到模型未写的文本上。现有水印各自只能抵御其中一种攻击，面对同时使用两种策略的"择优攻击者"全部失效。
AI.method: 将秘密密钥与上一句的语法结构绑定生成 KeyedLex 水印；语法在改写时变化较小，从而抵御抹除攻击；同时检测器无需精确恢复密钥，提高了检测容错性。作者还建模了一个可阅读公开设计并在两种攻击间择优的攻击者作为评估对象。
AI.result: 在两个测试模型上，KeyedLex 均优于所有对比水印：面对择优攻击者时信号仅损失约一半，而最佳基线损失约三分之二；同时在文本质量上与已知最佳水印持平，无额外代价。
AI.conclusion: 将密钥锚定在改写鲁棒的语法结构、并允许检测器容忍密钥不完全恢复，是同时抵御"抹除"与"伪造"两类攻击的可行思路；但 KeyedLex 仍损失约一半信号，水印对抗择优攻击的鲁棒性仍有提升空间。

title: Navigent: A Geometry-Grounded Agentic Framework for Vision Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a flexible alternative to task-specific navigation policies, while reliable long-horizon execution remains challenging. Agents must track navigation progress, detect discrepancies between commanded and actual motion, and recognize when movement has passed relevant landmarks or entrances. We present Navigent, an agentic VLN framework built around a frozen MLLM and a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic (GEC). GEC performs two complementary checks: action-to-motion consistency, which evaluates measured displacement against commanded movement, and motion-to-landmark consistency, which tracks agent-selected visual anchors and entrance candidates in world coordinates. Detected discrepancies interrupt the remaining action sequence and trigger reobservation, local adjustment, or node-based recovery. Historical visual memory supports progress tracking across extended routes. An offline self-improvement procedure further analyzes successful and failed training trajectories to refine navigation prompts and GEC logic while keeping model weights fixed. On the R2R-CE validation-unseen split (1,839 episodes) and RxR-CE validation-unseen split(3,669 episodes), Navigent achieves 84.0%/86.0% SR and 72.9%/69.1% SPL, respectively, demonstrating the value of geometry-grounded execution verification for reliable agentic navigation. Project Page: https://marslab-navigent.github.io/navigent.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/MarsLab-Navigent/Navigent

AI.tldr: 提出 Navigent，一种基于冻结 MLLM 的智能体式 VLN 框架，核心是几何锚定的执行评审器（GEC），通过动作-运动一致性、运动-地标一致性两类检查打断错误动作序列并触发恢复，配合历史视觉记忆与离线自改进；在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 验证未见集上取得 84.0%/86.0% SR 与 72.9%/69.1% SPL。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型为 VLN 提供灵活且无需任务专用策略的方案，但长程可靠执行仍困难：智能体需跟踪导航进度、检测指令与实际运动的偏差、并判断是否已越过相关地标或入口。
AI.method: 围绕冻结 MLLM 构建智能体框架，加入 Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic：(1) 动作-运动一致性检查，将实测位移与指令动作比对；(2) 运动-地标一致性检查，在世界坐标系中追踪智能体自选的视觉锚点与入口候选。检测到偏差即中断剩余动作序列，触发重新观察、局部调整或基于节点的恢复；并用历史视觉记忆支撑长路线进度跟踪。另有离线自改进流程，分析成功/失败轨迹以优化导航提示与 GEC 逻辑，模型权重保持不变。
AI.result: R2R-CE 验证未见集（1,839 回合）：SR 84.0%，SPL 72.9%；RxR-CE 验证未见集（3,669 回合）：SR 86.0%，SPL 69.1%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明几何锚定的执行验证对可靠智能体式导航具有显著价值，可在不训练模型权重的前提下提升长程执行的鲁棒性。

title: Correlation-Aware Evidential Fusion for Trusted Multi-View Classification
summary: Trusted multi-view classification aims to make accurate and reliable predictions by integrating information from multiple views. Existing methods typically estimate class evidence and uncertainty for each view and combine the resulting opinions through aggregation rules. However, they generally treat different views as independent information sources, overlooking the correlations among them. Highly correlated views tend to produce similar evidence, and treating them as independent sources may repeatedly count consistent information and give it disproportionate influence, while weakening complementary evidence that provides additional information. Consequently, such correlation-unaware fusion may not only limit classification performance but also produce miscalibrated uncertainty estimates. To address this issue, we propose Correlation-Aware Fusion of Evidence (CAFE), a framework for trusted multi-view classification. CAFE applies complementarity-based trust discounting to the evidence produced by view-private experts and introduces a correlation-aware constraint to reduce the repeated contribution of similar evidence. It then learns sample-specific weights from the global multi-view context to adaptively combine the correlation-adjusted private evidence with cross-view collaborative evidence. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that CAFE consistently improves classification and calibration performance in general settings, with particularly significant gains when strong correlations exist among views.

AI.tldr: CAFE: 通过互补性信任折扣和相关感知约束，解决多视图证据融合中视图相关性被忽视的问题，提升分类与校准性能。
AI.motivation: 现有可信多视图分类方法将各视图视为独立信息源，忽略视图间相关性。高度相关的视图会产生相似证据，独立处理会重复计入一致信息、赋予其过大权重，同时削弱互补证据，导致分类性能受限且不确定性估计失准。
AI.method: 提出 Correlation-Aware Fusion of Evidence (CAFE) 框架：1) 对视图私有专家产生的证据施加基于互补性的信任折扣；2) 引入相关感知约束，降低相似证据的重复贡献；3) 从全局多视图上下文学习样本特异性权重，自适应融合相关性调整后的私有证据与跨视图协作证据。
AI.result: 在六个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，CAFE 在一般设置下持续提升分类与校准性能，且在视图间存在强相关时增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模视图相关性并调整证据融合，可有效避免一致信息的重复计数，兼顾互补证据利用，从而同时改善多视图分类精度与不确定性校准的可靠性。

title: Read Before You Use: Improving Visual Memory Utilization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal memory enables long-horizon vision-language agents to preserve and retrieve past experiences. While prior research has focused on memory construction and retrieval, effectively using the provided memory remains a challenge for vision-language models (VLMs). We find that VLMs often fail to answer downstream questions even when sufficient multimodal evidence is provided. To investigate why VLMs struggle, we replace memory images with reference captions and observe substantial performance gains, suggesting difficulties in reading visual evidence directly. However, model-generated captions may omit critical information, limiting this approach in practice. These limitations motivate a closer examination of memory utilization, revealing failures in both evidence reading and downstream question answering. Building on this distinction, we propose \textbf{MemRU}, a two-stage training framework that improves evidence reading through supervised fine-tuning (Read SFT) and downstream evidence utilization through Group Relative Policy Optimization (Use GRPO). Experimental results demonstrate that our 8B model generalizes across three unseen multimodal memory systems, outperforming Qwen3-VL-32B and approaching GPT-5-mini.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多模态记忆的"使用"瓶颈，发现VLM难以直接读取记忆图像，提出两阶段训练框架MemRU：Read SFT提升证据读取，Use GRPO提升下游利用。
AI.motivation: 长程视觉语言智能体需要多模态记忆保存与检索过去经验，而现有研究多聚焦记忆构建与检索，忽略了VLM有效"使用"已提供记忆的难题——即使给出充分的多模态证据，VLM仍常常答错。
AI.method: 通过将记忆图像替换为参考描述，观察性能大幅提升，定位问题在于VLM"读取视觉证据"困难；进一步分析发现记忆利用在"证据读取"和"下游问答"两个环节均会失败。据此提出MemRU两阶段训练：先以监督微调（Read SFT）改善证据读取，再用组相对策略优化（Use GRPO）强化下游证据利用。模型生成的描述可能遗漏关键信息，故不能仅依赖描述替代。
AI.result: 实验表明8B模型可泛化到三种未见过的多模态记忆系统，性能超过Qwen3-VL-32B并接近GPT-5-mini。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆利用拆分为证据读取与下游问答两阶段并分别用SFT与GRPO优化是有效路径，小模型亦可在此任务上具备强泛化与竞争力。

title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
summary: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. Domain-specific data selection and augmentation improve factual knowledge, mathematics, and programming skills, while agent trajectories introduced during pretraining improve performance on agentic benchmarks after supervised fine-tuning. In zero-shot reasoning evaluation, the model achieves leading results among open base models of comparable size, with 88.7% pass@8 on IMO-AnswerBench and 82.9% pass@8 on LiveCodeBench v5-v6. To evaluate Russian-language factual knowledge, we introduce and release two benchmarks with their evaluation protocols: WikiWebFacts, which tests short factual questions drawn from encyclopedic sources and search queries, and HardMultiQA, which tests more demanding factual questions inspired by user interactions. Our model scores 86.5% on WikiWebFacts and 67.9% on HardMultiQA, compared with 83.2% and 65.4% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base (284B total and 13B active parameters) and 72.8% and 54.5% for Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base (120B total and 12B active parameters), outperforming both larger models on these benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Yandex发布80B总参/3B激活的MoE基座模型AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base（Apache 2.0），在零样本推理与俄语事实知识基准上超越更大规模的开放基座模型。
AI.motivation: 作者希望以高稀疏度MoE在可控激活参数下构建强基座模型，同时指出"留出集训练损失"作为下游性能代理的局限，并弥补俄语事实知识评测基准的缺失。
AI.method: 从零训练MoE模型：Kimi Delta Attention与全注意力混合、Attention Residuals、Muon优化器；17.5T token通用预训练+两阶段上下文扩展+推理与智能体专项阶段；含数据采集/增强流程、架构消融与缩放律实验；引入MoE输出上的辅助损失以在预测学习率下稳定训练；预训练中引入智能体轨迹。
AI.result: 零样本推理在同规模开放基座模型中领先：IMO-AnswerBench pass@8 88.7%、LiveCodeBench v5-v6 pass@8 82.9%；新发布的俄语基准WikiWebFacts 86.5%、HardMultiQA 67.9%，优于DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base（83.2%/65.4%，284B总参）与Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base（72.8%/54.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 领域数据筛选与增强提升事实、数学与编程能力；预训练引入智能体轨迹可在SFT后提升智能体基准表现；模型以远少激活参数超越更大模型，验证了架构、数据与训练策略的有效性。

title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并研究"技能能启用但未被充分利用"（EBU）现象，构建EBU-Bench基准（12类医疗任务）量化自主使用与显式引导使用技能的准确率差距，并提出EBU-Evolve将执行反馈蒸馏为技能指令，使自主使用准确率提升33.33–55.17pp。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽拥有包含规则和流程的技能，但自主执行时常常无法有效应用，在医疗等高风险场景中忽视一个关键约束就会导致看似合理却错误的结论，因此需要量化和缓解这一EBU问题。
AI.method: 构建MedSkill-E²框架；构造EBU-Bench基准覆盖12个医疗相关任务组及配套技能；以"显式引导阅读并应用技能"与"自主使用技能"的准确率差定义EBU gap；提出EBU-Evolve，利用两种使用模式下的执行反馈，将有效指导蒸馏进可复用的技能说明中。
AI.result: 所有被测模型-harness组合均存在EBU，平均差距43.94pp；同一模型在不同harness上自主技能使用准确率最多相差38.96pp；进化后的技能使自主执行准确率提升33.33–55.17pp，且可跨模型、跨harness迁移，模型排名也可能改变。
AI.conclusion: 在模型与技能固定时，自主技能使用准确率随harness变化；即使技能被打开，EBU仍可能存在；EBU-Evolve能在同技能未见任务上提升自主使用准确率并跨模型与harness迁移，凸显harness设计与技能表述的重要性。

title: InstructTTS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Objective Instruction-Following TTS
summary: Instruction-following text-to-speech (Instruct-TTS) renders a target transcript in the manner described by a free-form natural-language instruction, and a good rendition must succeed on three fronts at once: following the instruction, pronouncing the transcript correctly, and sounding natural. Reinforcement learning has become the standard way to post-train such generative models toward human preferences, and TTS systems increasingly adopt it. When the three objectives are optimized together under a single scalar reward, typically with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), training tends to be unstable: the objectives compete, and the shared update drifts toward whichever one is easiest to improve, producing a seesaw among them. We instead adapt on-policy distillation (OPD), which fuses several single-objective teachers by matching their velocity fields on the student's own rollouts. Realizing this for Instruct-TTS first calls for a sound reward on each axis, which we analyze carefully: a distilled Qwen-Omni proxy for the costly Gemini judge, dialect-free data for the WER reward, and DNSMOS in place of the language-biased UTMOS. We then train three single-objective teachers with GRPO and fuse them with OPD, routing each rollout to the instruction-following or WER teacher by its data domain and letting every rollout additionally follow the MOS teacher for quality. This lets instruction following and intelligibility improve together without a trade-off, but the quality target conflicts with instruction following, so following it additively reintroduces the seesaw. We therefore propose conflict-aware velocity fusion, which projects the quality target off the direction that opposes the primary objective before fusing, and show that it markedly reduces the instruction-following/quality trade-off. The fused model improves over scalar-reward GRPO on all three objectives at once.

AI.tldr: 提出基于冲突感知速度融合的在线策略蒸馏(OPD)框架，解决 Instruct-TTS 中指令遵循、发音准确、自然度三目标在单标量奖励 GRPO 下互相拉扯的"跷跷板"问题，实现三目标同时提升。
AI.motivation: Instruct-TTS 需同时满足指令遵循、转写准确、声音自然三方面要求。现有做法将三者合并为单一标量奖励并用 GRPO 优化，但目标间相互竞争，共享更新会漂向最易改进的目标，导致训练不稳定并出现目标间的跷跷板现象。
AI.method: 改用在策略蒸馏(OPD)：在学生自身 rollout 上匹配多个单目标教师的 velocity field。首先为各维度设计可靠奖励：用蒸馏的 Qwen-Omni 代理替代昂贵 Gemini 评判、用无方言数据计算 WER、用 DNSMOS 替代有语言偏置的 UTMOS。随后用 GRPO 分别训练三个单目标教师，再以 OPD 融合：按数据域将 rollout 路由到指令遵循或 WER 教师，并同时跟随 MOS 教师。针对质量目标与指令遵循的冲突，提出冲突感知速度融合——融合前将质量目标投影到与主目标相反方向的法向之外。
AI.result: 指令遵循与可懂度可无权衡地共同提升；冲突感知融合显著降低指令遵循与音质之间的权衡。最终融合模型在全部三个目标上同时优于标量奖励 GRPO。
AI.conclusion: 以多教师 OPD 加冲突感知速度融合替代单标量奖励 GRPO，是缓解 Instruct-TTS 多目标跷跷板、实现三目标协同提升的有效后训练方案。

title: GeoTex: Geometry-as-Texture Encoding and History-Grounded 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting models 3D scene evolution to support future prediction and scenario generation in autonomous-driving world models. Semantic occupancy abstracts image color and texture into discrete labels, leaving 3D voxel arrangements as the primary cues for distinguishing local shapes within each class. Existing methods borrow image-encoding frameworks to obtain compact latent representations through height channelization or plane factorization, but do not sufficiently model within-column height patterns and cross-column relations jointly before compression, weakening these geometric cues. Forecasting also underutilizes complementary history and struggles to retain reliable observation evidence. We therefore propose GeoTex, an occupancy world model combining geometry-as-texture encoding with history-grounded forecasting. GeoTex Representation jointly encodes within-column height patterns and cross-column relations into compact continuous latent representations and restores 3D structure through content-dependent height unfolding and geometric interaction. GeoTex Prediction retains initial evidence throughout rollout in fixed cross-observation relational memory and incorporates complementary recent history through target-referenced residual updates. After prediction training, decoder-only adaptation improves semantic decoding of predicted states. GeoTex improves average forecasting mIoU and IoU by 9.79% and 11.91% relative to GenieDrive while reducing parameters from 3.47M to 2.33M, with gains increasing at longer horizons. Code is included in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: GeoTex是一个4D占用世界模型，结合"几何即纹理"编码与历史锚定预测，提升自动驾驶场景演化预测精度并降低参数量。
AI.motivation: 语义占用丢失颜色纹理，仅剩3D体素排列提供类内形状线索。现有方法借用图像编码框架（高度通道化/平面分解），压缩前未联合建模列内高度模式与列间关系，削弱几何线索；预测阶段对互补历史利用不足，且难以保留可靠观测证据。
AI.method: 1) GeoTex Representation：联合编码列内高度模式与列间关系为紧凑连续隐表示，并通过内容依赖的高度展开与几何交互恢复3D结构；2) GeoTex Prediction：在固定跨观测关系记忆中保留初始证据，并以目标参照残差更新融入近期互补历史；3) 预测训练后采用decoder-only适配提升预测状态语义解码。
AI.result: 相对GenieDrive，平均预测mIoU提升9.79%，IoU提升11.91%，参数量由3.47M降至2.33M，且长时域增益更明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模几何线索与历史记忆机制，GeoTex在更小模型下实现更准确的4D占用预测，长时域优势突出，代码已随补充材料提供。

title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables (includes Appendix / Supplementary Material)
summary: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved by 2.90 percentage points on average, with a best score of 64.4%. On the human expert evaluation subset, EPPC-CARE and the human expert showed comparable agreement with the reference standard, with differences favoring EPPC-CARE. Discussion: These findings suggest that identifying triplet components (span, code, subcode) sequentially can improve performance across model families while preserving the supporting text behind each identification. EPPC-CARE links the communication code and subcode with the source text (span), supporting human verification of automated annotations in clinical informatics. EPPC-CARE may therefore make larger-scale studies of patient-provider communication more feasible and provide a foundation for human-in-the-loop annotation workflows. Conclusion: EPPC-CARE offers a more reliable and reviewable approach for automated characterization of communication behaviors in secure patient-provider messaging.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估EPPC-CARE，一个自动识别患者门户消息中沟通行为并给出支撑文本的三元组（span, code, subcode）抽取框架。
AI.motivation: 患者门户消息蕴含丰富的医患沟通信息，但人工提取成本高；且现有自动化方法难以在给出分类的同时保留支撑原文，不利于人工核查。
AI.method: 基于867条消息构建5,516条参考标准三元组标注（文本片段+沟通大类Code+子类Sub-code）；EPPC-CARE按顺序依次识别三元组各成分；在六种开源权重LLM上，与监督微调及EPPC-OASIS等沟通类模型对比，并在100条消息上与人类专家标注进行比较。
AI.result: 在全部六个模型上均优于EPPC-OASIS，Triplet F1平均提升2.90个百分点，最佳64.4%；在人类专家评估子集上，EPPC-CARE与参考标准的一致性可与专家相当，差异方向更有利于EPPC-CARE。
AI.conclusion: EPPC-CARE为安全医患消息中的沟通行为刻画提供了更可靠、可复核的自动化途径，支持人机协同（human-in-the-loop）标注流程，并使大规模沟通研究更可行。

title: Crucible: Evaluating LLM Agents in Executable Chemistry Research Environments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on chemistry knowledge benchmarks, which mainly assess question answering and isolated tasks. Chemical research, however, requires using specialized tools and interpreting their outputs to obtain chemically valid results. To address this gap, we introduce Crucible Bench to evaluate this ability across all four stages of the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycle. The benchmark contains 1,078 tasks in 12 task families curated from 18 published datasets, covering molecular design, synthesis planning, experimental execution, closed-loop optimization, simulation, and analytical characterization. Agents access 75 domain-specific tools through the Model Context Protocol in seven isolated environments. Sandboxed graders verify the resulting synthesis routes, experimental protocols, and other outputs. Laboratory tasks use robotic simulators or previously measured experimental data. We evaluate 14 LLMs as agents and find that the best achieves an overall score of 0.545, with synthesis planning and closed-loop optimization emerging as the hardest domains. Overall performance does not predict optimization performance well: the model ranked twelfth overall achieves the highest score in closed-loop optimization. Error analysis also shows that agents often submit chemically invalid results despite running their tools successfully. Stronger models benefit more from tool access, but reliable use of chemical software remains a challenge that Crucible Bench can track as models improve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Crucible Bench，一个覆盖化学 DMTA 全流程（设计-合成-测试-分析）的智能体基准，含 1,078 个任务、75 个领域工具、7 个隔离环境与沙箱评分器，用于评估 LLM 使用化学工具并产出化学上有效结果的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有化学基准主要考察问答与孤立任务，而真实化学研究需要调用专业工具并正确解释其输出才能得到化学上有效的结果，这一能力缺口未被评估。
AI.method: 构建 Crucible Bench：从 18 个已发表数据集整理 12 个任务族共 1,078 个任务，覆盖分子设计、合成规划、实验执行、闭环优化、模拟与分析表征；通过 Model Context Protocol 在 7 个隔离环境中提供 75 个领域专用工具；用沙箱评分器验证合成路线、实验方案等输出，实验室任务使用机器人模拟器或已有实测数据；评测 14 个 LLM 智能体。
AI.result: 最佳模型总分 0.545；合成规划与闭环优化最难；总体性能对优化性能预测性差（总排名第十二的模型在闭环优化中得分最高）；错误分析显示智能体常成功运行工具却提交化学上无效的结果；更强模型从工具接入中获益更多。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的化学软件使用仍是挑战，Crucible Bench 可作为跟踪模型进步的基准。

title: CondUQ: Calibrated Conditional Uncertainty Quantification Using Distribution Matching
summary: Many applications, especially reliability- and safety-critical ones, require accurate uncertainty quantification for the outputs of model- or learning-based measurement, estimation, and prediction systems. The errors of such systems often vary with factors such as input quality and operating conditions, and thus cannot be accurately described by a single Gaussian model. Although Gaussian mixture models and calibrated quantiles can approximate such error distributions, their unconditional forms do not capture how the error behavior depends on these factors. Hence, we propose condUQ, an approach that conditions error models on observable factors for enabling accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification. condUQ is built on top of an existing system without modifying it and applies even when the system is a black box. First, condUQ maps the observable factors to a latent quality index (QI) such that errors sharing the same QI follow a common, approximately Gaussian conditional distribution. The QI predictor is trained end-to-end with a distribution-matching objective, without requiring quality labels. Second, for each QI, a Gaussian error model is then fitted and calibrated on a large held-out dataset. condUQ is demonstrated on three examples: (a) GPS multipath errors conditioned on satellite elevation and signal strength, (b) relative attitude errors of a transformer-based visual relative pose regression model conditioned on its internal features of the image pairs, and (c) prediction errors of a world model conditioned on the input observations and actions. In all three examples, condUQ substantially reduces the discrepancy between the modeled and empirical error distributions compared with a single global model. Moreover, the learned QIs reveal how the underlying factors affect the error characteristics in a manner consistent with physical principles.

AI.tldr: condUQ 将误差模型条件化在可观测因素上，通过无监督学习的潜在质量指数(QI)对样本分组，为每组拟合并校准高斯误差模型，在 GPS 多路径、视觉相对位姿回归和世界模型三个案例中显著优于单一全局模型，且学到的 QI 符合物理直觉。
AI.motivation: 可靠性与安全关键应用需要准确的不确定性量化，但系统误差随输入质量和运行条件变化，单一高斯模型难以刻画；GMM 和校准分位数虽能近似误差分布，但其无条件形式无法反映误差行为如何依赖于这些因素。
AI.method: condUQ 构建于现有系统之上且不改动系统本身，可用于黑盒情形。第一步，将可观测因素映射为潜在质量指数(QI)，使同一 QI 下的误差服从近似共同的高斯条件分布；QI 预测器以分布匹配为目标端到端训练，无需质量标签。第二步，对每个 QI 在大型留出数据集上拟合并校准高斯误差模型。
AI.result: 三个示例：(a) 以卫星仰角和信号强度为条件的 GPS 多路径误差；(b) 以其图像对内部特征为条件的 Transformer 视觉相对位姿回归模型的相对姿态误差；(c) 以输入观测和动作为条件的世界模型预测误差。三者中 condUQ 相比单一全局模型均大幅缩小了建模误差分布与经验误差分布之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 基于可观测因素对误差模型做条件化能实现准确可靠的不确定性量化；学到的质量指数揭示了各因素如何影响误差特性，其方式与物理原理一致。

title: Efficient Scene-Distribution-Aware Second-Order Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to ACCV 2026
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) optimization updates the Gaussian parameters one training view at a time, tens of thousands of times. Unlike such single-view updates, multi-view batches reduce dependence on individual training views, and second-order optimization reduces the number of updates with larger, structured parameter changes. Because fewer updates leave fewer chances to correct a change that fits only the views used in one update, scene coverage becomes more important for each second-order update. Multi-view second-order updates, however, are expensive. Pixel sampling reduces this cost, but two issues remain. First, selecting views without considering overlap leaves some views redundant. To address this, we propose a view selection strategy that reduces this redundancy. Second, existing work processes the sampled pixels of each view in a separate pass and recomputes alpha compositing for these pixels from scratch. We introduce two implementation strategies that reduce both overheads by processing the sampled pixels of multiple views in joint passes and reusing the transmittance and accumulated color cached during rendering. On three datasets, our method reaches higher PSNR than the sampled second-order baseline in less than half its optimization time, with competitive SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出改进3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）多视图二阶优化的方法：通过考虑视图重叠的视图选择策略减少冗余，并用联合 pass 处理多视图采样像素、复用渲染缓存，在三个数据集上以不到一半时间达到更高PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3DGS逐视图更新数万次，依赖单一训练视图；多视图批次+二阶优化能减少更新次数，但每次更新覆盖面要求更高，且多视图二阶更新代价高昂。像素采样可降本，但仍存在视图冗余（未考虑重叠）和逐视图单独处理像素、从头重算alpha合成导致的额外开销。
AI.method: 1) 视图选择策略：考虑视图间重叠，减少冗余视图；2) 两种实现策略：将多视图采样像素放入联合pass处理，并复用渲染中缓存的透射率与累积颜色，避免从头重算alpha合成。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，相比采样二阶基线，以不到其一半的优化时间达到更高PSNR，SSIM与LPIPS具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过重叠感知视图选择与联合像素处理/缓存复用，可显著降低多视图二阶3DGS优化开销并提升质量，验证了多视图二阶优化的实用性。

title: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
summary: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.

AI.tldr: MEG2text 是一个非侵入式脑到文本解码系统，通过修正训练/评估流程、脑-文本对齐、类平衡词读出及目标词语言模型融合，在词排序任务上显著超越 MEG-XL。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式脑到文本的核心难点在于将学到的脑-语言表征转化为准确的词预测，而已有方法在此环节表现受限。
AI.method: 结合四部分：修正后的训练与评估流程、脑-文本对齐、类平衡的词读出层（学习式解码规则）、目标词语言模型融合。
AI.result: 在 LibriBrain100 词排序任务上达到 64.12% 平均 Top-10 平衡准确率，较 MEG-XL 在四个语料上平均提升 16.92 个百分点，且每个语料均有增益；受控实验表明实现修正与学习式读出均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 解码规则（而非仅表征）是非侵入式脑到文本的关键环节；相同特征下学习分类规则即可提升解码，系统改进能更好利用已对齐的神经特征。

title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. We initialize the router by imitating successful execution graphs, then jointly refine its decisions with a variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) whose reward favors correct answers and penalizes spending and budget overruns. Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.

AI.tldr: 提出 MeterRouter，一个预算感知的动态多智能体路由器，按每查询货币预算逐步构建协作图，实现准确、经济且可控的 MAS 路由。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统虽优于单智能体，但智能体间通信带来大量 token 开销；给每个智能体配大模型导致资源利用低效。查询成本由招募智能体数量、角色与模型分配、通信拓扑共同决定，而现有路由器只隐式处理成本，且固定的精度-成本偏好无法表达调用方对特定查询的付费意愿。
AI.method: MeterRouter 增量式合成协作图，在给定查询与每查询货币预算下，依次选择每个智能体的角色、LLM、入边连接与终止条件；先用模仿成功执行图进行初始化，再用 GRPO 变体联合优化决策，其奖励奖励正确答案并惩罚花费与预算超支。
AI.result: 在五个基准和三级 LLM 池上：精度可与最强 MAS 媲美；成本比最强 MAS 路由器低 82%，并把精度-成本前沿扩展到单智能体系统上限之外；能随指定预算调整开支且极少超支。
AI.conclusion: 将预算作为显式约束并为每查询动态分配资源，可有效提升 MAS 的资源效率与可控性。

title: BReD: Block Replay Dithering for Stable Low-Bit EMA Optimizer States
summary: Low-bit storage of optimizer states can substantially reduce the memory footprint of large-scale training. In practice, however, these states are not quantized once: at every training step, they are dequantized, updated, requantized, and written back. This iterative quantization pipeline can destabilize training. We identify a failure mode behind this instability: for states updated via exponential moving averages (EMAs), quantization errors are recursively fed into subsequent updates. As a result, biased errors accumulate over time while high-variance errors are amplified, particularly when the EMA decay factor is close to 1. To address this error accumulation, we propose BReD (Block Replay Dithering), a method that reduces rounding bias and controls rounding variance during quantization. BReD adapts classical subtractive dithering to optimizer-state quantization by combining deterministic seed replay with block-wise shared dither values, avoiding auxiliary random-tensor storage and per-element dither values generation. Across the default pretraining settings (five optimizers at 120M; AdamW and Muon at 1.1B and 3.4B model) and supervised fine-tuning (AdamW and Muon at 7B model), 4-bit BReD closely matches training with full-precision optimizer states, with PPL shifts $\leq0.5$ in pretraining and $\leq0.2$ in fine-tuning and average downstream performance changes within 0.7 points. Moreover, 3-bit BReD preserves stable convergence in the evaluated settings, offering a more aggressive alternative. Our implementation of BReD is available at: https://github.com/ZhanHeshen/BReD

AI.tldr: 提出 BReD（块重放抖动）方法，通过确定性种子重放和块级共享抖动值降低量化舍入偏差并控制方差，使 4-bit 优化器状态量化训练与全精度几乎一致。
AI.motivation: 低比特存储优化器状态可降低大规模训练显存，但训练中每步都要反量化—更新—重量化—写回，形成迭代量化管线。对于经指数移动平均（EMA）更新的状态，量化误差会被递归反馈进后续更新：偏差随时间累积、高方差误差被放大，尤其当 EMA 衰减因子接近 1 时会导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 分析并指出 EMA 优化器状态的量化误差累积失效模式；提出 BReD，将经典减法抖动（subtractive dithering）适配到优化器状态量化：结合确定性种子重放与块级共享抖动值，避免额外随机张量存储与逐元素抖动生成。
AI.result: 在默认预训练设置（120M 下五种优化器；1.1B 与 3.4B 下 AdamW 和 Muon）及 7B 模型监督微调（AdamW 和 Muon）中，4-bit BReD 与全精度优化器状态训练高度接近：预训练 PPL 偏移 ≤0.5，微调 ≤0.2，下游平均性能变化在 0.7 分以内；3-bit BReD 在评估设置中仍保持稳定收敛。
AI.conclusion: 量化误差的递归反馈是低比特优化器状态训练不稳定的关键原因；BReD 以低开销方式同时抑制舍入偏差与方差，使 4-bit 乃至 3-bit 优化器状态量化在多种模型规模和优化器下可行，代码已开源。

title: Nepali Currency Denomination Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and MobileNetV2: An Experimental Comparison
summary: Automated currency denomination recognition is a computer vision task with applications in cash handling, financial technology, and assistive systems. This study classifies seven Nepali currency denominations (Rs. 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, and 1,000) using three configurations: a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN), MobileNetV2 with transfer learning, and MobileNetV2 with hyperparameter tuning. A compiled dataset of 16,249 images was used, comprising 10,500 training, 3,500 validation, and 2,249 independent test images. Images were resized to 128 x 128 pixels, normalized, and augmented to vary orientation, scale, illumination, and appearance. Models were evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and precision-recall and ROC analysis. The hyperparameter-tuned MobileNetV2 achieved the highest validation accuracy (95\%), with precision, recall, and F1-score of 0.93, 0.91, and 0.92, but reached only 84\% accuracy on the held-out test set. MobileNetV2 with transfer learning but no additional tuning achieved 89\% test accuracy, and the conventional CNN achieved 85\%. Transfer learning therefore provided a competitive approach under the evaluated conditions, while higher validation accuracy from tuning did not yield higher test accuracy. To demonstrate practical deployment, a Flask-based web prototype using TensorFlow Lite was developed, supporting image upload and live webcam recognition with both visual and voice output. The study shows the feasibility of combining lightweight deep learning with a voice-assisted web interface for Nepali currency recognition, and highlights the need for more diverse datasets, greater robustness under uncontrolled imaging conditions, and broader real-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比传统CNN、MobileNetV2迁移学习与MobileNetV2超参数调优三种配置识别尼泊尔7种纸币面额，并开发基于Flask和TensorFlow Lite的语音辅助网页原型。
AI.motivation: 货币面额自动识别在现金处理、金融科技和辅助系统中具应用价值，尤其对视觉障碍人群有实用意义，但尼泊尔卢比相关研究较少，缺乏轻量可部署方案。
AI.method: 使用16249张图像（训练10500、验证3500、测试2249），统一缩放至128×128并做归一化与方向/尺度/光照/外观增强；训练三种配置：传统CNN、MobileNetV2迁移学习、MobileNetV2超参数调优；采用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1及PR/ROC评估；再用Flask+TensorFlow Lite搭建支持上传与实时摄像头、带视觉和语音输出的网页原型。
AI.result: 调优版MobileNetV2验证准确率最高达95%（精确率0.93、召回率0.91、F1 0.92），但独立测试仅84%；未调优迁移学习模型测试89%，传统CNN测试85%。验证集高准确率未转化为更高测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习在评估条件下具竞争力，轻量深度学习结合语音辅助网页界面用于尼泊尔货币识别可行；但需更丰富多样的数据集、提升非受控成像条件下的鲁棒性并开展更广泛真实场景评估。

title: PoVi: Agentic Poetry-to-Video Generation with Knowledge Grounding and Figurative Understanding
summary: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimodal generation beyond direct text-to-video synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出PoVi基准与智能体框架，实现诗歌到视频的"有依据"生成，评测语义落地、语篇连贯与视听实现。
AI.motivation: 诗歌语言高度压缩，依赖历史文化知识，常通过隐喻、意象等非字面方式表达含义，单纯文本到视频的转换不足以传达其语义。
AI.method: 先将诗歌语义重构为"证据受限"的表示，再逐步转化为旁白、解读、角色资产与镜头级视觉规划，并进行与旁白对齐的视频生成；在3种规划主干与4种视频生成器上验证。
AI.result: 在三种规划主干与四种视频生成器上均稳定优于单次调用生成，且在隐含背景知识与隐喻关系上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: PoVi为研究知识驱动、长时程多模态生成提供了测试平台，超越直接的文本到视频合成。

title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous systems that operate continuously in dynamic environments. Such agents need not only solve current tasks but also learn from past interactions to improve future performance. However, existing streaming benchmarks often rely on short task sequences or largely independent tasks, providing limited evidence of whether agents can effectively reuse experience when later tasks depend on earlier outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EvoLink-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving agents in long-horizon, interdependent task streams. It covers daily office work, multi-turn dialogue, and AutoResearch-style workflows, with persistent workspaces and dependencies across tasks. The benchmark includes two complementary levels: \textbf{L1}, which evaluates the acquisition and revision of language-expressible knowledge, and \textbf{L2}, which assesses the development of task-level capabilities through execution and feedback. Its evaluation further distinguishes within-task recovery, persistent-state updates, and experience reuse in later tasks. We evaluate five agent frameworks across three backbone configurations under three persistence conditions, covering 19,635 scored task slots from selected evaluation cohorts. Results show that no framework consistently performs best across both levels, retries recover only a limited proportion of failed tasks, and persistent-state updates do not necessarily improve subsequent performance. Furthermore, the effects of evolution differ between knowledge- and capability-level tasks, suggesting that these two forms of evolution require different learning mechanisms. Performance gains also vary across domains and task streams, with improvements on some tasks not necessarily extending to others.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EvoLink-Bench，用于评估长时程、任务间相互依赖场景下的自进化 LLM 智能体，揭示现有框架在经验复用与持续学习上的明显不足。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正从被动聊天机器人转向在动态环境中持续运行的自主系统，需要从过去交互中学习以提升未来表现。但现有流式基准多采用短任务序列或基本独立的任务，无法检验后续任务依赖先前结果时智能体能否有效复用经验。
AI.method: 构建 EvoLink-Bench 基准，覆盖日常办公、多轮对话与 AutoResearch 类工作流，具备持久工作区与跨任务依赖。分两个层级：L1 评估语言可表达知识的获取与修正，L2 通过执行与反馈评估任务级能力发展。评估区分任务内恢复、持久状态更新与后续任务中的经验复用。实验评估 5 个智能体框架、3 种骨干配置、3 种持久化条件，覆盖 19,635 个计分任务槽。
AI.result: 没有任何框架在两个层级上一致最优；重试仅能挽回有限比例的失败任务；持久状态更新并不必然提升后续表现；进化效果在知识级与能力级任务上表现不同，说明两类进化需要不同的学习机制；性能增益也因领域与任务流而异，某些任务上的提升未必迁移到其他任务。
AI.conclusion: 长时程依赖任务流下的智能体自进化仍是开放难题，知识获取与能力发展需区分对待，持久化状态与重试机制的收益有限且不具通用性，未来需针对不同进化形式设计专门学习机制。

title: DuoMI: Dual Mutual Information Regularization for Expert Reuse in Looped Transformers
summary: We introduce Dual Mutual Information Regularization (DuoMI), a method for regulating expert routing across rounds in looped mixture-of-experts (MoE) Transformers. When two rounds of computation share an expert pool, their routers may favor different expert subsets, limiting the reuse of individual expert parameters across rounds. Even when aggregate expert usage is identical across rounds, we would still prefer each token to retain some experts while switching to others. DuoMI addresses both aspects of routing: it uses round-level marginal mutual information to limit the dependence of aggregate expert usage on the round, and token-level conditional mutual information to penalize average cross-round routing changes that fall outside a target interval. During training, DuoMI computes differentiable penalties from soft routing distributions over all experts. It adds no model parameters and leaves sparse Top-$k$ routing strategy unchanged at inference. On a looped OLMoE backbone in which paired adjacent layers share experts, DuoMI improves the average score across $15$ downstream tasks from $50.08\%$ to $51.82\%$, a gain of $1.74$ percentage points over the looped baseline.

AI.tldr: DuoMI 用双层互信息正则化调节循环 MoE Transformer 跨轮次专家路由，在 OLMoE 上 15 个下游任务平均分从 50.08% 提升至 51.82%。
AI.motivation: 循环 MoE 中两轮计算共享专家池时，路由器可能偏好不同专家子集，削弱单个专家参数跨轮复用；即便总体使用分布相同，也希望每个 token 保留部分专家、替换部分专家。
AI.method: 提出 Dual Mutual Information Regularization：用轮次级边际互信息限制总体专家使用对轮次的依赖；用 token 级条件互信息惩罚超出目标区间的平均跨轮路由变化。训练时基于所有专家的软路由分布计算可微惩罚，不增加参数，推理时仍保持稀疏 Top-k 路由。
AI.result: 在相邻层共享专家的循环 OLMoE 骨干上，15 个下游任务平均分由 50.08% 提升到 51.82%，提升 1.74 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DuoMI 是一种无需额外参数、不改变推理路由策略的正则化方法，可有效改善循环 MoE 的跨轮专家复用与下游性能。

title: VTK-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Distinguishing Language Priors and Text Modal Bias in Visual Language Models
summary: Visual language models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities across various multimodal tasks, but they remain susceptible to hallucinations, undermining their reliability. Existing hallucination benchmarks primarily focus on identifying hallucinations and describing their manifestations, often neglecting their underlying causes. Specifically, multimodal hallucinations can stem from two distinct failure modes: text modality bias (TMB), reflecting an over-reliance on misleading text input; and language prior (LP), reflecting a reliance on previously learned knowledge. To differentiate these failure modes, we propose VTK-Bench, a benchmark that explicitly separates three information sources: visual information (V), textual information (T), and prior knowledge (K). By establishing mutually exclusive answers corresponding to V, T, and K, VTK-Bench enables fine-grained attribution analysis of model responses. Furthermore, we introduce discrete attribution and soft attribution metrics to characterize information source preferences. Extensive experiments on 11 representative open-source VLMs show that LP is more prevalent than TMB in most evaluated models. Notably, TMB decreases substantially with model scaling, whereas LP exhibits relatively limited improvement and remains the dominant failure mode. These findings highlight the importance of different information source preferences for a deeper understanding of multimodal hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 提出 VTK-Bench，通过分离视觉(V)、文本(T)、先验知识(K)三种信息源并设计互斥答案，实现多模态幻觉的细粒度归因，发现语言先验(LP)比文本模态偏置(TMB)更普遍。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉基准只识别幻觉及其表现，忽视成因。多模态幻觉可源于两种失败模式：文本模态偏置(TMB，过度依赖误导性文本)与语言先验(LP，依赖已学知识)，二者需被区分。
AI.method: 构建 VTK-Bench，显式分离视觉、文本、先验知识三类信息源，为V/T/K设置互斥答案以支持细粒度归因；并提出离散归因与软归因两种指标刻画信息源偏好；在11个开源VLM上开展实验。
AI.result: 多数模型中LP比TMB更普遍；TMB随模型规模增大显著下降，而LP改善有限并持续主导；LP是主要失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 不同信息源偏好对深入理解多模态幻觉至关重要，缓解幻觉需重点应对语言先验问题。

title: Bigger Model or Bigger Table? How Much Backbone a Chorus N-gram Module Replaces
summary: We ask how much of a transformer's backbone the Chorus N-gram module replaces. Chorus adds hashed tables of token bigrams and trigrams to its input and attention. We train models of 16M to 349M parameters on 1.34 billion tokens of Polish printed before 1918 and find the size of a plain model with the same held-out loss. A separate learning-rate search for each kind of model cuts Chorus's gain at 47M by about a third. With tables about as large as the backbone, Chorus then matches a plain model 1.34 times its size at 16M and 1.16 to 1.20 times from 107M to 349M. With these tables, each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a plain model of its size and faster than one of the same loss. On a fact quiz the two differ about as much as two seeds of one model. The results rest on one corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and a fifth of an epoch.

AI.tldr: Chorus N-gram 模块（在输入与注意力中加入哈希化的 token bigram/trigram 表）能以约 1.16–1.34 倍的等效规模替代 transformer 主干，但每增加的参数量最多只替代 0.31 个主干参数；额外的学习率搜索还会把 47M 模型上的增益削减约三分之一。
AI.motivation: 作者想量化 Chorus N-gram 模块究竟能替代 transformer 主干的多大比例——即用等效困惑度来衡量其"参数量价值"，此前缺乏系统性的对照估算。
AI.method: 在 13.4 亿 token（1918 年前波兰语印刷文本）、8000 词表、约五分之一个 epoch 的数据上训练 16M–349M 参数模型；对每类模型分别做学习率搜索；以相同 held-out loss 的普通 transformer 规模作为等效基准，并考察表大小约等于主干时的表现；再用事实问答测验比较两者。
AI.result: 去偏后（含独立学习率搜索）Chorus 在 47M 上的增益缩小约三分之一；表与主干等大时，Chorus 在 16M 处匹敌 1.34 倍规模的普通模型，107M–349M 区间为 1.16–1.20 倍；每个新增参数最多替代 0.31 个主干参数。训练速度慢于同规模普通模型、快于同等 loss 的普通模型；事实测验上二者差异约等于同模型两个随机种子的差异。
AI.conclusion: Chorus 的收益真实但有限，且高度依赖表大小与调参公平性；结论仅基于单语料、单分词与不足一个 epoch 的设定，泛化性有待验证。

title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. Through this dual-level design, DLaR establishes a hierarchical exploration-exploitation strategy that operates at both token and training levels. Extensive experiments on four in-distribution and three out-of-distribution mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DLaR achieves the highest average performance across model scales, reaching 27.9%/50.6% Pass@1/Pass@8 on Llama-3.2-1B and 46.8%/68.2% on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Code: \href{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}.

AI.tldr: DLaR提出双层级动态随机性控制框架，在token级和训练级分别调节潜在推理的扰动强度，在GRPO下提升探索与连贯性的平衡，并在多个数学推理基准上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在推理方法采用确定性推理，无法探索多样推理路径；近期引入随机性的方法又存在两个问题：对所有步骤施加均匀随机性并非最优，且无约束扰动会破坏推理连贯性。
AI.method: 在GRPO强化学习框架内设计两种不同时间粒度的机制：token级的自适应随机性调制（ASM），基于置信度-熵融合信号动态调整每个潜在步骤的扰动强度，不确定时增强探索、自信时保持稳定；训练级的训练感知随机性调节（TAST），按课程调度逐步衰减基础随机性水平。
AI.result: 在4个分布内和3个分布外数学推理基准上，DLaR在各模型规模下平均性能最高：Llama-3.2-1B上Pass@1/Pass@8为27.9%/50.6%，Qwen2.5-1.5B上为46.8%/68.2%。
AI.conclusion: 双层级设计构成token级与训练级的层次化探索-利用策略，有效缓解均匀随机性与扰动破坏连贯性的问题，提升潜在推理的探索质量与整体推理性能。

title: DualCast: Dual-Image Conditioned Diffusion Transformers for Digital Human E-Commerce Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in world models for game interaction and control have increased the demand for large-scale gameplay videos paired with camera trajectories. However, capturing synchronized camera trajectories often requires game-specific pipelines, limiting scalability. We therefore propose GameWeaver, a unified diffusion framework that automatically produces paired video--camera data through three complementary tasks: camera pose estimation from observed video, video generation along a prescribed camera trajectory, and joint video--camera generation from a reference image and text. First, each tipxel stores the normalized 3D coordinates of a pixel ray's endpoint in a reference coordinate frame. The resulting three-channel tipxel fields and RGB frames share the pretrained video model's VAE. Next, a fully trainable dual-stream Transformer exchanges appearance and geometry features through bidirectional gated attention and conditions both streams on shared text features. Finally, deterministic fitting recovers camera intrinsics and normalized trajectories from generated tipxel fields. In our evaluation tasks, GameWeaver achieves a normalized translation MSE of 0.0029 for camera control; for joint generation, it scores 85.48 out of 100 on instruction adherence versus 64.71 for the best cascade on that metric, validating the feasibility of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: GameWeaver 是一个统一的扩散框架，用三个互补任务（视频到相机位姿估计、按指定轨迹生成视频、从参考图与文本联合生成视频和相机）自动产出视频-相机配对数据，并通过 tipxel 三通道几何表示与 VAE 共享、双流 Transformer 双向门控注意力实现外观与几何的联合建模。
AI.motivation: 世界模型的游戏交互与控制研究需要大规模、带同步相机轨迹的游戏视频，但当前采集同步轨迹依赖游戏专用管线，难以扩展到新游戏，成为数据规模瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 tipxel 表示：每像素存储其在参考坐标系下射线端点的归一化 3D 坐标，形成三通道 tipxel 场，与 RGB 帧共享预训练视频模型的 VAE 潜空间。采用完全可训练的双流 Transformer，通过双向门控注意力交换外观与几何特征，并以共享文本特征对两路进行条件注入。最后用确定性拟合从生成的 tipxel 场恢复相机内参与归一化轨迹。
AI.result: 在评估任务中，相机控制达到 0.0029 的归一化平移 MSE；联合生成在指令遵循度上得分 85.48/100，而最佳级联方案仅为 64.71。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了所提方法的可行性：统一扩散框架可在无需游戏专用采集管线的情况下自动生成视频-相机配对数据，且联合生成质量明显优于级联方案。

title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE-OPD框架，通过"学生引导的教师补全+置信度门控"扩展历史覆盖并过滤不可靠更新，用"事后回放分配"依据下游执行证据选择关键决策轮次，在长程任务上兼顾效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 完全在线on-policy蒸馏需每次更新都做新环境rollout，对长程智能体代价高昂。前缀回放可复用已存历史、支持一次轨迹多次更新，但存在两点缺陷：(1)收集阶段仅用教师轨迹会缺失学生诱导的历史，而扩大历史覆盖又会降低教师可靠性；(2)复用阶段固定的按位置调度无法识别可能出现在任意深度的关键决策。
AI.method: CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence）：1) 学生播种的教师补全 + 响应级置信度门控，扩大历史覆盖同时过滤不可靠更新；2) 事后回放分配（hindsight replay allocation），利用下游执行证据挑选有影响力的关键轮次进行回放。
AI.result: 在长程任务（软件工程、深度研究）上优于在线OPD及既有前缀回放基线；SWE-bench Verified 上任务成功率提升至59.5%，相较异步在线OPD端到端训练时间减少45%、环境交互动作减少44%。
AI.conclusion: 前缀回放的两大瓶颈可通过"覆盖导向收集+证据导向回放"统一解决，在不牺牲（甚至提升）长程任务成功率的前提下显著降低训练成本，为长程智能体的高效在线蒸馏提供可行方案。

title: Evaluating Aviation Safety Knowledge Extraction with SmolLM2: From Zero-Shot to Retrieval-Grounded Prompting
summary: Aviation accident narratives contain safety knowledge that is difficult to capture using structured occurrence fields alone. This study evaluates prompting-based knowledge extraction across four dimensions: concept accuracy, verbatim evidence grounding, structural compliance, and directed relation extraction. SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct was evaluated under zero-shot, one-shot, fixed few-shot, and retrieval-grounded prompting using 300 National Transportation Safety Board narratives from 2000-2020, containing 3,763 reference concepts and 467 directed relations. Evaluation combined structural checks, verbatim evidence matching, expert-reviewed semantic matching, and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. No prompting strategy performed best across all dimensions. Retrieval-grounded prompting achieved the highest concept micro-F1 of 32.27%, although its advantage over fixed few-shot prompting was uncertain (95% CI: -0.92 to 2.40 percentage points). One-shot prompting achieved the highest relation F1 of 6.95%, identifying directed relation extraction as the principal SmolLM2 bottleneck. Compared with fixed few-shot prompting, retrieval improved verbatim grounding (59.45% vs. 54.02%) but reduced complete structural compliance (33.3% vs. 42.7%). Verbatim matching establishes source presence rather than evidential relevance. An exploratory comparison using 35 benchmark narratives showed that Qwen3-8B achieved higher concept micro-F1 across all prompting conditions and higher relation F1 under demonstration-based prompting, reaching 51.37% and 34.62%, respectively, under one-shot prompting. The small subset limits generalization. These findings support evaluating semantic correctness, source traceability, structural reliability, and directed relation accuracy separately.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估SmolLM2-1.7B在航空事故叙述上四种提示策略的知识抽取表现，发现无单一策略全面最优：检索增强在概念F1与证据溯源上占优，one-shot在关系F1上最好，而关系抽取是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 航空事故叙述蕴含难以用结构化字段捕获的安全知识，需评估LLM提示式抽取在语义正确性、证据可溯源、结构合规和关系抽取方面的实际能力与瓶颈。
AI.method: 使用300篇2000–2020年NTSB叙述（3,763个参考概念、467条有向关系），对SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct测试zero-shot、one-shot、固定few-shot、检索增强四种提示；评估结合结构检查、逐字证据匹配、专家语义匹配与配对bootstrap置信区间；并用35篇基准叙述探索性对比Qwen3-8B。
AI.result: 检索增强概念micro-F1最高（32.27%），但相对few-shot优势不确定（95% CI −0.92~2.40）；one-shot关系F1最高（6.95%）；检索增强较few-shot提升证据溯源（59.45% vs 54.02%）却降低结构完整合规（33.3% vs 42.7%）。Qwen3-8B在one-shot下达概念F1 51.37%、关系F1 34.62%，但子集小、泛化受限。
AI.conclusion: 逐字匹配仅证明来源存在而非证据相关性；应分别评估语义正确性、来源可追溯性、结构可靠性与有向关系准确性，且需针对关系抽取单独优化。

title: Kolpona: An Agentic Framework with Gradient-Free Neuron Programming for RTL Generation
summary: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) for register-transfer level (RTL) design are usually improved by fine-tuning on curated Verilog corpora, which needs large sets of verified designs and GPU training. We present Kolpona, an agentic framework that improves such models without gradient training. Its first component is neuron programming, a new form of weight-space programming (WSP) that writes single neurons in closed form into the weights to remove failure habits found on practice tasks, and keeps each edit only when testbench results on fresh tasks favour it. At inference time, tool-using agents propose designs, and a label-free selection stage delivers one design per task from the specification, the candidates and their simulations alone. On Qwen3.5-4B, edits to 16 neurons raise the VerilogEval v2 pass@1 of the model alone from 31.7% to 55.4%, and the full framework reaches 77.6%. On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1% to 94.9% on VerilogEval v2 and from 66.0% to 92.0% on RTLLM v2.1 on a single 32 GB GPU, above every published system in our comparison. The RTL edits also carry over to Python and raise the pass@1 of the 4B model alone from 84.8% to 91.5% on HumanEval+ and from 67.7% to 77.5% on MBPP+.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kolpona，一种无需梯度训练即可提升开放权重LLM进行RTL设计的智能体框架，通过"神经元编程"直接闭合形式改写单个神经元权重并结合推理时的工具智能体与无标签选择，将VerilogEval v2 pass@1大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 现有提升RTL设计LLM的方法依赖在精选Verilog语料上微调，需要大量已验证设计和GPU训练资源，成本高。作者希望找到一种无需梯度训练的替代方案来改进模型在RTL任务上的表现。
AI.method: Kolpona框架包含两部分：(1) 神经元编程——一种权重空间编程（WSP）新形式，以闭合形式将单个神经元写入权重，用以消除在练习任务中发现的失败习惯，且仅当在新任务上的测试台结果更优时保留每次编辑；(2) 推理时使用工具调用智能体提出设计，再由无标签选择阶段仅依据规格、候选及其仿真结果，为每个任务挑出一个设计。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上，仅编辑16个神经元即将VerilogEval v2 pass@1从31.7%提升至55.4%，完整框架达到77.6%；在Qwen3.8-27B上，单张32GB GPU上VerilogEval v2从73.1%升至94.9%，RTLLM v2.1从66.0%升至92.0%，优于所有对比系统。RTL编辑还可迁移到Python，使4B模型在HumanEval+上从84.8%升至91.5%，MBPP+上从67.7%升至77.5%。
AI.conclusion: 神经元编程与智能体推理相结合，可在无梯度训练、单卡资源条件下显著提升RTL设计性能，并展现出跨语言（到Python）的迁移能力，为开放权重LLM的改进提供了高效新路径。

title: Teaching Students to Stand on Their Own: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Fine-Grained Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning (FG-FSCIL) aims to incrementally learn visually similar new classes from limited images without catastrophic forgetting. Prior work typically learns strong representations on base classes or leverages vision foundation models (VFMs) directly as backbones or via knowledge distillation. However, VFM backbones incur high computational costs and do not guarantee fine-grained recognition. Although knowledge distillation reduces inference cost, our preliminary experiments reveal that distilled students still lag substantially behind their VFM teachers, particularly on new classes. To address this limitation, we propose STAND, a systematic VFM-to-student distillation design tailored for FG-FSCIL. Specifically, STAND connects the teacher and student by equipping the student with a fixed copy of the teacher's classifier, aligning their outputs via projectors, and feeding both models composite images that combine different training images. On these composite images, relation distillation matches how the teacher and the student relate each image to other images, while difference distillation matches how this relation changes between two composite images. Finally, we freeze the student and classify new classes using length-calibrated prototypes, which restore the reduced similarity of few-shot prototypes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that STAND achieves state-of-the-art performance across FG-FSCIL datasets at low computational cost, while generalizing across student backbones and broader datasets.

AI.tldr: STAND 提出一套面向细粒度小样本类增量学习（FG-FSCIL）的系统性 VFM→学生蒸馏方案，通过共享教师分类器、复合图像关系/差异蒸馏与长度校准原型，在低算力下实现 SOTA。
AI.motivation: FG-FSCIL 需从少量图像增量学习视觉相似的新类且不遗忘。直接用视觉基础模型（VFM）作骨干算力开销大，且不保证细粒度识别；而以知识蒸馏降本的学生模型经初步实验发现仍显著落后于 VFM 教师，尤其在新类上。
AI.method: 1) 给学生配备教师分类器的固定副本，并用投影器对齐二者输出，以连接教师与学生；2) 向两模型输入由不同训练图像合成的复合图像；3) 在复合图像上做关系蒸馏（对齐教师/学生对某图与其他图的关系）与差异蒸馏（对齐两幅复合图像间关系的变化）；4) 冻结学生，用长度校准原型分类新类，以恢复小样本原型被削弱的相似度。
AI.result: 在多个 FG-FSCIL 数据集上以低计算成本达到 SOTA，且可跨学生骨干与更广泛数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion: 针对 VFM 教师与学生在新类上的差距，STAND 通过结构化蒸馏设计与原型长度校准有效提升 FG-FSCIL，兼顾性能与效率。

title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
summary: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it still covers close to nine tenths of what each later token selects on DS-V4.1-Flash. We present DFly2, a block-parallel drafter that shares the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads the KV its paired target layer cached (KV sharing), at the positions that layer's indexer selected, a fixed number anywhere in the context (Index sharing). DFly2 thus runs no scoring pass and keeps no cache of its own. On DS-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4~flash, whose sparse attention and architecture differ, it accepts more tokens per step than DFlash and DSpark trained on the same recipe, over general, long-context and agentic benchmarks. Its margin over the stronger baseline widens from 3.9%-10.5% on general workloads to 10.0%-31.5% on long-context and agentic ones. At high concurrency on DS-V4.1-Flash, at matched per-user decode speed, its throughput is 62% and 81% higher on two 64K sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DFly2，一种与目标模型共享稀疏性的块并行投机解码 drafter：直接读取配对目标层缓存的 KV，并使用该层 indexer 为当前 query 选出的固定数量位置（索引共享），从而无需自行维护缓存、也无需打分。在三个异构稀疏模型上均超越同样配方训练的 DFlash 与 DSpark，长上下文与 agentic 场景增益更大。
AI.motivation: 原生稀疏目标模型（如 DeepSeek-V4、Hy4）已成为长上下文主流，但其投机解码 drafter 仍自带全 prompt 或滑窗缓存，带来显存、prefill 时间、前缀缓存命中与并发度开销。已有"读目标缓存"的 drafter 只解决了"用哪个缓存"，未解决"用哪些位置"，仍全读或读最近窗口；而为每个 query 动态选择位置在 drafter 中计算代价随上下文增长。作者观察到：稀疏目标本身已为每个 query 在它必需的缓存上选好位置，这两项决策已被目标完成并付过代价。
AI.method: 1) 测量目标 indexer 选择的"一步提前"复用度：在 DS-V4.1-Flash 上，提前一步做出的选择仍覆盖后续 token 实际选择的近九成。2) 据此设计 DFly2：每个 draft 层读取其配对目标层缓存的 KV（KV 共享），并只在该层 indexer 为该 query 选出的、上下文中任意位置的固定数量 token 上做注意力（索引共享）。3) 因此 drafter 不执行打分 pass、不保有自己的缓存，并采用块并行结构。
AI.result: 在稀疏注意力与架构各异的 DS-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash、Hy4-flash 上，相比同一配方训练的 DFlash 与 DSpark，每步接受 token 数更高，覆盖通用、长上下文与 agentic 基准。相对更强基线的领先幅度从通用负载的 3.9%–10.5% 扩大到长上下文与 agentic 的 10.0%–31.5%。在 DS-V4.1-Flash 高并发、单用户解码速度对齐条件下，两个 64K 数据集上吞吐分别高出 62% 与 81%。
AI.conclusion: Drafter 的缓存与位置选择两项决策均可由原生稀疏目标"免费"提供，共享目标稀疏性可同时消除 drafter 的缓存开销与选择开销，并在多样稀疏架构上稳定提升接受长度与高并发吞吐，说明该思路具有跨模型通用性。

title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. In particular, our vSFT using Qwen3-4B outperforms GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% and 13.9% in success rate on ALFWorld, and by 4.8% and 18.2% on WebShop, respectively. We believe that learning how to adapt a model, rather than an adapted model, offers a promising path towards more capable agents that improve themselves.

AI.tldr: 提出vSFT框架，用自然语言密集反馈经超网络转换为低秩权重更新，实现测试时参数级自进化，优于上下文方法与RL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic RL虽可在policy上学习，但测试时面临rollout昂贵、奖励稀疏的问题，难以应用；而上下文反馈式的自反思/上下文学习又不改变权重。
AI.method: vSFT构建agent与监督者经超网络的闭环：监督者根据agent失败轨迹生成自然语言（言语）监督，超网络将其转换为低秩权重更新以调优agent，实现测试时参数内演化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B上，ALFWorld成功率比GRPO和Reflexion分别高8.7%和13.9%；WebShop上分别高4.8%和18.2%，并优于其上下文对应方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习"如何适配模型"而非直接得到适配后的模型，是构建可自我提升agent的有前景路径；测试时参数演化有效结合密集语言反馈与权重更新。

title: Quaternion-Tucker ZigZag Networks: Halving Transformer Backbone Parameters and Enabling Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling
comment: 12 pages, 12 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/shu195/QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT | Open weights: https://huggingface.co/spacetime9 | Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24424501
summary: Standard Transformers allocate independent dense weight matrices to every feed-forward network (FFN) layer, coupling parameters linearly with depth (O(L)) and discarding prior compute when scaling capacity. Conversely, weight-tied Looped Transformers decouple depth from parameters (O(1)) but enforce time-homogeneous updates. We formulate the L-layer FFN stack as a 3D Tensor Cuboid and introduce QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT, unifying: (1) 4D Quaternion Hamilton GEMMs in bfloat16 (4x FFN compression), (2) 64x64 Block-Diagonal Tucker SwiGLU Cores for depth-specific rotations over a shared basis, (3) Braided ZigZag Diamond Routing (L0 -> L2 -> L1 -> L3) for zero-FLOP top-down refinement, and (4) Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling in both width and depth. We also introduce Annealed Gated Bounce-Back Scaffolding (GatedBounce), which self-distills to 0.0% inference overhead. Across algorithmic tasks (8-bit Parity, 56-seed routing ablations, Mod-53 Grokking) and language modeling (TinyStories, FineWeb-Edu), our model outperforms standard Transformers at 2x-7.6x compression. On A100, QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT-12 (39.0M backbone) beats StandardGPT-12 (85.0M backbone) at 5/5 controlled checkpoints. Continually scaling one lineage across 6.00B tokens via zero-loss width growth (rank 6144 -> 8192), two bit-exact depth expansions (L = 12 -> 16 -> 20, 70.9M backbone, max_diff = 0.000000), and WSD cooldown reaches 3.3582 FineWeb-Edu loss (28.74 PPL) and 44.75% full-split zero-shot accuracy across 16,955 questions (ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, BoolQ), matching GPT-3 Small (125M, 300B tokens) at 50x fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出 QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT，将 L 层 FFN 堆叠建模为 3D Tensor Cuboid，用四元数 GEMM、Block-Diagonal Tucker 核、ZigZag 路由与无损宽度/深度扩展，在 2x–7.6x 压缩下超越标准 Transformer。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 每层 FFN 独立参数（O(L)）且扩容时丢弃已有计算；Looped Transformer 参数为 O(1) 但强制时间同质更新，缺乏层特异性。需在压缩参数的同时保留深度特化与扩容无损性。
AI.method: 1) bfloat16 的 4D 四元数 Hamilton GEMM（4x FFN 压缩）；2) 64x64 块对角 Tucker SwiGLU 核，在共享基上做层特异性旋转；3) 编织式 ZigZag Diamond 路由（L0→L2→L1→L3）实现零 FLOP 自顶向下精化；4) 宽度与深度上的精确 2D 零损失持续扩展；另加 Annealed Gated Bounce-Back Scaffolding（GatedBounce），自蒸馏至 0.0% 推理开销。
AI.result: 在 8-bit Parity、56 种子路由消融、Mod-53 Grokking 及 TinyStories/FineWeb-Edu 上，2x–7.6x 压缩下优于标准 Transformer；A100 上 39.0M 骨干的 12 层模型在 5/5 受控检查点胜过 85.0M 标准模型。单血统持续扩展 6.00B token：宽度 rank 6144→8192 零损失增长、两次位精确深度扩展（12→16→20，最大误差 0.000000），最终 FineWeb-Edu loss 3.3582（PPL 28.74），16955 题零样本准确率 44.75%，以 50x 更少 token 匹敌 GPT-3 Small。
AI.conclusion: 将 FFN 堆栈视为张量立方体、以四元数与 Tucker 分解压缩、配合路由与无损扩容，可在极低参数与 token 预算下达到大模型水平，兼具架构压缩与持续学习扩展优势。

title: Spectral Colorimetry Based on GMoE for Temperature Measurement in Explosion Fields
summary: Spectroscopic thermometry in explosion fields has attracted considerable attention in related engineering domains, primarily because it can mitigate the interference of traditional contact methods with temperature distributions and address the limitations of high-temperature measurement scenarios. However, existing physics-model-driven methods typically rely on regressing a single radiance-ratio pair, which limits their adaptability to wide-range temperature estimation. This limitation arises from notable variations in the mapping between grayscale ratios and radiance ratios at different temperatures. In contrast, existing data-driven methods often suffer from limited performance due to the scarcity of training data, a challenge exacerbated by the sensitivity of explosion fields. In this work, we propose a gated mixture of experts (GMoE) framework that integrates a divide-and-conquer strategy in deep learning with physical prior knowledge for temperature estimation, thereby decomposing the complex task into multiple expert-specific subtasks. Specifically, each expert is developed using physically calibrated polynomial functions to model the relationship between grayscale ratios and radiance ratios for a given pair of spectral bands, with temperature then estimated using a physical model incorporating the corresponding parameters. Additionally, a gating network is designed to adaptively weight the outputs of different experts and generate the final temperature estimate. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the best performance when implemented with the Transformer-based gating network, yielding a mean RMSE of $12.70 \pm 1.32$ K and a mean MAE of $7.96 \pm 0.86$ K. Compared with conventional spectral colorimetry, the proposed framework reduces the mean RMSE and MAE by 63.4\% and 70.8\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出门控专家混合（GMoE）框架，将深度学习的分治策略与物理先验结合，用于爆炸场光谱测温，显著降低温度估计误差。
AI.motivation: 爆炸场光谱测温中，传统接触法干扰温度分布且难以应对高温场景；现有物理模型方法只用单一辐射比回归，难以适应宽温范围（灰度比与辐射比映射随温度变化）；数据驱动方法则因爆炸场数据稀缺而性能受限。
AI.method: 提出GMoE框架：每个专家用物理标定的多项式函数对特定谱带对的灰度比—辐射比映射建模，再借助物理模型估计温度；门控网络自适应加权各专家输出并融合生成最终温度。采用基于Transformer的门控网络实现。
AI.result: Transformer门控版本表现最佳，平均RMSE为12.70±1.32 K，平均MAE为7.96±0.86 K；相比传统光谱比色法，RMSE和MAE分别降低63.4%和70.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验与分治式深度学习结合可有效应对宽温域与数据稀缺问题，实现高精度爆炸场温度估计。

title: PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
summary: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona control through training data. Results show that our structured, attribute-based style representation enables per-axis control and better intent preservation at comparable style fidelity than free-text persona descriptions used in existing methods. A human expert evaluation found the augmented conversations plausible, with favorable ratings for intent preservation, style naturalness, and multilingual authenticity. Finally, PersonaFactory conversations achieve comparable performance to original training data on capability benchmarks, are preferred on real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style more closely to users without explicit steering.

AI.tldr: PersonaFactory 是一个端到端流水线，生成结构化用户画像并据此改写真实用户提示，产出约74万画像与124万条覆盖85种语言的人物风格合成对话，实现可逐轴控制的风格迁移与更好的意图保持。
AI.motivation: 大模型正大量替代真实用户参与训练数据生成、对齐与评估，但开箱即用的模型生成的合成用户提示多为单一语言、风格扁平，无法复现真实的人机交流机制，因此需要能模拟真实用户多样性的合成数据生成方法。
AI.method: 提出 PersonaFactory 流水线：先生成包含背景与交流行为的详细用户画像，再以画像视角对已有用户提示进行增强，构建约74万条结构化画像和约124万条、覆盖85种语言的画像风格对话语料；用 LLM 评判器与启发式指标评估增强保真度、特征对风格采纳与意图保持的影响，以及训练数据对助手人格控制的下游效果。
AI.result: 基于属性的结构化风格表示相比现有自由文本画像描述，在同等风格保真度下支持逐轴控制且意图保持更好；人类专家认为增强对话可信，意图保持、风格自然度与多语言真实性评分良好；在能力基准上与原始训练数据相当，在真实用户提示上同等回复长度下更受偏好，且无需显式引导即能更贴合用户调整回复风格。
AI.conclusion: 结构化画像驱动的提示增强可在保持能力与意图的前提下，生成多样、真实、多语言的合成用户数据，并提升助手的风格适应能力，为规模化构建个性化对齐与评估数据提供可行方案。

title: EgoUseBench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents under Evolving First-Person Contexts
summary: AI wearables, such as smart glasses, extend the context available to agents beyond digital environments to users' physical surroundings. With these devices, computer tasks can originate from users' ongoing activities rather than solely from explicit instructions. Through first-person observations, agents can identify objects and activities relevant to user requests and ground digital tasks in the surrounding context. We call this interaction paradigm Ego Use. However, first-person observations are limited by the wearer's viewpoint and may provide incomplete or ambiguous evidence of ongoing activities. As new observations arrive, agents may need to revise their understanding of the physical context and user intent, and reassess whether prior digital actions remain valid. Whether current agents can reliably handle these changes remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce EgoUseBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ego Use across three interaction settings with different levels of first-person context. Computer-Use relies on explicit instructions, Offline Ego Use provides prerecorded first-person context before execution, and Online Ego Use provides continuous observations as user intent evolves. Based on over 74 hours of real-world first-person recordings, we construct 693 tasks across the three interaction settings. To capture task evolution, we track first-person observations, user requirements, and website state separately.
