We further group tasks by how information changes during execution, resulting in three types: Graft (revised user requirements), Refresh (new first-person observations), and Clarify (agent-initiated information seeking). We evaluate advanced models and find that average success rates in Online Ego Use are 26.3% lower than in Computer-Use. This result reveals the difficulty of keeping task execution aligned with evolving first-person context and user intent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出交互范式"Ego Use"（AI可穿戴设备基于第一人称观察将数字任务落地于物理环境），并构建EgoUseBench基准（74小时真实第一人称录像、693个任务、三种交互设置），评测发现模型在在线Ego Use下成功率比传统Computer-Use低约26.3%。
AI.motivation: AI可穿戴设备（如智能眼镜）使任务可源自用户正在进行的活动而非明确指令，智能体可借助第一人称观察识别相关物体与活动、将数字任务锚定到物理情境。但第一人称观察受佩戴者视角限制，证据可能不完整或含糊；随着新观察到来，智能体需修正对物理情境与用户意图的理解，并重估既有数字动作是否仍有效。现有智能体能否可靠应对这些变化，尚缺乏充分评测。
AI.method: 提出EgoUseBench基准，覆盖三种不同第一人称上下文的交互设置：Computer-Use（依赖明确指令）、Offline Ego Use（执行前提供预录第一人称上下文）、Online Ego Use（在执行过程中随用户意图演化持续提供观察）。基于超74小时真实第一人称录像构建693个任务；分别追踪第一人称观察、用户需求和网页状态以刻画任务演化；并按执行中信息变化方式将任务分为Graft（用户需求被修改）、Refresh（出现新第一人称观察）、Clarify（智能体主动寻求信息）三类。
AI.result: 对先进模型的评测显示，Online Ego Use的平均成功率比Computer-Use低26.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该结果揭示了让任务执行持续对齐不断变化的第一人称上下文与用户意图的困难，说明现有智能体在Ego Use场景下仍有明显能力缺口。

title: MolGPAO: Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree with Speculative Decoding and Sub-Millisecond Seam Healing for 3D Molecules
summary: Autoregressive generation over adaptive 3D octrees (Uni-3DAR) offers an intrinsic $O(N \log N)$ sparsity advantage over dense $O(N^2)$ equivariant diffusion and flow models on large drug-like molecules, yet lags in geometric equilibrium, closed-shell valence stability, and property fidelity due to Morton-seam coordinate jumps, leaf-heavy compute with root-count trapping, and target-shortcut collapse in internal critics. We introduce MolGPAO (Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree), a standalone 3D octree architecture and single-output speculative tree-decoding engine using zero external surrogates, zero reinforcement learning, and zero inference-time MLIP relaxation. MolGPAO unifies: (1) non-trapping 6-D ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding with L5-to-L1 covalent packing priors; (2) a FlashAttention-2 pause-and-gather speculative octree funnel ($m_{s1} \to m_{s2} \to 1$, $M_{\mathrm{out}} = 1$); (3) an anti-shortcut ground-truth TwoStageOctreeProcessCritic with 64-RBF covalent edge gating and $SO(3)$-invariant 12-channel multipole norms (blind QM9 $r = 0.9867$--$0.9989$); (4) a $<0.5$ ms 4-layer $SE(3)$ PostTreeGraphRefiner for Morton-seam healing, expected-XYZ bonded supervision, selective CFG, and zero-heavy-displacement valence reconciliation; and (5) bubble-free stride-2 GPU leaf decoding. Across GEOM-Drugs (0.49 GPU-h), disjoint 50k/50k QM9 (0.43 GPU-h), and PBE0/def2-TZVP-verified OE62 (0.56 GPU-h), MolGPAO lifts drug-scale valid-connected yield 6.78x (12.7% to 86.2%, 99.83% atom stability), runs 7.3x faster (or 1.65x faster at 2.0x yield) than 100-step FlowMol at $N=100$, beats 156 GPU-h PropMolFlow on QM9 HOMO (-12.7%) and dipole (-21.0%) at 362x lower compute, and doubles live DFT hit rate on OE62 (33.3% vs. 16.7%) at 92.8x lower compute.

AI.tldr: MolGPAO 是一个独立的 3D 八叉树自回归分子生成架构，结合无陷阱嵌入、推测式树解码、防捷径过程评论器与轻量 SE(3) 精修器，在药物规模分子生成上大幅提升有效产率与属性保真度，并将计算成本降低 1-2 个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自适应 3D 八叉树的自回归生成（Uni-3DAR）虽有 O(N log N) 稀疏性优势，但在几何平衡、闭壳层价态稳定性和属性保真度上落后于稠密 O(N²) 的等变扩散/流模型，问题根源是 Morton 接缝坐标跳变、叶子计算过重导致根节点计数陷阱，以及内部评论器出现目标捷径坍缩。
AI.method: 统一五项设计：(1) 非陷阱 6D ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding，含 L5→L1 共价堆积先验；(2) FlashAttention-2 暂停-汇聚推测式八叉树漏斗 (m_s1→m_s2→1，M_out=1)；(3) 防捷径的 TwoStageOctreeProcessCritic，使用 64-RBF 共价边门控与 SO(3) 不变 12 通道多极矩范数；(4) <0.5 ms 的 4 层 SE(3) PostTreeGraphRefiner 用于 Morton 接缝修复、期望 XYZ 成键监督、选择性 CFG 与零重原子位移的价态调和；(5) 无气泡 stride-2 GPU 叶子解码。全程不使用外部代理模型、强化学习和推理时 MLIP 弛豫。
AI.result: 在 GEOM-Drugs（0.49 GPU-h）、互斥 50k/50k QM9（0.43 GPU-h）及 PBE0/def2-TZVP 验证的 OE62（0.56 GPU-h）上：药物规模有效连通产率提升 6.78 倍（12.7%→86.2%，原子稳定性 99.83%）；N=100 时比 100 步 FlowMol 快 7.3 倍（或 2.0 倍产率下快 1.65 倍）；以 362 倍更低算力在 QM9 HOMO（-12.7%）和偶极矩（-21.0%）上超越 156 GPU-h 的 PropMolFlow；OE62 实际 DFT 命中率翻倍（33.3% vs 16.7%），算力低 92.8 倍。评论器在盲测 QM9 上 r=0.9867–0.9989。
AI.conclusion: MolGPAO 证明八叉树自回归架构在结合针对性的坐标、解码与评论器设计后，可同时实现高有效产率、强属性保真度与极低计算成本，成为扩散/流模型的高效替代方案。

title: VAPOR: Improving Multimodal Reasoning with Sparse Visual Updates
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in visual reasoning, but extended generation over large visual contexts remains computationally expensive. During autoregressive decoding, visual attention is recomputed for every generated token, even when consecutive tokens rely on similar visual evidence. We introduce VAPOR (Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh), a training-free framework that reduces this redundancy by reusing visual attention outputs across decoding steps and refreshing them when needed. VAPOR caches the visual attention output while continuing to update textual attention at every step, helping reduce visual grounding drift during extended reasoning. To decide when to reuse cached outputs, VAPOR estimates visual attention mass using a low-rank approximation. It also uses prefill-based attention consistency and cache age to make independent Persist and Refresh decisions for each attention head. VAPOR retains the full visual key-value (KV) cache, so all visual tokens remain available when new evidence is needed. Experiments on eight image and four video reasoning benchmarks across two MLLM families show that VAPOR improves accuracy over dense attention on nearly all benchmarks while achieving 1.11-1.21x decoding speedups. Compared with the strongest state-of-the-art acceleration baseline in each setting, VAPOR further improves accuracy by 0.35-2.15 percentage points while achieving comparable or lower decoding latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Su-my/VAPOR.

AI.tldr: VAPOR 是一个免训练框架，通过跨解码步复用视觉注意力输出并按需刷新，在保持完整视觉 KV 缓存的前提下加速多模态大模型的视觉推理，获得 1.11–1.21x 解码加速且精度普遍提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在长程视觉推理中生成代价高昂：自回归解码时每个 token 都重算视觉注意力，即便相邻 token 依赖的视觉证据高度相似，造成大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 缓存视觉注意力输出并在解码步间复用，同时每步照常更新文本注意力以抑制视觉 grounding 漂移；用低秩近似估计视觉注意力质量，并结合 prefill 阶段的注意力一致性与缓存年龄，为每个注意力头独立决定 Persist 或 Refresh；保留完整视觉 KV 缓存以便需要时访问全部视觉 token。整个方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在两大 MLLM 系列、8 个图像与 4 个视频推理基准上，几乎全部基准精度优于稠密注意力，解码加速 1.11–1.21x；相比各设定下最强的 SOTA 加速基线，精度再提升 0.35–2.15 个百分点，延迟相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 视觉注意力在解码步间存在可观冗余，按头粒度进行持久化+按需刷新可在不训练、不丢弃视觉信息的情况下同时提升精度与效率，为 MLLM 长视觉上下文推理提供了实用加速方案。

title: VulnSafe: Measuring Vulnerability-Aware Relational Safety in Large Language Models
summary: Emotionally supportive interactions require large language models not only to avoid overtly harmful content, but also to recognize vulnerability-related risk, regulate their relational stance, preserve user agency, and provide context-appropriate support. Existing safety benchmarks often measure isolated violations, leaving unclear what underlying response competence their scores represent. We introduce VulnSafe, a Chinese capability assessment centered on Vulnerability-Aware Response Competence (VARC). VARC organizes relational safety into five complementary constructs: Risk Perception, Safety Preservation, Autonomy Protection, Supportive Response, and Boundary Management. Following an evidence-centered design, 41 scenarios elicit construct-relevant behavior through 2,050 balanced prompts and scenario-specific scoring rubrics. The assessment further separates proactive should-do behavior from prohibitive should-not behavior. Across eight representative LLMs, results show distinct competence profiles and larger disparities than prohibitive requirements. VulnSafe therefore makes relational safety interpretable as a multidimensional model capability rather than as refusal compliance alone.

AI.tldr: 提出VulnSafe，一个面向中文的能力评估基准，以"脆弱性感知回应能力"(VARC)五维框架衡量大模型的关系性安全，而非仅统计拒答合规。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准多度量孤立的违规行为，难以解释分数背后模型具备何种回应能力；而情感支持场景要求模型不仅避免有害内容，还要识别脆弱性风险、调节关系姿态、维护用户自主性并给予恰当支持。
AI.method: 提出VARC框架，含风险感知、安全保持、自主性保护、支持性回应、边界管理五个构念；采用证据中心设计，设计41个情境、2050条平衡提示与情境化评分量表，并区分主动"应做"行为与禁止"不应做"行为。
AI.result: 在8个代表性大模型上评估，各模型呈现不同的能力画像；在主动"应做"要求上的差异显著大于禁止性要求上的差异。
AI.conclusion: VulnSafe将关系性安全解释为多维度的模型能力，而非单纯的拒答合规，提升了安全评估的可解释性。

title: On Utilization of Edge-AI for condition monitoring towards predictive maintenance: A use case in dairy processing using explainable AI
summary: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are driving Industry 4.0, enhancing productivity, automation, and efficiency in manufacturing systems. This study develops an Edge-AI-based condition monitoring framework, as a step towards predictive maintenance, for a rotary valve in a dairy processing pilot plant, using vibration data collected via a low-power IIoT sensor node and processed on an edge device.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个基于边缘AI的状态监测框架，利用低功耗IIoT传感器采集旋转阀振动数据并在边缘设备上处理，作为乳品加工中预测性维护的一步。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网与人工智能推动工业4.0，需提升制造系统的生产力、自动化与效率；乳品加工中旋转阀的健康监测是迈向预测性维护的关键需求。
AI.method: 采用低功耗IIoT传感器节点采集旋转阀振动数据，并在边缘设备上本地处理，构建Edge-AI状态监测框架。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果（缺乏准确率、数据集规模或对比指标等量化信息）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为乳品加工厂旋转阀的预测性维护提供了Edge-AI状态监测的初步框架。

title: The Reference Matters: Displacement Probing for Weight-Space Learning
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures. (Equal contribution: Haechan Shin and Hoonki Lee)
summary: Weight-space learning predicts a model's attributes directly from its parameters, and probing-based methods do so efficiently by reading a model's responses to learned probes. Prior work shows that probing succeeds within a Model Tree -- models fine-tuned from a shared pretrained origin -- but not why. We trace this to the shared origin itself: since a tree's leaves start from the same weights, what distinguishes them is their displacement from that origin. This motivates probing the displacement rather than the raw weight, an intervention we call the DiSplacement Probe (DSProbe). We develop this idea along two axes: extending it to second-order Gram responses, whose displacement, to first order, tracks the feature changes induced by fine-tuning; and treating the reference as a design choice, learning a shared component to subtract beyond the pretrained origin. Across four architectures on the Model Jungle benchmark, the resulting Refined-DSProbe (R-DSProbe) sets a new state of the art, matches prior accuracy with substantially fewer probes, and supports a single encoder shared across Model Trees, reducing metanetwork parameters by 3.61 times. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/DSProbe.

AI.tldr: 论文解释并改进模型树内的探针式权重空间学习：通过探测模型相对共享预训练原点的"位移"（DSProbe），并扩展到二阶Gram响应与可学习参考组件，得到R-DSProbe。
AI.motivation: 现有探针方法能在模型树（共享预训练父模型的微调模型集合）内有效预测模型属性，但此前工作只观察到现象而未解释其原因。作者希望回答"为什么有效"，并据此设计更强的方法。
AI.method: 将探针成功归因于共享原点的存在——叶节点区别在于它们相对原点的位移，故提出探测位移而非原始权重（DSProbe）。沿两条轴扩展：（1）对二阶Gram响应进行探测，其一阶位移可追踪微调引起的特征变化；（2）把参考点视为设计变量，学习一个可减去的共享组件，超越预训练原点。
AI.result: 在Model Jungle基准上跨四种架构，R-DSProbe取得新的SOTA；以显著更少的探针达到与先前方法相当的准确率；支持跨模型树共享单一编码器，元网络参数减少3.61倍。
AI.conclusion: 探针式权重空间学习的有效性源于共享原点下的位移信息；显式建模位移并优化参考点，可同时提升精度、降低探针与元网络开销，并实现跨模型树泛化。

title: Show Me the Change You Want: Visual Example-Guided Change Detection
summary: Change detection identifies where images differ, but in practice users often seek only a particular kind of change. Existing referring change detection methods rely on predefined categories, textual descriptions, or annotated masks, limiting flexibility or requiring additional annotation. In this paper, we propose a new way to perform change detection, where an unannotated before-and-after image pair serves as a visual example to guide change localization in another pair. Our framework, Visual Example-Guided Change Detection (VECD), learns comparable attribute states from single images and introduces an example-conditioned readout to match changes across different objects and scenes. The example itself defines the request, without text, example masks, or test-time fine-tuning. We evaluate VECD on four datasets spanning rendered scenes and natural image edits: EditCLEVR, MagicBrush, HumanEdit, and MaskEdit. Experiments demonstrate cross-dataset generalization without fine-tuning: a single fixed example pair guides change detection across multiple scenes, even when examples and queries originate from different datasets. VECD selects matching changes in scenes with multiple simultaneous changes and returns an empty mask when the requested change is absent. It further generalizes to attribute families withheld from paired training, achieving 74.54\% to 93.38\% mIoU across four holdout settings. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/VECD

AI.tldr: VECD 提出用无标注的"前后图像对"作为视觉示例来引导变化检测，通过跨图学习可比的属性状态和示例条件读出，实现免文本、免示例掩码、免测试时微调的灵活变化定位。
AI.motivation: 现有指代式变化检测依赖预定义类别、文本描述或标注掩码，灵活性受限且需额外标注。用户往往只想定位某一特定类型的变化，因此需要一种更灵活、无需额外标注的引导方式。
AI.method: 以一对无标注的前后图像作为视觉示例输入，框架从单张图像学习可比较的属性状态（comparable attribute states），并引入示例条件读出（example-conditioned readout），将示例中的变化模式匹配到不同物体和场景中，无需文本、示例掩码或测试时微调。
AI.result: 在 EditCLEVR、MagicBrush、HumanEdit、MaskEdit 四个数据集上验证：单一固定示例对可跨场景、跨数据集泛化且无需微调；能在多变化场景中选出匹配变化，请求变化缺失时返回空掩码；对未参与配对训练的属性族也有泛化，四种留出设置 mIoU 达 74.54%–93.38%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉示例可作为一种简洁有效的无标注引导信号，VECD 在跨数据集泛化、多变化场景选择与属性族泛化方面表现良好，为灵活变化检测提供了新范式。

title: The Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark: Do Language Models Know the Foundations of Early-Grade Literacy?
summary: Many languages of instruction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are poorly represented in the data used to train language models. Before these models can support early-grade literacy in such languages, we need to know whether they hold the linguistic knowledge of each language that literacy teaching relies on. To test this, we present the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark and the reproducible, largely automated pipeline that turns curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil books into a vetted question set organised on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and seven grade levels. The pipeline combines LLM-driven source survey, feature consolidation, item generation and quality control with an item-selection step inspired by item response theory and a final expert review. We instantiate it for Kiswahili (Kenya; 135 items) and English (United Kingdom; 137 items) and evaluate 121 and 119 models respectively. Frontier models exceed 90% accuracy in both languages, but accuracy falls steeply for smaller and cheaper models, and more so in Kiswahili. The two best models under 10 billion parameters reach 91.7% and 73.0% in English but only 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili, and the mean accuracy of models deployable on mobile and tablet hardware is 47% in English against 24% in Kiswahili. The models most practical for low-resource classrooms are therefore the least capable in the languages they would serve. We release a 20-item sample per language, all pipeline prompts, open-source code, and a public leaderboard. This is the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for measuring and generating decodable text to support foundational literacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark及可复现的自动化流水线，将课程文件、教师指南和学生用书转化为覆盖9个语言学维度、7个年级的验证题集，用于评估语言模型在低资源教学语言上的语言知识。
AI.motivation: 中低收入国家(LMICs)教学语言在语言模型训练数据中代表性不足。在模型能支持这些语言的早期读写教育之前，需先确认模型是否掌握读写教学所依赖的语言知识，而此前缺乏相应评测工具。
AI.method: 构建基准及自动化流水线：LLM驱动的源材料调研、特征整合、题目生成与质量控制，结合受项目反应理论启发的题目筛选和最终专家复核。实例化于斯瓦希里语(肯尼亚，135题)和英语(英国，137题)，分别评测121和119个模型。
AI.result: 前沿模型两种语言准确率均超90%，但更小更便宜的模型准确率急剧下降，斯瓦希里语更明显：10B以下最佳两个模型英语达91.7%和73.0%，斯瓦希里语仅51.9%和40.7%；可在移动设备部署的模型平均准确率英语47%、斯瓦希里语24%。
AI.conclusion: 最适用于低资源课堂的模型在目标语言上能力最弱。作者发布每语言20题样本、全部流水线提示词、开源代码和公开排行榜，并将其作为测量与生成可解码文本以支持基础读写能力的三级评测阶梯的第一级。

title: CARROT: Competitive Adaptive Graph Clustering via Semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport
summary: Deep graph clustering (DGC) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for unsupervised attributed graph clustering. However, existing methods often struggle with two practical challenges encountered in real-world applications: the number of clusters $K$ is unknown a priori, and cluster sizes are frequently highly imbalanced. Methods relying on a pre-specified $K$ may fail to recover the underlying clustering structure when $K$ is misspecified, while many approaches implicitly favor balanced partitions, hindering the discovery of minority clusters. We propose CARROT, a Competitive Adaptive gRaph clustering framework via semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport, which introduces semi-relaxed optimal transport into deep graph clustering to jointly address both challenges. CARROT first pre-trains node embeddings to establish a meaningful embedding space, and then jointly optimizes embeddings and cluster assignments through an Adaptive Clustering Mechanism. The mechanism combines semi-relaxed optimal transport to adapt cluster capacities to the underlying data, a competition loss to concentrate mass onto well-supported cluster prototypes, thereby starving degenerate ones, and hard pruning to progressively eliminate them. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that CARROT achieves state-of-the-art NMI and ARI, accurately recovers the number of clusters without supervision, and faithfully preserves size-imbalanced community structures.

AI.tldr: CARROT 提出基于半松弛最优传输的竞争自适应深度图聚类框架，同时解决 K 未知与簇规模高度不平衡两大实际问题，在五个基准上取得 SOTA 的 NMI/ARI 并自动恢复簇数。
AI.motivation: 现有深度图聚类方法普遍假设簇数 K 已知且偏向均衡划分：K 设定错误会导致结构恢复失败，而隐式均衡偏好会淹没少数簇，难以应对真实场景。
AI.method: 先用预训练获得有意义的节点嵌入空间；再通过自适应聚类机制联合优化嵌入与簇分配，该机制结合半松弛最优传输（自适应簇容量）、竞争损失（将质量集中到有支撑的簇原型、饿死退化簇）以及硬剪枝（逐步淘汰退化簇）。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准上取得 SOTA 的 NMI 与 ARI，无监督地准确恢复簇数量，并忠实保留规模不平衡的社区结构。
AI.conclusion: 将半松弛最优传输引入 DGC 可在一体化框架内同时处理未知 K 与不平衡簇，验证了容量自适应与竞争—剪枝机制的有效性。

title: GlassGround: GUI Grounding Beyond Native Screenshots with Egocentric Wearable Vision
summary: Wearable assistants must localize interface elements from camera observations when direct screenshot access is unavailable, yet existing GUI grounding benchmarks primarily evaluate native screenshots. We introduce GlassGround, a new benchmark that pairs native screenshots with wearable camera observations while holding GUI states, instructions, and targets fixed. GlassGround contains 3,250 tasks across Android and iOS, captured using four wearable devices under four viewing conditions. Across ten open-source models, mean grounding accuracy drops from 94.8% on screenshots to 48.5% on camera images. Further analysis reveals that changes in target scale, screen geometry, and background cannot fully explain this performance degradation. We then study two ways to narrow this gap. At inference time, local zooming and screen rectification help but leave most of the gap. For training-time adaptation, we build on GlassGround's paired-view design and introduce PairDistill, a baseline that aligns target representations across views alongside coordinate supervision. Trained on independently collected data and using no screenshots at inference, it improves camera-image accuracy by 9.4 and 12.2 points on two backbones and transfers to unseen devices and operating systems. Combined with local zooming, it reaches 69.6% and 64.4%, but does not close the gap. The GlassGround dataset and code are available at https://github.com/yunnw/GlassGround.

AI.tldr: 提出 GlassGround 基准，用配对的原生截图与可穿戴相机图像（固定 GUI 状态/指令/目标）评估 GUI 定位，显示模型从截图 94.8% 暴跌至相机图像 48.5%；并给出 PairDistill 跨视图表示对齐基线，结合局部放大可提升至约 65–70%，但仍未弥合差距。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴助手无法获取直接截图，必须从相机观测中定位界面元素，而现有 GUI grounding 基准只评测原生截图，无法反映真实可穿戴场景下的性能。
AI.method: 构建 GlassGround：3250 个 Android/iOS 任务，四款可穿戴设备、四种观看条件，截图与相机图像严格配对并固定 GUI 状态、指令和目标。评测十种开源模型，并分析目标尺度、屏幕几何、背景的影响。方法上尝试推理时的局部放大（local zooming）与屏幕矫正（screen rectification），以及训练时的 PairDistill——利用配对视图对齐目标表示并辅以坐标监督，训练于独立采集数据且推理不用截图。
AI.result: 平均定位准确率从截图 94.8% 降至相机图像 48.5%；尺度、几何、背景变化无法完全解释该退化。局部放大与矫正只略微缩小差距；PairDistill 在两个骨干上分别提升 9.4 与 12.2 点，并可迁移到未见设备与操作系统；与局部放大结合达 69.6% 与 64.4%。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴相机下的 GUI grounding 仍是开放难题，现有手段（推理时矫正、训练时跨视图对齐）虽有帮助但远未弥合与截图评测的差距；GlassGround 与代码已开源，为后续研究提供配对视图基准。

title: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.

AI.tldr: 提出基于近似Bregman响应函数（PBRF）的定向修复框架，在无需原始蒸馏语料的情况下修复蒸馏模型的信任度退化，并扩展为基于优势比的目标以支持偏好监督；在提升信任行为最多8%的同时困惑度下降不足1%。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏虽能将大模型压缩为小模型部署，但即便下游性能保持，压缩过程也可能带来信任度（trustworthiness）方面的退化。修复这些失败很困难：原始蒸馏语料常不可得，而直接偏好优化（DPO）又可能改变从教师模型继承的能力。
AI.method: 核心是PBRF（proximal Bregman response function）定向修复框架：1）利用代理数据集（surrogate proxy dataset）估计PBRF所需的曲率，摆脱对原始迁移语料的依赖；2）通过优势比（odds-ratio）目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督，从而可使用偏好/非偏好响应对，同时约束对蒸馏模型的改动幅度。
AI.result: 在预训练与后训练蒸馏模型上均提升了定向信任度行为，且基本保持下游性能；不同蒸馏模型上信任度回归最多提升8%，而困惑度下降不足1%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为修复蒸馏模型的信任度退化提供了实用替代方案，可取代重新蒸馏或无约束偏好优化，在有监督偏好数据和有限语料条件下实现高效、低损伤的定向修复。

title: Do We Really Need an LLM for Weight-Space Programming? A Deterministic Forward-Only Paradigm and Its Capability Boundaries
summary: Recent work on Weight-Space Programming uses LLMs to edit neural weights with forward passes only, conflating LLM scripting with the underlying algebra of forward-only editing. We show that for core structured editing regimes, an LLM optimizer is unnecessary, and introduce Forward Weight-Space Programming (FWSP): a deterministic pipeline combining probing, localization, stratified operators (O1-O4), automatic blind routing (83.3% vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM with the same tool library), and paired verification with zero additional per-token computation. For reasoning LLMs, we propose Protected FisherGate, a closed-form covariance-whitened readout edit orthogonal to normal-reasoning states: on DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B, a single frozen math-calibrated patch achieves 84.2% HumanEval pass@1 (1K budget; 75.4 +/- 9.4% across 3/5 Stage-4-passing subsets), beating 512-token-reserved budget forcing by +14.6 pp (-23.4% tokens) while transferring across HF-to-vLLM backends on full GSM8K and MATH-500. Across five modalities and thirteen models (50K to 27B dense and FP8 MoE), we further prove and verify two operator boundaries, subspace entanglement and frozen representation span, where FWSP-localized LoRA bridges forward-only and gradient adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出无需LLM的确定性前向权重编辑流程FWSP，并用Protected FisherGate解决推理LLM的补丁编辑问题，在多模态多模型上验证其有效性与算子边界。
AI.motivation: 现有Weight-Space Programming用LLM以仅前向方式编辑神经网络权重，将"LLM脚本化"与"仅前向编辑的底层代数"混为一谈，导致不必要的LLM开销。
AI.method: FWSP确定性流水线：探测、定位、分层算子O1-O4、自动盲路由（83.3% vs 27B LLM的33.3%）、零额外逐token计算的配对验证；针对推理LLM提出Protected FisherGate——闭式协方差白化读出编辑，正交于正常推理状态。
AI.result: DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B上单个冻结数学校准补丁达84.2% HumanEval pass@1（1K预算；3/5子集75.4±9.4%），超预算强制+14.6pp且省23.4% token，并可跨HF-vLLM迁移至GSM8K/MATH-500；证明并验证两个算子边界（子空间纠缠、冻结表示张成），FWSP定位的LoRA可桥接前向与梯度适应。
AI.conclusion: 核心结构化编辑无需LLM优化器，前向编辑+定位LoRA可桥接纯前向与梯度适应，实现高效、可迁移的权重编程。

title: Assessing the Physical Interpretability of AlphaEarth Foundation Embeddings Through Multi-Sensor Satellite Time-Series Benchmarking for Agricultural Mapping
summary: Accurate and dynamic maps of agricultural LULC are important for agricultural water resource management, particularly in areas where water scarcity is prevalent, such as Morocco. Here, we evaluate the utility of AlphaEarth Foundation Model (AEF) embeddings for agricultural LULC and irrigation-type mapping in Morocco. AEF embeddings were compared to single-date and time-series remote-sensing features using three machine-learning classifiers: XGBoost, CatBoost, and TabPFN. We also evaluated whether AEF embeddings can: (a) provide an efficient and transferable alternative to conventional direct use of Earth observation products and (b) reconstruct biophysical information. Results showed that multi-temporal feature time series achieved the highest performance, with accuracies of 0.93 for agricultural LULC and 0.87 for irrigation-type mapping when using TabPFN. However, AEF embeddings yielded comparable results, achieving accuracies of 0.91 for agricultural LULC and 0.85 for irrigation-type mapping, while reducing the need for extensive data processing and manual feature engineering typically required for satellite products. Spatial LULC mapping using TabPFN achieved comparable overall accuracies (0.85-0.86) across the three feature configurations, but revealed substantial differences in mapped tree cover, ranging from 14.57% for surface reflectance to 29.79% for AFE. Physical probing revealed that AEF embeddings strongly encode spectral indices (A30-SWIR: rho=0.58-0.67), (A38-NDMI: rho=-0.72), vegetation (A49-NDVI: rho = 0.72-0.73), and SAR structure (A25-VH: rho = 0.71). Future research should focus on enhancing the interpretability of embedding-based approaches by incorporating physical knowledge to develop more transparent and trustworthy AI systems for agricultural applications.

AI.tldr: 论文评估AlphaEarth基础模型(AEF)嵌入在摩洛哥农业土地利用/覆被(LULC)及灌溉类型制图中的效用，发现AEF嵌入性能接近多时相特征时序（LULC 0.91 vs 0.93；灌溉 0.85 vs 0.87），同时大幅减少数据处理和手工特征工程需求。
AI.motivation: 准确、动态的农业LULC地图对水资源匮乏地区（如摩洛哥）的农业水资源管理至关重要。传统依靠遥感产品直接使用需大量数据处理与手工特征工程，因此探索基础模型嵌入能否作为高效、可迁移的替代方案，并检验其是否可重建生物物理信息。
AI.method: 对比AEF嵌入与单时相/多时相遥感特征，使用XGBoost、CatBoost、TabPFN三种分类器，开展农业LULC与灌溉类型制图；并采用物理探针(physical probing)分析嵌入与光谱指数、NDVI、NDMI、SAR结构等的相关性。
AI.result: 多时相特征时序配合TabPFN性能最高（LULC 0.93，灌溉 0.87）；AEF嵌入相当（0.91/0.85）。空间制图整体精度相近(0.85–0.86)，但树冠覆盖制图差异显著（地表反射率14.57% vs AEF 29.79%）。物理探针显示AEF嵌入强烈编码光谱指数(A30-SWIR ρ=0.58–0.67)、NDMI(A38 ρ=-0.72)、NDVI(A49 ρ=0.72–0.73)及SAR结构(A25-VH ρ=0.71)。
AI.conclusion: AEF嵌入可作为高效、可迁移的遥感特征替代方案，性能接近多时相特征时序且减少工程负担；但其编码的生物物理信息存在偏差（如树冠覆盖高估）。未来应结合物理知识增强嵌入方法的可解释性，构建更透明可信的农业AI系统。

title: ScanAR: Parallel Row-Scan Decoding for Efficient Image Generation in Unified Autoregressive Models
summary: Unified multimodal autoregressive (AR) models represent text and images in one token sequence and generate all modalities with a shared next-token prediction head. Their image generation, however, decodes an $H\times W$ visual grid token by token in raster order, which takes $HW$ sequential steps and dominates inference time. Existing acceleration methods for visual AR generation either change the tokenizer, the prediction head, or the model interface, or keep the model but cannot reach high parallelism without losing quality, so they do not carry over to unified AR models. We propose ScanAR, a row-scan parallel decoding method that only redefines the predecessors of visual tokens. The first visual row is generated from left to right as usual, and each later row is generated in a single parallel step, with every token predicted from the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Nonvisual tokens keep the standard autoregressive rule. ScanAR reduces the visual decoding depth from $HW$ to $H+W$ without changing the backbone, vocabulary, or output head and without adding parameters, and it supports both training from scratch and lightweight post-training. On Emu3.5-Image-34B, ScanAR post-training reaches a GenEval score of 82.36, the best among post-training acceleration methods trained on the same data, and generates $512\times512$ images $13.8\times$ faster than raster decoding under the same inference setting. On ImageNet, ScanAR trained from scratch has the highest throughput at every model size with FID comparable to raster LlamaGen. On the 34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 model, ScanAR preserves the overall quality of embodied scene generation, interleaved image-text generation, and video generation.

AI.tldr: ScanAR 提出行扫描并行解码，把统一多模态自回归模型的视觉解码深度从 HW 降到 H+W，在保持质量的同时显著加速。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态 AR 模型按光栅顺序逐 token 解码 H×W 视觉网格，需要 HW 步串行，主导推理时间。已有加速方法要么改动 tokenizer/预测头/模型接口，要么难以在保质量前提下高并行，均不适用于统一 AR 模型。
AI.method: 仅重定义视觉 token 的前驱关系：第一行从左到右生成，其后每一行在单个并行步内生成，每个 token 由上一行纵向对齐的 token 预测；非视觉 token 仍用标准自回归规则。不改变骨干、词表与输出头，不新增参数，支持从零训练与轻量后训练。
AI.result: Emu3.5-Image-34B 上后训练 GenEval 达 82.36（同数据后训练加速方法中最佳），512×512 生成比光栅解码快 13.8×；ImageNet 从零训练在各模型尺寸吞吐最高，FID 与光栅 LlamaGen 相当；34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 上保持具身场景、图文交错与视频生成质量。
AI.conclusion: ScanAR 是一种简单、无需改结构的高并行视觉解码方案，可通用迁移到统一多模态 AR 模型，兼顾加速与质量。

title: Proverbs As A Window On Collective Prescriptions
summary: Proverbs, as repositories of traditional wisdom, have informed human reasoning for millennia. Yet the collective prescriptions they encode have remained largely unquantified. We introduce a computational framework to analyze nearly 50,000 English-language proverbs. Using large language models, validated against human judgments, we map the topical landscape of proverbs, assess their prescriptive power, and quantify their recommendations on key dimensions of human judgment and behavior. We find that most proverbs are prescriptive, offering guidance in domains under individual control, such as preparation and prudent action, whereas proverbs about uncontrollable circumstances, such as fate and mortality, tend to describe rather than prescribe. When prescriptive proverbs take a consistent stance, they favor caution over risk, long-term over short-term outcomes, honesty over deception, and kindness over malice, and show a moderate tendency toward suspicion over trust. On dimensions involving genuine trade-offs, especially autonomy versus compliance, proverbs provide contradicting advice rather than a single recommendation. This analysis provides a quantitative map of the collective prescriptions in a culture's proverbial wisdom, revealing a core of prudent, honest, and forward-looking guidance alongside varied advice where circumstances dictate the best course of action.

AI.tldr: 本文构建计算框架分析近5万条英语谚语，量化其规劝性与价值取向。
AI.motivation: 谚语承载传统智慧却长期缺乏量化研究，其集体规训内容未被系统测绘。
AI.method: 用大语言模型（经人类判断验证）标注谚语主题、规劝力度及在关键行为维度上的推荐倾向。
AI.result: 多数谚语为规劝性，集中于可控领域；倾向谨慎、长期、诚实、善意，对信任略偏怀疑；在自主vs服从等权衡维度上建议互相矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 谚语智慧呈现"谨慎、诚实、前瞻"的核心，并在情境依赖处提供多元甚至冲突的建议。

title: HoMe: Toward Practical Harness Optimization of Memory Systems for AI Assistants
summary: The behavior of memory systems for long-running AI assistants is governed by a harness, which consists of the code, prompts, and configurations for memory construction, maintenance, retrieval, and answer generation. However, optimizing the harness of a memory system remains largely manual, and unrestricted editing alone does not ensure structural improvements. In this paper, we introduce HoMe, an evaluation-driven framework that iteratively evaluates candidate harnesses and derives each new candidate from any previously evaluated harness by editing any part of it. HoMe combines session-level memory versioning with execution traces to identify shared failure mechanisms across cases and localize them to the responsible sessions and harness components. It encourages early structural exploration through candidate gating and reduces evaluation cost through smoke tests, adaptive sampling, and the reuse of constructed memory. We validate HoMe with the open-source memory system ReMe on two large-scale long-horizon memory benchmarks, LongMemEval-S and BEAM. With six formal candidate evaluations per benchmark, after a full initial evaluation, HoMe discovers harnesses that improve end-task performance over the originally strong harness while consuming far fewer query-time tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe.

AI.tldr: 提出HoMe——一个评估驱动的框架，自动迭代优化长时AI助手的记忆系统harness（构建、维护、检索与答案生成的代码/提示/配置），在LongMemEval-S和BEAM上以很少的查询token消耗获得端任务性能提升。
AI.motivation: 长时运行AI助手的记忆系统行为由harness（记忆构建、维护、检索与答案生成的代码、提示与配置）决定，但目前harness优化基本靠人工，且无约束的编辑无法保证结构上的改进。因此需要一种能自动、可靠地改进harness的方法。
AI.method: HoMe是一个评估驱动的框架：迭代评估候选harness，每个新候选都从任意已评估过的harness编辑得到（可编辑任意部分）。它结合会话级记忆版本化与执行轨迹，识别跨案例的共享失败机制，并定位到责任会话与harness组件；通过candidate gating促进早期结构探索；通过smoke tests、自适应采样与已构建记忆复用降低评估成本。
AI.result: 在开源记忆系统ReMe上，于LongMemEval-S和BEAM两个大规模长程记忆基准上验证；每个基准仅进行六次正式候选评估（在完整初始评估之后），HoMe即发现优于原本已很强harness的harness，同时大幅降低查询时token消耗。
AI.conclusion: HoMe表明记忆系统harness可以被自动、评估驱动地优化，在提升端任务性能的同时显著节省查询token，代码已在GitHub开源（agentscope-ai/ReMe）。

title: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
summary: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are positioned to act as orbital edge-compute nodes in emerging 6G non-terrestrial networks, supporting forecasting and control tasks for ground cellular infrastructure. However, training such models is challenged by heterogeneous ground-cell traffic patterns, intermittent links to ground stations, and the satellites' own orbital motion, which continuously shifts the data each satellite observes. In this work, we extend Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to the LEO setting and apply it to cellular internet-traffic forecasting on the Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino dataset. Satellites cooperate exclusively through $k$-nearest inter-satellite gossip with no ground-side aggregator, while zero-shot head selection lets each satellite specialize to the latent traffic regime of the ground cell currently beneath it. Averaged over $K{=}20$ post-training orbital snapshots, our extension reduces forecasting Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) by $15.3\%$ over a decentralized FedAvg baseline of equivalent capacity, with cluster recovery accuracy of $85.3\%$. The results indicate that clustered specialization yields measurable gains under the structural heterogeneity inherent to realistic cellular-over-LEO scenarios.

AI.tldr: 将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到LEO卫星场景，用于地面蜂窝流量预测，在无地面聚合器、仅靠k最近邻星间gossip的条件下实现卫星对流量模式的专门化，RMSE较去中心化FedAvg基线降低15.3%。
AI.motivation: LEO星座有望成为6G非地面网络中的在轨边缘计算节点，为地面蜂窝基础设施提供预测与控制服务。但训练此类模型面临三大挑战：地面小区流量模式异构、与地面站链路间歇、卫星轨道运动导致观测数据持续漂移。
AI.method: 在LEO场景下扩展去中心化联邦聚类方法DFCA；卫星仅通过k近邻星间gossip协作，不设地面侧聚合器；采用零样本头部选择，使每颗卫星专门化于其正下方地面小区的潜在流量模式；在Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino数据集上做互联网流量预测。
AI.result: 在K=20个训练后轨道快照上平均，预测RMSE相比同等容量的去中心化FedAvg基线降低15.3%，聚类恢复准确率达85.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在真实蜂窝-LEO场景固有的结构异构性下，聚类式专门化能带来可测量的性能增益。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
summary: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.

AI.tldr: MedPACT：用"即时答案支持"与"前瞻引导"两种观测信用做智能体强化学习的医学VQA框架。
AI.motivation: 医学VQA需要主动获取证据并决定下一步看哪里，但仅用最终答案奖励无法揭示哪些观察真正支持作答，也无法引导后续检查。
AI.method: 提出内容受控估计器：在共享真实观测历史下比较由真实观测与匹配替代观测引发的下一动作差异，隔离观测内容对后续决策的贡献；将即时答案支持与前瞻引导两种信用结合进GRPO，把观测信用分配给对应工具调用token，并叠加轨迹级结果监督；单一视觉语言模型、仅用图像-问题-答案监督，信用估计仅限训练阶段。
AI.result: 在4B与8B骨干、六个医学VQA基准上取得更高准确率、强分布外泛化能力和显著更低的推理成本；案例显示其避免了重复观测并能利用已获证据引导后续检查。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度观测信用与结果监督结合可提升医学VQA智能体决策的准确性与效率，具备实际应用潜力。

title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRBench Pro，一个以结构化知识覆盖为核心评估目标的深度研究智能体基准，用 Wikipedia 知识树+子图自动生成查询与证据 rubric，144 个案例覆盖 24 个领域共 44,102 条 rubric，从广度与深度（几何平均）衡量覆盖，最好智能体仅达 57.04%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准虽在多维度评估报告质量，但缺少专门从知识角度评估"报告覆盖哪些研究方向、探索有多深"的评测，因此需要把结构化知识覆盖作为首要评价目标。
AI.method: 从 Wikipedia 自动构建本地知识树，采样子图生成研究查询与有证据支撑的 rubric；每条 rubric 对应树中一个关系，保留知识结构。智能体只接收研究查询，从而可测量主要研究方向的广度与知识链上的深度。
AI.result: 包含 24 个领域 144 个案例、44,102 条 rubric；评估 16 个深度研究智能体，显示广度与深度上各有强弱，最佳整体覆盖率为 57.04%；rubric 判定与人工标注高度一致，且在测试的指标配置下智能体排名保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: DRBench Pro 提供以知识覆盖为中心、忠实保留知识结构且与人类判断一致的稳健评测框架，揭示现有深度研究智能体在知识广度与深度上仍有明显差距。

title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
summary: Large pretrained language models provide capable policies for interactive tasks, but how much model capacity is necessary for a specialized language agent? We introduce ZeroHero, a framework for training small language agents (SLAs) from scratch. In each environment, a large language model acts as the expert, and we collect its successful trajectories. We pretrain each SLA, which has fewer than 50 million parameters, to predict the expert's responses given the interaction history. We then post-train the agent on its own interactions using proximal policy optimization (PPO). During post-training, reasoning alignment supplements environment rewards with expert supervision on the language the agent generates alongside its actions. We evaluate the agents in three multistep environments where acting requires both understanding and generating language. In Crafter, agents interpret textual observations and generate reasoning before acting. In WebShop, they translate shopping instructions into search queries. In Alfworld-Dialogue, they ask clarifying questions and use the answers to guide household actions. The agents approach expert performance on WebShop and surpass their respective demonstration experts on Crafter training rollouts and held-out Alfworld-Dialogue tasks. An interactive demo is available at https://zoyav.github.io/-ZoyaV-zerohero-demo.

AI.tldr: ZeroHero framework trains small language agents (<50M params) from scratch for interactive language tasks, using LLM expert trajectories for pretraining and PPO with reasoning alignment for post-training, achieving expert-level or better performance.
AI.motivation: Large pretrained LMs make capable interactive agents, but it's unclear how much model capacity a specialized language agent actually needs; exploring whether small models can suffice.
AI.method: A large LM acts as expert to collect successful trajectories per environment; pretrain small agents (<50M params) to predict expert responses from interaction history; then post-train with PPO on their own interactions, using reasoning alignment that adds expert supervision on generated language to environment rewards.
AI.result: Evaluated in Crafter, WebShop, and Alfworld-Dialogue; agents approach expert performance on WebShop and surpass demonstration experts on Crafter training rollouts and held-out Alfworld-Dialogue tasks.
AI.conclusion: Small language agents trained from scratch can effectively handle multistep interactive tasks requiring language understanding and generation, matching or exceeding much larger expert models in specialized environments.

title: CARE-WM: Same-Horizon Self-Conditioning with Constraint-Adaptive Regularization for Latent World Models
summary: Planning with latent world models requires both accurate multi-step predictions and latent distances that reflect physical proximity to the goal. However, models are typically trained on ground-truth observations but must rely on their own imaginations during planning, while closer latent distances do not necessarily correspond to better task outcomes. Existing methods resort to auxiliary training objectives or additional task-cost readouts, which respectively incur extra training overhead or leave the latent geometry itself misaligned with task cost. We introduce CARE-WM, a drop-in training method that meets both requirements without additional supervision, a separate cost model, or any change to LeWM's architecture and Euclidean-cost planner. CARE-WM trains the predictor on its own predictions and adaptively calibrates the strength of latent regularization. With a single hyperparameter configuration, CARE-WM improves mean planning success over LeWM across all evaluated continuous-control tasks and matches or exceeds the best results of other LeWM-family methods on most tasks. Further analyses show lower open-loop latent prediction error and closer agreement between latent-cost rankings and physical task costs.

AI.tldr: CARE-WM：一种即插即用的训练方法，让潜在世界模型的预测器在自己的预测上训练，并自适应校准潜在正则化强度，无需额外监督或代价模型，即可同时提升多步预测准确性与潜在距离的任务对齐性。
AI.motivation: 用潜在世界模型做规划需要两个条件：准确的多步预测，以及能反映"离目标物理距离"的潜在距离。但现有模型在真实观测上训练、规划时却依赖自身想象，存在训练-推理不匹配；同时潜在距离更近并不等于任务结果更好。已有方法靠辅助训练目标（带来额外开销）或额外任务代价读出（潜在几何本身仍与任务代价错位）来缓解，均不理想。
AI.method: CARE-WM 保持 LeWM 的架构与欧氏代价规划器不变，做两件事：(1) 用预测器自身的预测（而非仅真实观测）训练预测器，缓解想象与观测的分布差异；(2) 自适应校准潜在正则化的强度，使潜在几何更贴合任务代价。方法为 drop-in，无需额外监督、独立代价模型或架构修改，且仅用单一超参数配置。
AI.result: 在单一超参数配置下，CARE-WM 在所评估的全部连续控制任务上均提升了相对 LeWM 的平均规划成功率，并在多数任务上达到或超过其他 LeWM 系列方法的最佳结果。进一步分析显示开环潜在预测误差更低，且潜在代价排序与真实物理任务代价的一致性更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过"自预测训练 + 自适应正则校准"，可在不增加架构复杂度和额外监督的前提下，同时改善多步预测精度与潜在空间的代价对齐性，验证了训练方式与潜在几何塑形对潜在世界模型规划性能的关键作用。

title: DuoWM:Integrating Dual 6-DoF Visual Flows into Action-Conditioned Drone World Model
summary: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

AI.tldr: DuoWM：一个第一人称无人机视频世界模型，通过"动作流"和"物体流"两种互补视觉条件，结合变换感知预训练，实现更准确的相机指令对齐与6-DoF场景变换建模。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型难以将相机指令与视觉动态对齐，且难以表示完整的6-DoF场景变换。
AI.method: 提出DuoWM，采用两种互补视觉条件：动作流将未来相机位置与朝向投影到每个目标帧；物体流对初始观测做前向形变并叠加局部6-DoF变换以锚定场景运动。另引入变换感知预训练，在标准RGB视频训练前将物体外观与显式变换轴配对。
AI.result: 在Sekai-drone数据集上，视频质量、3D一致性和轨迹跟随均取得最佳结果。相比SOTA方法Captain Safari，真实域FVD和LPIPS降低17.2%和21.6%；游戏域AUC@30从0.5003升至0.5719，AUC@15从0.3088升至0.3747。
AI.conclusion: 双流视觉条件与变换感知预训练有效提升了动作条件视频世界模型的相机控制对齐能力和6-DoF变换表示能力。

title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 μ-Bench，一个面向共享空间中多用户语音智能体的闭环全双工联合任务基准，含 20 领域、100 场景、800 用例及 JTS/Pure JTS/ATC 指标，评测 13 个语音智能体。
AI.motivation: 共享空间中的语音智能体需同时满足多个用户相互依赖的请求，并保证每个用户的权限、隐私与任务约束；现有评测在参与者于会话中实时反应的设定上覆盖不足。
AI.method: 构建闭环、全双工多用户语音交互基准：模拟参与者基于各自隔离的目标/知识/权限配置，随智能体语音与工具结果自适应反应；覆盖 20 个领域、100 个场景，变化组规模、声学条件与追问需求，形成 800 个用例（408 工具增强、392 无工具）。定义 Joint Task Success（JTS，需所有用户目标、隐私边界与终态同时成立）与 Pure JTS（额外禁止未授权工具调用），并用 Attribution、Threading、Coordination（ATC）诊断定位失败来源。
AI.result: 13 个语音智能体中，闭源系统峰值成功率为无工具 62.24%、工具增强 65.44%，开源权重模型均低于 20%。ATC 诊断显示开源模型主要落后于多轮归因与话题串接；控制对比表明组规模增大时，即使能力较强的系统联合任务成功率也持续下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过将反应式多用户模拟与可验证的会话级结果结合，μ-Bench 为共享场景语音智能体提供了严格且可诊断的测试平台，并揭示现有系统在多方归因、串接与规模化协作上的明显不足。

title: REE: A Scientific Research Entrance Exam for AI Agents
summary: Autonomous research agents are emerging as a promising approach to scientific problem-solving across disciplines, owing to their growing ability to improve a solution through repeated experiments. Evaluating this ability requires benchmarks that pose open-ended research problems and measure improvements over established scientific methods. We introduce REE (Research Entrance Exam), a benchmark that tests AI agents on scientific research. It consists of 100 open-ended research problems spanning five broad scientific areas and 23 domains. To ensure high quality, every problem is drawn from active research in its field and individually reviewed by domain experts. Each problem is posed as a task of iterative improvement: an agent has up to 12 hours to improve a working starter solution, and REE scores the result on a common scale against an established expert solution evaluated under comparable conditions. By this measure, two of the four frontier agents we evaluate, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, outperform the expert solutions on 86% and 81% of problems, across all five scientific areas. Their runs also show how they do so: both agents surpass the expert solutions within the first two hours on average, and their best solutions mostly tailor or combine established methods of the field. REE thus provides a unified framework for evaluating autonomous scientific research, capturing both improvements over established methods and the research processes behind them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 REE（Research Entrance Exam）基准，用 100 个来自活跃研究的开放式科研问题（5 大领域、23 个子域）评测自主科研智能体，以"12 小时内改进起始解法、对照专家解打分"为范式；两个前沿智能体在 86%/81% 问题上超过专家解，且多为对既有方法的裁剪与组合。
AI.motivation: 自主科研智能体通过反复实验改进解法的能力日益增强，但缺乏既能提出开放式科研问题、又能衡量相对既有科学方法改进程度的基准，现有评测无法统一评估"是否真的超越专家方法"及其研究过程。
AI.method: 构建 REE 基准：100 个开放式研究问题，覆盖 5 大科学领域、23 个子域，每题均取自该领域活跃研究并经领域专家逐一审核。任务形式为迭代改进——智能体最多 12 小时改进一个可运行的起始解法，结果在同一尺度上与在可比条件下评测的既有专家解对比打分，并可分析其研究过程轨迹。
AI.result: 在所评测的四个前沿智能体中，Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 分别在 86% 和 81% 的问题上超越专家解，且横跨全部五个科学领域；两者平均在两小时内即超过专家解，其最佳解法大多是裁剪或组合该领域的既有方法。
AI.conclusion: REE 为评估自主科学研究提供了统一框架，既能衡量相对既有方法的改进幅度，也能刻画改进背后的研究过程，可作为开放式科研智能体能力的通用评测标准。

title: Feature Engineered Reinforcement Learning for S-pair Selection in Buchberger's Algorithm
summary: Selecting the order in which to process S-pairs is a crucial decision in Buchberger's algorithm for computing Groebner bases: this choice can change the cost by orders of magnitude. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning agents viewing exponent vectors of the polynomials outperform classical heuristics on binomial ideals. We extend this line of work to general polynomial ideals by using statistical features. We introduce a 17-dimensional feature vector to describe a polynomial and use PPO to train policies on five distributions of random ideals. We find that using S-polynomial features significantly outperforms S-pair features on all five distributions. The new policies also outperform the retrained RL baseline on all five distributions, reducing algorithmic work by 41--53\% relative to the degree heuristic on four distributions where learning helps. The additional cost of the feature engineering means that wall-clock cost remains similar to the baseline, but our new approach benefits from easier transfer to unseen distributions.

AI.tldr: 用17维多项式统计特征（而非单纯指数向量）配合PPO学习S-对处理顺序，在五类随机理想分布上均优于S-对特征与重训RL基线，相比次数启发式减少41–53%算法工作量。
AI.motivation: Buchberger算法中S-对的选取顺序对计算代价影响可达数量级；已有工作表明强化学习在二项式理想上优于经典启发式，但尚需推广到一般多项式理想。
AI.method: 构造17维多項式统计特征向量描述多项式，用PPO在五种随机理想分布上训练策略；对比S-多项式特征与S-对特征、重训RL基线及次数启发式。
AI.result: S-多项式特征在全部五种分布上显著优于S-对特征，并优于重训RL基线；在四个学习有效的分布上相对次数启发式减少41–53%算法工作量。因特征工程额外开销，实际墙钟时间与基线相近，但更易迁移到未见分布。
AI.conclusion: 统计特征引导的RL策略可有效推广到一般多项式理想，提升算法效率并具备更好的分布迁移性，尽管当前墙钟收益受特征计算成本限制。

title: Bridging Transferability and Discriminability via Positive-Unlabeled Domain Adaptation for Building Damage Mapping Across Disaster Events
summary: Mapping the damage to buildings following natural and human-caused disasters is essential for disaster response and humanitarian assistance. However, differences in hazard types, geographic environments, building characteristics, and imaging conditions cause cross-event distribution shifts that limit the generalization of deep learning models to new disaster events, even for geospatial foundation models (GFMs) pretrained on extensive Earth observation data. Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) can mitigate these shifts, but adaptation remains challenging when damage-proportion and damage-appearance shifts coexist and interact. We identify enhancing target-domain discriminability as key to addressing this challenge. To this end, inspired by positive-unlabeled (PU) learning, we introduce positive-unlabeled domain adaptation, a paradigm that incorporates PU weak supervision to enhance target-domain discriminability, requiring only a few labeled damaged buildings in the target domain. Building upon this straightforward intuition, we develop Positive-ANchored Domain Adaptation (PANDA), comprising two complementary and mutually reinforcing components: Pairwise Alignment with Intra-class Robustness (PAIR) for discriminative representation learning and Refine Gate and Verifier (RAV) for supervision refinement. On a global-scale multi-disaster benchmark, PANDA generally outperforms representative domain adaptation and PU learning methods. Results on the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires show its effectiveness in new disaster scenarios with few labeled damaged buildings. Further experiments demonstrate the potential of integrating PANDA with GFMs for cross-event adaptation. These findings highlight PANDA's practical potential for rapid, reliable, and cross-event building damage mapping.

AI.tldr: 提出正-无标签域自适应范式与PANDA方法，利用目标域少量已标注损毁建筑提升判别性，实现跨灾害事件的建筑损毁制图。
AI.motivation: 灾害类型、地理环境、建筑特征与成像条件差异导致跨事件分布偏移，使深度学习模型乃至地理空间基础模型（GFM）难以泛化到新灾害事件；UDA虽可缓解，但损伤比例与损伤外观偏移并存且交互时效果有限，关键在于提升目标域判别性。
AI.method: 受PU学习启发，将PU弱监督引入域自适应，仅需目标域少量已标注损毁建筑；构建PANDA，包含互补互促的两部分：PAIR（成对对齐+类内鲁棒性）用于判别性表征学习，RAV（Refine Gate与Verifier）用于监督精炼。
AI.result: 在全球尺度多灾害基准上总体优于代表性域自适应与PU学习方法；在2025年洛杉矶山火新场景中，少量标注损毁建筑即有效；并展示PANDA与GFM结合用于跨事件适配的潜力。
AI.conclusion: PANDA具有快速、可靠、跨事件建筑损毁制图的实用潜力。

title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
summary: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.

AI.tldr: DART通过回访被拒绝的推理轨迹、分解并定位高不确定性步骤、生成显著不同的替代候选，挖掘数学推理训练数据，提升难题覆盖与后训练效果。
AI.motivation: 难数学问题在独立蒙特卡洛采样下很难得到通过验证的解答轨迹，导致后训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 从被拒绝的轨迹出发，将其分解为推理步骤，按位置加权不确定性排序，对高排名步骤借助参考答案引导和meta-thought生成刻意不同的替代候选，再补全轨迹。
AI.result: 在贪心法未解决的DeepMath-103K问题上，相同生成轨迹数下比MC采样多恢复37%的问题；每个恢复问题的生成成本几乎相同，每条被接受轨迹成本低30%。用DART挖掘数据后训练Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，在MATH-500与AIME六个评测中五个取得最高点估计。
AI.conclusion: 重新利用被拒绝轨迹可扩展问题覆盖，并提供有效的后训练数据。

title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. For occluded-pedestrian emergence, five rounds of post-training improve the critical-phase collision-free rate on the sealed test set from 0.261 to 0.579 for AutoVLA and from 0.390 to 0.765 for ReCogDrive, while the unnecessary braking rate in paired control scenarios never exceeds 0.013. On a full-scale vehicle without real-world training, post-trained ReCogDrive achieves 4 of 5 safe passages, versus 1 of 5 for the base model. Fine-grained evaluation reveals a pattern obscured by the collision-free rate alone: both VLA models learn anticipatory deceleration before reaching the occluding vehicle, while braking after pedestrian emergence remains limited. For stop-sign yielding, the stop-before-line rate rises from 0.100 to 0.897 for AutoVLA and from 0.000 to 0.667 for ReCogDrive. With sequential training from the pedestrian-capability models, it reaches 0.599 and 0.358, respectively, while the pedestrian collision-free rate decreases by at most 0.032.

AI.tldr: 提出"失败驱动的数据飞轮"框架，通过把任务相关实体插入重建的真实场景来构造目标场景，按行为需求与难度形成失败图谱并定向分配数据生成配额，实现VLA模型的后训练，在自动驾驶遮挡行人涌现与停车让行任务上显著提升安全指标并迁移至实车。
AI.motivation: 预训练VLA模型难以满足新平台的全部行为需求，而缺乏大规模部署车队数据的团队无法获取相应失败数据来修复，需要一种不依赖现有数据覆盖的高效后训练方案。
AI.method: 构建失败驱动的数据飞轮：在重建的真实场景中插入任务相关实体以合成数据中缺失的目标场景；逐项评估模型对目标任务各行为需求的满足情况，形成跨任务条件与难度的失败图谱；每轮重评估并按失败率给仍失败的条件分配更大数据生成配额。在自动驾驶中实例化（遮挡行人涌现、停车标志路口让行），并在仿真与实车上对两个VLA模型和一个非VLA规划器评测。
AI.result: 遮挡行人任务五轮后训练：关键阶段无碰撞率AutoVLA从0.261升至0.579，ReCogDrive从0.390升至0.765，配对对照场景不必要制动率不超过0.013；实车无真实数据训练下后训练ReCogDrive达5次中4次安全通过（基座1/5）。细粒度评估显示两个VLA模型学到遮挡车前的预期性减速，但行人出现后的制动仍有限——该模式被单一无碰撞率掩盖。停车让行：停车线前停车率AutoVLA 0.100→0.897，ReCogDrive 0.000→0.667；顺序训练后分别为0.599和0.358，行人无碰撞率下降最多0.032。
AI.conclusion: 失败驱动的数据飞轮能在数据有限条件下有效后训练VLA模型，安全行为指标大幅提升且副作用小，并可零真实数据迁移至实车；同时细粒度评估揭示聚合指标掩盖的行为缺陷，说明需按需求维度诊断模型能力。

title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. Hidden State Mixing (HSM) samples among backbone and MTP hidden states aligned to the same prediction target, exposing the drafter to mixtures of states from different MTP steps without explicitly simulating inference. Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD) is a regularization method that stochastically blocks gradients through hidden state and embedding pathways while preserving the forward computation. Neither method adds inference cost. In joint pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, HSGD yields the highest acceptance rates at early draft positions, while HSM performs best later in the draft. These acceptance rate trends favor HSM for long-draft-length serving and HSGD for short-draft-length serving. Furthermore, across four Nemotron models and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, HSM-based MTP boosting with a frozen backbone improves mean acceptance length by up to 52.2% over the co-trained MTP. For EAGLE-3 drafters, HSM offers competitive acceptance with TTT, with 48% lower peak reserved training memory in a four-step Qwen3-8B comparison. HSM implementations are publicly available in Megatron-LM and NVIDIA Model Optimizer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种仅训练期使用的隐状态增强方法 HSM 与 HSGD，缓解 MTP/EAGLE 式草稿模型在自回归使用中的训练-推理不匹配，且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: MTP 模块与 EAGLE 草稿模型复用目标模型隐状态以加速投机解码，但训练时提供的是主干或单步 MTP 隐状态序列，推理时却要 attends 目标前缀加递归生成的 MTP 状态尾部，造成训练-推理不匹配。EAGLE-3 的 TTT 通过显式模拟推理来解决，但带来额外显存和特殊注意力掩码的代价。
AI.method: 隐藏状态混合（HSM）：在预测同一目标的对齐主干隐状态与 MTP 隐状态间采样，让草稿模型接触不同 MTP 步的混合状态，无需显式模拟推理。隐藏状态梯度分离（HSGD）：正则化方法，随机阻断隐状态与嵌入路径的梯度而保留前向计算。
AI.result: 联合预训练+有监督微调下，HSGD 在早期草稿位置接受率最高，HSM 在草稿后段更优；因此长草稿长度服务宜用 HSM，短草稿宜用 HSGD。在四个 Nemotron 模型与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，冻结主干的 HSM 式 MTP 增强相较联合训练 MTP 平均接受长度最高提升 52.2%。对 EAGLE-3 草稿模型，HSM 接受率与 TTT 相当，而在四步 Qwen3-8B 对比中峰值预留训练显存降低 48%。
AI.conclusion: HSM 与 HSGD 以零推理开销有效缓解自回归草稿的训练-推理不匹配，可按草稿长度需求选用；HSM 已开源实现于 Megatron-LM 与 NVIDIA Model Optimizer。

title: Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology via Topology-Informed Graph Attention and Gene-Semantics Conditioning
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) profiles gene expression with spatial context but remains costly, motivating models that infer expression from H&E images. Existing approaches face three key limitations: (i) a single patch embedding is often insufficient: morphologically similar regions can exhibit distinct expression due to spatial context, while naive neighborhood aggregation can over-smooth boundaries; (ii) conventional fixed, gene-indexed output heads treat genes independently and cannot directly support strict zero-shot prediction for unseen genes; and (iii) common metrics under-measure spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution. To address these challenges, we propose TIGEM, a topology-informed, gene-conditioned framework for histology-to-ST inference. TIGEM learns topology-aware spot representations by regularizing graph attention with tissue-level topology and morphology cues to avoid cross-compartment smoothing, and uses gene semantic modulation to replace gene-indexed heads, enabling zero-shot prediction for unseen genes. We also introduce Graph Spectral Correlation (GSC) to evaluate spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution complement to PCC/MSE. Across three large-scale ST datasets, TIGEM achieves overall state-of-the-art performance and significantly improved boundary prediction resolution, and further demonstrates the ability to predict expression patterns for genes unseen during training, extending prior zero-shot histology-to-ST efforts with topology-aware spatial propagation and PLM-based gene conditioning.

AI.tldr: TIGEM 是一个拓扑感知、基因条件化的框架，从 H&E 图像推断空间转录组（ST）表达，解决邻域平滑过度、无法零样本预测新基因、评价指标不足三大问题。
AI.motivation: ST 成本高，故希望从 H&E 图像推断基因表达。现有方法存在三方面不足：(i) 单 patch 嵌入不足，形态相似区域因空间上下文表达不同，而朴素邻域聚合会过度平滑边界；(ii) 固定基因索引输出头把基因视为独立，无法零样本预测未见基因；(iii) 常用指标低估空间模式保真度与边界分辨率。
AI.method: 提出 TIGEM：(1) 用组织级拓扑与形态线索正则化图注意力，学习拓扑感知的 spot 表示，避免跨分区平滑；(2) 用基因语义调制替代基因索引输出头，实现未见基因的零样本预测；(3) 提出图谱相关（GSC）指标，作为 PCC/MSE 的补充来衡量空间模式保真度与边界分辨率。
AI.result: 在三个大规模 ST 数据集上取得整体 SOTA 性能，边界预测分辨率显著提升，并能预测训练中未见基因的表达模式。
AI.conclusion: TIGEM 以拓扑感知空间传播与基于 PLM 的基因条件化，扩展了此前的零样本 histology-to-ST 工作，同时新的 GSC 指标更好地评估空间保真度。

title: Tokenisation is not in APX
summary: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了分词（tokenisation）优化问题在 P≠NP 前提下不存在常数因子近似算法，即不属于 APX 类，对直接分词与自底向上分词、压缩目标与 unigram 对数似然目标、二元及以上字母表均成立；即使在单字母表上，直接分词也是 APX-难的。
AI.motivation: 分词器（如 BPE、unigram 语言模型）广泛用于现代自然语言处理，其训练本质是在给定目标（压缩率或似然）下寻找最优切分方案，但此前缺乏对该优化问题计算复杂性的理论刻画。作者希望厘清：寻找最优分词器是否可在多项式时间内近似。
AI.method: 采用计算复杂性理论中的归约方法：从 NP-难问题出发构造归约，证明若存在任何常数因子近似算法（即 PTAS/APX 类算法）则可推出 P=NP。分析覆盖两类分词范式（direct 与 bottom-up）、两类目标函数（压缩目标与 unigram 对数似然）、以及二元与更大字母表；并单独针对单字母表情形构造更强的 APX-难性归约。
AI.result: 证明除非 P=NP，否则没有任何多项式时间算法能给出目标值在最优解任意常数倍之内的分词器，即分词优化问题不在 APX 类中；该结论在直接/自底向上分词、压缩/似然目标、二元及以上字母表下均成立。此外，即使在单字母表（unary）情形，直接分词仍是 APX-难的，因而连多项式时间近似方案（PTAS）也不存在。
AI.conclusion: 分词器优化在理论上具有高度不可近似性：不仅无法精确求解，连常数因子近似也不可能（除非 P=NP），单字母表下更无 PTAS。这为实践中依赖贪心启发式（如 BPE 合并）提供了理论依据，也提示应从启发式、参数化或受限输入等方向寻求可保证的算法。

title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.

AI.tldr: INSPIRE是一个两阶段时序知识图谱预测框架：第一阶段用覆盖全候选目录、带可用性感知与掩码的共享模式预测器，第二阶段冻结它并用轻量个体证据适配器融合文本先验与相关性加权长程事件统计，显著提升新兴实体的推理排序性能。
AI.motivation: 时序知识图谱中新兴实体从零样本登场逐步演化为稀疏、突发的小样本轨迹，现有范式割裂：模式迁移方法缺乏全目录事件记忆，在线记忆模型存在端点角色不对称问题，损害未见答案的排序；同时稀疏早期交互兼具长程分散与局部冗余且分布偏斜。
AI.method: 两阶段框架（已知目录下预测）。Stage I：可用性感知的共享模式预测器，融合全候选目录上事件更新的记忆，并施加查询侧与目录侧协同掩码。Stage II：冻结该预测器，优化轻量个体证据适配器（EA），结合文本语义先验与相关性加权长程事件统计，采用支持度与角色平衡的共答监督、先验几率去偏和软残差对齐。评估上按端点角色分解，并用查询micro与答案实体macro指标追踪新兴答案队列。
AI.result: 在ICEWS与GDELT的四个基准上，Emerging MRR较最强基线提升16.73%–88.83%；相对配对Stage I，EA使Emerging MRR提升8.28%–32.63%，Answer-new MRR提升7.81%–41.24%，队列macro MRR提升9.64%–39.94%。
AI.conclusion: 增益源于语义先验与候选级分数竞争，能抑制错配的既有竞争者，且不依赖零支持先验捷径。代码已开源。

title: AlignPre: Skill-Aligned Post-Training for Latent-Free Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting requires accurate short-term predictions under rapidly evolving spatiotemporal dynamics. Generative diffusion models can produce detailed and competitive radar forecasts by modeling conditional distributions. However, most existing approaches rely on separately trained components, such as deterministic branches or latent compression modules. More fundamentally, distribution matching alone fails to explicitly optimize operational forecast skill. We propose AlignPre, a streamlined pixel-space nowcasting framework that bridges this gap via skill-aligned post-training (SAPT). AlignPre employs an end-to-end flow-matching forecaster with a hierarchical spatiotemporal architecture for distribution matching and direct radar-field synthesis, without latent compression. During post-training, SAPT exploits the analytic structure of forecast verification scores to construct a differentiable objective. By backpropagating gradients of this objective from radar fields to the generator, SAPT turns forecast verification into direct training feedback. Across three real-world benchmarks spanning different forecast horizons, AlignPre consistently surpasses state-of-the-art deterministic and generative baselines in forecast skill, demonstrating that aligning generative modeling with domain-specific verification provides an effective paradigm for meteorological forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出AlignPre：端到端像素空间流匹配降水临近预报框架，并用"技能对齐后训练"(SAPT)把可微的预报检验评分直接作为训练反馈，在三个真实基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式降水临近预报多依赖分别训练的组件（确定性分支、隐空间压缩模块），流程冗长；更关键的是仅做分布匹配无法显式优化业务预报技巧（如检验评分）。
AI.method: AlignPre采用分层时空架构的端到端流匹配预报器，直接在像素空间合成雷达场，无需隐空间压缩。后训练阶段SAPT利用预报检验评分的解析结构构造可微目标，将梯度从雷达场回传至生成器，把检验过程转化为训练信号。
AI.result: 在覆盖不同预报时效的三个真实世界基准上，AlignPre在预报技巧上稳定优于SOTA的确定性方法与生成式方法基线。
AI.conclusion: 将生成建模与领域特定的检验指标对齐，是气象预报的一种有效范式。

title: SprintGS: Eliminating Redundancy for Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders photorealistic novel views in real time, but its per-scene training (optimization) remains slow. Recent fast training methods such as FastGS shorten training to a few minutes by reducing the number of Gaussians. Profiling FastGS, we find two costs that remain even in its compact model. First, rasterization is still the largest cost, and redundant work remains in it. Second, the loss computation does not shrink with the number of Gaussians, so its share of the training time grows as the model becomes compact. We present SprintGS, a training framework built on FastGS that keeps the model compact and reduces both costs. For rasterization, scheduled tile culling limits each Gaussian to the tiles where it matters, using a coarse footprint that is annealed to the exact one before training ends; convergence-aware pruning removes converged, nearly transparent Gaussians; and a shuffle-efficient backward pass reduces the data exchanged between GPU threads. For the loss, a fused loss computes the loss and its image gradient in the forward pass without a loss map, removing most of its cost. SprintGS trains 2.15x faster than FastGS at comparable quality, and 1.81x faster in its high-quality setting. It also accelerates other fast training methods and dynamic, sparse-view, and surface reconstruction.

AI.tldr: SprintGS 在 FastGS 基础上从光栅化与损失计算两方面优化，训练速度比 FastGS 快 2.15 倍（高质量设置 1.81 倍），质量相当，并可推广到其他快速训练与动态、稀疏视角、表面重建任务。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 可实时渲染逼真新视角，但逐场景训练（优化）仍慢；FastGS 等通过减少高斯数量把训练压缩到几分钟，但剖析发现即使模型已紧凑，仍有两项成本：光栅化仍是最大开销且存在冗余工作，损失计算不随高斯数量减少而变化，占比随模型紧凑而上升。
AI.method: 基于 FastGS 构建。光栅化侧：(1) 调度式 tile 剔除，用粗略足迹限制每个高斯参与的有意义 tile，并在训练结束前退火至精确足迹；(2) 收敛感知剪枝，移除已收敛、近乎透明的高斯；(3) shuffle 高效反向传播，减少 GPU 线程间数据交换。损失侧：融合损失在前向中直接计算损失及图像梯度，无需构建 loss map。
AI.result: 在质量相当条件下训练速度比 FastGS 快 2.15 倍；高质量设置下快 1.81 倍。同时可加速其他快速训练方法，并适用于动态重建、稀疏视角重建和表面重建。
AI.conclusion: 保持模型紧凑并同时削减光栅化与损失两项成本，是加速紧凑 3DGS 训练的有效路径；所提技术具有较好的通用性，可与其他快速训练方法及多类重建任务结合。

title: What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
summary: Mathematicians solve problems faster when they know the right theory. We ask how much a stated theory is worth to a large language model (LLM) solver, and whether a model can write that theory itself. In a length-matched protocol, adding the right theory to the context of Qwen3-14B raises pass@1 on pattern waiting-time problems from 0.37 to 0.83 and cuts the median tokens of correct solutions from 10.2k to 6.3k, while worked examples of the same length do not help. The gain shrinks as the solver and its token budget grow (+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), and at a long budget it comes almost entirely from finishing within budget: solutions that finish are correct 98--100\% of the time in every condition. To separate induction from recall, we plant unpublished theorems in custom probability families and measure how much of the oracle theory's gain an induced theory recovers. A strong open model, required to explore the training problems with code before writing, recovers 60\% of the gain on one planted family, 48\% on a second, and almost none on a third, where it finds the right form but not the condition that makes the form computable. No single induced note is complete, but a strong model that merges several notes recovers 61\% of the gain on the classic family, above the best single note (47\%). Theories are worth the reasoning they save, and models can find their pieces before they can assemble them.

AI.tldr: 论文量化了"给定正确理论"对LLM解题的价值，并考察模型能否自行写出该理论；发现理论主要节省推理长度/帮助在预算内完成，而模型能发现理论片段但难以完整组装。
AI.motivation: 数学家掌握正确理论后解题更快。作者想知道：对LLM求解器而言，"给出理论"值多少？以及模型能否自己写出该理论——从而区分"归纳"与"记忆"。
AI.method: 采用长度匹配协议，在模式等待时间（pattern waiting-time）问题上比较上下文中加入正确理论、等长worked examples与无理论条件对Qwen3-14B pass@1与正确解token数的影响；并在自建概率族中"植入"未发表定理，测量诱导出的理论与oracle理论增益之比。还要求强开源模型先用代码探索训练问题再写理论笔记，并比较多份笔记合并的效果。
AI.result: 加入正确理论使pass@1从0.37升至0.83，正确解token中位数从10.2k降至6.3k，等长worked examples无帮助。增益随求解器能力与token预算增加而缩小（+0.46、+0.26、+0.07）；长预算下增益几乎全部来自"在预算内完成"，各条件下完成的解正确率98–100%。诱导理论在植入族上分别回收60%、48%和几乎为0的增益（第三族找到正确形式但缺可计算条件）。单份笔记均不完整，多笔记合并可回收经典族61%，高于最佳单笔记47%。
AI.conclusion: 理论的价值等于它所节省的推理量；模型能发现理论的"零件"，但尚不能自行组装成完整理论。

title: Do Machine Learning Ensembles Beat Published Quotas? Target Parameterization, Censored Baselines, and Conformal Intervals Under Admissions Reform
summary: Public admission capacity caps published prior to matriculation are widely used by ministries and institutional analysts as default intake projections in centralized postsecondary clearinghouses. Using an audited 2022 to 2026 Vietnamese undergraduate panel (26,895 program-year records across 309 universities) linked to strictly lagged t-1 occupational vacancy signals, this paper evaluates machine learning, multilevel, and censored econometric estimators against published quotas across 5,385 continuing 2024 programs (five-fold university-grouped cross-validation) and 3,348 matched (2,179 grain-consistent) 2025 programs strictly out of time. Because 62.8% of 2024 programs enroll their exact published quota, unanchored log-growth ensembles degrade accuracy, while the worst 5% generate half of total quota error via unfilled "phantom capacity." Controlled target ablations, including a single-factor test under widened non-binding clipping, show that parameterizing the log fill ratio ln(D_it / S_it) instead of log growth reduces 2024 MAE by 21.5% (14.86 to 11.67), aligns ML with Tobit, Cragg, REML HLM, and capped L1 baselines, and lifts combined tuition and institutional-tier TreeSHAP attribution from 2.5% to 45.8%. Hurdle stacking attains the lowest full-census 2024 MAE (H-Hard 11.29; H-Soft 11.32 vs. 12.35, p = 0.022, clearing 10% not 5% FDR; fold-overlap p = 0.134), whereas continuous QA-Stack outperforms H-Soft on mixed-reporting campuses, Tobit (median) ties H-Soft across both 90% MCS sets, and interior-only Cragg-ML lowers RMSE to 28.1. Under Vietnam's 2025 unified-clearing reform, exact filling falls to 10.4%, H-Soft and capped L1 tie quotas (p = 0.979), and 90% cluster-weighted conformal coverage drops from 89.3% to 74.6%. Across 257 reporting campuses, reconciled 2026 national totals (627,114 to 629,256) lie squarely within 604,533 to 662,044.

AI.tldr: 本文用2022–2026年越南本科招生面板（309所大学、26,895条项目-年记录），将配额封顶（admission capacity caps）作为基准，评估机器学习、多层模型与删失计量估计器对招生的预测，发现以对数填充率 ln(D/S) 作为目标比对数增长更优。
AI.motivation: 在集中式高校录取清算系统中，教育部与机构分析者普遍把入学前公布的招生配额上限当作默认的招生预测值。本文检验这种"配额即预测"的做法是否成立，以及何种建模目标能更好刻画实际入学（填充）行为。
AI.method: 构建经审计的2022–2026越南本科项目-年面板（309校、26,895条），并关联严格滞后的 t-1 职业空缺信号。在2024年5,385个延续项目中采用按大学分组五折交叉验证，并在2025年3,348个匹配项目上做严格样本外检验。对比机器学习、多层（REML HLM）、删失计量（Tobit、Cragg、capped L1）等估计器，并施加受控目标消融实验（含放宽非约束裁剪下的单因子检验）。
AI.result: 2024年62.8%的项目恰好招满公布配额，未锚定的对数增长集成模型反而降低精度，最差5%项目产生总配额误差的一半（"幻影容量"）。改用 ln(D_it/S_it) 为目标使2024年MAE下降21.5%（14.86→11.67），并使ML结果与Tobit、Cragg、REML HLM、capped L1 对齐，学费与院校层级 TreeSHAP 归因占比从2.5%升至45.8%。Hurdle 堆叠取得最低全样本2024 MAE（H-Hard 11.29；H-Soft 11.32 vs 12.35，p=0.022，仅过10%未过5% FDR）。2025年统一清算改革后精确招满率降至10.4%，90%聚类加权共形覆盖由89.3%降至74.6%。
AI.conclusion: 配额上限并非可靠默认预测。以对数填充率为目标的建模、Hurdle 堆叠与删失估计器表现更稳健；制度性改革（2025统一清算）显著改变填充行为并削弱预测覆盖，需针对制度变化重新校准模型。

title: DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting
summary: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.

AI.tldr: DriftWAM 是一个面向世界-动作模型（WAM）的少步蒸馏框架，通过在视频学习中引入预测视频所诱导的动作信息，实现高效且保性能的部署。
AI.motivation: WAM 统一了未来视频预测与动作生成，但迭代去噪推理成本高。少步蒸馏虽有前景，但在激进减少步数时任务性能难以保持。现有方法采用逐点轨迹一致性蒸馏，只追求视觉保真度，未利用下游动作信息优化视频生成，也缺乏显式的分布级对齐。
AI.method: DriftWAM 包含两部分：(1) 动作感知视频漂移（action-aware video drifting），通过联合视觉-动作相似度核进行视频分布匹配，在诱导动作引导下驱动样本演化；(2) 动作引导视频正则（action-guided video regularization），利用联合核识别出的师生兼容匹配，将动作级梯度直接反传至视频生成器。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 基准及真实世界机器人操作任务上，相同推理速度下，DriftWAM 在各少步设置中均持续优于先前的一致性蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 将动作信息纳入少步蒸馏的视频分布匹配与梯度正则，可有效在低步数下保持任务性能，为 WAM 的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model address. The text holds the content. A removable knowledge edit supplies the address through its subject key and supports multi-hop composition. A pair of steering vectors decides, query by query, whether the model adopts the memory or keeps its own answer; the vectors store no content and control how the text memory is used. On frozen models under a pre-registered, test-once protocol, TASK reduces memory-ignoring hallucinations to at most 1.5% in all ten model-dataset cells and cuts neighbour misuse from 39.2% to 7.5% (+10.8 pp composite on CounterFact). It improves a 300-memory library over BM25 RAG by 16.4 pp, an advantage that holds at 3,000 memories, resolves fact revisions without fact IDs, and adds 7.5 pp of multi-hop accuracy on MQuAKE. 21 of 23 cross-model comparisons (8B-27B, four families) are significant, and TASK beats three recent context-steering methods in 9 of 10 model-dataset cells.

AI.tldr: 提出"使用期记忆幻觉"问题并提出TASK记忆框架，将文本内容、激活引导与知识编辑统一到同一模型内地址上，显著降低记忆幻觉。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖外部记忆却仍产生幻觉：即便正确记忆已被检索进提示，答案仍与之矛盾或把记忆用错对象。作者将此定义为"使用期记忆幻觉"，指出其源于参数知识与外部记忆的冲突。
AI.method: 在五个开源模型上归纳三种幻觉形式：记忆忽略、记忆误用、版本混淆。提出TASK记忆：文本笔记存内容；可移除的知识编辑通过主语键提供"地址"并支持多跳组合；一对引导向量逐查询决定模型采纳记忆还是保留自身答案。在冻结模型、预注册test-once协议下评估。
