AI.result: 十个模型-数据集单元中记忆忽略幻觉降至≤1.5%；邻接误用从39.2%降至7.5%（CounterFact复合提升10.8pp）。300记忆库较BM25 RAG提升16.4pp且3000条时仍保持；无需fact ID解决事实修订；MQuAKE多跳+7.5pp。23个跨模型对比中21个显著，并在9/10单元优于三种近期上下文引导方法。
AI.conclusion: 将"内容"与"寻址/使用控制"分离是缓解使用期记忆幻觉的有效途径，TASK在冻结模型上多维度超越RAG与上下文引导基线，具备可扩展性与鲁棒性。

title: SysBio-SR: Benchmarking Symbolic Regression for Trajectory Fidelity and Mechanism Recovery in Systems Biology
summary: Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dynamical systems from data. In systems biology, however, accurately reproducing system trajectories does not necessarily imply recovery of the underlying reaction mechanisms. Existing benchmarks evaluate numerical accuracy, expression complexity, or equation-level similarity, but not agreement between recovered reactions and reference mechanisms in biological systems. We introduce SysBio-SR, a benchmark of 198 literature-based biological ODE systems with reaction annotations spanning mass action, Michaelis--Menten, Hill, and complex kinetics. Trajectory fidelity is evaluated across all systems under in-distribution reconstruction and out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation, while mechanism recovery is assessed on the subset of 161 systems. We evaluate trajectory fidelity across 11 symbolic-discovery methods and assess mechanism recovery for three reaction-based methods. Joint analysis across systems highlights how severely trajectory-based evaluation overestimates true mechanism recovery. Motivated by these findings, we develop KineSelect, a framework that searches candidate reaction topologies under biologically grounded kinetic laws to select optimal mechanisms that balance trajectory fidelity with structural parsimony. Compared with the strongest baseline, KineSelect improves aggregate OOD extrapolation \(R^2\) by 19.2\% and overall reaction F1 score by 14.3\%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SysBio-SR基准（198个文献来源的生物ODE系统，含反应机制注释）以及KineSelect框架，揭示仅凭轨迹拟合会严重高估机制恢复能力，并给出兼顾轨迹保真与结构简约的机制选择方法。
AI.motivation: 系统生物学中，数值上准确复现轨迹并不等于恢复真实的反应机制；现有基准只评数值精度、表达式复杂度或方程相似度，缺少对"恢复反应与参考机制一致性"的评估。
AI.method: 构建SysBio-SR基准：198个生物ODE系统，覆盖质量作用、Michaelis-Menten、Hill与复合动力学，全部用于分布内重建与OOD外推的轨迹保真评估，其中161个用于机制恢复评估；评测11种符号发现方法与3种基于反应的方法。据此提出KineSelect，在生物合理的动力学定律下搜索候选反应拓扑，选择在轨迹保真与结构简约间取得平衡的最优机制。
AI.result: 联合分析表明基于轨迹的评估显著高估真实机制恢复程度。相较最强基线，KineSelect将整体OOD外推R²提升19.2%，反应级F1提升14.3%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹精度不能替代机制正确性，需建立机制层面的评估基准；KineSelect通过受约束的拓扑搜索同时改善外推能力与机制恢复质量。

title: Dynamic Forcing: Learning Action-Grounded Sparse Dynamic Representations with Dense Future Guidance for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) support robot control through visual prediction, but dense future modeling repeatedly encodes static context already available in the current observation, while action-relevant changes are often spatially sparse. We study sparse dynamic representation learning, retaining the current observation as a contextual anchor and using a small set of compact dynamic tokens to represent anticipated changes. We develop CompactWAM, a sparse-dense joint predictive framework that enables sparse representation learning within a video-supervised shared backbone, without requiring a reconstruction objective for the sparse pathway. Since a limited token budget alone does not specify which information to retain, we introduce Dynamic Forcing, which pairs direct action supervision with privileged dense future guidance to promote action relevance and dynamic fidelity. While action prediction gradients directly drive compact tokens to capture control-relevant cues, dense future guidance further shapes them via action functional guidance that matches sparse and dense contributions to the action expert, and dynamics-aware distribution matching, which aligns temporal relational changes relative to a static reference. At inference, a single visual forward pass encodes current observations and compact dynamic tokens for action generation, eliminating dense future modeling. CompactWAM achieves 98.4\% success on LIBERO and 77.9\% on LIBERO-Plus, retaining respective success rates of 98.3\% and 76.6\% with only 9.2\% of the dense future token budget. Evaluations on RoboTwin~2.0 and real-world manipulation further demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned sparse predictive representations.

AI.tldr: CompactWAM：以当前观测为静态上下文锚点，用少量紧凑动态token表示未来变化，在视频监督共享骨干中实现稀疏表示学习，并引入Dynamic Forcing提升动作相关性与动态保真度。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）依赖视觉预测支持机器人控制，但密集的未来建模会反复编码当前观测中已有的静态上下文，而真正与动作相关的变化在空间上往往稀疏，造成计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出稀疏-稠密联合预测框架CompactWAM：保留当前观测作为上下文锚点，用一小组紧凑动态token表示预期变化；稀疏通路无需重建目标即在视频监督共享骨干内学习。提出Dynamic Forcing，结合直接动作监督与特权稠密未来引导，并含两项约束：动作功能引导（匹配稀疏与稠密通路对动作专家的贡献）与动态感知分布匹配（以静态参考对齐时间关系变化）。推理时仅一次视觉前向即编码观测与动态token生成动作，无需稠密未来建模。
AI.result: LIBERO上98.4%成功率，LIBERO-Plus上77.9%；仅用9.2%的稠密未来token预算时仍保持98.3%与76.6%。RoboTwin 2.0与真实机器人操作实验进一步验证了所学稀疏预测表示的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏动态表示可在大幅压缩未来建模开销的同时保持甚至接近稠密预测的控制性能，说明WAM中的冗余主要来自静态上下文，聚焦动作相关的稀疏变化是高效且有效的建模范式。

title: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
summary: We consider the problem of constructing knowledge bases for applications based on large language models, in which the structure of a knowledge base determines how an application can retrieve and connect the information needed to answer a question. We study Self-Structuring Learning, a setting in which questions and expected answers guide the construction of a persistent knowledge base whose editable structure can be a graph schema or the organization of linked knowledge documents. We propose Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which diagnoses discrepancies between expected answers and responses obtained through the current knowledge base. At each round, the method proposes a structural edit, rebuilds the knowledge base, and adopts the edit when the learning loss decreases. The retained structure is evaluated on other questions about the same sources. By randomizing over candidate edits, we express the loss change of an edit as a derivative with respect to the probability of selecting it, and we evaluate joint edits as single candidates because their changes interact. Schema Descent instantiates the method for graph schemas. In experiments on large documents, each a bundle of research papers, the updated knowledge cards and graph schemas obtain higher mean Answer F1 on held-out generated questions than their initial structures, with schema gains in every document. On human questions, mean F1 rises for schemas and falls for cards: the updated structures serve the kind of question they were learned from.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自结构化学习"设定与"知识库梯度下降"方法，通过诊断当前知识库回答与期望答案的差异，迭代地提出并测试结构性编辑（如Schema Descent用于图模式），使知识库结构能直接由问答驱动优化。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的应用依赖知识库结构来检索和连接信息，但如何构建合适的结构（图模式或文档组织）通常靠人工设计，缺少由问答效果直接指导结构构建的方法。
AI.method: 提出Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent：诊断期望答案与当前知识库回答的差异；每轮提出一个结构编辑、重建知识库，若学习损失下降则采纳；通过随机化候选编辑，将损失变化表达为对选择概率的导数；联合编辑作为单一候选评估以处理交互。Schema Descent为其针对图模式的具体实例化。
AI.result: 在每份文档为一组研究论文的大规模文档实验中，更新后的知识卡片与图模式在留出生成问题上获得更高平均Answer F1，所有文档的schema均有提升；在人类问题上图模式F1上升而卡片F1下降。
AI.conclusion: 知识库结构可由问答反馈驱动自动学习改进；所学结构更适配其训练来源的问题类型（生成问题或人类问题），说明结构学习与问题分布密切相关。

title: Unstable Action Boundaries in Lethal Drone Agents
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents raise safety risks that are not captured by text-only refusal behavior, especially when tools can trigger high-impact actions. This concern is salient in military settings, where autonomous weapons raise the possibility of delegating force decisions to software agents. In this work, we study whether a drone agent's action boundary is stable under changes to the target descriptor. We evaluate recent and popular LLMs in a simulated perception-action pipeline over real-world drone imagery, where models can localize requested targets and invoke a simulated lethal tool. We find two concerning failure modes. First, some LLM agents invoke the lethal tool for ordinary generic descriptors such as \emph{people}, requiring no jailbreak at all. Second, an agent that initially appears conservative under protected descriptors can become unsafe under a simple semantic target shift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无人机LLM智能体的行动边界在目标描述语变化下是否稳定，发现在真实无人机影像模拟管道中，部分模型对"people"等普通描述即调用致命工具，且初始保守的智能体在语义微调下会变得不安全。
AI.motivation: 工具型LLM智能体可触发高影响动作，其安全风险超出纯文本拒答行为；军事场景中把武力决策交给软件智能体尤为敏感，需检验其行为边界是否稳健。
AI.method: 在基于真实无人机影像的模拟感知-动作管道中评估多个近期主流LLM，模型可定位指定目标并调用模拟致命工具，考察目标描述语变化下的行动边界稳定性。
AI.result: 发现两种令人担忧的失效模式：一是部分智能体对"people"等普通通用描述即调用致命工具，无需越狱；二是初始在受保护描述下表现保守的智能体，经简单语义目标转换后变得不安全。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠文本拒答无法保障工具型智能体安全；行动边界对目标描述高度敏感，需重视智能体层面的动作安全评估与约束。

title: EvoVAU: Tool Evolution for Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) requires reasoning about event progression, interactions, and the contextual conditions that distinguish abnormal behavior from common activity across diverse scenes. Although video agents enable multi-round analysis, the predefined analytical operations may not adequately satisfy these diverse reasoning demands. In this paper, we present EvoVAU, a framework that evolves a reusable tool library for a frozen video solver. Guided by task outcomes and execution trajectories, an external proposer identifies potential limitations in the library and refines it, retaining task experience as analytical operations that can be reused across questions. Specifically, Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback guides tool refinement by combining current errors with paired execution trajectories from historical corrections and regressions. Adoption-Aware Selection accepts a candidate library only when overall development-set accuracy improves and corrections outnumber regressions among questions on which the solver invokes new or modified tools. Using a small development set, EvoVAU alternates tool refinement with candidate evaluation and selection. At test time, the evolved library remains fixed, with no further involvement from the proposer. Experiments on several VAU benchmarks demonstrate strong performance and the flexibility of the evolved library across anomaly domains.

AI.tldr: EvoVAU提出一个为冻结视频求解器进化可复用工具库的框架，通过外部提议者根据任务结果和执行轨迹识别并改进工具库，在多个VAU基准上取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 视频异常理解（VAU）需要推理事件进展、交互和上下文条件以区分异常与常见活动；现有视频智能体的预定义分析操作难以满足多样化的推理需求。
AI.method: 外部提议者依据任务结果与执行轨迹进化工具库；采用跨版本对比反馈（结合当前错误与历史修正/回退的配对执行轨迹）指导改进；采用采纳感知选择（仅当开发集整体精度提升且新/改工具上修正数多于回退数时才接受候选库）；用小型开发集交替进行工具改进与候选评估选择；测试时工具库固定，提议者不再参与。
AI.result: 在多个VAU基准上表现出强劲性能，且进化后的工具库在不同异常领域间具有灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 通过进化可复用工具库，可在不改变冻结视频求解器的前提下提升视频异常理解能力，并具备跨领域的泛化灵活性。

title: MUSE: Multi-Task Uncertainty-Aware Self-Supervised Encoder for mmWave ISAC
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) allows a wireless system to use the same waveform for communication and environment sensing. At mmWave frequency bands, ISAC enables diverse human sensing tasks, such as localization, gesture recognition, and pose estimation, with high precision. However, each task requires training a dedicated model, typically from scratch on a task-specific dataset, with no mechanism to flag unreliable predictions. This hurts the scalability, transferability, and reliability of mmWave ISAC models. In this work, we propose MUSE (Multi-task Uncertainty-aware Self-supervised Encoder), a unified framework for mmWave human sensing. MUSE leverages a self-supervised transformer model with per-dataset tokenization and is trained via masked autoencoding across five datasets. During fine-tuning, MUSE uses evidential classification heads that enable uncertainty quantification. MUSE replaces N separate encoders with a single shared transformer encoder, an N-times backbone parameter reduction, while achieving a 9.7 percentage points improvement in classification performance compared to the task-specific model, showing that learning jointly across tasks improves per-task generalization. Across four classification tasks, MUSE produces reliable uncertainty estimates that enable selective prediction, improving accuracy by abstaining on the least confident 20% of predictions. We further improve the reliability of the model's confidence estimates using temperature scaling and conformal prediction. Finally, MUSE's uncertainty signal remains reliable even under cross-user deployment, assigning higher uncertainty to wrong predictions than to correct ones 78% of the time, and recovering 9.2 percentage points of accuracy through selective prediction, with no additional retraining on the unseen user.

AI.tldr: MUSE是一个统一的多任务不确定性感知自监督编码器框架，用单个共享Transformer实现mmWave ISAC人体感知，替代N个任务专用模型并同时提供可靠的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有mmWave ISAC人体感知任务（定位、手势识别、姿态估计）各自从头训练专用模型，缺乏跨任务可扩展性与迁移性，且无法标识不可靠预测，损害了系统的可靠性与扩展性。
AI.method: 提出MUSE：采用自监督Transformer，按数据集进行tokenization，在五个数据集上通过掩码自编码（MAE）联合训练；微调阶段使用证据式分类头（evidential classification heads）实现不确定性量化；并用温度缩放与保形预测（conformal prediction）进一步校准置信度。
AI.result: 单一共享编码器替代N个专用编码器，骨干参数减少N倍；相比任务专用模型分类性能提升9.7个百分点。在四个分类任务中，通过在置信度最低的20%预测上弃答可提升准确率；跨用户部署无需额外重训练，78%情况下对错误预测给出更高不确定性，选择性预测可恢复9.2个百分点准确率。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务联合学习可提升单任务泛化能力，MUSE在显著压缩参数的同时提供可靠、可校准且跨用户稳健的不确定性信号，为mmWave ISAC人体感知提供统一、可扩展且可信的解决方案。

title: Probabilistic Monocular Biomechanical Reconstruction via Guided Flow Matching
summary: Reconstructing 3D joint kinematics from a single video is ill-posed due to depth and stature ambiguity, limb occlusion, and missing uncertainty estimates. We introduce the Biomechanical Flow Model (BFM), a continuous-time flow-matching prior over subject anthropometry, anatomical joint-angle trajectories, and virtual markers, trained on multi-camera clinical recordings from 565 participants and steered toward monocular 2D keypoints at test time without paired video training. In a head-to-head comparison on the same clinical trials against a state-of-the-art deterministic trajectory optimizer fitting the identical skeleton, BFM achieves comparable joint-angle accuracy across walking and timed-up-and-go (TUG). Across held-out control, prosthetic, and neurologic participants, BFM reaches 3.91 deg and 4.97 deg mean absolute joint-angle error on walking and TUG while providing credible intervals that bridge temporal and whole-limb occlusions. Where keypoints are hidden, the intervals widen with the error and keep their coverage near nominal. Supplying individual anthropometric calibration removes most monocular pelvis depth error, whereas testing on out-of-distribution pediatric crouch gait produces biased, overconfident extension predictions, highlighting the need for pathologically diverse movement priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生物力学流模型（BFM），一种在受试者人体测量学、关节角度轨迹与虚拟标记上的连续时间流匹配先验，用565名参与者的多相机临床数据训练，测试时以单目2D关键点导向，实现带可信区间的3D关节运动学重建。
AI.motivation: 从单视频重建3D关节运动学是病态问题，面临深度与身高歧义、肢体遮挡以及缺乏不确定性估计等困难。
AI.method: 使用连续时间流匹配先验建模人体测量学、解剖学关节角轨迹和虚拟标记；基于565名受试者的多相机临床记录训练，测试时以单目2D关键点引导，无需配对视频训练。
AI.result: 与拟合同一骨架的确定性轨迹优化器对比，在步行与TUG上精度相当；在控制、假肢与神经学受试者上，平均绝对关节角误差分别为3.91°和4.97°；遮挡处区间随误差增大并保持接近名义的覆盖率；个体人体测量校准可基本消除骨盆深度误差；但在儿童蹲伏步态上出现偏差且过度自信。
AI.conclusion: BFM能提供带可信区间的可靠3D关节运动学估计并处理遮挡，但需要更多病理多样性运动先验以泛化到分布外步态。

title: Agent-as-a-Verifier: From Scores to Evidence for General Verification
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Verification is increasingly critical across various inference and learning paradigms, such as test-time scaling, recursive intelligence and automated research, where feedback can improve efficiency and optimization. Common score-based verifiers, or discriminative reward models, predict a scalar reward for an output. While useful for filtering, rewarding, and ranking, such scores provide no explicit, auditable evidentiary basis for the judgment. In parallel, although existing generative process reward models offer text feedback, most designs do not fully exploit agentic capabilities, such as tool use and iterative reasoning, which are essential for fact-checking and fine-grained claim verification. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing Agent-as-a-Verifier, an agentic, certificate-producing verification system that places role-separated LLM agents inside a formal-methods-inspired claim-obligation-certificate protocol. Given a generation candidate, Agent-as-a-Verifier produces a certificate by extracting a verdict-blind dependency graph of claims, independently compiling the task's acceptance contract, and deriving checkable obligations. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, Agent-as-a-Verifier achieves higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art approach. Across different downstream applications, the augmented agent also outperforms the plain agent on FrontierMath and CyberGym. More importantly, Agent-as-a-Verifier is able to identify reward-hacking solutions that deceive the benchmark evaluator, highlighting its broader potential for iterative and recursive agent optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sunyxedu/General-Verifier

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent-as-a-Verifier：分离角色的 LLM 智能体验证系统，通过"声明—义务—证书"协议产出可审计的证据式验证结论，而非单一标量分数。
AI.motivation: 现有 score-based verifier 只输出标量奖励，缺乏可审计的证据基础；现有生成式过程奖励模型虽有文本反馈，但未充分利用工具调用与迭代推理等 agentic 能力，难以支撑事实核查与细粒度声明验证。
AI.method: 将角色分离的多个 LLM agent 置于形式化方法启发的 claim-obligation-certificate 协议中：对待验证生成提取"得分盲"的声明依赖图，独立编译任务的验收契约，并据此推导可检查的验证义务，最终生成证书。
AI.result: Terminal-Bench 2.1 上准确率超越 SOTA；在 FrontierMath 与 CyberGym 上增强后的 agent 优于原始 agent；并能识别欺骗基准评测器的 reward-hacking 解。
AI.conclusion: 证据式、可审计的智能体验证在推理与学习范式中有更广潜力，尤其适用于迭代/递归式 agent 优化与奖励作弊识别。

title: FlipVLA: Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action(VLA) Models Only Through Bit Flips
comment: 14 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

AI.tldr: FlipVLA 通过少量固定比特翻转（无需重训练）在 VLA 模型中植入物体触发后门，利用 FC-GELU-FC 结构中的选择器-放大器机制，在保持干净场景性能的同时实现高达 90%+ 的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型直接驱动真实机器人动作，恶意篡改可能威胁物理安全；需要研究能否用极小的参数比特翻转、免训练地植入物体触发后门，同时不破坏正常输入的性能。
AI.method: 提出两阶段"选择器-放大器"方法：选择器在选定通道构建触发器相关响应，并借 GELU 抑制背景活动；放大器修改下游权重，将该响应转化为与动作相关的扰动；通过通道筛选与离散比特搜索，在有限修改预算下构造两部分。
AI.result: 在 OpenVLA-OFT 与 GR00T N1.7 上、四个 LIBERO 套件中，攻击成功率达 90.22%–100%，干净场景任务成功率最多仅下降 1.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 表明 VLA 模型存在免训练、低预算比特翻转后门的严重安全隐患，且该方法能在高攻击成功率与低性能损失间取得良好平衡，凸显物理安全风险。

title: SOC-Net: Second-Order-Cone-Constrained Neural Networks
summary: In many applications, neural networks must learn input-output maps that respect prior knowledge such as physical laws, safety requirements, and operating limits. These requirements constrain which outputs are admissible for a given input and often admit second-order cone (SOC) representations, including norm bounds and robust linear inequalities. Examples in control include friction cones, thrust bounds, and input-robust control barrier function (CBF) conditions. However, existing approaches to enforcing general input-dependent SOC constraints require a conic solver, an iterative scheme whose feasibility depends on convergence, or an interior feasible point for each input. We propose SOC-Net, a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent SOC constraints by construction for every input, even outside the training distribution. SOC-Net projects an affine lifting of the backbone output onto the reachable slice of a fixed product of Lorentz cones and maps the correction back to the output space. For separable constraints, this projection splits into one projection per cone, and each is available in closed form or reduces to a single scalar equation, regardless of the cone dimension. We prove that SOC-Net retains the expressive power of the backbone network under regularity conditions and accommodates end-to-end training by standard backpropagation with an explicit Jacobian. Experiments on contact force allocation with friction constraints and 3-D obstacle avoidance with an input-robust CBF demonstrate that SOC-Net satisfies the constraints at every evaluated input, with lower evaluation latency than the tested solver-based and iterative baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SOC-Net，一种通过构造方式保证输入依赖二阶锥（SOC）约束的神经网络结构，将主干输出的仿射提升投影到Lorentz锥可达切片上，闭式或单标量方程求解，兼顾表达力与端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 许多应用中神经网络需满足物理定律、安全约束、操作极限等先验知识，这些约束常可表示为二阶锥形式（范数界、鲁棒线性不等式，如摩擦锥、推力界、输入鲁棒CBF条件）。现有方法需调用锥求解器、依赖收敛的迭代方案，或要求每个输入都有内点可行解。
AI.method: SOC-Net将主干网络的仿射提升投影到固定Lorentz锥乘积的可达切片上，再将修正映射回输出空间；对可分离约束，投影分解为每个锥一次投影，无论锥维度均可用闭式或化简为单个标量方程；给出显式雅可比以支持标准反向传播端到端训练。
AI.result: 证明在正则条件下SOC-Net保持主干网络的表达力；在带摩擦约束的接触力分配和基于输入鲁棒CBF的三维避障实验中，SOC-Net在所有评估输入上均满足约束，且评估延迟低于所测试的求解器类和迭代基线。
AI.conclusion: SOC-Net提供了一种构造性、高效且理论可保证的输入依赖SOC约束满足方案，适用于安全关键控制任务。

title: MMotion: Collaborative Cross-Scale Memory for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motions from natural-language descriptions, enabling applications in animation, virtual avatars, and embodied agents. Despite recent progress, existing methods either retrieve motion exemplars or retain long-range context, but rarely exploit memory to jointly reason about semantics, dynamics, and generation history. In this paper, we propose MMotion, a collaborative multi-scale memory framework that unifies scale-conditioned semantic retrieval, latent dynamics modeling, and causal working memory. Specifically, semantic memory provides motion priors at different generation scales, dynamics memory captures latent state transitions, and working memory preserves causal context from previously generated motions. A collaborative fusion mechanism integrates these complementary memories to determine what motion to generate, how it should evolve, and how it should remain consistent with its history. MMotion is architecture-agnostic and can be readily integrated into both diffusion-based and next scale autoregressive models. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 MMotion 多尺度协同记忆框架，用于文本到动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法要么检索动作样例，要么保留长程上下文，很少利用记忆机制联合推理语义、动力学与生成历史。
AI.method: MMotion 框架包含三类记忆并协同融合：语义记忆在不同生成尺度提供动作先验；动力学记忆捕捉潜状态转移；工作记忆保存已生成动作的因果上下文；再经协同融合机制决定生成何种动作、如何演化、如何与历史保持一致。该框架与具体架构无关，可接入扩散模型与下一尺度自回归模型。
AI.result: 在标准基准与多种骨干网络上，相较强基线均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 统一多尺度记忆有利于文本到动作生成的语义、动力学与时间一致性，且具备良好的架构通用性。

title: When High Capacity Becomes Undeployable: Pore-Filling Constraints for Multi-Objective Optimization of Direct Air Capture Sorbents
summary: Amine-impregnated sorbents with the highest nominal CO2 capacity are frequently the least deployable, as amine beyond the pore-volume limit blocks active sites. Yet multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) for direct air capture (DAC) treats formulation search as unconstrained. We encode the pore-filling boundary as an explicit outcome constraint, c(x) = tanh(1 - phi_hat) - tau, and use it as a diagnostic instrument on a hand-curated, DOI-traceable benchmark of 618 solid-amine formulations from 43 publications. Unconstrained MOBO attains higher nominal capacity (3.639 +/- 0.815 vs. 2.964 +/- 0.728 mmol/g, p = 1.0e-11), but across 100 seeds 63.2% of its Pareto-optimal candidates violate the pore-filling boundary versus 39.3% under the constraint: it is rewarded for proposing candidates outside the pore-confined design regime. The constraint steers the front to lower loadings (55.8 vs. 65.2 wt%) and larger pores. The boundary is corroborated once apparatus effects are harmonized hierarchically: 77.8% of kinetic variance is between-laboratory, and pore filling carries a significant kinetic penalty (p = 0.002). Standard hypervolume over-credits feasibility-agnostic methods by 13.9-16.1% (vs. 11.1% constrained), and three surrogate-based analyses---the constrained front, a regeneration-energy third objective, and harmonized kinetics---consistently point to a conservative deployable window at pore filling phi_hat ~ 0.4-0.5 (45-55 wt% loading). The benchmark and associated analysis outputs accompany this submission.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"孔填充边界"作为显式约束引入DAC固体胺配方的多目标贝叶斯优化，在618个可溯源配方基准上证明无约束MOBO会奖励不可部署的高负载候选，并给出保守可部署窗口（phi_hat≈0.4–0.5，45–55 wt%）。
AI.motivation: 标称CO2容量最高的胺浸渍吸附剂往往最难部署——超出孔体积上限的胺会堵塞活性位点；然而面向直接空气捕集（DAC）的MOBO将配方搜索当作无约束问题，导致优化偏向孔外设计区间。
AI.method: 构建包含43篇文献、618个固体胺配方的DOI可溯源基准；将孔填充边界编码为显式结果约束 c(x)=tanh(1−phi_hat)−τ；对比约束/无约束MOBO（100个随机种子）；用分层模型统一装置效应以校验边界，并评估超体积指标偏差。
AI.result: 无约束MOBO标称容量更高（3.639±0.815 vs 2.964±0.728 mmol/g，p=1.0e-11），但其Pareto候选63.2%违反孔填充边界，约束下为39.3%；约束使前沿转向更低负载（55.8 vs 65.2 wt%）与更大孔道。动力学方差77.8%来自实验室间差异，孔填充有显著动力学代价（p=0.002）。标准超体积高估无约束方法13.9–16.1%（约束法11.1%）。三项代理分析一致指向phi_hat≈0.4–0.5的可部署窗口。
AI.conclusion: 将物理可行性作为显式约束对DAC材料发现至关重要；无约束MOBO与标准超体积会系统性奖励不可部署候选。研究给出保守可部署设计窗口，并随文发布基准与分析输出。

title: Revisiting Monocular In-Hand Object Scanning: Dataset, Pose Estimation, and Surface Reconstruction
summary: In-Hand Object Scanning (IHOS) from monocular video captured by a commodity smartphone holds immense potential to democratize 3D digitization for non-expert users, facilitating applications in digital archiving, augmented reality, and custom fabrication. Yet, IHOS remains largely understudied due to a lack of realistic datasets and systematic benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we introduce ToysRUs, a high-quality dataset featuring diverse figurines captured by 4K Ultra High-Definition (UHD) monocular videos. Studying IHOS from first principles, we examine structure-from-motion (SfM) for camera pose estimation, which is key to IHOS. We identify two key challenges: small baselines between consecutive frames, and sparse feature matches across large-view, long-range frames, further exacerbated by dynamic hand occlusions. Guided by these insights, we propose performing SfM on video sub-sequences sampled at sufficient angular intervals, and iteratively stitches the corresponding sub-trajectories into a unified global trajectory. Furthermore, for high-fidelity surface reconstruction, we introduce occlusion-aware 2D Gaussian Splatting, which incorporates opacity rendering and omits the opacity loss on hand regions. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing approaches, including neural implicit representations and 3D foundation models, in both geometric accuracy and photometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToysRUs数据集以及一套从单目手机视频进行手持物体扫描（IHOS）的流程：按角度间隔采样子序列做SfM再迭代拼接全局轨迹，并用遮挡感知的2D高斯泼溅完成高保真重建。
AI.motivation: IHOS（手持物体扫描）能让非专家用户用普通手机实现3D数字化，应用于数字存档、AR和定制制造，但因缺乏真实数据集和系统基准而研究不足；同时SfM相机位姿估计面临帧间基线小、大视角远距帧特征匹配稀疏、动态手部遮挡等问题。
AI.method: 1）构建ToysRUs数据集，包含用4K UHD单目视频拍摄的多样小雕像；2）从第一性原理分析SfM，提出在足够角度间隔采样的视频子序列上分别做SfM，并将子轨迹迭代拼接为统一全局轨迹；3）提出遮挡感知2D高斯泼溅，引入不透明度渲染并在手部区域省略不透明度损失以实现高保真表面重建。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明，该框架在几何精度和光度保真度上均显著优于现有方法，包括神经隐式表示和3D基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过新数据集、面向IHOS的SfM子轨迹拼接策略和遮挡感知2DGS，建立了单目手持物体扫描的系统性基准并取得领先性能。

title: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD). 5 pages main text, 28 pages total
summary: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.

AI.tldr: 论文用闭式精度界解释了CTSE反卷积比比例估计更难的原因，并提出可计算的可学性分数来指导靶向反卷积；在NSCLC生存分析中，CTSE特征的预后价值与估计难度无关，稀疏生存模型可达到与bulk基因模型相当的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有反卷积方法多预测细胞类型比例，较少预测细胞类型特异表达（CTSE），而后者能捕捉比例遗漏的细胞状态，但基准显示其难度大得多。作者希望从理论上解释这一差距，并探究估计难度是否决定临床应用价值。
AI.method: 针对CTSE推导逐基因线性估计器的R²上界；针对比例，推导跨基因汇总的最佳线性估计器的闭式R²及其可计算下界，用于预测哪些细胞类型可学。据此对106个经生物学筛选的(细胞类型,基因)对进行靶向反卷积，并在非小细胞肺癌总体生存数据上用稀疏生存模型评估。
AI.result: CTSE的R²存在较低上限，解释其难度；比例估计因跨基因汇总更易学。在NSCLC生存中，估计难度并不预测预后价值；基于反卷积特征（多为CTSE）的稀疏生存模型与直接基于bulk基因的稀疏模型预测性能相当，且能将信号归因到特定细胞类型；部分CTSE特征显示出对应bulk基因未体现的预后信号。
AI.conclusion: 可学性与临床价值是不同维度，难以估计的CTSE仍可能具有独特预后价值。靶向反卷积结合可学性分析为细胞类型层面的临床解读提供了可行路径。

title: MotionODE: Enhancing Autoregressive Text-to-Motion Generation with Continuous-Depth Modeling
summary: Autoregressive text-to-motion generation requires local motion predictions to reconcile cross-temporal textual requirements with the available motion context. While existing methods primarily improve motion representations and generation order, the internal formation of conditioned motion representations remains less explored. We introduce MotionODE, a continuous-depth post-training framework that refines hidden-state evolution in pretrained autoregressive generators. MotionODE reinterprets selected Transformer residual branches as local vector fields and replaces their original updates with midpoint Runge--Kutta (RK2) integration, while preserving the motion representation and outer generation mechanism. To address the mismatch between pretrained update paths and newly introduced intermediate states, we propose mixed one-step/two-step RK2 post-training under motion-token supervision, with optional distillation and update-map constraints to preserve pretrained behavior. This minimally invasive framework supports both next-token and next-scale generation without training the generator from scratch. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D demonstrate consistent improvements in text--motion alignment across MoScale, BAMM and LMR, highlighting internal representation updates as a complementary direction for improving autoregressive motion generation.

AI.tldr: MotionODE 是一个连续深度的后训练框架，将预训练自回归文本驱动动作生成器中部分 Transformer 残差分支重新解释为局部向量场，并用中点 Runge–Kutta（RK2）积分替换原有更新，从而在不改变运动表示和外部生成机制的情况下改进文本-动作对齐。
AI.motivation: 自回归文本生成动作需要局部运动预测同时协调跨时间的文本约束与已有动作上下文。现有方法主要改进运动表示和生成顺序，却较少探讨条件动作表示的内部形成过程。
AI.method: 把选定的 Transformer 残差分支视为局部向量场，以 RK2 中点积分替代原更新；针对预训练更新路径与新引入中间状态的不匹配，提出混合一步/两步 RK2 后训练，采用运动 token 监督，并可选加入蒸馏与更新映射约束以保留预训练行为；框架微创，支持 next-token 与 next-scale 生成，无需从头训练。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D 上，于 MoScale、BAMM 和 LMR 上均取得一致的文本-动作对齐改进。
AI.conclusion: 内部表示更新是提升自回归动作生成的一个互补方向；MotionODE 以轻量后训练方式验证了其有效性。

title: Text-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models for Multimodal Forecasting
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS 2026)
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide transferable numerical forecasting priors. However, forecast-relevant information may be conveyed in text without being reflected in the observed series. Many multimodal forecasting methods integrate such context through model inputs or intermediate representations. We investigate a complementary mechanism: text-conditioned parameter adaptation. We propose Context-to-LoRA for Time Series (C2LoRA-TS), which encodes text and generates temporary Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) updates for selected weight matrices of a frozen TSFM. Both the numerical backbone and text encoder remain frozen, and the method exactly recovers the frozen TSFM output when context is absent. Evaluated on Time-MMD across nine domains and three TSFM architectures, C2LoRA-TS achieves lower aggregate forecasting error than the frozen-TSFM and Static LoRA baselines for every architecture and seed. Replacing the instance-specific text with a single globally fixed context degrades performance for every architecture. These results support text-conditioned parameter generation as a viable strategy for multimodal forecasting with frozen TSFMs.

AI.tldr: 提出C2LoRA-TS：用文本编码器生成临时LoRA参数，动态更新冻结时序基础模型的部分权重，实现文本条件化的多模态预测。
AI.motivation: 预测相关信息可能存在于文本中而不体现在观测序列里；现有多模态方法多在输入或中间表示层融合上下文，作者想探索一种互补机制——通过参数自适应注入文本信息。
AI.method: 冻结数值骨干和文本编码器，用文本编码器输出生成针对选定权重矩阵的临时LoRA更新；无上下文时可精确恢复原TSFM输出。
AI.result: 在Time-MMD的9个领域、3种TSFM架构上，C2LoRA-TS的总体预测误差在每个架构和随机种子下均低于冻结TSFM与Static LoRA基线；将实例文本替换为单一全局固定上下文后，所有架构性能均下降。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件化参数生成是冻结TSFM多模态预测的可行策略，且实例级文本信息具有实际增益。

title: 3D CoCa v3: Contrastive Learners with Scene Graphs for Urban Scene Understanding
summary: Understanding large-scale 3D urban scenes requires representations that capture both multi-scale geometric structures and complex spatial relationships. However, existing 3D vision-language methods primarily emphasize global semantic alignment or object-level representations, leaving structured relational modeling underexplored within unified contrastive and generative frameworks. In this paper, we present 3D CoCa v3, a scene-graph-enhanced contrastive and generative framework for urban 3D scene understanding. Our framework features a Pyramid Vision Encoder for multi-scale geometric representation learning and a language-model-based decoder with question-guided caption retrieval and visual cross-attention. We further introduce MSG-based relational descriptions to enrich contrastive 3D-language alignment with structured spatial relationships. To support semantic and relational supervision, we construct City3D-9.6K, a multi-view urban vision-language dataset with aligned visual-geometric observations, scene captions, and scene graphs. Extensive experiments on City-3DQA demonstrate that 3D CoCa v3 achieves 88.35% and 64.79% overall top-1 accuracy on the sentence-wise and city-wise splits, surpassing 3D CoCa v2 by 20.88 and 3.57 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, 3D CoCa v3 achieves the best performance on GeoEval3D, demonstrating its effectiveness in urban spatial reasoning and geometric understanding. Code is available at https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/3DCoCav3.

AI.tldr: 提出场景图增强的对比+生成统一框架 3D CoCa v3，用于城市3D场景理解，并构建多视角城市视觉-语言数据集 City3D-9.6K，在 City-3DQA 与 GeoEval3D 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D城市场景理解需要同时建模多尺度几何结构与复杂空间关系，但现有3D视觉-语言方法侧重全局语义对齐或物体级表示，统一的对比与生成框架中缺乏结构化关系建模。
AI.method: 1) 金字塔视觉编码器进行多尺度几何表示学习；2) 基于语言模型的解码器，含问题引导的caption检索与视觉交叉注意力；3) 引入基于最小生成树(MSG)的关系描述，以结构化空间关系增强对比式3D-语言对齐；4) 构建 City3D-9.6K 数据集（对齐的视觉-几何观测、场景描述、场景图）提供语义与关系监督。
AI.result: 在 City-3DQA 上总体 top-1 准确率分别为 88.35%（sentence-wise）与 64.79%（city-wise），较 3D CoCa v2 提升 20.88 与 3.57 个百分点；在 GeoEval3D 上取得最佳表现，体现城市空间推理与几何理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 将场景图/关系结构化建模融入对比-生成统一框架，可显著提升城市3D场景的语义对齐与空间推理能力，配套数据集为语义与关系监督提供支撑。

title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
summary: This paper studies policy learning for cooperative task allocation in open multi-agent systems, where submodular utilities model diminishing marginal returns due to overlapping agent contributions. While standard methods evaluate every candidate action to update the policy, this may incur an excessive computational cost online. Hence, we impose a budget on these evaluations and analytically study the effect of query budget on online learning. Our algorithm samples a prescribed number of agent-action pairs and applies inverse-probability weighting to their marginal gains, yielding an unbiased gradient estimate of the expected stage utility for a Kullback-Leibler (KL) mirror-ascent update. We derive a $1/2$-approximate regret bound that elegantly splits into a tracking error between optimal and learned policies, quantified by their KL divergence, and a query-dependent feedback term. Experiments on cooperative information coverage show that our approach retains high performance with significantly less computation online.

AI.tldr: 研究开放多智能体系统中基于次模效用的合作任务分配策略学习，通过对候选动作评估施加查询预算，提出逆概率加权的无偏梯度估计与KL镜像上升更新算法，大幅降低在线计算量。
AI.motivation: 标准策略学习方法需对每个候选动作逐一评估以更新策略，在开放多智能体系统的次模效用（重叠贡献导致边际收益递减）场景中在线计算开销过大，因此需要引入评估查询预算并分析其对在线学习的影响。
AI.method: 对预设数量的智能体-动作对采样，对其边际增益施加逆概率加权（inverse-probability weighting），得到期望阶段效用梯度的无偏估计，用于Kullback-Leibler镜像上升（KL mirror-ascent）策略更新。
AI.result: 推导出1/2近似遗憾界，该界可清晰分解为最优策略与学习策略间的跟踪误差（由KL散度刻画）与依赖查询预算的反馈项；在合作信息覆盖实验中以显著更少的在线计算保持高性能。
AI.conclusion: 查询预算受限下的采样加权策略学习在理论上可保证1/2近似遗憾，在实践上能以更低在线开销维持竞争性表现。

title: The Missing Root: Geometric Imagination Without Images in Large Language Models
summary: This paper proposes a new paradigm and method for giving large language models spatial understanding. Standard language models operate exclusively over discrete words (secondary representations of things rather than continuous space itself), forcing them to guess geometry verbally. Whereas most multimodal approaches equate spatial grounding with camera images or video frames, spatial structure itself is not a picture: it consists of coordinate frames, solid boundaries, and how objects move and relate to each other in continuous space. Motivated by this distinction, we place continuous object tokens combining pose (position, orientation, and scale) and signed-distance shape embeddings alongside word tokens inside a single uninterrupted transformer sequence, allowing language and geometry to attend to each other as object scenes are built and updated step by step. Control tokens switch output automatically between natural-language words and continuous object state updates to a persistent object workspace, while an attention mask blocks earlier prose when generating the answer, so responses must be read directly from settled geometry. To prove this method works, we attach a narrow parallel spatial stream (+4.4% weights) alongside unfrozen Qwen3-1.7B layers. In our two-dimensional tests, the model spawns and transforms multi-object scenes from English descriptions, transfers shapes to held-out nouns, and relies causally on the workspace to answer spatial questions.

AI.tldr: 提出将连续物体token（位姿+符号距离形状嵌入）与词token置于同一transformer序列的新范式，用控制token切换语言/几何输出，并加注意力掩码强制从几何工作区作答；在Qwen3-1.7B旁挂+4.4%参数实现2D空间理解。
AI.motivation: 语言模型只在离散词上运算，无法直接表示连续空间，只能"用语言猜几何"；而多数多模态方法把空间grounding等同于图像/视频帧，但空间结构本身不是图片，而是坐标系、实心边界及物体间的连续位置关系。
AI.method: 构建连续物体token，融合pose（位置、朝向、尺度）与signed-distance形状嵌入，与词token混排于单一不间断transformer序列，使语言与几何互相attend；控制token自动切换输出为自然语言或对持久物体工作区的连续状态更新；生成答案时用注意力掩码屏蔽先前散文，迫使回答直接读取已确定的几何。
AI.result: 在冻结的Qwen3-1.7B层旁附加窄并行空间流（仅+4.4%权重），2D测试中模型能依英文描述生成并变换多物体场景、将形状迁移到未见过名词、并因果性地依赖工作区回答空间问题。
AI.conclusion: 将连续几何token直接嵌入语言模型序列可赋予其空间理解能力，且以极低额外参数代价实现，为空间grounding提供了不同于图像模态的新路径。

title: Change Point Detection with Generative Models
summary: Change point detection (CPD) methods aim to identify abrupt changes in the properties of time series, which is a key problem in numerous fields. A major class of CPD approaches relies on computing a CPD score, which is either a discrepancy or divergence between two subsequent samples, called windows. A fundamental limitation of window-based CPD is the 'sample size bottleneck.' To ensure temporal precision, windows must be small; however, small samples provide insufficient statistical evidence for the classifiers and deep-learning models currently used to compute CPD scores. This leads to high variance in the scores and frequent mispredictions. Our study tackles this issue by exploring generative models for window augmentation, effectively expanding available data to improve CPD quality. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly enhances CPD. Specifically, we show that this approach allows simple classifiers to outperform complex deep-learning baselines by stabilizing the CPD score distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于窗口的变点检测（CPD）中"样本量瓶颈"问题，提出用生成模型对窗口进行数据增强，使简单分类器也能稳定检测分数分布并优于复杂深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 基于窗口的CPD依靠计算相邻两个窗口之间的差异/散度得分来判别变点。为保证时间精度，窗口必须很小，但小样本无法为分类器和深度学习模型提供足够的统计证据，导致得分方差大、误判频繁，这构成"样本量瓶颈"这一根本性局限。
AI.method: 探索使用生成模型对窗口进行增强（window augmentation），通过生成额外样本有效扩充可用数据，以提升CPD得分计算的统计可靠性。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了CPD性能：通过稳定CPD得分分布，使简单分类器的表现超过复杂的深度学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 生成式窗口增强是缓解小窗口样本不足问题的有效手段，能够以更低模型复杂度获得更优的变点检测效果。

title: SPiXSeg: Rethinking MLLM-based Image Segmentation as Superpixel Classification
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for image segmentation. However, existing methods either use a decoder or use patch-based approach which trades boundary precision against the number of decisions as coarse grid cells mix foreground and background pixels, while finer grids require many more predictions, and autoregressive mask generation adds sequential decoding overhead. We propose SPiXSeg, which shifts the output from per-patch to per-superpixel label assignment, using superpixel tokens formed by aggregating patch-level visual features. An off-the-shelf model partitions each image into task-agnostic superpixels, so the partition is computed once and reused across tasks. A Spix-to-Mask (S2M) module scores each superpixel token in a single MLLM forward pass by directly comparing the MLLM's hidden representations, without autoregressive generation or a separate scoring network, and the selected superpixels are mapped directly to pixels without refinement. Without any trainable decoder head or post-hoc refinement, SPiXSeg achieves an average cIoU of 80.5 with LLaVA-1.5-7B and 81.9 with InternVL2.5-8B on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg and, when trained only on COCO-Stuff, extends to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with mIoU of 29.0, 59.5 and 95.4 on ADE20K, PASCAL Context and PASCAL VOC, outperforming several SoTA MLLM baselines. Our results suggest that a fixed, query-agnostic superpixel partition is enough for accurate language-guided segmentation.

AI.tldr: SPiXSeg将MLLM分割输出从逐patch改为逐超像素标签分配，用固定超像素划分配合S2M模块单次前向打分，无需解码器或后处理即取得SOTA级分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM图像分割方法存在两难：解码器方法需额外网络；patch方法在边界精度与决策数量间取舍（粗网格混合前景背景、细网格预测过多），且自回归掩码生成带来顺序解码开销。
AI.method: 用现成模型将图像划分为任务无关超像素（一次计算、跨任务复用），聚合patch级视觉特征形成超像素token；Spix-to-Mask（S2M）模块在单次MLLM前向中通过直接比较隐藏表示对每个超像素token打分，无自回归生成、无独立打分网络，选中超像素直接映射到像素、无细化。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg上平均cIoU达80.5（LLaVA-1.5-7B）与81.9（InternVL2.5-8B）；仅在COCO-Stuff训练即可扩展到开放词汇语义分割，ADE20K/PASCAL Context/PASCAL VOC上mIoU为29.0、59.5、95.4，优于多个SOTA MLLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 固定的、查询无关的超像素划分足以实现准确的语言引导分割，无需可训练解码头或后处理细化。

title: Train-Only-Constrained LM for Synthetic Clinical Trajectories: Leak-Safe Calibration and Auditable Dynamics
comment: Preprint (pre-review version, 6 pages, 2 figures). Accepted at SECURE AI4H@AAAI 2026, Singapore. Extended version to appear in Springer CCIS vol. 3004 (2027): https://link.springer.com/book/9789819239238
summary: Simulating clinical time series necessitates temporal realism, calibration that preserves model integrity, and privacy transparency. We present a train-only, constrained language-model pipeline that factorizes generation. A compact GPT-style language model learns cross-biomarker co-occurrence through quantile tokens, and temporal directions are enforced by 3x3 per-biomarker Markov transitions fit on TRAIN, allowing dynamics to be audited. We fit a monotone quantile map (QMap) on TRAIN only (SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)); no TEST statistics are used. The fixed map is then applied to SYN(TEST) severities. The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction. A classifier-based membership-inference audit results in an AUC of approximately 0.5; we make no differential-privacy claim. We present multi-seed results with paired 95% confidence intervals and quantify the severity of QMap's alignment (Delta W1 with confidence interval). This is a Stage-1 method result obtained on a controlled simulator; Stage-2 validation on real EHR cohorts with clinical endpoints is planned.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用训练集的约束语言模型流水线，分解放大式生成临床时间序列，兼顾时间真实性、校准与隐私透明性。
AI.motivation: 临床时间序列合成需要同时满足三方面要求：时间动态的真实性、不破坏模型完整性的校准、以及隐私透明度。现有方法难以兼顾，且常需使用测试集统计量，缺乏可审计性。
AI.method: 仅用TRAIN的约束LM流水线：小型GPT式语言模型通过分位数token学习跨生物标志物共现；时间方向由在TRAIN上拟合的3×3逐标志物马尔可夫转移强制约束，动力学可审计。仅在TRAIN上拟合单调分位数映射QMap（SYN(TRAIN)→SIM(TRAIN)），不使用任何TEST统计量，再将固定映射应用于SYN(TEST)的严重度。
AI.result: 在5000名患者的模拟测试床（参数处于已发表临床范围）中，相比经验采样器，分布保真度与共现性更优；小λ扫描后检测性接近随机水平；时间依从性由构造保证；成员推断审计AUC约0.5。给出多种子结果、配对95%置信区间及QMap对齐强度（ΔW1及置信区间）。
AI.conclusion: 这是受控模拟器上的Stage-1方法结果，未作差分隐私声明；计划在真实EHR队列与临床终点上进行Stage-2验证。

title: Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation
summary: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出连续基础模型引导的伪标签加权UDA方法，用于乳腺超声分割跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声分割模型在跨设备、跨机构、跨人群时泛化差，需研究无监督域适应（UDA）中的伪标签加权策略。
AI.method: EMA教师生成目标域伪标签，冻结的超声分割基础模型AutoSAMUS以有界权重（0.5–1）调制其贡献，权重融合先验确定性与与教师的一致性；相较此前的选择性BiRP规则，改为对所有目标像素加权监督，且测试时无需基础模型推理。
AI.result: 五个公开乳腺超声数据集、三个源域、11个源-目标方向。TransUNet协议下连续加权在4个BUSI源目标上均优于全像素EMA与原始BiRP；在4个BUS-BRA源目标上平均Dice最高、HD95最低。BrEaST源结果不一：BUSI最佳、OASBUD与原BiRP相当，BUS-UCLM上无方法超过仅源域训练。U-Net管线中仅一致性加权与完整公式相当。
AI.conclusion: 连续加权在多设定下有增益但不普适，先验确定性的增量价值未证实；因加权规则在部分目标测试结果查看后制定，作者将其视为探索性研究并同时报告不利结果。

title: LLM-coupled interpretable tool wear monitoring with multi-evidence reasoning in CNC machining
summary: Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing diagnostic models have high accuracy but provide limited guidance for tool replacement. This study proposes a two layer framework combining deep learning wear classification and LLM assisted reasoning. The first layer uses PCA Loading feature selection and optimized GRU to recognize three wear states, achieving 98.38 percent macro F1 score on the PHM2010 dataset. The second layer uses LLMs to generate natural language reports and replacement suggestions from classification results and feature trends. Engineer evaluation shows the reports outperform rule templates. Cross dataset tests on NASA milling data support the generalizability of this framework.

AI.tldr: 提出两层框架：第一层用PCA Loading特征选择+优化GRU识别三种磨损状态（PHM2010上macro F1=98.38%），第二层用LLM根据分类结果与特征趋势生成自然语言报告与换刀建议，工程师评价优于规则模板，NASA铣削数据交叉验证支持泛化性。
AI.motivation: CNC加工中刀具磨损的可解释评估具有挑战性；现有诊断模型准确率高，但对刀具更换决策的指导有限。
AI.method: 两层框架：①深度学习磨损分类层——PCA Loading特征选择 + 优化的GRU，识别三种磨损状态；②LLM辅助推理层——由分类结果和特征趋势生成自然语言报告与刀具更换建议。
AI.result: PHM2010数据集上macro F1达98.38%；工程师评估显示生成报告优于规则模板；NASA铣削数据跨数据集测试支持框架的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将高精度深度学习分类与LLM可解释推理结合，可在保持高识别精度的同时提升刀具更换决策的可解释性与可操作性，并具备一定跨数据集泛化性。

title: Hybrid Reinforcement Learning for One-step Degraded Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) is essential for robust perception, yet existing methods remain limited under complex degradations. While diffusion models (DMs) offer powerful modeling capabilities to combat such degradations, their iterative process incurs high computational cost. One-step distillation effectively accelerates inference but typically leads to over-smoothed results. To resolve these limitations, we propose a one-step fusion framework with hybrid reinforcement learning, termed OneHRL. We treat degraded inputs as intermediate noisy states along a generative trajectory, enabling a distilled one-step generator to rectify them directly to the clean fusion results. Concurrently, to mitigate the over-smoothed results in distillation, we incorporate the Flow-GRPO paradigm to introduce stochasticity into the deterministic one-step generation. This restores the stochastic exploration necessary for sampling-based reinforcement learning. Furthermore, we design a coarse-to-fine reward that integrates a global semantic reward with an object-level reward. This hybrid reward ensures that the generator captures both naturalness and fine-grained texture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior fusion quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一步式融合框架 OneHRL，将退化输入视作生成轨迹中的中间噪声状态直接用一步蒸馏生成器修复，并结合 Flow-GRPO 引入随机性与由粗到细的混合奖励，兼顾融合质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 红外与可见光图像融合在复杂退化下表现受限；扩散模型虽建模能力强但迭代推理计算代价高，而现有一步蒸馏方法虽加速推理却易产生过度平滑的结果。
AI.method: 将退化输入视为生成轨迹的中间含噪状态，使蒸馏后的一步生成器直接将其校正为干净融合结果；引入 Flow-GRPO 范式为确定性一步生成注入随机性，恢复基于采样的强化学习所需的随机探索；设计由全局语义奖励与目标级奖励组成的由粗到细混合奖励。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在融合质量与效率上均取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: OneHRL 通过一步生成 + 强化学习随机探索 + 混合奖励，在保持高效推理的同时提升了退化场景下的红外可见光融合质量。

title: LatentCP-DPO: Conformal Pessimism for DPO with Finite-Sample Guarantees
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) learns a response policy from human preference data, but with a limited dataset it can overfit to noisy or weakly informative preference labels. We introduce LatentCP-DPO, a framework that combines conformal prediction with pessimistic preference optimization for Bradley-Terry (BT) pairwise feedback and Plackett-Luce (PL) ranking feedback. Building on LatentCP's construction of uncertainty sets for unobserved model parameters, we address how to incorporate this uncertainty into preference optimization and characterize its effect on policy performance. Under exchangeability and a correctly specified preference model, we construct uncertainty sets for latent relative rewards with finite-sample marginal coverage from conformal prediction sets for observable preferences. We then learn a response policy by maximizing the worst-case expected preference log-likelihood over these uncertainty sets, using an independent collection of prompts and candidate responses without preference labels. Under suitable assumptions, we establish finite-sample upper bounds on regularized policy suboptimality that separate policy-class approximation error, conformal uncertainty, and statistical estimation error. For BT feedback, we further establish a worst-case lower bound for LatentCP-DPO that matches the upper bound's reciprocal dependence on the number of unlabeled optimization examples. The lower bound also shows that the uncertainty sets can induce a bias that persists as the optimization sample grows. Together, these results characterize both the statistical accuracy and potential limitations of preference optimization using conformal uncertainty sets. Experiments support the benefits of the proposed framework in finite preference datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentCP-DPO，将共形预测构造的不确定性集合与悲观（最坏情况）偏好优化结合，用于 BT 成对反馈与 PL 排序反馈，并给出有限样本的上下界理论刻画。
AI.motivation: DPO 在偏好数据有限时容易过拟合噪声或弱信息的偏好标签；需要一种能显式刻画并利用不确定性、提升小样本下鲁棒性的偏好优化方法。
AI.method: 借助 LatentCP 对未观测模型参数构造不确定性集合：在可交换性与偏好模型正确设定下，由可观测偏好的共形预测集构造潜在相对奖励的有限样本边际覆盖不确定性集合；再用独立无偏好标签的提示与候选回答，在此集合上最大化最坏情况期望偏好对数似然（悲观优化）。覆盖 BT 与 Plackett-Luce 两类反馈。
AI.result: 在给定假设下建立了正则化策略次优性的有限样本上界，可分解为策略类近似误差、共形不确定性与统计估计误差三部分；对 BT 反馈还给出匹配的下界，显示对无标签优化样本数的倒数依赖，并表明不确定性集合会引入随优化样本增长而持续存在的偏差。实验验证了有限偏好数据下的收益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从理论上刻画了基于共形不确定性集合的偏好优化的统计精度与潜在局限（持续偏差），并经验性支持其在小样本偏好数据上的优势。

title: Structured Noise Diffusion for Echocardiography Haze Removal
summary: Echocardiographic images are frequently degraded by spatially structured haze artifacts that obscure anatomical boundaries and hinder clinical analysis. Conventional diffusion models typically employ pixel-independent Gaussian noise, limiting their ability to represent localized ultrasound haze. In this study, we propose a structure-informed diffusion framework that explicitly models ultrasound haze as an accumulation of localized Gaussian components constrained by the ultrasound fan geometry. The forward process generates spatially correlated corruption by sampling component locations and scales, providing a formulation that better reflects the spatial characteristics of real echo artifacts. During reverse restoration, a dual-head network predicts an anchor probability map and Gaussian scale parameters to progressively remove structured artifacts while reducing the center bias associated with direct coordinate regression. We evaluated the framework on the public DehazingEcho2025 benchmark and two private clinical datasets, without retraining or fine-tuning on either private cohort. Our method achieved the highest mean generalized contrast-to-noise ratio across all three datasets, reaching $0.715 \pm 0.090$ on the public benchmark while preserving tissue edges.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知扩散框架，将以超声扇形几何约束的局部高斯成分叠加来显式建模超声雾状伪影，替代像素独立高斯噪声，实现更好的去雾与边界保留。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图存在空间结构化雾状伪影，遮挡解剖边界；常规扩散模型使用像素独立高斯噪声，难以刻画局部化、空间相关的超声雾状退化。
AI.method: 在正向前向过程中采样局部高斯成分的位置与尺度，并按超声扇形几何约束，生成空间相关的结构化退化；逆向恢复时采用双头网络，分别预测锚点概率图与高斯尺度参数，逐步去除结构化伪影，并用概率图替代直接坐标回归以缓解中心偏置。
AI.result: 在公开 DehazingEcho2025 基准及两个私有临床数据集上评估（私有数据不重训不微调），三数据集平均gCNR均最高，公开基准达 0.715±0.090，且能保留组织边缘。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、几何约束的扩散建模优于像素独立噪声范式，具备良好跨数据集泛化与边缘保持能力。

title: Scaling Looped MoE Language Models under Matched Budgets: Information Flow and Parameter Allocation
summary: Looped Transformers decouple computational depth from parameter count, and prior studies have demonstrated promising performance gains with increased computation. However, systematic design principles for configuring these models under strict iso-parameter and iso-FLOP constraints remain scarce. We contribute to this direction by improving information flow in looped models and systematically studying loop parameter configurations. Specifically, we refine this information flow via gated inner-loop state updates and a cross-stage residual connection. Building on this design, controlled studies identify a configuration combining a single-pass Core depth of 25%-35% of the total unrolled depth with reallocating saved parameters into extra routed experts per layer, improving performance at zero extra compute while preserving compatibility with existing training infrastructure. Evaluated after 1T pre-training tokens, our 69B MLA and 51B KDA Mixture-of-Experts models outperform budget-matched non-recurrent baselines by an average of 1.16 and 2.29 percentage points across four benchmarks, respectively. Further reproduction experiments on a common backbone with a 200B-token training budget show that our method achieves lower perplexity than other looped methods. Code for these reproduction experiments is available at https://github.com/lxi01766/Scaling-Looped-MoE-Language-Models-under-Matched-Budgets-Information-Flow-and-Parameter-Allocation.

AI.tldr: 该论文改进循环Transformer的信息流并系统研究循环参数配置，在等参数等FLOP约束下提出将部分深度用单遍Core深度（25%-35%）换取更多路由专家，零额外计算即提升性能。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer可解耦计算深度与参数数量，但严格等参数、等FLOP约束下如何系统配置这类模型缺乏设计原则。
AI.method: 通过门控内循环状态更新和跨阶段残差连接改进信息流；在此基础上做控制实验，研究单遍Core深度占比与节省参数重新分配至每层额外路由专家的配置。
AI.result: 1T token预训练后，69B MLA和51B KDA MoE模型在四项基准上分别比同预算非循环基线平均高1.16和2.29个百分点；200B token复现实验中困惑度低于其他循环方法。
AI.conclusion: 在零额外计算下，Core深度取展开总深度25%-35%并将节省参数转为额外路由专家是有效配置，且兼容现有训练设施。

title: OmniMeld: Enhancing Audio-Visual Understanding via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Audio-visual understanding requires perceptual grounding, temporal understanding, and semantic inference. Multi-teacher distillation can consolidate these capabilities, but direct probability matching does not explicitly capture teacher prediction changes across audio-visual conditions. We introduce OmniMeld, a multi-teacher on-policy distillation method that integrates domain expertise through modality-response-guided distribution matching. We train four teachers covering grounding and correspondence, temporal dynamics and event structure, causal and inferential reasoning, and contextual and holistic understanding. Each sample is routed to its corresponding teacher for supervision conditioned on student-generated answer prefixes. We derive transport costs from teacher prediction changes over shared candidate tokens across audio-visual conditions, using optimal transport to match student predictions to those of the teacher under complete audio-visual input. We also construct OmniMeld-20K for domain-specialized teacher training. The dataset spans four capability domains, with responses structured into evidence, reasoning, and answer sections and verified through consistency checks and media-based review. Experiments on audio-visual and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate competitive teacher performance among similarly sized open-source models. The student improves over its base model across all evaluated benchmarks and surpasses the teachers' base model on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OmniMeld：一种多教师on-policy蒸馏方法，通过模态-响应引导的分布匹配整合四类领域专家教师，用于音视频理解。
AI.motivation: 音视频理解需要感知grounding、时序理解和语义推理等多种能力；多教师蒸馏可整合这些能力，但直接概率匹配无法显式捕捉教师预测在音视频条件下的变化。
AI.method: 训练四个教师分别覆盖grounding与对应关系、时序动态与事件结构、因果推理、上下文整体理解；以学生生成的答案前缀为条件将样本路由到对应教师；基于共享候选token在音视频条件下的教师预测变化构建传输代价，用最优传输把学生预测与完整音视频输入下的教师分布对齐；并构建OmniMeld-20K数据集（四能力域，回答分证据/推理/答案三段，经一致性检查与媒体复核）。
AI.result: 同类规模开源模型中教师表现具竞争力；学生在所有评测基准上优于基座模型，并在多个基准上超过教师的基座模型。
AI.conclusion: 多教师on-policy蒸馏结合模态响应引导的最优传输分布匹配，可有效整合领域专长并提升音视频与通用视频理解能力。

title: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
summary: Random projection is a basic compression primitive for Euclidean representation learning, with the Johnson--Lindenstrauss lemma giving a target dimension $k=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log n)$ independent of the ambient dimension. As hyperbolic representations gain increasing attention in modern Transformers, vision-language models, and large language models, the same need for oblivious dimensionality reduction arises, but no analogous primitive yet exists for hyperbolic representations. We study this gap. Two natural attempts fail in dual ways: a tangent-space scheme gives a clean local guarantee but is chart-bound and pays a curvature penalty, while a fully hyperbolic projection in the hyperboloid model is geometrically native but mixes radial and angular error before feeding them into the conditioning of $\operatorname{arcosh}$. We propose radial-angular random projection (RAP), which preserves the radial coordinate exactly and applies a Euclidean random projection only to the angular direction, lifting the result back to the target hyperboloid. RAP is hyperbolic-to-hyperbolic by construction, costs one Gaussian matrix-vector product, and reduces hyperbolic compression to a normalized angular JL question on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$. We prove a finite-set RAP guarantee with explicit $\sinh(\sqrt{c}\,r_x)\sinh(\sqrt{c}\,r_y)$ conditioning, complemented by a local tangent-space JL theorem and an arcosh-conditioning lemma for the fully hyperbolic comparator. Across an origin-centered broad-radius point cloud, a balanced tree, a clustered Gaussian, and the WordNet noun hierarchy, RAP attains the lowest mean relative distortion in every $(n,k)$ cell, reducing distortion over the strongest hyperbolic baseline by approximately $48\%$--$49\%$ on broad-radius data. RAP also scales to million-point datasets and improves retrieval on vision--language representations over hyperbolic projection baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出径向-角向随机投影(RAP)：精确保留双曲表示的径向坐标，仅对角度方向做欧氏随机投影再抬回目标双曲面，为双曲表示学习提供首个类JL的无偏降维原语，实验显著优于现有双曲基线。
AI.motivation: 欧氏表示学习有Johnson–Lindenstrauss随机投影这一基本压缩原语，而双曲表示在Transformer、视觉-语言模型和大模型中日益重要，却缺少对应的双曲降维原语。现有两种自然方案各有缺陷：切空间方案仅局部有效且受曲率惩罚；双曲面模型的完全双曲投影会混合径向与角向误差，影响arcosh条件数。
AI.method: RAP将目标点表示为径向坐标与球面角向两部分，精确保留径向坐标，仅对角向在S^{d-1}上施加欧氏随机投影，再抬回目标双曲面。该构造天然是双曲到双曲映射，代价仅为一次高斯矩阵-向量乘法，并把双曲压缩问题约化为归一化角向的JL问题。作者给出有限集RAP保证（含显式sinh(√c r_x)sinh(√c r_y)条件项），并辅以切空间局部JL定理和针对完全双曲比较方法的arcosh条件数引理。
AI.result: 在原点中心宽半径点云、平衡树、聚类高斯和WordNet名词层级上，RAP在每个(n,k)组合下均取得最低平均相对失真；宽半径数据上相较最强双曲基线降低约48%–49%。RAP可扩展到百万点数据集，并在视觉-语言表示检索任务上优于双曲投影基线。
AI.conclusion: RAP是一个简单、高效、几何自洽的双曲随机投影原语，将双曲降维归结为角向JL问题并给出理论保证，理论与大规模实验均验证其有效性和可扩展性，填补了双曲表示学习缺乏 oblivious 降维工具的空白。

title: MAFNet-UR$^3$: Mask-Aware Fusion Network for Unified Raindrop and Reflection Removal
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 LoViF Workshop. Received the Outstanding Challenge Paper Runner-Up Award
summary: Raindrops and reflections frequently co-occur on windshields and jointly obscure scene content, making their unified removal, referred to as UR$^3$, a highly ill-posed problem. Existing approaches are mainly based on diffusion models and thus can produce visually plausible restorations. However, they may generate scene-inconsistent structures in severely corrupted regions. To address this limitation, we propose MAFNet-UR$^3$, which adopts a three-stage framework to exploit multiple observations for scene-consistent unified raindrop and reflection removal. Specifically, Stage I suppresses raindrops while preserving the reflection layer, and Stage II performs prior-guided reflection removal followed by image-space refinement. Stage III estimates degradation masks from intermediate restoration results to provide degradation cues and performs mask-aware multi-scale fusion across observations to preserve scene structure and fine details. As a result, our proposed MAFNet-UR$^3$-L achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RDRF-testing benchmark, outperforming DiffUR$^3$ by 2.33 dB in PSNR and 2.7634 in the challenge score. Our method ranked third in the LoViF 2026 UR$^3$ Challenge, achieving a final score of 41.1416.

AI.tldr: 提出MAFNet-UR^3，用三阶段框架利用多观测实现场景一致的车窗雨滴与反光联合去除，在RDRF-testing上超越DiffUR^3（PSNR +2.33 dB），LoViF 2026 UR^3挑战赛获第三名（41.1416分）。
AI.motivation: 车窗上雨滴与反光常同时出现并共同遮挡场景，二者联合去除（UR^3）高度病态。现有基于扩散模型的方法虽视觉上逼真，但在严重退化区域易生成与场景不一致的结构。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：Stage I 抑制雨滴同时保留反光层；Stage II 先验引导去反光后进行图像空间细化；Stage III 从中间恢复结果估计退化掩码提供退化线索，并在多观测间做掩码感知的多尺度融合，以保持场景结构与细节。
AI.result: MAFNet-UR^3-L在RDRF-testing基准上达到SOTA，PSNR较DiffUR^3高2.33 dB，挑战分数高2.7634；在LoViF 2026 UR^3挑战赛排名第三，最终得分41.1416。
AI.conclusion: 通过分阶段解耦雨滴与反光、结合掩码感知的多观测多尺度融合，可在严重退化区域保持场景一致性，优于扩散模型类方法。

title: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
summary: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. Furthermore, several recent approaches to characterizing heterogeneous and graded materials employ parameter-heavy, deep learning-based frameworks trained to enforce force equilibrium at specified collocation points within the material. In this work, we propose an interpretable and time-efficient framework that predicts the three-dimensional relative spatial variation of a constitutive parameter field for multiple parameters of a heterogeneous hyperelastic material, using only displacement-field data. In this work, we validate our framework on 3D synthetic and 2D experimental benchmarks involving heterogeneous, graded, and anisotropic hyperelastic materials. By leveraging the linear nature of the inverse problem for hyperelastic materials and directly optimizing for the constitutive parameters at the finite-element level, we achieve acceptable prediction accuracy with significantly lower computational time compared to recently reported deep-learning-based frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释、省时的框架，仅用位移场数据预测非均质超弹性材料多个本构参数场的三维相对空间变化，并在合成与实验基准上验证。
AI.motivation: 识别非均质固体的空间变化材料属性仍具挑战；功能梯度材料/复合材料设计与制造、以及生物医学中活体测量表征非均质组织均需此类技术。现有研究多针对均质材料，非均质/梯度材料研究较少，且近期方法多为参数繁重、基于深度学习的框架。
AI.method: 利用超弹性材料反问题的线性性质，直接在有限元层面优化本构参数，预测本构参数场的三维相对空间变化，框架可解释且计算高效；仅使用位移场数据进行反演识别。
AI.result: 在涉及非均质、梯度及各向异性超弹性材料的三维合成和二维实验基准上验证，取得可接受的预测精度，且计算时间显著低于近期报道的深度学习框架。
AI.conclusion: 基于线性性质与有限元级直接优化的框架能有效、低成本地识别非均质超弹性材料参数场，优于深度学习方法的计算效率，具备功能梯度材料与生物组织表征的应用潜力。

title: Concept Generalization in Visual Brain Decoding via Encoder-Generated fMRI
summary: Visual brain decoders are typically trained and evaluated on stimuli drawn from similar semantic distributions, leaving their ability to reconstruct unseen concepts poorly understood. We study this concept generalization problem by withholding semantic concepts from a target subject's training data. We find that three recent fMRI-to-image decoders degrade substantially for the held-out concepts, even when the concept remains available for multi-subject models. In contrast, brain encoders that map a pretrained visual representation directly to voxels are markedly more robust to the same semantic holdout. Motivated by this asymmetry, we use such an encoder to generate synthetic fMRI responses for new images and add the resulting image-fMRI pairs to decoder training. Across three decoders, four subjects, and twelve semantic concepts, synthetic data recovers a substantial fraction of the performance lost on unseen concepts without requiring additional, time-consuming fMRI acquisition. We further show that the same approach improves general decoding performance across a wide range of data budgets. Analyses of encoder training conditions, encoder designs, and synthetic-data controls show that the gains depend on both encoder generalization and the semantic content of the synthetic supervision, rather than merely increasing the amount of training data. Together, our results show that encoder-generated fMRI can transfer semantic generalization to decoders.

AI.tldr: 视觉脑解码器在未见语义概念上泛化差，而脑编码器更鲁棒；用编码器生成合成fMRI数据加入训练，可恢复大量丢失性能。
AI.motivation: 现有fMRI-to-image解码器通常在相似语义分布上训练和评估，其对未见概念的泛化能力缺乏研究；作者希望量化并缓解这一概念泛化问题。
AI.method: 将特定语义概念从目标被试训练数据中剔除以构造留出实验；比较三种解码器与直接将预训练视觉表征映射到体素的脑编码器；再用该编码器为新图像生成合成fMRI响应，将图像-fMRI对加入解码器训练（3种解码器、4名被试、12个概念），并进行编码器训练条件、编码器设计和合成数据对照分析。
AI.result: 三种解码器在留出概念上性能显著下降，即使这些概念在多被试模型中仍可用；脑编码器对同一留出更鲁棒。合成数据在无需额外fMRI采集的情况下恢复了未见概念上损失性能的相当一部分，并在广泛数据预算下提升整体解码性能。增益依赖编码器泛化能力和合成监督的语义内容，而非单纯增加数据量。
AI.conclusion: 编码器生成的fMRI可将语义泛化能力迁移给解码器，为提升脑解码器对未见概念的泛化提供了无需额外采集的可行途径。

title: Inverse Reinforcement Learning with State-Dependent Foresight for Human Decision-Making
summary: Computational modeling of behavior represents individuals with a model fitted to their observed behavior and characterizes them through its parameters. Naturalistic tasks incorporate the complexity of real environments and yield high-dimensional behavioral trajectories. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) infers the latent reward function underlying these trajectories. Standard IRL, however, assumes effectively infinite-horizon planning, whereas human foresight is both bounded and state-dependent. Here we introduce SC-AIRL (State-Conditional Adversarial IRL), which builds these two cognitive properties into the planner. Per-depth policies share one reward but differ in how far ahead they sum it explicitly. A state-conditional router mixes them according to the current state. Across held-out episodes in pedestrian crossing and highway overtaking tasks, SC-AIRL improves imitation over Standard AIRL, raising top-1 accuracy from 0.549 to 0.647 and from 0.629 to 0.718, respectively, while more closely reproducing participant behavior in rollouts. Inferred planning depth correlates with self-reported anxiety and motor impulsivity. SC-AIRL thus reproduces human behavior more closely than Standard AIRL while providing an interpretable, model-derived measure of state-dependent foresight.

AI.tldr: 提出SC-AIRL（状态条件对抗式逆强化学习），将"有界且随状态变化的规划视野"嵌入规划器，通过多深度策略共享奖励+状态条件路由器混合，在两个自然任务上比标准AIRL更好地模仿人类行为，并给出可解释的规划深度指标。
AI.motivation: 计算行为建模常用拟合模型及其参数刻画个体，但自然任务生成高维行为轨迹。IRL可推断潜在奖励函数，然而标准IRL假设近乎无限视野规划，而人类前瞻性是有界且随状态变化的，这一不匹配导致建模失真。
AI.method: SC-AIRL：为不同规划深度（per-depth）分别设置策略，它们共享同一奖励函数，但显式求和奖励的前瞻步数不同；再用一个状态条件路由器依据当前状态对这些策略进行混合。以对抗式IRL框架训练。
AI.result: 在行人过街与高速超车任务的留出episode上，top-1模仿准确率分别由标准AIRL的0.549提升至0.647、0.629提升至0.718；rollout中更贴近被试行为。推断的规划深度与自报焦虑、运动冲动性相关。
AI.conclusion: SC-AIRL比标准AIRL更贴近人类行为，并提供可解释、由模型导出的状态依赖前瞻性度量，可作为个体差异的心理学关联指标。

title: X-Matte: VAE-Free Pixel-Space Flow Matching for Single-Step Image Matting
summary: Pre-trained generative models offer rich visual priors for image matting, but their adaptation often relies on variational autoencoders (VAEs), whose spatial compression can degrade fine alpha details and introduce additional inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose X-Matte, a VAE-free pixel-space flow matching framework for single-step image matting. By eliminating latent compression, X-Matte formulates the RGB-to-alpha transition as a continuous flow directly in pixel space. We adopt trajectory-wide x-prediction with transition-aware alpha supervision, enabling the model to learn from intermediate states while directly predicting the target alpha matte in a single forward pass. This design avoids both VAE encoding and decoding and iterative sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate performance competitive with state-of-the-art trimap-free matting methods on P3M benchmarks, together with promising zero-shot generalization to RWP-636 and AIM-500. Moreover, X-Matte achieves up to a 9.4x inference speedup over a constructed single-step latent counterpart at high resolution, demonstrating the effectiveness of VAE-free pixel-space modeling for accurate and efficient image matting.

AI.tldr: X-Matte：一种无VAE、像素空间的flow matching单步图像抠图框架，直接在像素空间完成RGB到alpha的连续流变换，避免VAE压缩与迭代采样，在P3M上性能具竞争力，高分辨率下比单步latent对照快9.4倍。
AI.motivation: 预训练生成模型为抠图提供丰富视觉先验，但现有适配依赖VAE；VAE的空间压缩会损害精细alpha细节，并引入额外推理开销。
AI.method: 提出X-Matte，去除latent压缩，将RGB-to-alpha建模为像素空间的连续流；采用trajectory-wide x-prediction与transition-aware alpha监督，使模型可从中间状态学习并单次前向直接预测目标alpha，无需VAE编解码与迭代采样。
AI.result: 在P3M基准上与SOTA无trimap抠图方法性能相当；对RWP-636和AIM-500展现良好的零样本泛化；高分辨率下相比构建的单步latent对照最高9.4倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 无VAE的像素空间建模可同时实现准确且高效的图像抠图，验证了该范式的有效性。

title: RAWPrism: A Three-Task Dataset and a Unified Model for RAW-Domain Image Fusion
summary: Research on multi-exposure fusion (MEF), multi-focus fusion (MFF), and infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has largely focused on rendered RGB images, while unified fusion across these tasks in the RAW domain before image signal processing (ISP) remains relatively underexplored. To support research in this setting, we introduce the RAWPrism dataset, covering all three tasks, and the RAWPrism model, a lightweight unified multi-task fusion network. The RAWPrism dataset comprises 422 usable MEF scenes and 150 registered MFF pairs from our RAW captures, together with 1,500 FMB-derived IVIF samples, in which the visible RAW inputs are reconstructed by ReRAW and their RGB counterparts rendered by CycleISP. Scene-level partitions and task-specific rendering and scoring protocols connect these resources to method development and evaluation. To our knowledge, the RAWPrism model is the first to unify MEF, MFF, and IVIF directly in the RAW domain. It combines a CFA-aware representation, task-conditioned source gating, and a shared backbone to support all three tasks with one 3.58M-parameter checkpoint. Together, the dataset and model support the study of shared fusion mechanisms across exposure, focus, and spectral complementarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAWPrism数据集与RAWPrism模型，首次在ISP之前的RAW域统一处理多曝光融合、多聚焦融合和红外-可见光融合三大任务。
AI.motivation: 现有MEF、MFF、IVIF研究大多基于渲染后的RGB图像，而在ISP之前的RAW域实现跨任务统一融合的研究相对缺乏，缺少相应数据资源支撑。
AI.method: 构建RAWPrism数据集：422个可用MEF场景、150对配准MFF RAW图像，以及1500个由FMB转化并借助ReRAW重建可见光RAW、CycleISP渲染RGB的IVIF样本，并提供场景级划分与任务特定的渲染与评分协议。模型方面，RAWPrism为轻量统一多任务融合网络，采用CFA感知表示、任务条件化源门控与共享骨干。
AI.result: 单一3.58M参数检查点即可支持MEF、MFF、IVIF三类任务；数据集与模型为研究曝光、对焦与光谱互补性背后的共享融合机制提供支撑。
AI.conclusion: RAW域统一融合框架可行，RAWPrism数据集与模型可促进跨任务共享融合机制的研究。

title: Off the Driven Path: Transferable Road Understanding in Driving VLAs
summary: End-to-end driving policies increasingly operate without explicit HD maps at inference, raising the question of what road knowledge they actually internalize. To probe this knowledge through model outputs, we introduce Road-KSU, a framework that automatically converts HD maps and actor annotations into a road-centric scene graph. From this, we derive road-focused question answering and reasoning targets, complemented by map-based trajectory compliance metrics. Pairing Road-KSU with geographically disjoint splits yields a $2 \times 2$ evaluation crossing output modality (language vs. action) with place familiarity (seen vs. unseen roads). On NAVSIM, 95% of test samples lie within 10m of a training sample, and scores of 13 published planners on turns rise steeply with the number of training drives through the test location, pointing to memorized road geometry. Retraining on geographically disjoint splits and probing with Road-KSU confirm that action-space performance degrades most on unfamiliar turns, with failures dominated by geometric compliance. Language accuracy, however, drops on road-centric VQA on straight and curved roads alike, and remains stable on dynamic scene content. Scaling the training data further reveals a double dissociation: more drives through the same places improve driving on unseen roads but leave road question answering unchanged, whereas spreading a fixed data budget over more places increases road question answering with little change in driving performance. These findings show that improved driving scores need not imply broader road understanding on unseen roads, and identify geographic diversity as key to transferable road knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Road-KSU框架，将HD地图与行为标注转为道路中心场景图，用于探测量化端到端驾驶策略"记住了什么道路知识"，并揭示驾驶分数提升不等于对未见道路的泛化理解，地理多样性是迁移性道路知识的关键。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略在推理时越来越多地不用显式HD地图，但其内部究竟内化了哪些道路知识并不清楚；同时现有评测分数可能被训练地点记忆所虚高，缺少能区分"记忆"与"理解"、且能同时考察语言与动作两种输出模态的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建Road-KSU框架：自动把HD地图与交通参与者标注转换成道路中心的场景图，由此生成道路导向的问答与推理目标，并补充基于地图的轨迹合规指标；结合地理不重叠的数据划分，形成输出模态（语言vs动作）×地点熟悉度（见过vs未见）的2×2评测。在NAVSIM上对13个已发表规划器做测试位置训练次数与表现的关系分析，并用地理不重叠划分重训与Road-KSU探测进行验证与数据规模实验。
AI.result: NAVSIM上95%测试样本距训练样本在10m内，13个规划器在转弯上分数随测试地点训练行驶次数增加而陡升，说明存在对道路几何的记忆。地理不重叠重训+探测显示：动作空间性能在陌生转弯上下降最多，失败以几何合规为主；语言准确率在直道与弯道的道路导向VQA上均下降，而在动态场景内容上保持稳定。数据规模实验呈现双重分离：在同一地点增加行驶次数能改善未见道路上的驾驶但不改道路问答；固定预算下分散到更多地点则提升道路问答而驾驶性能变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶分数的提升并不必然意味着对未见道路有更广的道路理解；地理多样性才是获得可迁移道路知识的关键。评测应同时考察语言与动作两种模态并控制地点重叠，以避免记忆带来的虚高。

title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
comment: 4 pages + references and appendix (12 pages total). Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database. However, a wrong query can match by luck when the data lack the rows that expose its bug. We study a counterfactual-database (CF) reward that also runs the final query on a few hidden, code-generated copies of the database and pays only if all results match (strict form) or by the share matched (mean form). On 1,302 synthetic audit questions, the strict form lowers the share of buggy queries paid in full from 29.5% to 16.8% and of reward hacks from 54.1% to 1.9%, rejecting 0 of 2,847 correct queries; copies from a family-blind generator do about as well. In a controlled GRPO comparison on a 3.35B model with three seeds per arm, training on the mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy (8.4% vs 11.7%), because the two rewards disagreed on only 5-7% of rollouts; on Spider it gained 1.6 points. One seed reverses both signs, so single-seed reward comparisons mislead. Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards ; data, models, demo: https://huggingface.co/counterfactual-sql

AI.tldr: 提出反事实数据库（CF）奖励：在若干隐藏的、代码生成的数据副本上运行最终查询，只有全部匹配（严格）或按匹配比例（均值）才给分，以减少"侥幸匹配"的虚假奖励。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL强化学习只在单一数据库上与参考答案比对结果给奖励。若数据库恰好缺少能暴露查询bug的行，错误查询也会"侥幸"匹配，导致对有缺陷查询的过度奖励与reward hack。
AI.method: 设计 CF 奖励：对最终 SQL 在少量隐藏、代码生成的数据库副本上执行，严格形式要求全部结果匹配才全额支付，均值形式按匹配比例给分。在1302道合成审计题上评估；并在3.35B模型上用GRPO做控制实验，每臂3个随机种子，比较均值形式与基线。
AI.result: 严格形式把被全额奖励的buggy查询比例从29.5%降到16.8%，reward hack从54.1%降到1.9%，且未误拒2847条正确查询中的任何一条；族盲生成器的副本效果相近。GRPO中均值形式未提升域内准确率（8.4% vs 11.7%），因两种奖励仅在5-7%的rollout上不一致；Spider上提升1.6点。有一个种子使两处符号反转，说明单种子比较会误导。
AI.conclusion: CF奖励能有效抑制侥幸匹配与reward hack且几乎不误伤正确查询，但在训练中带来的精度收益有限且对随机种子敏感；奖励差异需多样本、多种子评估，代码与数据已开源。

title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
summary: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/.
