AI.tldr: 提出 LayoutRecall，一种多轮 3D 布局控制的图像编辑方法，用盒面隐式记忆存储与检索物体外观，解决物体被遮挡或移出视野后外观丢失的问题，并发布 LayoutLoop 基准。
AI.motivation: 在连续多轮编辑中，当物体被遮挡或离开视野，最新图像会丢失其外观；而目标布局仍要求它在指定位置重现，因此需要从早期观测中恢复外观。
AI.method: 1) Box-Surface Latent Memory：将图像隐变量存放在 3D 盒的面上，并沿目标视角光线检索；2) Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning：用目标视角位置、共享盒局部嵌入和按物体的注意力，把检索到的 token 注入 FLUX.2 编辑器；3) 对应损失：促使去噪时关注匹配的观测。
AI.result: 在 LayoutLoop 与真实场景数据上进行了大量实验，验证了方法的能力。
AI.conclusion: 在 3D 盒局部坐标系中存储并复用外观，可有效支持多轮布局可控编辑中的物体外观回忆。

title: Strong Starts, Simple Recipes: Unified Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation from Multimodal Specialists
comment: Project page, code, and model weights: https://amberheart.github.io/Uni-MOPD/
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain specialists into a single unified model. Existing methods focus on refining the distillation procedure while initializing the student from a base model or a multi-domain SFT checkpoint, which leaves capability integration largely to distillation itself. Instead, we treat the starting point as a design variable and propose Unified MOPD (Uni-MOPD), which pairs a strong start with a simple recipe: a training-free uniform merge of specialists from the same base model initializes the student, and short MOPD with uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL refines it. Across five multimodal domains and 19 benchmarks, our study establishes three findings. (1) The starting point matters more than subsequent training choices: before any training, the uniform merge already matches the score that the base model reaches after 200 MOPD updates, and after short distillation it matches higher-scoring, search-based starts. (2) Short MOPD recovers most of the capabilities the merge leaves unintegrated; it improves every domain, with the largest gains where the domain teacher still leads. (3) From a strong start, uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL match or exceed every evaluated sampling strategy and divergence, without schedules, per-token weighting, or truncation hyperparameters. Uni-MOPD outperforms Open-MOPD at the same training budget while training 3.3 times faster than its released code. We will release the training framework, specialist checkpoints, and unified student.

AI.tldr: Uni-MOPD 把"学生模型初始化方式"当作核心设计变量：先用同源专家做免训练均匀合并得到强起点，再用短程、均匀域采样、全词表反向KL的多教师on-policy蒸馏精炼，即可在5个多模态域、19个基准上超越Open-MOPD且训练快3.3倍。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD）研究多聚焦于改进蒸馏过程本身，而学生模型仍从基座或多域SFT检查点初始化，把能力整合完全交给蒸馏训练完成，忽略了起点选择的巨大作用。
AI.method: 提出Uni-MOPD：起点上，对同一基座模型训练出的各领域专家做免训练的参数均匀合并（uniform merge）作为学生初始化；训练上，采用短程MOPD，配合均匀域采样与全词表反向KL目标，不使用调度、逐token加权或截断超参。
AI.result: 在5个多模态域、19个基准上得出三点：(1) 起点比后续训练选择更重要——训练前均匀合并即达到基座模型经200步MOPD后的分数，短程蒸馏后又可匹配更昂贵的搜索式起点；(2) 短程MOPD补回合并未整合的大部分能力，各域均提升，且在领域教师仍领先处增益最大；(3) 强起点下均匀域采样+全词表反向KL达到或超过所有对比采样策略与散度。同预算下优于Open-MOPD，训练速度为其官方代码的3.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 初始化是MOPD中被低估的关键变量；强起点加简单配方（均匀合并 + 短程均匀采样全词表反向KL）已足够高效地完成多专家能力整合，作者将开源训练框架、专家检查点与统一学生模型。

title: DeltaRAE: Derivative Tokenization for Long Video Generation
summary: Latent video generators are trained on clips of a few seconds, and much of this limit lies in their tokenizers, which spend as many tokens on a static frame as on a moving one and need future frames that do not exist during generation. We introduce DeltaRAE, a causal representation autoencoder for video. Its derivative tokenization encodes periodic anchor frames in full and all remaining frames with a few tokens each, and its causal encoder and decoder read a frozen pretrained image encoder. On UCF-101 and Kinetics-600, a standard diffusion transformer trained on DeltaRAE latents is competitive with state-of-the-art video tokenizers. DeltaRAE halves the tokenizer GFLOPs on 16-frame clips relative to keeping the same number of patch tokens for every frame, and it represents a minute of video with 18.8x fewer tokens. The tokenizer trains end to end on one-minute videos, and in video prediction a generator on its latents produces a full minute of video. The same generator collapses within 15 seconds in most videos when the tokenizer has the same token budget but no pretrained encoder.

AI.tldr: DeltaRAE 是一种面向视频的因果表示自编码器（causal representation autoencoder），通过“导数式”token 化——周期性完整编码锚帧、其余帧只用极少 token 表示——并以冻结的预训练图像编码器作为因果编解码器的读取源，从而大幅压缩视频 token 数量并支持超长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间视频生成器只能训练几秒的片段，瓶颈在于 tokenizer：它对静态帧和运动帧消耗同样多的 token，不区分信息冗余；并且在生成时还需要未来帧（非因果），而这些帧在自回归生成中并不存在。
AI.method: 提出 DeltaRAE：1）导数式 token 化，周期性锚帧完整编码，其余帧每帧仅用少量 token（编码相对变化）；2）采用因果编码器与解码器，允许自回归生成；3）编解码器读取一个冻结的预训练图像编码器，以继承强视觉先验。用标准扩散 Transformer 在 DeltaRAE 潜变量上训练验证。
AI.result: 在 UCF-101 与 Kinetics-600 上，DeltaRAE 潜变量训练的扩散 Transformer 与 SOTA 视频 tokenizer 相当；16 帧片段上 tokenizer GFLOPs 减半（相比每帧等量 patch token）；一分钟视频所需 token 少 18.8 倍；tokenizer 可在完整一分钟视频上端到端训练，且潜变量生成器可预测出完整一分钟视频。对照实验中，同样 token 预算但无预训练编码器的版本，多数视频在 15 秒内生成即崩塌。
AI.conclusion: DeltaRAE 通过因果导数式 token 化与预训练图像编码器先验，同时解决长视频生成的 token 冗余与因果性两大瓶颈，在保持竞争性生成质量的同时显著降低计算与 token 开销，并使一分钟级视频生成成为可能。

title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
comment: 41 pages, 17 figures. (Equal contribution : Hoonki Lee and Haechan Shin)
summary: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate.

AI.tldr: Any-Rate 提出一种嵌套多精度量化方法，从单个 checkpoint 以半比特为步长支持 2–8 比特（2–4 比特区间为 0.5 步），在 2/3 比特达到多精度方法 SOTA，2 比特保留 69% FP16 精度。
AI.motivation: 嵌套多精度量化通过只读取权重前导比特从单一 checkpoint 得到多种精度，适合端侧不同内存/能耗预算部署；但现有方法只支持整数比特，相邻精度间精度差距大，2 比特时严重退化。
AI.method: 将 8 权重块中部分 bit-plane 约束为扩展汉明码字（每权重 0.5 比特）；每行跨精度共享一个 LUT；对所有精度联合编码并为每个精度设独立目标，降低共享 bit-plane 带来的损失。
AI.result: 四个 LLM 上，2/3 比特为多精度方法 SOTA，2 比特保留 69% FP16 精度，4 比特与最佳相差 1 分以内；解码速度与现有 kernel 相当；LPDDR 能耗模型估计同等精度下能耗最多降低 27%。
AI.conclusion: Any-Rate 以半比特粒度提供细粒度多精度服务，缓解相邻精度精度断层与低比特退化问题，且不牺牲解码速度并降低能耗。

title: SIA: Selective Image Analogy
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). 28 pages including supplementary material. Project page: https://selective-image-analogy.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/alimohammadiamirhossein/selective-image-analogy Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/selective-image-analogy/SIA-Multi-Edit-Analogy
summary: Image analogy transfers a demonstrated transformation from a before/after pair (A, A') to a new query image B. Existing methods assume all changes in (A, A') should be fully transferred, limiting flexibility when users want only a subset of the demonstrated edits. We introduce Selective Image Analogy (SIA), a new setting where a single demonstration pair encodes multiple edits, and the user selects at inference time which edits to apply to B. To support this, we curate a multi-edit analogy dataset with full-edit and partial-edit targets. We then train a model that first learns to transfer the complete demonstrated transformation, and then gains selective control through a mask-aligned suppression mechanism: a token-gated LoRA that restricts adapter updates to suppressed edit tokens during denoising, paired with a concept suppression vector that weakens the selected tokens in the text embeddings before denoising. Together, these components allow SIA to suppress unwanted edits that remain visible in A', while preserving the user-selected ones, all without requiring a new demonstration pair for each edit combination. We perform extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations along with user studies to demonstrate the efficacy of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性图像类比(SIA)新任务：单一示范对可含多个编辑，用户在推理时选择只迁移其中部分编辑；构建多编辑类比数据集并训练模型先学全量迁移、再用掩码对齐抑制机制实现选择性控制。
AI.motivation: 现有图像类比方法假设示范对(A, A')中的所有变化都应被完整迁移，缺乏灵活性；用户往往只想应用其中一部分编辑，而为每种编辑组合单独提供示范对又不现实。
AI.method: 构建含全编辑与部分编辑目标的多编辑类比数据集；先训练模型学习完整转换，再通过掩码对齐抑制机制获得选择性控制：一是token门控LoRA,在去噪时把适配器更新限制在被抑制的编辑token上;二是概念抑制向量,在去噪前削弱文本嵌入中被选中的token。
AI.result: 大量定量与定性实验及用户研究表明，该方法能抑制A'中仍可见的无关编辑、保留用户选择的编辑，且无需为每种编辑组合重新提供示范对。
AI.conclusion: SIA将图像类比扩展为可控的选择性编辑迁移，验证了掩码对齐抑制机制的有效性，提升了类比方法在真实使用中的灵活性。

title: DiversePlace: Diversity-Seeking Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Macro Placement
summary: Macro placement is a critical early-stage decision in physical design because macro locations strongly constrain subsequent implementation stages. The task is difficult because these high-impact discrete decisions must be made before downstream quality can be measured accurately, forcing training to rely on fast but imperfect training-time oracles such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). Existing RL-based placers therefore mostly optimize single HPWL-driven solutions, and their long sequential horizons often require heavy search assistance or offline expert data while leaving little room to preserve multiple competitive layouts. We address this gap by making quality-controlled diversity an explicit objective for macro placement. Instead of relying on a single proxy-optimal solution, we maintain a compact archive of HPWL-competitive yet meaningfully different placements for downstream selection. We realize this idea in DiversePlace, a curriculum proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that combines a quality-gated diversity reward with an expanding placement horizon, enabling from-scratch RL optimization while keeping exploration inside competitive HPWL regions. On the ISPD2005 benchmarks, DiversePlace consistently improves top-5, top-10, and top-20 archive diversity and achieves lower or virtually identical HPWL on all eight designs with better efficiency. Code: https://github.com/William030422/NIPS2026-DiversePlace.

AI.tldr: DiversePlace将"质量可控的多样性"作为宏单元布局的显式目标，用课程式PPO+质量门控多样性奖励+扩展布局视野，从零训练维护一个HPWL有竞争力但彼此差异明显的紧凑解集，供下游选择。
AI.motivation: 宏单元位置深刻约束后续物理设计阶段，但决策需在下游质量可测之前做出，只能依赖HPWL等快速但 imperfect 的训练期oracle。现有RL布局器多只优化单一HPWL驱动解，长序列horizon需大量搜索辅助或离线专家数据，且几乎没有余地保留多个有竞争力的布局。
AI.method: 提出DiversePlace：基于课程学习的PPO框架，结合(a)质量门控的多样性奖励，使探索保持在有竞争力的HPWL区域内同时鼓励解间差异；(b)逐步扩展的布局视野(expanding placement horizon)，支持从零开始的RL优化。以紧凑archive形式维护多个HPWL有竞争力且彼此意义不同的布局。
AI.result: 在ISPD2005基准的全部8个设计上，DiversePlace稳定提升top-5/top-10/top-20 archive多样性，且HPWL更低或基本持平，同时效率更好。
AI.conclusion: 将多样性作为显式、质量受控的目标可让RL布局器在保持HPWL竞争力的同时产出多个可比选方案，为下游选择留出空间，且无需离线专家数据或重搜索辅助。

title: TWIST: Teacher-Weighted Initial-Noise Spherical Transform for Quality-Preserving Diversity in Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: Timestep-distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in one or a few steps, but often suffer from reduced mode coverage and limited diversity. Recent methods improve diversity by optimizing the initial noise at inference time, requiring costly backpropagation through the denoiser. Moreover, their diversity objectives typically repel generated samples without accounting for how the corresponding teacher model distributes its outputs. We introduce Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform (TWIST), a lightweight network that transforms the low-frequency components of initial noise to improve diversity without inference-time optimization. TWIST uses a teacher-guided determinantal point process (DPP) objective to align the feature-space diversity of student samples with that of the teacher. By amortizing noise optimization into a single network, TWIST eliminates inference-time backpropagation while preserving the efficiency of few-step generation. On SDXL-Turbo, TWIST matches the diversity of MoNO at less than 25% of its inference cost, while achieving higher recall and better PickScore, ImageReward, and CLIPScore under matched compute budgets. On SDXL-Lightning, it achieves comparable recall at lower cost without the ImageReward degradation observed with MoNO.

AI.tldr: TWIST: 用轻量网络变换初始噪声低频分量，借助教师引导的DPP目标对齐师生特征多样性，无需推理期反传即可提升少步扩散模型的多样性。
AI.motivation: 时间步蒸馏扩散模型（如SDXL-Turbo/Lightning）能少步生成高质量图像，但模式覆盖与多样性下降。现有方法在推理时优化初始噪声以提升多样性，需对去噪器反复反传，开销大；且其多样性目标只是排斥样本，未考虑教师模型的输出分布。
AI.method: 提出Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform（TWIST）：一个轻量网络，仅变换初始噪声的低频分量；采用教师引导的行列式点过程（DPP）目标，将学生样本的特征空间多样性与教师对齐；把噪声优化摊销进单个网络，一次性前向即可，无需推理时反传。
AI.result: 在SDXL-Turbo上，TWIST以不到MoNO 25%的推理成本达到同等多样性，并在等算力下获得更高召回及更好的PickScore、ImageReward、CLIPScore；在SDXL-Lightning上以更低成本取得可比召回，且无MoNO的ImageReward下降问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将教师引导的多样性目标摊销为噪声变换网络，TWIST在保持少步生成效率的同时有效弥合蒸馏模型与教师的多样性差距，兼具高效与质量。

title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
comment: 28 pages. Supplementary code and results included. WhoWhen library: https://github.com/mojolearn/whowhen
summary: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. On a 12-hour sepsis forecasting task, carrying forward makes a model look 0.163 AUC better than raw values when a patient's hours are split between training and test, but only 0.046 better when patients are held out. The exaggeration under patient overlap also appears in a second ICU dataset with mortality as the outcome. On the sepsis task, a chronological control with complete follow-up, in which training sees only a patient's earlier, resolved hours, shows no positive mean overlap gap. Timing is a strong predictor: with complete follow-up, hour of stay and measurement counts alone, with no clinical value, score 0.761 on held-out patients, and adding the raw clinical values changes that by +0.018. Outside the ICU, 95% of drives and 75% of loans have records on both sides of a calendar cut, and the overlap gap persists under a calendar split. The audits show which features and preprocessing choices to check; the evaluation protocol decides the consequences. I release the code, a library that runs the audits on any table with a unit column and a time column, and a guide to using the audits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两个无需训练事件预测模型的简单审计方法（同一单元识别审计、同单元时间先后审计），用于度量数据集在事件预测前携带的"单位身份/时间"信息；在六个领域七个公开数据集上发现按时间前向填充（carry-forward）与患者重叠会显著夸大ICU sepsis/死亡率任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 许多基于运维日志的事件预测模型（如ICU脓毒症、硬盘故障）可能只是通过识别记录来自哪个患者/硬盘、以及记录的时间先后而"得分高"，而非真正预测事件。作者希望在训练任何模型之前就能量化数据集中这类信息的含量。
AI.method: 提出两个审计（audit）：(1) 身份审计——分类器能否判断两条记录来自同一单元；(2) 时序审计——同一单元的两条记录哪条更晚。原假设下两者期望AUC均为0.5。在六个领域七个公开数据集上运行，并对比carry-forward预处理、患者重叠/留出协议、按时间顺序的完整随访对照，以及不含临床数值的时序特征基线。
AI.result: ICU中身份审计揭示carry-forward将身份AUC从0.916抬升至0.993。12小时sepsis预测中，carry-forward在患者时间被训练/测试切分时使模型虚高0.163 AUC，留出患者时仅+0.046；该"重叠差距"在第二个ICU数据集（死亡率结局）中再现。时序特征（住院小时数+测量计数，无临床值）在留出患者上可达0.761，加入原始临床值仅+0.018。非ICU领域：95%硬盘、75%贷款有跨日历切分点记录，日历切分下重叠差距仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 审计能指示应检查哪些特征与预处理选择，而评估协议决定了这些信息的后果。作者发布代码、可在任意含单元列与时间列的表上运行审计的库，以及审计使用指南。

title: RelPRM: Grounding Visual Process Reward Models in Relational Evidence
summary: Visual process reward models (PRMs) can detect calculation errors yet assign high scores to steps that misread visual relations. Supervision based on subsequent answer success does not directly establish whether a step's relational claim holds. To strengthen visual-relation verification, we first build an automated pipeline that programmatically verifies each claim and identifies the required objects, relations, and image regions. It produces RelProcessTrain and RelProcessBench (RPB), which tests whether scores respond appropriately to relational evidence through controlled image edits and step rephrasings. Building on this pipeline, we further introduce RelPRM, a visual-relation-oriented method for process reward modeling with two training mechanisms. Relation-evidence self-distillation constructs views preserving necessary objects, relations, and dependencies, reducing the burden of finding decisive evidence in complex scenes and transferring reliable evidence-assisted judgments to full images. Relation-evidence-driven consistency training encourages appropriate score changes when relation edits reverse a step's truth, stability under irrelevant edits, and similar score changes across paraphrases. At inference, RelPRM directly scores the current step using only the original image and reasoning context. RelPRM achieves 66.2% on VisualProcessBench (VPB) and 68.4% on RPB, gains of 4.2 and 9.9 percentage points over VisualPRM-8B. These results show that training for visual relations improves both relational verification and step assessment across broader multimodal reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建关系校验数据管线（RelProcessTrain、RelProcessBench），并提出面向视觉关系的过程奖励模型 RelPRM，以关系证据自蒸馏与关系证据驱动一致性训练提升关系核验能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉过程奖励模型（PRM）能发现计算错误，却会给错误解读视觉关系的步骤打高分；而基于后续答案正确性的监督无法直接判断某步骤的关系性陈述是否成立。
AI.method: 先用自动化管线程序化验证每条步骤陈述，定位所需对象、关系与图像区域，产出训练集 RelProcessTrain 与基准 RelProcessBench（RPB，通过受控图像编辑与步骤改写检验打分是否随关系证据变化）。在此基础上提出 RelPRM，含两种训练机制：①关系证据自蒸馏，构造保留必要对象、关系与依赖关系的视图，把可靠的证据辅助判断迁移到全图；②关系证据驱动一致性训练，要求关系反转时分数合理变化、无关编辑时分数稳定、改写表述时分数一致。推理时仅用原图与推理上下文直接打分。
AI.result: RelPRM 在 VisualProcessBench 上达 66.2%，在 RPB 上达 68.4%，分别较 VisualPRM-8B 提升 4.2 与 9.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 针对视觉关系进行训练可同时提升关系核验与步骤评估能力，并泛化到更广泛的多模态推理任务。

title: Out of Sight, Not Out of Clues: Can Video LLMs Guess from Partial Evidence?
summary: In real-world applications like egocentric recording, visual accessibility, and surveillance review, visual evidence for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) is often only partially captured. A reliable model should match its response to the evidence: answering when sufficient, guessing from visible clues when partial, and abstaining when absent. Yet existing benchmarks enforce a binary answerable-or-unanswerable split, leaving partial evidence unmeasured and obscuring whether failures arise from missing evidence or misjudging sufficiency. We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning. ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input. Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues. Targeted fine-tuning shows that this reflects missing supervision rather than insufficient capacity: supervising the guess level lifts appropriate guessing from 1.6% to 40.4% without extra false refusals, whereas conventional refusal tuning rejects 92% of guessable questions. Data and code will be released at https://github.com/suat-llm/ClueProbe.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ClueProbe 诊断基准，将"感知证据"与"判断证据充分性"分离，发现 Video LLM 的失败主要源于分级充分性判断能力缺失而非感知不足，并通过针对性微调验证了这是监督缺失而非容量不足。
AI.motivation: 现有 Video LLM 基准仅采用"可回答/不可回答"的二元划分，无法衡量"部分证据"情形，也无法区分模型失败究竟源于看不到证据，还是误判了证据是否充分。
AI.method: 构建 ClueProbe 基准：598 个自然视频、1,721 个人工标注问题，标签为 Answerable / Guessable / Unanswerable，并配有修改措辞或视觉输入的受控扰动；评测 10 个开源与闭源 Video LLM，并通过针对性微调进行诊断验证。
AI.result: 模型能感知证据但缺乏分级充分性意识，几乎不做"部分线索猜测"（仅 1.6% 适当猜测）；监督 guess 层级可将该比例提升至 40.4% 且不增加误拒答，而传统拒答微调会拒绝 92% 的可猜测问题。
AI.conclusion: Video LLM 的核心缺陷是分级充分性判断而非感知能力，属于监督缺失而非容量不足，需要引入中间层级的"猜测"监督信号。

title: SMOTE 25 Years of Magic: What Has Been Done, What the Evidence Shows, and Whom It Reached
comment: 60 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables. The online appendix (55 pages) is an ancillary file. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24212321
summary: Background. SMOTE was published in this journal in 2002 and reviewed here at its fifteenth anniversary in 2018. At twenty-five it is cited by more than 34,000 indexed works, half of them outside computer science. Objectives. To establish what the methods built on SMOTE change, how strong the evidence for them is, and whom the technique has reached. Methods. We audited a curated corpus of 76 papers, 37 of which propose a SMOTE-family generator, and tested its coverage with a systematic search of 22,426 records in the PRISMA 2020 format. From the corpus we collected 1,756 dataset entries, 1,511 published comparisons with SMOTE and the evaluation design of 71 studies; from the search we drew 300 applications of SMOTE at random. We used an agentic AI approach to extract, screen and code under our written rules, and we report how each step was checked. Results. Every variant re-decides some of the six decisions of the SMOTE rule, and 24 of the 37 are only ever run on two classes. In their own papers, proposed methods beat SMOTE in 79.0% of the decided comparisons, but independent studies find that the gains shrink with strong learners and tuned thresholds, and that resampling damages calibration. The corpus holds 52 of the 3,097 records that pass the screen and covers the early years closely, the recent ones thinly. The reach is very wide, but a benefit at the level of outcomes is undemonstrated, four harms are documented, and an estimated 37% of applications resample the whole data set before splitting it. Conclusions. For tabular classification, a new SMOTE variant should no longer count as a contribution in itself: a new generator should be tested one decision at a time against class weighting and a tuned threshold with a strong learner, with calibration reported. We close with a selection guide, a reporting checklist of fifteen items and a research agenda.

AI.tldr: SMOTE 25周年审计：系统审查76篇SMOTE族论文及4226条检索记录（抽取300例应用），发现SMOTE变体仅在自身论文中占优、独立研究显示收益随强模型与阈值调优而消失且损害概率校准，约37%应用在划分前重采样；提出新变体不应再单独视为贡献。
AI.motivation: SMOTE自2002年发表已25年、被引超34,000次且半数来自计算机科学之外，因此需要厘清其衍生方法究竟改了什么、证据强度如何、技术实际触达了哪些领域。
AI.method: 构建76篇论文的精选语料（含37篇提出SMOTE族生成器），并以PRISMA 2020格式系统检索22,426条记录检验覆盖度；从语料中收集1,756条数据集记录、1,511个与SMOTE的对比及71项研究的评估设计，从检索中随机抽取300个应用；采用agentic AI按书面规则进行提取、筛选与编码，并报告每步核查方式。
AI.result: 每个变体都重新决定SMOTE规则六项决策中的若干项，37个中有24个仅在二分类上运行；在自身论文中79.0%的已决对比优于SMOTE，但独立研究显示强学习器与阈值调优会削弱增益且重采样损害校准；语料覆盖早期充分、近期稀疏；触达面极广但未见结果层面益处的证据，记录到四类危害，约37%应用在划分前对全体数据重采样。
AI.conclusion: 表格分类中，新的SMOTE变体不应再单独算作贡献；新生成器须针对类别加权与调优阈值、使用强学习器逐项检验单一决策并报告校准。作者最后给出选择指南、15项报告清单与研究议程。

title: Tortho-Gaussian++: Suppressing Geometric Drift and Floaters for Robust Gravity-Aligned TDOM Generation in Large-Scale Aerial Scenes
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable performance in aerial scene reconstruction, motivating its recent extension to true digital orthophoto maps (TDOMs) generation. We propose Tortho-Gaussian++, a novel 3DGS training framework that suppresses geometric drift and floaters and automatically prunes unreliable peripheral regions, coupled with a robust gravity-aligned TDOM rendering solution. First, we explore geometric support via viewing-ray-based geometric observability analysis, quantitatively characterizing the reliability for each Gaussian and subsequently pruning peripheral regions with particularly weak geometric support. Second, the optimizer state initialization is refined for newly created Gaussians during densification, intrinsically suppressing drift and floaters without external priors. Lastly, a robust gravity direction estimation solution is designed, combining image-derived gravity cues, camera-distribution priors and nadir views, to achieve a gravity-aligned orthogonal projection reference for TDOM rendering. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) datasets demonstrate that our Tortho-Gaussian++ outperforms vanilla 3DGS by 0.5-3.5 dB in average PSNR and yields comparable or superior performance to prior-guided 3DGS methods. Notably, it reduces the training time, VRAM and Gaussian number by 45.5%, 47.2%, and 58.6%, respectively. Qualitative evaluations confirm that our method effectively suppresses drift and floaters, while robust gravity direction estimation reduces tilt-induced facade artifacts in TDOMs.

AI.tldr: Tortho-Gaussian++ 提出一个改进的3DGS训练框架，通过几何可观测性分析剪枝弱支撑区域、优化致密化时新高斯优化器状态、以及稳健重力方向估计，实现高质量TDOM生成，在精度、效率和鲁棒性上超越原生3DGS与先验引导方法。
AI.motivation: 原生3DGS用于航拍场景重建与TDOM生成时存在几何漂移、悬浮物（floaters）以及边缘区域几何支撑不足的问题，同时正交投影渲染依赖准确的重力方向。
AI.method: 1) 基于视射线的几何可观测性分析，量化每个高斯可靠性并剪枝弱支撑的边缘区域；2) 改进致密化阶段新建高斯的优化器状态初始化，无需外部先验即抑制漂移与悬浮物；3) 融合图像重力线索、相机分布先验与天底视角，稳健估计重力方向，构建重力对齐的正交投影参考用于TDOM渲染。
AI.result: 在多个大规模UAV数据集上平均PSNR优于原生3DGS 0.5–3.5 dB，与先验引导3DGS方法相当或更优；训练时间、显存和高斯数量分别减少45.5%、47.2%、58.6%；定性结果证实有效抑制漂移与悬浮物，重力估计减少倾斜导致的外立面伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在效率与质量上均具优势，为航拍场景的稳健TDOM生成提供了实用方案。

title: Resilience Analysis Through Automated Stage Identification and Quantitative Assessment
summary: This paper introduced an ML-based approach, designed to be domain- and threat-agnostic, for automated recognition of PARA (Plan/Prepare, Absorb, Recover, Adapt) resilience stages in system-performance time series, enabling subsequent quantitative resilience analysis across different systems. We investigate four ML models for resilience stage recognition: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). We then use the ML models' predictions to quantify system resilience by computing corresponding resilience metrics from system-performance data observed before, during, and after disruptive events. We evaluate the proposed approach using datasets from two distinct operational domain network systems and an airport transportation system, demonstrating its domain-agnostic applicability to resilience assessment. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of resilience stage classification, with the best F1-scores ranging from 74.3% to 99.4% across all resilience stages. The overall resilience metrics R_t and RL are estimated, with the best models' MAPE ranging from 0.35-0.82% on IEEE 802.11 and LTE to 1.65-9.56% for the airport. These results provide a basis for threat-agnostic resilience analysis of complex engineering systems, enabling further assessment of how effectively a system withstands, absorbs, and recovers from disruptive events and stress conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种领域与威胁无关的机器学习方法，自动识别系统性能时间序列中的PARA弹性阶段，并据此量化系统弹性。
AI.motivation: 复杂工程系统在受扰动时需评估其抵御、吸收与恢复能力，但缺乏可跨领域、跨威胁类型通用的自动化弹性阶段识别与量化手段。
AI.method: 比较RF、SVM、LightGBM、XGBoost四种模型识别PARA（Plan/Prepare、Absorb、Recover、Adapt）阶段，再用预测结果计算扰动前后及期间性能数据的弹性指标（R_t、RL）。
AI.result: 在两个不同网络系统及机场交通系统数据上验证领域无关性；各阶段最佳F1为74.3%–99.4%；R_t与RL估算的MAPE在IEEE 802.11和LTE上为0.35–0.82%，机场为1.65–9.56%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为复杂工程系统提供威胁无关的弹性分析基础，可进一步评估系统抵御、吸收与恢复扰动的效能。

title: Event-WAM: Learning to Act with Event-Derived Futures
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage future visual modeling for robotic action learning, with recent studies exploring alternative or complementary objectives beyond conventional RGB prediction. We introduce Event-WAM, which incorporates event-derived visual changes as auxiliary future supervision alongside RGB. Event-WAM constructs temporally structured event representations from RGB demonstrations and encodes them using a frozen pretrained RGB video VAE, without training an event-specific VAE. Joint RGB--Event latent flow matching provides appearance- and change-oriented supervision without requiring event observations or explicit future generation at inference. Across simulated benchmarks, Event-WAM maintains comparable performance under standard conditions, while robustness gains under perturbations are benchmark-dependent, including improvements on LIBERO-Plus. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate improved manipulation success under both standard and unseen perturbation conditions. Further analyses show that policy improvements are not consistently accompanied by higher future prediction fidelity, suggesting the potential of change-oriented supervision for action learning.

AI.tldr: Event-WAM 将事件相机衍生的视觉变化作为辅助未来监督，与 RGB 一同用于机器人动作学习，无需事件 VAE 或推理时事件输入。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 主要依赖 RGB 未来预测作为监督，缺少对"变化"这一动作相关信号的显式建模；而引入事件视觉通常需要额外传感器、专用编码器与推理时输入，代价高。
AI.method: 从 RGB 演示中构造具有时间结构的事件表示，并用冻结的预训练 RGB 视频 VAE 编码（不训练事件专用 VAE）；在隐空间做 RGB–事件联合 latent flow matching，提供外观导向与变化导向的联合监督；推理时不需要事件观测，也不显式生成未来帧。
AI.result: 在多个仿真基准上标准条件下性能相当，扰动下鲁棒性提升依基准而异（如 LIBERO-Plus 有提升）；真实世界实验在标准与未见扰动条件下操作成功率均提升。分析发现策略提升并不总伴随更高的未来预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 变化导向的辅助监督（事件信号）可有效提升动作学习与鲁棒性，且其收益不依赖于更准确的未来视觉预测，说明 WAM 的监督目标设计比预测保真度更关键。

title: UPP-Gauss: Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting for B-mode Novel-View Synthesis
summary: Accurate novel-view synthesis of B-mode ultrasound images requires modeling acoustic propagation through tissue and the resulting appearance variations across probe poses. We propose Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting (UPP-Gauss), which integrates these acoustic interactions into an explicit Gaussian representation. UPP-Gauss constructs acoustic maps by sampling three 3D Gaussian fields using the probe pose and acoustic beam propagation direction, then combines these maps according to ultrasound propagation to synthesize B-mode images. Across three acoustically diverse datasets, UPP-Gauss achieves the best reconstruction quality with efficient rendering, improving PSNR over the best baseline on each dataset by 1.43 dB on average. These results demonstrate accurate and efficient B-mode novel-view synthesis through explicit Gaussian modeling of ultrasound propagation.

AI.tldr: UPP-Gauss 将超声声学传播建模嵌入显式 3D 高斯表示，实现精确高效的 B 超新视角合成。
AI.motivation: B 超新视角合成需同时建模组织中的声波传播与不同探头位姿下的成像外观变化，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建三个 3D 高斯场，依据探头位姿与声束传播方向采样生成声学图，再按超声传播规律组合这些声学图合成 B-mode 图像。
AI.result: 在三个声学特性各异的数据集上取得最佳重建质量，PSNR 平均比最佳基线提升 1.43 dB，且渲染高效。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式高斯建模超声传播，可实现准确且高效的 B 超新视角合成。

title: Investigating the efficacy of vortex beam speckle patterns for the recognition of atmospheric turbulence and fractional topological charge with a deep learning model
summary: Fractional topological charge (TC) enlarges the usable mode set of orbital angular momentum (OAM) links, but reading it reliably after atmospheric turbulence remains difficult. Interferometric and diffractive methods need an undistorted beam and a careful alignment, while most learned approaches treat integer or coarsely spaced charges and do not include turbulence. Here we ask whether the charge of a scalar vortex beam can be regressed directly from a single speckle image, and at which turbulence strength this stops working. We propagate vortex beams over 1500~m through 150 von Kármán phase screens, scatter them with a fixed random diffuser, and record $256\times256$, 16-bit speckle images for TC from 0 to 10 in steps of 0.01 and turbulence strengths $D/r_0$ from 0 to 50; the results reported here use a subset of 20\,000 images, and a data set of $10^{6}$ images is in preparation. A convolutional neural network estimates the TC and, through an auxiliary head, the turbulence category. On charges withheld from training, the mean absolute error is 0.031 without turbulence (with a common intensity scale) and rises to 0.78 at $D/r_0=10$ and 1.85 at $D/r_0=50$, against 2.5 for a constant prediction, and the turbulence category is identified correctly in 78\% of the images. The results show that, at the present training size, the charge is read accurately only without turbulence, and that the charge and the turbulence oth act on the speckle grain size, which may limit the readout. Experimental validation and the extension to vector vortex beams are left for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否从单幅散斑图像直接回归标量涡旋光束的分数拓扑荷(TC)，并确定其在大气湍流下的失效阈值：在无湍流时网络估计误差很小(MAE 0.031)，但随湍流增强迅速恶化(D/r0=10时为0.78，D/r0=50时为1.85)，说明现有训练规模下仅在无湍流条件下可准确读出。
AI.motivation: 分数拓扑荷可扩展OAM链路的可用模式集，但湍流后可靠读出困难：干涉与衍射方法需要无畸变光束与精确对准，多数学习方法只处理整数或粗间隔电荷且未纳入湍流。作者因此希望探索能否直接从单幅散斑图回归分数TC，并界定其可用的湍流强度范围。
AI.method: 用von Kármán相位屏(150个)在1500 m路径上传输涡旋光束，经固定随机散射体产生散斑，记录256×256、16位散斑图像；TC覆盖0–10、步长0.01，湍流强度D/r0为0–50；当前结果使用2万幅子集(百万级数据集在准备中)。采用卷积神经网络回归TC，并设辅助头分类湍流等级。
AI.result: 在训练中未出现的电荷上：无湍流(统一强度尺度)时MAE为0.031；D/r0=10时升至0.78，D/r0=50时为1.85(常数预测为2.5)；湍流类别识别正确率78%。
AI.conclusion: 在现有训练规模下，仅在无湍流时能准确读出电荷；电荷与湍流均作用于散斑颗粒尺寸，可能构成读出限制。实验验证与向矢量涡旋光束的推广留待后续工作。

title: Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning
summary: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $π_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $π_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

AI.tldr: 提出全景感知无人机目标跟踪新范式，构建360UAV-ETrack基准并提出360UAV-TVLA视觉-语言-动作框架，显著提升闭环跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 传统具身无人机跟踪将目标可观测性与航向控制耦合，目标易离开前视相机视野；本文探索利用全球形（全景）感知在不主动调整航向的情况下跟踪指定目标。
AI.method: 构建360UAV-ETrack仿真基准（2652条序列、超173万同步观测、8类跟踪任务、150个留出闭环场景）；提出360UAV-TVLA全景VLA框架，包含持久视觉指代PVR、压缩时序记忆CTM、几何对齐轨迹监督GTS，用于实例识别、运动推理与三维控制。
AI.result: 在两种VLA骨干上均优于标准微调：π0归一化平均跟踪帧数从22.56%提升至35.28%，π0.5从25.68%提升至33.64%；并揭示离线模仿精度与闭环跟踪可靠性之间的显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 全景感知解耦航向控制为目标跟踪提供可行范式，所构建基准具挑战性，为未来无人机具身跟踪研究提供测试平台。

title: Tune for Retention, Not Just Gain: SFT Forgets Far Less than You Think
summary: Catastrophic forgetting, the drastic loss of previously acquired capabilities when learning new ones, is a central challenge in language model fine-tuning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely believed to be prone to such forgetting. Recent works have attributed this to the off-policy nature of SFT, arguing that on-policy learning is key to continual learning. In this paper, we challenge this premise. We show that while maximizing new-task performance can induce catastrophic forgetting, alternative hyperparameter choices (lower learning rate and batch size) can yield similar gains with little to no forgetting. With hyperparameters selected jointly for gain and retention, vanilla SFT retains prior capabilities far better than previously suggested and can be competitive with Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), an on-policy approach designed to mitigate forgetting. While SDFT can be more robust to hyperparameter choices, it also requires a retention-aware criterion to identify hyperparameter configurations that avoid catastrophic forgetting. Our results challenge the view that on-policy training is what enables learning with retention and raise broader questions about what drives catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战"灾难性遗忘源于SFT的off-policy特性"这一观点，证明合理选择超参数（较小学习率与批量）的vanilla SFT可在获得新任务收益的同时几乎不遗忘，效果可与on-policy的SDFT竞争。
AI.motivation: 近期工作将SFT的灾难性遗忘归因于其off-policy特性，主张on-policy学习是持续学习的关键。作者质疑这一前提。
AI.method: 系统考察超参数（学习率、批量大小）对新任务性能与旧能力保持的联合影响；采用同时针对"增益"和"保持"的超参数选择准则，对比vanilla SFT与Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) 的遗忘表现。
AI.result: 追求新任务性能最大化会导致灾难性遗忘，但较小学习率和批量大小可取得相近收益且几乎不遗忘；联合选取超参数的vanilla SFT保持能力远优于以往结论，并能与SDFT竞争；SDFT虽对超参数更鲁棒，但同样需要保持感知准则才能避免遗忘。
AI.conclusion: on-policy训练并非实现"学习同时保持"的必要条件；结果对"何种因素驱动微调中的灾难性遗忘"提出更广泛的疑问。

title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
summary: Diagnosing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires hypothesis-driven reasoning: pathologists form a differential diagnosis, seek discriminative evidence, weigh its reliability, and stop once it suffices. However, existing training-free WSI agents lack an explicit framework for such reasoning. They typically use a large language model (LLM) to aggregate the region descriptions of a multimodal LLM (MLLM), without a belief over the candidates or regard for the descriptions' reliability. Consequently, a repeated model error counts as independent evidence for an incorrect diagnosis. We introduce BayesPath, a training-free WSI agent that casts the pathologist's Scan-Look-Weigh-Decide process as reliability-aware Bayesian reasoning. An explicit belief over the candidates is updated with each observation through a reliability-aware likelihood and guides where to look next and when to stop. This likelihood corrects for the models' answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and captures diagnostic confusions estimated without labels. The updates form an interpretable evidence trail of how each observation shapes the belief. On five MultiPathQA tasks spanning slide classification and slide VQA, BayesPath achieves the highest average accuracy among training-free agents, 58.6% against 34.1% for the next best, with large gains on slide classification. On identical observations, Bayesian updating outperforms LLM aggregation on average, even with a larger LLM. BayesPath's belief is also better calibrated than naive Bayes, so uncertain cases can be deferred to pathologists. Code is available at https://github.com/bryanwong17/BayesPath

AI.tldr: BayesPath 是一个免训练的 WSI 智能体，把病理医生的"扫描-观察-权衡-决策"过程建模为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理，在五个 MultiPathQA 任务上平均准确率达 58.6%，远超次优方法的 34.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练 WSI 智能体缺乏显式推理框架：仅用 LLM 汇总 MLLM 的区域描述，既没有对候选诊断的信念表示，也不考虑描述可靠性，导致模型的重复错误被当作独立证据，从而强化错误诊断。病理诊断本质是假设驱动的推理过程（形成鉴别诊断、寻找区分性证据、权衡可靠性、证据充分即停止），现有方法未体现这一点。
AI.method: 将诊断过程形式化为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理：维护对候选诊断的显式信念，每次观察通过可靠性感知似然函数更新信念，并据此引导下一步观察位置与停止时机。该似然函数可校正模型答案偏差、对相关观察降权，并利用无标签方式估计的诊断混淆关系。
AI.result: 在涵盖切片分类与切片 VQA 的五个 MultiPathQA 任务上，BayesPath 在免训练智能体中取得最高平均准确率 58.6%（次优 34.1%），切片分类任务提升尤为显著。在相同观察下，贝叶斯更新的效果平均优于 LLM 聚合，即使后者使用更大的 LLM。此外，其信念校准优于朴素贝叶斯，可将不确定病例交由病理医生复核。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可靠性感知的贝叶斯信念更新是构建免训练 WSI 智能体的有效框架，能提供可解释的证据链并支持不确定性延迟决策；代码已开源。

title: ChemoMAE: Self-Supervised Spectral Representation Learning Reveals Chemical Heterogeneity in Historical Wood
comment: 51 pages, 18 figures (9 in the main text and 9 in the appendices)
summary: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用自监督Transformer（ChemoMAE）对日本历史木构建筑49个木材试样的近红外高光谱图像学习像素级光谱表征，并以局部标签一致性（LLA）量化聚类空间连续性，进而提出木材内部与表面劣化的机理假设。
AI.motivation: 历史木构建筑中多种环境因素数百年作用于化学组成随解剖区域变化的木材，形成复杂劣化模式；理解这些模式对保护修复至关重要，但其机制尚不清楚。同时，不同树种与使用历史的试样难以在统一基础上比较，且缺乏预定义化学状态类别。
AI.method: 对49个历史建筑木材横切面做近红外高光谱成像；用ChemoMAE（掩码去噪自监督Transformer，利用光谱变量间的多重共线性）学习像素级表征；对表征聚类得到无预定义类别的空间图；提出Local Label Agreement（LLA）衡量相邻像素标签一致性，并与基线方法比较；随后重新训练并在全部试样上拟合聚类中心。
AI.result: 在验证试样上，仅用光谱时ChemoMAE的平均LLA高于基线方法；跨全部试样得到的空间图呈现出与木材解剖结构和表面暴露预期效应一致的空间结构。
AI.conclusion: 结合区域光谱、空间分布与木材解剖、使用历史及既有研究，提出木材内部与表面劣化的机理模型假设；该探索性AI for Science框架为将自监督学到的潜在模式与领域知识关联、研究材料状态形成机制提供基础。

title: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
summary:
Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies.
  Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance.
  Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文提出TAT-Det——首个面向儿童睾丸附件扭转(TAT)的专家标注超声数据集，含1203例患者2600张图像，提供病灶级检测框与像素级分割掩码，并给出目标检测与分割基线。
AI.motivation: TAT是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的首要病因，但临床表现非特异，且缺乏标准化的儿童急性阴囊急症数据集，导致诊断困难、缺乏AI研究基础资源。
AI.method: 在浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院采集1203例患者共2600张超声图像；对TAT阳性图像标注病灶级边界框（检测）和像素级分割掩码；采用多阶段流程：由认证儿科超声医师独立标注、共识复核与精修。并使用代表性深度学习模型建立目标检测与语义分割基线基准。
AI.result: 提供检测与分割基线基准，其中YOLO11m取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet取得最佳分割性能。
AI.conclusion: TAT-Det弥补了儿童急诊超声公开资源的空白，为自动化TAT分析的AI方法开发与评估奠定基础。

title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
summary: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. After a supervised cross-page warm-up and multi-page fine-tuning with DocSEAM frozen, our 9B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated open-weight models of up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks. We further show that under controlled re-pagination, DocSEAM reduces sensitivity to boundary placement and improves cross-page span localization

AI.tldr: DocSEAM 是一个轻量模块，通过在视觉编码器与语言模型之间注入跨页上下文偏置，缓解多页文档模型中页面边界处的特征不连续问题，在 5 个多页文档 VQA 基准上取得 10B 以下开源模型中的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多页文档视觉语言模型逐页独立编码，视觉 token 在形成时无法访问相邻页面内容，导致页面边界出现特征级不连续；语言模型只能基于这些孤立形成的页表示进行推理，缺乏局部跨页上下文归纳偏置。
AI.method: DocSEAM（Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking），插入在预训练视觉编码器与语言模型之间。对每页构建"中心页+左右两邻居"的局部三元组，采用中心锚定的掩码自注意力并配合方向显著性门控融合邻居信息，仅返回增强后的中心页 token，视觉 token 数量不变。训练上先做有监督跨页预热，再在多页微调时冻结 DocSEAM。
AI.result: 9B 参数模型在五个多页文档 VQA 基准上，于 10B 参数以内的开源权重模型中达到 SOTA。在受控重新分页实验中，DocSEAM 降低了对边界切分位置的敏感性，并提升了跨页片段定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 以轻量、不改 token 数的方式为视觉表示注入局部跨页上下文，可有效缓解页边界不连续问题，提升多页文档理解性能与对分页方式的鲁棒性。

title: Learning from Crowds with Unsupervised Item Response Models
summary: Item Response Theory (IRT) is the study of tests, including the properties of both test items and test takers. Crowdsourced labelling can be cast as an unsupervised IRT problem: annotators play the role of test takers with varying ability, and annotation tasks play the role of items with varying difficulty. We evaluate unsupervised variants of standard logistic IRT models for latent trait recovery and label inference on six datasets with crowdsourced labels and known ground truths. Unsupervised IRT models can recover annotator and item traits (e.g., ability, difficulty and discrimination) reliably across most datasets when compared to supervised variants trained on the ground truth. IRT models seem to be more stable in label inference compared to most baselines, but might not be the best possible choice depending on the dataset. We further propose to use IRT models to inform classifiers during training and compare against existing crowd-learning methods. We find that crowd-learning methods can improve F1 over majority-vote baselines, but no method significantly improves both F1 and calibration. IRT-informed curriculum methods seem to preserve calibration better than other crowd-learning methods, but are not at the frontier regarding F1, and the best crowd-learning methods in terms of F1 seem to be miscalibrated.

AI.tldr: 该文将众包标注建模为无监督IRT问题，在六个有真值的数据集上系统评估无监督IRT模型对标注者/题目潜在特质的恢复能力与标签推断表现，并提出用IRT指导分类器训练（课程学习），与现有众包学习方法对比。
AI.motivation: 众包标注中标注者能力与任务难度存在差异，传统多数投票等方法忽略这一结构；IRT天然刻画"被试能力—题目难度"，但无监督IRT在众包标签推断中的可靠性以及能否用于改进下游分类器，尚缺乏系统实证。
AI.method: 将众包标注视为无监督IRT问题（标注者≈被试，任务≈条目）；在六个带真值的众包数据集上评估标准logistic IRT模型的无监督变体，与用真值训练的监督变体对比；进一步用IRT模型生成信息以指导分类器训练（IRT-informed课程方法），并与已有众包学习方法比较F1与校准。
AI.result: 无监督IRT在多数数据集上能较可靠地恢复标注者能力、题目难度与区分度，接近监督变体；标签推断稳定性优于多数基线，但并非所有数据集上的最优选择。众包学习方法可提升F1，但没有方法同时显著改善F1与校准：IRT课程方法校准保持更好但F1非最前沿，F1最优方法往往校准较差。
AI.conclusion: IRT是众包标注分析与标签推断的稳健工具，但需按数据集选择；其作为训练信号在校准上有优势，F1与校准之间存在权衡，尚无明显兼顾两者的方法。

title: A Computational Model of Continuous Recognition Memory for Natural Images
summary: Recognizing an image we have seen before is a basic function of human visual memory. Understanding human continuous recognition memory (CRM) can help machine vision systems predict which images people are likely to remember and generate more memorable images. It can also inform the diagnosis of memory impairments and the development of interventions to improve memory. This paper proposes the first computational model for CRM. The model captures three key components of continuous recognition memory (CRM): image encoding, memory decay, and decision making. It encodes each image as a distinct random variable in a perceptual space. As the memory of an image fades, the distribution of its random variable drifts within that space. To decide whether the current image has been seen before, the observer retrieves samples from the distributions associated with previously encoded images and compares them with the current image. Our model predicts human observers' trial-by-trial responses in CRM tasks within the variability observed across human participants. Our model is parameter efficient, requiring only four shared parameters and two parameters per observer. It can accurately predict the memorability of an image no worse than prior methods that require millions of parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个针对人类连续再认记忆（CRM）的计算模型，通过图像编码、记忆衰退与决策三个阶段刻画记忆过程，仅需极少参数即可逐试次预测人类判断，并预测图像记忆性。
AI.motivation: 理解人类连续再认记忆有助于机器视觉预测人易记住的图像、生成更具记忆性的图像，并辅助记忆障碍诊断与干预。现有方法缺乏对人类CRM机制的计算建模，且预测记忆性往往依赖海量参数。
AI.method: 模型含三个组件：(1) 将每张图像编码为感知空间中的一个随机变量；(2) 记忆衰退时该随机变量的分布在空间中漂移；(3) 判断当前图像是否见过时，从已编码图像对应分布中采样并与当前图像比较。模型仅含4个共享参数和每位观察者2个参数。
AI.result: 模型能在人类参与者间的变异范围内逐试次预测CRM任务反应；参数高效（4共享+2/人）；图像记忆性预测精度不劣于需数百万参数的先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立首个CRM计算模型，以极少参数同时解释人类逐试次行为并预测图像记忆性，为记忆机制研究与机器视觉应用提供统一框架。

title: Automated Batch-Variable Selection for ComBat-Based Radiomic Harmonization
summary:
ComBat harmonizes multicentre radiomic features, but batch variables are usually chosen manually, without a standardized criterion across image acquisition parameters. We propose ParsiComBat, which selects acquisition parameters for ComBat, balancing batch-effect removal against feature-structure preservation and abstaining when technical variation is negligible.
  ParsiComBat ranks candidate acquisition parameters by batch effect, filters redundancy, and scores sequential ComBat corrections. We evaluated it in three experiments: in simulations, testing whether it recovered a known batch variable and abstained without one; in CT (NSCLC-Radiomics) and MRI (MAMA-MIA) cohorts, comparing batch-effect removal against manufacturer (manual), every feasible parameter (greedy) and AutoCombat; and in clinical prediction, internally and externally.
  In simulations, ParsiComBat identified the true batch variable in 92.9% of positive trials and abstained in 99.2% of null controls. In CT, correcting for reconstruction kernel reduced mean k-nearest neighbour batch-effect test from 0.276 to 0.032, almost matching greedy correction of six variables. In MRI, correcting for slice thickness and manufacturer reduced it from 0.680 to 0.325, slightly more than manual selection but less than greedy correction of seven variables. Removing technical variation did not improve clinical discrimination: no strategy, including raw features, differed significantly from ParsiComBat in area under the curve.
  ParsiComBat provides a data-driven framework that removes technical batch effects using minimal acquisition parameters, preserving feature structure and clinical discrimination. It selects variables verifiable against the acquisition protocol and abstains when no correction is needed, supporting transparent, reproducible multicentre radiomics.

AI.tldr: ParsiComBat 是一种数据驱动的 ComBat 批次变量自动选择框架，通过排序候选采集参数、去冗余并评估顺序校正效果，在去除技术批次效应的同时保留特征结构与临床判别力，并在无技术变异时"弃权"不校正。
AI.motivation: ComBat 能调和多中心影像组学特征，但其批次变量通常靠人工选择，缺乏跨图像采集参数的统一标准，容易造成过度或不足校正。
AI.method: 按批次效应对候选采集参数排序，过滤冗余变量，并对顺序 ComBat 校正方案打分，在批次效应去除与特征结构保留之间权衡；无显著技术变异时弃权。实验包括：(1) 仿真测试能否恢复已知批次变量并在无批次时弃权；(2) CT（NSCLC-Radiomics）与 MRI（MAMA-MIA）队列，与人工选择厂商、贪心（全部可行参数）及 AutoCombat 对比；(3) 内部与外部临床预测验证。
AI.result: 仿真中正例识别真实批次变量 92.9%，无批次对照弃权率 99.2%。CT 上校正重建核使 kNN 批次效应检验均值从 0.276 降至 0.032，接近贪心校正六个变量的效果；MRI 上校正层厚与厂商使 0.680 降至 0.325，优于人工选择但弱于贪心校正七个变量。去除技术变异未改善临床判别力，AUC 上任何策略（含原始特征）与 ParsiComBat 均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: ParsiComBat 以最少采集参数去除技术批次效应，保留特征结构与临床判别力，所选变量可与采集协议核验，并在无需校正时弃权，支持透明可复现的多中心影像组学。

title: Where to Approximate: Understanding and Accelerating Looped Multi-View Reconstruction
summary: Looped multi-view reconstruction refines scene features by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block. Making these updates cheaper requires knowing how an approximation at one step affects the rest of the refinement. We study this with paired interventions in Déjà View and stacked reconstruction transformers, separating the error an approximation injects, how that error propagates, and how it affects the output. In Déjà View, approximation errors are attenuated more strongly than matched random perturbations under a scale-adjusted state-error measure, and a local Jacobian decomposition separates the contribution of channel gating from the response to spatial error structure. Spatial approximations made early benefit from subsequent refinement, whereas cross-step reuse depends on which quantity is cached and how reuse steps are spaced. At equal final norm, approximation errors change the predicted rotations 1.55 times as much as random errors. These findings guide our proposed method, which reduces spatial resolution and pools keys and values early in refinement, then interleaves attention-output reuse with full attention, and is adapted through lightweight self-distillation. Across five reconstruction benchmarks, the balanced configuration runs $1.63\times$ faster than the official 16-step Déjà View model with a 1.86-point reduction in average pose AUC@$3^\circ$. At matched latency, it exceeds the interpolated curve of a trained baseline using full refinement blocks by 4.73 points in AUC@$3^\circ$ and improves the corresponding geometry metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过配对干预实验分析循环多视图重建中近似误差的注入、传播与输出影响，并据此提出降分辨率、早期池化KV、注意力输出复用交错及自蒸馏的加速方法。
AI.motivation: 循环多视图重建反复使用共享transformer块，降低单步开销需理解某一步近似如何影响后续细化过程。
AI.method: 在Déjà View与堆叠重建transformer上做配对干预，分离误差注入、传播与输出效应；用尺度校正的状态误差度量比较近似误差与随机扰动，并用局部雅可比分解区分通道门控与空间误差结构响应。据此提出：早期降低空间分辨率并池化keys/values，将注意力输出复用与完整注意力交错，通过轻量自蒸馏适配。
AI.result: 近似误差比匹配随机扰动被更强衰减；早期空间近似可受益于后续细化，跨步复用效果依赖缓存量与复用间隔；等最终范数下近似误差对预测旋转的改变是随机误差的1.55倍。五个基准上，平衡配置比官方16步Déjà View快1.63倍，平均pose AUC@3°仅降1.86；同延迟下比全细化块训练基线插值曲线高4.73点AUC@3°并改善几何指标。
AI.conclusion: 对近似误差机理的分析可指导有效的重建加速设计，在较小精度损失下显著提速并优于同延迟基线。

title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
summary: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. NeurCo improves requirement satisfaction from 46.8% to 52.3% on Wan and from 66.5% to 69.3% on Minimax H3, and achieves further gains when combined with prompt enhancers, including on Seedance 2.5. Our analysis reveals model-specific differences in control capabilities and trade-offs between controllability and photorealism, highlighting capability-guided compilation as a promising approach to programmable generative video rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出 Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo)，通过自动探测冻结的视频生成模型的可靠能力，构建"能力手册"，并将用户意图编译为模型特定的执行策略，同时发布 VComBench 基准。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频模型缺乏像 HTML/CSS 或 Blender 那样可预测的控制接口，其能力隐式地来自训练，难以判断哪些需求能被可靠执行。
AI.method: 用模型无关的中间表示（对象、约束、事件、相机）表达用户意图，自动探测冻结模型以构建模型特定能力手册，再编译为模型特定执行策略：可靠需求保持不变，不可靠需求被选择性改写或编译为替代执行方式；并提出含380个多需求组合任务的 VComBench（覆盖 T2V、I2V、参考图生视频）。
AI.result: Wan 上需求满足率从46.8%提升至52.3%，Minimax H3 从66.5%提升至69.3%，与提示增强器结合后进一步提升（包括 Seedance 2.5）。
AI.conclusion: 分析揭示了模型间控制能力的差异以及可控性与照片真实感之间的取舍，表明能力引导的编译是实现可编程生成式视频渲染的有前景路径。

title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models
summary: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades requires the output of every model on every item, and its cost. Stored collections built for routing keep no per-option probabilities. We provide a dataset on which ensemble methods, routers and cascades are simulated quickly, without new model calls. DecisionReplay holds the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models, endpoints that return a probability for every answer option, on 35 benchmarks, with the token counts, billed cost and measured latency of every call, all released. A deterministic simulator replays any policy that selects, combines or cascades them. One well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat: pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it, and stacking gains 1.0 points at 3.4 times its cost. The models are wrong together: two that are both wrong choose the same wrong option in 72% of cases. The best router matches that model at 64% of its cost, and certified early exit cuts the cost of a stacked ensemble by 43% without changing an answer. DecisionReplay makes it cheap and fast to test whether a new method changes these results.

AI.tldr: 发布 DecisionReplay 数据集与模拟器，低成本复现集成、路由与级联策略的评估。
AI.motivation: 比较集成、路由器与级联需每个模型在每个样本上的输出及成本，但现有路由集合缺少逐选项概率，重新调用模型代价高。
AI.method: 收集17个商用决策模型在35个基准上的完整概率向量、token数、计费成本与实测延迟；提供确定性模拟器回放任意选择、组合或级联策略。
AI.result: 每基准选单一最优模型难以超越：池化集成低2.7点，堆叠高1.0点但成本3.4倍；两模型同错时72%选同一错误项；最佳路由器以64%成本达到同等精度；认证早退在不改变答案下将堆叠成本降43%。
AI.conclusion: DecisionReplay 使快速低成本检验新方法成为可能，并揭示模型错误高度相关、路由与早退更具性价比。

title: RefMix: Expanding Endpoint Proposals for Diversity-Preserving Reward Fine-Tuning
summary: Online forward matching aligns flow-based generative models by repeatedly generating, rewarding, and fitting model-produced endpoints. However, this behavior creates an on-policy feedback loop: as high-reward modes become increasingly favored, alternative modes become less likely to appear in subsequent training pools, progressively reducing visual diversity. We introduce RefMix, a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy that addresses this limitation by injecting alternative candidates into the training pool while retaining the original task reward and forward matching objective. In particular, RefMix uses a reference model during early high-noise steps to expose alternative visual modes, followed by the current reward-tuned model for endpoint completion. Across state-of-the-art online forward matching methods, RefMix consistently improves visual diversity while preserving task reward performance. Controlled inference experiments further demonstrate that training-time endpoint exposure is critical to improve reward--diversity trade-offs, beyond the impact of reference-assisted inference. By rethinking how training endpoints are proposed, RefMix achieves up to 44% higher diversity over forward matching baselines at comparable reward levels.

AI.tldr: RefMix 提出参考辅助的端点提议策略，缓解在线前向匹配中的策略内反馈回路导致多样性衰减问题。
AI.motivation: 在线前向匹配反复生成、奖励、拟合模型端点，形成 on-policy 反馈回路：高奖励模式被不断强化，其他模式逐渐消失，视觉多样性持续下降。
AI.method: RefMix 在训练池中注入替代候选：早期高噪声阶段用参考模型暴露其他视觉模式，随后由当前奖励调优模型完成端点补全，同时保留原始任务奖励与前向匹配目标。
AI.result: 在多个 SOTA 在线前向匹配方法上一致提升视觉多样性并保持奖励性能；受控推理实验表明训练时端点暴露是关键；相比基线在同等奖励水平下多样性最高提升 44%。
AI.conclusion: 重新设计训练端点的提议方式是改善奖励-多样性权衡的有效途径，超越仅靠参考辅助推理的收益。

title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
summary: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.

AI.tldr: 将代理-目标模型间的不匹配建模为多保真赌博机问题，用配对审计残差纠正数据分配决策，证明理论界并在CivilComments-WILDS上验证。
AI.motivation: 数据分配常用小代理模型为更大目标模型挑选训练数据，但代理模型的排序可能与目标模型不一致，导致次优训练效果。需要显式建模并纠正这种不匹配。
AI.method: 将数据分配决策建模为多保真赌博机（每臂=数据干预），代理奖励每轮可见，目标奖励仅在罕见审计时与同一更新配对观测；由此识别逐臂不匹配（不假设共享偏移或排序保持）。提出不匹配校正赌博机：用配对残差纠正代理、仅审计不确定决策、在训练中分配审计预算，并采用滑动窗口策略应对突变。
AI.result: 理论上给出遗憾分解与平稳条件下的下界：仅用代理可致线性遗憾，且需要最少配对审计次数；突变下早期耗尽审计预算也会导致线性遗憾，滑动窗口策略达到 √(Γ_T T log T) 量级遗憾。实验在CivilComments-WILDS上用BERT-Small指导BERT-Large训练，不匹配纠正相比同等目标预算的target-only策略提升最差组准确率；同等审计次数下，分散审计使最差组准确率提升6.3–10.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 代理与目标的不匹配可被显式建模和纠正；通过配对审计与预算时间分散可显著提升公平性指标下的数据分配效果，并具理论保证。

title: Predicting acute food crises and discovering actionable drivers with causal machine learning
summary: Acute food insecurity is driven by a compound of conflict, adverse climate events, displacement, and economic shocks. We enrich the open-access Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset with driver variables (monthly, subnational, 80 countries, 2007--2024) and develop missing-data-resilient machine learning pipelines forecasting crisis occurrence at 3, 6, and 9-month lead times using both FEWS NET and, for the first time at scale, IPC/CH classifications. Pipelines, evaluated through nested cross-validation, outperform no-skill baselines by 15 to 50 percentage points in PR-AUC, with performance correlated with crisis prevalence rather than the classification system. TreeSHAP-based explainability reveals compound, geography-specific predictive signal profiles, with three recurrent forecasting archetypes. Comparing predictive importance against doubly robust causal estimates of actionable drivers, we find that acute conflict events, having the weakest predictive signals, emerge as primary causal drivers of crisis classification whilst agroclimatology is the sole dimension in which predictive importance and causal effect align.

AI.tldr: 本文通过为Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset补充驱动变量，构建抗缺失数据的机器学习流水线，预测次国家级粮食危机（3/6/9个月提前量），并首次大规模使用IPC/CH分类；识别出三类预测模式，并发现预测重要性与因果效应存在错位。
AI.motivation: 急性粮食不安全由冲突、极端气候、流离失所和经济冲击共同驱动，但现有数据缺失严重、资料来源不一，且缺乏对多驱动因素的可预测性与因果作用的系统比较，难以支撑提前预警。
AI.method: 在开放获取的Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset中补充驱动变量（月度、次国家级、80国、2007–2024），构建可容忍缺失值的ML流水线，分别在FEWS NET及首次大规模IPC/CH分类上预测3/6/9个月提前的危机发生；用嵌套交叉验证评估，以TreeSHAP解释重要性，并与双重稳健因果估计进行对比。
AI.result: 流水线在PR-AUC上较无技能基线提升15–50个百分点，且表现更多与危机流行率相关而非分类体系；TreeSHAP揭示复合且地区特异的预测信号，并归纳出三种反复出现的预测原型；急性冲突事件预测信号最弱却是主要因果驱动，农业气候是唯一预测重要性与因果效应一致的维度。
AI.conclusion: 粮食危机可提前数月有效预测，但高预测能力不等于因果驱动，直接以预测模型指导干预可能偏误；预警与政策设计应结合因果证据，重点关注冲突等因果主导因素。

title: Where Does Free-Text 3D Grounding Fail? An Error Analysis of Report-Sentence Segmentation in Chest CT
summary: Free-text 3D grounding, segmenting in a CT volume the region described by one sentence of the radiology report, could link reports to images at scale, but it is unclear where current models fail. We analyse the publicly released VoxTell model on all 381 findings of the 200-scan ReXGroundingCT validation set, where it grounds 53.5% of findings. Its failures are rarely about which lesion or side is meant. No miss lies on the side opposite to the one named, and findings are almost never confused with one another. Instead, predictions are too large, land on a neighbouring lesion on the correct side, or are missing for small findings, and diffuse findings are rarely grounded. Removing location words halves performance, to the level of label-only prompting, and anatomical rules derived from the sentence never improve the full-sentence output. The same pattern holds on the hidden 300-scan test set. Further progress therefore depends on extent estimation and small-lesion sensitivity rather than on anatomical post-processing.

AI.tldr: 对 VoxTell 模型在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集全部381条finding上的错误分析表明，其失败主要不在解剖定位（左右、病灶辨识几乎不出错），而在范围估计与小结节敏感性：预测过大、落到同侧邻近病灶、小结节漏检、弥漫性病灶难以接地；去除位置词会使性能减半至仅标签提示水平，而解剖规则后处理无法提升完整句子的输出，隐藏测试集上趋势一致。
AI.motivation: 自由文本3D接地（按报告单句在CT中分割相应区域）有望大规模连接报告与影像，但当前模型的失败模式尚不清楚，需要系统诊断以指明改进方向。
AI.method: 对公开的 VoxTell 模型在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集全部381条finding（200例扫描）上做逐条错误分析，并在隐藏的300例扫描测试集上复核；同时进行消融：删除句子中的位置词、加入从句子推导的解剖规则，与仅标签提示对比。
AI.result: 模型成功接地53.5%的finding。失败很少涉及"哪个病灶"或"哪一侧"：无遗漏落在句子所述对侧，finding之间几乎不混淆。主要失败是预测范围过大、落在同侧邻近病灶、小结节缺失，弥漫性病灶很少被接地。删除位置词使性能降至约一半（等同仅标签提示水平），解剖规则从未改善完整句子的输出；隐藏测试集结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 未来进展的关键在于范围（extent）估计与小结节敏感性，而非解剖学后处理。结果提示模型已较好掌握粗粒度解剖先验，但缺乏精确边界回归与弱监督下的小目标检测能力。

title: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.

AI.tldr: VIBES用一个对抗式目标替代像素重建，强制隐状态足以预测奖励与下一隐状态，使全局最优诱导双模拟关系，配合容量瓶颈抑制无关干扰，在Distracting Control Suite、Realistic ManiSkill和100连杆游泳机器人上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基于重建的MBRL目标会让模型把表征容量浪费在与任务无关的干扰因素上，损害数据效率与泛化。作者希望用任务充分性（奖励+动力学）而非像素重建来约束表征，且不依赖图像专用增强，能同时适用于向量状态任务。
AI.method: 提出VIBES：以对抗项取代像素重建，要求隐状态足以预测奖励和下一隐状态；理论证明该目标度量编码器距离奖励与动力学充分性的差距，且在可实现精确充分性时其全局最优诱导历史上的双模拟关系。再叠加固定容量隐瓶颈，促使保留任务相关信息、丢弃无关变化。该方法可直接替换Dreamer的模型学习组件。
AI.result: 在Distracting Control Suite上取得SOTA；在Realistic ManiSkill的视觉复杂操作任务上同样有效；在高维向量状态任务（100连杆游泳机器人）上验证可扩展性。UMAP嵌入与最近邻探针分析显示，学到的表征对任务相关结构敏感、对干扰不变。
AI.conclusion: 用奖励与动力学充分性驱动的对抗目标替代重建，可在保留任务相关信息的同时天然忽略干扰，适用范围覆盖视觉与向量状态，是一种通用的MBRL模型学习改进方案。

title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
summary: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.

AI.tldr: 提出 Embodied-VGGT，利用具身采集中的平台-环境几何与重复观测线索，在全局优化中稳健保持局部一致几何，显著降低长序列重建轨迹误差与几何误差。
AI.motivation: 长序列重建需在纠正累积漂移的同时保持局部几何一致性。机器人与自动驾驶的具身采集天然提供重复的平台-环境几何和场景结构、平台运动的重复观测，可用于建立可靠的局部关系，但现有方法未充分利用这些线索。
AI.method: 三个模块：(1) MAGC（记忆增强接地块）基于 Scal3R 的全局上下文记忆，用预测地面几何导出的相对尺度参考来正则化测试时记忆更新，促进跨块一致性并限制对可靠局部几何的改动；(2) SA（超点对齐）在空间区域上平衡地面与非地面证据，估计块间平移；(3) CL（交叉环优化）利用交错窗口间的几何与运动一致性选出连贯块组，每组共享一个 Sim(3) 校正，从而在全局优化中保持组内相对变换。
AI.result: 在五个公开驾驶基准上持续且显著提升长序列重建效果。KITTI Odometry 上平均绝对轨迹误差 7.30 m、Chamfer 距离 2.67 m，在同一评测协议下相比 SOTA 基线分别降低 46.8% 与 23.3%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 充分利用具身采集的几何与运动重复线索，可有效兼顾全局漂移纠正与局部几何一致性，为长序列重建提供稳健范式。

title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
comment: 31 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/maxipetro/lens-diffing-backdoors
summary: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于token readout的通用评分系统，统一评估权重/激活/输出三类后门检测的model diffing方法，并引入J-lens与J++-lens改进权重类及激活类方法。
AI.motivation: 微调过程中后门检测需要统一的比较框架，且现有权重类和激活类方法尚未利用J-lens这类透镜工具来提升检测效果。
AI.method: 构建基于token readout的公共打分系统；在权重类和激活类方法中引入J-lens及其refinement J++-lens；对比被植入后门模型与其基础模型进行实验，并测试针对性的反制（惩罚后门词概率、置换隐藏单元、只训练读取residual stream的层）。
AI.result: J++-lens在所有设定中改善权重类方法，J-lens改善其在单层内的排序；最强单一方法 ΔW J++ 在12个设定中的11个将命名后门的token排进前十；ADL、Diff Mining等输出/激活类方法在模型被惩罚给出后门词概率时失效，而权重类方法受影响；隐藏单元置换或仅训练读取层则相反，能隐藏后门不被权重类方法发现，但ADL/Diff Mining仍可检测。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何单一方法能同时抵御两类攻击；J++-lens是提升权重类后门检测的有效增强，但检测方法的选择需考虑攻击类型。

title: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
summary: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. Further analyses reveal interpretable decision rules and how they evolve through feedback-driven refinement. Comparisons with policies generated without source code access and experiments under challenging conditions further demonstrate the benefits of readable world models. These findings suggest that direct policy synthesis can reduce reliance on trial and error, challenging the necessity of task-specific RL training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种新范式：让基于 LLM 的自主编码智能体通过阅读环境源代码（可读世界模型）直接合成控制策略，并用在线反馈或离线数据迭代改进，无需针对任务做 RL 训练。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在序贯决策中表现优异，但学习有效策略往往需要大量交互经验；基于模型的方法虽借助世界模型缓解该问题，但仍依赖规划或策略优化。作者希望探索一条绕过任务特定 RL 训练的替代路径。
AI.method: LLM 编码智能体分析环境源代码，把环境知识转译为可执行的决策规则（即策略），再通过在线反馈或离线数据反复精炼策略；整个过程不进行任务特定的 RL 训练，并与传统 RL、无源代码访问生成策略等方法进行对比。
AI.result: 在多个决策基准上，合成策略达到或超过传统 RL 方法，且所需经验大幅减少；分析展示了策略具有可解释的决策规则及其在反馈驱动下的演化过程，同时验证了可读世界模型（源代码访问）带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 直接策略合成能减少对试错的依赖，说明任务特定的 RL 训练并非必要，为基于可读世界模型的策略获取提供了新思路。

title: FasterGRN: Reducing the Refinement Redundancy for Accelerating Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Departing from the paradigm of diffusion and autoregressive models, Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) enables high-quality image generation through iterative refinements. However, this repeated processing over the entire visual representations results in substantial computation overhead. Furthermore, the binary representations and global refinement mechanism in GRN disable the direct application of acceleration strategies developed for other generative models. To accelerate GRN model, we first observe several key properties by analyzing the entire generative process. That includes the stage characteristic, dual branch similarity and more importantly, the $\textbf{refinement redundancy}$. Motivated by the observations, we present $\textbf{FasterGRN}$, a training-free acceleration method for the Generative Refinement Network. $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ first divides the GRN into the semantic establishment stage and detail refinement stage according to its semantic establishment. For alleviating the refinement redundancy mainly resulting from the detail refinement stage, we propose Adaptive Retention Expansion ($\textbf{ARE}$) and Selective Token Freezing ($\textbf{STF}$) to shrink refinement steps and reduce token computations, respectively. In the experiments on GenEval and DPG-Bench benchmarks, our method $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ achieves a $2.03\times$ sampling speedup while largely preserving image generation performance. Our evaluation on COCO datasets additionally demonstrates that $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ even outperforms the original GRN in image fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的FasterGRN，通过两阶段划分、自适应保留扩展(ARE)和选择性Token冻结(STF)减少细化冗余，在保持生成质量的同时实现2.03×采样加速。
AI.motivation: Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) 通过迭代细化生成图像，但对整幅视觉表示反复处理带来巨大计算开销；且其二值表示与全局细化机制使其他生成模型的加速策略无法直接适用。
AI.method: 分析整个生成过程，发现阶段特性、双分支相似性及细化冗余等关键性质；据此将GRN划分为语义建立阶段与细节细化阶段，并针对细节细化阶段的冗余提出自适应保留扩展(ARE)以缩减细化步数、选择性Token冻结(STF)以减少Token计算。
AI.result: 在GenEval和DPG-Bench上实现2.03×采样加速且基本保持生成性能；在COCO数据集上图像保真度甚至超越原始GRN。
AI.conclusion: FasterGRN是一种无需训练的GRN加速方法，通过利用生成过程的内在特性有效消除细化冗余，在速度与质量间取得良好平衡。

title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
summary: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weight models, SEPO ranks first in 8 of 12 settings on the harmonic mean of quality, diversity, and novelty, while no baseline leads in more than two. On average, it raises LLM-judged diversity from 1.92 to 3.43 and novelty from 1.00 to 3.34 over base sampling (1-5 scale), with quality decreasing from 3.72 to 3.30. We further show that expanding the optimized ensemble increases separation among prompt-conditioned response distributions. These results support system prompt ensemble optimization as a promising approach to improving LLM creativity at inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的SEPO框架，通过系统提示词集成优化，在推理时提升大模型创造性生成的多样性、新颖性与质量
AI.motivation: 偏好对齐后的LLM存在模式坍缩，输出集中于少量高奖励响应，损害创造性生成；现有测试时方法偏重多样性，忽视单条响应是否同时高质量且新颖，而实际用户常只需一条有说服力的原创回答。
AI.method: 将创造性生成形式化为多目标分布优化问题；SEPO结合提示词演化与贪心max-min选择，在质量约束下寻找行为相异的系统提示词，推理时对每条响应均匀采样一个提示词。
AI.result: 在四个质量要求递增的创造性生成任务与三个开源模型上，SEPO在12种设置中8项于质量、多样性、新颖性调和均值上排名第一（无基线超过两项）；多样性1.92→3.43、新颖性1.00→3.34，质量3.72→3.30（1-5分）。扩展集成规模可增大提示词条件分布的分离度。
AI.conclusion: 系统提示词集成优化是推理时提升LLM创造力的有前景方法，需在质量与多样性间权衡。

title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
summary: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. We analyze gradients and an early training update to provide local evidence that updates learned at one ratio can benefit compression at other ratios. These results show that LLift can improve compression across deployment budgets without fine-tuning each compressed model separately.

AI.tldr: LLift 通过一次低秩微调，让预训练模型在多个压缩比下直接做 SVD 压缩都不再需要逐比例微调。
AI.motivation: 基于 SVD 的压缩通常会带来性能下降，需要后续微调或权重修正；而针对不同压缩预算又要重复进行比例专属优化，成本高。
