AI.method: 在单一压缩比下，以原模型为教师微调一个低秩近似；将学到的更新合并回原始权重，同时保留未参与训练前向的互补分量；再对目标矩阵做 SVD，并在不同截断秩下复用同一分解。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-7B 上，单个准备好的模型在三种压缩比下均取得精度提升，且提升可泛化到不同模型家族、模型规模和 SVD 压缩算子；梯度与早期训练更新的分析提供了单比例更新可惠及其他比例压缩的局部证据。
AI.conclusion: LLift 无需对每个压缩模型单独微调，即可在不同部署预算下改善 SVD 压缩效果。

title: geo-eval-harness: An Evaluation Harness for Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial foundation model (GFM) research papers are plagued by inconsistent evaluation settings (e.g., different pre-processing and probes), making it difficult to separate performance from evaluation choices. We propose geo-eval-harness}, an open-source framework for controlled model comparisons. We use this harness to evaluate 100 GFMs and general vision models on 6 classification and 14 segmentation datasets, using multiple probes on frozen or low-rank-adapted encoders. We show that under controlled evaluation, general vision backbones are competitive on RGB classification and high-resolution segmentation, but GFMs shine on multispectral tasks. When we compare any two of the top-ten classification models on a single dataset, their 95% confidence intervals overlap 73% of the time. We show that bigger models are not always better: inference FLOPs correlate weakly with segmentation performance. Moreover, translating inference compute into large-area mapping workloads shows how small accuracy differences have outsized deployment cost differences: with frozen encoders on SpaceNet2, a 0.9-point mIoU difference corresponds to 5.9x the compute and days of additional projected GPU time. Our findings stress the importance of comparing models under explicit and fixed settings, and reporting uncertainty and deployment compute alongside accuracy. Our geo-eval-harness makes controlled experiments easy, fast, and fully reproducible. We release the code, configurations, and results at https://github.com/torchgeo/geo-eval-harness.

AI.tldr: 提出开源框架 geo-eval-harness，用统一受控的评测设置对 100 个地理空间基础模型（GFM）与通用视觉模型进行对比，覆盖 6 个分类与 14 个分割数据集，并强调不确定性与部署算力的报告。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型研究普遍存在评测设置不一致（预处理、探针各异）的问题，导致难以区分模型性能差异与评测选择带来的差异。
AI.method: 构建开源受控评测框架 geo-eval-harness；在冻结或低秩适配（LoRA 类）编码器上使用多种探针，评测 100 个 GFM 与通用视觉模型，覆盖 6 个分类、14 个分割数据集，并分析置信区间、推理 FLOPs 与实际大面积制图工作负载的部署成本。
AI.result: 受控评测下，通用视觉骨干在 RGB 分类与高分辨率分割上具竞争力，GFM 在多光谱任务上占优；前十分类模型两两对比时 95% 置信区间重叠率达 73%；模型越大并非越好，推理 FLOPs 与分割性能仅弱相关；SpaceNet2 上 0.9 点 mIoU 差异对应 5.9 倍算力与数天额外 GPU 时间。
AI.conclusion: 模型比较必须在明确且固定的设置下进行，并同时报告不确定性与部署算力；geo-eval-harness 使受控实验快速、可复现，代码、配置与结果已开源。

title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.

AI.tldr: SPLICE 通过对失败轨迹构造局部训练目标，解决长时程智能体任务中 group-based RL 全失败组无梯度的问题，并在 SWE 与 Deep Research 任务上优于 GRPO 和全轨迹引导基线。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的分组强化学习（如 GRPO）在长时程智能体任务上常出现“全失败组”：所有采样轨迹奖励为零，导致组内相对优势无定义、无法产生基于奖励的策略梯度。常见补救是用更强模型提供完整解，但完整轨迹代价高，且让学习器暴露在过长的离策略历史上。
AI.method: SPLICE 在线从当前策略的失败轨迹中构造局部训练目标：对每个全失败组，由提议模型在当前策略轨迹上选取一个拼接点，并从该点生成若干有界选项；用重复的当前策略续写估计每个选项的价值，将正价值估计转换为回报加权的局部目标，再在选项上拟合当前策略。
AI.result: 在两种策略族、两个长时程智能体任务（SWE-bench Verified 与 BrowseComp-Plus）共四个设置上，SPLICE 全部优于 GRPO 与全轨迹引导基线，较 GRPO 提升 2.8–9.8 个百分点；在初始失败的 SWE 任务上，将 GRPO 的“毕业率”提高 10.8 个百分点；同时降低了昂贵的提议模型计算量。
AI.conclusion: 局部拼接目标为全失败组提供了有效且低成本的学习信号，兼顾性能提升与计算效率。

title: Provably Efficient Concave Utility Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
summary: Concave utility reinforcement learning (CURL) unifies a diverse range of problems, including standard reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning, and maximum entropy exploration. Unlike standard RL, CURL generally requires estimating high-dimensional state-action occupancy measures. Consequently, existing methods for CURL either sidestep the exploration problem, are restricted to the tabular setting, or lack computationally efficient policy optimization. To address this, we study CURL in finite-horizon episodic bilinear MDPs, where the transition model admits a low-dimensional representation in known feature spaces. We use the bilinear structure to efficiently estimate occupancy measures via low-dimensional feature expectations, and propose a model-based optimistic concave utility policy optimization (OCUPO) framework. We first instantiate OCUPO in the on-policy setting, where each iteration uses independent trajectories to estimate the concave utility policy gradient, and prove an $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-4})$ sample complexity. To improve sample efficiency, we then instantiate OCUPO in the off-policy setting. We propose a novel backward feature regression subroutine that reuses trajectories collected by past policies to estimate the occupancy measure of the current policy. Under suitable technical assumptions on the policy class (satisfied, e.g., by log-linear policies with sufficiently expressive features), we prove that the resulting algorithm achieves an $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity, up to a controllable projection error. We further extend our framework to linear MDPs and show that the resulting off-policy algorithm retains the same sample complexity. In these settings, the dependence on $ε$ matches that for standard RL with linear function approximation. Moreover, our algorithms do not rely on the integral oracle required by prior work.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究有限时域双线性 MDP 下的凹效用强化学习（CURL），利用低维特征期望估计占用测度，提出乐观凹效用策略优化框架 OCUPO，实现 on-policy O(ε⁻⁴) 与 off-policy O(ε⁻²) 的样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: CURL 统一了标准 RL、模仿学习与最大熵探索等问题，但通常需要估计高维状态-动作占用测度。现有方法要么回避探索问题，要么局限于表格情形，要么缺乏计算高效的策略优化手段，因此需要在新结构假设下设计高效算法。
AI.method: 在转移模型具有已知特征空间低维表示的双线性 MDP 中，借助双线性结构通过低维特征期望高效估计占用测度，提出基于模型的乐观凹效用策略优化（OCUPO）框架。on-policy 版本每轮用独立轨迹估计凹效用策略梯度；off-policy 版本提出一种新的反向特征回归子程序，复用历史策略采集的轨迹来估计当前策略的占用测度，并给出策略类（如特征足够丰富的对数线性策略）上的技术假设。框架还扩展到线性 MDP。
AI.result: on-policy OCUPO 达到 Õ(ε⁻⁴) 样本复杂度；off-policy 版本达到 Õ(ε⁻²) 样本复杂度（至多相差可控投影误差），扩展至线性 MDP 时保持相同复杂度，对 ε 的依赖与线性函数逼近下的标准 RL 一致，且算法不依赖先前工作所需的积分 oracle。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为双线性 MDP 与线性 MDP 下的凹效用 RL 提供了计算高效、样本复杂度最优阶的乐观策略优化方法，并通过 off-policy 轨迹复用大幅提升样本效率，摆脱了积分 oracle 的限制。

title: ScaleCurve: From Constant Scale to Consistent Motion for World-Space Human Mesh Recovery
summary: World-space human mesh recovery can lose spatial consistency even when camera-space body estimates are accurate. A single sequence-wide scale resolves global scale ambiguity but cannot correct local scale distortion along a reconstructed camera path. We present ScaleCurve, a framework that estimates time-varying metric corrections from human-ground geometry. We construct scale observations by comparing predicted foot geometry with locally fitted ground planes. Joint temporal optimization downweights inconsistent observations and couples neighboring scale estimates, allowing calibration to adapt along the camera path without freely following measurement noise. We scale camera translation increments and integrate them into a calibrated trajectory. With this camera fixed, we refine the lifted body motion using 2D image evidence and pretrained 3D dynamics, while restricting global trajectory rescaling. ScaleCurve achieves state-of-the-art performance on most evaluated metrics on both EMDB-2 and SLOPER4D. Consistent gains across three HMR backbones demonstrate its compatibility with diverse body estimates without retraining. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: ScaleCurve 从人体-地面几何关系估计随时间变化的尺度修正，解决世界坐标系人体网格恢复中的局部尺度畸变问题。
AI.motivation: 世界坐标系人体网格恢复即使相机坐标系估计准确，也可能失去空间一致性；单条序列一个全局尺度只能消除全局尺度歧义，无法修正沿相机路径的局部尺度畸变。
AI.method: 比较预测脚部几何与局部拟合地平面构造尺度观测；联合时序优化对不一致观测降权并耦合相邻尺度估计；按尺度缩放相机平移增量并积分为标定轨迹；固定相机后用2D证据与预训练3D先验细化人体运动，同时限制全局轨迹重缩放。
AI.result: 在 EMDB-2 与 SLOPER4D 上多数指标达到SOTA；在三个HMR骨干上均有一致提升，无需重新训练即可兼容不同人体估计。
AI.conclusion: 时变尺度校正能有效提升世界坐标系人体网格恢复的空间一致性，且方法通用性强。

title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
summary: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

AI.tldr: 提出Mixture-of-Loops Transformer（MoLT），以KV作为跨深度与循环的可复用记忆，构建MoLA注意力，并给出MoLT-R/MoLT-KV两种变体及平衡效率与质量的U-MoLT，在预训练与推理上全面优于非循环基线。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过共享层复用提升表达力，但效率代价高。要推进“表达力-效率”边界，需重新审视相邻循环之间传递什么：即一个Transformer循环应向下一循环传递何种信息。
AI.method: MoLA用keys/values作为记忆实现跨深度与循环的选择性复用。MoLT-R保留残差流并读取跨循环局部KV以换表达力；MoLT-KV从embedding重启、读取当前循环局部KV与前置循环记忆KV，消除同位置跨循环依赖，配合loop forcing并行训练，实现超越训练循环horizon的单次遍历MoL解码。U-MoLT将记忆构建与预测读出分离，跳过未使用的decoder遍历且不改变预测。
AI.result: 400B token预训练中，U-MoLT在700M/1.5B dense与3B MoE上均超过OLMo3；700M达1.7x验证CE token效率，3B MoE十域困惑度改善0.75、十任务准确率提升2.1个百分点。Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base的100B token继续预训练中，11个域CE全部下降，平均1.4x token效率。推理时MoL-Hybrid-2在S规模(~113M)下延迟996.6ms，与非循环OLMo3的1000.6ms持平。
AI.conclusion: 以KV为循环间传递载体是可行且有效的设计轴：MoLT-KV通过切断同位置跨循环依赖换取效率与可并行训练，U-MoLT在保持预测不变的前提下剪枝计算，使循环Transformer在多规模、多场景下同时取得更好质量与接近非循环模型的推理延迟。

title: Evacuation Traffic Prediction for Dynamic Transportation Networks over Multiple Hurricanes: A Generalized Graph Learning Approach
summary: High traffic demand during hurricane evacuations causes severe congestion on major highways, leading to delays and safety risks for evacuees. Predicting evacuation traffic in real-time can significantly enhance evacuation management efforts. However, evacuation traffic is highly dynamic and uncertain due to evolving hurricane characteristics and diverse population response. Each hurricane has unique characteristics and evacuation contexts, resulting in different spatial-temporal traffic patterns. Moreover, the structure of detector-based transportation networks varies across multiple hurricanes. Hence, a model trained on the data from one hurricane may not generalize well for others. This study proposes a generalized dynamic graph learning framework using traffic detectors and evacuation data from 12 historical hurricanes. Leveraging the dynamic nature of transportation network, we develop a Graph Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (GCN-LSTM) model that predicts evacuation traffic up to 6 hours in advance. For an unseen hurricane (Milton, 2024), the model shows strong generalizability, achieving an RMSE of 280.6 and R2 of 0.96 for 1-hour prediction, and an RMSE of 459.8 and R2 of 0.89 for overall 6-hours prediction. We also introduce a modular training approach, where we evaluate performance improvements by sequentially incorporating data from multiple hurricanes. The proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baseline models for overall 6-hour prediction horizons. Ablation experiments show an 8.4% improvement in RMSE for the proposed dynamic GCN-LSTM model compared to its static counterpart. Traffic management officials can use the developed model to understand future traffic conditions during hurricane evacuation in advance and take proactive measures to reduce delays during evacuation.

AI.tldr: 提出动态图学习框架，用12场历史飓风的检测器与疏散数据训练GCN-LSTM模型，可在未见飓风（Milton 2024）上提前6小时预测疏散交通流量。
AI.motivation: 飓风疏散期间大流量导致严重拥堵与安全风险，实时预测可提升管理效率；但疏散交通高度动态、不确定，各飓风特征与疏散情境差异大，且检测器网络结构在不同飓风间不一致，导致单一飓风训练的模型难以泛化。
AI.method: 构建基于交通检测器与疏散数据的动态图学习框架，融合12场历史飓风数据；利用交通网络动态特性设计图卷积-长短期记忆网络（GCN-LSTM）进行最长6小时的多步预测；并提出模块化训练策略，逐步并入多场飓风数据以评估性能提升，同时开展与静态模型的消融对比及基线模型比较。
AI.result: 在未参与训练的飓风Milton（2024）上：1小时预测RMSE 280.6、R2 0.96；6小时整体预测RMSE 459.8、R2 0.89。整体6小时预测性能优于现有最优基线；消融显示动态GCN-LSTM较静态版本RMSE提升8.4%。
AI.conclusion: 动态图建模显著提升跨飓风的疏散交通预测泛化能力；交通管理部门可据此提前掌握疏散期间未来路况，采取主动措施减少延误。

title: Manga Page Parser: Comprehensive Visual Parsing through Local Story Understanding
summary: Understanding manga requires connecting who appears and who speaks with the events, character states, and relationships that unfold across panels. We study manga visual parsing through local story understanding: analyzing each double-page spread independently to capture and organize its story information in a reusable structured representation. We propose MangaParser, an agentic reading framework that jointly performs character clustering, speaker diarization, and speaker-to-character binding within a shared multimodal conversation, without additional training or fine-tuning. The agent uses structured story memory to guide character and speaker identification, inspecting relevant image regions when uncertain and refining its predictions and story records together as evidence accumulates. Quantitative evaluations show that our parser substantially outperforms manga-specific models across multiple backbones. Parsing examples illustrate how a unified representation links the character and speaker predictions with narrative content and supporting evidence. We further test reusability through story question answering using outputs generated before the questions are provided. The results confirm output reusability, offering a foundation for manga translation, content retrieval, and question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出 MangaParser，一个无需训练的智能体式漫画阅读框架，在共享多模态对话中联合完成角色聚类、说话人分离与说话人-角色绑定，并构建结构化故事记忆以提升可复用性。
AI.motivation: 理解漫画需要把"谁出现、谁说话"与跨分镜的事件、角色状态和关系关联起来；现有漫画专用模型难以统一建模这些信息，也缺乏可复用的结构化输出。
AI.method: 以双页跨页为单位做局部故事理解；用 agentic 框架在单一多模态对话中联合执行角色聚类、说话人分离和说话人-角色绑定；借助结构化故事记忆引导识别，在不确定时检视相关图像区域，并随证据累积迭代修正预测与故事记录；无需额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 在多种骨干模型上显著优于漫画专用模型；解析示例显示统一表示能关联角色/说话人预测与叙事内容及支撑证据；在问题给出前生成输出的故事问答实验中验证了可复用性。
AI.conclusion: MangaParser 提供统一、可复用的漫画故事表示，为漫画翻译、内容检索与问答奠定基础。

title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
summary: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.

AI.tldr: 测试"语言模型用词思考，多模态模型用图思考"这一假设：让模型先描述所需辅助图像，再结合原图与生成图回答问题。结果显示图像生成普遍降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 类比语言模型以词元进行思维链推理，作者探究多模态模型能否"用图像思考"——即通过自生成辅助图像提升视觉问答表现。
AI.method: 模型先描述它需要什么样的辅助图像（helper），生成该图像后与原图一起输入作答。在13组视觉-语言模型与生成器组合、10个任务上进行评测；并对统一模型（BAGEL、Janus-Pro-7B）及重复图像编辑进行额外实验。
AI.result: 生成辅助图像平均使准确率下降3.7个百分点，10个任务中9个下降；BAGEL与Janus-Pro-7B各有8个任务变差。VSTAR上在相同规划提示下加入生成图，准确率下降10.47点。多次图像编辑结果因任务而异：ChartQAPro与MathVista仍低于无生成基线，ERQA经10次编辑后提升3点。
AI.conclusion: "以图思考"的构想目前难以成立，辅助图像生成总体损害而非改善视觉问答；效果高度依赖任务，仅个别场景（如多次编辑后的ERQA）可能获益。

title: Effect of class proportion shifts on classifier curvature
summary: Changing the class mix can alter mean loss without changing the classifier. To distinguish this reweighting from changes in the model itself, we studied ten-class CIFAR-10 classification in separate branches for two target classes, measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to the output-layer parameters on fixed images of each target class. Across ten new initialisations, after 60 updates to the output layer with frozen features, the trace changed by -0.152% on average in branches where the target class share rose from 10% to 19%, and by +0.071% in branches where it fell to 1%, relative to each branch's initial trace. These changes do not isolate the effect of class share from that of the assigned training images. We developed a forecast based on initial class gradients after examining the first experiment's results and then tested it prospectively without modification. For direct increases from 10% to 19%, rather than increases after a deficit, its mean absolute error was 0.022 percentage points on the initial-trace scale, compared with 0.152 for a zero-change forecast and 0.104 for equally weighted gradients. Using the assigned class proportions improved the forecast of how much the trace would change.

AI.tldr: 在CIFAR-10十类分类中，仅改变类别比例（reweighting）而非模型本身，会使输出层损失Hessian迹产生约±0.1%量级的变化，且该变化可通过初始类别梯度与所分配类别比例被预测。
AI.motivation: 改变类别混合会改变平均损失，即使分类器未变。作者希望把这种"重加权效应"与模型本身的变化区分开来，即探讨数据分布（类别比例）变化如何独立影响损失曲面的局部几何性质（Hessian迹）。
AI.method: 研究十类CIFAR-10分类，针对两个目标类分别设置分支；固定特征、冻结特征，仅对输出层做60次更新，在各类目标类的固定图像上测量损失Hessian关于输出层参数的迹。用十次新初始化进行实验，并基于第一次实验的初始类别梯度构造预测，随后进行前瞻性、未修改的检验，与零变化预测和等权梯度预测作对比。
AI.result: 相对各分支初始迹，目标类占比从10%升至19%的分支平均变化-0.152%，降至1%的分支为+0.071%。该变化无法将类别占比效应与所分配训练图像效应完全分离。对于从10%直接升至19%的情形，预测的平均绝对误差为0.022个百分点，优于零变化预测（0.152）和等权梯度预测（0.104）。
AI.conclusion: 类别比例变化会使输出层Hessian迹产生小幅但可量化的变化；利用所分配的类别比例可改进对该迹变化的预测。但实验设计存在混杂，尚不能单独隔离类别占比的因果效应。

title: Rethinking Unsupervised Cross-Modal Homography Estimation:Spatially Aware Representations and Geometric Consistency Learning
summary: Unsupervised cross-modal homography estimation is challenging because appearance differences obscure shared geometric structures. Separating modality transfer from homography estimation helps reduce these differences, but accurate alignment still requires effective geometric representations and consistency constraints on the two subtasks. We propose GeoCo (Geometry-Aware and Consistency-Constrained Homography Estimation), a framework that addresses these two requirements without cross-modal transformation labels. Its homography estimator, RVHomo, adapts hierarchical features from a frozen vision foundation model (VFM) and fuses them with local CNN features to capture structural context and spatial detail. Two geometric consistency constraints encourage modality transfer to preserve geometry and homography predictions to remain consistent under synthetic geometric transformations. Through two-stage progressive distillation, we further obtain GeoCo-D, which uses the lightweight RVHomo-D estimator. An intermediate model first learns to perform cross-modal matching without modality transfer, then transfers prediction and feature knowledge to the student, eliminating online VFM extraction. Experiments on GoogleMap, OPT-SAR, FSD, and VIS-IR show that GeoCo reduces mean average corner error by 17.4-46.7% relative to the best-performing baseline on each dataset. GeoCo-D also outperforms all compared baselines while using 98.5% fewer parameters and 70.4% fewer FLOPs than the complete GeoCo teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoCo框架，通过几何感知与一致性约束解决无监督跨模态单应性估计问题，并通过渐进蒸馏得到轻量模型GeoCo-D。
AI.motivation: 跨模态图像的外观差异会掩盖共享几何结构；将模态转换与单应性估计分离虽能缓解差异，但仍需有效的几何表征与两个子任务间的一致性约束，且缺乏跨模态变换标签。
AI.method: 1) 单应性估计器RVHomo，融合冻结视觉基础模型(VFM)的分层特征与局部CNN特征，兼顾结构上下文与空间细节；2) 两条几何一致性约束：促使模态转换保持几何结构、使单应性预测在合成几何变换下保持一致；3) 两阶段渐进蒸馏得到GeoCo-D，先用中间模型学习无模态转换的跨模态匹配，再向轻量学生RVHomo-D迁移预测与特征知识，免除在线VFM提取。
AI.result: 在GoogleMap、OPT-SAR、FSD、VIS-IR上，GeoCo相对各数据集最佳基线将平均角点误差降低17.4%–46.7%；GeoCo-D优于所有对比基线，且相较完整GeoCo教师参数量减少98.5%、FLOPs减少70.4%。
AI.conclusion: 几何一致性与VFM-CNN特征融合能有效提升无监督跨模态单应性估计精度，渐进蒸馏可在大幅压缩模型的同时保持甚至提升性能。

title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
summary: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on five benchmarks show Maco-RL raises Qwen3.5-27B's overall score from 43.6 to 54.2 and then to 60.1 with continual expansion, reaching the frontier held by Qwen3.8-27B, which is further pushed outward by +5.7. Maco-RL also outperforms single-task RL with less compute for policy updates. These results support MixRL as a practical and compute-efficient post-training approach with substantial potential to strengthen general agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: Maco-RL：通过配额式异步调度器与三缓冲采样，稳定并高效地扩展混合任务强化学习。
AI.motivation: 混合任务强化学习(MixRL)可跨域训练统一策略，避免专家模型与额外蒸馏，但面临训练稳定性差、rollout算力分配低效、难以持续扩展新领域三大挑战。
AI.method: 提出Maco-RL：(1) 基于配额的调度器，跨多个任务域进行异步rollout，通过平衡梯度贡献、缓解off-policy效应稳定训练；(2) 正交方向的Tri-Buffer Sampling(TBS)，按掌握程度对样本分配算力，兼顾前沿探索与已获能力保持。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，将Qwen3.5-27B总体得分从43.6提升至54.2，持续扩展后达60.1，追平Qwen3.8-27B的前沿水平，并进一步外推+5.7；同时以更少的策略更新算力优于单任务RL。
AI.conclusion: MixRL是一种实用且算力高效的后训练范式，具有显著增强通用智能体能力的潜力。

title: MoSk: A Unified Motion-Skeleton Foundation Model for Human Motion Understanding and Generation
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/MoSk_site
summary: Foundation models (FMs) have advanced visual understanding and generation by providing semantically rich representations. However, this role of FMs remains underexplored in human motion. Large motion datasets offer diverse movements at scale, but often lack action labels for systematically evaluating learned representations on understanding tasks. Skeleton datasets enable such evaluation through established recognition protocols, yet are typically smaller and focus on predefined actions captured in controlled environments. To combine these strengths, we present MoSk, to the best of our knowledge, the first Motion-Skeleton foundation model to integrate motion and skeleton datasets. MoSk learns shared representations through self-supervised masked motion modeling. We incorporate joint-name embeddings to provide a common anatomical reference across various skeleton formats. A cross-attention decoder reconstructs masked motion from the encoder's features, with joint-name embeddings specifying the target joints. Experiments demonstrate strong action-recognition performance across diverse settings, including linear evaluation and fine-tuning. MoSk also substantially improves motion generation across multiple backbones through representation alignment, reducing FID on MotionMillion by up to 9.75 for unconditional generation and 3.83 for text-to-motion generation.

AI.tldr: MoSk是首个将动作(motion)与骨架(skeleton)数据集统一起来的人体运动基础模型，通过自监督掩码建模学习共享表示，在动作识别与动作生成任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在视觉理解与生成中价值已被验证，但这一作用在人体运动领域尚未充分探索。大规模motion数据集动作多样但缺乏动作标签，难以系统评估表示；skeleton数据集有成熟识别协议但规模小、动作受限、环境受控。作者希望结合两者优势。
AI.method: 提出MoSk基础模型，采用自监督掩码运动建模学习共享表示；引入joint-name embeddings作为跨不同骨架格式的统一解剖参考；使用跨注意力解码器从编码器特征重建被掩码的运动，并以joint-name embeddings指定目标关节。评估采用线性探测与微调等识别协议。
AI.result: 在多样设置下（线性评估、微调）展现强动作识别性能；通过表示对齐在多个生成骨干上显著改善动作生成，MotionMillion上无条件生成FID最多降低9.75，文本到动作生成降低3.83。
AI.conclusion: 将motion与skeleton数据集统一的自监督预训练可有效提升运动表示质量，同时惠及识别与生成任务，验证了基础模型范式在人体运动领域的可行性与价值。

title: Incorporating the Knowledge Distillation to Improve the EfficientNet Transfer Learning Capability
summary:
Due to the Deep Learning requirement for a large training dataset, Transfer Learning has become a central method in the field of Computer Vision, which heavily used Deep Learning. Since the adoption of transfer learning in the field, the performance of the models in computer vision is significantly upgraded. The common transfer learning practice in computer vision research is to use state-of-the-art architectures in the ImageNet dataset as the backbone network. The best performing architecture in ImageNet is currently held by EfficientNet, which is a set of architectures that were progressively grown from a baseline architecture.
  By observing the EfficientNet development approach, it is natural to hypothesize that the smaller EfficientNet architecture is capable to contain the knowledge of the larger architecture. This hypothesis comes from the fact that the larger EfficientNet architecture was grown from the smaller architecture. Therefore, in this study, we experimented if it is beneficial to transfer the knowledge from the larger architecture to the smaller architecture of the EfficientNet. To achieve this goal, we proposed a transfer learning method that uses Knowledge Distillation as the knowledge transfer mechanism from the larger to smaller architecture. We found that the proposed method is able to upgrade the performance of each of the EfficientNet architecture. Several smaller architectures are even able to outperform the larger architecture that was trained using the standard transfer learning method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用知识蒸馏将大型EfficientNet的知识迁移到较小的EfficientNet架构，使各规模模型的性能均得到提升。
AI.motivation: 深度学习依赖大规模训练数据，迁移学习在计算机视觉中广泛使用，通常以ImageNet预训练模型作为骨干网络。EfficientNet是目前ImageNet上表现最好的架构系列，且其大模型是由小模型逐级扩展而来，因此作者假设小模型有能力承载大模型的知识，并探索将大模型知识迁移到小模型是否有益。
AI.method: 提出一种以知识蒸馏为知识转移机制的迁移学习方法，将较大EfficientNet架构的知识迁移到较小的EfficientNet架构中。
AI.result: 所提方法能够提升每一个EfficientNet架构的性能，若干较小的架构甚至能超越使用标准迁移学习方法训练的大型架构。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了从大EfficientNet向小EfficientNet进行知识蒸馏式迁移的有效性，小模型可通过吸收大模型知识获得性能增益，甚至超过大模型。

title: Spec2Weights: Certifying Networks that a Language Model Writes from a Specification
summary: A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a plain-language specification, with no data and no gradient step. We ask when such a network can be proved exact in the float32 arithmetic it actually runs in. A float-safety lemma makes exhaustive float32 enumeration a proof for any summation order, and a layered error bound covers networks whose weights are not short binary fractions. With dynamic programming, template checks, an SMT proof, breadth-first search and induction for weight-tied recurrences, this certifies 12 of 15 written networks (one after a single constant fix) on every input of a stated domain (up to $10^{16}$ inputs, or every graph or grid up to a size bound), in a minute of CPU or less each. The certificates also say where a network stops being exact: the shortest-path network is exact iff the distance is at most 4,096 and fails at the predicted hops. Thirty new specifications were each written by a fresh session of one model family (Claude Opus 5.5). Twenty-five first submissions are certified exact for any summation order; the five tax schedules stay within \$0.11 of the true tax at every whole dollar in one fixed float32 run. An open 27B model passes 23 of the 30, and 25 with more thinking and code execution, so the method transfers in part. We also prove two limits of learning from examples: input coordinates never active in training cannot be learned from more in-range data, and Luhn-type checksums have exponentially small target-dependent gradient variance across their family. Tuned gradient descent on the same architectures agrees with both, which cover two of our five failure classes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型"直接写出"神经网络权重后，能否在真实 float32 算术下被严格证明精确，并提出一组可自动化的形式化验证方法，同时给出从不完全示例中学习的两条理论极限。
AI.motivation: 语言模型已能仅凭自然语言规格生成小网络权重（无数据、无梯度），但缺乏"正确性"保证：实际运行为 float32、可能受求和顺序影响，经验测试不足以覆盖全部输入。作者希望回答"何时能证明这样的网络在其真实浮点运算中精确"。
AI.method: 提出 float-safety 引理：使穷举 float32 枚举对任意求和顺序都构成证明；并用误差界覆盖权重非短二进制分数的情形。组合使用动态规划、模板检查、SMT 证明、广度优先搜索，以及对权重共享递推网络（RNN/GNN）的归纳法，对给定定义域（至多 1e16 个输入，或有限图/网格规模）做完整验证。
AI.result: 15 个手写网络中 12 个被认证精确（其中一个经一次常数修正），每个 ≤1 分钟 CPU；证书还能刻画精确性边界（如最短路网络当且仅当距离 ≤4096 时精确）。Claude Opus 5.5 新写的 30 条规格中，25 条首版即被认证为对任意求和顺序精确，其余 5 条税表在整数美元处误差 ≤$0.11；开源 27B 模型通过 23/30（加更多思考与代码执行为 25/30）。另证明两条学习极限：训练中未被激活的输入坐标无法从更多域内数据学到；Luhn 类校验和的目标相关梯度方差随族规模指数衰减——均与调优梯度下降实验一致，覆盖五类失败中的两类。
AI.conclusion: "生成即证明"在部分场景可行：形式化方法可对 LLM 生成的网络给出 float32 下的精确性证书与失效边界，并能迁移到其他模型（部分迁移）。但仍有失败类别无法由学习弥补，需要混合形式化验证与学习理论分析。

title: ContextHands: Completing Hand Motion with Learned Context and Joint-Specific Body Kinematics
summary: Detailed hand motion contributes to the realism and expressiveness of generated human motion. Completing these details from body motion and language requires connecting the context of an action to the articulation of the hands. We introduce ContextHands, which completes hand motion from an observed body sequence and text descriptions assigned to hands and time intervals. Our approach learns probabilistic hand features from the descriptions and body motion, using auxiliary hand prediction to connect these features to hand articulation. A body encoder preserves joint and body-part features across multiple temporal scales, allowing each hand joint to query these features for joint-specific body information. The diffusion generator combines this joint-specific body information with the learned hand context. Both encoders and the generator are trained jointly, so the final generation objective also shapes the context features. Experiments on the OakInk2 dataset show that ContextHands generates more accurate hand motion and achieves lower Fréchet Hand Distance than existing hand-motion and general human-motion generation methods adapted to the task. In qualitative examples of grasping and tool use, ContextHands more closely reproduces the detailed hand poses in the reference motion. We will release our code and pretrained models to support further research.

AI.tldr: ContextHands 从身体序列和文本描述中补全细致的手部动作，提升生成人体运动的真实感。
AI.motivation: 手部细节决定生成人体运动的真实感与表现力，但从身体运动与语言中推断手部关节的精细动作，需要将动作上下文与手部关节配合关联起来，这一任务具有挑战性。
AI.method: 输入为观测到的身体序列，以及分别指定给手部和时间区间的文本描述；从描述与身体运动中学习概率化手部特征，并用辅助手部预测将特征连接到手部关节；身体编码器在多个时间尺度上保留关节与身体部位特征，使每个手部关节可查询关节特定的身体信息；扩散生成器将关节特定身体信息与学习到的手部上下文结合；编码器与生成器联合训练。
AI.result: 在 OakInk2 数据集上，相比适配该任务的手部动作生成方法与通用人体运动生成方法，生成的手部动作更准确，Fréchet Hand Distance 更低；在抓取和工具使用的定性示例中，更贴近参考运动中的细节手部姿态。
AI.conclusion: ContextHands 通过联合建模文本、身体运动与手部关节上下文，有效提升手部动作生成的准确度与真实感；作者将开源代码与预训练模型。

title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.

AI.tldr: 提出 GRIP（Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers），用 on-policy distillation 让模型自行逐步补齐缺失模态，并由"知道诊断的插补教师"和"看到全部真实模态的诊断教师"打分，从而获得对缺失不确定性敏感的置信度，实现单一模型应对任意检测组合且良好校准。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病诊断依赖临床、生物样本与影像三类互补证据，但很少有患者做齐全套检查。现有方法对缺失模态要么直接丢弃、要么只填一个估计值，分类器从未见过该模态的其他可能取值，且插补结果也从不与诊断目标校验。
AI.method: 采用 on-policy distillation：模型自己填充缺失模态（rollout），每次补一个模态、采样多个填充。一个知晓诊断的插补教师对每一步填充打分，把诊断结果引入插补；一个见过所有真实模态的诊断教师提供软目标。在多样化的填充上训练，使模型学到的置信度反映缺失检测带来的不确定性，推理时仅用一次 rollout 即可诊断。
AI.result: 在 ADNI 队列上优于 SOTA 基线；在两个外部队列上判别力具竞争力，且在所有方法重新校准后，其校准误差在两个队列上均与最低者持平。将该教师机制加诸三个基线，均带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GRIP 提供单一且校准良好的模型，可适配患者实际完成的任意检测组合。

title: Counter-DECEIVR: Counterfactual Explanations for Deepfake Detectors using Detector-Guided Rectified Flow Inversion
summary: Deep-learning-generated media are increasingly passed off as real, driving an arms race between image generators and deepfake detectors. Trust in the latter is limited by their often black-box nature; and, while region-based explanations can sometimes be extracted, these become less useful as generation quality improves. Counterfactual examples, which show the minimal change that flips a detector's decision, reveal what evidence drives a verdict, helping analysts decide whether to trust it. This work introduces Counter-DECEIVR (DEtector-guided reCtifiEd flow InVeRsion for counterfactuals), a novel training-free framework that generates counterfactual examples. Counter-DECEIVR steers latents in the velocity field of a rectified flow model using gradients from off-the-shelf deepfake detectors, without training a generator or adapting the detector; unlike prior methods, it requires no per-instance or per-detector fitting and no diffusion training on the target data. It also leverages the detector's explanation maps to concentrate editing to salient regions, turning low-level feature importance into localised counterfactual edits. A single parameter controls the strength of the edits. Across two deepfake detectors and two widely used forensics datasets, Counter-DECEIVR outperforms prior counterfactual generation methods, including training-based ones. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出Counter-DECEIVR，一个免训练框架，在rectified flow模型的velocity field中，用现成deepfake检测器的梯度引导潜变量，并借助解释图聚焦显著区域，生成反事实样本以增强检测器的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度生成媒体被冒充为真实，检测器与生成器陷入军备竞赛；检测器常为黑盒，区域解释随生成质量提升而失效。反事实样本能揭示翻转判决的最小改动、说明证据来源，从而帮助分析者判断是否信任检测结果。
AI.method: Counter-DECEIVR（DEtector-guided reCtifiEd flow InVeRsion for counterfactuals）：无需训练生成器或适配检测器，也无需逐实例/逐检测器拟合、无需在目标数据上做diffusion训练；用离线deepfake检测器的梯度在rectified flow的速度场中引导潜变量；利用检测器的解释图将编辑集中于显著区域，把低层特征重要性转为局部化反事实编辑；单一参数控制编辑强度。
AI.result: 在两个deepfake检测器和两个主流取证数据集上，Counter-DECEIVR优于先前反事实生成方法，包括基于训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 反事实生成可用于提升deepfake检测器可信度；无需训练的检测器引导flow反演是一种有效、可扩展且更可解释的方案。代码将在接收后公开。

title: Robust Recourse under Causal Graph Ambiguity
summary:
Causal algorithmic recourse recommends actions to reverse unfavorable decisions by modeling how interventions change an individual's features. Existing methods typically assume one causal graph that describes the system and account for uncertainty in the causal mechanisms. However, there usually exist several graphs that fit the same data but can predict different effects for the same action. Certain actions may achieve recourse across multiple graphs, but as the set of potential graphs grows, a single best action may become infeasible.
  We propose Worst-Case Recourse and Graph-Weighted Recourse to find a low-cost action that succeeds across all candidate graphs or a specified fraction of graph weight, respectively. Assuming a set of plausible graphs, for each graph we fit Gaussian process structural equations and assess success using the posterior mean--standard-deviation criterion. We use gradient-based search to determine minimal cost actions and check the validity of the actions on fresh posterior samples. In synthetic and semi-synthetic benchmarks, relaxing robustness, the requirement that an action succeed under every candidate graph, can increase the number of valid recommendations for recourse and lower costs of actions for both methods. In the 20-node GP benchmark, relaxation increases the number of factual instances offered recourse (coverage) from 341 to 436 out of 1,000, while the number of true successes, actions that flip the decision under the generating model, falls from 251 to 184, illustrating the coverage--validity trade-off. Accounting for graph ambiguity can help decision-makers recommend actions that remain effective even when the causal mechanisms of the system are not fully known.

AI.tldr: 提出Worst-Case Recourse与Graph-Weighted Recourse两种方法，在候选因果图集合模糊性下寻找低成本且能成功的算法救济动作。
AI.motivation: 现有因果算法救济方法通常假设单一因果图，只考虑因果机制的不确定性；但实际上多个图都能拟合同一数据却对同一动作给出不同预测效果，单图假设可能导致行动在其他图中失效。
AI.method: 假设一组合理候选图，对每个图拟合高斯过程结构方程，用后验均值-标准差准则评估成功；采用基于梯度的搜索求最小代价动作，并在新后验样本上验证动作有效性。Worst-Case要求动作在所有候选图上成功，Graph-Weighted Requital要求成功于指定比例的图权重。
AI.result: 在合成与半合成基准中，放松鲁棒性（不再要求每个候选图都成功）可增加有效推荐数量并降低动作代价。20节点GP基准中，覆盖（获得救济的事实样本）从341/1000升至436/1000，但真实成功数从251降至184，体现覆盖-有效性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 考虑图歧义性有助于决策者在系统因果机制不完全已知时仍推荐有效动作，但需在覆盖范围与动作有效性之间做权衡。

title: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration: Methods, Trade-Offs, and Open Questions
summary: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis. Sampling can require dozens to hundreds of denoiser evaluations, with each pass becoming more expensive as resolution, video length, or model size increases. This cost affects latency and energy use in interactive and edge applications. We examine four approaches to accelerating inference: distillation, consistency training, sampling methods, and denoiser design. We express training objectives, transition maps, and numerical updates in a common notation to compare changes to the learning target, the sampling trajectory, and the work performed within each denoiser pass. Published image and video benchmarks illustrate the quality--cost trade-offs of one- and few-step generation, the interaction between solvers and timestep schedules, the effect of feature caching, and the difference between first-frame latency and sustained streaming throughput. We close with open problems in visual-native architectures and post-compression distillation, solver-aware few-step training, and semantic trajectory alignment with factorized distribution matching.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述性分析，将蒸馏、一致性训练、采样方法、去噪器设计四类加速推理的手段用统一符号体系对比，并讨论质量—成本权衡与开放问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流式生成模型采样需数十至数百次去噪器评估，随分辨率、视频长度或模型规模增长而愈发昂贵，影响交互与边缘应用的延迟和能耗。
AI.method: 用统一记号表达训练目标、转移映射与数值更新，从学习目标、采样轨迹、单次去噪器评估的计算量三个维度，系统比较蒸馏、一致性训练、采样方法、去噪器设计四种加速途径。
AI.result: 在已发表的图像与视频基准上展示了质量—成本权衡，包括单步/少步生成、求解器与时间步调度交互、特征缓存效果，以及首帧延迟与持续流式吞吐的区别。
AI.conclusion: 指出视觉原生架构与压缩后蒸馏、求解器感知的少步训练、结合因子化分布匹配的语义轨迹对齐等开放问题。

title: Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks
summary: The emerging field of weight space learning has demonstrated the potential to enable metanetworks, i.e. models that process neural network (NN) data, to support several steps of the machine learning lifecycle, from model optimisation to evaluation and adaptation. However, this potential has yet to materialise beyond small-scale MLPs or CNNs: most current models, including message-passing based graph metanetworks (GMNs), operate exclusively at the finest level of granularity, processing every neuron and weight of the input model. Their cost therefore scales with the number of parameters. Yet NNs are inherently organised hierarchically, with neurons forming layers and layers forming blocks and modules. Additionally, several of their properties, such as Lipschitz upper bounds and generalisation measures, are compositions of layer- and block-level quantities. To incorporate this inductive bias, we introduce Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks (H-GMNs), which leverage the input architecture's hierarchy to coarsen and refine the graph using permutation-symmetry-preserving pooling and un-pooling layers. Further, we extend H-GMNs to Transformers by introducing a graph construction that preserves permutation symmetries and enables multi-level pooling. Our evaluation includes new ResNet-18, ViT and varying ViT model zoos of up to 86M parameters, on tasks spanning model evaluation (an analytic Lipschitz bound proxy, generalisation and robustness prediction), testing (backdoor detection) and editing (pruning). Experimental results show that, compared to non-equivariant alternatives and flat GMNs, H-GMNs are markedly more sample-efficient, and their cost remains nearly constant as metanetwork depth grows, allowing deeper and more expressive processing where flat GMNs run out of memory, without compromising accuracy, which in certain cases considerably improves.

AI.tldr: 提出分层图元网络H-GMN，利用网络架构层次结构进行粗化/细化池化，并可扩展到Transformer，在ResNet-18、ViT等大规模模型库上实现更省样本、计算成本近恒定的权重空间学习。
AI.motivation: 现有权重空间学习方法（包括基于消息传递的图元网络GMN）只在最细粒度（逐个神经元和权重）处理输入模型，代价随参数量线性增长，难以扩展到大规模模型。而神经网络本身具有层次结构（神经元→层→块/模块），且Lipschitz上界、泛化度量等性质可由层/块级别量组合而成，因此应引入这种归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks (H-GMN)：利用输入架构的层次结构，通过保持置换对称性的pooling与un-pooling层对图进行粗化与细化；进一步为Transformer设计保持置换对称并支持多级池化的图构建方式，将H-GMN扩展到ViT。
AI.result: 在新建的ResNet-18、ViT及不同规模ViT模型库（最大86M参数）上，评估模型评价（Lipschitz界代理、泛化与鲁棒性预测）、测试（后门检测）与编辑（剪枝）任务。结果显示H-GMN比非等变方法和扁平GMN显著更具样本效率；其成本随元网络深度增长近乎恒定，可在扁平GMN内存耗尽时进行更深、更具表达力的处理，且不损失精度，某些情况下精度还明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 分层池化是权重空间学习中有效的归纳偏置，使元网络可扩展到真实规模模型并在多种ML生命周期任务上更高效、更具表达力。

title: Surf-Style: Surface-Based Scene Stylization
summary: Consistent and controllable 3D stylization is critical for visual computing applications such as immersive visualization, augmented and virtual reality content creation, and artistic scene rendering. While 2D image stylization has advanced significantly, extending these methods to 3D remains challenging due to the need for cross-view consistency, where stylized renderings must align across all viewpoints. Applying 2D stylization independently to each rendered view often results in inconsistencies across perspectives. Existing methods attempt to improve consistency by leveraging implicit radiance field representations, which model scene appearance as a function of spatial locations. However, these methods struggle with ambiguity in updating colors, as the indirect dependence between pixel appearance and learnable scene parameters makes it difficult to enforce consistent stylization during optimization. This work presents Surface-based Scene Stylization (Surf-Style), which reconstructs object surfaces in a 3D scene and uses these surfaces to achieve geometric consistency and localized stylization. Surf-Style defines a learnable appearance model over 3D space, which is modified to replicate the visual style of a reference image. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our method achieves superior consistency and offers greater flexibility in controllable stylization, including the ability to target specific surface regions and combine different styles.

AI.tldr: 提出 Surf-Style，通过重建 3D 对象表面实现一致且可控的 3D 风格化。
AI.motivation: 现有 2D 风格化逐视图应用导致跨视角不一致；基于隐式辐射场的方法因像素外观与场景参数间接依赖，颜色更新存在模糊性，难以保证风格一致。
AI.method: 重建场景中物体表面，并在 3D 空间上定义可学习的外观模型，利用表面实现几何一致性与局部化风格化，通过修改外观模型复现参考图风格。
AI.result: 相比 SOTA 方法具有更优的一致性，并支持更灵活的可控风格化，如针对特定表面区域、组合不同风格。
AI.conclusion: 基于表面的表示能有效解决 3D 风格化的跨视角一致性与可控性问题。

title: From NP-Hardness to Exact Tractability Through Sample Abundance
comment: 170 pages, 6 figures. Includes full mathematical proofs and supplementary code and data
summary: Additional observations can make exact optimization tractable without changing the objective or feasible set. We establish this phenomenon for noisy parity fitting, a worst-case NP-hard problem, with uniformly sampled rank-one sign tensor entries, independent fair factor signs and independent errors. For fixed interaction order $k\ge3$, $n$ signs per block, logarithmic mean degree and known channel biases, $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ further readings of the same source suffice with high probability for exact optimization in $O(n\log^2 n)$ worst-case work. The leading coefficient is sharp for weak recovery by depth-$O(\log\log n)$ local estimators with independent reading marks. A common signed-field law determines the gain over the generating source, the number of tied optima and the dimension needed for later reweightings. The geometry of the remaining coordinates determines the sharp radius of local verification for high-scoring assignments with high probability.

AI.tldr: 对带噪parity fitting这一最坏情形NP难问题，额外观测可在不改变目标与可行集的条件下使精确优化变得可解，并给出所需额外读数的尖锐阈值与算法。
AI.motivation: 探究"增加观测（读数）但不改变目标函数与可行域"是否能将原本NP难的精确优化问题变得可处理，并以noisy parity fitting作为具体载体验证这一现象。
AI.method: 研究噪声parity fitting：均匀采样的rank-one sign张量条目，独立公平符号因子与独立误差；固定交互阶k≥3、每块n个符号、对数平均度、已知信道偏置。利用O(n/(log n)^{1/(k-2)})量级的额外源读数，在O(n log^2 n)最坏情形工作量下实现精确优化；并分析depth-O(log log n)局部估计器的弱恢复、共同signed-field律与局部验证半径。
AI.result: 证明额外读数足以高概率实现精确优化且保持O(n log^2 n)最坏工作量；弱恢复的首项系数是尖锐的；共同signed-field律刻画了相对生成源的增益、并列最优数量及后续重加权所需维度；剩余坐标几何决定高得分赋值的尖锐局部验证半径。
AI.conclusion: 额外观测可使NP难问题在不改目标/可行域的前提下转为可精确求解，并给出尖锐的读数阈值、复杂度与几何刻画。

title: SPARC: Geometry-Guided Attention Pruning for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
summary: We present SPARC, a geometry-guided attention pruning framework that turns the native self-attention of pretrained video diffusion transformers into a unified mechanism for camera control and persistent scene memory. Our key insight is that attention connectivity can simultaneously serve as geometric conditioning for camera control and spatial addressing for historical memory retrieval. Motivated by the asymmetric contextual requirements of reconstructing observed content and synthesizing novel regions, SPARC restricts observed tokens to geometrically corresponding historical tokens and local spatiotemporal context, while preserving dense attention for unobserved regions. Correspondence-aware attention biasing and order-invariant historical positioning further enable stable retrieval across long temporal gaps. Without introducing additional learnable control or memory modules, SPARC achieves precise camera adherence and faithful scene revisitation while substantially reducing attention computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of aggressive attention pruning in improving camera adherence, revisit consistency, and visual fidelity, with an inference speedup of over 50x when combined with four-step distillation. Project page is available at https://zju3dv.github.io/SPARC.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARC，利用几何引导的注意力剪枝，把预训练视频扩散Transformer的自注意力同时转化为相机控制和持久场景记忆的统一机制。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer做相机控制与场景重访需要额外的可学习控制/记忆模块，且注意力计算开销大；重建已观测区域与合成新区域对上下文的非对称需求未被利用。
AI.method: 将已观测token的注意力限制到几何对应的历史token与局部时空上下文，未观测区域保留稠密注意力；引入对应感知的注意力偏置与顺序无关的历史定位以支持长时间跨度稳定检索，无需新增可学习模块。
AI.result: 相机跟随精准、场景重访一致，注意力计算大幅减少；结合四步蒸馏实现超50倍推理加速，并提升相机遵循度、重访一致性与视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 激进的注意力剪枝在此类任务中有效，几何引导注意力可作为统一的相机控制与场景记忆机制，兼顾效率与质量。

title: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^π(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^π\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^π\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, BRIAR expands discourse-aligned reasoning trees along an upper-confidence outcome-bifurcation frontier, steering rollouts away from absorbed rumination and toward unresolved decision points. Second, it models latent node values with boundary-scaled heteroscedastic edge variances and computes exact global posteriors in linear $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ time via two-pass Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) tree belief smoothing, eliminating $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ matrix inversions while gating out spurious boundary noise. Third, BRIAR detects minimal absorbed frontier nodes and applies zero-sum log-length centered suffix advantages strictly post-absorption, leaving pre-absorption derivations provably invariant.

AI.tldr: BRIAR 将 on-policy 验证器下推理轨迹的前缀通过概率建模为有界 Doob 鞅，据此提出树状 RLVR 框架，在“未决分叉前沿”扩展 rollout、用 RTS 树信念平滑做线性时间值估计，并对吸收后后缀施加零和长度中心化优势，减少冗余验证与早期错误传播。
AI.motivation: 标准策略优化器盲目分配 rollout 计算与梯度信用：难题上早期一步失误即毁掉后续轨迹，可解题上答案已定后仍生成大量冗余验证。作者将两者归因于同一结构事实——前缀通过概率鞅在 V→0 与 V→1 两端信用方差消失。
AI.method: 三部分：(1) 沿上置信结果分叉前沿扩展话语对齐推理树，把 rollout 引向未决决策点、远离已吸收的反复推敲；(2) 用边界缩放的异方差边方差建模隐节点值，通过两遍 Rauch–Tung–Striebel 树信念平滑在 O(|V|) 时间计算精确全局后验，消除 O(m^3) 矩阵求逆并门控边界噪声；(3) 检测最小吸收前沿节点，仅在吸收后施加零和、对数长度中心化的后缀优势，保证吸收前推导不变。
AI.result: 理论上给出鞅方差守恒及上界 V^π(u)(1−V^π(u)) 的刻画，并证明吸收前后缀优势不改变吸收前推导；计算上将树后验推断从立方复杂度降到线性复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 以鞅几何为核心重构 RLVR 的计算与信用分配，BRIAR 有望同时缓解难题早期错误与易题冗余验证两类低效，为树状推理强化学习提供原理化框架。

title: When to Respond, Where to Ground: Streaming 3D Affordance Grounding
summary: Given a continuous RGB-D stream and a language request, streaming 3D affordance grounding requires an agent to decide when to respond and where to locate the requested functional part using only observations available so far. Existing 3D affordance grounding methods typically assume complete scene observations, while streaming vision-language models lack fine-grained 3D functional grounding. Our goal is to jointly determine response timing and functional-part localization during continuous scene observation. We propose StreamAff, an evidence-guided response strategy that makes both decisions from the grounding model's own visual evidence. The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in. A conditional look-back policy lets the model answer from an earlier observation at the moment of the request or wait for new evidence, and zoom-and-refine grounding segments the part named in the answer on the 3D points of the selected frame. We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame. We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder. StreamAff achieves 30.14% StreamIoU on 15-second streams, a 40.6% relative improvement over the strongest of these baselines.

AI.tldr: StreamAff提出流式3D可供性定位方法，利用模型自身视觉证据联合决定何时响应与定位何处，并引入StreamFun3D基准与StreamIoU指标。
AI.motivation: 现有3D可供性定位假设完整场景观测，而流式视觉语言模型缺乏细粒度3D功能定位能力；需在连续观测中同时决定响应时机与功能部件定位。
AI.method: 对读入帧的视觉patch打分，综合支持度与"等待"选项决定是否响应，最高分patch选定定位帧；条件回看策略决定用请求时刻的早期观测还是等待新证据；zoom-and-refine在选定帧3D点上分割部件。另构建StreamFun3D基准（Current/History/Future/Unobserved四种证据设置）和StreamIoU指标。
AI.result: 在15秒流上StreamAff达30.14% StreamIoU，相较最强基线（适配的离线方法与外部决策器基线）相对提升40.6%。
AI.conclusion: 以证据引导的响应策略可有效统一响应时机与3D功能定位，StreamFun3D与StreamIoU为流式3D可供性定位提供评测基础。

title: Hijacking 3D Generation: Targeted Adversarial Attacks against Image-to-3D Models via Prefix Trajectory Alignment
summary: Online services that deploy Image-to-3D models enable users to generate high-quality 3D assets from a single image. However, the generated 3D geometry can violate content policies and cause broader security risks. To prevent such content, these services typically use policy-restricted inspectors to examine uploaded images before generation. Since the inspector examines only the visible content of the input, a visually benign image can still induce the generation of policy-restricted 3D geometry. However, turning this vulnerability into an effective attack is non-trivial in the black-box setting: global backpropagation through the long DiT generation trajectory is difficult to fit, while different image preprocessing pipelines across services can substantially reduce transferability. In this paper, we present PTA3D, a targeted adversarial attack against Image-to-3D models that addresses these challenges through Prefix Trajectory Alignment (PTA) and Preprocessing Aware Optimization (PAO). PTA progressively aligns the prefix DiT outputs of the adversarial trajectory with those of the target trajectory, where the core geometric structure is formed, allowing the final geometry to be controlled without optimizing through the complete generation trajectory. PAO exposes adversarial optimization to diverse image transformations rather than a single preprocessing pipeline, reducing sensitivity to the mismatch between surrogate and target services. We establish a prefix-to-output bound and a preprocessing-aware transfer bound to theoretically characterize the effectiveness of the two designs. Experiments on three open-source Image-to-3D models and three online services show that PTA3D achieves 41.5%-88.5% ASR on online services and 90.8%-94.6% ASR in white box settings, substantially outperforming existing attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出PTA3D，一种针对Image-to-3D模型的定向对抗攻击，通过前缀轨迹对齐与预处理感知优化，在黑盒在线服务上实现41.5%-88.5%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 线上Image-to-3D服务仅在生成前检查上传图像的可见内容，攻击者可利用视觉上无害的图像诱导生成违反内容政策的三维几何；但黑盒设定下，DiT长生成轨迹全局反传难拟合，且各服务预处理流程差异大导致迁移性差。
AI.method: PTA3D包含两个设计：Prefix Trajectory Alignment（PTA）逐步对齐对抗轨迹与目标轨迹的前缀DiT输出，在核心几何结构形成阶段施加控制，避免优化完整生成轨迹；Preprocessing Aware Optimization（PAO）在优化中暴露于多样图像变换而非单一预处理管线，提升跨服务迁移性。并给出前缀到输出界与预处理感知迁移界作理论刻画。
AI.result: 在3个开源Image-to-3D模型和3个线上服务上测试，线上服务ASR达41.5%-88.5%，白盒设定ASR达90.8%-94.6%，显著优于已有攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了Image-to-3D服务中仅检查输入图像的检查机制的漏洞，证明了在仅控制前缀轨迹与多样化预处理条件下的黑盒定向攻击可行性，为相关服务的内容安全防护提出新的警示。

title: Projector Subspace Optimization for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet adapting them to sequential tasks requires Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Existing replay-free methods expand prompts or routed LoRA experts across multi-layer decoders, incurring heavy parameter and routing overhead while shifting internal feature distributions. Instead, we identify the final linear layer of the vision-language projector as a high-capacity, coordinate-stationary bridge, where sequential updates easily induce interface drift by displacing historical visual tokens. While low-rank subspace adaptation offers a compact remedy, selecting directions solely from historical statistics or task gradients sacrifices plasticity or stability, and unconstrained multi-step updates still accumulate large drift. To resolve both issues, we propose Projector Refinement through Optimized Update Directions (PROUD), a continual subspace optimization framework for the terminal projector layer. At task onset, PROUD combines retained input statistics with initial gradients to analytically extract a metric-orthonormal subspace maximizing first-order task gain under a drift budget. During training, it regularizes updates within this fixed subspace via an exact Frobenius penalty before losslessly merging them with zero inference or routing overhead. Experiments on UCIT and CoIN across MLLM backbones show that PROUD outperforms recent replay-free baselines in continual accuracy while curbing forgetting with a fraction of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: PROUD是一个面向多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）的持续子空间优化框架，仅精修视觉-语言投影器的最后线性层，在任务开始时联合历史输入统计与初始梯度解析地提取度量正交子空间，训练中施加精确Frobenius正则以抑制漂移，并可无损合并、推理零开销。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态持续指令微调的无回放方法需在多层解码器中扩展prompt或路由LoRA专家，带来参数与路由开销且改变内部特征分布；作者指出视觉-语言投影器末层是高容量、坐标稳定的"桥接"位置，顺序更新易位移历史视觉token造成接口漂移。低秩子空间适配虽紧凑，但仅用历史统计或任务梯度选方向会在可塑性与稳定性间失衡，且无约束多步更新仍累积大漂移。
AI.method: 以投影器末端线性层为适配目标。任务开始时，结合保留的输入统计与初始梯度，在漂移预算下解析地构造度量正交子空间，使一阶任务增益最大化；训练期间在该固定子空间内更新，并用精确Frobenius惩罚正则化；训练后将更新无损合并到原权重，推理阶段无额外参数或路由开销。
AI.result: 在UCIT与CoIN基准、多种MLLM主干上的实验表明，PROUD在持续准确率上优于近期无回放基线，同时以极少可训练参数抑制遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 针对投影器末层的持续子空间优化是一种高效、低开销的MCIT方案：兼顾稳定性与可塑性，避免多层扩展与路由成本，并能零推理开销地部署。

title: When to Trust a PFN: Detecting Harmful Shift in Tabular Foundation Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text, 73 pages total with appendix. Code: https://github.com/teivng/cald. Project page: https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~viet/cald.html
summary: Tabular prior-fitted networks (PFNs) work well across tabular classification problems but can fail silently at deployment when distributions shift. We propose CALD (Calibrated Anchor-Loss Disagreement), a lightweight unsupervised monitor that triggers an alarm to warn when a PFN might fail. By finetuning the decoder to maximize disagreement with the test-set prediction while maintaining accuracy on an ID anchor set, CALD identifies harmful OOD batches through the resulting anchor loss, requiring no labels on test batches. We prove that the post-finetune anchor loss has a strictly lower expectation under sufficiently severe shift than under ID eval, yielding a one-sided test. Across 14 datasets covering tabular and structured distribution shift, on both TabPFN and TabICL, CALD matches or outperforms baselines on harmful shifts and is markedly more resilient to benign-shift false alarms.

AI.tldr: CALD：一种无需测试标签的轻量无监督监控器，通过微调解码器制造与测试预测的最大分歧并保持ID锚集精度，用锚损失检测tabular PFN在分布漂移下的潜在失效。
AI.motivation: Tabular PFN（如TabPFN、TabICL）在表格分类上表现良好，但分布漂移时可能"静默失败"（无报错地输出错误预测），部署中缺乏可靠预警手段。
AI.method: CALD微调解码器，使其在ID锚集上保持准确率的同时最大化与测试集预测的分歧；有害OOD批次会迫使模型偏离锚任务，从而在微调后的锚损失上体现出来，据此构造单侧检验。理论证明：在足够严重的漂移下，微调后锚损失的期望严格低于ID评估时。
AI.result: 在14个数据集（含表格与结构化分布漂移）、TabPFN与TabICL两个模型上，CALD对有害漂移的检测匹配或优于基线，且对良性漂移的误报更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CALD可作为一种实用的部署监控手段，兼顾有害漂移的敏感性检测与良性漂移下的低误报，且无需测试标签。

title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
summary: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time optimization. We also introduce the WorldBridge benchmark suite to evaluate 3D world generation from scattered, low-overlap references, which is rarely explored by current benchmarks. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method enables controllable and coherent 3D world generation, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art solutions. Our project page is available at https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/.

AI.tldr: WorldBridge 提出一个从稀疏、几乎无重叠的散乱图像生成连贯可控 3D 世界的框架，通过全局场景上下文编码、时空参考注意力与测试时潜变量一致性优化提升跨视图几何与外观一致性，并构建专门基准。
AI.motivation: 现有几何感知方法无法处理视觉重叠很少或没有重叠的散乱图像；图像/视频生成方法虽能补全未见区域，却导致跨视图几何不一致。该问题长期存在且缺乏针对性评测基准。
AI.method: 将散乱参考图编码为全局场景上下文，引导各视图的几何与外观生成；提出时间与空间参考注意力机制，沿目标轨迹增强时间参考保真度并支持轨迹外的灵活空间参考；引入即插即用的潜参考一致性策略，通过重投影引导的测试时优化提升参考保真度；同时发布 WorldBridge 基准套件。
AI.result: 定性与定量实验均表明方法可实现可控且连贯的 3D 世界生成，优于现有最先进方案。
AI.conclusion: WorldBridge 弥补了几何感知方法与生成式方法之间的空白，为低重叠散乱参考下的 3D 世界生成提供了有效方案与配套评测基准。

title: TaCo: Rethinking Correlation for Visual Tracking on Edge Devices
summary: Lightweight trackers have replaced cross-correlation with attention, and on low-power edge hardware they pay for it, since memory-bound softmax, normalization and reshaping operators of attention cost far more time than their arithmetic suggests. Benchmarking efficient trackers on an edge Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and an Arm CPU under one numerically validated protocol, we find that correlation trackers are the fast ones, but they lag in accuracy unless they adopt a ViT backbone, which brings attention back. We revisit what correlation lacks. Template--search interaction serves two roles: conditioning the search features on the target and matching them against it spatially. Attention does both, whereas correlation only matches, and does so on features extracted without knowledge of the target. We present TaCo (Target-aligned Correlation), which supplies the missing conditioning without attention by letting the template enter the per-frame network only as operands computed once per video. A descriptor of the target scales and shifts the search features channel by channel inside the backbone, and kernels aligned with the target box, each with a weight predicted from the template, correlate with them in one matrix product. With the backbone fixed, our correlation remains essential while incurring negligible NPU overhead, offering a better speed-accuracy trade-off than the attention-based interactions we tested. TaCo-T achieves 62.3% LaSOT AUC at 184 FPS on the Rockchip RV1126B NPU and 96 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 CPU, 3.0x and 3.5x the NPU speed of HiT-Tiny and AsymTrack-T at higher accuracy. TaCo-B reaches 65.6% at 50 FPS on the NPU, more than twice the speed of HiT-Base, AsymTrack-B and LightFC-vit, again at higher accuracy. Code and models are available at https://github.com/TsingWei/TaCo-Tracker.

AI.tldr: 提出TaCo，用无attention的目标对齐相关（模板条件化+目标对齐卷积核）替代注意力交互，在边缘NPU/CPU上实现更优速度-精度权衡。
AI.motivation: 轻量跟踪器用attention替代互相关，但attention中的softmax、归一化、reshape等内存受限算子在实际低功耗边缘硬件上耗时远超算术预期；而纯相关跟踪器虽快但精度落后，除非改用引入attention的ViT骨干。作者重新审视相关操作缺失的"条件化"能力。
AI.method: 将模板-搜索交互拆为两个角色：对搜索特征做目标条件化、以及空间匹配。attention两者兼有，相关只做匹配。TaCo让模板仅以每视频计算一次的算子进入逐帧网络：(1)目标描述子对骨干内搜索特征做逐通道scale和shift实现条件化；(2)与目标框对齐、权重由模板预测的卷积核，通过一次矩阵乘法完成相关。
AI.result: 在RV1126B NPU与Raspberry Pi 5 CPU上，TaCo-T达62.3% LaSOT AUC，184 FPS（NPU）、96 FPS（CPU），是HiT-Tiny和AsymTrack-T NPU速度的3.0x和3.5x且精度更高；TaCo-B达65.6%，50 FPS，速度超HiT-Base、AsymTrack-B、LightFC-vit两倍以上且精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 在骨干固定下，相关操作仍不可替代且NPU开销极小，TaCo提供了优于所测attention交互的速度-精度权衡，为边缘硬件轻量跟踪提供高效方案。

title: Adaptive Reliability Reserves for Residential Battery Fleets
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures; code and artifacts: https://github.com/MaruthiV/homefleet
summary: In a Houston 2024 replay, replacing a fixed 20 percent battery reserve with a county-risk threshold raises observed five-hour backup coverage from 75.0 percent to 86.5 percent and adds USD 10.2 in modeled annualized margin per home (paired 95 percent interval: USD +1.7 to USD +21.7). The paired coverage-gain interval includes zero. This is a conditional simulation result, not measured company reliability. Residential batteries face this tradeoff because market discharge consumes energy also needed for household outages. We release HomeFleet-ERCOT, combining observed prices and county outages with identified simulated homes and causal controller inputs. We compare independent-home optimization with 21 proximal policy optimization (PPO) training runs; ten promise-cost candidates span 31.1 percent-96.3 percent backup coverage. Of these, 10 have lower modeled margin than fixed 20 percent, and 3 also have lower coverage. Chronological, geographic, fleet, and storm tests examine transfer. An alert charging override has a conditional energy-and-power sufficiency guarantee, but only 19.5 percent of 41 county mass-outage episodes provide enough continuous warning for every battery preset. Synthetic tests include short, missed, and false warnings, load uplift, capacity loss, and dropout. A static AC audit retains existing feeder violations; aging comparisons expose model sensitivity. The released benchmark, controllers, and checkpoints provide a reproducible basis for comparing these tradeoffs. This work supports the design of residential battery programs that assess market value and household backup service together.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HomeFleet-ERCOT基准，用2024休斯顿重放对比家庭电池"市场放电收益"与"家庭备电服务"的权衡，发现多数PPO策略并不优于固定20%备电规则，仅少数实现覆盖与收益双增。
AI.motivation: 居民电池的市场放电会消耗本应留作停电备用的电量，现有电池项目设计缺少同时评估市场价值与家庭备电服务的可复现基准。
AI.method: 基于观测电价与县级停电数据构建识别化模拟家庭与因果控制器输入的HomeFleet-ERCOT；比较独立家庭优化与21次PPO训练；将固定20%备电规则替换为县级风险阈值，进行配对分析；开展时间序列、地理、车队与风暴迁移测试、告警充电覆盖策略的能效充分性保证分析，以及短/漏/误告警、负荷抬升、容量损失、掉线等合成测试和静态AC审计。
AI.result: 县级风险阈值将五小时备电覆盖率从75.0%提升至86.5%，每户年化边际收益+10.2美元（配对95%区间+1.7至+21.7），但覆盖增益区间含零；10个承诺成本候选覆盖31.1%–96.3%，其中10个margin低于固定20%，3个覆盖也更低；41次县级大规模停电中仅19.5%能为所有电池预设提供足够连续预警。
AI.conclusion: 结果为条件性仿真而非实测可靠性；发布基准、控制器与检查点，为兼顾市场价值与家庭备电的居民电池项目设计提供可复现比较基础。

title: From Diagnosing Alignment to Joint Supervision in Multimodal Draft Training
summary: Multimodal drafts learn from multimodal (MM) and text-only (TXT) supervision, yet their effects on alignment and how to combine them remain unclear. We diagnose draft-target alignment through paired predictions with and without visual input, decomposing distributional error into text-conditioned and visual-response components. Drafts with similar text-conditioned alignment can still differ markedly in visual-response risk and acceptance. Controlled continuation training shows that high-risk groups outperform random and low-risk groups, and visual-response risk guides MM training more effectively than aggregate risk. Building on these diagnostics, we propose MNRS-Joint, which configures joint supervision from a given draft's component-risk distributions, using modality-specific mean risks to determine the MM:TXT mixture. Across three warm-ups, its distinct mixtures fall in high-performing regions of the ratio sweeps. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, MNRS-Joint improves mean accepted length from 3.35 to 3.53 and mean speedup from $2.04\times$ to $2.16\times$ over composition-matched random training under greedy tree decoding. The gains also hold under stochastic chain decoding.

AI.tldr: 论文通过配对预测诊断多模态草稿模型的对齐误差，提出按模态风险配置MM:TXT监督比例的MNRS-Joint方法，在LLaVA-1.5-7B上提升接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 多模态草稿模型同时接受多模态(MM)与纯文本(TXT)监督，但二者对对齐的影响及如何组合尚不清晰，现有做法缺乏对训练监督配比的诊断依据。
AI.method: 以有/无视觉输入的配对预测诊断草稿与目标模型的对齐，将分布误差分解为文本条件组件与视觉响应组件；通过控制续训实验验证视觉响应风险的分组差异，并据此提出MNRS-Joint，用模态特定的平均风险决定MM:TXT混合比例。
AI.result: 高风险组在续训中优于随机组与低风险组，视觉响应风险比聚合风险更能指导MM训练；MNRS-Joint在三个warm-up下所得配比均落入比例扫描的高性能区；LLaVA-1.5-7B上贪心树解码平均接受长度3.35→3.53、加速2.04×→2.16×，随机链解码下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 按组件风险而非聚合风险配置多模态与文本监督比例，可有效提升多模态投机解码的草稿质量与推理加速。

title: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published at The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. Such labels can arise from heuristics, sensor-derived events, or existing rule-based systems, allowing Split-RL to incorporate rule-derived structure while retaining a learned policy. We theoretically show how early gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information and characterize when the Split-RL score isolates conflicting updates. We focus on constrained RL and offline RL with mixed datasets, each balancing two objectives that conflict locally. Across domains with spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, Split-RL consistently outperforms existing methods by meeting the episodic cost budget while maintaining competitive rewards. In offline settings, Split-RL localizes the tradeoff between imitation and policy improvement, outperforming other methods and achieving near-expert performance across varying dataset sizes.

AI.tldr: Split-RL：一种利用引导标签在树构建中局部隔离冲突梯度信号的梯度提升树RL算法，在约束RL与离线混合数据集任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 强化学习策略常被时空局部化的矛盾反馈训练（如开阔处求快、狭窄处求准）。神经网络参数共享所有来源的反馈，缺乏结构机制隔离冲突信号；标准树拟合也会在到达叶节点前聚合矛盾梯度信号。因此需要一种能按目标显式划分状态空间并防止信号干扰的方法。
AI.method: 提出Split-RL，基于梯度提升树（GBT）。利用GBT的归纳偏置显式按目标划分状态空间，并将引导标签（来自启发式、传感器事件或规则系统）整合进树构建过程，把更新路由到不相交的状态空间区域，避免信号干扰。理论上分析早期梯度聚合如何丢失目标特定信息，并刻画Split-RL评分何时能隔离冲突更新。聚焦约束RL与混有不同目标数据的离线RL两类场景。
AI.result: 在存在空间、稀有事件和时间冲突的多个领域上，Split-RL一致优于现有方法，在满足回合成本预算的同时保持有竞争力的奖励；离线设置下能定位模仿与策略改进之间的权衡，在不同数据集规模上优于其他方法并达到接近专家水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过在树构建阶段引入引导标签并局部隔离冲突梯度，Split-RL有效解决了多目标矛盾反馈下的策略学习问题，既能融入规则结构又保留可学习策略，在约束与离线RL中展现优越性与近专家性能。

title: Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion
summary: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. From the frequency perspective, we establish the equivalence between pixel-space and frequency-space diffusion when keeping the network operating in pixel space. On ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, EiT consistently outperforms JiT (Just image Transformers) in generation quality. Specifically, our EiT achieves better FID than JiT: 1.61 vs. 1.85 at $256\times256$, and 1.73 vs. 1.99 at $512\times512$. Remarkably, EiT can be seamlessly applied to video pixel diffusion by simply extending the patch size to temporal dimension and outperforms video latent diffusion in FVD evaluated on Kinetics-600 (resolution 256), under comparable total network parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/forever208/EiT

AI.tldr: 提出EiT（瓶颈式像素扩散Transformer），从架构、表示、频域三方面改进像素空间扩散，在ImageNet 256/512上超越JiT，并可无缝扩展到视频。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散相对潜空间扩散仍有差距，需系统探究其关键设计因素（模型架构、表示、频域），以提升像素扩散的生成质量。
AI.method: 受去噪自编码器（DAE）通过瓶颈去噪的启发，构建U形像素扩散Transformer，沿通道维度显式压缩；分析各层与各时间步的三阶段表示动态（去噪/局部特征扩展、基提升、后验投影），并借助通道瓶颈与更深网络实现更早去噪、更长基提升阶段；同时建立像素空间与频域扩散在保持网络于像素空间运算时的等价性。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256 FID 1.61 vs JiT 1.85；512×512 FID 1.73 vs JiT 1.99。将patch扩展至时间维后应用于视频像素扩散，在Kinetics-600（256分辨率）、相当总网络参数下FVD优于视频潜扩散。
AI.conclusion: EiT通过通道瓶颈架构与更早去噪、更长基提升的表示动态有效提升像素扩散质量，并可直接推广至视频生成，为像素空间扩散提供了可行且强的设计范式。

title: Barron Smoothness for Layers in Deep Neural Networks
summary: In order to bound approximation errors for deep neural networks, we split the problem into two steps: First the selection of optimal infinite width limits for each layer and second an optimal discretization of all layers to obtain finite sized networks. We show that in expectation, the latter problem is equivalently characterized by a layer wise generalization of Barron norms. Moreover, we provide an analysis of the optimization landscape and show that local minima are characterized by an equidistribution principle akin to similar ideas in adaptive spline and finite element approximation.

AI.tldr: 将深度网络逼近误差界拆为"选最优无限宽极限"和"最优离散化得有限网络"两步；后者在期望意义下等价于逐层推广的Barron范数，并刻画了优化景观中局部极小满足的等分布原理。
AI.motivation: 为深度神经网络给出逼近误差的界，需要合理选择每层网络宽度并优化有限宽度网络的离散化方案，此前的分析缺乏对这两步的系统分离与对优化景观的理论刻画。
AI.method: 把问题分两步：第一步为每层选取最优的无限宽极限；第二步对所有层做最优离散化以得到有限规模网络。利用期望意义下的分析，将该离散化问题等价刻画为Barron范数的逐层推广，并分析相应的优化景观，推导局部极小点的性质。
AI.result: 证明离散化问题在期望下由逐层推广的Barron范数等价刻画；并发现局部极小由一种"等分布原理"刻画，与自适应样条和有限元逼近中的类似思想相通。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了分析深度网络逼近误差的清晰结构，把宽度选择与离散化分离，并借助等分布原理联系到经典逼近理论，为误差界与优化行为提供理论依据。

title: FoMNet: Adaptive Kernels Meet Contextual Matching for Cross-Modal Homography Estimation
summary: Cross-modal homography estimation requires reliable correspondences despite appearance differences between sensing modalities. Multi-scale refinement progressively reduces the search range, but its accuracy remains limited by the ability of matching features to distinguish nearby candidates. The vision foundation model (VFM) provides complementary representations, yet integrating these features through fixed interpolation leaves their spatial aggregation independent of image content and the correspondence objective. We propose the Foundation Model-Enhanced Matching Network (FoMNet), which combines learned spatial adaptation of VFM features with contextual correspondence estimation. Patch Feature Upsampling (PFU) progressively predicts location-specific kernels to aggregate neighboring features on upsampled grids, preparing VFM representations for fusion with CNN features at different matching scales. Contextual Correlation Refinement (CCR) then jointly processes source descriptors and local correlations with spatial context to refine candidate scores before each homography update. To reduce upsampling overhead, we develop FoMNet-D, which replaces PFU with bicubic interpolation and uses multi-scale feature-relation distillation to recover accuracy. Experiments on five cross-modal datasets show that FoMNet achieves the lowest mean average corner error (MACE) among the evaluated methods, reducing MACE by 10.6%-72.7% relative to MCNet. FoMNet-D retains competitive accuracy while reducing inference latency by 34.0% relative to FoMNet.

AI.tldr: 提出FoMNet，将视觉基础模型特征的自适应空间聚合与上下文对应估计结合，用于跨模态单应性估计，MACE较MCNet降低10.6%-72.7%。
AI.motivation: 跨模态单应性估计依赖可靠对应关系，但多尺度细化受限于特征区分邻近候选的能力；VFM特征以固定插值融合，空间聚合与图像内容和对应目标无关。
AI.method: PFU逐步预测位置特定卷积核，在上采样网格聚合邻域特征，使VFM表示适配不同匹配尺度并与CNN特征融合；CCR联合处理源描述子与局部相关性及空间上下文，在每次单应性更新前细化候选分数；FoMNet-D用双三次插值替代PFU，并以多尺度特征关系蒸馏恢复精度。
AI.result: 在五个跨模态数据集上，FoMNet取得最低MACE，较MCNet降低10.6%-72.7%；FoMNet-D保持竞争力精度，推理延迟较FoMNet降低34.0%。
AI.conclusion: 内容自适应的VFM特征聚合与上下文相关性细化能有效提升跨模态匹配精度，且可通过蒸馏在轻量变体中保持精度。

title: Transferring Architecture as an Optimization Prior
summary: Initialization determines the optimization "fate" of a model, going far beyond just setting the scale of its weights. It establishes a fundamental initial geometry over the input data, dictating certain aspects such as which examples are considered close and which representations gradient descent will naturally refine first. In this paper, we view the initial geometry of a network as an optimization prior and ask whether a network can change its optimization prior by referencing a completely different architecture. To investigate this question, we use an initialization procedure where a target network is aligned to the representational geometry of a randomly initialized guide network before any downstream training occurs. Crucially, alignment to the guide network cannot transfer learned features, never receives gradients, and does not use labels. We demonstrate that this cross-architecture transfer of "fate" benefits the target network in two key domains: (1) instilling the optimization benefits of depth into shallow networks by aligning them to deeper networks, and (2) transferring representational granularity by using fine-resolution networks to shape the geometry of networks with coarser representations. In both cases, the alignment results in improved downstream performance of the target network. Ultimately, this demonstrates that a model's architectural destiny can be decoupled from its physical structure and explicitly modified at initialization.

AI.tldr: 通过将目标网络在训练前对齐到随机初始化引导网络的表示几何，可跨架构转移"初始化命运"，为浅层网络注入深度优势、为粗粒度网络转移细粒度表示能力，提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 初始化不仅决定权重尺度，还确立了输入数据上的初始几何结构，是重要的优化先验。作者想探究：网络能否通过参考一个完全不同的架构来改变自身的优化先验（即"命运"能否与物理结构解耦）。
AI.method: 提出一种初始化流程：在无任何下游训练前，将目标网络对齐到随机初始化的引导网络的表示几何。关键设计是引导网络不传递已学特征、不接收梯度、不使用标签，从而实现跨架构的"命运"转移。
AI.result: 在两个场景均有效：(1) 将浅层网络对齐到深层网络，为其引入深度的优化收益；(2) 用高分辨率网络塑造粗表示网络的几何，实现表示粒度转移。两种情况下目标网络的下游性能均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 模型的架构命运可与其物理结构解耦，并能在初始化阶段被显式修改，说明初始几何可作为一种可转移的优化先验。

title: When Position Favors the Wrong Part: Evaluating Left-Right Discrimination in Semantic Correspondence
summary: Overall part-discrimination accuracy can conceal failures when image position favors the wrong bilateral part. We examine whether dense descriptors distinguish the correct part under this conflict and whether their discrimination scores help select matching coordinates. We evaluate position agreement and conflict within the same target images and annotated part pairs, using a bounding-box-side score to define the conditions. We compare the original descriptors with their even and odd components under horizontal reflection, examine feature upsampling with the backbone and adapters fixed, and test candidate-selection rules based on odd scores. On SPair-71k, odd discrimination accuracy falls from 86.66% under agreement to 19.63% under conflict for frozen DINOv2, compared with 95.27% to 86.16% for MARCO. With MARCO's input geometry fixed, odd accuracy in box-side conflict was 34.12% on the native grid and 88.84% after learned upsampling and pooling back to that grid. Odd-score rules improve on the original hard-peak matchers overall for DINOv2 and DINOv3 and on conflict queries for MARCO.
