The selector ranks regions from a slide thumbnail, encodes the top K regions at 5x magnification, and selects b for processing at 20x. We evaluate seven frozen MIL aggregators on six tasks and compare them with nine efficient methods trained on the same features and splits. At a budget of (K,b)=(1000,10), encoding costs about 6.6% of the full bag and is 10-14x faster, excluding tiling. The AUROC drop is no more than 0.005 in 33 of 36 aggregator-task pairs. At (500,10), the cost falls to about 4% and inference is 13-22x faster, but AUROC drops by up to 0.035 on CAMELYON17, where small metastases are easily missed. Selection improves over random sampling by about 0.10 AUROC on tasks with focal lesions, while random sampling performs well on diffuse tasks. In our comparisons, the frozen model at (500,10) is ahead of nine efficient methods in 55 of 60 paired comparisons. Giving an existing WSI model fewer tiles is thus a baseline that a new efficient model should be compared with at matched encoder cost.

AI.tldr: 提出"冻结全图模型+轻量选块"作为WSI高效推理基线，在(500,10)预算下推理快13-22倍，性能优于此前的9种高效方法。
AI.motivation: 全切片级别分类需编码上千个高分辨率图块，编码是推理成本主要来源。现有高效方法多需在自选策略上重新训练模型，而"直接冻结现有全图模型、仅在选中的图块上运行"这一替代方案基本未被系统研究，也缺少与随机采样的等成本对比。
AI.method: 用仅3.3K参数的轻量选择器拟合冻结模型注意力（无需额外切片标签）：先在缩略图上排序区域，对前K个区域以5x编码，再挑b个以20x送入选定冻结MIL聚合器。在7个冻结MIL聚合器、6个任务上与9种高效方法在相同特征与划分下对比，并加入等成本随机采样。
AI.result: (K,b)=(1000,10)时编码成本约为全图的6.6%、快10-14倍，36个聚合器-任务组合中33个AUROC下降≤0.005；(500,10)时成本约4%、快13-22倍，但CAMELYON17因微小转移灶漏检AUROC最多降0.035。焦灶任务上选择比随机采样高约0.10 AUROC，弥散任务随机采样表现好。冻结模型(500,10)在60组配对比较中55组领先9种高效方法。
AI.conclusion: 给现有WSI模型更少图块是一个强基线，新高效模型应在等编码成本下与其比较。

title: CADENCE: Sensor-GroundedWorld-Consistent Gaussian SLAM for Collaborative Mobile Reconstruction
summary: Collaborative reconstruction with consumer phones promises faster and more complete indoor maps. However, heterogeneous devices introduce degraded observations and unreliable cross-device associations, so a single poor contributor or incorrect match can corrupt the shared Gaussian map. To address this, we propose \textbf{CADENCE}, a collaborative Gaussian simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that separates finding cross-device matches from deciding whether and how peer observations update the map. To find matches, a sensor-grounded regional memory summarizes committed observations and ranks candidate peer regions using appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude, and observation quality. Deterministic geometric verification and optional physical checks then decide which of the proposed matches are accepted. Once a match is accepted, separate cue-based confidences control how its observations contribute to pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory. As a result, useful depth can still contribute even when color is unreliable. Throughout this process, local tracking remains isolated from mapping, verification, and networking. We evaluate CADENCE on eight Matterport3D houses that were not used to train the memory. On these houses, regional memory achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of $0.95$ to $0.97$ and thus outperforms appearance retrieval, while verification keeps false-link rates below $0.5\,\%$. Furthermore, soft confidence weighting reduces the mean receiver peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) loss from $2.66$ to $1.05$\,dB across eight degradations while retaining useful peer depth. Finally, using inertial and platform motion, CADENCE tracks all twelve held-out iPhone scans with a mean absolute trajectory error of $6.98$\,cm, and its refined maps achieve better average rendering quality than the baselines.

AI.tldr: CADENCE 是一个多设备协同高斯 SLAM 系统，将"找到跨设备匹配"与"决定匹配如何更新地图"解耦，实现鲁棒协同建图。
AI.motivation: 手机协同重建室内地图更快更完整，但异构设备带来退化观测和不可靠的跨设备关联，单个劣质贡献者或错误匹配就会污染共享高斯地图。
AI.method: 提出 CADENCE：用传感器锚定的区域记忆（融合外观、相对位姿、重力、气压高度、观测质量）排序候选同伴区域以找匹配；再用确定性几何验证与可选物理校验决定是否接受；接受后按不同线索置信度分别控制对位姿约束、几何、外观和记忆的贡献；本地跟踪与建图/验证/通信隔离。
AI.result: 在 8 个未参与训练的 Matterport3D 房屋上，区域记忆 AUROC 达 0.95–0.97，优于外观检索，误链率低于 0.5%；软置信加权将 8 种退化下的平均 PSNR 损失从 2.66 dB 降至 1.05 dB；12 个留出 iPhone 扫描全部成功跟踪，平均绝对轨迹误差 6.98 cm，精化地图渲染质量优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离匹配发现与置信度加权融合、并隔离本地跟踪，CADENCE 在异构设备条件下实现了鲁棒的协同高斯 SLAM 与高质量地图重建。

title: Score-based Black-box Attack via Adversarial Condition Guided Diffusion Model
summary: Generative models enable unrestricted adversarial attacks that aim to fool classifiers while preserving the natural appearance and semantics of the original image. However, existing diffusion-based black-box attacks largely rely on transferability from surrogates, making their effectiveness sensitive to differences between surrogate and victim. Improving transferability can also distort semantic content and degrade image quality. Moreover, retaining the original prompt to preserve fidelity leaves the diffusion model's conditional prior underused for adversarial guidance. We address these limitations by adapting score-based black-box attacks to reverse diffusion, using the victim's output probabilities to guide latent updates without accessing its gradients. We further introduce adaptive-target guidance, which uses the victim's current runner-up class as an adversarial condition to steer denoising towards the decision boundary. Because such guidance can introduce unwanted semantic changes, we also propose target-search guidance, which searches for a small perturbation of the original condition embedding using a score-based attack. This achieves comparable attack effectiveness with better image quality than runner-up guidance. Experiments on the ImageNet-Compatible dataset show that our framework outperforms transfer-based baselines in both attack effectiveness and image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基于分数的黑盒攻击适配到逆向扩散过程，用受害者模型输出概率引导潜变量更新，并引入自适应目标引导（runner-up类别）与目标搜索引导（条件嵌入小扰动），在ImageNet-Compatible数据集上攻击效果与图像质量均优于迁移攻击基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的黑盒攻击主要依赖替代模型迁移性，效果对替代/受害者差异敏感；提升迁移性会扭曲语义、降低图像质量；且保留原始prompt使扩散模型的条件先验未被用于对抗引导。
AI.method: 把score-based黑盒攻击接入逆向扩散，用受害者输出概率（无梯度）更新潜变量；提出adaptive-target guidance，以受害者当前次优类作为对抗条件引导去噪靠近决策边界；并因该引导可能带来语义改变，提出target-search guidance，用score-based攻击搜索原条件嵌入的小扰动。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-Compatible数据集上，该框架在攻击有效性和图像质量两方面均优于基于迁移的基线；target-search引导达到与runner-up引导相当的攻击效果，且图像质量更好。
AI.conclusion: 直接利用受害者反馈引导逆向扩散可摆脱对迁移性的依赖，在保持自然外观与语义的同时实现有效黑盒对抗攻击。

title: Physics-Guided Generative Modelling of Oxy-Combustion Flame Images: From Conditional LSGANs to Denoising Diffusion Models
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for the 12th International Conference on Combustion Science and Processes (CSP 2027)
summary: Validating industrial oxy-combustion burner designs traditionally requires costly experimental campaigns in which each operating condition is physically reproduced on an instrumented rig and imaged via OH* chemiluminescence, rendering iterative design exploration prohibitively slow. This work develops deep generative surrogate models that map a 15-dimensional vector of continuous operating parameters (thermal power, swirl numbers, momentum ratios, mixture fractions, etc.) directly to a $512\times64$ heat-release flame image, trained on 1,609 experimental samples from the OXYTEC dual-swirl non-premixed oxy-combustion database. Two complementary generative paradigms are investigated, as they offer opposite strengths for surrogate modelling: a custom spatially-anchored conditional least-squares GAN (cLSGAN-L1-CBN), whose single-pass generation enables near-instantaneous inference, and a custom physics-guided denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), whose iterative sampling favours the smooth, continuous heat-release gradients of fluid flows. Both are validated through ablation on a stratified held-out test set. The optimized cLSGAN reaches RMSE 0.022 and FID 20.68 and generates an image in about 20 ms on a mobile workstation GPU, though extended training leaves its texture realism unchanged; the DDPM improves steadily over long training horizons, reaching RMSE 0.019 and FID 20.29 at 40,000 epochs, at the cost of roughly thirty seconds per image on the same hardware --- three orders of magnitude slower than the adversarial surrogate. A nearest-neighbour analysis traces the persistent worst-case errors to sparsely sampled regions of the parameter space, and a parameter-sensitivity study confirms smooth, physically consistent responses to perturbed inputs. These results demonstrate that carefully guided generative models can act as reliable visual surrogates for combustion experiments.

AI.tldr: 该文提出深度生成式代理模型，将15维工况参数直接映射为火焰放热图像，用以替代昂贵的氧燃烧器实验验证；对比条件GAN与扩散模型两种范式。
AI.motivation: 传统工业氧燃烧器设计验证需在仪器化台架上逐一复现工况并做OH*化学发光成像，成本高、迭代极慢，亟需能即时预测火焰图像的代理模型。
AI.method: 基于OXYTEC双旋流非预混氧燃烧数据库的1609个实验样本，构建两种生成式代理：(1) 自定义空间锚定条件最小二乘GAN（cLSGAN-L1-CBN），单次生成；(2) 自定义物理引导DDPM，迭代采样。通过分层留出测试集消融验证，并做最近邻分析与参数敏感性分析。
AI.result: 优化后cLSGAN达RMSE 0.022、FID 20.68，移动工作站GPU上约20 ms/图，但长时训练纹理真实性不再提升；DDPM在40000轮达RMSE 0.019、FID 20.29，但约30 s/图，慢约三个数量级。最差误差集中于参数空间稀疏采样区，敏感性分析显示响应平滑且物理一致。
AI.conclusion: 精心引导的生成模型可作为燃烧实验可靠的视觉代理；GAN胜在速度、DDPM胜在精度与可扩展性，误差主要源于数据覆盖不足。

title: A Hard Background Pairing Transfers across Classifiers and Images
summary: An image classifier names the object in an image, and its accuracy is the share of images named correctly. A classifier that names a car on a road may miss the same car pasted onto clouds. Composite benchmarks measure such failures by pasting objects cut from photographs onto backgrounds from other photographs. A pairing puts every object label on a different background label, such as truck on sea. The pairing on which some classifiers do worst, their hardest pairing, makes a strict test, but may be hard only for them or only on the photographs used to choose it. We show that the hardest pairing of some classifiers stays hard for others and on new photographs. We split 40 ImageNet classifiers into halves balanced by reported ImageNet accuracy. One half picks its hardest pairing of 8 object and 8 background labels from Common Objects in Context (COCO). The other half, held out of the choice, compares that pairing with random pairings of the same objects and backgrounds. For the 14 held-out classifiers with little net accuracy change after pasting objects back onto their own backgrounds, mean accuracy on composites from new photographs falls from 50.3% over random pairings to 43.7% on the hardest pairing, 6.6 percentage points lower. A benchmark using these composites can compare this pool's held-out classifiers on the fixed and random pairings.

AI.tldr: 作者验证了"最难配对"（如卡车贴到海上）不依赖特定分类器或特定照片：用一半ImageNet分类器选出的最难配对，对另一半留出分类器及新照片同样成立，平均精度比随机配对低6.6个百分点，可作为固定基准。
AI.motivation: 复合基准通过把物体贴到其他照片背景上测试分类器鲁棒性，但"最难配对"可能只对该批分类器或用于挑选它的那些照片才难，其普适性未知。
AI.method: 将40个ImageNet分类器按报告精度均衡分为两半；一半从COCO的8个物体与8个背景标签中选出最难配对，另一半（留出）不参与选择，仅比较该配对与同标签随机配对的表现；并额外使用新照片构建复合图，筛选出对贴回原背景后精度变化小的14个留出分类器进行评测。
AI.result: 在14个留出分类器上，新照片复合图平均精度从随机配对的50.3%降至最难配对的43.7%，下降6.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 最难配对具有跨分类器、跨照片的迁移性，可固定为一个复合基准，用于公平比较该分类器池中的留出模型。

title: ADClaw: A Programmable Visual Agent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.

AI.tldr: ADClaw 提出一种无需任务微调的检查智能体，用可执行代码反复检验缺陷假设，在 2D/3D 工业异常检测与 MMAD 理解任务上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 IAD 视觉语言模型依赖大规模领域数据微调且仅单次前向预测，无法复查模糊区域；工具型智能体虽可回看，但预定义工具接口限制了中间结果的组合能力，导致漏检细微缺陷或误判缺陷类型。
AI.method: ADClaw 包含三部分：1）结构化正常性先验（Structured Normality Prior），为每个假设检索适用规则与目标正常视觉参考；2）持久化检查工作台（Inspection Workbench），智能体在其中编写并执行代码，将掩码、异常图与测量量组合成新的检验；3）假设引导证据推理（Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning），判断证据是否支持疑似缺陷及位置，并以证据缺口或矛盾引导下一步代码动作。
AI.result: 在 2D 与 3D 工业异常检测基准上的检测与定位任务，以及 MMAD 的异常理解任务中均取得有竞争力的效果。
AI.conclusion: 以代码为工具的 hypothesis 检验范式可在免微调条件下提升 IAD 的灵活复查与推理能力。

title: LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction with Limited Real Data: An Architecture Benchmark under Fixed-Epoch Training
summary: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), inference timing, and spectral-energy agreement. We also evaluate four selected architectures with fixed-size training mixtures containing 0\%, 1\%, 5\%, 10\%, 20\%, 50\%, or 100\% real frames. With real-only training, UNet-V2 achieves the best reported reconstruction metrics (MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, and SSIM 0.647), followed by a denoising diffusion model (DDPM). In several mixtures containing 1--10\% real data, DDPM achieves lower error and higher image-quality metrics than the evaluated deterministic alternatives, whereas UNet-V2 leads with 100\% real data. Spectral analysis additionally reveals architecture-dependent discrepancies across frequency bands. These findings characterize reconstruction trade-offs under the stated data mixtures and fixed-epoch protocol, without establishing compute-matched superiority or isolating the diffusion objective from backbone differences.

AI.tldr: 该论文在统一20轮训练协议下，用真实SemanticKITTI与合成VoxelScape距离图像数据基准测试了9种神经架构从深度、语义标签、入射角和材质反射率重建LiDAR强度，并考察不同真实数据比例的影响。结果表明：纯真实数据训练时UNet-V2指标最佳，而仅1–10%真实数据混合时DDPM在误差和图像质量上更优。
AI.motivation: 真实LiDAR强度测量稀缺，物理仿真可作补充，但其效果取决于学习架构与可用真实训练数据量，二者缺乏系统性的对比认识。
AI.method: 选取9种神经架构，以深度、语义标签、入射角、材质反射率为输入重建强度；在SemanticKITTI（真实）与VoxelScape（合成）距离图像上统一采用固定20轮训练协议；评估MAE、MSE、PSNR、SSIM、推理时间和频谱能量一致性；并对4种代表性架构测试0%、1%、5%、10%、20%、50%、100%真实帧的固定规模混合训练。
AI.result: 纯真实数据训练时UNet-V2指标最好（MAE 0.234、MSE 0.140、PSNR 8.64 dB、SSIM 0.647），DDPM次之；在含1–10%真实数据的多种混合中DDPM误差更低、图像质量指标更高；频谱分析显示不同架构在各频段存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了给定数据混合与固定轮次协议下的重建权衡，但未确立算力对齐下的优越性，也未将扩散目标与骨干网络差异分离。

title: SEAM: A Self-Evolving and Adaptive Probing Framework for Automatic MLLM Hallucination Evaluation
summary: The severe susceptibility of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to hallucinations poses a critical threat to their reliability, making a rigorous evaluation framework indispensable. However, existing evaluation pipelines largely rely on predefined test items, suffering from high construction costs, rapid obsolescence as MLLMs evolve, and ineffectiveness in probing model-specific weaknesses. To address these limitations, we propose SEAM, a self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation. Specifically, SEAM introduces a composable Hallucination Probe Construction Library comprising ten hallucination-probing skills, three elicitation wrappers, and five question formats. Building on this library, SEAM establishes a dual-loop framework. In the inner loop (adaptive probing), skill-guided visual analysis, question composition, and hierarchical quality verification are coordinated with verifier and target-response feedback to refine test items and uncover model-specific hallucinations. In the outer loop (skill evolution), a skill updater distills historical probing trajectories into localized, reusable rule updates, which undergo held-out validation and are frozen before testing. Driven by these innovative structural designs, SEAM establishes an automated and self-evolving evaluation paradigm. Experiments across four target MLLMs and ten hallucination types demonstrate that SEAM substantially outperforms representative static benchmarks, achieving an 89.2\% relative improvement in mean valid hallucination discovery rate across 12 matched comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出SEAM自演化自适应探测框架，自动构建测试项以评估MLLM幻觉，显著优于静态基准。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM幻觉评测依赖预定义测试项，构建成本高、随模型演化迅速过时，且难以探测模型特有的弱点。
AI.method: 构建可组合的幻觉探测构建库（10种探测技能、3种诱导包装、5种问题格式）；采用双循环框架：内循环做自适应探测（技能引导的视觉分析、问题组合、分层质量校验，结合验证器与目标响应反馈迭代优化测试项），外循环做技能演化（技能更新器将历史探测轨迹蒸馏为局部可复用规则，经留出验证后冻结再测试）。
AI.result: 在4个目标MLLM和10类幻觉上实验，12组匹配比较中平均有效幻觉发现率相对提升89.2%，显著优于代表性静态基准。
AI.conclusion: SEAM实现了自动化、自演化的幻觉评测范式，能有效发现模型特异性幻觉，克服静态基准的局限。

title: You Only Look Multiple Times: YoloMT, a Real-Time Streaming Model on a T4
summary: We introduce a new model for real-time streaming captioning on a single GPU. YoloMT is a 449.8M-parameter streaming captioner that provides Pareto-frontier performance among generative vision models in its class. Distilled from a 27B teacher by SFT and GRPO, it leads every model under 1B parameters on OVO-Bench, MVBench, StreamingBench and Video-MME, answered from its captions, and beats LFM2.5-VL-1.6B and SmolVLM2-2.2B. YoloMT is designed to read more frames cheaply and make them informative, encoding each frame once and caching it as 16 tokens. This allows the model to incorporate and infer from past frames without additional vision passes, making it efficient and effective. We also provide a detailed recipe for training YoloMT, with its stages and data, as well as ablations that demonstrate the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出单GPU实时流式字幕模型YoloMT（449.8M参数），通过SFT+GRPO从27B教师蒸馏，在1B以下模型中以帕累托最优性能领先多个流式/视频基准。
AI.motivation: 在单GPU上实现高效实时的流式视频字幕生成，同时兼顾效率与效果。
AI.method: YoloMT将每帧只编码一次并缓存为16个token，使其可在无额外视觉前向的情况下利用并推理过去帧；模型由27B教师经SFT和GRPO蒸馏训练。
AI.result: 在OVO-Bench、MVBench、StreamingBench和Video-MME（以生成字幕回答）上，于1B参数以下模型中均领先，并优于LFM2.5-VL-1.6B和SmolVLM2-2.2B。
AI.conclusion: YoloMT在同类生成式视觉模型中达帕累托前沿性能；论文还给出完整训练配方（各阶段、数据）及验证各组件贡献的消融实验。

title: Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models
summary: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.

AI.tldr: 论文审计了Navigation World Models(NWM)训练与推理阶段动作编码的不一致问题，指出输入修正后可将视觉预测误差降低42%，并发布诊断修复工具ActRosetta，强调评估前须校验动作编码一致性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通常通过动作预测未来观测来评估，且默认评估时动作的准备方式与训练一致。但论文发现这种未经验证的假设可能使模型表现被低估：NWM训练与rollout代码间存在三处相互作用的差异，若不修正会导致不公正的准确率评估和错误的模型排名。
AI.method: 作者对NWM的训练与推理代码进行审计，找出三处相互作用的动作编码差异；在不重新训练的情况下修正输入，并在RECON导航数据集上用DreamSim度量平均视觉预测误差；通过消融（仅修正归一化偏移）验证误差交互效应；并对两个替代模型人为引入编码错误以检验敏感性；最后提出工具ActRosetta，用于检测动作编码是否与训练匹配、识别分歧原因并修复输入。
AI.result: 修正输入后，平均视觉预测误差（DreamSim, RECON）降低42%；修正还改变了探索性分析中NWM各checkpoint的排名，并消除或削弱了两个替代模型测得的优势；仅修正归一化偏移反而使误差上升，说明多处不一致需联合检查；故意引入编码错误后两个替代模型精度均下降。
AI.conclusion: 任何动作条件世界模型在报告rollout误差前，都应确认评估时的动作编码与训练完全一致；ActRosetta在预测对动作几乎不敏感的场景修复效果有限、诊断覆盖有限、控制改进尚未证实，但核心教训具有普适性。

title: DuCo: Exploiting Dual Cross-Layer Consistency for Sparse Geometric Attention
summary: Dense global attention is crucial for capturing cross-view geometry in visual geometry foundation models, yet its quadratic complexity limits efficient inference on long image sequences. Existing sparse attention methods primarily select entries of the global attention matrix based on attention probabilities and construct masks independently across layers, overlooking value redundancy and cross-layer information reuse. By analyzing attention distributions and clustering value representations across layers, we reveal two forms of \emph{cross-layer consistency}, characterized by highly similar attention probability distributions and localized changes in value redundancy structures. Building on these observations, we propose \textbf{DuCo}, a training-free sparse attention framework that exploits historical attention information and value redundancy for efficient geometric inference. Specifically, DuCo leverages historical attention information to estimate current-layer dense attention probabilities and introduces value clustering to exploit redundancy, with clusters efficiently refined through local updates across layers. Both factors are integrated through probability-weighted value distortion to jointly optimize four cluster representation states under an attention budget for sparse mask construction. Experiments across three visual geometry foundation models and five benchmarks demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架DuCo，利用跨层注意力分布相似性与value冗余结构的局部变化，实现视觉几何基础模型的高效推理。
AI.motivation: 视觉几何基础模型中稠密全局注意力对跨视角几何建模至关重要，但其二次复杂度限制了长图像序列的高效推理。现有稀疏注意力方法仅依据注意力概率选entry且逐层独立构mask，忽略了value冗余与跨层信息复用。
AI.method: 通过分析注意力分布与聚类value表示，发现两种跨层一致性：注意力概率分布高度相似、value冗余结构局部变化。基于此，DuCo利用历史注意力估计当前层稠密注意力概率，并用value聚类利用冗余、通过层间局部更新精炼簇；两者通过概率加权value失真统一，在注意力预算下联合优化四种簇表示状态以构建稀疏mask，无需训练。
AI.result: 在三个视觉几何基础模型和五个基准上实验，展现出良好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 跨层注意力与value冗余的一致性可被有效复用于免训练稀疏注意力，为几何基础模型长序列推理提供高效且保精度的方案。

title: Comparative Study of Deep Learning Architectures for Brain Tumour Classification
summary: Accurate and early classification of brain tumours from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for treatment planning, yet many published deep learning studies are trained and tested on small, single-source datasets, reporting accuracies that may not hold outside these datasets. This study compares six deep learning architectures for four-class classification (healthy, meningioma, glioma and pituitary tumour): a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN), an attention-based CNN, ShuffleNet, and EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50 and Xception augmented with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). The models were trained on a corpus assembled from four publicly available MRI datasets. Because these datasets carry no patient identifiers, a leakage-aware pipeline was developed that removes exact duplicates using MD5 hashing (550 images) and near-duplicates using perceptual hashing (8,024 images), and assigns visually similar images to the same fold during 5-fold group cross-validation. A leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) test on a fully held-out dataset was used to measure cross-dataset generalisation. Under a conventional random split, ShuffleNet achieved 97.1% accuracy with 1.2M parameters. Under leakage-aware group K-fold cross-validation, ShuffleNetV2 (98.41%) and EfficientNet-B0 (98.23%) were statistically indistinguishable (paired t-test, p = 0.19), and both significantly outperformed the custom CNNs. On the held-out dataset, accuracy dropped for every model: EfficientNet-B0 generalised best (78.4%), while ShuffleNetV2 fell to 66.2%. Glioma-meningioma confusion was the dominant error mode, and Grad-CAM maps showed that predictions were driven by tumour regions. These results indicate that in-distribution accuracy alone overstates real-world performance and that leakage-aware and cross-dataset evaluation should be reported alongside it.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过去重/近似去重的数据泄漏感知流程与留一数据集交叉验证，比较六种深度学习模型在四类脑肿瘤MRI分类上的表现，发现分布内准确率高达98%但跨数据集泛化骤降至66–78%。
AI.motivation: 许多已发表的脑肿瘤MRI深度学习研究仅在小型单源数据上训练与测试，报告的准确率难以推广；且公开数据集缺少患者标识，存在重复/近似重复图像导致的评估泄漏问题，使泛化性能被高估。
AI.method: 整合四个公开MRI数据集构建语料；用MD5哈希去除精确重复（550张）、感知哈希去除近似重复（8,024张），并将视觉相似图像分到同一折，进行5折分组交叉验证；比较六种架构（基线CNN、注意力CNN、ShuffleNet、以及带CBAM的EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50、Xception）；用留一数据集（LODO）测试跨数据集泛化；用配对t检验与Grad-CAM分析。
AI.result: 常规随机划分下ShuffleNet达97.1%（1.2M参数）；泄漏感知分组K折下ShuffleNetV2（98.41%）与EfficientNet-B0（98.23%）无显著差异（p=0.19），均显著优于自建CNN；留出数据集上所有模型下降，EfficientNet-B0最佳（78.4%），ShuffleNetV2降至66.2%；主要错误模式为胶质瘤-脑膜瘤混淆，Grad-CAM显示预测集中在肿瘤区域。
AI.conclusion: 分布内准确率会高估真实世界性能；应同时报告泄漏感知评估与跨数据集评估结果，轻量模型（如EfficientNet-B0）在跨中心泛化上更具优势。

title: Commit2Drive: Perception-Grounded Language Decisions as Commitments for Trajectory Planning in Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 19 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code will be released soon
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models introduce language reasoning into end-to-end autonomous driving. They output a language decision together with a trajectory, which makes the planner more interpretable. However, in existing methods the language decision is either an independent output or an index that selects among similar candidate trajectories, and its annotations are not verified against the trajectory. As a result, the language decision and the trajectory are often inconsistent in closed-loop driving. To address this, we propose Commit2Drive, a framework that imposes the language decision as a consistency constraint on trajectory planning. The decision is a commitment, a maneuver class with a continuous parameter that one deterministic rule reads from any trajectory, and it is grounded in facts reported by the perception of the model itself. A Maneuver Bank maps the commitment to a code with a kinematic meaning, and consistency losses train the planner to execute every admissible decision of a scene, so that the trajectory follows the decision. An automatic data pipeline supplies the supervision. Decisions are labeled from the future motion of the expert, counterfactual executions train the decision and the trajectory together, and rule-based functions with a Vision-Language Model (VLM) generate, review and refine the language annotations. The code is a lookup that involves no hidden state of the language model, so Commit2Drive is extensible to rule-based decisions, which the same planner executes without retraining. Commit2Drive uses a 0.5B language model and runs closed-loop inference online on a single consumer graphics card. On Bench2Drive, Commit2Drive reaches a Driving Score (DS) of 78.50 and a Success Rate (SR) of 55.91% with a lightweight model, which is competitive with the state of the art, and greatly reduces the language-action inconsistency. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: Commit2Drive 将语言决策作为轨迹规划的一致性约束：决策是从任意轨迹可读出、且扎根于自车感知事实的"承诺"（机动类+连续参数），通过 Maneuver Bank 编码与一致性损失训练规划器执行每个可采纳决策，并由自动数据管道提供监督。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 自动驾驶中语言决策要么是独立输出，要么只是在相似候选轨迹间做索引，且标注未与轨迹校验，导致闭环驾驶中语言决策与轨迹经常不一致、可解释性名不副实。
AI.method: 把语言决策定义为"承诺"——一种带连续参数的机动类别，可由唯一确定性规则从任意轨迹读出，并基于模型自身感知报告的事实。用 Maneuver Bank 将承诺映射为具运动学含义的码，施加一致性损失使规划器执行场景中每个可采纳决策。数据方面：从专家未来运动标注决策，用反事实执行联合训练决策与轨迹，再用规则函数加 VLM 生成、审阅、精炼语言标注。码是查表、不依赖语言模型隐状态。
AI.result: 在 Bench2Drive 上，使用 0.5B 语言模型的轻量方案达到 DS 78.50、SR 55.91%，与 SOTA 具竞争力；大幅降低语言-动作不一致；可在单张消费级显卡上在线闭环推理；且无需再训练即可扩展到规则型决策。
AI.conclusion: 以"承诺+可查表码"的形式把语言决策与轨迹强绑定，是一种轻量、可解释、可扩展且闭环可用的 VLA 规划范式。

title: Beyond Pose Control: Anatomically Consistent Ultrasound Video Generation
summary: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出为超声视频生成器注入"解剖先验"与"3D潜在记忆"两类知识，超越单纯位姿控制，实现新视角生成时合理且跨回访一致的解剖结构。
AI.motivation: 相机控制式视频生成依赖大规模数据隐式学习场景先验，但超声中追踪扫描数据稀少，无法隐式学习；而解剖学本身提供了显式先验。仅靠位姿控制导致未扫描区域解剖不合理、回访时解剖不一致。
AI.method: 模仿超声医师心理模型：1）基于人群受试者的解剖先验，引导未扫描区域生成，并被每个生成的切片块在线细化以贴近目标受试者，跨Transformer块指导布局；2）围绕超声横截面物理设计的3D潜在记忆，将生成切片累积成患者体积并在新位姿重切片，以细粒度形式从输入端注入生成器，保证回访一致性。
AI.result: 在甲状腺、肾脏和腰椎数据集上，视觉保真度、位姿跟随性和解剖一致性均优于位姿条件与记忆增强的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式解剖先验结合物理启发的3D记忆，可有效解决数据稀缺下的位姿可控超声生成，提升解剖合理性与一致性。

title: Guidance as Variance Matching
summary: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer to hand-crafted ones on SD 3.5 Medium. Third, we offer an interpretation of the mechanism behind guidance: each model makes a random error in predicting the posterior mean, and guidance rescales the difference of these errors into a sample with the posterior's covariance, which improves sampling. This view also suggests two new hypotheses that our experiments support: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its own checkpoint needs a larger scale than guiding it with an independently trained model.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现扩散模型中的guidance并非提升后验均值预测，而是修正其方差不足；提出方差匹配guidance规则，无需调参即可复现11个常用模型的启发式guidance尺度，并给出采样改进的机理解释。
AI.motivation: Guidance（如CFG）能显著提升扩散模型生成质量，但其作用机制尚不清楚。作者质疑"guidance改善预测精度"的常见直觉，探索guidance真正的作用来源。
AI.method: 1) 实证分析：在实际使用的尺度下，guidance使后验均值预测变差但样本变好；后验均值预测方差小于数据方差，guidance可恢复该方差。2) 提出variance-matched guidance：闭式规则，通过匹配引导后预测方差与数据方差来选择guidance尺度；可逐噪声层级应用得到无需调参的调度。3) 机理诠释：每个模型对后验均值预测存在随机误差，guidance将两个模型误差之差重缩放为具有后验协方差的样本。并据此提出并验证两个假设：负尺度guidance也可奏效；用模型自身checkpoint自引导需比用独立训练模型引导更大的尺度。
AI.result: 无需调参即复现11个广泛使用模型（图像、视频、音频、运动、世界生成）手工选取的guidance尺度；逐噪声级应用时在SD 3.5 Medium上用户偏好优于手工调度；实验支持负尺度guidance可行及自引导需更大尺度两个新假设。
AI.conclusion: Guidance的本质不是提升预测精度，而是通过重缩放模型间误差差异来恢复后验协方差、补偿方差收缩，从而改善采样。方差匹配提供了无需调参的尺度选择原则，并为guidance机制提供统一解释。

title: PRAM: Activating Latent Multimodal Knowledge through Partwise Reasoning
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://luo1yan.github.io/PRAM/ ; Code: https://github.com/Luo1Yan/PRAM ; Features: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Rowance/PRAM-features
summary: Emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval enable transfer between modalities without direct paired supervision. However, existing methods often prioritize sample-level alignment, overlooking local discriminative information and partwise statistical relations. To this end, we propose partwise reasoning across modalities (PRAM), which activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality. Specifically, we first present a multi-granularity covariance regularization module that estimates covariances from global and local vectors in two collections of modality-pivot pairs, stabilizing local estimates through adaptive blending with their cross-part means. Second, we devise a pivot-based spectral relational reasoning module that infers global and partwise statistical relations between target modalities through regularized covariance composition and extracts paired projection directions and their correlation strengths via whitening and spectral decomposition. Finally, we introduce a multi-granularity score fusion module that standardizes and fuses matching scores from global and local relations, incorporating task-specific information on pivot associations and class semantics for class prediction and candidate ranking. Extensive experiments across ten datasets demonstrate that PRAM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 16 classification settings and 19 retrieval settings, while exhibiting highly competitive performance in three sensing scenarios.

AI.tldr: PRAM通过共享枢轴模态组合部件级统计关系，在冻结编码器上实现跨模态涌现式分类与检索。
AI.motivation: 现有涌现式跨模态分类与检索方法偏重样本级对齐，忽略了局部判别信息与部件间的统计关系，导致跨模态知识迁移不充分。
AI.method: 提出PRAM，包含三个模块：(1)多粒度协方差正则化，从模态-枢轴对的全局与局部向量估计协方差，并用跨部件均值自适应混合以稳定局部估计；(2)基于枢轴的谱关系推理，通过正则化协方差组合推断目标模态间全局与部件统计关系，并以白化与谱分解提取配对投影方向及相关强度；(3)多粒度分数融合，标准化并融合全局与局部匹配分数，引入枢轴关联与类语义的任务特定信息用于分类预测和候选排序。
AI.result: 在十个数据集的16种分类设置和19种检索设置中达到SOTA，并在三种传感场景中表现极具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 利用冻结编码器中的潜在多模态知识、以部件级统计关系替代纯样本级对齐，可有效提升涌现式跨模态分类与检索性能。

title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
summary: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs (0.385 vs. 0.459), sitting 1.0 J&F point below the dense-encoder baseline; at ViT-B the gain over ALGM 0.95 is +3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]. On DAVIS 2017 val it stays within -0.19 J&F of the dense encoder at ViT-S (-0.12 at ViT-B). Controls qualify the result: protecting only the previous mask under ALGM matches or exceeds accuracy at higher FLOPs (0.486), so expectation and surprise mainly reduce counted encoder compute. Practically, lower counted encoder compute did not reduce startup-inclusive mean Cutie step time on a 12-video LVOS sample (3%-8% lower in steady state; an equally engineered ALGM is faster at ViT-S and ViT-B). Section 5.2 separately examines a Cutie permanent-memory schedule and its latency and memory trade-offs. Code: https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv

AI.tldr: 在冻结的DINOv3 ViT + 训练好的Cutie头上加入免训练"关注图"，按分割器预期目标分配分辨率，在长视频上以更少编码器FLOPs接近稠密编码器精度。
AI.motivation: ViT图像编码器在视频目标分割中强但昂贵；现有免训练token合并对全帧均匀降算力，连被跟踪目标也被粗化。仅保护上一帧掩码在长视频中因快速运动失效，目标落入背景合并区且误差锁死。
AI.method: 构建免训练关注图：对速度平移掩码与块匹配掩码取并集，做相机补偿的"surprise"检查，不确定区域交给对比式合并器，全部目标丢失时回落到该合并器。保护区内全分辨率，其余更粗合并。
AI.result: LVOS V2 valid（预注册协议、三个ViT-S种子）：比ALGM 0.98高+2.76 J&F（95%目标CI [+1.22,+4.44]；视频簇 [+0.99,+4.52]），编码器计费FLOPs少16%（0.385 vs 0.459），距稠密基线差1.0 J&F；ViT-B上比ALGM 0.95高+3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]。DAVIS 2017 val距稠密编码器-0.19 J&F（ViT-S）/-0.12（ViT-B）。对照显示仅保护上一掩码的ALGM精度相当或更高但FLOPs更高（0.486）。实际延迟未改善：12视频样本启动含入平均步时无下降（稳态3%–8%），同等工程化的ALGM在ViT-S/ViT-B更快。
AI.conclusion: 期望与surprise机制主要降低计费编码器算力，而非实际时延；精度收益在长视频上稳健但相对稠密编码器仍有差距，实用提速有限。5.2节另讨论Cutie永久记忆调度的延迟与内存权衡。

title: Stranger Things: When Objects Appear Without Their Typical Neighbors
comment: This paper was accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets. Dataset: huggingface.co/datasets/sidgairo18/strange-bench
summary: Visual context is a powerful cue for object recognition: scenes inform what, where, and at what scale objects are likely to appear. Yet over-reliance on context becomes a failure mode when models predict objects based on their typical neighbors rather than the objects' own visual features, which we call typicality bias. While extensively studied in the pre-Transformer era, it has often been assumed that architectural and scale improvements would naturally solve it, and a systematic diagnostic across the modern vision stack remains absent. We provide such a diagnostic framework. We measure typicality bias via normalized pointwise mutual information (NPMI) over object pairs, and introduce STRANGE-Bench (Synthetic Typicality-RANked Grounded Evaluation Benchmark): a photorealistic, layout-controlled benchmark spanning 17 sub-tiers from typical to never-co-occurring object pairs. Across five model families (specialist detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, self-supervised, vision-language, and multimodal large language models) and three recognition tasks (supervised detection, open-vocabulary detection, and classification), the bias is prevalent: gaps of 5-11 p.p. persist when objects appear outside their typical company, and do not consistently shrink with scale. To mitigate it, we turn to data augmentation: existing augmentations are designed for visual diversity, not for breaking co-occurrence shortcuts, and sample from the very distribution that produces typicality bias. We propose Anchor-Atypicality Sampling (AAS), a simple sampling rule for paste-based augmentations that uses the NPMI signal to tilt the training-time co-occurrence distribution toward atypical partners. AAS reduces the typicality gap by up to 1.6 p.p. on natural-image COCO splits and 23.0 p.p. on synthetic STRANGE-Bench across three model families, without sacrificing overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统诊断现代视觉模型中的"典型性偏差"（模型依赖共现上下文而非物体自身特征进行识别），提出测量框架与STRANGE-Bench基准，并给出基于NPMI信号的锚点非典型采样（AAS）增广方法以缓解该偏差。
AI.motivation: 视觉上下文虽有助于识别，但过度依赖会形成失败模式——模型按典型邻居而非物体自身特征预测，即典型性偏差。该问题在Transformer前被研究过，之后普遍被假定随架构与规模改进自然消解，但缺乏跨现代视觉栈的系统诊断。
AI.method: 1) 用物体对上的归一化点互信息（NPMI）度量典型性偏差；2) 构建STRANGE-Bench：真实感、布局可控，涵盖从典型到从不共现的17个子层级；3) 在五类模型族（专用检测器、开放词汇检测器、自监督、视觉语言模型、MLLM）与三类任务（监督检测、开放词汇检测、分类）上评测；4) 提出锚点非典型采样（AAS），一种用于粘贴式增广的采样规则，用NPMI信号将训练期共现分布向非典型伙伴倾斜。
AI.result: 偏差普遍存在：物体出现在非典型同伴中时有5–11个百分点的差距，且不随规模一致缩小。AAS在自然图像COCO划分上最多降低典型性差距1.6个百分点，在合成STRANGE-Bench上最多降低23.0个百分点，覆盖三个模型族，且不损失整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 典型性偏差并未被架构与规模改进消除，需专门诊断与干预；通过干扰训练期共现分布的增广采样可有效缓解偏差且保持整体性能。

title: Atunda: Building an Afrogenic Dance Movement Dataset for AI-Driven Classification
summary: This paper introduces Atunda, the first systematically collected video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves, designed for training and evaluating deep learning models for movement classification. The first phase of the dataset includes nearly 400 videos covering 13 distinct dance moves from African and African Diaspora performative culture, making it the first AI-ready resource of its kind. Using this dataset, we train and evaluate various configurations of temporal convolutional neural networks, achieving a classification accuracy exceeding 95%. The baseline results provide a benchmark for future studies in movement classification, especially in the understudied area of Afrogenic performative culture and tradition. This work lays the foundation for developing in the future digital metrics of similarity, automated attribution systems, and tools that preserve and promote the cultural heritage of Afrogenic dances.

AI.tldr: 提出首个系统采集的非洲裔舞蹈视频数据集Atunda（近400个视频、13种舞步），用于训练和评估动作分类深度学习模型。
AI.motivation: 非洲及非洲侨民表演文化中的舞蹈动作缺乏AI可用的数据集，相关动作分类研究严重不足。
AI.method: 构建Atunda数据集（第一阶段含近400个视频、覆盖13种不同舞步），并用多种配置的时间卷积神经网络（TCN）进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 动作分类准确率超过95%，为后续动作分类研究提供了基线基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来相似度数字化度量、自动归属系统以及非洲裔舞蹈文化遗产保护与推广工具奠定基础。

title: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
summary: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.

AI.tldr: 用仅仿真训练的预测器从单段真实跌落视频估计物体密度归一化刚度 E/ρ 与屈服应力 σ_Y/ρ，并提出 PhysReader 与真实数据集 PhysReader-Real。
AI.motivation: 真实视频无材料标签，只能靠合成数据训练与验证；但合成验证对输入几何表征的排序可能在真实域失效，需要研究何种输入能跨域迁移。
AI.method: 对比 3D 变形 tracklet 与短时 2D 光流 tracklet；PhysReader 读取视频与 2D tracklet，在仿真中通过与"看到精确 3D 变形"的教师模型匹配，学习隐式 3D 提升；并构建 PhysReader-Real（16 个日常物体各跌 5 次，参考材料参数由联合拟合与拉伸测试校验）。
AI.result: 仿真中 3D tracklet 最准，但真实中转移最差，且更优深度（仿真深度、LiDAR、渲染回放精确深度）也无法修复；2D 光流在仿真无效却迁移最佳。在 PhysReader-Real 上 PhysReader 优于所有其他输入与基线；唯一例外是以其预测为初值的逐场景优化器，略更接近但每视频需 49 分钟（vs 12 秒）。
AI.conclusion: 材料属性应从未两个域中都稳定可测的感知量读取，而非仿真中最有信息的量；2D 光流 tracklet + 仿真蒸馏式 3D 提升是最佳跨域方案。

title: Counting Beyond Frames: Codec Motion Tells Frozen Diffusion VLMs How Many
summary: Counting how many times something happens is among the simplest questions about a video and among the hardest for video-language models, autoregressive and diffusion alike. The difficulty lies between the frames: a model samples only a few of them, while each repetition unfolds as movement in between. Video codecs already record this movement densely as block displacements, and codec-based video models use it to shape their visual input. We are the first to show that this motion provides direct evidence for the count: a candidate count is a testable motion hypothesis, and unwinding the cycles it implies measures how strongly the observed directions support it. We present CoDiCount, a unified training-free framework that turns this test into a count potential and applies it while a frozen diffusion vision-language model (dVLM) denoises its answer. At every denoising step, structured count messages map each option letter, or each grammar-valid edit of an open integer, to the count it expresses and reweight the model's own probabilities within that set. Consistent gains over the official decoders on MotionBench, TOMATO, and SVCBench demonstrate the broad generalization of CoDiCount across diffusion models, datasets, and diverse counting tasks. With CoDiCount, a 7B dVLM outperforms GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on MotionBench, surpasses GPT-4o and much larger open models on TOMATO, and matches GPT-5.4 on SVCBench.

AI.tldr: CoDiCount：用编解码器块位移构造“运动假设”来检验候选计数，在冻结扩散VLM去噪过程中重加权，实现免训练计数的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 视频计数对视频语言模型（无论自回归还是扩散）都极难，难点在于“帧间”：模型只采样少数帧，而重复动作发生在帧与帧之间，因此缺乏计数的直接证据。
AI.method: 利用视频编解码器已密集记录的块位移作为运动证据，把候选计数视为可检验的运动假设：展开其蕴含的周期，用观测到的运动方向对该计数假设的支持强度进行度量，形成“计数势”（count potential）。CoDiCount 作为统一免训练框架，将该势在冻结扩散VLM的每一步去噪中注入：对选项字母或开放整数的合法编辑映射到其表达的具体计数，并仅在该集合内重加权模型自身概率。
AI.result: 在 MotionBench、TOMATO、SVCBench 上相对官方解码器取得一致增益，跨扩散模型、数据集与多种计数任务泛化良好；7B dVLM 在 MotionBench 上超过 GPT-5.1 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro，在 TOMATO 上超过 GPT-4o 及更大的开源模型，在 SVCBench 上与 GPT-5.4 持平。
AI.conclusion: 帧间运动（编解码器块位移）是视频计数的直接、被忽视的证据来源；将其形式化为可检验的运动假设并在去噪中约束解码，能以免训练方式大幅提升扩散VLM的计数能力，且不依赖模型规模。

title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
comment: 23 pages, including appendix. Video examples provided as ancillary files
summary: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

AI.tldr: ShowNow 用细粒度推测式流式生成，在播放期间预先准备动作条件未来，实现交互式世界模型的低延迟响应。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需持续生成视频并快速响应用户操作。仅提高实时吞吐无法解决输入延迟：粗粒度生成块延迟动作更新，输入后才生成又把计算加到响应路径上。
AI.method: 提出细粒度推测式流式框架：利用播放期间的可用算力在输入到来前准备动作条件未来；单潜变量承诺支持高频决策，可配置预备1–8个动作；构建匹配多未来数据集训练同一状态的替代延续，并用共享历史树执行与融合承诺提升效率。
AI.result: 单张 H100 上，5B 模型以 480p、16fps 支持 8 个预备未来；ViZDoom 中相比原生块 SolarWM-FT，中位输入到显示延迟由 620ms 降至 208ms；匹配策略实验中重启空 ticks 从 1.56% 降至 0.09%（94%），动作变化的按时响应改善。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度承诺与提前准备具有互补作用，视觉保真度和长时一致性存在可测的权衡；把播放期计算转化为响应式视觉交互。

title: Seeing the Right Context: Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing scene understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret queried targets in relation to nearby objects and surrounding structures, which serve as spatial references or define the scope of an answer. However, standard answers and bounding boxes often leave these contextual relationships implicit. Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K to make them explicit in 5,394 training pairs for visual question answering (VQA), with spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. GeOPD uses these annotations for on-policy distillation, guiding a frozen teacher with region marks on the full image and a visual fact while preserving surrounding spatial references. It prioritizes teacher corrections that agree with the shift in the student's next token distribution when evidence is restored. A complementary objective weights the contrast between the student's scores on the two views by how much masking lowers the teacher's log probability for the same sampled token. Experiments on five remote sensing VQA benchmarks show that GeOPD outperforms the evaluated open-source MLLMs and matched post-training baselines, improving over the 4B and 9B base models by 5.81 and 2.97 percentage points on average. The dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD.

AI.tldr: GeOPD通过构建GeoContext-5K数据集并采用区域标记与视觉事实引导的在线策略蒸馏，让遥感多模态大模型显式利用空间上下文，在五个遥感VQA基准上平均超越4B和9B基座模型5.81和2.97个百分点。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景理解需要MLLM结合邻近物体和周围结构等空间参照来解读目标，但标准答案与边界框往往使这些上下文关系保持隐式，模型难以有效利用。
AI.method: 构建GeoContext-5K（5,394条VQA训练对，含空间线索、视觉事实和支持区域）；采用在线策略蒸馏，用冻结教师模型在全图上加区域标记并附视觉事实进行引导。优先采信在证据恢复时与学生下一token分布偏移相一致的教师纠正，并以掩码导致教师对数概率下降的幅度对两视图分数对比进行加权。
AI.result: 在五个遥感VQA基准上优于所评估的开源MLLM及匹配的后训练基线，相比4B和9B基座模型平均提升5.81和2.97个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模空间上下文并结合证据感知的在线策略蒸馏可有效提升遥感多模态大模型的场景理解能力，数据集与代码将公开。

title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate cross-view interaction. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers-inspired framework that reads complementary knowledge from spatially aligned RGB and wavelet views within a fully frozen visual foundation. ReMoT employs staged joint attention to enable controlled local and global cross-view interaction, while learnable fusion queries progressively read complementary evidence across Transformer depth without writeback. ReMoT achieves 91.2% average accuracy across eight benchmark groups with 3,074 trainable parameters, attaining the highest overall average among the evaluated methods. These results support structured knowledge readout as a promising alternative to backbone adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMoT，一个受Mixture-of-Transformers启发的框架，在完全冻结的视觉基础模型中，从空间对齐的RGB与小波视图读取互补知识，仅用3,074个可训练参数在八组基准上达到91.2%平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型本身已编码可迁移的检测知识，进一步骨干适配反而损害泛化；线性探测仅限末层RGB特征，多线索检测器则面临适配损失可迁移性、异构编码器难以整合、晚期融合缺乏中间跨视图交互等问题。因此需要从"骨干适配"转向"知识读取"。
AI.method: ReMoT受Mixture-of-Transformers启发，在全冻结基础模型中读取RGB与小波两个空间对齐视图的互补知识：采用分阶段联合注意力实现可控的局部与全局跨视图交互，并用可学习的融合查询在Transformer不同深度逐步读取互补证据，且不回写（no writeback）。
AI.result: 在八个基准组上取得91.2%平均准确率，仅需3,074个可训练参数，在所评估方法中整体平均表现最高。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持"结构化知识读取"可作为替代骨干适配的有前景方向。

title: WorldInteract: Controllable Streaming Video Generation for Multi-Material Interactions
summary: Video world models aim to create interactive physical worlds that capture how diverse materials move and interact. Yet material-dependent dynamics remain underexplored in controllable video generation, limiting reliable control in scenes with different materials. We present WorldInteract, a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interaction into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation. External pushes and contact impulses are expressed through a shared velocity-increment interface, allowing material behaviors learned from interaction-free videos to be reused in interacting scenes. A physics controller predicts contacts and computes velocity increments from estimated masses and restitution coefficients, while a causal generator executes these increments using learned material behaviors. This separation enables cross-material interaction without supervised contact videos spanning diverse material pairings and contact configurations. We train the generator on 30k simulated interaction-free videos spanning 22 material classes and introduce Material-Aware RL, using verifiable physical rewards to refine material behavior and control execution. WorldInteract substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Physics-IQ and delivers more reliable push control on real-world images.

AI.tldr: WorldInteract 提出一种流式视频生成框架，将跨材质交互分解为"材质相关行为生成"与"接触响应计算"两部分，通过共享的速度增量接口复用无交互视频中学到的材质行为，并以 Material-Aware RL 用可验证物理奖励精修，实现可控的跨材质交互动画生成。
AI.motivation: 现有可控视频生成对材质相关动力学（materials-dependent dynamics）探索不足，导致在含不同材质的场景中难以可靠控制；同时缺少覆盖多样材质配对与接触配置的带监督接触视频数据。
AI.method: 将跨材质交互解耦为两个模块：(1) 物理控制器预测接触、根据估计的质量与恢复系数计算速度增量；(2) 因果生成器用学到的材质行为执行这些增量。外部推力与接触冲量统一表示为速度增量接口，使无交互视频中学到的材质行为可复用于交互场景。生成器在 22 个材质类别的 3 万条模拟无交互视频上训练，并用 Material-Aware RL 以可验证物理奖励微调行为与控制执行。
AI.result: 在 Physics-IQ 基准上显著优于 SOTA 方法，并在真实图像上实现更可靠的推力控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦材质行为与接触响应、复用无交互数据并引入物理奖励强化学习，可在无需监督接触视频的条件下实现可靠的跨材质交互视频生成与可控操作。

title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
summary: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow

AI.tldr: RevFlow提出"生成即逆向编码"范式，用冻结编码器的中间表示作为逐级生成目标，从深层语义逐步回到浅层细节再解码到像素；并提出统一模型HyC-DiT与语义空间原生匹配实现少步生成。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表示虽加速生成学习，但抽象掉外观与空间细节后，使回到像素的负担转移到更大的解码器上。作者质疑：既然编码器已学习像素到语义的路径，表示到像素的路径为何要独立学习。
AI.method: 以冻结编码器各层中间表示为连续生成目标，先生成深层语义表示，再生成保留外观和空间细节的浅层表示，最后解码为像素；用HyC-DiT（共享标准DiT骨干+各阶段特定条件注入）统一学习各阶段转换，避免每阶段单独训练生成器；并在语义表示空间做原生匹配以支持少步采样。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256上，690M模型5个epoch即达1.96 FID，1.55B模型达1.74 FID；89M解码器实现30.25 dB重建PSNR；经原生匹配适配后，RevFlow-XL单步采样（每阶段一步）达2.85 FID。
AI.conclusion: 复用预训练编码器的逆向路径可显著加速生成模型的学习与采样，兼顾高保真重建与少步高质量生成。

title: SceneDesigner3D: Agentic Evolutionary Search for Principled Rearrangement of 3D Indoor Scenes
summary: Scene rearrangement is an essential task for 3D content creation applications, requiring generation of diverse, aesthetic and functional scene rearrangements. We present SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D indoor scene rearrangement that systematically explores the design space of 3D scenes and generates multiple solutions according to common interior design principles. Given an input scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D represents the rearrangement as an editable program and evolves a population of candidate layouts. Starting from distinct design ideas, a VLM agent mutates the programs by refining promising candidates, exploring new rearrangement strategies or redesigning from scratch, while verifying the layouts for physical validity. Proposals are scored by a VLM judge for adherence to the input prompt and satisfaction of design principles such as balance, zoning and emphasis, as well as numerically computed principles such as circulation and clutter. An archive of top-performing, structurally varied candidates further increases diversity of rearrangements. Experiments on the SAGE-10k and SceneSmith datasets show that SceneDesigner3D improves prompt adherence and computed design principle scores over baselines by up to 5.1% and 15.2%, respectively. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SceneDesigner3D 提出一种基于智能体进化搜索的3D室内场景重排方法，通过进化布局程序并结合VLM评审与数值验证，生成多样且符合设计原则的重排方案。
AI.motivation: 场景重排是3D内容创作的关键任务，需要生成多样、美观且功能合理的场景，但如何系统探索设计空间并兼顾物理有效性与室内设计原则仍是挑战。
AI.method: 将重排表示为可编辑程序，从多个不同设计思路出发进化候选布局种群；VLM智能体通过改进优质候选、探索新策略或重新设计进行变异，并验证布局物理有效性；由VLM评审依据提示遵循度和平衡、分区、强调等原则打分，同时数值计算动线与杂乱度等指标；维护结构多样化的优质候选存档以提升多样性。
AI.result: 在SAGE-10k和SceneSmith数据集上，相比基线，提示遵循度提升最高5.1%，设计原则计算分数提升最高15.2%。
AI.conclusion: 进化式智能体搜索结合VLM评判与数值约束，能有效提升3D场景重排的多样性与设计合理性，代码将公开。

title: CIRKDV2: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation with Contextual Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
summary: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation often guide the student to mimic the teacher's structured information generated from an individual image. However, they ignore the global semantic relations across various images that are valuable for KD. This paper proposes Cross-Image Relational KD V2 (CIRKDV2), which focuses on transferring structured pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations modeled from global images in the dataset. A large teacher network often constructs a well-structured feature space in terms of global contextual dependencies. CIRKDV2 makes the student mimic the better structured semantic relations of the teacher, thus improving the feature representational capability. Beyond relational distillation, we further propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings to match the semantic level with the teacher. This avoids the semantic gap problem between the teacher and student occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. Experimental results on Cityscapes, ADE20K, Pascal VOC, and COCO-Stuff-164K demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic segmentation distillation methods by large margins across various network architectures. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD.

AI.tldr: 提出CIRKDV2，用跨图像全局语义关系（像素-像素、像素-区域、通道-通道）做知识蒸馏，并结合上下文聚合的特征蒸馏，使学生在语义分割上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有语义分割KD方法仅让学生模仿来自单张图像的教师结构化信息，忽略了数据集中跨图像的全局语义关系，而这些关系对KD有价值。
AI.method: CIRKDV2从数据集全局图像建模并迁移三类结构化关系：pixel-to-pixel、pixel-to-region、channel-to-channel；学生模仿教师更优的结构化语义关系以提升特征表征能力。此外提出上下文特征蒸馏，用上下文聚合增强学生像素嵌入，使其与教师语义层级匹配，从而避免传统特征蒸馏中的语义鸿沟问题。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes、ADE20K、Pascal VOC、COCO-Stuff-164K上，多种网络架构下均大幅优于SOTA语义分割蒸馏方法。代码与预训练模型已公开。
AI.conclusion: 跨图像关系蒸馏加上下文特征蒸馏是提升分割KD的有效方案，兼顾全局语义关系迁移与语义鸿沟缓解。

title: WorldExpand: Building Coherent 3D Worlds via Sparse Joint Panoramic Expansion
summary: Constructing complete 3D worlds from a single panorama is challenging because large portions of the scene remain unobserved. Existing panoramic-video methods expand spatial coverage through dense sequential generation, but neighboring frames contain substantial redundancy, long trajectories accumulate errors, and independently generated directions may be inconsistent. We present WorldExpand, which formulates single-panorama world expansion as the generation of sparse, complementary, and high-resolution panoramic observations. This representation concentrates the generation budget on informative scene regions and preserves the fine-grained details required for 3D construction. WorldExpand addresses two key challenges: where to observe and how to synthesize. Our Coverage-Guided View Selection identifies informative target locations using scene-adaptive quadrants and warp-based coverage scores, while our Joint Panoramic Diffusion uses Gaussian-splatting-based geometric warps to jointly synthesize four pose-grounded and cross-view-consistent panoramas. A diagnostic-guided global--local attention schedule retains global attention only in sensitive layers, reducing the training and inference costs of high-resolution joint generation. The resulting posed panoramas can be directly fed into an existing reconstruction pipeline to build an explicit 3D representation. Experiments show that WorldExpand recovers content behind occluders and around distant corners, improves both novel-view synthesis and downstream 3D reconstruction metrics across various datasets, and generalizes robustly to diverse in-the-wild scenes. WorldExpand runs significantly faster than the state-of-the-art panoramic-video method while producing higher-resolution observations with stronger cross-view consistency.

AI.tldr: WorldExpand 将单全景图的三维世界扩展重构为"稀疏、互补、高分辨率全景观测"的生成问题，通过覆盖率引导视角选择与联合全景扩散模型生成四个位姿锚定、跨视角一致的全景图，再送入现成重建流程构建显式三维表示。
AI.motivation: 单张全景图构建完整3D世界时大量区域未被观测。现有全景视频方法靠密集序列生成扩展覆盖，但相邻帧冗余大、长轨迹误差累积、独立生成的方向间不一致，且计算开销大、分辨率受限。
AI.method: 提出两条主线：(1) Coverage-Guided View Selection，用场景自适应象限与基于 warp 的覆盖率分数挑选高信息量目标位置；(2) Joint Panoramic Diffusion，借助高斯泼溅几何 warp 联合合成四张位姿锚定且跨视角一致的全景图。此外设计诊断引导的全局-局部注意力调度，仅在敏感层保留全局注意力，降低高分辨率联合生成的训练与推理成本。
AI.result: 能恢复遮挡物后方与远处转角内容；在多个数据集上提升新视角合成与下游3D重建指标；对多样 in-the-wild 场景鲁棒泛化；相比SOTA全景视频方法显著更快，且分辨率更高、跨视角一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: 以稀疏互补高分辨率观测替代密集序列生成，是可行的单全景世界扩展范式，兼顾质量、一致性与效率，并可直接接入现有重建管线生成显式3D表示。

title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
summary: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.

AI.tldr: SPIRE：一种传感器驱动的语义脉冲框架，从单条脉冲流中实现光照鲁棒的目标检测，用曝光自适应+渐进前缀累积视图+脉冲时序编码+残差校正，在仿真VOC/COCO和真实PKU-Vidar-DVS上显著超越基线且计算量更低。
AI.motivation: 欠曝削弱物体细节、过曝模糊边界，传统相机在极端光照下检测性能下降。脉冲相机将光编码为高频二值流，其长窗口计数提供稳定外观线索、短观测揭示发放率变化，具备抗光照退化的潜力，但如何充分利用单条脉冲流的多尺度时域信息并融合语义（ANN）与脉冲特征尚待解决。
AI.method: 提出SPIRE：1) 用全包观测经面向检测的光照自适应构建外观视图；2) 由逐渐增长的前缀构建累积视图序列，每个前缀给出率图、边缘图及随脉冲累积的率差；3) 在选定尺度上，用ANN特征与脉冲初始化共同设定初始膜电位与发放阈值，使语义线索塑造时序编码响应；4) 训练时用局部脉冲计数对比监督双分支，将实测与ANN预测对比的残差结合脉冲特征，对融合特征金字塔产生有界校正（SPIRE-D）。
AI.result: 仿真VOC与COCO上，SPIRE-D在四种欠曝/过曝设置下比最强基线高4.00–5.50 AP50；真实PKU-Vidar-DVS录制上达67.07 AP50、40.10 AP75；MACs比SPFD少50.4%。
AI.conclusion: SPIRE通过传感器驱动的语义-脉冲融合与多前缀时域编码，实现了光照鲁棒的目标检测，在仿真与真实数据上均取得领先精度并显著降低计算开销，验证了单脉冲流中外观与时序信息结合的有效性。

title: Diffusion Steering via Adaptive Reward Estimation and Resampling
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate images that satisfy complex prompts, yet often produce images that omit requested objects, attributes, or relationships. We ask if models can more reliably generate text-aligned images by redistributing probability toward their more successful outcomes. We propose TrailMix, a training-free method that uses the base model's distribution of possible outcomes to adaptively guide generation toward better text alignment. During denoising, TrailMix generates inexpensive lookahead images from parallel trajectories (trails) and scores their alignment with the prompt using an external judge. The resulting distribution of reward scores allows us to estimate how strongly to steer generation toward a desired alignment level. We use these estimates to reweight and resample trajectories, favoring more promising outcomes. Across three text-to-image benchmarks, TrailMix outperforms existing baselines, with particularly strong gains on rare multi-object compositions. We further extend TrailMix to targeted image editing and introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance), a systematic benchmark evaluating whether semantic edits preserve other image content. Experiments on SEAM-Bench and existing benchmark PIE-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for controlled image editing. Our results show how a model's own possible outcomes can inform reliable and controllable generation.

AI.tldr: TrailMix 是一种无需训练的文本到图像生成方法：在去噪过程中用并行轨迹生成廉价的 lookahead 图像，借助外部评判器给其与提示词的对齐度打分，据此估计应施加的引导强度，并对轨迹重加权与重采样，从而把概率质量转移到更符合文本的结果上。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型虽能响应复杂提示词，却常遗漏所要求的物体、属性或关系。作者希望验证：模型能否通过把概率质量重新分配给其自身更成功的生成结果，更可靠地产出与文本对齐的图像。
AI.method: TrailMix 为无训练方法。去噪时从并行轨迹采样生成低成本 lookahead 图像，用外部评判器评估其与提示词的对齐度；由这些奖励分数的分布估计应向目标对齐水平引导的强度，再据此对轨迹重加权和重采样；同时扩展至定向图像编辑，并提出 SEAM-Bench 基准评估语义编辑对其他内容的保持。
AI.result: 在三个文本到图像基准上优于现有基线，在稀有多物体组合上增益尤为显著；在 SEAM-Bench 与 PIE-Bench 上的实验表明该方法在受控图像编辑中有效。
AI.conclusion: 模型自身可能的结果分布可用于指导可靠且可控的生成；基于自身结果重分配概率是实现更好文本对齐的有效途径。

title: TIDE-Flow: Fine-Grained Temporal Evidence and Structured Displacement Matching for Spike Optical Flow
summary: Spike cameras capture high-speed motion through an integrate-and-fire mechanism, providing fine-grained temporal observations without exposure blur. However, their binary streams encode accumulated illumination rather than instantaneous intensity, making reliable motion estimation challenging. Existing spike-based methods exploit temporal aggregation to construct motion representations, but this process may weaken fine-grained firing patterns. Meanwhile, correlation-based estimators often rely on learned matching features without explicitly characterizing the spatial distribution and ambiguity of candidate displacements. To address these challenges, we propose TIDE-Flow, a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that jointly exploits Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) and Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE). TIE combines raw spike patterns, multi-scale firing statistics, temporal moments, and boundary-aware interval cues, preserving complementary temporal information before spatial feature compression. DEE further integrates structured candidate-grid features with explicit displacement statistics to characterize matching geometry and competing correspondences. Both components are incorporated into a difference-correlation recurrent refinement framework, enabling effective temporal motion modeling and correspondence estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TIDE-Flow, with controlled ablations validating the contributions of temporal and displacement evidence modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 TIDE-Flow 脉冲相机光流估计框架，通过时序积分证据（TIE）与位移证据编码（DEE）提升运动估计可靠性。
AI.motivation: 脉冲相机输出二值累积光照而非瞬时强度，现有方法靠时序聚合构造运动表示会削弱细粒度放电模式；基于相关的估计器依赖学习匹配特征，却未显式刻画候选位移的空间分布与歧义。
AI.method: TIE 融合原始脉冲模式、多尺度放电统计、时序矩及边界感知区间线索，在空间特征压缩前保留互补时序信息；DEE 结合结构化候选网格特征与显式位移统计，刻画匹配几何与竞争对应；二者嵌入差分相关循环细化框架。
AI.result: 大量实验验证 TIDE-Flow 的有效性，受控消融实验证实时序证据与位移证据建模的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合显式建模时序证据与位移不确定性，可改善脉冲相机下的光流估计，为细粒度运动表征与对应估计提供有效思路。

title: DocDUR-Net: Degradation-Aware Unified Document Image Restoration
summary: Captured document images often suffer from diverse degradations caused by uncontrolled imaging conditions, which reduce readability and obscure fine text structures. Single-degradation restoration methods are usually trained and deployed for individual degradation types, and therefore require model selection before restoration. Unified restoration models alleviate the need to maintain multiple restoration networks by sharing one network across tasks, but representative unified document image restoration methods still depend on external task selection. This dependency limits automatic document image restoration. We propose DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified restoration network that derives restoration guidance directly from the input image. It introduces a Degradation Perception Module (DPM) to extract degradation representations and predict degradation weights, and Degradation Prior-guided Adaptive Feature Fusion (DP-AFF) to combine learnable degradation priors with degradation features extracted from the input. The resulting guidance is injected into a shared restoration backbone, enabling adaptive restoration without external task selection. DocDUR-Net also supports a manual mode with explicit task selection. Experiments on document image restoration benchmarks show that DocDUR-Net achieves the best average PSNR of 29.405 dB and SSIM of 0.960 among unified methods while remaining competitive with single-degradation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DocDUR-Net，一种从输入图像自身推导退化引导的统一文档图像修复网络，无需外部任务选择。
AI.motivation: 单一退化修复方法需针对每种退化单独训练并部署，部署前需模型选择；现有统一方法虽共享一个网络，但仍依赖外部任务选择，限制了全自动文档修复。
AI.method: 引入退化感知模块（DPM）提取退化表示并预测退化权重；提出退化先验引导的自适应特征融合（DP-AFF），将可学习退化先验与输入提取的退化特征结合；将引导注入共享修复主干，实现自适应修复，同时保留手动指定任务模式。
AI.result: 在文档图像修复基准上，统一方法中取得最佳平均PSNR 29.405 dB和SSIM 0.960，并与单一退化方法相比具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DocDUR-Net通过输入驱动的退化感知实现了无需外部任务选择的统一文档图像修复，性能优于同类统一方法。

title: Towards Closing the Performance Gap in Cross-Modal Place Recognition
summary: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) matches natural language descriptions against databases of geo-tagged reference images, enabling localization without visual queries. Despite its potential for language-guided navigation, existing vision-language models lag far behind visual place recognition (VPR) baselines, even after task adaptation. Unlike general-purpose text-to-image retrieval, place recognition relies on subtle local cues to distinguish visually similar locations. We therefore hypothesize that a primary bottleneck in CMPR is capturing fine-grained correspondences between image regions and text details, which requires higher visual token granularity, strong text representation capacity, and local cross-modal matching. To address this challenge, we propose CrossPlace, a two-stage CMPR framework. Stage 1 performs global retrieval by pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder, while Stage 2 refines top candidates using a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker. Through systematic analysis, we isolate the drivers of retrieval accuracy and show that visual token density provides the largest performance improvement, while text encoder capacity and task fine-tuning offer complementary gains. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we also extend CMPR evaluation to city-scale and severe weather and illumination settings. Across all existing and new benchmarks, CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 improvements over prior cross-modal methods, closes the gap to unimodal text retrieval, and narrows it to unimodal VPR. Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段跨模态地点识别框架CrossPlace：第一阶段用DINOv2-B/14视觉骨干+BGE-Large文本编码器做全局检索，第二阶段用轻量token级交叉注意力重排，实现R@1两位数提升。
AI.motivation: 跨模态地点识别（CMPR）用自然语言描述匹配地理标记参考图像，可支撑语言导航，但现有视觉语言模型即使经过任务适配也远落后于视觉地点识别（VPR）基线。作者认为瓶颈在于细粒度图像区域-文本细节对应，需要更高视觉token粒度、更强文本表示与局部跨模态匹配。
AI.method: 两阶段CMPR框架：Stage 1全局检索，联合对齐的DINOv2-B/14视觉骨干配合渐进微调的BGE-Large文本编码器；Stage 2用轻量token级交叉注意力重排器对Top候选精排。并通过系统性消融隔离检索精度驱动因素。
AI.result: 视觉token密度带来最大性能提升，文本编码器容量与任务微调提供互补增益；在现有及新构建基准上（含城市尺度、恶劣天气与光照），CrossPlace相对此前跨模态方法R@1提升两位数，缩小了与单模态文本检索的差距，并缩小与单模态VPR的差距。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度token级跨模态匹配是CMPR的关键，视觉token密度是首要驱动因素；同时将评估扩展到城市尺度与恶劣条件，代码与基准已开源。

title: ProbFaS: Probabilistic Video Frame Selection for MLLMs via Multi-Fidelity Calibration
summary: Processing long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is prohibitively expensive, making informative frame selection essential for accurate video understanding. The default uniform sampling often misses task-relevant keyframes, while recent training-free selectors instead pick frames by how well each one matches the question under an image-text alignment (ITA) score. However, we show that ITA signals correspond poorly with the MLLM's true needs: their rankings correlate weakly with downstream accuracy and are even negatively correlated on over 40% of questions, whereas the MLLM's internal yes/no judgment yields a much stronger signal. We present ProbFaS, a training- and label-free probabilistic pipeline that fuses both signals for key frame selection. ProbFaS treats dense ITA scores as cheap, biased measurements and sparse MLLM judgments as accurate, costly ones, unifying them via co-kriging, a multi-fidelity Gaussian process, to calibrate relevance across all frames. A temporal determinantal point process then selects frames capturing relevance peaks while preserving temporal coverage. Across Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench, ProbFaS is the most accurate among fourteen state-of-the-art training-free selectors and uniform sampling in 13 of 15 settings (8-128 frames), outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 3.1 percentage points. On MLVU and LongVideoBench, 32 ProbFaS frames match or surpass the top baseline at 128 frames and uniform sampling with up to 768 frames.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProbFaS，一个无需训练和标注的概率式关键帧选择流程，融合稠密但偏置的图像-文本对齐（ITA）分数与稀疏但准确的 MLLM yes/no 判断，通过协同克里金（多保真高斯过程）校准全帧相关性，再用时间行列式点过程选帧。
AI.motivation: 长视频用 MLLM 处理代价高昂，需选帧。均匀采样漏掉任务关键帧；现有免训练选择器依赖 ITA 分数，但作者发现 ITA 排名与下游准确率相关性弱，甚至在超 40% 问题上呈负相关，而 MLLM 内部 yes/no 判断信号更强。
AI.method: 将稠密 ITA 分数视为廉价有偏测量、稀疏 MLLM 判断视为昂贵准确测量，用 co-kriging（多保真高斯过程）统一校准所有帧的相关性；随后用时间行列式点过程（temporal DPP）选取兼顾相关性峰值与时间覆盖的帧。全程无需训练与标签。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 上，15 个设置中 13 个优于 14 种免训练选择器和均匀采样，最高超最强基线 3.1 个百分点；MLVU 和 LongVideoBench 上 32 帧即追平或超过 128 帧最强基线及最多 768 帧的均匀采样。
AI.conclusion: ITA 信号与 MLLM 真实需求不匹配，需结合 MLLM 内部判断；ProbFaS 以多保真高斯过程融合两种信号并配合时间覆盖选帧，显著提升长视频理解效率与精度。

title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
summary: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic LongLive：一种异步式 agent 记忆系统，为实时自回归视频生成提供人物/物体/场景的文本与图像长期记忆，在不拖慢生成的前提下显著提升长故事一致性。
AI.motivation: 实时自回归视频生成器可以流式生成数分钟视频并即时接受新提示，但难以在长交互叙事中保持人物、物体与场景一致；已有的 agent 式离线多镜头方案需要预先读取完整脚本、逐镜头规划并重生成失败镜头，与直播式生成不兼容。
AI.method: 采用独立 GPU 上的异步记忆 agent：只读取已揭示的提示词、不看生成视频，为每个实体维护文本状态与演化图像；由此合成全局图像与单镜头记忆图像，由辅助 GPU 在下个镜头开始前预填入生成器的 attention sink，并写出实体卡片；用强化学习训练小语言模型（奖励由下游视频效果校准的图像奖励），在未知下一提示前决定记住什么。另构建逐镜头揭示的 LongStory-Online 基准（25 个故事、857 个镜头）。
AI.result: 相较基座 LongLive-2.0，持久状态准确率提升 26.3 点、主角身份 44.9 点、重访地点一致性 40.4 点，额外生成时间约 1%（H100）；单台 8×B200 节点上 BF16 生成达 34.3 FPS（快于实时），14 分钟故事画质稳定；在两个 MiniMax-H3 生成器上身份指标亦提升，其中 LongLive-H3 可与其同时实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 据称是首个由 LLM agent 维护文本与图像记忆的实时视频生成器，证明异步 agent 记忆可与在线流式生成解耦并存，实现长时一致性提升且几乎无额外延迟。

title: LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
summary: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE.
